## What works

- Overview with live sandbox counts, searchable employee directory/detail, employee directory sort controls, HR directory search/status filters/sorting, synthetic directory/workflow label-count summaries, searchable/mapped-filterable/sortable employee-linked record counts with all/visible CSV, sortable raw attendance register with a raw-only month calendar and searchable/filterable/sortable coverage report, cross-module sandbox search/export, Requests & tickets, searchable/sortable read-only Team roster with read-only detail view, and a temporary 2026 monthly statutory preview. Employee details open from a native keyboard-operable button without overriding table semantics; result counts and form feedback use polite status regions.
- Java employee/attendance services plus a workflow service. Local preview workflow and raw attendance-entry records are held in Java process memory; Firebase mode uses the signed-in user’s Firestore subcollections. Raw attendance remains read-only in Firebase mode.
- Leave requests and tickets validate inputs, derive employee names from the caller’s own synthetic directory, show documented queue labels, and support owner-sandbox cancellation. A monthly leave-request calendar displays pending/cancelled request dates only and can draft form bounds from two selected dates; it does not imply approval, submit a request, calculate days, or show balances. Search/status/type and inclusive requested-date-overlap filters, plus selectable table sorting, narrow the leave history display only; they do not change the calendar markers. Separate CSV controls export visible or all records. Row details reveal the submitted note/message and UTC timestamps without adding a reviewer workflow. Both local and Firestore workflow histories default to newest first; optional table sorting does not change storage order or all-record exports. Ticket lists also filter by stored type; workflow tables offer visible-only or all-record CSV export. No reviewer/approval/resolve/delete routes exist. The user has published the rules; live tests confirmed leave and ticket create/cancel persistence, plus cross-user denial.
- Read-only Team roster plus a synthetic directory editor. In Firebase mode, signed-in users can create/edit only name, department, role label, location, and demo status in their own sandbox. Local preview has no user authentication and shares one process-memory store for that API process. IDs are server-generated; delete, termination, schedule, salary, and government-ID fields are not exposed. New employees receive no schedule mapping, so attendance queries remain empty and raw capture rejects them rather than assigning one. A local-only attendance form can create a raw DEMO row for existing mapped synthetic employees; it enforces unique schedule/date and time order. Firebase attendance stays read-only; no correction, hours, or payroll calculation is included. This is not an HR role or a production employee-admin workflow.
- Employee detail now includes a read-only employee-specific ledger of raw attendance times and stored leave/ticket labels. The attendance register adds a month calendar showing only loaded raw row dates/times; selecting two dates applies an inclusive raw-record filter. Blank dates do not mean absence or unworked.
- CSV export for currently visible synthetic employee results, filtered HR directory and Team roster rows, loaded raw attendance rows, visible attendance coverage rows, synthetic directory, workflow label-count, and employee-linked count summaries, and either visible or all owner-sandbox workflow records. A read-only workspace JSON bundle and cross-module search use only owner-scoped GETs and include no payroll preview inputs, credentials, calculated hours, or pay. CSV cells are quoted and spreadsheet-formula prefixes are neutralized.

Logic is isolated in versioned rules/calculator modules; it is client-side only, is not retained, and can be exported as a clearly labelled preview CSV that is not a payslip.

Unmapped employees are labeled as unmapped, not absent. The attendance date fields default to that employee's earliest/latest available records, following the earlier MO-IT108 Requirements Analysis; the user can narrow the range. This is not a payroll-period calendar. The attendance API and reports do not derive hours or pay; the separate statutory preview uses only manually entered synthetic monthly bases.
- Firebase email/password sign-in, development-account creation, and password-reset email UI; reset responses do not disclose whether an email has an account. The app stays behind the sign-in gate when Firebase config is complete.

## Not implemented / important limits

- No production hosting, HR authorization roles, admin controls, audit trail, automated backup/restore, or production security review. The JSON download is a portable snapshot, not a restore path. The built-in JDK HTTP server is a learning prototype, not a hardened public service.
- No live employee, attendance, or payroll information. Do not use this prototype for payroll processing.
- A temporary 2026 monthly statutory preview is available with explicit synthetic inputs; its formulas/rates are isolated in `web/payroll-rules-2026.js` and `web/payroll-preview-2026.js`. There is still no work-hour derivation, attendance-to-gross formula, semi-monthly tax/split handling, saved payroll run, or payslip. The supplied material does not define the full attendance mechanics or exact cutoff/deduction allocation, so those are not inferred.
- Leave/ticket records are persistent only in the signed-in user’s sandbox after the updated rules are published; the current local preview uses process memory. There is no supervisor/reviewer role, real queue delivery, approval, notification, audit trail, team assignment, HR lifecycle editing, attendance import, or approved source-system integration.

17:# Incremental Implementation
19:## Overview
21:Build in thin vertical slices — implement one piece, test it, verify it, then expand. Avoid implementing an entire feature in one pass. Each increment should leave the system in a working, testable state. This is the execution discipline that makes large features manageable.
23:## When to Use
28:- Any time you're tempted to write more than ~100 lines before testing
32:## The Increment Cycle
42:│          Next slice                  │
47:For each slice:
50:2. **Test** — run the test suite (or write a test if none exists)
51:3. **Verify** — confirm the slice works as expected (tests pass, build succeeds, manual check)
53:5. **Move to the next slice** — carry forward, don't restart
55:## Slicing Strategies
75:Each slice delivers working end-to-end functionality.
83:Slice 1a: Implement backend against the contract + API tests
85:Slice 2: Integrate and test end-to-end
100:## Implementation Rules
124:Three similar lines of code is better than a premature abstraction. Implement the naive, obviously-correct version first. Optimize only after correctness is proven with tests.
148:Each increment changes one logical thing. Don't mix concerns:
156:After each increment, the project must build and existing tests must pass. Don't leave the codebase in a broken state between slices.
160:If a feature isn't ready for users but you need to merge increments:
171:This lets you merge small increments to the main branch without exposing incomplete work.
187:Each increment should be independently revertable:
191:- Database migrations should have corresponding rollback migrations
194:## Working with Agents
196:When directing an agent to implement incrementally:
202:Don't touch the UI yet — we'll do that in the next increment.
204:After implementing, run the repository's test and build commands to
205:verify nothing is broken."
208:Be explicit about what's in scope and what's NOT in scope for each increment.
210:## Increment Checklist
212:After each increment, verify with the repository's own commands (see the test-driven-development skill's Discover the Stack First section):
215:- [ ] All existing tests still pass (the repository's test command: `npm test`, `./gradlew test`, `pytest`, ...)
222:**Note:** Run each verification command after a change that could affect it. After a successful run, don't repeat the same command unless the code has changed since — re-running on unchanged code adds no information.
224:## Common Rationalizations
228:| "I'll test it all at the end" | Bugs compound. A bug in Slice 1 makes Slices 2-5 wrong. Test each slice. |
230:| "These changes are too small to commit separately" | Small commits are free. Large commits hide bugs and make rollbacks painful. |

17:# API and Interface Design
19:## Overview
23:## When to Use
26:- Defining module boundaries or contracts between teams
31:## Core Principles
35:> With a sufficient number of users of an API, all observable behaviors of your system will be depended on by somebody, regardless of what you promise in the contract.
37:This means: every public behavior — including undocumented quirks, error message text, timing, and ordering — becomes a de facto contract once users depend on it. Design implications:
42:- **Tests are not enough.** Even with perfect contract tests, Hyrum's Law means "safe" changes can break real users who depend on undocumented behavior.
46:Avoid forcing consumers to choose between multiple versions of the same dependency or API. Diamond dependency problems arise when different consumers need different versions of the same thing. Design for a world where only one version exists at a time — extend rather than fork.
50:Define the interface before implementing it. The contract is the spec — implementation follows.
53:// Define the contract first
74:Pick one error strategy and use it everywhere:
77:// REST: HTTP status codes + structured error body
78:// Every error response follows the same shape
80:  error: {
89:// 401 → Not authenticated
90:// 403 → Authenticated but not authorized
92:// 409 → Conflict (duplicate, version mismatch)
94:// 500 → Server error (never expose internal details)
97:**Don't mix patterns.** If some endpoints throw, others return null, and others return `{ error }` — the consumer can't predict behavior.
104:// Validate at the API boundary
109:      error: {
112:        details: result.error.flatten(),
117:  // After validation, internal code trusts the types
123:Where validation belongs:
131:Where validation does NOT belong:
132:- Between internal functions that share type contracts
169:Accepting an `Idempotency-Key` is the contract. Honouring it is the implementation, and it is where the money is lost — a key the server accepts but handles carelessly is worse than no key at all, because the client now believes retrying is safe.
211:    error: { code: 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED', message: 'Idempotency key reused with a different payload' },
230:## REST API Patterns
283:## TypeScript Interface Patterns
336:## Common Rationalizations
343:| "We'll version the API when we need to" | Breaking changes without versioning break consumers. Design for extension from the start. |
345:| "We can just maintain two versions" | Multiple versions multiply maintenance cost and create diamond dependency problems. Prefer the One-Version Rule. |
346:| "Internal APIs don't need contracts" | Internal consumers are still consumers. Contracts prevent coupling and enable parallel work. |
347:| "Accepting the Idempotency-Key header is enough" | The header is the contract; storing the key against the result is the implementation. A key you accept but don't honour tells the client retrying is safe when it isn't. |

17:# Test-Driven Development (TDD)
19:## Overview
21:Write the test first. Watch it fail. Write minimal code to pass.
23:**Core principle:** If you didn't watch the test fail, you don't know if it tests the right thing.
27:## When to Use
42:## The Iron Law
48:Write code before the test? Delete it. Start over.
52:- Don't "adapt" it while writing tests
56:Implement fresh from tests. Period.
58:## Red-Green-Refactor
63:    red [label="RED\nWrite failing test", shape=box, style=filled, fillcolor="#ffcccc"];
64:    verify_red [label="Verify fails\ncorrectly", shape=diamond];
65:    green [label="GREEN\nMinimal code", shape=box, style=filled, fillcolor="#ccffcc"];
66:    verify_green [label="Verify passes\nAll green", shape=diamond];
70:    red -> verify_red;
71:    verify_red -> green [label="yes"];
72:    verify_red -> red [label="wrong\nfailure"];
73:    green -> verify_green;
74:    verify_green -> refactor [label="yes"];
75:    verify_green -> green [label="no"];
76:    refactor -> verify_green [label="stay\ngreen"];
77:    verify_green -> next;
78:    next -> red;
84:Write one minimal test showing what should happen.
88:test('retries failed operations 3 times', async () => {
92:    if (attempts < 3) throw new Error('fail');
102:Clear name, tests real behavior, one thing
107:test('retry works', async () => {
116:Vague name, tests mock not code
129:npm test path/to/test.test.ts
133:- Test fails (not errors)
137:**Test passes?** You're testing existing behavior. Fix test.
139:**Test errors?** Fix error, re-run until it fails correctly.
143:Write simplest code to pass the test.
158:Just enough to pass
174:Over-engineered
177:Don't add features, refactor other code, or "improve" beyond the test.
184:npm test path/to/test.test.ts
188:- Test passes
189:- Other tests still pass
192:**Test fails?** Fix code, not test.
194:**Other tests fail?** Fix now.
196:**"Other tests" means the project's suite, not just your file.** A
197:green run of the test you wrote is not a green suite. Before you call
198:the change done, run the project's test command (bare `pytest`,
199:`npm test`, `cargo test` — whatever the repo uses) even when your task
200:named only one test file. A scope statement in your task bounds the
201:deliverable, not your verification. Any failure that run shows —
202:including one you didn't cause — goes in your report by name; a red
203:test you watched scroll past and didn't mention is a report falsified
208:After green only:
213:Keep tests green. Don't add behavior.
217:Next failing test for next feature.
219:## Good Tests
223:| **Minimal** | One thing. "and" in name? Split it. | `test('validates email and domain and whitespace')` |
224:| **Clear** | Name describes behavior | `test('test1')` |
225:| **Shows intent** | Demonstrates desired API | Obscures what code should do |
227:When writing or changing any test, read [writing-good-tests.md](writing-good-tests.md) for the rules that keep tests honest:
228:- Name the production change that would make the test fail — before writing it
230:- Keep test-only code in test utilities, out of production classes
233:## Common Rationalizations
237:| "Too simple to test" | Simple code breaks. Test takes 30 seconds. |
238:| "I'll test after" | Tests written after pass immediately — which proves nothing. They may test the wrong thing, test the implementation instead of the behavior, or miss the edge case you forgot. You never watched it fail, so you never proved it can catch the bug. Test-first forces that failure. |
239:| "Tests after achieve same goals (spirit not ritual)" | Tests-after answer "what does this do?"; tests-first answer "what should this do?" Tests written after are biased by the code you already wrote — you verify the cases you remembered, not the ones you'd have discovered. Coverage without proof the tests work. |
240:| "Already manually tested" | Manual testing is ad-hoc: no record of what you covered, no way to re-run it when the code changes, easy to forget cases under pressure. "Worked when I tried it" ≠ comprehensive. Automated tests run the same way every time. |
241:| "Deleting X hours is wasteful" | Sunk cost fallacy — that time is already spent either way. The real choice: rewrite with TDD (high confidence) vs. keep it and bolt tests on after (low confidence, likely bugs). Keeping code you can't trust is the waste. |
242:| "Keep as reference, write tests first" | You'll adapt it. That's testing after. Delete means delete. |
244:| "Test hard = design unclear" | Listen to test. Hard to test = hard to use. |
246:| "Manual test faster" | Manual doesn't prove edge cases. You'll re-test every change. |
247:| "Existing code has no tests" | You're improving it. Add tests for existing code. |
249:## Red Flags - STOP and Start Over
251:- Code before test
253:- Test passes immediately
254:- Can't explain why test failed
257:- "I already manually tested it"
267:## Example: Bug Fix
273:test('rejects empty email', async () => {
275:  expect(result.error).toBe('Email required');
281:$ npm test
282:FAIL: expected 'Email required', got undefined
289:    return { error: 'Email required' };
297:$ npm test
304:## Verification Checklist
308:- [ ] Every new function/method has a test
309:- [ ] Watched each test fail before implementing
310:- [ ] Each test failed for expected reason (feature missing, not typo)
311:- [ ] Wrote minimal code to pass each test
312:- [ ] All tests pass
315:- [ ] Edge cases and errors covered
319:## When Stuck
323:| Don't know how to test | Write wished-for API. Write assertion first. Ask your human partner. |

# Local demo inventory

This note separates unauthenticated process-memory behavior from Firebase-backed owner-sandbox behavior. It is not an acceptance rubric or a production-readiness claim.

## Local process-memory mode

- Selected when the API runs without a Firebase project ID. The browser shows `LOCAL PREVIEW`; there is no user sign-in boundary. Directory/workflow/raw records are shared by callers of that local API process and reset when the process stops.
- Synthetic employee create/update is limited to the allowed display fields. IDs are server-generated. New employees receive no schedule mapping.
- Raw attendance queries are read-only as a view; the explicitly authorized **create-only** demo form is the exception. It accepts an existing mapped synthetic employee, date, time-in, and time-out. The server supplies the existing schedule ID and `DEMO` label; the store enforces unique schedule/date and `timeIn <= timeOut`. No correction, delete, schedule assignment, attendance classification, hours, or pay is added.
- Leave/ticket workflows are synthetic, process-memory records with their existing submit/cancel limits; no reviewer, approval, resolution, or delivery action is present.
- The temporary statutory calculator takes fictional browser inputs and is not persisted or connected to attendance, employees, or a payroll API.
- The read-only raw attendance calendar (including its two-date inclusive filter), employee linked-record detail and searchable/mapped-filterable/sortable stored count summary with visible/all CSV, cross-module search, workflow type filters, visible/all CSV exports, and JSON workspace export use the same local demo service. The JSON export includes only the current synthetic records and marks `hoursCalculated:false`, `payrollIncluded:false`; search/export issue reads only.

## Firebase user-sandbox mode

- The app requires Firebase Email/Password sign-in when client configuration is complete; API reads/writes use the caller's user-scoped paths and existing published rules.
- Employee display fields and owner-scoped workflow routes retain their previously accepted limits. The employee-linked record view, raw attendance calendar, cross-module search, and JSON bundle use user-scoped reads.
- **Firebase attendance stays read-only.** `POST /api/attendance` is rejected with `403` before a storage service is accessed. No Firebase attendance write has been introduced.
- No user roles, employee-account mapping, supervisor/team boundaries, approvals, schedule assignment, attendance calculations, payroll inputs, or persisted pay/payslip workflow are introduced by this slice.

## Local acceptance evidence

- Java domain/service checks cover mapping, fixed day type, unique schedule/date, time order, and unmapped employee rejection.
- Java API integration checks cover the local `201` response metadata, duplicate `409`, invalid `400`, fixed server mapping/classification, client-supplied schedule rejection, and Firebase-mode `403`.
- Browser E2E covers successful local capture, duplicate/mapping/time-order rejection, raw calendar display, employee-linked rows, type-filtered visible exports, cross-module search, JSON export contents, and read-only HTTP methods for bundle/search.
- Latest fully run checks and their counts are recorded in `README.md` and `docs/peer-parity-roadmap.md`.

148:## Scope and security
rules_version = '2';
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {
    function signedInAs(uid) {
      return request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == uid;
    }

    function validDemoEmployee(employeeId) {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.keys().hasAll(['id', 'name', 'department', 'role', 'location', 'status'])
        && d.keys().hasOnly(['id', 'name', 'department', 'role', 'location', 'status'])
        && d.id is string && d.id == employeeId && d.id.size() <= 40
        && d.name is string && d.name.size() > 0 && d.name.size() <= 100
        && d.department is string && d.department.size() > 0 && d.department.size() <= 100
        && d.role is string && d.role.size() > 0 && d.role.size() <= 100
        && d.location is string && d.location.size() > 0 && d.location.size() <= 100
        && d.status in ['Active', 'On leave'];
    }

    function validDemoAttendance() {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.keys().hasAll(['attendanceId', 'scheduleId', 'date', 'timeIn', 'timeOut', 'dayType'])
        && d.keys().hasOnly(['attendanceId', 'scheduleId', 'date', 'timeIn', 'timeOut', 'dayType'])
        && d.attendanceId is int && d.attendanceId > 0
        && d.scheduleId is int && d.scheduleId > 0
        && d.date is string && d.date.matches('^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$')
        && d.timeIn is string && d.timeIn.matches('^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')
        && d.timeOut is string && d.timeOut.matches('^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')
        && d.dayType == 'DEMO';
    }

    function ownsDemoEmployee(uid, employeeId, employeeName) {
      let employeePath = /databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(uid)/demoEmployees/$(employeeId);
      return employeeId is string
        && (employeeId.matches('^DEMO-[0-9]{3}$') || employeeId.matches('^DEMO-[A-F0-9]{12}$'))
        && employeeName is string
        && exists(employeePath)
        && get(employeePath).data.name == employeeName;
    }

    function validDemoLeaveRequest(uid, requestId) {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.keys().hasAll(['id', 'employeeId', 'employeeName', 'leaveType', 'startDate', 'endDate', 'note', 'status', 'submittedAt'])
        && d.keys().hasOnly(['id', 'employeeId', 'employeeName', 'leaveType', 'startDate', 'endDate', 'note', 'status', 'submittedAt'])
        && d.id is string && d.id == requestId && d.id.matches('^LV-[A-F0-9]{12}$')
        && ownsDemoEmployee(uid, d.employeeId, d.employeeName)
        && d.leaveType in ['Vacation', 'Medical', 'Personal', 'Unpaid']
        && d.startDate is string && d.startDate.matches('^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$')
        && d.endDate is string && d.endDate.matches('^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$')
        && d.startDate <= d.endDate
        && d.note is string && d.note.size() <= 240
        && d.status == 'Pending review'
        && d.submittedAt is timestamp;
    }

    function validDemoLeaveCancellation(uid, requestId) {
      let previous = resource.data;
      let next = request.resource.data;
      return signedInAs(uid)
        && previous.id == requestId
        && previous.status == 'Pending review'
        && next.id == previous.id
        && next.diff(previous).affectedKeys().hasAll(['status', 'cancelledAt'])
        && next.diff(previous).affectedKeys().hasOnly(['status', 'cancelledAt'])
        && next.status == 'Cancelled'
        && next.cancelledAt is timestamp;
    }

    function validTicketQueue(ticketType, queue) {
      return (ticketType in ['Overtime request', 'Leave request', 'Timesheet correction'] && queue == 'Team Lead')
        || (ticketType == 'Payroll inquiry' && queue == 'Payroll Staff')
        || (ticketType == 'HR inquiry' && queue == 'HR')
        || (ticketType == 'Technical support' && queue == 'IT Admin');
    }

    function validDemoTicket(uid, ticketId) {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.keys().hasAll(['id', 'employeeId', 'employeeName', 'ticketType', 'queue', 'summary', 'status', 'submittedAt'])
        && d.keys().hasOnly(['id', 'employeeId', 'employeeName', 'ticketType', 'queue', 'summary', 'status', 'submittedAt'])
        && d.id is string && d.id == ticketId && d.id.matches('^TK-[A-F0-9]{12}$')
        && ownsDemoEmployee(uid, d.employeeId, d.employeeName)
        && validTicketQueue(d.ticketType, d.queue)
        && d.summary is string && d.summary.size() > 0 && d.summary.size() <= 240
        && d.status == 'Open'
        && d.submittedAt is timestamp;
    }

    function validDemoTicketCancellation(uid, ticketId) {
      let previous = resource.data;
      let next = request.resource.data;
      return signedInAs(uid)
        && previous.id == ticketId
        && previous.status == 'Open'
        && next.id == previous.id
        && next.diff(previous).affectedKeys().hasAll(['status', 'cancelledAt'])
        && next.diff(previous).affectedKeys().hasOnly(['status', 'cancelledAt'])
        && next.status == 'Cancelled'
        && next.cancelledAt is timestamp;
    }

    match /users/{uid}/demoEmployees/{employeeId} {
      allow read: if signedInAs(uid);
      allow create, update: if signedInAs(uid) && validDemoEmployee(employeeId);
      allow delete: if signedInAs(uid);
    }

    match /users/{uid}/demoAttendance/{attendanceId} {
      allow read: if signedInAs(uid);
      allow create, update: if signedInAs(uid) && validDemoAttendance();
      allow delete: if signedInAs(uid);
    }

    // Owner-only demo requests. There are deliberately no reviewer, approval, or delete permissions.
    match /users/{uid}/demoLeaveRequests/{requestId} {
      allow read: if signedInAs(uid);
      allow create: if signedInAs(uid) && validDemoLeaveRequest(uid, requestId);
      allow update: if validDemoLeaveCancellation(uid, requestId);
      allow delete: if false;
    }

    match /users/{uid}/demoTickets/{ticketId} {
      allow read: if signedInAs(uid);
      allow create: if signedInAs(uid) && validDemoTicket(uid, ticketId);
      allow update: if validDemoTicketCancellation(uid, ticketId);
      allow delete: if false;
    }

    // Default-deny: no other Firestore document paths are available to clients.
    match /{document=**} {
      allow read, write: if false;
    }
  }
}

package ph.motorph.web;

import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParseException;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpExchange;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.net.URLDecoder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;

/** Java 11 HTTP backend for the browser-based MotorPH prototype. */
public final class AppServer {
    private final Path webRoot;
    private final String firebaseProjectId;
    private final String firestoreApiRoot;
    private final EmployeeService localEmployeeService = new EmployeeService(new InMemoryEmployeeStore());
    private final EmployeeScheduleStore localScheduleStore = new InMemoryEmployeeScheduleStore();
    private final AttendanceStore localAttendanceStore = new InMemoryAttendanceStore();
    private final WorkflowStore localWorkflowStore = new InMemoryWorkflowStore();
    private HttpServer server;
    private java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService executor;

    public AppServer() {
        this(System.getenv().getOrDefault("FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID", ""),
            Paths.get(System.getenv().getOrDefault("WEB_ROOT", "web")), null);
    }

    AppServer(String firebaseProjectId, Path webRoot) {
        this(firebaseProjectId, webRoot, null);
    }

    AppServer(String firebaseProjectId, Path webRoot, String firestoreApiRoot) {
        this.firebaseProjectId = firebaseProjectId == null ? "" : firebaseProjectId.trim();
        if (webRoot == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("webRoot must not be null");
        this.webRoot = webRoot.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        this.firestoreApiRoot = firestoreApiRoot == null || firestoreApiRoot.trim().isEmpty()
            ? null : firestoreApiRoot.trim();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        int port = Integer.parseInt(System.getenv().getOrDefault("PORT", "8080"));
        String host = System.getenv().getOrDefault("HOST", "0.0.0.0");
        AppServer app = new AppServer();
        app.start(host, port);
        Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(new Thread(app::stop));
    }

    HttpServer start(String host, int port) throws IOException {
        if (server != null) throw new IllegalStateException("server is already started");
        server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress(host, port), 0);
        server.createContext("/api/health", this::handleHealth);
        server.createContext("/api/employees", this::handleEmployees);
        server.createContext("/api/attendance", this::handleAttendance);
        server.createContext("/api/reports/attendance", this::handleAttendanceReport);
        server.createContext("/api/workflows", this::handleWorkflows);
        server.createContext("/api/demo/seed", this::handleSeedDemo);
        server.createContext("/", this::handleStaticFiles);
        executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(8);
        server.setExecutor(executor);
        server.start();
        System.out.println("MotorPH Java API listening on " + host + ":" + server.getAddress().getPort());
        System.out.println("Mode: " + (firebaseProjectId.isEmpty() ? "local synthetic demo" : "Firebase-authenticated user sandbox"));
        System.out.println("Serving browser files from " + webRoot);
        return server;
    }

    void stop() {
        if (server != null) {
            server.stop(0);
            server = null;
        }
        if (executor != null) {
            executor.shutdownNow();
            executor = null;
        }
    }

    private void handleHealth(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!"GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
            return;
        }
        String mode = firebaseProjectId.isEmpty() ? "local-synthetic-demo" : "firebase-user-sandbox";
        sendJson(exchange, 200, "{\"status\":\"ok\",\"mode\":\"" + mode + "\"}");
    }

    private void handleEmployees(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        String path = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();
        String method = exchange.getRequestMethod();
        try {
            if ("GET".equals(method)) {
                RequestServices services = servicesFor(exchange);
                if ("/api/employees".equals(path) || "/api/employees/".equals(path)) {
                    String query = queryParameter(exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery(), "q");
                    List<Employee> matches = services.employeeService.searchEmployees(query);
                    int total = services.employeeService.listEmployees().size();
                    sendJson(exchange, 200, employeesToJson(matches, total));
                    return;
                }
                if (!path.startsWith("/api/employees/")) {
                    sendJson(exchange, 404, "{\"error\":\"Employee not found\"}");
                    return;
                }
                String id = path.substring("/api/employees/".length());
                if (id.isEmpty() || id.contains("/")) {
                    sendJson(exchange, 404, "{\"error\":\"Employee not found\"}");
                    return;
                }
                Optional<Employee> employee = services.employeeService.findEmployee(id);
                if (!employee.isPresent()) {
                    sendJson(exchange, 404, "{\"error\":\"Employee not found\"}");
                    return;
                }
                sendJson(exchange, 200, "{\"item\":" + employeeToJson(employee.get()) + "}");
                return;
            }
            if ("POST".equals(method) && "/api/employees".equals(path)) {
                RequestServices services = servicesFor(exchange);
                JsonObject body = readJsonBody(exchange);
                requireOnlyKeys(body, "name", "department", "role", "location", "status");
                Employee created = services.employeeService.createEmployee(requiredString(body, "name"),
                    requiredString(body, "department"), requiredString(body, "role"),
                    requiredString(body, "location"), requiredString(body, "status"));
                sendJson(exchange, 201, "{\"item\":" + employeeToJson(created) + "}");
                return;
            }
            if ("PUT".equals(method) && path.startsWith("/api/employees/")) {
                RequestServices services = servicesFor(exchange);
                String id = path.substring("/api/employees/".length());
                if (id.isEmpty() || id.contains("/")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Employee ID is invalid.");
                JsonObject body = readJsonBody(exchange);
                requireOnlyKeys(body, "name", "department", "role", "location", "status");
                Employee updated = services.employeeService.updateEmployee(id, requiredString(body, "name"),
                    requiredString(body, "department"), requiredString(body, "role"),
                    requiredString(body, "location"), requiredString(body, "status"));
                sendJson(exchange, 200, "{\"item\":" + employeeToJson(updated) + "}");
                return;
            }
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
        } catch (RequestException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, ex.statusCode, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (NoSuchElementException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 404, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (IllegalStateException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 409, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (FirestoreException ex) {
            sendApiError(exchange, ex);
        }
    }

    private void handleAttendance(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if ("POST".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            handleAttendanceCreate(exchange);
            return;
        }
        if (!"GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
            return;
        }
        String employeeId = queryParameter(exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery(), "employeeId");
        if (employeeId == null || employeeId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"employeeId is required\"}");
            return;
        }
        try {
            RequestServices services = servicesFor(exchange);
            LocalDate from = parseOptionalDate(queryParameter(exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery(), "from"));
            LocalDate to = parseOptionalDate(queryParameter(exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery(), "to"));
            AttendanceService attendanceService = new AttendanceService(services.employeeService,
                localScheduleStore, services.attendanceStore);
            List<AttendanceRecord> records = attendanceService.findForEmployee(employeeId, from, to);
            sendJson(exchange, 200, attendanceToJson(records));
        } catch (DateTimeParseException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"Dates must use YYYY-MM-DD\"}");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (java.util.NoSuchElementException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 404, "{\"error\":\"Employee not found\"}");
        } catch (FirestoreException ex) {
            sendApiError(exchange, ex);
        }
    }

    private void handleAttendanceCreate(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!firebaseProjectId.isEmpty()) {
            sendJson(exchange, 403, "{\"error\":\"Raw attendance entry is disabled in Firebase mode; this demo writer is local-memory only.\"}");
            return;
        }
        try {
            JsonObject body = readJsonBody(exchange);
            requireOnlyKeys(body, "employeeId", "date", "timeIn", "timeOut");
            LocalDate date = LocalDate.parse(requiredString(body, "date").trim());
            LocalTime timeIn = parseAttendanceTime(requiredString(body, "timeIn"));
            LocalTime timeOut = parseAttendanceTime(requiredString(body, "timeOut"));
            RequestServices services = servicesFor(exchange);
            AttendanceService attendanceService = new AttendanceService(services.employeeService,
                localScheduleStore, services.attendanceStore);
            AttendanceRecord created = attendanceService.createForEmployee(
                requiredString(body, "employeeId"), date, timeIn, timeOut);
            sendJson(exchange, 201, "{\"item\":" + attendanceRecordToJson(created)
                + ",\"storage\":\"local-process-memory\",\"syntheticOnly\":true,\"hoursCalculated\":false}");
        } catch (DateTimeParseException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"Date must use YYYY-MM-DD and times must use HH:mm\"}");
        } catch (RequestException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, ex.statusCode, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (NoSuchElementException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 404, "{\"error\":\"Employee not found\"}");
        } catch (IllegalStateException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 409, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        }
    }

    private static LocalTime parseAttendanceTime(String value) {
        String time = value == null ? "" : value.trim();
        if (!time.matches("^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$")) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Time values must use 24-hour HH:mm format.");
        }
        return LocalTime.parse(time);
    }

    private static LocalTime parseAttendanceTime(String value) {
        String time = value == null ? "" : value.trim();
        if (!time.matches("^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$")) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Time values must use 24-hour HH:mm format.");
        }
        return LocalTime.parse(time);
    }

    private void handleAttendanceReport(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!"GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
            return;
        }
        try {
            RequestServices services = servicesFor(exchange);
            String query = exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery();
            LocalDate from = parseOptionalDate(queryParameter(query, "from"));
            LocalDate to = parseOptionalDate(queryParameter(query, "to"));
            AttendanceService attendanceService = new AttendanceService(services.employeeService,
                localScheduleStore, services.attendanceStore);
            List<RawAttendanceSummary> summaries = attendanceService.summarizeRawRecords(from, to);
            sendJson(exchange, 200, attendanceSummaryToJson(summaries, from, to));
        } catch (DateTimeParseException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"Dates must use YYYY-MM-DD\"}");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (FirestoreException ex) {
            sendApiError(exchange, ex);
        }
    }

    private void handleWorkflows(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        String path = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();
        String method = exchange.getRequestMethod();
        try {
            if ("GET".equals(method) && "/api/workflows".equals(path)) {
                WorkflowService service = workflowsFor(exchange);
                sendJson(exchange, 200, workflowsToJson(service.listLeaveRequests(), service.listTickets(),
                    firebaseProjectId.isEmpty() ? "local-process-memory" : "user-scoped-firestore"));
                return;
            }
            if (!"POST".equals(method)) {
                sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
                return;
            }

            WorkflowService service = workflowsFor(exchange);
            if ("/api/workflows/leave".equals(path)) {
                JsonObject body = readJsonBody(exchange);
                requireOnlyKeys(body, "employeeId", "leaveType", "startDate", "endDate", "note");
                DemoLeaveRequest request = service.createLeaveRequest(
                    requiredString(body, "employeeId"), requiredString(body, "leaveType"),
                    requiredString(body, "startDate"), requiredString(body, "endDate"), optionalString(body, "note"));
                sendJson(exchange, 201, itemToJson(leaveToJson(request),
                    firebaseProjectId.isEmpty() ? "local-process-memory" : "user-scoped-firestore"));
                return;
            }
            if ("/api/workflows/tickets".equals(path)) {
                JsonObject body = readJsonBody(exchange);
                requireOnlyKeys(body, "employeeId", "ticketType", "summary");
                DemoTicket ticket = service.createTicket(requiredString(body, "employeeId"),
                    requiredString(body, "ticketType"), requiredString(body, "summary"));
                sendJson(exchange, 201, itemToJson(ticketToJson(ticket),
                    firebaseProjectId.isEmpty() ? "local-process-memory" : "user-scoped-firestore"));
                return;
            }
            String[] segments = path.substring("/api/workflows/".length()).split("/");
            if (segments.length == 3 && "cancel".equals(segments[2])) {
                if ("leave".equals(segments[0])) {
                    DemoLeaveRequest request = service.cancelLeaveRequest(segments[1]);
                    sendJson(exchange, 200, itemToJson(leaveToJson(request),
                        firebaseProjectId.isEmpty() ? "local-process-memory" : "user-scoped-firestore"));
                    return;
                }
                if ("tickets".equals(segments[0])) {
                    DemoTicket ticket = service.cancelTicket(segments[1]);
                    sendJson(exchange, 200, itemToJson(ticketToJson(ticket),
                        firebaseProjectId.isEmpty() ? "local-process-memory" : "user-scoped-firestore"));
                    return;
                }
            }
            sendJson(exchange, 404, "{\"error\":\"Workflow endpoint not found\"}");
        } catch (RequestException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, ex.statusCode, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (NoSuchElementException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 404, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (IllegalStateException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 409, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (FirestoreException ex) {
            sendApiError(exchange, ex);
        }
    }

    private WorkflowService workflowsFor(HttpExchange exchange) {
        if (firebaseProjectId.isEmpty()) return new WorkflowService(localEmployeeService, localWorkflowStore);
        FirestoreRestClient client = firestoreClientFor(exchange);
        EmployeeService employees = new EmployeeService(new FirestoreEmployeeStore(client));
        return new WorkflowService(employees, new FirestoreWorkflowStore(client));
    }

    private static JsonObject readJsonBody(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        String contentType = exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Content-Type");
        if (contentType == null || !contentType.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).startsWith("application/json")) {
            throw new RequestException(415, "Content-Type must be application/json.");
        }
        byte[] bytes = exchange.getRequestBody().readNBytes(8193);
        if (bytes.length > 8192) throw new RequestException(413, "Request body is too large.");
        try {
            JsonElement parsed = JsonParser.parseString(new String(bytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            if (!parsed.isJsonObject()) throw new RequestException(400, "JSON body must be an object.");
            return parsed.getAsJsonObject();
        } catch (JsonParseException ex) {
            throw new RequestException(400, "Request body is not valid JSON.");
        }
    }

    private static void requireOnlyKeys(JsonObject body, String... allowed) {
        java.util.Set<String> keys = new java.util.HashSet<>(java.util.Arrays.asList(allowed));
        for (String key : body.keySet()) {
            if (!keys.contains(key)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unexpected request field: " + key);
        }
    }

    private static String requiredString(JsonObject body, String field) {
        JsonElement value = body.get(field);
        if (value == null || !value.isJsonPrimitive() || !value.getAsJsonPrimitive().isString()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " is required and must be text.");
        }
        return value.getAsString();
    }

    private static String optionalString(JsonObject body, String field) {
        JsonElement value = body.get(field);
        if (value == null || value.isJsonNull()) return "";
        if (!value.isJsonPrimitive() || !value.getAsJsonPrimitive().isString()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must be text.");
        }
        return value.getAsString();
    }

    private static String itemToJson(JsonObject item, String storage) {
        JsonObject response = new JsonObject();
        response.add("item", item);
        response.addProperty("storage", storage);
        return response.toString();
    }

    private static String workflowsToJson(List<DemoLeaveRequest> leaveRequests, List<DemoTicket> tickets, String storage) {

        JsonArray leaves = new JsonArray();
        for (DemoLeaveRequest request : leaveRequests) leaves.add(leaveToJson(request));
        JsonArray ticketItems = new JsonArray();
        for (DemoTicket ticket : tickets) ticketItems.add(ticketToJson(ticket));
        response.add("leaveRequests", leaves);
        response.add("tickets", ticketItems);
        response.addProperty("storage", storage);
        return response.toString();
    }

        item.addProperty("startDate", request.getStartDate());
        item.addProperty("endDate", request.getEndDate());
        item.addProperty("note", request.getNote());
        item.addProperty("status", request.getStatus());

    private final String userId;
    private final String idToken;

    public FirestoreRestClient(String projectId, String userId, String idToken) {
        this(projectId, userId, idToken, API_ROOT);
    }

    /** Package-private endpoint override for isolated HTTP contract tests. */
    FirestoreRestClient(String projectId, String userId, String idToken, String apiRoot) {
        this.projectId = requireSafeSegment(projectId, "project id");
        this.userId = requireSafeSegment(userId, "user id");
        if (idToken == null || idToken.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Firebase sign-in is required");
        if (apiRoot == null || apiRoot.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("API root must not be blank");
        this.idToken = idToken.trim();
        this.apiRoot = apiRoot.trim().endsWith("/") ? apiRoot.trim() : apiRoot.trim() + "/";
    }

    public List<JsonObject> listDocuments(String collectionPath) {
        List<JsonObject> documents = new ArrayList<>();
        String pageToken = "";
        do {
            String url = documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "?pageSize=1000" + pageToken;
            JsonObject response = send("GET", url, null, false);
            JsonArray items = response.has("documents") ? response.getAsJsonArray("documents") : new JsonArray();
            for (JsonElement item : items) documents.add(item.getAsJsonObject());
            pageToken = response.has("nextPageToken")
                ? "&pageToken=" + queryEncode(response.get("nextPageToken").getAsString()) : "";
        } while (!pageToken.isEmpty());
        return documents;
    }

    public boolean createDocument(String collectionPath, String documentId, JsonObject fields) {
        String url = documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "?documentId=" + queryEncode(requireSafeSegment(documentId, "document id"));
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.add("fields", fields);
        return send("POST", url, body, true).has("name");
    }

    public boolean updateDocument(String collectionPath, String documentId, JsonObject fields, List<String> updateMask) {
        if (fields == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("document fields must not be null");
        if (updateMask == null || updateMask.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("update mask must not be empty");
        StringBuilder url = new StringBuilder(documentsUrl(collectionPath))
            .append('/').append(pathEncode(requireSafeSegment(documentId, "document id")));
        for (String field : updateMask) {
            String safeField = requireSafeSegment(field, "update field");
            url.append(url.indexOf("?") < 0 ? "?" : "&")
                .append("updateMask.fieldPaths=").append(queryEncode(safeField));
        }
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.add("fields", fields);
        return send("PATCH", url.toString(), body, false).has("name");
    }

    public String userCollection(String collectionName) {
        return "users/" + userId + "/" + requireSafeSegment(collectionName, "collection name");
    }

    private JsonObject send(String method, String url, JsonObject body, boolean allowExisting) {
        try {
            HttpRequest.Builder builder = HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create(url))
                .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(20))
                .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + idToken)
                .header("Accept", "application/json");
            if (body != null) {
                builder.header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
                    .method(method, HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(body.toString(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            } else {
                builder.method(method, HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.noBody());
            }
            HttpResponse<String> response = HTTP.send(builder.build(), HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            if (allowExisting && (response.statusCode() == 409 || response.statusCode() == 400)
                && response.body() != null && response.body().contains("ALREADY_EXISTS")) {
                return new JsonObject();
            }
            if (response.statusCode() < 200 || response.statusCode() >= 300) {
                throw firestoreError(response.statusCode(), response.body());
            }
            String responseBody = response.body();
            return responseBody == null || responseBody.trim().isEmpty()
                ? new JsonObject() : JsonParser.parseString(responseBody).getAsJsonObject();
        } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            throw new FirestoreException("Firestore request was interrupted.", 503);
        } catch (IOException | IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            throw new FirestoreException("Could not reach Firestore. Check the network and project setup.", 503);
        }
    }

    private String documentsUrl(String collectionPath) {
        StringBuilder path = new StringBuilder(apiRoot)
            .append(pathEncode(projectId)).append("/databases/(default)/documents");
        for (String segment : collectionPath.split("/")) {
            path.append('/').append(pathEncode(requireSafeSegment(segment, "path segment")));
        }
        return path.toString();
    }

    private static String requireSafeSegment(String value, String label) {
        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty() || value.contains("/")) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(label + " must be a non-empty path segment");
        }
        return value.trim();
    }

    private static String pathEncode(String value) {
        return URLEncoder.encode(value, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).replace("+", "%20");
    }

    private static String queryEncode(String value) {
        return URLEncoder.encode(value, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    private static FirestoreException firestoreError(int status, String body) {
        String message = "Firestore request failed (HTTP " + status + ").";
        if (status == 401) message = "Firebase sign-in expired. Sign out and sign in again.";
        else if (status == 403) message = "Firestore denied this request. Publish the scoped development rules in docs/firestore.rules, then retry.";
        else if (status == 404) message = "Firestore database or requested resource was not found. Check the Firebase project and database setup.";
        else if (status == 409 || status == 400) message = "A demo record could not be created. Refresh the page and try again.";
        return new FirestoreException(message, status);
    }
}

        return new Employee(
            stringValue(fields, "id"), stringValue(fields, "name"), stringValue(fields, "department"),

/** Firestore user-subcollection adapter. Firestore Rules enforce owner-only access. */
public final class FirestoreWorkflowStore implements WorkflowStore {
    private static final String LEAVE_COLLECTION = "demoLeaveRequests";
    private static final String TICKET_COLLECTION = "demoTickets";
    private final FirestoreRestClient client;

    public FirestoreWorkflowStore(FirestoreRestClient client) {
        if (client == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("client must not be null");
        this.client = client;
    }

    @Override
    public List<DemoLeaveRequest> listLeaveRequests() {
        List<DemoLeaveRequest> requests = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JsonObject document : client.listDocuments(client.userCollection(LEAVE_COLLECTION))) {
            requests.add(leaveFromDocument(document));
        }
        requests.sort(Comparator.comparing(DemoLeaveRequest::getSubmittedAt).reversed());
        return requests;
    }

    @Override
    public DemoLeaveRequest createLeaveRequest(DemoLeaveRequest request) {
        if (!client.createDocument(client.userCollection(LEAVE_COLLECTION), request.getId(), leaveFields(request))) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Request ID already exists; try submitting again.");
        }
        return request;
    }

    @Override
    public DemoLeaveRequest cancelLeaveRequest(String id, String cancelledAt) {
        DemoLeaveRequest current = listLeaveRequests().stream().filter(item -> item.getId().equals(id)).findFirst()
            .orElseThrow(() -> new NoSuchElementException("Leave request was not found in this user sandbox."));
        if (!"Pending review".equals(current.getStatus())) throw new IllegalStateException("Only a pending leave request can be cancelled.");
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("status", stringField("Cancelled"));
        fields.add("cancelledAt", timestampField(cancelledAt));
        if (!client.updateDocument(client.userCollection(LEAVE_COLLECTION), id, fields,
            java.util.Arrays.asList("status", "cancelledAt"))) {
            throw new NoSuchElementException("Leave request was not found in this user sandbox.");
        }
        return current.cancelled(cancelledAt);
    }

    @Override
    public List<DemoTicket> listTickets() {
        List<DemoTicket> tickets = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JsonObject document : client.listDocuments(client.userCollection(TICKET_COLLECTION))) {
            tickets.add(ticketFromDocument(document));
        }
        tickets.sort(Comparator.comparing(DemoTicket::getSubmittedAt).reversed());
        return tickets;
    }

    @Override
    public DemoTicket createTicket(DemoTicket ticket) {
        if (!client.createDocument(client.userCollection(TICKET_COLLECTION), ticket.getId(), ticketFields(ticket))) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Ticket ID already exists; try submitting again.");
        }
        return ticket;
    }

    @Override
    public DemoTicket cancelTicket(String id, String cancelledAt) {
        DemoTicket current = listTickets().stream().filter(item -> item.getId().equals(id)).findFirst()
            .orElseThrow(() -> new NoSuchElementException("Ticket was not found in this user sandbox."));
        if (!"Open".equals(current.getStatus())) throw new IllegalStateException("Only an open ticket can be cancelled.");
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("status", stringField("Cancelled"));
        fields.add("cancelledAt", timestampField(cancelledAt));
        if (!client.updateDocument(client.userCollection(TICKET_COLLECTION), id, fields,
            java.util.Arrays.asList("status", "cancelledAt"))) {
            throw new NoSuchElementException("Ticket was not found in this user sandbox.");
        }
        return current.cancelled(cancelledAt);
    }

    private static JsonObject leaveFields(DemoLeaveRequest request) {
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("id", stringField(request.getId()));
        fields.add("employeeId", stringField(request.getEmployeeId()));
        fields.add("employeeName", stringField(request.getEmployeeName()));
        fields.add("leaveType", stringField(request.getLeaveType()));
        fields.add("startDate", stringField(request.getStartDate()));
        fields.add("endDate", stringField(request.getEndDate()));
        fields.add("note", stringField(request.getNote()));
        fields.add("status", stringField(request.getStatus()));
        fields.add("submittedAt", timestampField(request.getSubmittedAt()));
        return fields;
    }

    private static JsonObject ticketFields(DemoTicket ticket) {
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("id", stringField(ticket.getId()));
        fields.add("employeeId", stringField(ticket.getEmployeeId()));
        fields.add("employeeName", stringField(ticket.getEmployeeName()));
        fields.add("ticketType", stringField(ticket.getTicketType()));
        fields.add("queue", stringField(ticket.getQueue()));
        fields.add("summary", stringField(ticket.getSummary()));
        fields.add("status", stringField(ticket.getStatus()));
        fields.add("submittedAt", timestampField(ticket.getSubmittedAt()));
        return fields;
    }

    private static DemoLeaveRequest leaveFromDocument(JsonObject document) {
        JsonObject fields = fields(document);
        return new DemoLeaveRequest(documentId(document), value(fields, "employeeId"), value(fields, "employeeName"),
            value(fields, "leaveType"), value(fields, "startDate"), value(fields, "endDate"), value(fields, "note"),
            value(fields, "status"), dateTimeValue(fields, "submittedAt"), dateTimeValue(fields, "cancelledAt"));
    }

    private static DemoTicket ticketFromDocument(JsonObject document) {
        JsonObject fields = fields(document);
        return new DemoTicket(documentId(document), value(fields, "employeeId"), value(fields, "employeeName"),
            value(fields, "ticketType"), value(fields, "queue"), value(fields, "summary"), value(fields, "status"),

    private static JsonObject fields(JsonObject document) {
        return document.has("fields") && document.get("fields").isJsonObject()
            ? document.getAsJsonObject("fields") : new JsonObject();
    }

    private static String documentId(JsonObject document) {
        String name = document.has("name") ? document.get("name").getAsString() : "";
        int slash = name.lastIndexOf('/');
        if (slash < 0 || slash == name.length() - 1) throw new IllegalStateException("Firestore workflow document has no ID.");
        return name.substring(slash + 1);
    }

    private static String value(JsonObject fields, String name) {
        JsonElement element = fields.get(name);
        if (element == null || !element.isJsonObject()) return "";
        JsonObject typed = element.getAsJsonObject();
        if (typed.has("stringValue")) return typed.get("stringValue").getAsString();
        if (typed.has("timestampValue")) return typed.get("timestampValue").getAsString();
        return "";
    }

    private static String dateTimeValue(JsonObject fields, String name) {
        return fields.has(name) ? value(fields, name) : "";
    }

        JsonObject field = new JsonObject();
        field.addProperty("stringValue", value);
        return field;
    }

        JsonObject field = new JsonObject();
        field.addProperty("timestampValue", value);

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
import java.util.OptionalInt;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/** Reads raw attendance for one employee; deliberately does not calculate paid hours. */
public final class AttendanceService {
    private final EmployeeService employeeService;
    private final EmployeeScheduleStore scheduleStore;
    private final AttendanceStore attendanceStore;

    public AttendanceService(EmployeeService employeeService, EmployeeScheduleStore scheduleStore,
                             AttendanceStore attendanceStore) {
        if (employeeService == null || scheduleStore == null || attendanceStore == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("attendance service dependencies must not be null");
        }
        this.employeeService = employeeService;
        this.scheduleStore = scheduleStore;
        this.attendanceStore = attendanceStore;
    }

    /** Inclusive optional date filtering; no pay-period calendar is inferred. */
    public List<AttendanceRecord> findForEmployee(String employeeId, LocalDate from, LocalDate to) {
        if (!employeeService.findEmployee(employeeId).isPresent()) {
            throw new NoSuchElementException("employee not found");
        }
        validateRange(from, to);
        OptionalInt scheduleId = scheduleStore.findScheduleIdForEmployee(employeeId.trim());
        if (!scheduleId.isPresent()) return java.util.Collections.emptyList();
        return attendanceStore.findByScheduleId(scheduleId.getAsInt()).stream()
            .filter(record -> from == null || !record.getDate().isBefore(from))
            .filter(record -> to == null || !record.getDate().isAfter(to))
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    /** Adds one local synthetic raw row for an existing mapping; no hours or classifications are inferred. */
    public AttendanceRecord createForEmployee(String employeeId, LocalDate date, LocalTime timeIn, LocalTime timeOut) {
        if (employeeId == null || employeeId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("employeeId is required.");
        }
        if (!employeeService.findEmployee(employeeId.trim()).isPresent()) {
            throw new NoSuchElementException("employee not found");
        }
        OptionalInt scheduleId = scheduleStore.findScheduleIdForEmployee(employeeId.trim());
        if (!scheduleId.isPresent()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("No configured synthetic schedule mapping exists for this employee; no schedule was assigned.");
        }
        if (!(attendanceStore instanceof MutableAttendanceStore)) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Attendance entry is disabled for this storage mode.");
        }
        return ((MutableAttendanceStore) attendanceStore).create(scheduleId.getAsInt(), date, timeIn, timeOut, "DEMO");
    }

    /** Counts raw rows and their date coverage; this never classifies attendance or derives hours. */
    public List<RawAttendanceSummary> summarizeRawRecords(LocalDate from, LocalDate to) {
        validateRange(from, to);
        List<AttendanceRecord> allRecords = attendanceStore.findAll();
        List<RawAttendanceSummary> summaries = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Employee employee : employeeService.listEmployees()) {
            OptionalInt schedule = scheduleStore.findScheduleIdForEmployee(employee.getId());
            if (!schedule.isPresent()) {
                summaries.add(new RawAttendanceSummary(employee.getId(), employee.getName(), null, 0, "", ""));
                continue;
            }
            List<AttendanceRecord> matched = allRecords.stream()
                .filter(record -> record.getScheduleId() == schedule.getAsInt())
                .filter(record -> from == null || !record.getDate().isBefore(from))
                .filter(record -> to == null || !record.getDate().isAfter(to))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
            String firstDate = matched.stream().map(record -> record.getDate().toString()).min(String::compareTo).orElse("");
            String lastDate = matched.stream().map(record -> record.getDate().toString()).max(String::compareTo).orElse("");
            summaries.add(new RawAttendanceSummary(employee.getId(), employee.getName(), schedule.getAsInt(),
                matched.size(), firstDate, lastDate));
        }
        summaries.sort(Comparator.comparing(RawAttendanceSummary::getEmployeeId));
        return summaries;
    }

    private static void validateRange(LocalDate from, LocalDate to) {
        if (from != null && to != null && from.isAfter(to)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("from date must be on or before to date");
        }
    }
}
package ph.motorph.web;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.util.Objects;

/** Raw attendance data model aligned to the supplied MO-IT107 Attendance fields. */
public final class AttendanceRecord {
    private final int attendanceId;
    private final int scheduleId;
    private final LocalDate date;
    private final LocalTime timeIn;
    private final LocalTime timeOut;
    private final String dayType;

    public AttendanceRecord(int attendanceId, int scheduleId, LocalDate date,
                            LocalTime timeIn, LocalTime timeOut, String dayType) {
        if (attendanceId <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("attendanceId must be positive");
        if (scheduleId <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("scheduleId must be positive");
        this.date = Objects.requireNonNull(date, "date must not be null");
        this.timeIn = Objects.requireNonNull(timeIn, "timeIn must not be null");
        this.timeOut = Objects.requireNonNull(timeOut, "timeOut must not be null");
        if (timeIn.isAfter(timeOut)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("timeIn must be less than or equal to timeOut per the supplied data dictionary");
        }
        if (dayType == null || dayType.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dayType must not be blank");
        this.attendanceId = attendanceId;
        this.scheduleId = scheduleId;
        this.dayType = dayType.trim();
    }

    public int getAttendanceId() { return attendanceId; }
    public int getScheduleId() { return scheduleId; }
    public LocalDate getDate() { return date; }
    public LocalTime getTimeIn() { return timeIn; }
    public LocalTime getTimeOut() { return timeOut; }
    public String getDayType() { return dayType; }
}

const serverChildren = [];
let browser;

function freePort() {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const server = net.createServer();
    server.once('error', reject);
    server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => {
      const { port } = server.address();
      server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve(port));
    });
  });
}

function start(command, args, env, label) {
  const child = spawn(command, args, {
    cwd: projectRoot,
    env,
    detached: process.platform !== 'win32',
    stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe']
  });
  child.log = '';
  child.on('error', error => { child.log += `${label}: ${error.message}\n`; });
  for (const stream of [child.stdout, child.stderr]) {
    stream.setEncoding('utf8');
    stream.on('data', chunk => { child.log = (child.log + chunk).slice(-8000); });
  }
  serverChildren.push(child);
  return child;
}

async function waitForServer(url, child, label) {
  const end = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  let lastError = 'no response';
  while (Date.now() < end) {
    if (child.exitCode !== null) throw new Error(`${label} exited early.\n${child.log}`);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(url);
      if (response.ok) return response;
      lastError = `HTTP ${response.status}`;
    } catch (error) {
      lastError = error.message;
    }
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 150));
  }
  throw new Error(`${label} did not become ready (${lastError}).\n${child.log}`);
}

async function stop(child) {
  if (!child || child.exitCode !== null) return;
  try {
    if (process.platform === 'win32') child.kill('SIGTERM');
    else process.kill(-child.pid, 'SIGTERM');
  } catch { /* already stopped */ }
  await Promise.race([
    new Promise(resolve => child.once('exit', resolve)),
    new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2500))
  ]);
  if (child.exitCode === null) {
    try {
      if (process.platform === 'win32') child.kill('SIGKILL');
      else process.kill(-child.pid, 'SIGKILL');
    } catch { /* already stopped */ }
  }
}

package ph.motorph.web;

import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpExchange;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;

/** Offline tests for Firestore REST token forwarding, document mapping, and errors. */
public final class FirestoreRestClientTest {
    private static int checks;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        listsUserDocumentsWithTheBearerTokenAndMapsEmployeeFields();
        mapsPermissionDenialWithoutExposingRequestCredentials();
        createsDocumentsWithTypedFieldsAndHandlesAlreadyExistingSeedRecords();
        updatesOnlyTheRequestedFieldsForWorkflowCancellation();
        rejectsPathInjectionInUserIdentifiers();
        System.out.println("PASS: " + checks + " Firestore REST adapter checks");
    }

    private static void listsUserDocumentsWithTheBearerTokenAndMapsEmployeeFields() throws Exception {
        String response = "{\"documents\":[{\"name\":\"projects/motorph-jd/databases/(default)/documents/users/user-123/demoEmployees/DEMO-001\","
            + "\"fields\":{\"id\":{\"stringValue\":\"DEMO-001\"},\"name\":{\"stringValue\":\"Mara Rivera\"},"
            + "\"department\":{\"stringValue\":\"People Operations\"},\"role\":{\"stringValue\":\"HR Coordinator\"},"
            + "\"location\":{\"stringValue\":\"Makati\"},\"status\":{\"stringValue\":\"Active\"}}}]}";
        try (FakeFirestoreServer server = new FakeFirestoreServer(200, response)) {
            FirestoreRestClient client = client(server);
            List<Employee> employees = new FirestoreEmployeeStore(client).findAll();
            check(employees.size() == 1, "one employee returned");
            check("Mara Rivera".equals(employees.get(0).getName()), "employee name mapped");
            check("Active".equals(employees.get(0).getStatus()), "employee status mapped");
            check("Bearer test-id-token".equals(server.authorization.get()), "Firebase ID token forwarded as bearer");
            check("GET".equals(server.method.get()), "collection read uses GET");
            check(server.path.get().contains("/users/user-123/demoEmployees"), "read is scoped to the supplied user path");
        }
    }

    private static void mapsPermissionDenialWithoutExposingRequestCredentials() throws Exception {
        try (FakeFirestoreServer server = new FakeFirestoreServer(403,
            "{\"error\":{\"code\":403,\"status\":\"PERMISSION_DENIED\"}}")) {
            try {
                client(server).listDocuments("users/user-123/demoEmployees");
                throw new AssertionError("expected FirestoreException for permission denial");
            } catch (FirestoreException ex) {
                check(ex.getStatusCode() == 403, "permission denial keeps HTTP 403");
                check(ex.getMessage().contains("Firestore denied"), "permission denial has actionable text");
                check(!ex.getMessage().contains("test-id-token"), "error does not include ID token");
            }
        }
    }

    private static void createsDocumentsWithTypedFieldsAndHandlesAlreadyExistingSeedRecords() throws Exception {
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        JsonObject id = new JsonObject();
        id.addProperty("stringValue", "DEMO-001");
        fields.add("id", id);
        try (FakeFirestoreServer server = new FakeFirestoreServer(200,
            "{\"name\":\"projects/motorph-jd/databases/(default)/documents/users/user-123/demoEmployees/DEMO-001\"}")) {
            FirestoreRestClient client = client(server);
            check(client.createDocument(client.userCollection("demoEmployees"), "DEMO-001", fields), "new document reports created");
            check("POST".equals(server.method.get()), "document creation uses POST");
            check(server.path.get().contains("documentId=DEMO-001"), "document ID is explicit");
            check(server.requestBody.get().contains("stringValue"), "Firestore typed field body is sent");
        }
        try (FakeFirestoreServer server = new FakeFirestoreServer(409,
            "{\"error\":{\"code\":409,\"status\":\"ALREADY_EXISTS\"}}")) {
            check(!client(server).createDocument("users/user-123/demoEmployees", "DEMO-001", fields),
                "re-seeding does not overwrite an existing document");
        }
    }

    private static void updatesOnlyTheRequestedFieldsForWorkflowCancellation() throws Exception {
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        JsonObject status = new JsonObject();
        status.addProperty("stringValue", "Cancelled");
        JsonObject cancelledAt = new JsonObject();
        cancelledAt.addProperty("timestampValue", "2026-11-03T10:15:30Z");
        fields.add("status", status);
        fields.add("cancelledAt", cancelledAt);
        try (FakeFirestoreServer server = new FakeFirestoreServer(200,
            "{\"name\":\"projects/motorph-jd/databases/(default)/documents/users/user-123/demoLeaveRequests/LV-012345ABCDEF\"}")) {
            FirestoreRestClient client = client(server);
            check(client.updateDocument("users/user-123/demoLeaveRequests", "LV-012345ABCDEF", fields,
                java.util.Arrays.asList("status", "cancelledAt")), "workflow cancellation patch succeeds");
            check("PATCH".equals(server.method.get()), "workflow status uses PATCH, not delete or recreate");
            check(server.path.get().contains("updateMask.fieldPaths=status")
                && server.path.get().contains("updateMask.fieldPaths=cancelledAt"), "patch mask limits changed Firestore fields");
            check(server.requestBody.get().contains("Cancelled") && server.requestBody.get().contains("timestampValue"),
                "cancellation sends only new status and timestamp values");
        }
    }

    private static void rejectsPathInjectionInUserIdentifiers() {
        try {
            new FirestoreRestClient("motorph-jd", "user/other", "token");
            throw new AssertionError("expected invalid UID to be rejected");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) {
            check(true, "UID cannot escape its Firestore path segment");
        }
    }

    private static FirestoreRestClient client(FakeFirestoreServer server) {
        return new FirestoreRestClient("motorph-jd", "user-123", "test-id-token", server.apiRoot());
    }

    private static void check(boolean condition, String message) {
        checks++;
        if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }

    private static final class FakeFirestoreServer implements AutoCloseable {
        private final HttpServer server;
        private final int status;
        private final String responseBody;
        private final AtomicReference<String> authorization = new AtomicReference<>();
        private final AtomicReference<String> method = new AtomicReference<>();
        private final AtomicReference<String> path = new AtomicReference<>();
        private final AtomicReference<String> requestBody = new AtomicReference<>("");

        FakeFirestoreServer(int status, String responseBody) throws IOException {
            this.status = status;
            this.responseBody = responseBody;
            server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress("127.0.0.1", 0), 0);
            server.createContext("/", this::handle);
            server.start();
        }

        String apiRoot() {
            return "http://127.0.0.1:" + server.getAddress().getPort() + "/v1/projects/";
        }

        private void handle(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
            authorization.set(exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Authorization"));
            method.set(exchange.getRequestMethod());
            path.set(exchange.getRequestURI().toString());
            requestBody.set(new String(exchange.getRequestBody().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            byte[] bytes = responseBody.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", "application/json");
            exchange.sendResponseHeaders(status, bytes.length);
            exchange.getResponseBody().write(bytes);
            exchange.close();
        }

        @Override
        public void close() {
            server.stop(0);
        }
    }
}
