    private static void createsRequestsInTheCurrentUserSubcollection() throws Exception {
        String id = "LV-012345ABCDEF";
        try (FakeFirestore server = new FakeFirestore(new Reply(200,
            "{\"name\":\"projects/demo/databases/(default)/documents/users/user-7/demoLeaveRequests/" + id + "\"}"))) {
            FirestoreWorkflowStore store = new FirestoreWorkflowStore(client(server));
            DemoLeaveRequest request = new DemoLeaveRequest(id, "DEMO-001", "Mara Rivera", "Vacation",
                "2026-11-10", "2026-11-11", "Synthetic only", "Pending review", "2026-11-03T10:00:00Z", "");
            check(store.createLeaveRequest(request) == request, "created workflow returned to caller");
            check(server.methods.get(0).equals("POST"), "workflow creation uses Firestore POST");
            check(server.paths.get(0).contains("/users/user-7/demoLeaveRequests")
                && server.paths.get(0).contains("documentId=" + id), "leave request path is scoped to user UID");
            check(server.bodies.get(0).contains("Pending review") && server.bodies.get(0).contains("timestampValue"),
                "leave fields use Firestore string and timestamp types");
            check("Bearer test-id-token".equals(server.authorization.get()), "ID token is forwarded for Firestore authorization");
        }
    }

    private static void listsTicketsAndMapsFirestoreFields() throws Exception {

        }

    private static void cancelsOnlyByPatchingStatusAndTimestamp() throws Exception {
        String id = "LV-012345ABCDEF";
        String document = "{\"name\":\"projects/demo/databases/(default)/documents/users/user-7/demoLeaveRequests/" + id + "\","
            + "\"fields\":{\"employeeId\":{\"stringValue\":\"DEMO-001\"},\"employeeName\":{\"stringValue\":\"Mara Rivera\"},"
            + "\"leaveType\":{\"stringValue\":\"Vacation\"},\"startDate\":{\"stringValue\":\"2026-11-10\"},"
            + "\"endDate\":{\"stringValue\":\"2026-11-11\"},\"note\":{\"stringValue\":\"\"},"
            + "\"status\":{\"stringValue\":\"Pending review\"},\"submittedAt\":{\"timestampValue\":\"2026-11-03T10:00:00Z\"}}}";
        try (FakeFirestore server = new FakeFirestore(
            new Reply(200, "{\"documents\":[" + document + "]}"),
            new Reply(200, "{\"name\":\"projects/demo/databases/(default)/documents/users/user-7/demoLeaveRequests/" + id + "\"}"))) {
            DemoLeaveRequest cancelled = new FirestoreWorkflowStore(client(server)).cancelLeaveRequest(id, "2026-11-03T11:00:00Z");
            check("Cancelled".equals(cancelled.getStatus()), "cancelled response reflects new state");
            check(server.methods.equals(Arrays.asList("GET", "PATCH")), "cancellation reads current state then patches");
            check(server.paths.get(1).contains("updateMask.fieldPaths=status")
                && server.paths.get(1).contains("updateMask.fieldPaths=cancelledAt"), "patch mask contains only cancellation fields");
            check(server.bodies.get(1).contains("Cancelled") && !server.bodies.get(1).contains("employeeName"),
                "cancellation cannot rewrite employee or request fields");
        }
    }

    private static FirestoreRestClient client(FakeFirestore server) {
        return new FirestoreRestClient("demo", "user-7", "test-id-token", server.apiRoot());
    }

    private static void check(boolean condition, String message) {
        checks++;
        if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }

    private static final class Reply {
        private final int status;
        private final String body;
        Reply(int status, String body) { this.status = status; this.body = body; }
    }

    private static final class FakeFirestore implements AutoCloseable {
        private final HttpServer server;
        private final List<Reply> replies;
        private final List<String> methods = new ArrayList<>();
        private final List<String> paths = new ArrayList<>();
        private final List<String> bodies = new ArrayList<>();
        private final AtomicReference<String> authorization = new AtomicReference<>();
        private int nextReply;

        FakeFirestore(Reply... replies) throws IOException {
            this.replies = Arrays.asList(replies);
            server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress("127.0.0.1", 0), 0);
            server.createContext("/", this::handle);
            server.start();
        }

        String apiRoot() { return "http://127.0.0.1:" + server.getAddress().getPort() + "/v1/projects/"; }

        private synchronized void handle(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
            methods.add(exchange.getRequestMethod());
            paths.add(exchange.getRequestURI().toString());
            authorization.set(exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Authorization"));
            bodies.add(new String(exchange.getRequestBody().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            Reply reply = replies.get(Math.min(nextReply++, replies.size() - 1));
            byte[] bytes = reply.body.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", "application/json");
            exchange.sendResponseHeaders(reply.status, bytes.length);
            exchange.getResponseBody().write(bytes);
            exchange.close();
        }

        @Override public void close() { server.stop(0); }
    }

package ph.motorph.web;

import com.google.gson.JsonObject;

import java.util.Arrays;

/** Creates only fictional, clearly marked records in one signed-in user's demo sandbox. */
public final class DemoSeedService {
    private final FirestoreRestClient client;

    public DemoSeedService(FirestoreRestClient client) {
        if (client == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("client must not be null");
        this.client = client;
    }

    public SeedResult seedMissingSyntheticRecords() {
        int employeesCreated = 0;
        for (Employee employee : new InMemoryEmployeeStore().findAll()) {
            if (client.createDocument(client.userCollection("demoEmployees"), employee.getId(), employeeFields(employee))) {
                employeesCreated++;
            }
        }

        int attendanceCreated = 0;
        InMemoryAttendanceStore sampleAttendance = new InMemoryAttendanceStore();
        for (int scheduleId : Arrays.asList(101, 102, 103)) {
            for (AttendanceRecord record : sampleAttendance.findByScheduleId(scheduleId)) {
                if (client.createDocument(client.userCollection("demoAttendance"),
                    Integer.toString(record.getAttendanceId()), attendanceFields(record))) {
                    attendanceCreated++;
                }
            }
        }
        return new SeedResult(employeesCreated, attendanceCreated);
    }

    private static JsonObject employeeFields(Employee employee) {
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("id", string(employee.getId()));
        fields.add("name", string(employee.getName()));
        fields.add("department", string(employee.getDepartment()));
        fields.add("role", string(employee.getRole()));
        fields.add("location", string(employee.getLocation()));
        fields.add("status", string(employee.getStatus()));
        return fields;
    }

    private static JsonObject attendanceFields(AttendanceRecord record) {
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("attendanceId", integer(record.getAttendanceId()));
        fields.add("scheduleId", integer(record.getScheduleId()));
        fields.add("date", string(record.getDate().toString()));
        fields.add("timeIn", string(record.getTimeIn().toString()));
        fields.add("timeOut", string(record.getTimeOut().toString()));
        fields.add("dayType", string("DEMO"));
        return fields;
    }

    private static JsonObject string(String value) {
        JsonObject typedValue = new JsonObject();
        typedValue.addProperty("stringValue", value);
        return typedValue;
    }

    private static JsonObject integer(int value) {
        JsonObject typedValue = new JsonObject();
        typedValue.addProperty("integerValue", Integer.toString(value));
        return typedValue;
    }

    public static final class SeedResult {
        private final int employeesCreated;
        private final int attendanceCreated;

        SeedResult(int employeesCreated, int attendanceCreated) {
            this.employeesCreated = employeesCreated;
            this.attendanceCreated = attendanceCreated;
        }

        public int getEmployeesCreated() { return employeesCreated; }
        public int getAttendanceCreated() { return attendanceCreated; }
    }
}
package ph.motorph.web;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/** Temporary raw attendance fixture. All entries and classifications are synthetic. */
public final class InMemoryAttendanceStore implements MutableAttendanceStore {
    private final List<AttendanceRecord> records;

    public InMemoryAttendanceStore() {
        List<AttendanceRecord> values = new ArrayList<>();
        values.add(record(5001, 101, "2026-10-01", "08:01", "17:00"));
        values.add(record(5002, 101, "2026-10-02", "07:58", "16:59"));
        values.add(record(5003, 101, "2026-10-15", "08:03", "17:01"));
        values.add(record(5101, 102, "2026-10-01", "08:00", "17:02"));
        values.add(record(5102, 102, "2026-10-03", "08:04", "17:03"));
        values.add(record(5201, 103, "2026-10-02", "08:10", "16:55"));
        records = values;
        enforceUniqueScheduleDate(records);
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized List<AttendanceRecord> findAll() {
        return new ArrayList<>(records);
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized List<AttendanceRecord> findByScheduleId(int scheduleId) {
        return records.stream()
            .filter(record -> record.getScheduleId() == scheduleId)
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized AttendanceRecord create(int scheduleId, LocalDate date, LocalTime timeIn,
                                                 LocalTime timeOut, String dayType) {
        for (AttendanceRecord existing : records) {
            if (existing.getScheduleId() == scheduleId && existing.getDate().equals(date)) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("A raw attendance record already exists for this synthetic schedule and date.");
            }
        }
        int nextId = records.stream().mapToInt(AttendanceRecord::getAttendanceId).max().orElse(0) + 1;
        if (nextId <= 0) throw new IllegalStateException("No synthetic attendance IDs remain in this process.");
        AttendanceRecord record = new AttendanceRecord(nextId, scheduleId, date, timeIn, timeOut, dayType);
        records.add(record);
        return record;
    }

    private static AttendanceRecord record(int attendanceId, int scheduleId, String date, String in, String out) {
        return new AttendanceRecord(attendanceId, scheduleId, LocalDate.parse(date),
            LocalTime.parse(in), LocalTime.parse(out), "DEMO");
    }

    private static void enforceUniqueScheduleDate(List<AttendanceRecord> records) {
        Set<String> keys = new HashSet<>();
        for (AttendanceRecord record : records) {
            String key = record.getScheduleId() + ":" + record.getDate();
            if (!keys.add(key)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duplicate attendance for schedule/date: " + key);
        }
    }
}

    private void handleSeedDemo(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!"POST".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
            return;
        }
        if (firebaseProjectId.isEmpty()) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"Firebase is not configured for this server.\"}");
            return;

        try {
            FirestoreRestClient client = firestoreClientFor(exchange);
            DemoSeedService.SeedResult result = new DemoSeedService(client).seedMissingSyntheticRecords();
            sendJson(exchange, 200, "{\"employeesCreated\":" + result.getEmployeesCreated()
                + ",\"attendanceCreated\":" + result.getAttendanceCreated()
                + ",\"syntheticOnly\":true}");
        } catch (FirestoreException ex) {
            sendApiError(exchange, ex);
        }
    }

    private RequestServices servicesFor(HttpExchange exchange) {
        if (firebaseProjectId.isEmpty()) {
            return new RequestServices(localEmployeeService, localAttendanceStore);
        }
        FirestoreRestClient client = firestoreClientFor(exchange);
        return new RequestServices(new EmployeeService(new FirestoreEmployeeStore(client)), new FirestoreAttendanceStore(client));
    }

    private FirestoreRestClient firestoreClientFor(HttpExchange exchange) {
        String authorization = exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Authorization");
        String uid = exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("X-Firebase-UID");
        if (authorization == null || !authorization.startsWith("Bearer ") || uid == null || uid.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new FirestoreException("Sign in with your Firebase account to continue.", 401);
        }
        String token = authorization.substring("Bearer ".length()).trim();
        if (token.length() > 8192 || uid.length() > 128 || uid.contains("/")) {
            throw new FirestoreException("Invalid Firebase session information.", 401);
        }
        return firestoreApiRoot == null
            ? new FirestoreRestClient(firebaseProjectId, uid, token)
            : new FirestoreRestClient(firebaseProjectId, uid, token, firestoreApiRoot);
    }

    private static LocalDate parseOptionalDate(String value) {
        return value == null || value.trim().isEmpty() ? null : LocalDate.parse(value.trim());
    }

    private static String attendanceToJson(List<AttendanceRecord> records) {
        StringBuilder json = new StringBuilder("{\"items\":[");
        for (int i = 0; i < records.size(); i++) {
            AttendanceRecord record = records.get(i);
            if (i > 0) json.append(',');
            json.append(attendanceRecordToJson(record));
        }
        return json.append("],\"count\":").append(records.size())
            .append(",\"hoursCalculated\":false}").toString();
    }

package ph.motorph.web;

import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.URI;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Small Firestore REST client that forwards a Firebase Auth ID token. Firestore
 * Security Rules, not server credentials, authorize every read and write.
 */
public final class FirestoreRestClient {
    private static final String API_ROOT = "https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/";
    private static final HttpClient HTTP = HttpClient.newBuilder()
        .connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(10)).build();

    private final String apiRoot;
    private final String projectId;
    private final String userId;
    private final String idToken;

    public FirestoreRestClient(String projectId, String userId, String idToken) {
        this(projectId, userId, idToken, API_ROOT);
    }

    /** Package-private endpoint override for isolated HTTP contract tests. */
    FirestoreRestClient(String projectId, String userId, String idToken, String apiRoot) {
        this.projectId = requireSafeSegment(projectId, "project id");
        this.userId = requireSafeSegment(userId, "user id");
        if (idToken == null || idToken.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Firebase sign-in is required");
        if (apiRoot == null || apiRoot.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("API root must not be blank");
        this.idToken = idToken.trim();
        this.apiRoot = apiRoot.trim().endsWith("/") ? apiRoot.trim() : apiRoot.trim() + "/";
    }

    public List<JsonObject> listDocuments(String collectionPath) {
        List<JsonObject> documents = new ArrayList<>();
        String pageToken = "";
        do {
            String url = documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "?pageSize=1000" + pageToken;
            JsonObject response = send("GET", url, null, false);
            JsonArray items = response.has("documents") ? response.getAsJsonArray("documents") : new JsonArray();
            for (JsonElement item : items) documents.add(item.getAsJsonObject());
            pageToken = response.has("nextPageToken")
                ? "&pageToken=" + queryEncode(response.get("nextPageToken").getAsString()) : "";
        } while (!pageToken.isEmpty());
        return documents;
    }

    public boolean createDocument(String collectionPath, String documentId, JsonObject fields) {
        String url = documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "?documentId=" + queryEncode(requireSafeSegment(documentId, "document id"));
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.add("fields", fields);
        return send("POST", url, body, true).has("name");
    }

    public boolean updateDocument(String collectionPath, String documentId, JsonObject fields, List<String> updateMask) {
        if (fields == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("document fields must not be null");
        if (updateMask == null || updateMask.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("update mask must not be empty");
        StringBuilder url = new StringBuilder(documentsUrl(collectionPath))
            .append('/').append(pathEncode(requireSafeSegment(documentId, "document id")));
        for (String field : updateMask) {
            String safeField = requireSafeSegment(field, "update field");
            url.append(url.indexOf("?") < 0 ? "?" : "&")
                .append("updateMask.fieldPaths=").append(queryEncode(safeField));
        }
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.add("fields", fields);
        return send("PATCH", url.toString(), body, false).has("name");
    }

    public String userCollection(String collectionName) {
        return "users/" + userId + "/" + requireSafeSegment(collectionName, "collection name");
    }

    private JsonObject send(String method, String url, JsonObject body, boolean allowExisting) {
        try {
            HttpRequest.Builder builder = HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create(url))
                .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(20))
                .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + idToken)
                .header("Accept", "application/json");
            if (body != null) {
                builder.header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
                    .method(method, HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(body.toString(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            } else {
                builder.method(method, HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.noBody());
            }
            HttpResponse<String> response = HTTP.send(builder.build(), HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            if (allowExisting && (response.statusCode() == 409 || response.statusCode() == 400)
                && response.body() != null && response.body().contains("ALREADY_EXISTS")) {
                return new JsonObject();
            }
            if (response.statusCode() < 200 || response.statusCode() >= 300) {
                throw firestoreError(response.statusCode(), response.body());
            }
            String responseBody = response.body();
            return responseBody == null || responseBody.trim().isEmpty()
                ? new JsonObject() : JsonParser.parseString(responseBody).getAsJsonObject();
        } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            throw new FirestoreException("Firestore request was interrupted.", 503);
        } catch (IOException | IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            throw new FirestoreException("Could not reach Firestore. Check the network and project setup.", 503);
        }
    }

    private String documentsUrl(String collectionPath) {
        StringBuilder path = new StringBuilder(apiRoot)
            .append(pathEncode(projectId)).append("/databases/(default)/documents");
        for (String segment : collectionPath.split("/")) {
            path.append('/').append(pathEncode(requireSafeSegment(segment, "path segment")));
        }
        return path.toString();
    }

    private static String requireSafeSegment(String value, String label) {
        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty() || value.contains("/")) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(label + " must be a non-empty path segment");
        }
        return value.trim();
    }

    private static String pathEncode(String value) {
        return URLEncoder.encode(value, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).replace("+", "%20");
    }

    private static String queryEncode(String value) {
        return URLEncoder.encode(value, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    private static FirestoreException firestoreError(int status, String body) {
        String message = "Firestore request failed (HTTP " + status + ").";
        if (status == 401) message = "Firebase sign-in expired. Sign out and sign in again.";
        else if (status == 403) message = "Firestore denied this request. Publish the scoped development rules in docs/firestore.rules, then retry.";
        else if (status == 404) message = "Firestore database or requested resource was not found. Check the Firebase project and database setup.";
        else if (status == 409 || status == 400) message = "A demo record could not be created. Refresh the page and try again.";
        return new FirestoreException(message, status);
    }
}
package ph.motorph.web;

import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/** User-scoped synthetic attendance records read through Firestore REST. */
public final class FirestoreAttendanceStore implements AttendanceStore {
    private final FirestoreRestClient client;

    public FirestoreAttendanceStore(FirestoreRestClient client) {
        if (client == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("client must not be null");
        this.client = client;
    }

    @Override
    public List<AttendanceRecord> findAll() {
        List<AttendanceRecord> records = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JsonObject document : client.listDocuments(client.userCollection("demoAttendance"))) {
            records.add(fromDocument(document));
        }
        return records;
    }

    @Override
    public List<AttendanceRecord> findByScheduleId(int scheduleId) {
        return findAll().stream().filter(record -> record.getScheduleId() == scheduleId).collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    private static AttendanceRecord fromDocument(JsonObject document) {
        JsonObject fields = document.has("fields") ? document.getAsJsonObject("fields") : new JsonObject();
        return new AttendanceRecord(
            integerValue(fields, "attendanceId"), integerValue(fields, "scheduleId"),
            LocalDate.parse(stringValue(fields, "date")), LocalTime.parse(stringValue(fields, "timeIn")),
            LocalTime.parse(stringValue(fields, "timeOut")), stringValue(fields, "dayType"));
    }

    private static int integerValue(JsonObject fields, String name) {
        JsonElement element = fields.get(name);
        if (element == null || !element.isJsonObject()) return 0;
        JsonElement value = element.getAsJsonObject().get("integerValue");
        return value == null || value.isJsonNull() ? 0 : Integer.parseInt(value.getAsString());
    }

    private static String stringValue(JsonObject fields, String name) {
        return FirestoreEmployeeStore.stringValue(fields, name);
    }
}
package ph.motorph.web;

import java.util.Objects;

/** A small employee view model for the first synthetic-data prototype. */
public final class Employee {
    private final String id;
    private final String name;
    private final String department;
    private final String role;
    private final String location;
    private final String status;

    public Employee(String id, String name, String department, String role, String location, String status) {
        this.id = requireText(id, "id");
        this.name = requireText(name, "name");
        this.department = requireText(department, "department");
        this.role = requireText(role, "role");
        this.location = requireText(location, "location");
        this.status = requireText(status, "status");
    }

    private static String requireText(String value, String field) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(value, field + " must not be null");
        if (value.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must not be blank");
        return value.trim();
    }

    public String getId() { return id; }
    public String getName() { return name; }
    public String getDepartment() { return department; }
    public String getRole() { return role; }
    public String getLocation() { return location; }
    public String getStatus() { return status; }
}
package ph.motorph.web;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
import java.util.Optional;

/** Process-memory store containing only fictional demo employees. */
public final class InMemoryEmployeeStore implements MutableEmployeeStore {
    private final Map<String, Employee> employees = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    public InMemoryEmployeeStore() {
        addFixture(new Employee("DEMO-001", "Mara Rivera", "People Operations", "HR Coordinator", "Makati", "Active"));
        addFixture(new Employee("DEMO-002", "Eli Santos", "Finance", "Payroll Associate", "Taguig", "Active"));
        addFixture(new Employee("DEMO-003", "Noa Reyes", "Operations", "Operations Lead", "Quezon City", "On leave"));
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized List<Employee> findAll() {
        return new ArrayList<>(employees.values());
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized Optional<Employee> findById(String id) {
        return Optional.ofNullable(id == null ? null : employees.get(id.trim()));
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized Employee create(Employee employee) {
        if (employees.containsKey(employee.getId())) throw new IllegalStateException("Employee ID already exists.");
        employees.put(employee.getId(), employee);
        return employee;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized Employee update(Employee employee) {
        if (!employees.containsKey(employee.getId())) throw new NoSuchElementException("Employee not found.");
        employees.put(employee.getId(), employee);
        return employee;
    }

    private void addFixture(Employee employee) {
        employees.put(employee.getId(), employee);
    }
}

    calendar displays submitted request dates only
    no reviewer notification, approve/reject, balance change, ticket resolution or payroll treatment
```

### 4.5 Reporting, search, and portable export

```text
attendance calendar = render raw rows by actual stored date; blank is not absence
employee detail = GET that employee's raw attendance + sandbox workflows; filter by exact employee ID

cross-module search = GET employee/workflow/raw attendance data; search only listed stored fields
CSV export = selected visible/all stored rows; neutralize spreadsheet formula prefixes
JSON export = GET snapshot for current mode/user; mark syntheticOnly, hoursCalculated=false, payrollIncluded=false
```

## 5. Full-build pseudocode — target behavior after decisions and implementation

The following is an implementation outline, not a claim that these functions already exist. `BLOCKED` means the product needs an approved rule, security boundary, or acceptance example before those lines can safely become code. The user’s latest message authorizes reusing prior submissions as **candidate source material**; it does not resolve conflicts between those submissions or turn their formulas into MotorPH policy automatically.

### 5.1 Authenticated storage promotion

```text
on every write:
    verify Firebase ID token server-side OR use authenticated Firebase SDK + rules
    derive uid from verified token, never trust a client-supplied employee/user relation
    load only users/{uid}/... records

attendance create (non-local capability requested, but not yet implemented or deployed):
    verify body allowlist
    verify employee exists in uid scope
    resolve schedule mapping from approved uid-owned schedule source
    begin transaction
        reserve unique key (uid, scheduleID, date)
        allocate durable attendance ID
        create raw row with allowed dayType from approved enum
    commit transaction or return conflict
    emit audit event only after approved schema/retention policy exists

never copy unauthenticated shared local process records into a Firebase user account automatically
```

**Technical requirement:** Firestore Security Rules cannot provide the same general transaction-safe composite uniqueness guarantee by a simple client check. A durable design should use a trusted backend/Cloud Function or a transaction with a deterministic uniqueness document/key, plus a reviewed rule set and emulator tests. No Firebase Console/rule publication is included in this code inventory.

apply explicit grace, meal-break, rounding, overtime, rest-day, holiday, leave and correction rules
produce a trace for each input row and each calculated output
compare trace and totals to approved golden cases
```

## 6. Re-review of the user's database design and later calculator work

The user's ctxt.io document is the **MO-IT107 database design/data dictionary**, not a database file or a set of calculation rules. It does, however, lay out a useful storage model that the earlier review had not connected to a working calculation pipeline:

- `Rates` and `Tax Table` are intended as changeable reference tables; the design mentions a rate `implementationYear`, although this field is missing from the linked Data Dictionary and the design's own key constraints disagree.
- `Government Deductibles` separates monthly employer contribution, employee contribution, and withholding tax.
- `Contributions` stores SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG amounts separately for `Employee` and `Employer`.
- `Payroll`, `Payslip`, `Earnings`, `Deductibles`, `Other Transactions`, `Government Tally`, and `Summary` cover the intended input/output and reporting areas. Payslip includes a start/end period and gross income.
- The related DFD describes the order of operations: timesheet validation → wage/adjustments → government deductibles → basic payroll computation → payslip → monthly summary. The System Admin has a rate-update flow.

That design is valuable for the **mechanics before calculation**, but it contains no actual rates, effective date ranges, formula, rounding policy, or worked expected values. In particular, the tax table is not explicit about whether each row is monthly, semi-monthly, or another withholding period, and the monthly government-deduction key shown in the design has no year component. The user-provided full synthesis likewise warns that the PDFs do not state statutory values or arithmetic. The design should be versioned and reconciled before it is used as a persistent production schema.

A different older SQLite file exists in peer folder 1 (`/home/user/repo_review/full_repo/testingester-main/1/-/myMotorPhdb.db`). I inspected its table definitions only—not any records—and found `Users`, `Allowance`, `Salary_Deduction`, `EmployeeAudit`, and `Employee_info`, not the normalized Rates/Tax Table/Government Deductibles design in the ctxt link. It is not a source of verified statutory rates.

### A later prior project did tackle the calculation pipeline

The supplied folder-9 review copy, `/home/user/repo_review/full_repo/testingester-main/9/-/oop/`, contains an actual `PayrollCalculator` orchestrator and separate SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, and withholding-tax calculators. Its pipeline is:

1. derive gross as worked days × hourly rate × 8;
2. calculate employee/employer statutory items;
3. calculate withholding after employee statutory contributions;
4. calculate net and build an immutable payroll record.

Its NOTES and console tests report this pipeline exercised. But the formulas are hard-coded as Java `double` constants and the source XLSX matrices cited by its verification note were on a personal Windows path, not among the supplied files. The source values are **not a current 2026 ruleset**:

- SSS caps the employee share at ₱1,125, which predates the 2025 schedule (2026 uses the current schedule effective January 2025: 5% employee / 10% employer on MSC up to ₱35,000, plus employer-only EC).
- PhilHealth uses 3%, a ₱10,000 floor/₱60,000 ceiling and a 50/50 split; the current direct-contributor advisory for formal-sector MBS gives 5%, ₱10,000 floor/₱100,000 ceiling, with allowances and overtime excluded from the MBS base.
- Pag-IBIG caps at ₱100, reflecting the former ₱5,000 MFS; Circular 460 moved the MFS ceiling to ₱10,000 effective February 2024, allowing up to ₱200 per side.
- Its first taxable monthly BIR band uses 20%; Annex E uses 15% from ₱20,833 to ₱33,332. The prior project also does not make a semi-monthly tax table part of its calculator API.

A separate folder-7 `ContributionCalculator.java` also computes semi-monthly values, but doubles the pay-period input to a monthly proxy and reuses old CP2 schedules: SSS max ₱1,125, PhilHealth 1.5% employee amount with ₱900 cap, Pag-IBIG cap ₱100, and a 20% first taxable band. Its payroll code labels overtime pricing as temporary pending confirmation. Folder 3 is even simpler (flat 4.5% SSS, 2% PhilHealth, ₱100 Pag-IBIG, no tax schedule). These show earlier mechanical exploration, but none supply a current validated 2026 profile.

The older folder-6 implementation is even more explicitly a CP2/course-project compatibility profile, not a 2026 statutory table. Neither implementation was copied into the current app.

## 7. Temporary 2026 module now in this prototype

Following the user's instruction, a **client-side-only, synthetic-input preview** has been added to the Payroll workspace. It is deliberately isolated and replaceable:

- Change rates, thresholds, table bands, sources, or the profile ID in `web/payroll-rules-2026.js`.
- Calculation logic is pure and separated in `web/payroll-preview-2026.js`; amounts are parsed and calculated in integer centavos (`BigInt`), not binary floating point.
- `web/payroll-preview-ui.js` only renders the submitted values and result. It sends no payroll API request, reads no employee or attendance record, and persists nothing in Firebase or local storage.
- Current scope is **monthly 2026 statutory preview only**. It requires separate cash-pay, SSS compensation, PhilHealth MBS, Pag-IBIG Fund Salary, and taxable-compensation inputs. That prevents the preview from silently assuming all legal contribution/tax bases are identical.
- It separates employee deductions from employer costs, includes the current SSS employer-only EC amount, uses the BIR **monthly** Annex E table with a provisional half-up centavo rounding rule, and blocks a negative net rather than emitting a negative payslip.
- It does not create/pay a payroll, resolve salary conversion, attendance hours, overtime, leave/holiday earnings, deductions between cutoffs, tax annualisation/adjustment, benefit exemptions, employees, or payslips.

For a fully synthetic ₱25,000 monthly example using ₱25,000 for each input base, this profile produces: SSS employee ₱1,250; SSS employer SS/MPF ₱2,500 plus EC ₱30; PhilHealth ₱625 each; Pag-IBIG ₱200 each; taxable base after employee shares ₱22,925; monthly BIR withholding ₱313.80; net estimate ₱22,611.20; employer statutory contributions ₱3,355; gross plus those employer contributions ₱28,355.00. The difference from `ph-payroll`'s documented ₱22,611.25 is the disclosed monthly-table versus annualized-tax method/rounding difference; the sandbox uses the published BIR monthly table for its monthly mode, not the library result.

The input boundaries and the editable monthly calculation are now covered in `test/web/payroll-preview-2026.test.js`; a browser E2E check confirms the result and that no payroll API call is made. The profile remains a **temporary estimate**, not an approved payroll policy or statutory compliance guarantee.

- PhilHealth Advisory PA2025-0002: 5% effective Jan. 2025; monthly basic salary floor ₱10,000 / ceiling ₱100,000; allowances, overtime, 13th-month pay, bonuses and similar items excluded from employer MBS: https://www.philhealth.gov.ph/advisories/2025/PA2025-0002.pdf

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
import java.util.OptionalInt;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/** Reads raw attendance for one employee; deliberately does not calculate paid hours. */
public final class AttendanceService {
    private final EmployeeService employeeService;
    private final EmployeeScheduleStore scheduleStore;
    private final AttendanceStore attendanceStore;

    public AttendanceService(EmployeeService employeeService, EmployeeScheduleStore scheduleStore,
                             AttendanceStore attendanceStore) {
        if (employeeService == null || scheduleStore == null || attendanceStore == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("attendance service dependencies must not be null");
        }
        this.employeeService = employeeService;
        this.scheduleStore = scheduleStore;
        this.attendanceStore = attendanceStore;
    }

    /** Inclusive optional date filtering; no pay-period calendar is inferred. */
    public List<AttendanceRecord> findForEmployee(String employeeId, LocalDate from, LocalDate to) {
        if (!employeeService.findEmployee(employeeId).isPresent()) {
            throw new NoSuchElementException("employee not found");
        }
        validateRange(from, to);
        OptionalInt scheduleId = scheduleStore.findScheduleIdForEmployee(employeeId.trim());
        if (!scheduleId.isPresent()) return java.util.Collections.emptyList();
        return attendanceStore.findByScheduleId(scheduleId.getAsInt()).stream()
            .filter(record -> from == null || !record.getDate().isBefore(from))
            .filter(record -> to == null || !record.getDate().isAfter(to))
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    /** Adds one local synthetic raw row for an existing mapping; no hours or classifications are inferred. */
    public AttendanceRecord createForEmployee(String employeeId, LocalDate date, LocalTime timeIn, LocalTime timeOut) {
        if (employeeId == null || employeeId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("employeeId is required.");
        }
        if (!employeeService.findEmployee(employeeId.trim()).isPresent()) {
            throw new NoSuchElementException("employee not found");
        }
        OptionalInt scheduleId = scheduleStore.findScheduleIdForEmployee(employeeId.trim());
        if (!scheduleId.isPresent()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("No configured synthetic schedule mapping exists for this employee; no schedule was assigned.");
        }
        if (!(attendanceStore instanceof MutableAttendanceStore)) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Attendance entry is disabled for this storage mode.");
        }
        return ((MutableAttendanceStore) attendanceStore).create(scheduleId.getAsInt(), date, timeIn, timeOut, "DEMO");
    }

    /** Counts raw rows and their date coverage; this never classifies attendance or derives hours. */
    public List<RawAttendanceSummary> summarizeRawRecords(LocalDate from, LocalDate to) {
        validateRange(from, to);
        List<AttendanceRecord> allRecords = attendanceStore.findAll();
        List<RawAttendanceSummary> summaries = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Employee employee : employeeService.listEmployees()) {
            OptionalInt schedule = scheduleStore.findScheduleIdForEmployee(employee.getId());
            if (!schedule.isPresent()) {
                summaries.add(new RawAttendanceSummary(employee.getId(), employee.getName(), null, 0, "", ""));
                continue;
            }
            List<AttendanceRecord> matched = allRecords.stream()
                .filter(record -> record.getScheduleId() == schedule.getAsInt())
                .filter(record -> from == null || !record.getDate().isBefore(from))
                .filter(record -> to == null || !record.getDate().isAfter(to))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
            String firstDate = matched.stream().map(record -> record.getDate().toString()).min(String::compareTo).orElse("");
            String lastDate = matched.stream().map(record -> record.getDate().toString()).max(String::compareTo).orElse("");
            summaries.add(new RawAttendanceSummary(employee.getId(), employee.getName(), schedule.getAsInt(),
                matched.size(), firstDate, lastDate));
        }
        summaries.sort(Comparator.comparing(RawAttendanceSummary::getEmployeeId));
        return summaries;
    }

    private static void validateRange(LocalDate from, LocalDate to) {
        if (from != null && to != null && from.isAfter(to)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("from date must be on or before to date");
        }
    }
}

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.OptionalInt;

/** Synthetic employee-to-schedule mapping; replace with the approved source later. */
public final class InMemoryEmployeeScheduleStore implements EmployeeScheduleStore {
    private final Map<String, Integer> scheduleByEmployee;

    public InMemoryEmployeeScheduleStore() {
        Map<String, Integer> values = new HashMap<>();
        values.put("DEMO-001", 101);
        values.put("DEMO-002", 102);
        values.put("DEMO-003", 103);
        scheduleByEmployee = Collections.unmodifiableMap(values);
    }

    @Override
    public OptionalInt findScheduleIdForEmployee(String employeeId) {
        Integer scheduleId = employeeId == null ? null : scheduleByEmployee.get(employeeId);
        return scheduleId == null ? OptionalInt.empty() : OptionalInt.of(scheduleId);
    }
}
package ph.motorph.web;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.util.Objects;

/** Raw attendance data model aligned to the supplied MO-IT107 Attendance fields. */
public final class AttendanceRecord {
    private final int attendanceId;
    private final int scheduleId;
    private final LocalDate date;
    private final LocalTime timeIn;
    private final LocalTime timeOut;
    private final String dayType;

    public AttendanceRecord(int attendanceId, int scheduleId, LocalDate date,
                            LocalTime timeIn, LocalTime timeOut, String dayType) {
        if (attendanceId <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("attendanceId must be positive");
        if (scheduleId <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("scheduleId must be positive");
        this.date = Objects.requireNonNull(date, "date must not be null");
        this.timeIn = Objects.requireNonNull(timeIn, "timeIn must not be null");
        this.timeOut = Objects.requireNonNull(timeOut, "timeOut must not be null");
        if (timeIn.isAfter(timeOut)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("timeIn must be less than or equal to timeOut per the supplied data dictionary");
        }
        if (dayType == null || dayType.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dayType must not be blank");
        this.attendanceId = attendanceId;
        this.scheduleId = scheduleId;
        this.dayType = dayType.trim();
    }

    public int getAttendanceId() { return attendanceId; }
    public int getScheduleId() { return scheduleId; }
    public LocalDate getDate() { return date; }
    public LocalTime getTimeIn() { return timeIn; }
    public LocalTime getTimeOut() { return timeOut; }
    public String getDayType() { return dayType; }
}

service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {
    function signedInAs(uid) {
      return request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == uid;
    }

    function validDemoEmployee(employeeId) {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.keys().hasAll(['id', 'name', 'department', 'role', 'location', 'status'])
        && d.keys().hasOnly(['id', 'name', 'department', 'role', 'location', 'status'])
        && d.id is string && d.id == employeeId && d.id.size() <= 40
        && d.name is string && d.name.size() > 0 && d.name.size() <= 100
        && d.department is string && d.department.size() > 0 && d.department.size() <= 100
        && d.role is string && d.role.size() > 0 && d.role.size() <= 100
        && d.location is string && d.location.size() > 0 && d.location.size() <= 100
        && d.status in ['Active', 'On leave'];
    }

    function validDemoAttendance() {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.keys().hasAll(['attendanceId', 'scheduleId', 'date', 'timeIn', 'timeOut', 'dayType'])
        && d.keys().hasOnly(['attendanceId', 'scheduleId', 'date', 'timeIn', 'timeOut', 'dayType'])
        && d.attendanceId is int && d.attendanceId > 0
        && d.scheduleId is int && d.scheduleId > 0
        && d.date is string && d.date.matches('^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$')
        && d.timeIn is string && d.timeIn.matches('^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')
        && d.timeOut is string && d.timeOut.matches('^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$')
        && d.dayType == 'DEMO';
    }

    function ownsDemoEmployee(uid, employeeId, employeeName) {
      let employeePath = /databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(uid)/demoEmployees/$(employeeId);
      return employeeId is string
        && (employeeId.matches('^DEMO-[0-9]{3}$') || employeeId.matches('^DEMO-[A-F0-9]{12}$'))
        && employeeName is string
        && exists(employeePath)
        && get(employeePath).data.name == employeeName;
    }

    function validDemoLeaveRequest(uid, requestId) {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.keys().hasAll(['id', 'employeeId', 'employeeName', 'leaveType', 'startDate', 'endDate', 'note', 'status', 'submittedAt'])
        && d.keys().hasOnly(['id', 'employeeId', 'employeeName', 'leaveType', 'startDate', 'endDate', 'note', 'status', 'submittedAt'])
        && d.id is string && d.id == requestId && d.id.matches('^LV-[A-F0-9]{12}$')
        && ownsDemoEmployee(uid, d.employeeId, d.employeeName)
        && d.leaveType in ['Vacation', 'Medical', 'Personal', 'Unpaid']
        && d.startDate is string && d.startDate.matches('^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$')
        && d.endDate is string && d.endDate.matches('^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$')
        && d.startDate <= d.endDate
        && d.note is string && d.note.size() <= 240
        && d.status == 'Pending review'
        && d.submittedAt is timestamp;
    }

    function validDemoLeaveCancellation(uid, requestId) {
      let previous = resource.data;
      let next = request.resource.data;
      return signedInAs(uid)
        && previous.id == requestId
        && previous.status == 'Pending review'
        && next.id == previous.id
        && next.diff(previous).affectedKeys().hasAll(['status', 'cancelledAt'])
        && next.diff(previous).affectedKeys().hasOnly(['status', 'cancelledAt'])
        && next.status == 'Cancelled'
        && next.cancelledAt is timestamp;
    }

    function validTicketQueue(ticketType, queue) {
      return (ticketType in ['Overtime request', 'Leave request', 'Timesheet correction'] && queue == 'Team Lead')
        || (ticketType == 'Payroll inquiry' && queue == 'Payroll Staff')
        || (ticketType == 'HR inquiry' && queue == 'HR')
        || (ticketType == 'Technical support' && queue == 'IT Admin');
    }

    function validDemoTicket(uid, ticketId) {
      let d = request.resource.data;
      return d.keys().hasAll(['id', 'employeeId', 'employeeName', 'ticketType', 'queue', 'summary', 'status', 'submittedAt'])
        && d.keys().hasOnly(['id', 'employeeId', 'employeeName', 'ticketType', 'queue', 'summary', 'status', 'submittedAt'])
        && d.id is string && d.id == ticketId && d.id.matches('^TK-[A-F0-9]{12}$')
        && ownsDemoEmployee(uid, d.employeeId, d.employeeName)
        && validTicketQueue(d.ticketType, d.queue)
        && d.summary is string && d.summary.size() > 0 && d.summary.size() <= 240
        && d.status == 'Open'
        && d.submittedAt is timestamp;
    }

    function validDemoTicketCancellation(uid, ticketId) {
      let previous = resource.data;
      let next = request.resource.data;
      return signedInAs(uid)
        && previous.id == ticketId
        && previous.status == 'Open'
        && next.id == previous.id
        && next.diff(previous).affectedKeys().hasAll(['status', 'cancelledAt'])
        && next.diff(previous).affectedKeys().hasOnly(['status', 'cancelledAt'])
        && next.status == 'Cancelled'
        && next.cancelledAt is timestamp;
    }

    match /users/{uid}/demoEmployees/{employeeId} {
      allow read: if signedInAs(uid);
      allow create, update: if signedInAs(uid) && validDemoEmployee(employeeId);
      allow delete: if signedInAs(uid);
    }

    match /users/{uid}/demoAttendance/{attendanceId} {
      allow read: if signedInAs(uid);
      allow create, update: if signedInAs(uid) && validDemoAttendance();
      allow delete: if signedInAs(uid);
    }

    // Owner-only demo requests. There are deliberately no reviewer, approval, or delete permissions.
    match /users/{uid}/demoLeaveRequests/{requestId} {
      allow read: if signedInAs(uid);
      allow create: if signedInAs(uid) && validDemoLeaveRequest(uid, requestId);
      allow update: if validDemoLeaveCancellation(uid, requestId);
      allow delete: if false;
    }

    match /users/{uid}/demoTickets/{ticketId} {
      allow read: if signedInAs(uid);
      allow create: if signedInAs(uid) && validDemoTicket(uid, ticketId);
      allow update: if validDemoTicketCancellation(uid, ticketId);
      allow delete: if false;
    }

    // Default-deny: no other Firestore document paths are available to clients.
    match /{document=**} {
      allow read, write: if false;
    }
  }

public final class AppServer {

    public AppServer() {
        this(System.getenv().getOrDefault("FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID", ""),
            Paths.get(System.getenv().getOrDefault("WEB_ROOT", "web")), null);
    }

    AppServer(String firebaseProjectId, Path webRoot) {
        this(firebaseProjectId, webRoot, null);
    }

    AppServer(String firebaseProjectId, Path webRoot, String firestoreApiRoot) {
        this.firebaseProjectId = firebaseProjectId == null ? "" : firebaseProjectId.trim();
        if (webRoot == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("webRoot must not be null");
        this.webRoot = webRoot.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        this.firestoreApiRoot = firestoreApiRoot == null || firestoreApiRoot.trim().isEmpty()
            ? null : firestoreApiRoot.trim();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        int port = Integer.parseInt(System.getenv().getOrDefault("PORT", "8080"));
        String host = System.getenv().getOrDefault("HOST", "0.0.0.0");
        AppServer app = new AppServer();
        app.start(host, port);
        Runtime.getRuntime().addShutdownHook(new Thread(app::stop));
    }

    HttpServer start(String host, int port) throws IOException {
        if (server != null) throw new IllegalStateException("server is already started");
        server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress(host, port), 0);
        server.createContext("/api/health", this::handleHealth);
        server.createContext("/api/employees", this::handleEmployees);
        server.createContext("/api/attendance", this::handleAttendance);
        server.createContext("/api/reports/attendance", this::handleAttendanceReport);
        server.createContext("/api/workflows", this::handleWorkflows);
        server.createContext("/api/demo/seed", this::handleSeedDemo);
        server.createContext("/", this::handleStaticFiles);
        executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(8);
        server.setExecutor(executor);
        server.start();
        System.out.println("MotorPH Java API listening on " + host + ":" + server.getAddress().getPort());
        System.out.println("Mode: " + (firebaseProjectId.isEmpty() ? "local synthetic demo" : "Firebase-authenticated user sandbox"));
        System.out.println("Serving browser files from " + webRoot);
        return server;
    }

    void stop() {
        if (server != null) {
            server.stop(0);
            server = null;
        }
        if (executor != null) {
            executor.shutdownNow();
            executor = null;
        }
    }

    private void handleHealth(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!"GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
            return;
        }
        String mode = firebaseProjectId.isEmpty() ? "local-synthetic-demo" : "firebase-user-sandbox";
        sendJson(exchange, 200, "{\"status\":\"ok\",\"mode\":\"" + mode + "\"}");
    }

    private void handleEmployees(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        String path = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();
        String method = exchange.getRequestMethod();
        try {
            if ("GET".equals(method)) {
                RequestServices services = servicesFor(exchange);
                if ("/api/employees".equals(path) || "/api/employees/".equals(path)) {
                    String query = queryParameter(exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery(), "q");
                    List<Employee> matches = services.employeeService.searchEmployees(query);
                    int total = services.employeeService.listEmployees().size();
                    sendJson(exchange, 200, employeesToJson(matches, total));
                    return;
                }
                if (!path.startsWith("/api/employees/")) {
                    sendJson(exchange, 404, "{\"error\":\"Employee not found\"}");
                    return;
                }
                String id = path.substring("/api/employees/".length());
                if (id.isEmpty() || id.contains("/")) {
                    sendJson(exchange, 404, "{\"error\":\"Employee not found\"}");
                    return;
                }
                Optional<Employee> employee = services.employeeService.findEmployee(id);
                if (!employee.isPresent()) {
                    sendJson(exchange, 404, "{\"error\":\"Employee not found\"}");
                    return;
                }
                sendJson(exchange, 200, "{\"item\":" + employeeToJson(employee.get()) + "}");
                return;
            }
            if ("POST".equals(method) && "/api/employees".equals(path)) {
                RequestServices services = servicesFor(exchange);
                JsonObject body = readJsonBody(exchange);
                requireOnlyKeys(body, "name", "department", "role", "location", "status");
                Employee created = services.employeeService.createEmployee(requiredString(body, "name"),
                    requiredString(body, "department"), requiredString(body, "role"),
                    requiredString(body, "location"), requiredString(body, "status"));
                sendJson(exchange, 201, "{\"item\":" + employeeToJson(created) + "}");
                return;
            }
            if ("PUT".equals(method) && path.startsWith("/api/employees/")) {
                RequestServices services = servicesFor(exchange);
                String id = path.substring("/api/employees/".length());
                if (id.isEmpty() || id.contains("/")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Employee ID is invalid.");
                JsonObject body = readJsonBody(exchange);
                requireOnlyKeys(body, "name", "department", "role", "location", "status");
                Employee updated = services.employeeService.updateEmployee(id, requiredString(body, "name"),
                    requiredString(body, "department"), requiredString(body, "role"),
                    requiredString(body, "location"), requiredString(body, "status"));
                sendJson(exchange, 200, "{\"item\":" + employeeToJson(updated) + "}");
                return;
            }
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
        } catch (RequestException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, ex.statusCode, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (NoSuchElementException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 404, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (IllegalStateException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 409, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (FirestoreException ex) {
            sendApiError(exchange, ex);
        }
    }

# Candidate policy review from prior submissions and current references

**Status: research and changeable demo profile; not approved production policy.** The user invited disclosed candidate inference and specifically authorized a temporary 2026 statutory preview. This document records prior-work candidates and risks. A synthetic-input monthly preview is enabled in the app, but this document does not authorize attendance-hour derivation, saved payroll/payslips, approvals, or role-based access. No official MotorPH payroll rulebook or active grading rubric was found in the supplied set.

## 1. What the inspected MO-IT110 peer implementation says

The supplied peer review copy at `/home/user/repo_review/full_repo/testingester-main/6/-/` contains an explicit, testable candidate model:

- `src/motorph/model/AttendanceRecord.java`: first cutoff is days 1–15; second cutoff is day 16 through actual month end. Login from 08:00 through 08:10 is treated as 08:00; logout after 17:00 is capped at 17:00. It calculates elapsed time directly from those adjusted times and does **not** subtract a meal interval.
- `src/motorph/service/PayrollProcessor.java`: the first cutoff has no deductions and net equals cutoff gross. On the second cutoff, it computes monthly contributions from the combined two-cutoff gross, computes withholding tax after those contributions, and subtracts the whole monthly deduction amount from the second-cutoff gross (floored at zero). Allowances are shown on the second-cutoff slip but excluded from net in that implementation.
- `src/motorph/model/Employee.java`: gross is hourly rate times the calculated minutes. The course-project fixtures also supply semi-monthly and hourly rates.
- The peer has substantial tests and CP2 compatibility comparisons, but its own behavior is still an implementation choice, not an authoritative MotorPH payroll rule.

**Important defect/risk found in that candidate:** an 08:00–17:00 record yields nine elapsed hours because the code caps at 17:00 but deducts no lunch. DOLE's source says normal work hours do not exceed eight hours a day and requires at least a 60-minute meal period off work; a pair of in/out times without a meal record cannot distinguish the unpaid break. The peer rule must not be copied as an hours-worked or overtime algorithm without resolving that mismatch.

The supplied peer review also records 473 of 476 comparison rows and 14 of 14 cutoff summaries matching the CP2 output; three row differences were ₱0.01 due to floating/half-centavo behavior. That is compatibility evidence, not legal-compliance evidence. See `/home/user/repo_review/submission-comprehensive-report.md` and `/home/user/repo_review/submission-feature-pseudocode.md` for the review context. No peer employee or government-ID data was copied into this app or document.

A public MO-IT110 repository surfaced the same 1–15 / 16–month-end pattern and second-cutoff deduction convention, but explicitly says its payroll tables/thresholds are copied from CP2 rather than independently verified. Treat it as corroboration of a *course-project convention*, not a company policy: https://github.com/fdtan/MO-IT110_OOP-MS2_TanFD.

## 2. Current official statutory references located

These sources can support statutory-component research, but they do not establish MotorPH's attendance import, pay-period, allowance, leave, or role policy:

| Component | Source finding | Boundary before implementation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SSS | The SSS site publishes its contribution schedule effective Jan. 1, 2025: 15% total on MSC up to ₱35,000, split 5% employee / 10% employer; EC is employer-only. The schedule also distinguishes the MPF portion above ₱20,000. | Use the circular/table and verify every bracket and rounding boundary. Do not assume a new 2026 table without a newer official circular. |
| PhilHealth | The 2026 advisory states the 5% contribution rate effective Jan. 2025, with ₱10,000 floor and ₱100,000 ceiling. The 2025 employer advisory says use monthly basic salary and excludes overtime, allowances, 13th-month pay, bonuses and specified absence/undertime reductions from that base. | Confirm the formal-sector share split and exact payroll-period deduction method against the applicable circular. |
| Pag-IBIG | Circular 460 raises the Maximum Fund Salary to ₱10,000 effective February 2024; the employee rate is 1% at fund salary ≤₱1,500 and 2% above, while the employer rate is 2%. | Confirm applicable employee category and effective date; don't extrapolate to voluntary/other member types. |
| BIR withholding | Annex E to RR 11-2018 publishes daily, weekly, semi-monthly and monthly tables effective Jan. 1, 2023 onward. | The chosen tax base, payroll-period method, taxable allowances/benefits, year-end adjustment and rounding need explicit tests. A monthly-only example is not a semi-monthly payroll specification. |
| Hours/premiums | DOLE's official materials specify an eight-hour normal workday, a minimum 60-minute meal period off work, and statutory overtime/night/rest-day/holiday provisions. | The attendance schema lacks meal punches, a defined `dayType` enum, and an authoritative schedule/holiday assignment. Those facts must be supplied or explicitly selected as demo assumptions. |

## 3. A net-pay reference found online — useful, but not a drop-in payroll engine

`ph-payroll` is the strongest technical reference located for statutory components: its README says it uses exact decimal arithmetic, effective-dated rules, source circulars, and fails closed outside covered periods; it documents support from **2026-01** because the 2026 PhilHealth rule is the most recent component. Its scope is monthly basic pay plus statutory contributions/tax, not attendance-hour computation, MotorPH's cutoff handling, leave treatment, or a payslip workflow. It is MIT-licensed and asks users to verify results before relying on it: https://github.com/earnieacts/ph-payroll.

### Documented synthetic example from that reference

For monthly basic pay of ₱25,000, the library documents employee deductions of SSS ₱1,250, PhilHealth ₱625, Pag-IBIG ₱200, withholding tax ₱313.75, and net ₱22,611.25. A manual annualized arithmetic check gives taxable monthly income ₱22,925; annualized ₱275,100; 15% of the ₱25,100 annual amount above ₱250,000 is ₱3,765, or ₱313.75 per month. This is a reference example only—not this app's result or an approved MotorPH payslip.

Two caveats need reconciliation before adoption:

1. The BIR Annex E monthly table uses rounded peso breakpoints (₱20,833 and 15% above that), which yields ₱313.80 for ₱22,925 when read directly. The library's annualized method gives ₱313.75. The ₱0.05 difference needs a verified BIR-period/rounding interpretation and an independent approved example.
2. In the library source, `employerCost` is the sum of employer contributions (₱3,355 in its ₱25,000 example), not basic salary plus those contributions. Do not display that field as total employer payroll cost without changing/renaming it.

A second 2026 calculator repository also advertises complete deductions and net pay, but the repository surfaced with a single commit and no comparable validation evidence. It is a secondary cross-check, not a preferred authority: https://github.com/tenzerodev/rdcruz-ph-payroll.

## 4. Workflow/role patterns in peer submissions

The supplied peer corpus shows patterns, not a consistent permission contract: employee requests, an admin/manager review screen, approve/reject outcomes, leave-credit changes, and separate payroll/admin roles appear in different projects. Folder 9's `LeaveService.java` performs approve/reject and updates request files plus leave-credit counters transactionally, but the service itself has no authorization check. Other projects use different role labels and access patterns. These examples are not sufficient to invent secure Firebase roles or reviewer boundaries.

## 5. Safe recommendation / next decision

1. Keep production-style payroll, attendance-hour reports, approvals and reviewer controls disabled.
2. If the project needs a classroom demonstration before official rules are confirmed, expose the folder-6 conventions only as a **clearly labelled, synthetic candidate profile**, after the user confirms the meal-break, cutoff, deduction timing, allowance, and net-floor choices. Preserve the official statutory calculator as a separately sourced component and reconcile BIR withholding first.
3. Mark any inferred role/workflow matrix as a proposal based on the peer corpus; do not publish it as live authorization until the user approves the exact employee, HR/approver, payroll, and admin boundaries.
4. Keep the external payroll library as a comparison source, not a dependency or oracle; reproduce independent golden values and cite official circulars before expanding beyond the disposable statutory preview into attendance-based or persisted payroll.

## 6. Re-review of the user's database design and later calculator work

The user's ctxt.io document is the **MO-IT107 database design/data dictionary**, not a database file or a set of calculation rules. It does, however, lay out a useful storage model that the earlier review had not connected to a working calculation pipeline:

- `Rates` and `Tax Table` are intended as changeable reference tables; the design mentions a rate `implementationYear`, although this field is missing from the linked Data Dictionary and the design's own key constraints disagree.
- `Government Deductibles` separates monthly employer contribution, employee contribution, and withholding tax.
- `Contributions` stores SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG amounts separately for `Employee` and `Employer`.
- `Payroll`, `Payslip`, `Earnings`, `Deductibles`, `Other Transactions`, `Government Tally`, and `Summary` cover the intended input/output and reporting areas. Payslip includes a start/end period and gross income.
- The related DFD describes the order of operations: timesheet validation → wage/adjustments → government deductibles → basic payroll computation → payslip → monthly summary. The System Admin has a rate-update flow.

That design is valuable for the **mechanics before calculation**, but it contains no actual rates, effective date ranges, formula, rounding policy, or worked expected values. In particular, the tax table is not explicit about whether each row is monthly, semi-monthly, or another withholding period, and the monthly government-deduction key shown in the design has no year component. The user-provided full synthesis likewise warns that the PDFs do not state statutory values or arithmetic. The design should be versioned and reconciled before it is used as a persistent production schema.

A different older SQLite file exists in peer folder 1 (`/home/user/repo_review/full_repo/testingester-main/1/-/myMotorPhdb.db`). I inspected its table definitions only—not any records—and found `Users`, `Allowance`, `Salary_Deduction`, `EmployeeAudit`, and `Employee_info`, not the normalized Rates/Tax Table/Government Deductibles design in the ctxt link. It is not a source of verified statutory rates.

### A later prior project did tackle the calculation pipeline

The supplied folder-9 review copy, `/home/user/repo_review/full_repo/testingester-main/9/-/oop/`, contains an actual `PayrollCalculator` orchestrator and separate SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, and withholding-tax calculators. Its pipeline is:

1. derive gross as worked days × hourly rate × 8;
2. calculate employee/employer statutory items;
3. calculate withholding after employee statutory contributions;
4. calculate net and build an immutable payroll record.

Its NOTES and console tests report this pipeline exercised. But the formulas are hard-coded as Java `double` constants and the source XLSX matrices cited by its verification note were on a personal Windows path, not among the supplied files. The source values are **not a current 2026 ruleset**:

- SSS caps the employee share at ₱1,125, which predates the 2025 schedule (2026 uses the current schedule effective January 2025: 5% employee / 10% employer on MSC up to ₱35,000, plus employer-only EC).
- PhilHealth uses 3%, a ₱10,000 floor/₱60,000 ceiling and a 50/50 split; the current direct-contributor advisory for formal-sector MBS gives 5%, ₱10,000 floor/₱100,000 ceiling, with allowances and overtime excluded from the MBS base.
- Pag-IBIG caps at ₱100, reflecting the former ₱5,000 MFS; Circular 460 moved the MFS ceiling to ₱10,000 effective February 2024, allowing up to ₱200 per side.
- Its first taxable monthly BIR band uses 20%; Annex E uses 15% from ₱20,833 to ₱33,332. The prior project also does not make a semi-monthly tax table part of its calculator API.

A separate folder-7 `ContributionCalculator.java` also computes semi-monthly values, but doubles the pay-period input to a monthly proxy and reuses old CP2 schedules: SSS max ₱1,125, PhilHealth 1.5% employee amount with ₱900 cap, Pag-IBIG cap ₱100, and a 20% first taxable band. Its payroll code labels overtime pricing as temporary pending confirmation. Folder 3 is even simpler (flat 4.5% SSS, 2% PhilHealth, ₱100 Pag-IBIG, no tax schedule). These show earlier mechanical exploration, but none supply a current validated 2026 profile.

The older folder-6 implementation is even more explicitly a CP2/course-project compatibility profile, not a 2026 statutory table. Neither implementation was copied into the current app.

## 7. Temporary 2026 module now in this prototype

Following the user's instruction, a **client-side-only, synthetic-input preview** has been added to the Payroll workspace. It is deliberately isolated and replaceable:

- Change rates, thresholds, table bands, sources, or the profile ID in `web/payroll-rules-2026.js`.
- Calculation logic is pure and separated in `web/payroll-preview-2026.js`; amounts are parsed and calculated in integer centavos (`BigInt`), not binary floating point.
- `web/payroll-preview-ui.js` only renders the submitted values and result. It sends no payroll API request, reads no employee or attendance record, and persists nothing in Firebase or local storage.
- Current scope is **monthly 2026 statutory preview only**. It requires separate cash-pay, SSS compensation, PhilHealth MBS, Pag-IBIG Fund Salary, and taxable-compensation inputs. That prevents the preview from silently assuming all legal contribution/tax bases are identical.
- It separates employee deductions from employer costs, includes the current SSS employer-only EC amount, uses the BIR **monthly** Annex E table with a provisional half-up centavo rounding rule, and blocks a negative net rather than emitting a negative payslip.
- It does not create/pay a payroll, resolve salary conversion, attendance hours, overtime, leave/holiday earnings, deductions between cutoffs, tax annualisation/adjustment, benefit exemptions, employees, or payslips.

For a fully synthetic ₱25,000 monthly example using ₱25,000 for each input base, this profile produces: SSS employee ₱1,250; SSS employer SS/MPF ₱2,500 plus EC ₱30; PhilHealth ₱625 each; Pag-IBIG ₱200 each; taxable base after employee shares ₱22,925; monthly BIR withholding ₱313.80; net estimate ₱22,611.20; employer statutory contributions ₱3,355; gross plus those employer contributions ₱28,355.00. The difference from `ph-payroll`'s documented ₱22,611.25 is the disclosed monthly-table versus annualized-tax method/rounding difference; the sandbox uses the published BIR monthly table for its monthly mode, not the library result.

The input boundaries and the editable monthly calculation are now covered in `test/web/payroll-preview-2026.test.js`; a browser E2E check confirms the result and that no payroll API call is made. The profile remains a **temporary estimate**, not an approved payroll policy or statutory compliance guarantee.

### Updated sources used for the temporary profile

- SSS's official contribution page links Circular 2024-006 / the schedule effective Jan. 2025: 15% total on MSC (5% employee / 10% employer), up to ₱35,000 MSC; EC is employer-only and set at ₱10 or ₱30 by MSC band: https://www.sss.gov.ph/pay-contribution/
- PhilHealth Advisory PA2025-0002: 5% effective Jan. 2025; monthly basic salary floor ₱10,000 / ceiling ₱100,000; allowances, overtime, 13th-month pay, bonuses and similar items excluded from employer MBS: https://www.philhealth.gov.ph/advisories/2025/PA2025-0002.pdf
- Pag-IBIG Circular 460: employee 1% at Fund Salary up to ₱1,500, 2% above; employer 2%; MFS ₱10,000, effective Feb. 2024: https://www.pagibigfund.gov.ph/documents/Circular%20No.%20460%20-%20Guidelines%20on%20the%20Pag-IBIG%20Fund's%20Implementation%20of%20Increase%20in%20the%20MFS%20Effective%20February%202024.pdf

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';

const projectRoot = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const sourceDir = path.join(projectRoot, 'src/main/java/ph/motorph/web');
const gsonJar = path.join(projectRoot, 'lib/gson-2.13.2.jar');
const timeoutMs = 15_000;
const javaClasses = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), 'motorph-e2e-classes-'));
const serverChildren = [];
let browser;

function freePort() {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const server = net.createServer();
    server.once('error', reject);
    server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => {
      const { port } = server.address();
      server.close(error => error ? reject(error) : resolve(port));
    });
  });
}

function start(command, args, env, label) {
  const child = spawn(command, args, {
    cwd: projectRoot,
    env,
    detached: process.platform !== 'win32',
    stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe']
  });
  child.log = '';
  child.on('error', error => { child.log += `${label}: ${error.message}\n`; });
  for (const stream of [child.stdout, child.stderr]) {
    stream.setEncoding('utf8');
    stream.on('data', chunk => { child.log = (child.log + chunk).slice(-8000); });
  }
  serverChildren.push(child);
  return child;
}

async function waitForServer(url, child, label) {
  const end = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
  let lastError = 'no response';
  while (Date.now() < end) {
    if (child.exitCode !== null) throw new Error(`${label} exited early.\n${child.log}`);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(url);
      if (response.ok) return response;
      lastError = `HTTP ${response.status}`;
    } catch (error) {
      lastError = error.message;
    }
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 150));
  }
  throw new Error(`${label} did not become ready (${lastError}).\n${child.log}`);
}

async function stop(child) {
  if (!child || child.exitCode !== null) return;
  try {
    if (process.platform === 'win32') child.kill('SIGTERM');
    else process.kill(-child.pid, 'SIGTERM');
  } catch { /* already stopped */ }
  await Promise.race([
    new Promise(resolve => child.once('exit', resolve)),
    new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2500))
  ]);
  if (child.exitCode === null) {
    try {
      if (process.platform === 'win32') child.kill('SIGKILL');
      else process.kill(-child.pid, 'SIGKILL');
    } catch { /* already stopped */ }
  }
}
