package ph.motorph.web;

import com.google.gson.JsonObject;

import java.util.Arrays;

/** Creates only fictional, clearly marked records in one signed-in user's demo sandbox. */
public final class DemoSeedService {
    private final FirestoreRestClient client;

    public DemoSeedService(FirestoreRestClient client) {
        if (client == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("client must not be null");
        this.client = client;
    }

    public SeedResult seedMissingSyntheticRecords() {
        // Preflight the new rules path before any writes so an unpublished ruleset cannot leave a partial seed.
        client.listDocuments(client.userCollection("demoEmployeeSchedules"));
        int employeesCreated = 0;
        for (Employee employee : new InMemoryEmployeeStore().findAll()) {
            if (client.createDocument(client.userCollection("demoEmployees"), employee.getId(), employeeFields(employee))) {
                employeesCreated++;
            }
        }

        int mappingsCreated = 0;
        EmployeeScheduleStore sampleMappings = new InMemoryEmployeeScheduleStore();
        for (Employee employee : new InMemoryEmployeeStore().findAll()) {
            java.util.OptionalInt scheduleId = sampleMappings.findScheduleIdForEmployee(employee.getId());
            if (scheduleId.isPresent() && client.createDocument(client.userCollection("demoEmployeeSchedules"),
                employee.getId(), scheduleMappingFields(employee.getId(), scheduleId.getAsInt()))) {
                mappingsCreated++;
            }
        }

        int attendanceCreated = 0;
        InMemoryAttendanceStore sampleAttendance = new InMemoryAttendanceStore();
        for (int scheduleId : Arrays.asList(101, 102, 103)) {
            for (AttendanceRecord record : sampleAttendance.findByScheduleId(scheduleId)) {
                if (client.createDocument(client.userCollection("demoAttendance"),
                    Integer.toString(record.getAttendanceId()), attendanceFields(record))) {
                    attendanceCreated++;
                }
            }
        }
        return new SeedResult(employeesCreated, mappingsCreated, attendanceCreated);
    }

    private static JsonObject employeeFields(Employee employee) {
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("id", string(employee.getId()));
        fields.add("name", string(employee.getName()));
        fields.add("department", string(employee.getDepartment()));
        fields.add("role", string(employee.getRole()));
        fields.add("location", string(employee.getLocation()));
        fields.add("status", string(employee.getStatus()));
        return fields;
    }

    private static JsonObject scheduleMappingFields(String employeeId, int scheduleId) {
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("employeeId", string(employeeId));
        fields.add("scheduleId", integer(scheduleId));
        return fields;
    }

    private static JsonObject attendanceFields(AttendanceRecord record) {
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("attendanceId", integer(record.getAttendanceId()));
        fields.add("scheduleId", integer(record.getScheduleId()));
        fields.add("date", string(record.getDate().toString()));
        fields.add("timeIn", string(record.getTimeIn().toString()));
        fields.add("timeOut", string(record.getTimeOut().toString()));
        fields.add("dayType", string("DEMO"));
        return fields;
    }

    private static JsonObject string(String value) {
        JsonObject typedValue = new JsonObject();
        typedValue.addProperty("stringValue", value);
        return typedValue;
    }

    private static JsonObject integer(int value) {
        JsonObject typedValue = new JsonObject();
        typedValue.addProperty("integerValue", Integer.toString(value));
        return typedValue;
    }

    public static final class SeedResult {
        private final int employeesCreated;
        private final int scheduleMappingsCreated;
        private final int attendanceCreated;

        SeedResult(int employeesCreated, int scheduleMappingsCreated, int attendanceCreated) {
            this.employeesCreated = employeesCreated;
            this.scheduleMappingsCreated = scheduleMappingsCreated;
            this.attendanceCreated = attendanceCreated;
        }

        public int getEmployeesCreated() { return employeesCreated; }
        public int getScheduleMappingsCreated() { return scheduleMappingsCreated; }
        public int getAttendanceCreated() { return attendanceCreated; }
    }

package ph.motorph.web;

import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

/** User-scoped demo employee records read through the Firestore REST API. */
public final class FirestoreEmployeeStore implements MutableEmployeeStore {
    private final FirestoreRestClient client;

    public FirestoreEmployeeStore(FirestoreRestClient client) {
        if (client == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("client must not be null");
        this.client = client;
    }

    @Override
    public List<Employee> findAll() {
        List<Employee> employees = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JsonObject document : client.listDocuments(client.userCollection("demoEmployees"))) {
            employees.add(fromDocument(document));
        }
        return employees;
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<Employee> findById(String id) {
        if (id == null) return Optional.empty();
        return findAll().stream().filter(employee -> employee.getId().equals(id)).findFirst();
    }

    @Override
    public Employee create(Employee employee) {
        if (!client.createDocument(client.userCollection("demoEmployees"), employee.getId(), employeeFields(employee))) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Employee ID already exists; refresh the directory and retry.");
        }
        return employee;
    }

    @Override
    public Employee update(Employee employee) {
        if (!client.updateDocument(client.userCollection("demoEmployees"), employee.getId(), employeeFields(employee),
            java.util.Arrays.asList("id", "name", "department", "role", "location", "status"))) {
            throw new java.util.NoSuchElementException("Employee not found.");
        }
        return employee;
    }

    private static JsonObject employeeFields(Employee employee) {
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("id", stringField(employee.getId()));
        fields.add("name", stringField(employee.getName()));
        fields.add("department", stringField(employee.getDepartment()));
        fields.add("role", stringField(employee.getRole()));
        fields.add("location", stringField(employee.getLocation()));
        fields.add("status", stringField(employee.getStatus()));
        return fields;
    }

    private static JsonObject stringField(String value) {
        JsonObject field = new JsonObject();
        field.addProperty("stringValue", value);
        return field;
    }

    private static Employee fromDocument(JsonObject document) {
        JsonObject fields = document.has("fields") ? document.getAsJsonObject("fields") : new JsonObject();
        return new Employee(
            stringValue(fields, "id"), stringValue(fields, "name"), stringValue(fields, "department"),
            stringValue(fields, "role"), stringValue(fields, "location"), stringValue(fields, "status"));
    }

    static String stringValue(JsonObject fields, String name) {
        JsonElement element = fields.get(name);
        if (element == null || !element.isJsonObject()) return "";
        JsonElement value = element.getAsJsonObject().get("stringValue");
        return value == null || value.isJsonNull() ? "" : value.getAsString();
    }
}

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/** User-scoped synthetic attendance records read through Firestore REST. */
public final class FirestoreAttendanceStore implements AttendanceStore {
    private final FirestoreRestClient client;

    public FirestoreAttendanceStore(FirestoreRestClient client) {
        if (client == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("client must not be null");
        this.client = client;
    }

    @Override
    public List<AttendanceRecord> findAll() {
        List<AttendanceRecord> records = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JsonObject document : client.listDocuments(client.userCollection("demoAttendance"))) {
            records.add(fromDocument(document));
        }
        return records;
    }

    @Override
    public List<AttendanceRecord> findByScheduleId(int scheduleId) {
        return findAll().stream().filter(record -> record.getScheduleId() == scheduleId).collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    private static AttendanceRecord fromDocument(JsonObject document) {
        JsonObject fields = document.has("fields") ? document.getAsJsonObject("fields") : new JsonObject();
        return new AttendanceRecord(
            integerValue(fields, "attendanceId"), integerValue(fields, "scheduleId"),
            LocalDate.parse(stringValue(fields, "date")), LocalTime.parse(stringValue(fields, "timeIn")),
            LocalTime.parse(stringValue(fields, "timeOut")), stringValue(fields, "dayType"));
    }

    private static int integerValue(JsonObject fields, String name) {
        JsonElement element = fields.get(name);
        if (element == null || !element.isJsonObject()) return 0;
        JsonElement value = element.getAsJsonObject().get("integerValue");
        return value == null || value.isJsonNull() ? 0 : Integer.parseInt(value.getAsString());
    }

    private static String stringValue(JsonObject fields, String name) {
        return FirestoreEmployeeStore.stringValue(fields, name);
    }
}

package ph.motorph.web;

import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;

/** Firestore user-subcollection adapter. Firestore Rules enforce owner-only access. */
public final class FirestoreWorkflowStore implements WorkflowStore {
    private static final String LEAVE_COLLECTION = "demoLeaveRequests";
    private static final String TICKET_COLLECTION = "demoTickets";
    private final FirestoreRestClient client;

    public FirestoreWorkflowStore(FirestoreRestClient client) {
        if (client == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("client must not be null");
        this.client = client;
    }

    @Override
    public List<DemoLeaveRequest> listLeaveRequests() {
        List<DemoLeaveRequest> requests = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JsonObject document : client.listDocuments(client.userCollection(LEAVE_COLLECTION))) {
            requests.add(leaveFromDocument(document));
        }
        requests.sort(Comparator.comparing(DemoLeaveRequest::getSubmittedAt).reversed());
        return requests;
    }

    @Override
    public DemoLeaveRequest createLeaveRequest(DemoLeaveRequest request) {
        if (!client.createDocument(client.userCollection(LEAVE_COLLECTION), request.getId(), leaveFields(request))) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Request ID already exists; try submitting again.");
        }
        return request;
    }

    @Override
    public DemoLeaveRequest cancelLeaveRequest(String id, String cancelledAt) {
        DemoLeaveRequest current = listLeaveRequests().stream().filter(item -> item.getId().equals(id)).findFirst()
            .orElseThrow(() -> new NoSuchElementException("Leave request was not found in this user sandbox."));
        if (!"Pending review".equals(current.getStatus())) throw new IllegalStateException("Only a pending leave request can be cancelled.");
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("status", stringField("Cancelled"));
        fields.add("cancelledAt", timestampField(cancelledAt));
        if (!client.updateDocument(client.userCollection(LEAVE_COLLECTION), id, fields,
            java.util.Arrays.asList("status", "cancelledAt"))) {
            throw new NoSuchElementException("Leave request was not found in this user sandbox.");
        }
        return current.cancelled(cancelledAt);
    }

    @Override
    public List<DemoTicket> listTickets() {
        List<DemoTicket> tickets = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JsonObject document : client.listDocuments(client.userCollection(TICKET_COLLECTION))) {
            tickets.add(ticketFromDocument(document));
        }
        tickets.sort(Comparator.comparing(DemoTicket::getSubmittedAt).reversed());
        return tickets;
    }

    @Override
    public DemoTicket createTicket(DemoTicket ticket) {
        if (!client.createDocument(client.userCollection(TICKET_COLLECTION), ticket.getId(), ticketFields(ticket))) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Ticket ID already exists; try submitting again.");
        }
        return ticket;
    }

    @Override
    public DemoTicket cancelTicket(String id, String cancelledAt) {
        DemoTicket current = listTickets().stream().filter(item -> item.getId().equals(id)).findFirst()
            .orElseThrow(() -> new NoSuchElementException("Ticket was not found in this user sandbox."));
        if (!"Open".equals(current.getStatus())) throw new IllegalStateException("Only an open ticket can be cancelled.");
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("status", stringField("Cancelled"));
        fields.add("cancelledAt", timestampField(cancelledAt));
        if (!client.updateDocument(client.userCollection(TICKET_COLLECTION), id, fields,
            java.util.Arrays.asList("status", "cancelledAt"))) {
            throw new NoSuchElementException("Ticket was not found in this user sandbox.");
        }
        return current.cancelled(cancelledAt);
    }

    private static JsonObject leaveFields(DemoLeaveRequest request) {
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("id", stringField(request.getId()));
        fields.add("employeeId", stringField(request.getEmployeeId()));
        fields.add("employe

            value(fields, "status"), dateTimeValue(fields, "submittedAt"), dateTimeValue(fields, "cancelledAt"));

    private static DemoTicket ticketFromDocument(JsonObject document) {

        return document.has("fields") && document.get("fields").isJsonObject()
            ? document.getAsJsonObject("fields") : new JsonObject();
    }

    private static String documentId(JsonObject document) {
        String name = document.has("name") ? document.get("name").getAsString() : "";
        int slash = name.lastIndexOf('/');
        if (slash < 0 || slash == name.length() - 1) throw new IllegalStateException("Firestore workflow document has no ID.");
        return name.substring(slash + 1);
    }

    private static String value(JsonObject fields, String name) {
        JsonElement element = fields.get(name);
        if (element == null || !element.isJsonObject()) return "";
        JsonObject typed = element.getAsJsonObject();
        if (typed.has("stringValue")) return typed.get("stringValue").getAsString();
        if (typed.has("timestampValue")) return typed.get("timestampValue").getAsString();
        return "";
    }

    private static String dateTimeValue(JsonObject fields, String name) {
        return fields.has(name) ? value(fields, name) : "";
    }

    private static JsonObject stringField(String value) {
        JsonObject field = new JsonObject();
        field.addProperty("stringValue", value);
        return field;
    }

    private static JsonObject timestampField(String value) {
        JsonObject field = new JsonObject();
        field.addProperty("timestampValue", value);
        return field;
    }

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
import java.util.Optional;

/** Process-memory store containing only fictional demo employees. */
public final class InMemoryEmployeeStore implements MutableEmployeeStore {
    private final Map<String, Employee> employees = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    public InMemoryEmployeeStore() {
        addFixture(new Employee("DEMO-001", "Mara Rivera", "People Operations", "HR Coordinator", "Makati", "Active"));
        addFixture(new Employee("DEMO-002", "Eli Santos", "Finance", "Payroll Associate", "Taguig", "Active"));
        addFixture(new Employee("DEMO-003", "Noa Reyes", "Operations", "Operations Lead", "Quezon City", "On leave"));
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized List<Employee> findAll() {
        return new ArrayList<>(employees.values());
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized Optional<Employee> findById(String id) {
        return Optional.ofNullable(id == null ? null : employees.get(id.trim()));
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized Employee create(Employee employee) {
        if (employees.containsKey(employee.getId())) throw new IllegalStateException("Employee ID already exists.");
        employees.put(employee.getId(), employee);
        return employee;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized Employee update(Employee employee) {
        if (!employees.containsKey(employee.getId())) throw new NoSuchElementException("Employee not found.");
        employees.put(employee.getId(), employee);
        return employee;
    }

    private void addFixture(Employee employee) {
        employees.put(employee.getId(), employee);
    }
}

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/** Temporary raw attendance fixture. All entries and classifications are synthetic. */
public final class InMemoryAttendanceStore implements AttendanceStore {
    private final List<AttendanceRecord> records;

    public InMemoryAttendanceStore() {
        List<AttendanceRecord> values = new ArrayList<>();
        values.add(record(5001, 101, "2026-10-01", "08:01", "17:00"));
        values.add(record(5002, 101, "2026-10-02", "07:58", "16:59"));
        values.add(record(5003, 101, "2026-10-15", "08:03", "17:01"));
        values.add(record(5101, 102, "2026-10-01", "08:00", "17:02"));
        values.add(record(5102, 102, "2026-10-03", "08:04", "17:03"));
        values.add(record(5201, 103, "2026-10-02", "08:10", "16:55"));
        records = values;
        enforceUniqueScheduleDate(records);
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized List<AttendanceRecord> findAll() {
        return new ArrayList<>(records);
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized List<AttendanceRecord> findByScheduleId(int scheduleId) {
        return records.stream()
            .filter(record -> record.getScheduleId() == scheduleId)
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    private static AttendanceRecord record(int attendanceId, int scheduleId, String date, String in, String out) {
        return new AttendanceRecord(attendanceId, scheduleId, LocalDate.parse(date),
            LocalTime.parse(in), LocalTime.parse(out), "DEMO");
    }

    private static void enforceUniqueScheduleDate(List<AttendanceRecord> records) {
        Set<String> keys = new HashSet<>();
        for (AttendanceRecord record : records) {
            String key = record.getScheduleId() + ":" + record.getDate();
            if (!keys.add(key)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duplicate attendance for schedule/date: " + key);
        }
    }
}

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.util.ArrayList;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;

/** Process-memory store used only by the unauthenticated local synthetic preview. */
public final class InMemoryWorkflowStore implements WorkflowStore {
    private final Map<String, DemoLeaveRequest> leaveRequests = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, DemoTicket> tickets = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    @Override
    public synchronized List<DemoLeaveRequest> listLeaveRequests() {
        List<DemoLeaveRequest> result = new ArrayList<>(leaveRequests.values());
        result.sort(Comparator.comparing(DemoLeaveRequest::getSubmittedAt).reversed());
        return result;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized DemoLeaveRequest createLeaveRequest(DemoLeaveRequest request) {
        if (leaveRequests.containsKey(request.getId())) throw new IllegalStateException("Request ID already exists.");
        leaveRequests.put(request.getId(), request);
        return request;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized DemoLeaveRequest cancelLeaveRequest(String id, String cancelledAt) {
        DemoLeaveRequest existing = leaveRequests.get(id);
        if (existing == null) throw new NoSuchElementException("Leave request was not found.");
        if (!"Pending review".equals(existing.getStatus())) throw new IllegalStateException("Only a pending leave request can be cancelled.");
        DemoLeaveRequest cancelled = existing.cancelled(cancelledAt);
        leaveRequests.put(id, cancelled);
        return cancelled;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized List<DemoTicket> listTickets() {
        List<DemoTicket> result = new ArrayList<>(tickets.values());
        result.sort(Comparator.comparing(DemoTicket::getSubmittedAt).reversed());
        return result;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized DemoTicket createTicket(DemoTicket ticket) {
        if (tickets.containsKey(ticket.getId())) throw new IllegalStateException("Ticket ID already exists.");
        tickets.put(ticket.getId(), ticket);
        return ticket;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized DemoTicket cancelTicket(String id, String cancelledAt) {
        DemoTicket existing = tickets.get(id);
        if (existing == null) throw new NoSuchElementException("Ticket was not found.");
        if (!"Open".equals(existing.getStatus())) throw new IllegalStateException("Only an open ticket can be cancelled.");
        DemoTicket cancelled = existing.cancelled(cancelledAt);
        tickets.put(id, cancelled);
        return cancelled;
    }

## 3. Current product snapshot

### 3.1 Technology

| Layer | Current local product |
|---|---|
| Browser | HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript |
| Server | Java 11-compatible JDK HTTP server (`com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer`) |
| Persistence | Local JSON file (`data/demo-data.json`) |
| Runtime dependencies | JDK only for the app; Node.js and Python are used by the test script |
| UI approach | Single-page navigation with independent module panels, forms, filters, tables, dialogs, and CSV output |

The original LMArena workspace was described as a Java backend and browser UI with Firebase Email/Password Authentication plus user-scoped Firestore REST storage. That mode is **not in this reconstructed package**. The local build is intentionally self-contained and uses JSON. Do not say Firebase is connected in this ZIP.

## 8. Payroll calculation profile

**Profile ID:** `PH-STATUTORY-2026-MONTHLY-PROVISIONAL`  
**Period:** monthly  
**Currency:** PHP  
**Persistence:** none  
**Role:** educational/demo estimate from explicit fictional inputs.

Five amounts are required independently:

- `cashPay`
- `sssCompensation`
- `philHealthMbs`
- `pagibigFundSalary`
- `taxableCompensation`

This separation avoids silently assuming that agency compensation bases are identical.

### 8.1 SSS

- Regular SS rate: 15% total, split 5% employee and 10% employer.
- Applied MSC: minimum ₱5,000, maximum ₱35,000, ₱500 increments according to the January 2025 schedule.
- MSC above ₱20,000 is the MPF/MySSS Pension Booster component.
- Employer EC: ₱10 at MSC ₱14,500 and below, ₱30 from MSC ₱15,000 and above.

### 8.2 PhilHealth

- 5% rate.
- MBS floor ₱10,000, ceiling ₱100,000.
- Equal employee/employer split.
- The basis is separately supplied rather than inferred from cash pay.

### 8.3 Pag-IBIG

- Maximum Fund Salary ₱10,000.
- Employee share 1% at Fund Salary of ₱1,500 and below, otherwise 2%.
- Employer share 2%.

### 8.4 BIR withholding

The calculator uses the monthly Annex E table:

| Monthly taxable compensation | Tax |
|---|---|
| ₱20,833 and below | ₱0 |
| ₱20,834–₱33,332 | 15% of excess over ₱20,833 |
| ₱33,333–₱66,666 | ₱1,875 + 20% of excess over ₱33,333 |
| ₱66,667–₱166,666 | ₱8,541.80 + 25% of excess over ₱66,667 |
| ₱166,667–₱666,666 | ₱33,541.80 + 30% of excess over ₱166,667 |
| ₱666,667 and above | ₱183,541.80 + 35% of excess over ₱666,667 |

The implementation compares centavo values against the next whole-peso bracket lower bound (for example, `< ₱33,333`) so ₱33,332.50 remains in the lower band.

The current preview subtracts employee SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG shares from the explicit taxable compensation before applying monthly withholding. This is a documented implementation assumption. Annual reconciliation, all taxable/exempt benefit classifications, and full withholding adjustment rules are outside this module.

### 8.5 Rounding and sample

- Java `BigDecimal` for all monetary arithmetic.
- Two-decimal `HALF_UP` rounding.
- Negative bases are rejected; negative resulting net is rejected.
- Net estimate = cash pay − employee SSS − employee PhilHealth − employee Pag-IBIG − BIR monthly withholding.
- Employer cost estimate = cash pay + employer SSS + employer EC + employer PhilHealth + employer Pag-IBIG.

For the illustrative case where all five input bases equal ₱25,000:

| Result | Amount |
|---|---:|
| SSS employee | ₱1,250.00 |
| SSS employer SS/MPF | ₱2,500.00 |
| SSS employer EC | ₱30.00 |
| PhilHealth employee | ₱625.00 |
| PhilHealth employer | ₱625.00 |
| Pag-IBIG employee | ₱200.00 |
| Pag-IBIG employer | ₱200.00 |
| Employee statutory shares before tax | ₱2,075.00 |
| Taxable base after employee statutory shares | ₱22,925.00 |
| BIR monthly withholding | ₱313.80 |
| Estimated net | **₱22,611.20** |
| Employer statutory cost | ₱3,355.00 |
| Employer cost estimate | **₱28,355.00** |

### 8.6 Excluded from payroll

No attendance-derived wage, salary conversion, meal-break/time-hour derivation, tardiness, undertime, overtime, night differential, holiday/rest-day premiums, leave pay/accrual/monetisation, bonuses, commissions, loans, advances, other deductions, semi-monthly cutoff splitting, deduction allocation by cutoff, saved payroll run, posting, bank payout, remittance, annual tax reconciliation, or payslip is implemented.

The preview is active. The full payroll lifecycle is unfinished.

## 12. Open work and next development order

Continue product work; do not revert to a frozen state. The following order minimises dependency clashes.

1. **Schedule and attendance model:** add schedule assignment, shift definitions, rest-day/holiday calendar, attendance import/source, and explicit policy for breaks/overnight shifts. Keep unmapped attendance distinct from absence.
2. **Work-hour calculations:** derive only after schedule and attendance policies exist; add correction flow and test cases for missing punches, overlaps, overnight spans, breaks, holidays, and rest days.
3. **Leave lifecycle:** leave balances, accrual rules, request approval/rejection, reviewer identity/authority, credit deductions, cancellation/reversal, and calendar statuses. Keep the current request demo as baseline.
4. **Ticket workflow:** real queue assignment, authorised review, response/resolution/reopen, event history, and user-visible notifications/status.
5. **HR/team lifecycle:** department/position/supervisor references, onboarding/offboarding, schedule assignments, team membership, authority boundaries, and audit history.
6. **Payroll run:** connect validated work-time inputs to salary bases, premiums, leave pay, other earnings/deductions, pay periods, deduction allocation, annual tax treatment, result records, approvals, payslip, and remittance reports. Retain the statutory profile as separately versioned calculation code.
7. **Security and persistence:** if Firebase is restored, use Firebase Auth ID tokens and user-scoped access; define roles and record-level authorisation; test allow/deny paths; never add admin credentials to the browser.
8. **Final product QA:** full browser E2E, 320px to desktop responsive checks, keyboard/accessibility review, malformed-input and error-recovery tests, persistence/reload checks, export checks, and dependency/licence review.

Do not use the historical peer-parity percentage as an automatic target for arbitrary feature additions. Maintain a traceability matrix from each proposed feature to a course source, peer evidence, or clearly marked product inference. }

function requireState(state) {
  if (!state || !Array.isArray(state.leaveRequests) || !Array.isArray(state.tickets)) {
    throw new TypeError('Workflow state is invalid.');
  }
}

function findEmployee(employeeId, employees) {
  const employee = Array.isArray(employees) && employees.find(item => item && item.id === employeeId);
  if (!employee) throw new Error('Choose an employee from the synthetic demo directory.');
  return employee;
}

function isValidDate(value) {
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) return false;
  const date = new Date(`${value}T00:00:00.000Z`);
  return !Number.isNaN(date.valueOf()) && date.toISOString().slice(0, 10) === value;
}

function cleanOptionalText(value, field) {
  const text = String(value ?? '').trim();
  if (text.length > MAX_NOTE_LENGTH) throw new Error(`${field} must be ${MAX_NOTE_LENGTH} characters or fewer.`);
  return text;
}

function dateStamp(value) {
  const date = value instanceof Date ? value : new Date(`${value}T00:00:00.000Z`);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.valueOf())) throw new Error('Submission date is invalid.');
  return date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

export function submitLeaveRequest(state, input, employees, submittedAt = new Date()) {
  requireState(state);
  if (!input || !LEAVE_TYPES.includes(input.leaveType)) throw new Error('Choose a valid leave type.');
  const employee = findEmployee(input.employeeId, employees);
  if (!isValidDate(input.startDate) || !isValidDate(input.endDate)) throw new Error('Enter a valid date for both leave dates.');
  if (input.startDate > input.endDate) throw new Error('The start date must be on or before the end date.');
  const note = cleanOptionalText(input.note, 'Note');
  const request = {
    id: `LV-${String(state.nextLeaveNumber).padStart(4, '0')}`,
    employeeId: employee.id,
    employeeName: String(employee.name || employee.id),
    leaveType: input.leaveType,
    startDate: input.startDate,
    endDate: input.endDate,
    note,
    status: 'Pending review',
    submittedAt: dateStamp(submittedAt)
  };
  return {
    state: { ...state, leaveRequests: [...state.leaveRequests, request], nextLeaveNumber: state.nextLeaveNumber + 1 },
    request
  };
}

export function cancelLeaveRequest(state, requestId, employeeId) {
  requireState(state);
  const request = state.leaveRequests.find(item => item.id === requestId);
  if (!request) throw new Error('Leave request was not found.');
  if (request.employeeId !== employeeId) throw new Error('You can only cancel your own request.');
  if (request.status !== 'Pending review') throw new Error('Only a pending leave request can be cancelled.');
  const leaveRequests = state.leaveRequests.map(item => item.id === requestId ? { ...item, status: 'Cancelled' } : item);
  return { ...state, leaveRequests };
}

export function submitTicket(state, input, employees, submittedAt = new Date()) {
  requireState(state);
  const ticketType = input && input.ticketType;
  if (!Object.hasOwn(TICKET_QUEUES, ticketType)) throw new Error('Choose a valid ticket type.');
  const employee = findEmployee(input.employeeId, employees);
  const summary = cleanOptionalText(input.summary, 'Message');
  if (!summary) throw new Error('Add a short message before submitting the ticket.');
  const ticket = {
    id: `TK-${String(state.nextTicketNumber).padStart(4, '0')}`,
    employeeId: employee.id,
    employeeName: String(employee.name || employee.id),
    ticketType,
    queue: TICKET_QUEUES[ticketType],
    summary,
    status: 'Open',
    submittedAt: dateStamp(submittedAt)
  };
  return {
    state: { ...state, tickets: [...state.tickets, ticket], nextTicketNumber: state.nextTicketNumber + 1 },
    ticket
  };
}

export function cancelTicket(state, ticketId, employeeId) {
  requireState(state);
  const ticket = state.tickets.find(item => item.id === ticketId);
  if (!ticket) throw new Error('Ticket was not found.');
  if (ticket.employeeId !== employeeId) throw new Error('You can only cancel your own ticket.');
  if (ticket.status !== 'Open') throw new Error('Only an open ticket can be cancelled.');
  const tickets = state.tickets.map(item => item.id === ticketId ? { ...item, status: 'Cancelled' } : item);
  return { ...state, tickets };
}

export { LEAVE_TYPES, MAX_NOTE_LENGTH, TICKET_QUEUES };
==== csv
function validateColumns(columns) {
  if (!Array.isArray(columns) || columns.length === 0) throw new TypeError('CSV must include at least one column.');
  columns.forEach((column, index) => {
    if (!column || typeof column.key !== 'string' || !column.key.trim()
      || typeof column.label !== 'string' || !column.label.trim()) {
      throw new TypeError(`CSV column ${index + 1} must include a key and label.`);
    }
  });
}

function csvCell(value) {
  const text = String(value ?? '');
  // Prefix spreadsheet formula-like cells with an apostrophe before quoting.
  // This includes formula markers preceded by whitespace, tabs, or line breaks.
  const safeText = /^[\s]*[=+\-@]/u.test(text) ? `'${text}` : text;
  return `"${safeText.replaceAll('"', '""')}"`;
}

export function buildCsv(columns, rows) {
  validateColumns(columns);
  if (!Array.isArray(rows)) throw new TypeError('CSV rows must be an array.');
  rows.forEach((row, index) => {
    if (!row || typeof row !== 'object' || Array.isArray(row)) {
      throw new TypeError(`CSV row ${index + 1} must be an object.`);
    }
  });
  const header = columns.map(column => csvCell(column.label)).join(',');
  const body = rows.map(row => columns.map(column => csvCell(row[column.key])).join(','));
  return [header, ...body].join('\r\n');
}
==== search
function hasQuery(record, fields, query) {
  return fields.some(field => {
    const value = record && record[field];
    return value !== null && value !== undefined && String(value).toLowerCase().includes(query);
  });
}

/** Searches only the explicitly enumerated synthetic directory, raw, and stored workflow fields. */
export function searchSandboxRecords(query, { employees = [], attendanceByEmployee = {}, leaveRequests = [], tickets = [] } = {}) {
  const needle = String(query || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!needle) return { employees: [], attendance: [], leaveRequests: [], tickets: [] };
  const employeeItems = Array.isArray(employees) ? employees : [];
  const leaveItems = Array.isArray(leaveRequests) ? leaveRequests : [];
  const ticketItems = Array.isArray(tickets) ? tickets : [];
  const attendanceGroups = attendanceByEmployee && typeof attendanceByEmployee === 'object' && !Array.isArray(attendanceByEmployee)
    ? attendanceByEmployee : {};
  const attendance = Object.entries(attendanceGroups).flatMap(([employeeId, rows]) =>
    (Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : []).map(record => ({ ...record, employeeId }))
      .filter(record => hasQuery(record,
        ['employeeId', 'attendanceId', 'scheduleId', 'date', 'timeIn', 'timeOut', 'dayType'], needle)));

  return {
    employees: employeeItems.filter(record => hasQuery(record,
      ['id', 'name', 'department', 'role', 'location', 'status'], needle)),
    attendance,
    leaveRequests: leaveItems.filter(record => hasQuery(record,
      ['id', 'employeeId', 'employeeName', 'leaveType', 'startDate', 'endDate', 'status', 'note'], needle)),
    tickets: ticketItems.filter(record => hasQuery(record,
      ['id', 'employeeId', 'employeeName', 'ticketType', 'queue', 'summary', 'status'], needle))
  };
}

function friendlyAuthError(error) {
  const code = error && error.code || '';
  if (code === 'auth/operation-not-allowed') return 'Email/Password sign-in is disabled. Enable it in Firebase Console → Authentication → Sign-in method.';
  if (code === 'auth/unauthorized-domain') return 'This preview domain is not authorized. Add its host under Firebase Console → Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains, or test on localhost.';
  if (code === 'auth/invalid-api-key' || code === 'auth/api-key-not-valid.-please-pass-a-valid-api-key.') return 'The Firebase Web API key in .env.local is missing or invalid.';
  if (code === 'auth/email-already-in-use') return 'That email already has a Firebase account. Use Sign in instead.';
  if (code === 'auth/weak-password') return 'Use a password with at least six characters.';
  if (code === 'auth/invalid-email') return 'Enter a valid email address.';
  if (code === 'auth/too-many-requests') return 'Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.';
  if (code === 'auth/invalid-credential' || code === 'auth/wrong-password' || code === 'auth/user-not-found') return 'Email or password is incorrect.';
  return error && error.message ? error.message : 'Firebase sign-in could not be completed.';
}

async function signIn() {
  setAuthError('');
  document.getElementById('auth-reset-status').textContent = '';
  try {
    await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, authEmail.value.trim(), authPassword.value);
  } catch (error) {
    setAuthError(friendlyAuthError(error));
  }
}

async function createDevAccount() {
  setAuthError('');
  document.getElementById('auth-reset-status').textContent = '';
  try {
    await createUserWithEmailAndPassword(auth, authEmail.value.trim(), authPassword.value);
  } catch (error) {
    setAuthError(friendlyAuthError(error));
  }
}

async function sendPasswordReset() {
  setAuthError('');
  const status = document.getElementById('auth-reset-status');
  const button = document.getElementById('password-reset-button');
  status.textContent = '';
  if (!authEmail.value.trim() || !authEmail.checkValidity()) {
    authEmail.reportValidity();
    return;
  }
  button.disabled = true;
  status.textContent = '';
  try {
    await sendPasswordResetEmail(auth, authEmail.value.trim());
    status.textContent = 'If an account exists for that email, Firebase will send a reset link.';
  } catch (error) {
    if (error && ['auth/user-not-found', 'auth/user-disabled'].includes(error.code)) {
      status.textContent = 'If an account exists for that email, Firebase will send a reset link.';
    } else {
      setAuthError(friendlyAuthError(error));
    }
  } finally {
    button.disabled = false;
  }
}

# Candidate policy review from prior submissions and current references

**Status: research only; no calculator is active.** The temporary 2026 browser preview once described in this document has been removed under the current “no temporary features” instruction. ## 1. What the inspected MO-IT110 peer implementation says

The supplied peer review copy at `/home/user/repo_review/full_repo/testingester-main/6/-/` contains an explicit, testable candidate model:

- `src/motorph/model/AttendanceRecord.java`: first cutoff is days 1–15; second cutoff is day 16 through actual month end. Login from 08:00 through 08:10 is treated as 08:00; logout after 17:00 is capped at 17:00. It calculates elapsed time directly from those adjusted times and does **not** subtract a meal interval.
- `src/motorph/service/PayrollProcessor.java`: the first cutoff has no deductions and net equals cutoff gross. On the second cutoff, it computes monthly contributions from the combined two-cutoff gross, computes withholding tax after those contributions, and subtracts the whole monthly deduction amount from the second-cutoff gross (floored at zero). Allowances are shown on the second-cutoff slip but excluded from net in that implementation.
- `src/motorph/model/Employee.java`: gross is hourly rate times the calculated minutes. The course-project fixtures also supply semi-monthly and hourly rates.
- The peer has substantial tests and CP2 compatibility comparisons, but its own behavior is still an implementation choice, not an authoritative MotorPH payroll rule.

**Important defect/risk found in that candidate:** an 08:00–17:00 record yields nine elapsed hours because the code caps at 17:00 but deducts no lunch. DOLE's source says normal work hours do not exceed eight hours a day and requires at least a 60-minute meal period off work; a pair of in/out times without a meal record cannot distinguish the unpaid break. The peer rule must not be copied as an hours-worked or overtime algorithm without resolving that mismatch.

The supplied peer review also records 473 of 476 comparison rows and 14 of 14 cutoff summaries matching the CP2 output; three row differences were ₱0.01 due to floating/half-centavo behavior. That is compatibility evidence, not legal-compliance evidence. See `/home/user/repo_review/submission-comprehensive-report.md` and `/home/user/repo_review/submission-feature-pseudocode.md` for the review context. No peer employee or government-ID data was copied into this app or document.

A public MO-IT110 repository surfaced the same 1–15 / 16–month-end pattern and second-cutoff deduction convention, but explicitly says its payroll tables/thresholds are copied from CP2 rather than independently verified. Treat it as corroboration of a *course-project convention*, not a company policy: https://github.com/fdtan/MO-IT110_OOP-MS2_TanFD.

## 2. Current official statutory references located

These sources can support statutory-component research, but they do not establish MotorPH's attendance import, pay-period, allowance, leave, or role policy:

| Component | Source finding | Boundary before implementation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| SSS | The SSS site publishes its contribution schedule effective Jan. 1, 2025: 15% total on MSC up to ₱35,000, split 5% employee / 10% employer; EC is employer-only. | Pag-IBIG | Circular 460 raises the Maximum Fund Salary to ₱10,000 effective February 2024; the employee rate is 1% at fund salary ≤₱1,500 and 2% above, while the employer rate is 2%. | Confirm applicable employee category and effective date; don't extrapolate to voluntary/other member types. |

A manual annualized arithmetic check gives taxable monthly income ₱22,925; annualized ₱275,100; 15% of the ₱25,100 annual amount above ₱250,000 is ₱3,765, or ₱313.75 per month. This is a reference example only—not this app's result or an approved MotorPH payslip.

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.util.Objects;

/** A small employee view model for the first synthetic-data prototype. */
public final class Employee {
    private final String id;
    private final String name;
    private final String department;
    private final String role;
    private final String location;
    private final String status;

    public Employee(String id, String name, String department, String role, String location, String status) {
        this.id = requireText(id, "id");
        this.name = requireText(name, "name");
        this.department = requireText(department, "department");
        this.role = requireText(role, "role");
        this.location = requireText(location, "location");
        this.status = requireText(status, "status");
    }

    private static String requireText(String value, String field) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(value, field + " must not be null");
        if (value.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must not be blank");
        return value.trim();
    }

    public String getId() { return id; }
    public String getName() { return name; }
    public String getDepartment() { return department; }
    public String getRole() { return role; }
    public String getLocation() { return location; }
    public String getStatus() { return status; }
}
package ph.motorph.web;

/** Synthetic leave request stored only in a user's development sandbox. */
public final class DemoLeaveRequest {
    private final String id;
    private final String employeeId;
    private final String employeeName;
    private final String leaveType;
    private final String startDate;
    private final String endDate;
    private final String note;
    private final String status;
    private final String submittedAt;
    private final String cancelledAt;

    public DemoLeaveRequest(String id, String employeeId, String employeeName, String leaveType,
            String startDate, String endDate, String note, String status, String submittedAt, String cancelledAt) {
        this.id = id;
        this.employeeId = employeeId;
        this.employeeName = employeeName;
        this.leaveType = leaveType;
        this.startDate = startDate;
        this.endDate = endDate;
        this.note = note;
        this.status = status;
        this.submittedAt = submittedAt;
        this.cancelledAt = cancelledAt == null ? "" : cancelledAt;
    }

    public DemoLeaveRequest cancelled(String timestamp) {
        return new DemoLeaveRequest(id, employeeId, employeeName, leaveType, startDate, endDate,
            note, "Cancelled", submittedAt, timestamp);
    }

    public String getId() { return id; }
    public String getEmployeeId() { return employeeId; }
    public String getEmployeeName() { return employeeName; }
    public String getLeaveType() { return leaveType; }
    public String getStartDate() { return startDate; }
    public String getEndDate() { return endDate; }

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.util.Objects;

/** Raw attendance data model aligned to the supplied MO-IT107 Attendance fields. */
public final class AttendanceRecord {
    private final int attendanceId;
    private final int scheduleId;
    private final LocalDate date;
    private final LocalTime timeIn;
    private final LocalTime timeOut;
    private final String dayType;

    public AttendanceRecord(int attendanceId, int scheduleId, LocalDate date,
                            LocalTime timeIn, LocalTime timeOut, String dayType) {
        if (attendanceId <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("attendanceId must be positive");
        if (scheduleId <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("scheduleId must be positive");
        this.date = Objects.requireNonNull(date, "date must not be null");
        this.timeIn = Objects.requireNonNull(timeIn, "timeIn must not be null");
        this.timeOut = Objects.requireNonNull(timeOut, "timeOut must not be null");
        if (timeIn.isAfter(timeOut)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("timeIn must be less than or equal to timeOut per the supplied data dictionary");
        }
        if (dayType == null || dayType.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dayType must not be blank");
        this.attendanceId = attendanceId;
        this.scheduleId = scheduleId;
        this.dayType = dayType.trim();
    }

    public int getAttendanceId() { return attendanceId; }
    public int getScheduleId() { return scheduleId; }
    public LocalDate getDate() { return date; }
    public LocalTime getTimeIn() { return timeIn; }
    public LocalTime getTimeOut() { return timeOut; }
    public String getDayType() { return dayType; }
}

Also notable finding: app.js apiHeaders sends X-Firebase-UID header — server trusts the header + Bearer token but doesn't verify the token; authorization relies on Firestore rules (the token is forwarded). That's a real gap worth flagging: server-side identity is asserted by the client header, effective authorization is Firestore Rules validating the forwarded ID token. Good to note in "missing/gaps" as trust boundary: the Java server doesn't call Identity Toolkit to verify the ID token; instead it forwards the token to Firestore, which validates it. But X-Firebase-UID selects the path. If someone sent a mismatched UID, Firestore rules should reject because request.auth.uid won't match path. So it fails closed by rules. Worth a precise note.

Startup, mode selection, and request plumbing (Java) ### 3.1 `AppServer` **`AppServer()`** — reads `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID` from the environment and `WEB_ROOT` (default `web`), delegates to the 3-arg constructor. **[LIVE]** **`AppServer(String firebaseProjectId, Path webRoot)`** — delegates with `firestoreApiRoot = null` (i.e. real Google endpoint). **[LIVE]** **`AppServer(String firebaseProjectId, Path webRoot, String firestoreApiRoot)`** **[LIVE]** ``` 1. normalise projectId (trim; null -> "") 2. if projectId is blank: build the four in-memory fixtures (employee, schedule, attendance, workflow) else: null all four out — there is no process-memory fallback in cloud mode 3. reject a null webRoot 4. store webRoot as absolute+normalised 5. store firestoreApiRoot (blank -> null) — package-private override used only by HTTP contract tests ``` Note the constructor does **not** enforce the Firebase requirement. Only `main` does. A test or future embedding could still construct a local server; that is intentional and documented in `build-status-no-local-no-temp.md`. **`main(String[])`** **[LIVE]** ``` 1. projectId <- env FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID (default "") 2. testMode <- env MOTORPH_TEST_MODE == "true" 3. port <- env PORT (default 8080); host <- env HOST (default 0.0.0.0) 4. loopbackOnly <- host in {127.0.0.1, localhost, ::1} 5. if projectId is blank AND (not testMode OR not loopbackOnly): throw "FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID is required. Local-memory runtime is disabled; isolated tests must bind to loopback." 6. construct AppServer, start(host, port), register shutdown hook -> stop() ``` This is the fail-closed gate proven by the test suite's startup assertion. **`start(String host, int port) -> HttpServer`** **[LIVE]** ``` 1. refuse if already started 2. HttpServer.create(InetSocketAddress(host,port), backlog 0) 3. mount contexts: /api/health, /api/employees, /api/attendance, /api/reports/attendance, /api/workflows, /api/demo/seed, then "/" for static files 4. executor = fixed pool of 8; server.start() 5. print listening address, mode sentence, and served directory 6. return server ``` Contexts are prefix matches, so `/api/workflows/leave` is handled by `handleWorkflows`, which splits the tail itself. **`stop()`** — `server.stop(0)` and `executor.shutdownNow()`; nulls both fields. **[LIVE]** **`handleHealth(exchange)`** **[LIVE]** ``` 1. if method != GET -> 405 {"error":"Method not allowed"} 2. mode <- projectId blank ? "local-synthetic-demo" : "firebase-user-sandbox" 3. 200 {"status":"ok","mode":mode} ``` No storage, ruleset, or version fields. If you later want the UI to display "which payroll ruleset is active", this is the natural place — but only once one exists. **`handleEmployees(exchange)`** **[LIVE]** — one method serving five route shapes. ``` try: if GET and path is /api/employees or /api/employees/: q <- queryParameter("q") matches <- employeeService.searchEmployees(q) total <- employeeService.listEmployees().size() // full directory size, not match count 200 employeesToJson(matches, total) // {items[], total, matched} if GET and path starts with /api/employees/: id <- substring after prefix if id blank or contains "/" -> 404 employee <- employeeService.findEmployee(id) or 404 200 {"item": …} if POST and path == /api/employees: body <- readJsonBody() // requires JSON content type, ≤8 KiB requireOnlyKeys(name, department, role, location, status) created <- employeeService.createEmployee(all five requiredString fields) 201 {"item": …} if PUT and path starts with /api/employees/: id <- substring after prefix; blank or "/" -> IllegalArgumentException -> 400 body <- readJsonBody(); requireOnlyKeys(same five) updated <- employeeService.updateEmployee(id, five requiredString fields) 200 {"item": …} else 405 catch RequestException -> its status code + {"error": message} catch IllegalArgumentException -> 400 catch NoSuchElementException -> 404 catch IllegalStateException -> 409 catch FirestoreException -> sendApiError (mapped status, safe message) ``` Gaps: no DELETE, no pagination, no `If-Match`/optimistic concurrency, no audit of who changed a record. `total` is computed by a second full directory read. **`handleAttendance(exchange)`** **[LIVE][READ-ONLY]** ``` 1. method != GET -> 405 // this is what makes POST /api/attendance 405 2. employeeId <- queryParameter("employeeId"); blank -> 400 "employeeId is required" 3. from, to <- parseOptionalDate(...) // null when blank; LocalDate.parse otherwise 4. services <- servicesFor(exchange) 5. attendanceService <- new AttendanceService(employeeService, scheduleStore, attendanceStore) 6. records <- attendanceService.findForEmployee(employeeId, from, to) 7. 200 attendanceToJson(records) // {items[], count, hoursCalculated:false} catch DateTimeParseException -> 400 "Dates must use YYYY-MM-DD" catch IllegalArgumentException -> 400 ; NoSuchElementException -> 404 ; FirestoreException -> mapped ``` **`handleAttendanceReport(exchange)`** **[LIVE][READ-ONLY]** ``` 1. method != GET -> 405 2. from, to <- parseOptionalDate(query) 3. summaries <- AttendanceService.summarizeRawRecords(from, to) 4. 200 attendanceSummaryToJson(summaries, from, to) {items[{employeeId,employeeName,scheduleId,hasScheduleMapping,rawRecordCount,firstRecordDate,lastRecordDate}], count, from, to, hoursCalculated:false} ``` **`handleWorkflows(exchange)`** **[LIVE]** ``` try: if GET and path == /api/workflows: service <- workflowsFor(exchange) 200 {leaveRequests[], tickets[], storage: "user-scoped-firestore" | "local-process-memory"} if method != POST -> 405 service <- workflowsFor(exchange) if path == /api/workflows/leave: body <- readJsonBody(); requireOnlyKeys(employeeId,leaveType,startDate,endDate,note) 201 {"item": leaveToJson(service.createLeaveRequest(...)), "storage": …} if path == /api/workflows/tickets: body <- readJsonBody(); requireOnlyKeys(employeeId,ticketType,summary) 201 {"item": ticketToJson(service.createTicket(...)), "storage": …} segments <- tail.split("/") if segments.length == 3 and segments[2] == "cancel": if segments[0] == "leave" -> 200 cancelLeaveRequest(segments[1]) if segments[0] == "tickets" -> 200 cancelTicket(segments[1]) 404 "Workflow endpoint not found" same catch ladder as employees ``` Gaps: no approve/reject/assign/comment route, no list-by-employee server-side query (the client filters the full list), no idempotency key. **`workflowsFor(exchange) -> WorkflowService`** ``` if projectId blank: return new WorkflowService(localEmployeeService, localWorkflowStore) client <- firestoreClientFor(exchange) // throws 401 if headers missing employees<- new EmployeeService(new FirestoreEmployeeStore(client)) service <- new WorkflowService(employees, new FirestoreWorkflowStore(client)) ``` A fresh client and stores are constructed per request; any per-store cache dies with the request. **`readJsonBody(exchange) -> JsonObject`** **[VALIDATION]** ``` 1. Content-Type must exist and start with application/json -> else 415 2. read at most 8,193 bytes; if > 8,192 -> 413 3. parse; must be a JSON object -> else 400 (non-object) or 400 (invalid JSON) ``` No schema/type validation here; that is per-field, later, via `requiredString`/`optionalString`. **`requireOnlyKeys(body, allowed...)`** **[VALIDATION]** — throws 400-class `IllegalArgumentException` naming the first unexpected key. This is the allowlist that stops a client inventing fields such as `salary`. **`requiredString(body, field) -> String`** **[VALIDATION]** — must be a JSON string primitive; otherwise `"<field> is required and must be text."` Returns raw (untrimmed) text; trimming happens downstream. **`optionalString(body, field) -> String`** **[VALIDATION]** — missing or JSON null → `""`; must otherwise be a string primitive. **`itemToJson(item, storage) -> String`** — `{"item": <object>, "storage": <label>}`. **`workflowsToJson(leaveRequests, tickets, storage) -> String`** — arrays plus the storage label. No sorting here (ordering comes from the store). **`leaveToJson(request) -> JsonObject`** — ten properties: `id, employeeId, employeeName, leaveType, startDate, endDate, note, status, submittedAt, cancelledAt`. **`ticketToJson(ticket) -> JsonObject`** — nine properties: `id, employeeId, employeeName, ticketType, queue, summary, status, submittedAt, cancelledAt`. **`handleSeedDemo(exchange)`** **[LIVE]** ``` 1. method != POST -> 405 2. projectId blank -> 400 "Firebase is not configured for this server." 3. result <- DemoSeedService(client).seedMissingSyntheticRecords() 4. 200 {employeesCreated, scheduleMappingsCreated, attendanceCreated, syntheticOnly:true} ``` Writes only fictional fixture values. It cannot be re-run destructively: existing document IDs return `ALREADY_EXISTS` and are counted as not created. **`servicesFor(exchange) -> RequestServices`** ``` if projectId blank: (localEmployeeService, localScheduleStore, localAttendanceStore) else: client <- firestoreClientFor(exchange) (new EmployeeService(new FirestoreEmployeeStore(client)), new FirestoreEmployeeScheduleStore(client), new FirestoreAttendanceStore(client)) ``` **`firestoreClientFor(exchange) -> FirestoreRestClient`** **[LIVE] — the security boundary, read carefully** ``` 1. authorization <- header "Authorization"; must start with "Bearer " 2. uid <- header "X-Firebase-UID"; must be non-blank 3. else FirestoreException("Sign in with your Firebase account to continue.", 401) 4. token <- authorization minus "Bearer ", trimmed 5. reject if token > 8,192 chars, uid > 128 chars, or uid contains "/" -> 401 6. new FirestoreRestClient(projectId, uid, token, optional override) ``` **The Java server never verifies the token itself.** It cannot mint data access either: the token is forwarded to Firestore, which validates it, and the path is derived from `uid`. A forged `X-Firebase-UID` therefore produces a request that Firestore Rules reject (the path would not match `request.auth.uid`). The design fails closed, but it does mean every authorization decision lives in Rules, not in Java. If you ever add a privileged read (payroll registers, other employees' records), this pattern is no longer sufficient — you would need server-side token verification and a role model. Flagged as **[GAP] OPS-3**. **`parseOptionalDate(String) -> LocalDate|null`** **[VALIDATION]** — blank/null → null, else `LocalDate.parse` (throws `DateTimeParseException` → 400). **`attendanceToJson(records) -> String`** — hand-built JSON: `{items:[{attendanceId,scheduleId,date,timeIn,timeOut,dayType}], count, hoursCalculated:false}`. **`attendanceRecordToJson(record) -> String`** — one row; `dayType` is escaped, the numeric/date/time fields are trusted shapes. **`attendanceSummaryToJson(summaries, from, to) -> String`** — rows plus `count`, echoed `from`/`to` (or null), and `hoursCalculated:false`. **`handleStaticFiles(exchange)`** **[LIVE]** ``` 1. HEAD allowed; anything else -> 405 text 2. path "/" -> "/index.html" 3. requested <- webRoot.resolve(path minus leading "/").normalize() 4. if not under webRoot OR not a regular file -> 404 // traversal guard 5. headers: X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, Cache-Control no-store, CSP default-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com https://securetoken.googleapis.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self', Referrer-Policy no-referrer, Permissions-Policy camera/mic/geo off 6. HEAD -> Content-Length only; GET -> write bytes ``` The CSP `connect-src` allowlist is why Firebase Auth works from the app and why an arbitrary external API would not. **`employeesToJson(employees, total) -> String`** — `{items[], total, matched}`. **`employeeToJson(employee) -> String`** — the six display fields, escaped. **`queryParameter(rawQuery, target) -> String`** **[VALIDATION]** — manual split on `&` and first `=`; URL-decodes key and value; returns `""` for missing. Note `""` is indistinguishable from an absent parameter, which is why `handleAttendance` tests `trim().isEmpty()`. **`decode(value) -> String`** — `URLDecoder.decode(...,"UTF-8")`, returning `""` on failure rather than throwing. **`contentTypeFor(path) -> String`** — html/css/js/svg mapped to explicit types with UTF-8; everything else `application/octet-stream`. **`escapeJson(value) -> String`** — escapes `\ " \n \r \t` only. Control characters below 0x20 other than those are not escaped; acceptable for the current field set, would need hardening before free-text payroll remarks. **`sendApiError(exchange, exception)`** — clamps status into 400–599 (default 500) and emits `{"error": …}`. **`sendJson(exchange, status, body)`** — delegates to `sendText` with `application/json; charset=utf-8`. **`sendText(exchange, status, type, body)`** — sets content type, `nosniff`, `no-store`, then writes bytes. **`RequestException(int statusCode, String message)`** — checked-at-catch-time carrier for 400/413/415-class errors. **`RequestServices(employeeService, scheduleStore, attendanceStore)`** — value holder for the three services a read path needs. ### 3.2 `FirestoreException` **`FirestoreException(String message, int statusCode)`** — carries a message and an HTTP-ish status for the handler ladder. **`getStatusCode()`** returns it. ### 3.3 `FirestoreRestClient` — the only network egress **`FirestoreRestClient(projectId, userId, idToken)`** — delegates to the 4-arg form with the real API root. **`FirestoreRestClient(projectId, userId, idToken, apiRoot)`** **[LIVE]** ``` 1. projectId, userId must be non-blank, single path segments (no "/") 2. idToken must be non-blank 3. apiRoot must be non-blank; force a trailing "/" ``` The override exists so contract tests can point at a local stub. **`listDocuments(collectionPath) -> List<JsonObject>`** **[LIVE]** ``` 1. pageToken <- "" 2. do: url <- documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "?pageSize=1000" + pageToken response <- send(GET, url, null, allowExisting=false) append every element of response.documents pageToken <- response.nextPageToken ? "&pageToken=" + encoded : "" 3. while pageToken non-empty ``` Every read is unbounded: there is no per-user cap or index assumption, and the whole collection is materialised in memory each call. **`createDocument(collectionPath, documentId, fields) -> boolean`** **[LIVE]** ``` url <- documentsUrl + "?documentId=" + encode(documentId) body <- {"fields": fields} return send(POST, url, body, allowExisting=true).has("name") ``` Returns `false` on `ALREADY_EXISTS` (409, or 400 whose body mentions it) so callers can treat re-seeding as a no-op. No pre-existence read; it relies on the create conflict. **`updateDocument(collectionPath, documentId, fields, updateMask) -> boolean`** **[LIVE]** ``` require fields non-null; require updateMask non-empty url <- documentsUrl + "/" + encode(documentId) for each field in updateMask: url += "?/&" + "updateMask.fieldPaths=" + encode(field) return send(PATCH, url, {"fields": fields}, false).has("name") ``` Field-masked PATCH, so unspecified fields are preserved. This is what makes cancel safe: only `status` and `cancelledAt` are touched. **`userCollection(collectionName) -> String`** — `"users/" + userId + "/" + collectionName` with a safe-segment check. Every store goes through this; there is no way to address another user's tree from this class. **`send(method, url, body, allowExisting) -> JsonObject`** (private) **[LIVE]** ``` 1. build request: 20 s timeout, Authorization: Bearer <idToken>, Accept: application/json 2. attach JSON body + Content-Type if body present 3. execute 4. if allowExisting and status in {409,400} and body contains "ALREADY_EXISTS" -> return {} 5. if status outside 200–299 -> firestoreError(status, body) 6. empty body -> {} else parse as object catch InterruptedException -> re-interrupt, FirestoreException 503 catch IOException | IllegalArgumentException -> FirestoreException("Could not reach Firestore…", 503) ``` **`documentsUrl(collectionPath) -> String`** — `apiRoot + project/databases/(default)/documents` then each path segment encoded individually, so a collection name cannot smuggle a slash. **`requireSafeSegment(value,label)`** **[VALIDATION]** — non-blank, no `/`, trimmed. **`pathEncode(value)`** — `URLEncoder` with `+` → `%20`. **`queryEncode(value)`** — plain `URLEncoder` (the `+` form is legal in a query string). **`firestoreError(status, body) -> FirestoreException`** — maps to human text: 401 "Firebase sign-in expired…", 403 "Firestore denied this request. Publish the scoped development rules in docs/firestore.rules, then retry.", 404 "database or requested resource was not found", 400/409 "A demo record could not be created…". Anything else keeps the generic message. PART1 echo "part1 bytes:"; wc -c /home/user/motorph-ms2/docs/function-pseudocode-and-handoff-synthesis.md

const attendanceResultCount = document.getElementById('attendance-result-count');

function initials(name) {
  return name.trim().split(/\s+/).slice(0, 2).map(part => part[0]).join('').toUpperCase();
}

function makeCell(content) {
  const cell = document.createElement('td');
  if (content instanceof Node) cell.append(content);
  else cell.textContent = content;
  return cell;
}

function downloadCsvFile(filename, columns, records) {
  const csv = buildCsv(columns, records);
  const blob = new Blob([`\uFEFF${csv}`], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename;
  link.hidden = true;
  document.body.append(link);
  link.click();
  link.remove();
  window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
}

function downloadJsonFile(filename, data) {
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json;charset=utf-8' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename;
  link.hidden = true;
  document.body.append(link);
  link.click();
  link.remove();
  window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
}
