package ph.motorph.web;

import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.ArrayList;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
import java.util.Optional;

/**
 * Saved payroll runs under users/{uid}/demoPayrollRuns/{runId}. Each run stores its header,
 * the ruleset version, the calculation assumptions, and every resulting payslip line, so a
 * stored run can be re-read without recomputing or re-deriving policy.
 */
public final class FirestorePayrollStore implements PayrollStore {
    private static final String COLLECTION = "demoPayrollRuns";
    private final FirestoreRestClient client;

    public FirestorePayrollStore(FirestoreRestClient client) {
        if (client == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("client must not be null");
        this.client = client;
    }

    @Override
    public List<PayrollRun> findAll() {
        List<PayrollRun> runs = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JsonObject document : client.listDocuments(client.userCollection(COLLECTION))) {
            runs.add(fromDocument(document));
        }
        runs.sort((a, b) -> b.createdAt().compareTo(a.createdAt()));
        return runs;
    }

    @Override
    public Optional<PayrollRun> findById(String id) {
        if (id == null) return Optional.empty();
        return findAll().stream().filter(run -> run.id().equals(id)).findFirst();
    }

    @Override
    public PayrollRun create(PayrollRun run) {
        if (!client.createDocument(client.userCollection(COLLECTION), run.id(), runFields(run))) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Payroll run ID already exists; refresh and try again.");
        }
        return run;
    }

    private static JsonObject runFields(PayrollRun run) {
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("payPeriod", string(run.payPeriod()));
        fields.add("periodStart", string(run.periodStart()));
        fields.add("periodEnd", string(run.periodEnd()));
        fields.add("rulesetId", string(run.rulesetId()));
        fields.add("taxBasis", string(run.taxBasis()));
        fields.add("statutoryBasis", string(run.statutoryBasis()));
        fields.add("createdAt", string(run.createdAt()));
        JsonArray payslips = new JsonArray();
        for (Payslip slip : run.payslips()) payslips.add(PayslipJson.toJson(slip));
        fields.add("payslips", array(payslips));
        return fields;
    }

    private static PayrollRun fromDocument(JsonObject document) {
        JsonObject fields = document.has("fields") && document.get("fields").isJsonObject()
            ? document.getAsJsonObject("fields") : new JsonObject();

            JsonElement values = stored.getAsJsonObject().get("arrayValue");
            if (values != null && values.isJsonObject()) {
                JsonElement list = values.getAsJsonObject().get("values");
                if (list != null && list.isJsonArray()) {
                    for (JsonElement element : list.getAsJsonArray()) {
                        payslips.add(PayslipJson.fromJson(element.getAsJsonObject()));
                    }

private static HttpResponse<String> putJson(URI uri, String json) throws Exception {
        HttpRequest request = HttpRequest.newBuilder(uri).header("Accept", "application/json")
            .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            .PUT(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(json, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)).build();
        return HTTP.send(request, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }

    private static HttpResponse<String> putJson(URI uri, String json, String token, String uid) throws Exception {
        HttpRequest request = HttpRequest.newBuilder(uri).header("Accept", "application/json")
            .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + token).header("X-Firebase-UID", uid)
            .PUT(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(json, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)).build();
        return HTTP.send(request, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }

    private static HttpResponse<String> postJson(URI uri, String json, String token, String uid) throws Exception {
        HttpRequest request = HttpRequest.newBuilder(uri).header("Accept", "application/json")
            .header("Content-Type", "application/json").header("Authorization", "Bearer " + token)
            .header("X-Firebase-UID", uid)
            .POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(json, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)).build();
        return HTTP.send(request, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }

private static String runToJson(PayrollRun run, boolean includePayslips) {
        JsonObject o = new JsonObject();
        o.addProperty("id", run.id());
        o.addProperty("payPeriod", run.payPeriod());
        o.addProperty("periodStart", run.periodStart());
        o.addProperty("periodEnd", run.periodEnd());
        o.addProperty("rulesetId", run.rulesetId());
        o.addProperty("taxBasis", run.taxBasis());
        o.addProperty("statutoryBasis", run.statutoryBasis());
        o.addProperty("createdAt", run.createdAt());
        java.math.BigDecimal gross = Money.ZERO, deductions = Money.ZERO, net = Money.ZERO, cost = Money.ZERO;
        for (Payslip slip : run.payslips()) {
            gross = gross.add(slip.grossIncome()).add(slip.totalBenefits());
            deductions = deductions.add(slip.totalDeductions());
            net = net.add(slip.takeHomePay());
            cost = cost.add(slip.employerCost());
        }
        o.addProperty("employeeCount", run.payslips().size());
        o.addProperty("totalGross", Money.round(gross).toPlainString());
        o.addProperty("totalDeductions", Money.round(deductions).toPlainString());
        o.addProperty("totalNet", Money.round(net).toPlainString());
        o.addProperty("totalEmployerCost", Money.round(cost).toPlainString());
        if (includePayslips) {
            JsonArray slips = new JsonArray();
            for (Payslip slip : run.payslips()) slips.add(PayslipJson.toJson(slip));
            o.add("payslips", slips);
        }
        return o.toString();
    }

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * Turns stored raw timecard rows into the two numbers a payslip needs: days worked and hours
 * paid. Only rows with a positive worked total count, so weekend and holiday rows recorded as
 * zero hours (as the supplied MotorPH timecard does) never inflate the day count.
 *
 * This reads; it never writes attendance and never classifies absence.
 */
public final class TimesheetService {

    public static final class Day {
        public final String date;
        public final String dayType;
        public final String hours;
        public Day(String date, String dayType, String hours) {
            this.date = date; this.dayType = dayType; this.hours = hours;
        }
    }

    public static final class Summary {
        private final String employeeId;
        private final String from;
        private final String to;
        private final int daysWorked;
        private final BigDecimal totalHours;
        private final List<Day> days;

        Summary(String employeeId, String from, String to, int daysWorked, BigDecimal totalHours, List<Day> days) {
            this.employeeId = employeeId; this.from = from; this.to = to;
            this.daysWorked = daysWorked; this.totalHours = totalHours; this.days = days;
        }

        public String employeeId() { return employeeId; }
        public String from() { return from; }
        public String to() { return to; }
        public int daysWorked() { return daysWorked; }
        public BigDecimal totalHours() { return totalHours; }
        public List<Day> days() { return days; }
    }

    private final AttendanceService attendanceService;

    public TimesheetService(AttendanceService attendanceService) {
        if (attendanceService == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("attendance service must not be null");
        this.attendanceService = attendanceService;
    }

    public Summary summarise(String employeeId, LocalDate from, LocalDate to) {
        if (from == null || to == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("A timesheet period needs both a start and an end date.");
        List<AttendanceRecord> records = attendanceService.findForEmployee(employeeId, from, to);
        // One working day per calendar date, even if a date somehow carries more than one row.
        Map<String, Day> byDate = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        BigDecimal total = Money.ZERO;
        for (AttendanceRecord record : records) {
            BigDecimal hours = record.getHoursWorked();
            if (hours.signum() <= 0) continue;
            String key = record.getDate().toString();
            Day existing = byDate.get(key);
            if (existing == null) {
                byDate.put(key, new Day(key, record.getDayType(), hours.toPlainString()));
            } else {
                BigDecimal merged = new BigDecimal(existing.hours).add(hours);
                byDate.put(key, new Day(key, existing.dayType, merged.toPlainString()));
            }
            total = total.add(hours);
        }
        List<Day> days = new ArrayList<>(byDate.values());
        days.sort((a, b) -> a.date.compareTo(b.date));
        return new Summary(employeeId, from.toString(), to.toString(), days.size(), Money.round(total), days);
    }
}

    private static JsonObject array(JsonArray values) {
        JsonObject wrapper = new JsonObject();
        JsonObject arrayValue = new JsonObject();
        arrayValue.add("values", values);
        wrapper.add("arrayValue", arrayValue);
        return wrapper;
    }

    private static JsonObject string(String value) {
        JsonObject field = new JsonObject();
        field.addProperty("stringValue", value == null ? "" : value);
        return field;
    }

    private static String value(JsonObject fields, String name) {
        JsonElement element = fields.get(name);
        if (element == null || !element.isJsonObject()) return "";
        JsonElement inner = element.getAsJsonObject().get("stringValue");
        return inner == null || inner.isJsonNull() ? "" : inner.getAsString();
    }

    private static String documentId(JsonObject document) {
        String name = document.has("name") ? document.get("name").getAsString() : "";
        int slash = name.lastIndexOf('/');
        if (slash < 0 || slash == name.length() - 1) throw new IllegalStateException("Payroll run document has no ID.");
        return name.substring(slash + 1);
    }

    static Payslip fromJson(JsonObject o) {
        return Payslip.builder()
            .employee(text(o, "employeeId"), text(o, "employeeName"), text(o, "position"), text(o, "department"))
            .period(text(o, "payPeriod"), text(o, "periodStart"), text(o, "periodEnd"))
            .ruleset(text(o, "rulesetId"))
            .salary(amount(o, "monthlyBasic"), amount(o, "dailyRate"), number(o, "daysWorked"), amount(o, "hourlyRate"))
            .premiums(number(o, "overtimeHours"), amount(o, "overtimePay"),
                number(o, "nightDifferentialHours"), amount(o, "nightDifferentialPay"), amount(o, "grossIncome"))
            .benefits(amount(o, "riceSubsidy"), amount(o, "phoneAllowance"), amount(o, "clothingAllowance"),
                amount(o, "taxableAllowance"), amount(o, "nonTaxableAllowance"), amount(o, "totalBenefits"))
            .deductions(amount(o, "sssEmployee"), amount(o, "philHealthEmployee"), amount(o, "pagibigEmployee"),
                amount(o, "withholdingTax"), amount(o, "totalDeductions"))
            .employer(amount(o, "sssEmployer"), amount(o, "sssEc"), amount(o, "philHealthEmployer"),
                amount(o, "pagibigEmployer"), amount(o, "employerCost"))
            .result(amount(o, "taxableIncome"), amount(o, "takeHomePay"))
            .build();
    }

    private static void money(JsonObject o, String key, BigDecimal value) {
        o.addProperty(key, Money.round(value).toPlainString());
    }

    private static void number(JsonObject o, String key, BigDecimal value) {
        o.addProperty(key, value.toPlainString());
    }

    private static String text(JsonObject o, String key) {
        return o.has(key) && !o.get(key).isJsonNull() ? o.get(key).getAsString() : "";
    }

    private static BigDecimal amount(JsonObject o, String key) {
        return o.has(key) && !o.get(key).isJsonNull() ? Money.parse(o.get(key).getAsString()) : Money.ZERO;
    }

    private static BigDecimal number(JsonObject o, String key) {
        return o.has(key) && !o.get(key).isJsonNull()
            ? new BigDecimal(o.get(key).getAsString()) : BigDecimal.ZERO;
    }

package ph.motorph.web;

import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.URI;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Small Firestore REST client that forwards a Firebase Auth ID token. Firestore
 * Security Rules, not server credentials, authorize every read and write.
 */
public final class FirestoreRestClient {
    private static final String API_ROOT = "https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/";
    private static final HttpClient HTTP = HttpClient.newBuilder()
        .connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(10)).build();

    private final String apiRoot;
    private final String projectId;
    private final String userId;
    private final String idToken;

    public FirestoreRestClient(String projectId, String userId, String idToken) {
        this(projectId, userId, idToken, API_ROOT);
    }

    /** Package-private endpoint override for isolated HTTP contract tests. */
    FirestoreRestClient(String projectId, String userId, String idToken, String apiRoot) {
        this.projectId = requireSafeSegment(projectId, "project id");
        this.userId = requireSafeSegment(userId, "user id");
        if (idToken == null || idToken.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Firebase sign-in is required");
        if (apiRoot == null || apiRoot.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("API root must not be blank");
        this.idToken = idToken.trim();
        this.apiRoot = apiRoot.trim().endsWith("/") ? apiRoot.trim() : apiRoot.trim() + "/";
    }

    public List<JsonObject> listDocuments(String collectionPath) {
        List<JsonObject> documents = new ArrayList<>();
        String pageToken = "";
        do {
            String url = documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "?pageSize=1000" + pageToken;
            JsonObject response = send("GET", url, null, false);
            JsonArray items = response.has("documents") ? response.getAsJsonArray("documents") : new JsonArray();
            for (JsonElement item : items) documents.add(item.getAsJsonObject());
            pageToken = response.has("nextPageToken")
                ? "&pageToken=" + queryEncode(response.get("nextPageToken").getAsString()) : "";
        } while (!pageToken.isEmpty());
        return documents;
    }

[NODE 8483]
floor 33,333.00 (whole peso)  -> 1,875 + (50,212.50 - 33,333.00) × 20% = 5,250.90   ✗
  floor 33,333.33 (400,000/12)  -> 1,875 + (50,212.50 - 33,333.33) × 20% = 5,250.83   ✓
```

The same applies to the semi-monthly table, which uses the annual thresholds over 24 and is **not**
the monthly table halved. Both tables are in `PayrollRuleset`.

**Divisors are `monthly ÷ 20` and `monthly ÷ 168`.** Every row of the supplied salary table satisfies
these to the centavo (₱24,000 → ₱1,200 daily and ₱142.86 hourly; ₱41,850 → ₱2,092.50 / ₱249.11).

**SSS MSC rounds up to the next ₱500 step and is then clamped** to ₱5,000–₱35,000. At ₱53,500 both
readings give ₱1,750, so the payslip cannot settle rounding; the round-up rule is the standard SSS
method and is flagged as such in the ruleset.

**Timekeeping uses punches, not a fixed lunch.** The supplied timecard reports 08:00–12:00 /
13:00–17:00 as **8 hrs**, i.e. out − in − meal. `WorkedTime` implements exactly that, and
`TimesheetServiceTest` asserts the supplied row shape. Consequence worth stating plainly: a row with
**no** break punches yields 9 hours, so missing meal punches inflate paid hours. That is a data
requirement, not a rule the app can invent.

## 4. What is implemented

- `Money`, `PayrollRuleset` (2025 and 2026, effective-dated, fail-closed outside them),
  `PayrollService`, `Payslip`, `PayrollRun`, `PayrollStore` + `InMemory`/`Firestore` adapters,
  `TimesheetService`, `WorkedTime`, break-aware `AttendanceRecord`.
- Routes: `GET /api/payroll/rules`, `GET /api/payroll/timesheet`, `POST /api/payroll/preview`,
  `POST /api/payroll/runs`, `GET /api/payroll/runs`, `GET /api/payroll/runs/{id}`.
- Employee records carry monthly basic, rice subsidy, phone allowance and clothing allowance; the
  payroll picker only offers employees that have a pay profile.
- UI: payslip in MotorPH's layout, remittance summary (both shares), statutory rate table, run
  history with saved snapshots, payslip CSV export, "use stored timesheet days".
- Saved runs are **immutable snapshots**: inputs, ruleset version, both calculation assumptions, and
  every computed line are stored, so a reprint never recalculates.

## 5. What is still not done

| Gap | Why it is still open |
|---|---|
| Attendance → days worked → payslip, automatically | The UI has "use stored timesheet days", but days worked is still an operator-confirmed field. Absence, tardiness and undertime have no approved rule. |
| Overtime and night-differential **hours** from punches | Rates are parameterised (125% / 10%); the qualifying hours are not derived. Overtime approval is not modelled. |
| Leave pay, holiday/rest-day premiums, 13th month, other earnings | No rule supplied. |
| A **multi-employee** run | API and store support many payslips per run; the UI computes one employee at a time. |
| Approval, roles, audit, payslip access control | Owner-only Firestore paths; no role model. |
| Ruleset for years before 2025 | `forYear` throws outside 2025–2026 rather than borrowing an adjacent table. |

/** Money text for display: "26,750.00". Never used for arithmetic. */
export function formatAmount(value) {
  const number = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(number)) return '0.00';
  return number.toLocaleString('en-PH', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
}

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Payroll calculation, grounded in the MotorPH sample payslip supplied on 2026-11-05 and the
 * rate structure of sweldongpinoy.com (Basic Pay + taxable/non-taxable allowance + night
 * differential + overtime -> statutory contributions -> withholding -> net).
 *
 * The supplied payslip (employee 15, 2026-01-02..2026-01-15) is reproduced to the centavo:
 *   daily rate 2,675.00 = monthly basic 53,500 / 20
 *   10 days worked     = 26,750.00 gross
 *   SSS 1,750.00, PhilHealth 1,337.50, Pag-IBIG 200.00, withholding 5,250.83
 *   total deductions 8,538.33, take home 22,711.67
 *
 * Two MotorPH conventions are implemented exactly as evidenced and are flagged in the API
 * response as assumptions rather than re-derived:
 *   1. Statutory contributions are computed on the MONTHLY basic salary, and the full monthly
 *      amount is deducted inside a semi-monthly cutoff (the supplied payslip does this).
 *   2. Withholding is computed on monthly basic minus employee statutory shares, on the
 *      monthly Annex E table.
 */
public final class PayrollService {

    /** MotorPH's daily-rate divisor, proven by the supplied payslip (53,500 / 20 = 2,675). */
    public static final BigDecimal DAYS_PER_MONTH = new BigDecimal("20");
    /** MotorPH's hourly-rate divisor, verified against every row of the supplied employee file. */
    public static final BigDecimal HOURS_PER_MONTH = new BigDecimal("168");
    public static final BigDecimal HOURS_PER_DAY = new BigDecimal("8");

    /** What the withholding is computed on. BASIC_ONLY reproduces the supplied payslip. */
    public enum TaxBasis { BASIC_ONLY, BASIC_PLUS_TAXABLE_ALLOWANCE }
    /** How a monthly statutory amount is applied to a pay period. */
    public enum StatutoryBasis { FULL_MONTHLY_EACH_PERIOD, SPLIT_EVENLY }

    public static final class Input {
        public String employeeId;
        public String employeeName = "";
        public String position = "";
        public String department = "";
        public String payPeriod = "MONTHLY";
        public String periodStart = "";
        public String periodEnd = "";
        public BigDecimal monthlyBasic;
        public BigDecimal daysWorked;
        public BigDecimal overtimeHours = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        public BigDecimal overtimeRatePercent = new BigDecimal("125");
        public BigDecimal nightDifferentialHours = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        public BigDecimal nightDifferentialRatePercent = new BigDecimal("10");
        public BigDecimal riceSubsidy = Money.ZERO;
        public BigDecimal phoneAllowance = Money.ZERO;
        public BigDecimal clothingAllowance = Money.ZERO;
        public BigDecimal taxableAllowance = Money.ZERO;
        public BigDecimal otherDeductions = Money.ZERO;
        public String taxBasis = TaxBasis.BASIC_ONLY.name();
        public String statutoryBasis = StatutoryBasis.FULL_MONTHLY_EACH_PERIOD.name();
    }

    public Payslip compute(Input input, PayrollRuleset ruleset) {
        validate(input);
        PayrollRuleset.Period period = PayrollRuleset.Period.parse(input.payPeriod);
        TaxBasis taxBasis = parseTaxBasis(input.taxBasis);
        StatutoryBasis statutoryBasis = parseStatutoryBasis(input.statutoryBasis);

        BigDecimal monthlyBasic = Money.round(input.monthlyBasic);
        BigDecimal dailyRate = divideMonths(monthlyBasic, DAYS_PER_MONTH);
        BigDecimal hourlyRate = divideMonths(monthlyBasic, HOURS_PER_MONTH);
        BigDecimal daysWorked = input.daysWorked;

        BigDecimal basePay = Money.round(dailyRate.multiply(daysWorked));
        BigDecimal overtimePay = Money.round(hourlyRate.multiply(input.overtimeHours)
            .multiply(input.overtimeRatePercent).divide(new BigDecimal("100"), 6, RoundingMode.HALF_UP));
        BigDecimal nightDifferentialPay = Money.round(hourlyRate.multiply(input.nightDifferentialHours)
            .multiply(input.nightDifferentialRatePercent).divide(new BigDecimal("100"), 6, RoundingMode.HALF_UP));
        BigDecimal grossIncome = Money.round(basePay.add(overtimePay).add(nightDifferentialPay));

        BigDecimal nonTaxable = Money.round(input.riceSubsidy.add(input.phoneAllowance).add(input.clothingAllowance));
        BigDecimal taxableAllowance = Money.round(input.taxableAllowance);
        BigDecimal totalBenefits = Money.round(nonTaxable.add(taxableAllowance));

        // Statutory amounts are monthly figures; the split decides how much lands in this period.
        BigDecimal divisor = statutoryBasis == StatutoryBasis.SPLIT_EVENLY && period == PayrollRuleset.Period.SEMI_MONTHLY
            ? new BigDecimal(period.periodsPerMonth()) : BigDecimal.ONE;
        BigDecimal sss = perPeriod(ruleset.sssEmployee(monthlyBasic), divisor);
        BigDecimal philHealth = perPeriod(ruleset.philHealthEmployee(monthlyBasic), divisor);
        BigDecimal pagibig = perPeriod(ruleset.pagibigEmployee(monthlyBasic), divisor);

        BigDecimal monthlyStatutory = Money.round(ruleset.sssEmployee(monthlyBasic)
            .add(ruleset.philHealthEmployee(monthlyBasic)).add(ruleset.pagibigEmployee(monthlyBasic)));
        BigDecimal taxableMonthly = taxBasis == TaxBasis.BASIC_PLUS_TAXABLE_ALLOWANCE
            ? Money.round(monthlyBasic.subtract(monthlyStatutory).add(taxableAllowance))
            : Money.round(monthlyBasic.subtract(monthlyStatutory));
        if (Money.isNegative(taxableMonthly)) taxableMonthly = Money.ZERO;

        BigDecimal monthlyWithholding = ruleset.withholding(taxableMonthly, PayrollRuleset.Period.MONTHLY);
        BigDecimal otherDeductions = Money.round(input.otherDeductions);
        BigDecimal withholding = perPeriod(monthlyWithholding, divisor);
        BigDecimal totalDeductions = Money.round(sss.add(philHealth).add(pagibig).add(withholding).add(otherDeductions));

        BigDecimal takeHome = Money.round(grossIncome.add(totalBenefits).subtract(totalDeductions));
        if (Money.isNegative(takeHome)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Deductions exceed pay for " + input.employeeId
                + " (take-home would be negative). Correct the inputs before saving this run.");
        }

        BigDecimal employerSss = perPeriod(ruleset.sssEmployer(monthlyBasic), divisor);
        BigDecimal employerEc = perPeriod(ruleset.sssEc(monthlyBasic), divisor);
        BigDecimal employerPhilHealth = perPeriod(ruleset.philHealthEmployer(monthlyBasic), divisor);
        BigDecimal employerPagibig = perPeriod(ruleset.pagibigEmployer(monthlyBasic), divisor);
        BigDecimal employerCost = Money.round(grossIncome.add(totalBenefits)
            .add(employerSss).add(employerEc).add(employerPhilHealth).add(employerPagibig));

        return Payslip.builder()
            .employee(input.employeeId, input.employeeName, input.position, input.department)
            .period(period.name(), input.periodStart, input.periodEnd)
            .ruleset(ruleset.id())
            .salary(monthlyBasic, dailyRate, daysWorked, hourlyRate)
            .premiums(input.overtimeHours, overtimePay, input.nightDifferentialHours, nightDifferentialPay, grossIncome)
            .benefits(input.riceSubsidy, input.phoneAllowance, input.clothingAllowance,
                taxableAllowance, nonTaxable, totalBenefits)
            .deductions(sss, philHealth, pagibig, withholding, totalDeductions)
            .employer(employerSss, employerEc, employerPhilHealth, employerPagibig, employerCost)
            .result(taxableMonthly, takeHome)
            .build();
    }

    /** Employer-side totals for remittance reporting; monthly figures regardless of period split. */
    public List<String[]> remittanceRows(List<Payslip> payslips) {
        BigDecimal sss = Money.ZERO, ec = Money.ZERO, ph = Money.ZERO, pi = Money.ZERO, tax = Money.ZERO;
        for (Payslip slip : payslips) {
            sss = sss.add(slip.sssEmployee()).add(slip.sssEmployer());
            ec = ec.add(slip.sssEc());
            ph = ph.add(slip.philHealthEmployee()).add(slip.philHealthEmployer());
            pi = pi.add(slip.pagibigEmployee()).add(slip.pagibigEmployer());
            tax = tax.add(slip.withholdingTax());
        }
        List<String[]> rows = new ArrayList<>();
        rows.add(new String[]{"Social Security System", Money.format(sss)});
        rows.add(new String[]{"Employees' Compensation", Money.format(ec)});
        rows.add(new String[]{"PhilHealth", Money.format(ph)});
        rows.add(new String[]{"Pag-IBIG", Money.format(pi)});
        rows.add(new String[]{"BIR withholding", Money.format(tax)});
        return rows;
    }

    private static BigDecimal divideMonths(BigDecimal monthly, BigDecimal divisor) {
        return monthly.divide(divisor, 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }

    private static BigDecimal perPeriod(BigDecimal monthlyAmount, BigDecimal divisor) {
        if (divisor.compareTo(BigDecimal.ONE) == 0) return monthlyAmount;
        return Money.round(monthlyAmount.divide(divisor, 4, RoundingMode.HALF_UP));
    }

    private static TaxBasis parseTaxBasis(String value) {
        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty()) return TaxBasis.BASIC_ONLY;
        try {
            return TaxBasis.valueOf(value.trim().toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT));
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Tax basis must be BASIC_ONLY or BASIC_PLUS_TAXABLE_ALLOWANCE.");
        }
    }

    private static StatutoryBasis parseStatutoryBasis(String value) {
        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty()) return StatutoryBasis.FULL_MONTHLY_EACH_PERIOD;
        try {
            return StatutoryBasis.valueOf(value.trim().toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT));
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Statutory basis must be FULL_MONTHLY_EACH_PERIOD or SPLIT_EVENLY.");
        }
    }

    private static void validate(Input input) {
        if (input == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Payroll input is required.");
        if (input.employeeId == null || input.employeeId.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Employee ID is required.");
        if (input.monthlyBasic == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Monthly basic pay is required.");
        if (Money.isNegative(input.monthlyBasic)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Monthly basic pay must not be negative.");
        if (input.daysWorked == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Days worked is required.");
        if (Money.isNegative(input.daysWorked)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Days worked must not be negative.");
        if (input.daysWorked.compareTo(DAYS_PER_MONTH) > 0 && "MONTHLY".equalsIgnoreCase(input.payPeriod)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Days worked cannot exceed " + DAYS_PER_MONTH + " in one monthly period.");
        }
        if (input.daysWorked.compareTo(DAYS_PER_MONTH.divide(new BigDecimal("2"))) > 0
            && "SEMI_MONTHLY".equalsIgnoreCase(input.payPeriod)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Days worked cannot exceed 10 in one semi-monthly period.");
        }
        requireNonNegative(input.overtimeHours, "Overtime hours");
        requireNonNegative(input.nightDifferentialHours, "Night differential hours");
        requireNonNegative(input.riceSubsidy, "Rice subsidy");
        requireNonNegative(input.phoneAllowance, "Phone allowance");
        requireNonNegative(input.clothingAllowance, "Clothing allowance");
        requireNonNegative(input.taxableAllowance, "Taxable allowance");
        requireNonNegative(input.otherDeductions, "Other deductions");
        requireNonNegative(input.overtimeRatePercent, "Overtime rate");
        requireNonNegative(input.nightDifferentialRatePercent, "Night differential rate");
        PayrollRuleset.Period period = PayrollRuleset.Period.parse(input.payPeriod);
        if (period == PayrollRuleset.Period.SEMI_MONTHLY) {
            // 10 days is the semi-monthly ceiling at a 20-day month.
            if (input.daysWorked.compareTo(new BigDecimal("10")) > 0) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Days worked cannot exceed 10 in a semi-monthly period.");
            }
        }
        requireIsoDate(input.periodStart, "Period start");
        requireIsoDate(input.periodEnd, "Period end");
        if (input.periodStart.compareTo(input.periodEnd) > 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Period start must be on or before period end.");
        }
    }

    private static void requireNonNegative(BigDecimal value, String field) {
        if (value != null && Money.isNegative(value)) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must not be negative.");
    }

    private static void requireIsoDate(String value, String field) {
        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " is required.");
        try {
            LocalDate parsed = LocalDate.parse(value.trim());
            if (!parsed.toString().equals(value.trim())) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must be YYYY-MM-DD.");
        } catch (java.time.format.DateTimeParseException ex) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must be YYYY-MM-DD.");
        }
    }
}

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Effective-dated statutory ruleset. Every rate here is either published by the agency
 * or derived from the supplied MotorPH payslip, which acts as the controlling golden case.
 *
 * Verification anchor (MotorPH payslip 15-2026-01-15, employee 15, monthly basic 53,500):
 *   SSS employee 1,750.00 ; PhilHealth 1,337.50 ; Pag-IBIG 200.00 ;
 *   taxable 50,212.50 ; withholding 5,250.83 ; total deductions 8,538.33 ; net 22,711.67.
 * Those seven figures reproduce exactly under the rules below.
 */
public final class PayrollRuleset {

    public enum Period {
        MONTHLY(1),
        SEMI_MONTHLY(2);

        private final int periodsPerMonth;
        Period(int periodsPerMonth) { this.periodsPerMonth = periodsPerMonth; }
        public int periodsPerMonth() { return periodsPerMonth; }
        public static Period parse(String value) {
            if (value == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Pay period is required.");
            switch (value.trim().toUpperCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).replace('-', '_')) {
                case "MONTHLY": return MONTHLY;
                case "SEMI_MONTHLY": case "SEMIMONTHLY": case "SEMI": return SEMI_MONTHLY;
                default: throw new IllegalArgumentException("Pay period must be Monthly or Semi-monthly.");
            }
        }
    }

    /** One withholding band: tax = base + (taxable - floor) * rate, for taxable above floor. */
    public static final class TaxBracket {
        private final BigDecimal floor;
        private final BigDecimal base;
        private final BigDecimal rate;

        TaxBracket(String floor, String base, String rate) {
            this.floor = new BigDecimal(floor);
            this.base = new BigDecimal(base);
            this.rate = new BigDecimal(rate);
        }

        public BigDecimal floor() { return floor; }
        public BigDecimal base() { return base; }
        public BigDecimal rate() { return rate; }

        public BigDecimal apply(BigDecimal taxable) {
            return Money.round(base.add(taxable.subtract(floor).multiply(rate)));
        }
    }

    /**
     * BIR Annex E (RR 11-2018 as amended by RA 10963).
     *
     * The bracket floors are the annual statutory thresholds divided by 12 (250,000/12 =
     * 20,833.33, 400,000/12 = 33,333.33, and so on). Published tables usually round these to
     * whole pesos, but only the exact twelfths reproduce the supplied MotorPH payslip:
     * 50,212.50 taxable gives 5,250.83, whereas a whole-peso 33,333 floor gives 5,250.90.
     * The two renditions differ by at most a third of a peso at a bracket edge.
     */
    private static final List<TaxBracket> MONTHLY_TAX = Collections.unmodifiableList(Arrays.asList(
        new TaxBracket("20833.33",  "0",           "0.15"),
        new TaxBracket("33333.33",  "1875.00",     "0.20"),
        new TaxBracket("66666.67",  "8541.80",     "0.25"),
        new TaxBracket("166666.67", "33541.80",    "0.30"),
        new TaxBracket("666666.67", "183541.80",   "0.35")
    ));

    /**
     * Annex E semi-monthly. This is its own published table with its own floors and bases; it
     * is not the monthly table halved. Floors are likewise the annual thresholds over 24.
     */
    private static final List<TaxBracket> SEMI_MONTHLY_TAX = Collections.unmodifiableList(Arrays.asList(
        new TaxBracket("10416.67",  "0",           "0.15"),
        new TaxBracket("16666.67",  "937.50",      "0.20"),
        new TaxBracket("33333.33",  "4270.70",     "0.25"),
        new TaxBracket("83333.33",  "16770.70",    "0.30"),
        new TaxBracket("333333.33", "91770.70",    "0.35")
    ));

    private final String id;
    private final String effectiveFrom;
    private final String effectiveTo;
    private final BigDecimal sssEmployeeRate;
    private final BigDecimal sssEmployerRate;
    private final BigDecimal sssMinMsc;
    private final BigDecimal sssMaxMsc;
    private final BigDecimal sssMscStep;
    private final BigDecimal sssEcLow;
    private final BigDecimal sssEcHigh;
    private final BigDecimal sssEcThreshold;
    private final BigDecimal sssMpfThreshold;
    private final BigDecimal phRate;
    private final BigDecimal phFloor;
    private final BigDecimal phCeiling;
    private final BigDecimal pagibigMaxFund;
    private final BigDecimal pagibigLowThreshold;
    private final BigDecimal pagibigEmployeeLow;
    private final BigDecimal pagibigEmployeeHigh;
    private final BigDecimal pagibigEmployerRate;

    private PayrollRuleset(int year) {
        this.id = "PH-STATUTORY-" + year;
        this.effectiveFrom = year + "-01-01";
        this.effectiveTo = year + "-12-31";
        // SSS Circular 2024-006: 15% total, MSC 5,000-35,000 in 500 steps. Unchanged for 2026.
        this.sssEmployeeRate = new BigDecimal("0.05");
        this.sssEmployerRate = new BigDecimal("0.10");
        this.sssMinMsc = new BigDecimal("5000");
        this.sssMaxMsc = new BigDecimal("35000");
        this.sssMscStep = new BigDecimal("500");
        this.sssEcLow = new BigDecimal("10.00");
        this.sssEcHigh = new BigDecimal("30.00");
        this.sssEcThreshold = new BigDecimal("15000");
        this.sssMpfThreshold = new BigDecimal("20000");
        // PhilHealth: 5% of monthly basic, floor 10,000, ceiling 100,000, split evenly.
        this.phRate = new BigDecimal("0.05");
        this.phFloor = new BigDecimal("10000");
        this.phCeiling = new BigDecimal("100000");
        // Pag-IBIG: max fund salary 10,000; employee 1% at or below 1,500 else 2%; employer 2%.
        this.pagibigMaxFund = new BigDecimal("10000");
        this.pagibigLowThreshold = new BigDecimal("1500");
        this.pagibigEmployeeLow = new BigDecimal("0.01");
        this.pagibigEmployeeHigh = new BigDecimal("0.02");
        this.pagibigEmployerRate = new BigDecimal("0.02");
    }

    private static final PayrollRuleset Y2026 = new PayrollRuleset(2026);
    private static final PayrollRuleset Y2025 = new PayrollRuleset(2025);

    public static PayrollRuleset forYear(int year) {
        if (year == 2026) return Y2026;
        if (year == 2025) return Y2025;
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No statutory ruleset is loaded for " + year
            + ". Available: 2025, 2026. Refusing to calculate outside a covered year.");
    }

    public String id() { return id; }
    public String effectiveFrom() { return effectiveFrom; }
    public String effectiveTo() { return effectiveTo; }
    public BigDecimal sssEmployeeRate() { return sssEmployeeRate; }
    public BigDecimal sssEmployerRate() { return sssEmployerRate; }
    public BigDecimal sssMinMsc() { return sssMinMsc; }
    public BigDecimal sssMaxMsc() { return sssMaxMsc; }

public List<TaxBracket> taxBrackets(Period period) {
        List<TaxBracket> source = period == Period.SEMI_MONTHLY ? SEMI_MONTHLY_TAX : MONTHLY_TAX;
        return new ArrayList<>(source);
    }

    /**
     * Withholding for one period. Bands are cumulative over the period's own table, so the
     * caller passes the taxable amount for that period, not an annualised figure.
     */
    public BigDecimal withholding(BigDecimal taxablePeriod, Period period) {
        if (Money.isNegative(taxablePeriod)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Taxable amount must not be negative.");
        TaxBracket chosen = null;
        for (TaxBracket bracket : taxBrackets(period)) {
            if (taxablePeriod.compareTo(bracket.floor()) > 0) chosen = bracket;
        }
        return chosen == null ? Money.ZERO : chosen.apply(taxablePeriod);
    }

    /** Employee share quoted for a payslip line and for the employer's remittance total. */
    public BigDecimal sssEmployee(BigDecimal monthlyBasic) {
        return Money.round(monthlySalaryCredit(monthlyBasic).multiply(sssEmployeeRate));
    }

    public BigDecimal sssEmployer(BigDecimal monthlyBasic) {
        return Money.round(monthlySalaryCredit(monthlyBasic).multiply(sssEmployerRate));
    }

    public BigDecimal sssEc(BigDecimal monthlyBasic) {
        BigDecimal msc = monthlySalaryCredit(monthlyBasic);
        return msc.compareTo(sssEcThreshold()) >= 0 ? sssEcHigh : sssEcLow;
    }

    /** Salary credit rounded up to the next 500 step, then clamped to the published floor and ceiling. */
    public BigDecimal monthlySalaryCredit(BigDecimal monthlyBasic) {
        if (Money.isNegative(monthlyBasic)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Monthly basic pay must not be negative.");
        BigDecimal clamped = Money.min(Money.max(monthlyBasic, sssMinMsc), sssMaxMsc);
        BigDecimal divided = clamped.divide(sssMscStep, 0, java.math.RoundingMode.CEILING);
        BigDecimal rounded = divided.multiply(sssMscStep);
        return Money.min(Money.max(rounded, sssMinMsc), sssMaxMsc);
    }

    public BigDecimal philHealthTotal(BigDecimal monthlyBasic) {
        BigDecimal base = Money.min(Money.max(monthlyBasic, phFloor), phCeiling);
        return Money.round(base.multiply(phRate));
    }

    public BigDecimal philHealthEmployee(BigDecimal monthlyBasic) {
        return Money.round(philHealthTotal(monthlyBasic).divide(new BigDecimal("2"), 4, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP));
    }

    public BigDecimal philHealthEmployer(BigDecimal monthlyBasic) {
        return Money.round(philHealthTotal(monthlyBasic).subtract(philHealthEmployee(monthlyBasic)));
    }

    public BigDecimal pagibigEmployee(BigDecimal monthlyBasic) {
        BigDecimal fund = Money.min(Money.max(monthlyBasic, Money.ZERO), pagibigMaxFund);
        BigDecimal rate = fund.compareTo(pagibigLowThreshold) <= 0 ? pagibigEmployeeLow : pagibigEmployeeHigh;
        return Money.round(fund.multiply(rate));
    }

    public BigDecimal pagibigEmployer(BigDecimal monthlyBasic) {
        BigDecimal fund = Money.min(Money.max(monthlyBasic, Money.ZERO), pagibigMaxFund);
        return Money.round(fund.multiply(pagibigEmployerRate));
    }
}

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.LocalTime;

/**
 * Time-to-hours conversion for one timecard row.
 *
 * The supplied MotorPH timecard is the reference: 08:00 AM, break out 12:00 PM, break in
 * 01:00 PM, out 05:00 PM is reported as 8 hrs. That is (out - in) minus (break in - break out):
 * nine hours elapsed less one unpaid meal hour. Standard time uses the same rule, which is why
 * an 08:00-17:00 row with no break recorded is 9 hours, not 8.
 */
public final class WorkedTime {
    private WorkedTime() { }

    public static BigDecimal hoursBetween(LocalTime in, LocalTime breakOut, LocalTime breakIn, LocalTime out) {
        long minutes = Duration.between(in, out).toMinutes();
        if (minutes < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("time out must not precede time in");
        if (breakOut != null && breakIn != null) {
            long breakMinutes = Duration.between(breakOut, breakIn).toMinutes();
            if (breakMinutes < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("break in must not precede break out");
            minutes -= breakMinutes;
        }
        if (minutes < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("the meal break is longer than the time at work");
        return BigDecimal.valueOf(minutes).divide(new BigDecimal("60"), 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }

    /** Whole minutes, for arithmetic that must not round twice. */
    public static long minutesBetween(LocalTime in, LocalTime breakOut, LocalTime breakIn, LocalTime out) {
        long minutes = Duration.between(in, out).toMinutes();
        if (breakOut != null && breakIn != null) minutes -= Duration.between(breakOut, breakIn).toMinutes();
        return minutes;
    }
}
package ph.motorph.web;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
import java.util.OptionalInt;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/** Reads raw attendance for one employee; deliberately does not calculate paid hours. */
public final class AttendanceService {
    private final EmployeeService employeeService;
    private final EmployeeScheduleStore scheduleStore;
    private final AttendanceStore attendanceStore;

    public AttendanceService(EmployeeService employeeService, EmployeeScheduleStore scheduleStore,
                             AttendanceStore attendanceStore) {
        if (employeeService == null || scheduleStore == null || attendanceStore == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("attendance service dependencies must not be null");
        }
        this.employeeService = employeeService;
        this.scheduleStore = scheduleStore;
        this.attendanceStore = attendanceStore;
    }

    /** Inclusive optional date filtering; no pay-period calendar is inferred. */
    public List<AttendanceRecord> findForEmployee(String employeeId, LocalDate from, LocalDate to) {
        if (!employeeService.findEmployee(employeeId).isPresent()) {
            throw new NoSuchElementException("employee not found");
        }
        validateRange(from, to);
        OptionalInt scheduleId = scheduleStore.findScheduleIdForEmployee(employeeId.trim());
        if (!scheduleId.isPresent()) return java.util.Collections.emptyList();
        return attendanceStore.findByScheduleId(scheduleId.getAsInt()).stream()
            .filter(record -> from == null || !record.getDate().isBefore(from))
            .filter(record -> to == null || !record.getDate().isAfter(to))
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    /** Counts raw rows and their date coverage; this never classifies attendance or derives hours. */
    public List<RawAttendanceSummary> summarizeRawRecords(LocalDate from, LocalDate to) {
        validateRange(from, to);
        List<AttendanceRecord> allRecords = attendanceStore.findAll();
        List<RawAttendanceSummary> summaries = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Employee employee : employeeService.listEmployees()) {
            OptionalInt schedule = scheduleStore.findScheduleIdForEmployee(employee.getId());
            if (!schedule.isPresent()) {
                summaries.add(new RawAttendanceSummary(employee.getId(), employee.getName(), null, 0, "", ""));
                continue;
            }
            List<AttendanceRecord> matched = allRecords.stream()
                .filter(record -> record.getScheduleId() == schedule.getAsInt())
                .filter(record -> from == null || !record.getDate().isBefore(from))
                .filter(record -> to == null || !record.getDate().isAfter(to))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
            String firstDate = matched.stream().map(record -> record.getDate().toString()).min(String::compareTo).orElse("");
            String lastDate = matched.stream().map(record -> record.getDate().toString()).max(String::compareTo).orElse("");
            summaries.add(new RawAttendanceSummary(employee.getId(), employee.getName(), schedule.getAsInt(),
                matched.size(), firstDate, lastDate));
        }
        summaries.sort(Comparator.comparing(RawAttendanceSummary::getEmployeeId));
        return summaries;
    }

    private static void validateRange(LocalDate from, LocalDate to) {
        if (from != null && to != null && from.isAfter(to)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("from date must be on or before to date");
        }
    }
}
package ph.motorph.web;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Exact-decimal money helper. Every payroll amount passes through here so rounding
 * happens in exactly one place. Firestore has no decimal type, so amounts are stored
 * as plain decimal strings and parsed back into BigDecimal.
 */
public final class Money {
    public static final BigDecimal ZERO = new BigDecimal("0.00");
    private static final BigDecimal HUNDRED = new BigDecimal("100");

    private Money() { }

    /** Two-decimal, half-up: the convention that reproduces the supplied MotorPH payslip. */
    public static BigDecimal round(BigDecimal value) {
        if (value == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("amount must not be null");
        return value.setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }

    /** Parse a user/CSV amount, tolerating currency marks, spaces and thousands separators. */
    public static BigDecimal parse(String raw) {
        if (raw == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("amount must not be null");
        String cleaned = raw.replace('\u20B1', ' ').replace(",", "").replace("\u00A0", " ").trim();
        if (cleaned.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("amount must not be blank");
        try {
            return round(new BigDecimal(cleaned));
        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Not a valid amount: " + raw.trim());
        }
    }

    /** Parse, treating blank as zero; used for optional allowance columns. */
    public static BigDecimal parseOrZero(String raw) {
        return raw == null || raw.trim().isEmpty() ? ZERO : parse(raw);
    }

    public static BigDecimal of(String value) {
        return round(new BigDecimal(value));
    }

    public static BigDecimal percentOf(BigDecimal base, String percent) {
        return round(base.multiply(new BigDecimal(percent)).divide(HUNDRED, 10, RoundingMode.HALF_UP));
    }

    public static BigDecimal min(BigDecimal a, BigDecimal b) { return a.compareTo(b) <= 0 ? a : b; }
    public static BigDecimal max(BigDecimal a, BigDecimal b) { return a.compareTo(b) >= 0 ? a : b; }

    public static boolean isNegative(BigDecimal value) { return value.compareTo(BigDecimal.ZERO) < 0; }

    /** Thousands-separated two-decimal text for display only; stored and compared values stay BigDecimal. */
    public static String format(BigDecimal value) {
        return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%,.2f", round(value));
    }
}

function isValidDate(value) {
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) return false;
  const date = new Date(`${value}T00:00:00.000Z`);
  return !Number.isNaN(date.valueOf()) && date.toISOString().slice(0, 10) === value;
}

  return text;
}

  const date = value instanceof Date ? value : new Date(`${value}T00:00:00.000Z`);

async function fetchSandboxSnapshot() {
  const headers = await apiHeaders();
  const [healthResponse, employeesResponse, workflowsResponse] = await Promise.all([
    fetch('/api/health', { headers }),
    fetch('/api/employees', { headers }),
    fetch('/api/workflows', { headers })
  ]);
  const [health, employeePayload, workflowPayload] = await Promise.all([
    healthResponse.json(), employeesResponse.json(), workflowsResponse.json()
  ]);
  for (const [response, payload, label] of [
    [healthResponse, health, 'Health'],
    [employeesResponse, employeePayload, 'Employee'],
    [workflowsResponse, workflowPayload, 'Workflow']
  ]) {
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload.error || `${label} request failed (${response.status})`);
  }
  if (!Array.isArray(employeePayload.items)) throw new Error('Unexpected employee response.');
  const attendancePairs = await Promise.all(employeePayload.items.map(async employee => {
    const response = await fetch(`/api/attendance?employeeId=${encodeURIComponent(employee.id)}`, { headers });
    const payload = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload.error || `Attendance request failed (${response.status})`);
    return [employee.id, Array.isArray(payload.items) ? payload.items : []];
  }));
  return {
    mode: health.mode || 'unknown',
    employees: employeePayload.items,
    leaveRequests: Array.isArray(workflowPayload.leaveRequests) ? workflowPayload.leaveRequests : [],
    tickets: Array.isArray(workflowPayload.tickets) ? workflowPayload.tickets : [],
    attendanceByEmployee: Object.fromEntries(attendancePairs)
  };
}

async function loadEmployees() {
  const requestNumber = ++state.requestNumber;
  const query = search.value.trim();
  showTableMessage('Loading employee records…');
  resultCount.textContent = 'Loading';
  try {
    const url = query ? `/api/employees?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}` : '/api/employees';
    const response = await fetch(url, { headers: await apiHeaders() });
    const payload = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload.error || `Request failed (${response.status})`);
    if (!payload || !Array.isArray(payload.items)) throw new Error('Unexpected employee response');
    if (requestNumber !== state.requestNumber) return;
    state.employees = payload.items;
    state.totalEmployees = Number.isInteger(payload.total) ? payload.total : payload.items.length;
    if (!query) {
      state.allEmployees = payload.items;
      populateAttendanceEmployees();
      populateWorkflowEmployees();
      populatePayrollEmployees();
      renderDirectoryViews();
    }
    seedDemoButton.hidden = !(state.user && !query);
    renderEmployees();
  } catch (error) {
    if (requestNumber !== state.requestNumber) return;
    state.employees = [];
    state.allEmployees = [];
    seedDemoButton.hidden = true;
    populateAttendanceEmployees();
    populateWorkflowEmployees();
    renderDirectoryViews();
    renderEmployees();
    showTableMessage(error.message || 'Could not reach the Java service. Check that the prototype server is running, then refresh.');
    resultCount.textContent = 'Could not load records';
  }
}

async function seedSyntheticDemoData() {
  seedDemoButton.disabled = true;
  seedDemoButton.textContent = 'Adding missing fixtures…';
  try {
    const response = await fetch('/api/demo/seed', { method: 'POST', headers: await apiHeaders() });
    const payload = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload.error || `Request failed (${response.status})`);
    resultCount.textContent = `${payload.employeesCreated} employees, ${payload.scheduleMappingsCreated} schedule links, and ${payload.attendanceCreated} attendance rows added`;
    await loadEmployees();
  } catch (error) {
    showTableMessage(error.message || 'Could not write the synthetic demo records.');
    resultCount.textContent = 'Demo setup failed';
  } finally {
    seedDemoButton.disabled = false;
    seedDemoButton.textContent = 'Add missing synthetic fixtures';
  }
}

function populatePayrollEmployees() {
  const select = document.getElementById('payroll-employee');
  if (!select) return;
  const previous = select.value;
  select.replaceChildren();
  const withPay = state.allEmployees.filter(employee => employee.monthlyBasic);
  state.payrollEmployees = withPay;
  if (!withPay.length) {
    const option = document.createElement('option');
    option.value = '';
    option.textContent = state.allEmployees.length ? 'No stored salary records yet' : 'Load the directory first';
    select.append(option);
    return;
  }
  withPay.forEach(employee => {
    const option = document.createElement('option');
    option.value = employee.id;
    option.textContent = `${employee.id} — ${employee.name}`;
    select.append(option);
  });
  if (withPay.some(employee => employee.id === previous)) select.value = previous;
  applyPayrollEmployee();
}

/** Loads the selected employee's salary into the form so every run starts from stored data. */
function applyPayrollEmployee() {
  const employeeId = document.getElementById('payroll-employee').value;
  const employee = state.payrollEmployees.find(item => item.id === employeeId);
  const status = document.getElementById('payroll-status');
  if (!employee) {
    document.getElementById('payroll-days').value = '';
    status.textContent = 'Add a monthly basic pay to an employee record before running payroll.';
    return;
  }
  document.getElementById('payroll-days').value = document.getElementById('payroll-days').value || '10';
  status.textContent = `${employee.name}: monthly basic ${formatAmount(employee.monthlyBasic)}, `
    + `rice ${formatAmount(employee.riceSubsidy)}, phone ${formatAmount(employee.phoneAllowance)}, `
    + `clothing ${formatAmount(employee.clothingAllowance)}.`;
}

}

async function useStoredTimesheet() {
  const employeeId = document.getElementById('payroll-employee').value;
  const from = document.getElementById('payroll-start').value;
  const to = document.getElementById('payroll-end').value;
  if (!employeeId || !from || !to) {
    setWorkflowStatus('payroll-status', 'Choose an employee and a period start and end first.', true);
    return;
  }
  try {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ employeeId, from, to });
    const response = await fetch(`/api/payroll/timesheet?${params.toString()}`, { headers: await apiHeaders() });
    const payload = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload.error || `Request failed (${response.status})`);
    document.getElementById('payroll-days').value = String(payload.daysWorked);
    const hours = formatAmount(payload.totalHours);
    setWorkflowStatus('payroll-status', payload.daysWorked
      ? `Stored timecard: ${payload.daysWorked} day(s), ${hours} paid hours. Days worked filled in; hours are informational only.`
      : 'No stored timecard rows with positive hours in this period; days worked left at 0.');
  } catch (error) {
    setWorkflowStatus('payroll-status', error.message || 'Could not load the stored timesheet.', true);
  }
}

function exportPayslip() {
  const slip = state.currentPayslip;
  const status = document.getElementById('payslip-export-status');
  if (!slip) {
    status.textContent = 'Compute a payslip first.';
    return;
  }
  try {
    const rows = payslipCsvRows([slip]);
    const name = `motorph-payslip-${String(slip.employeeId).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9._-]/g, '_')}-${slip.periodEnd}.csv`;
    downloadCsvFile(name, payslipCsvColumns(), rows);
    status.textContent = `Exported one payslip row for ${slip.employeeName || slip.employeeId}; amounts are stored values, not recalculated.`;
  } catch (error) {
    status.textContent = `Export failed: ${error.message || 'unknown error'}`;
  }
}

FUNCTION start(host, port):
    server ← HttpServer.create(host, port)
    server.context("/api/health",            handleHealth)
    server.context("/api/employees",         handleEmployees)        # list, detail, create, update
    server.context("/api/attendance",        handleAttendance)       # read only

    server.context("/api/demo/seed",         handleSeedDemo)
    server.context("/",                      handleStaticFiles)      # last = catch-all
    server.start() → server

[NODE 8791]

FUNCTION firestoreClientFor(exchange):
    auth ← header Authorization
    uid  ← header X-Firebase-UID
    IF auth does not start with "Bearer " OR uid blank:
        fail(401, "Sign in with your Firebase account to continue.")
    token ← auth after "Bearer "
    IF token longer than 8192 chars OR uid longer than 128 OR uid contains "/":
        fail(401, "Invalid Firebase session information.")          # path-injection guard
    return new FirestoreRestClient(projectId, uid, token[, apiRoot])

[NODE 8861]
text
FUNCTION readJsonBody(exchange):
    IF Content-Type is not application/json: fail(415, "Content-Type must be application/json.")
    bytes ← first 8193 bytes of body
    IF bytes > 8192:                          fail(413, "Request body is too large.")
    parse; IF not an object:                  fail(400, "JSON body must be an object.")
    IF parse error:                           fail(400, "Request body is not valid JSON.")
    → JsonObject

FUNCTION requireOnlyKeys(body, allowed):
    FOR each key in body: IF key not in allowed: fail(400, "Unexpected request field: " + key)
    # Unknown fields are rejected, never ignored — a typo in a money field cannot pass silently.

FUNCTION numberOr(body, field, fallback):     # accepts JSON number OR decimal string
    missing/null → fallback
    → BigDecimal(text of value)               # one parsing rule for the whole API

FUNCTION sendApiError(exchange, FirestoreException):
    map Firestore status → HTTP (401 unauthenticated, 403 permission, 404, 409, 429, 503…)
    body: {"error": "<firestore message>"}

FUNCTION sendJson(exchange, status, json):
    headers: Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
             X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
             Cache-Control: no-store
             Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'   # API responses are data, not documents
    write body

FUNCTION handleStaticFiles(exchange):
    resolve requested path against webRoot, normalise
    IF resolved path is outside webRoot:  fail(404)        # ../ traversal blocked
    serve file with the right content type, or index.html for the SPA routes
    headers: nosniff, frame-ancestors, referrer-policy, a restrictive CSP

[NODE 8864]
Two interfaces per concern. One implementation talks to Firestore, one to an array in memory. The
services only ever see the interface, which is why the whole product is testable with no emulator.

[NODE 8868]
MutableEmployeeStore is separate from EmployeeStore on purpose: a read-only store (any future
export or projection) can implement the read interface and EmployeeService will refuse writes with
IllegalStateException("This employee store is read-only.") instead of half-working.

[NODE 8874]
text
CONSTRUCTOR(projectId, uid, idToken[, apiRoot]):
    validate projectId and uid are safe single path segments
    IF idToken blank: THROW "Firebase sign-in is required"
    normalise apiRoot to end with "/"

FUNCTION listDocuments(collectionPath):                 # paged, follows nextPageToken
    documents ← []
    LOOP:
        url ← documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "?pageSize=1000" + pageToken
        response ← send("GET", url)
        append response.documents to documents
        pageToken ← response.nextPageToken or ""
    UNTIL pageToken empty
    → documents

FUNCTION createDocument(collectionPath, documentId, fields):
    url ← documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "?documentId=" + urlencode(documentId)
    → send("POST", url, {fields}, allowExisting=true).has("name")     # false = ALREADY_EXISTS

FUNCTION updateDocument(collectionPath, documentId, fields, updateMask):
    url ← …/{documentId} + "?updateMask.fieldPaths=" + each field
    → send("PATCH", url, {fields}).has("name")

FUNCTION send(method, url, body, allowExisting):
    request with Authorization: Bearer <idToken>, Accept: application/json,
            Content-Type when there is a body, 20 s timeout
    IF response 2xx → parse JSON (or {} when empty)
    IF allowExisting AND (409 or 400 with ALREADY_EXISTS) → {}          # idempotent create
    ELSE → firestoreError(status, body)                                 # becomes HTTP status
    network error / interrupted → FirestoreException(503, "Could not reach Firestore…")

FUNCTION documentsUrl(collectionPath):
    apiRoot + urlencode(projectId) + "/databases/(default)/documents"
      + "/" + urlencode(each segment of collectionPath)

FUNCTION userCollection(name):
    → "users/" + uid + "/" + name           # ← every collection goes through this

[NODE 8881]
text
FUNCTION FirestoreEmployeeStore.findAll():
    → listDocuments("users/{uid}/demoEmployees").map(fromDocument)

FUNCTION FirestoreEmployeeStore.fromDocument(doc):
    fields ← doc.fields or {}
    id, name, department, role, location, status ← stringValue of each
    monthlyBasic, riceSubsidy, phoneAllowance, clothingAllowance ←
        amountOrNull(...)                  # absent field → null, NOT zero (see §6.4)

FUNCTION FirestoreEmployeeStore.create(e):
    createDocument(collection, e.id, employeeFields(e)); on false → 409 "ID already exists"

FUNCTION employeeFields(e):
    six string fields, plus the four pay fields as decimal STRINGS when a pay profile exists
    # Firestore has no decimal type; strings keep centavo precision exact.

FUNCTION FirestoreAttendanceStore.fromDocument(doc):
    attendanceId, scheduleId ← integerValue
    date, timeIn, breakOut, breakIn, timeOut ← stringValue (break punches optional)
    hoursWorked ← decimal string → BigDecimal
    dayType ← stringValue, default "DEMO"

FUNCTION FirestorePayrollStore.runFields(run):
    payPeriod, periodStart, periodEnd, rulesetId, taxBasis, statutoryBasis, createdAt (strings)
    payslips ← arrayValue[ {PayslipJson.toJson(slip)} … ]      # the whole computed slip

FUNCTION FirestorePayrollStore.fromDocument(doc):
    read header strings
    read payslips[].arrayValue.values[] → PayslipJson.fromJson
    IF no payslips: THROW "Stored payroll run <id> has no payslips."     # refuse a broken snapshot
    → PayrollRun
    # No recalculation anywhere in this function. A reprint is a read.

FUNCTION FirestorePayrollStore.findById(id):
    → findAll().first(run.id == id)         # small collection, one read, no index needed

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
import java.util.UUID;

/** Validates and coordinates safe, non-payroll workflow demonstrations. */
public final class WorkflowService {
    private static final int MAX_TEXT_LENGTH = 240;
    private static final List<String> LEAVE_TYPES = Collections.unmodifiableList(
        Arrays.asList("Vacation", "Medical", "Personal", "Unpaid"));
    private static final Map<String, String> TICKET_QUEUES;
    static {
        Map<String, String> queues = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        queues.put("Overtime request", "Team Lead");
        queues.put("Leave request", "Team Lead");
        queues.put("Timesheet correction", "Team Lead");
        queues.put("Payroll inquiry", "Payroll Staff");
        queues.put("HR inquiry", "HR");
        queues.put("Technical support", "IT Admin");
        TICKET_QUEUES = Collections.unmodifiableMap(queues);
    }

    private final EmployeeService employeeService;
    private final WorkflowStore store;

    public WorkflowService(EmployeeService employeeService, WorkflowStore store) {
        if (employeeService == null || store == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("workflow dependencies must not be null");
        this.employeeService = employeeService;
        this.store = store;
    }

    public List<DemoLeaveRequest> listLeaveRequests() { return store.listLeaveRequests(); }
    public List<DemoTicket> listTickets() { return store.listTickets(); }

    public DemoLeaveRequest createLeaveRequest(String employeeId, String leaveType,
            String startDate, String endDate, String note) {
        Employee employee = requireEmployee(employeeId);
        if (!LEAVE_TYPES.contains(leaveType)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Choose a valid leave type.");
        LocalDate start = parseDate(startDate, "start date");
        LocalDate end = parseDate(endDate, "end date");
        if (start.isAfter(end)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("The start date must be on or before the end date.");
        String safeNote = optionalText(note, "Note");
        String id = "LV-" + randomSuffix();
        return store.createLeaveRequest(new DemoLeaveRequest(id, employee.getId(), employee.getName(), leaveType,
            start.toString(), end.toString(), safeNote, "Pending review", Instant.now().toString(), ""));
    }

    public DemoLeaveRequest cancelLeaveRequest(String id) {
        requireId(id, "LV-");
        return store.cancelLeaveRequest(id, Instant.now().toString());
    }
=== ticket create ===
    }

    public DemoTicket createTicket(String employeeId, String ticketType, String summary) {
        Employee employee = requireEmployee(employeeId);
        String queue = TICKET_QUEUES.get(ticketType);
        if (queue == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Choose a valid ticket type.");
        String safeSummary = requiredText(summary, "Message");
        String id = "TK-" + randomSuffix();
        return store.createTicket(new DemoTicket(id, employee.getId(), employee.getName(), ticketType, queue,
            safeSummary, "Open", Instant.now().toString(), ""));
    }

    public DemoTicket cancelTicket(String id) {
        requireId(id, "TK-");
        return store.cancelTicket(id, Instant.now().toString());
    }

    private Employee requireEmployee(String employeeId) {
        String id = requiredText(employeeId, "Employee ID");
        return employeeService.findEmployee(id).orElseThrow(() ->
            new NoSuchElementException("Choose an employee from your synthetic demo directory."));
    }

    private static LocalDate parseDate(String value, String field) {
        String text = requiredText(value, field);
        try {
            LocalDate date = LocalDate.parse(text);
            if (!date.toString().equals(text)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Enter a valid YYYY-MM-DD " + field + ".");
            return date;
        } catch (DateTimeParseException ex) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Enter a valid YYYY-MM-DD " + field + ".");
        }
    }

    private static String requiredText(String value, String field) {
        String text = value == null ? "" : value.trim();
        if (text.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " is required.");
        if (text.length() > MAX_TEXT_LENGTH) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must be " + MAX_TEXT_LENGTH + " characters or fewer.");
        return text;
    }

    private static String optionalText(String value, String field) {
        String text = value == null ? "" : value.trim();
        if (text.length() > MAX_TEXT_LENGTH) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must be " + MAX_TEXT_LENGTH + " characters or fewer.");
        return text;
    }

    private static String randomSuffix() {
        return UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "").substring(0, 12).toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    private static void requireId(String id, String prefix) {
        if (id == null || !id.matches(prefix + "[A-F0-9]{12}")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Workflow record ID is invalid.");
    }
}

$ cd /home/user/motorph-ms2 && cat >> docs/full-pseudocode-inventory.md <<'MARKDOWN' --- ## 5. Primitives ### 5.1 `Money` — every centavo in the system passes through here ``` round(value) → value.setScale(2, HALF_UP) # one rounding rule, one place parse("₱ 53,500.00") → strips ₱, commas, nbsp → BigDecimal("53500.00") parseOrZero(null | "") → 0.00 of("2675") → 2675.00 percentOf(base, "125") → round(base × 125 / 100) min(a,b) / max(a,b) # BigDecimal comparison, never double isNegative(v) → v < 0 format(v) → "26,750.00" # display only; never parsed back ``` **Rule enforced everywhere:** floats are never used for money. Firestore stores decimal strings, Java keeps `BigDecimal`, and the browser only formats strings it was handed. ### 5.2 `WorkedTime` — one timecard row → hours ``` FUNCTION hoursBetween(in, breakOut, breakIn, out): minutes ← out − in IF minutes < 0: fail "time out must not precede time in" IF both break punches present: breakMinutes ← breakIn − breakOut IF breakMinutes < 0: fail "break in must not precede break out" minutes ← minutes − breakMinutes IF minutes < 0: fail "the meal break is longer than the time at work" → round(minutes / 60, 2) FUNCTION minutesBetween(...): same, whole minutes, no rounding (for chained arithmetic) ``` The supplied MotorPH timecard is the reference: `08:00 / 12:00 / 13:00 / 17:00` → 9 hours elapsed minus a 1-hour meal = **8.00**. Consequence, stated openly: a row with **no** break punches returns **9.00**, because the app cannot invent a lunch break that was never punched. `TimesheetServiceTest` pins both cases. ### 5.3 `PayrollRuleset` — the statutory tables, effective-dated ``` CONSTRUCTOR(year): id ← "PH-STATUTORY-" + year effectiveFrom ← year + "-01-01"; effectiveTo ← year + "-12-31" SSS employee 5%, employer 10%, MSC 5,000–35,000 step 500, EC 10.00 below MSC 15,000 else 30.00, MPF above MSC 20,000 PhilHealth 5% of basic, floor 10,000, ceiling 100,000, split 50/50 Pag-IBIG fund capped at 10,000; employee 1% at ≤1,500 else 2%; employer 2% forYear(2026) → Y2026 ; forYear(2025) → Y2025 forYear(anything else) → THROW "No statutory ruleset is loaded for <year>…" # Refusing is the feature: the app will not borrow a neighbouring year's table. ``` **Contribution subfunctions** — each takes the *monthly* basic: ``` monthlySalaryCredit(basic): # SSS salary credit clamped ← min(max(basic, 5,000), 35,000) rounded ← ceiling(clamped / 500) × 500 # round UP to the next ₱500 step → min(max(rounded, 5,000), 35,000) sssEmployee(basic) → round(MSC × 0.05) sssEmployer(basic) → round(MSC × 0.10) sssEc(basic) → MSC ≥ 15,000 ? 30.00 : 10.00 philHealthTotal(basic): base ← min(max(basic, 10,000), 100,000) → round(base × 0.05) philHealthEmployee(basic) → round(total / 2) philHealthEmployer(basic) → round(total − employee) # they always sum to the total pagibigEmployee(basic): fund ← min(max(basic, 0), 10,000) → round(fund × (fund ≤ 1,500 ? 0.01 : 0.02)) pagibigEmployer(basic): fund ← min(max(basic, 0), 10,000) → round(fund × 0.02) ``` **Withholding** — BIR Annex E, two separate tables: ``` MONTHLY table floor base rate 20,833.33 0.00 15% 33,333.33 1,875.00 20% 66,666.67 8,541.80 25% 166,666.67 33,541.80 30% 666,666.67 183,541.80 35% SEMI_MONTHLY table floor base rate 10,416.67 0.00 15% 16,666.67 937.50 20% 33,333.33 4,270.70 25% 83,333.33 16,770.70 30% 333,333.33 91,770.70 35% FUNCTION withholding(taxable, period): chosen ← the LAST bracket whose floor is strictly below taxable # walk the table upward IF none: → 0.00 → round(bracket.base + (taxable − bracket.floor) × bracket.rate) FUNCTION TaxBracket.apply(taxable): → round(base + (taxable − floor) × rate) ``` The semi-monthly table is **not** the monthly table halved — it is its own published table with its own bases. The floors are the annual statutory thresholds divided by 12 (or 24), carried to the centavo: 400,000 / 12 = 33,333.33, not 33,333. Only the exact twelfths reproduce the supplied payslip (5,250.83 rather than 5,250.90). See `docs/payroll-ruleset-and-golden-case.md` §3. `Period.parse("semi-monthly" | "SEMIMONTHLY" | "SEMI")` → `SEMI_MONTHLY`; anything else is a `400`. --- ## 6. Employees ### 6.1 `Employee` — the record ``` FIELDS id, name, department, role, location, status, monthlyBasic?, riceSubsidy?, phoneAllowance?, clothingAllowance? CONSTRUCTOR: trims text, rejects blank, rejects negative money, status ∈ {Active, On leave} withPay(basic, rice, phone, clothing) → copy with pay inputs hasPayProfile() → monthlyBasic != null ``` `monthlyBasic` being **nullable** is load-bearing: `null` means "no salary on file", which is different from `0.00` ("salary of zero"). The payroll picker only lists employees with a pay profile, and a Firestore document missing the field reads back as `null`, not zero. ### 6.2 `EmployeeService` — the use cases ``` listEmployees() → store.findAll() findEmployee(id) → store.findById(trimmed id) # never throws; Optional createEmployee(name, dept, role, location, status, [basic, rice, phone, clothing]): store MUST implement MutableEmployeeStore, else 409 "This employee store is read-only." id ← "DEMO-" + 12 random hex chars, UPPERCASE # server-generated; client cannot choose it → store.create(validated(id, name, dept, role, location, status, pay fields…)) updateEmployee(id, name, dept, role, location, status, [basic, rice, phone, clothing]): IF id does not match DEMO-[A-Z0-9]{3,12}: fail 400 "Employee ID is invalid." existing ← findEmployee(id) or 404 basic ← supplied ? supplied : existing.monthlyBasic # omitted = keep, never zero rice ← supplied ? supplied : existing.riceSubsidy phone ← supplied ? supplied : existing.phoneAllowance clothing ← supplied ? supplied : existing.clothingAllowance → store.update(validated(...)) searchEmployees(q): IF q blank → all employees lowercase q; keep employees whose "id name dept role location status" contains it # One searchable string, case-insensitive, across every displayed field. validated(id, name, dept, role, location, status, …): each text field trimmed, non-blank, ≤ 100 chars status must be exactly "Active" or "On leave" ``` ### 6.3 The employee HTTP handler ``` handleEmployees(exchange): path ← /api/employees or /api/employees/{id} services ← servicesFor(exchange) # builds a Firestore client in real mode → 401 if unsigned GET collection: q ← query param "q" items ← q ?
