public final class AccessPolicy {
    public static final String VERSION = "RBAC-2026-11-05-matrix-v1";

    public enum Role {
        EMPLOYEE("Employee"), SUPERVISOR("Supervisor"), PAYROLL("Payroll Staff"), HR("HR"), ADMIN("System Admin");
        public final String label;
        Role(String label) { this.label = label; }
    }

    public enum Scope { NONE, SELF, TEAM, ALL }

    public enum Area { EMPLOYEES, ATTENDANCE, LEAVE, OVERTIME, TICKETS, PAYROLL, REPORTS, STATUTORY, EARNINGS, REMITTANCE, PAY_CHANGES }

    /** The signed-in account. {@code explicit} is false only for unauthenticated legacy calls (see AppServer). */
    public static final class Actor {
        public final String employeeId;
        public final Role role;
        public final boolean explicit;

        public Actor(String employeeId, Role role, boolean explicit) {
            this.employeeId = employeeId;
            this.role = role;
            this.explicit = explicit;
        }
    }

    /** Thrown when the signed-in account may not do something; AppServer answers 403. */
    public static final class AccessDenied extends RuntimeException {
        public AccessDenied(String message) { super(message); }
    }

    private static final Map<String, Role> ROLES;
    private static final Map<String, Role> DEFAULT_ROLES;
    private static final Map<String, String> DEFAULT_SUPERVISORS;
    private static final Map<String, String> SUPERVISOR_OF;
    private static final Map<Role, Map<Area, Scope>> READ;
    static {
        Map<String, Role> roles = new HashMap<>();
        roles.put("DEMO-001", Role.HR);
        roles.put("DEMO-002", Role.PAYROLL);
        roles.put("DEMO-003", Role.SUPERVISOR);
        roles.put("DEMO-004", Role.EMPLOYEE);
        roles.put("DEMO-005", Role.ADMIN);
        // shortcut: process-wide so the System Admin can change roles; a real directory stores the role per account.
        DEFAULT_ROLES = Collections.unmodifiableMap(new HashMap<>(roles));
        ROLES = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>(roles);
        Map<String, String> supervisors = new HashMap<>();
        // One synthetic team: Noa Reyes (Operations Lead) supervises the other staff; the admin has no supervisor.
        supervisors.put("DEMO-001", "DEMO-003");
        supervisors.put("DEMO-002", "DEMO-003");
        supervisors.put("DEMO-004", "DEMO-003");
        // shortcut: process-wide so onboarded people join a team; a real directory stores the reporting line per employee.
        DEFAULT_SUPERVISORS = Collections.unmodifiableMap(new HashMap<>(supervisors));
        SUPERVISOR_OF = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<>(supervisors);

        Map<Role, Map<Area, Scope>> read = new EnumMap<>(Role.class);
        for (Role role : Role.values()) read.put(role, new EnumMap<>(Area.class));
        for (Area area : Area.values()) read.get(Role.ADMIN).put(area, Scope.ALL);
        put(read, Role.HR, Scope.ALL, Area.EMPLOYEES, Area.ATTENDANCE, Area.LEAVE, Area.OVERTIME, Area.TICKETS, Area.PAYROLL, Area.REPORTS,
            Area.EARNINGS, Area.REMITTANCE, Area.PAY_CHANGES);
        put(read, Role.PAYROLL, Scope.ALL, Area.EMPLOYEES, Area.ATTENDANCE, Area.OVERTIME, Area.PAYROLL, Area.REPORTS, Area.STATUTORY,
            Area.EARNINGS, Area.REMITTANCE, Area.PAY_CHANGES);
        put(read, Role.PAYROLL, Scope.TEAM, Area.LEAVE);
        put(read, Role.PAYROLL, Scope.SELF, Area.TICKETS);
        put(read, Role.SUPERVISOR, Scope.TEAM, Area.EMPLOYEES, Area.ATTENDANCE, Area.LEAVE, Area.OVERTIME, Area.TICKETS, Area.PAYROLL, Area.EARNINGS, Area.PAY_CHANGES);
        put(read, Role.EMPLOYEE, Scope.TEAM, Area.EMPLOYEES, Area.LEAVE);
        put(read, Role.EMPLOYEE, Scope.SELF, Area.ATTENDANCE, Area.OVERTIME, Area.TICKETS, Area.PAYROLL);
        READ = read;
    }

    private static void put(Map<Role, Map<Area, Scope>> read, Role role, Scope scope, Area... areas) {
        for (Area area : areas) read.get(role).put(area, scope);
    }

    private AccessPolicy() { }

    /** Accounts without an assigned role (e.g. employees created in the demo) are regular employees. */
    public static Role roleOf(String employeeId) { return ROLES.getOrDefault(employeeId, Role.EMPLOYEE); }

    public static boolean isKnownAccount(String employeeId) { return ROLES.containsKey(employeeId); }

    public static Optional<String> supervisorOf(String employeeId) { return Optional.ofNullable(SUPERVISOR_OF.get(employeeId)); }

    /**
     * System Admin changes someone's role. Guard rails: never your own role; at least one System Admin stays among
     * {@code activeIds}; a supervisor with direct reports keeps the role until the team is reassigned.
     */
    public static synchronized void changeRole(Actor actor, String targetId, Role newRole, java.util.Collection<String> activeIds) {
        if (actor.role != Role.ADMIN) throw new AccessDenied("Only the System Admin changes roles.");
        if (actor.employeeId.equals(targetId)) throw new AccessDenied("Nobody changes their own role.");
        Role current = roleOf(targetId);
...
    public static synchronized void importRoles(Map<String, Role> roles, Map<String, String> supervisors) {
        ROLES.clear();
        ROLES.putAll(roles == null ? DEFAULT_ROLES : roles);
        SUPERVISOR_OF.clear();
        SUPERVISOR_OF.putAll(supervisors == null ? DEFAULT_SUPERVISORS : supervisors);
    }

    public static void requireAdmin(Actor actor) {
        if (actor.role != Role.ADMIN) throw new AccessDenied("Only the System Admin can open system configuration.");
    }

    /** Onboarding puts a new hire on a supervisor's team; the supervisor must hold the Supervisor role. */
    public static void assignSupervisor(String employeeId, String supervisorId) {
        if (roleOf(supervisorId) != Role.SUPERVISOR) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Choose a supervisor (an account with the Supervisor role).");
        SUPERVISOR_OF.put(employeeId, supervisorId);
    }

    public static boolean isDirectReport(String supervisorId, String employeeId) {
        return supervisorId != null && supervisorId.equals(SUPERVISOR_OF.get(employeeId));
    }

    /** Self, direct reports, and (if the person has a supervisor) that supervisor and their other reports. */
    public static Set<String> teamOf(String employeeId) {
        Set<String> team = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        team.add(employeeId);
        Optional<String> lead = supervisorOf(employeeId);
        lead.ifPresent(team::add);
        for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : SUPERVISOR_OF.entrySet()) {
            if (entry.getValue().equals(employeeId) || lead.map(entry.getValue()::equals).orElse(false)) team.add(entry.getKey());
        }
        return team;
    }

    public static Scope readScope(Role role, Area area) { return READ.get(role).getOrDefault(area, Scope.NONE); }

    public static boolean canRead(Actor actor, Area area, String targetEmployeeId) {
        switch (readScope(actor.role, area)) {
            case ALL: return true;
            case TEAM: return targetEmployeeId != null && teamOf(actor.employeeId).contains(targetEmployeeId);
            case SELF: return actor.employeeId.equals(targetEmployeeId);
            default: return false;
        }
    }

    public static void requireRead(Actor actor, Area area, String targetEmployeeId) {
        if (!canRead(actor, area, targetEmployeeId)) {
            throw new AccessDenied(actor.role.label + " accounts cannot view " + area.name().toLowerCase() + " for " + targetEmployeeId + ".");
        }
    }

    /** Areas with no per-person target (reports, statutory preview): only an ALL scope gets in. */
    public static void requireArea(Actor actor, Area area) {
        if (readScope(actor.role, area) != Scope.ALL) {
            throw new AccessDenied(actor.role.label + " accounts cannot open " + area.name().toLowerCase() + ".");
        }
    }

    public static void requireEmployeeEdit(Actor actor) {
        if (actor.role != Role.ADMIN && actor.role != Role.HR) throw new AccessDenied("Only HR or a System Admin can create or edit employee records.");
    }

    public static void requireAttendanceEdit(Actor actor, String targetEmployeeId) {
        boolean allowed = actor.role == Role.ADMIN
            || (actor.role == Role.SUPERVISOR && isDirectReport(actor.employeeId, targetEmployeeId));
        if (!allowed) throw new AccessDenied("Only a System Admin, or the employee's supervisor, can edit attendance.");
    }

    /** Leave, overtime and tickets are filed for yourself; an admin may file for anyone, HR for anyone's leave or ticket. */
    public static void requireCreate(Actor actor, Area area, String targetEmployeeId) {
        boolean allowed = actor.employeeId.equals(targetEmployeeId) || actor.role == Role.ADMIN
            || (actor.role == Role.HR && (area == Area.LEAVE || area == Area.TICKETS));

    public static void requireReview(Actor actor, Area area, String ownerEmployeeId) {

    /** Earnings/deductions entries and disbursement: Payroll Staff or System Admin, never for their own pay. */
    /**
     * One person's earnings and voluntary deductions (RBAC matrix: Earnings/Deductibles R,U for the supervisor's team):
     * Payroll Staff and the System Admin for anyone, a supervisor for their direct reports; never your own pay.
     */
    public static void requireEarningsEdit(Actor actor, String ownerEmployeeId) {
        boolean allowed = actor.role == Role.ADMIN || actor.role == Role.PAYROLL
            || (actor.role == Role.SUPERVISOR && isDirectReport(actor.employeeId, ownerEmployeeId));
        if (!allowed) throw new AccessDenied("Only Payroll Staff, a System Admin, or the employee's supervisor can change their earnings and deductions.");
        if (actor.employeeId.equals(ownerEmployeeId)) throw new AccessDenied("Nobody can change their own pay.");
    }

    public static void requirePayrollProcessing(Actor actor, String ownerEmployeeId) {
        if (actor.role != Role.ADMIN && actor.role != Role.PAYROLL) throw new AccessDenied("Only Payroll Staff or a System Admin can process payroll.");
        if (ownerEmployeeId != null && actor.employeeId.equals(ownerEmployeeId)) throw new AccessDenied("Nobody can change their own pay.");
    }

    /** Team schedules: the person's supervisor or a System Admin. */
    public static void requireScheduleEdit(Actor actor, String targetEmployeeId) {
        boolean allowed = actor.role == Role.ADMIN || (actor.role == Role.SUPERVISOR && isDirectReport(actor.employeeId, targetEmployeeId));
        if (!allowed) throw new AccessDenied("Only the employee's supervisor or a System Admin can change their schedule.");
    }

    /** Promotion, merit increase, bonus or disciplinary/unpaid leave requests: filed by the supervisor (or admin). */
    public static void requirePayChangeRequest(Actor actor, String targetEmployeeId) {
        if (actor.employeeId.equals(targetEmployeeId)) throw new AccessDenied("Nobody can request a pay change for themselves.");
        boolean allowed = actor.role == Role.ADMIN || (actor.role == Role.SUPERVISOR && isDirectReport(actor.employeeId, targetEmployeeId));
        if (!allowed) throw new AccessDenied("Pay-change requests are filed by the employee's supervisor or a System Admin.");
    }

    /** HR decides promotions, merit increases and disciplinary leave; Payroll Staff decide bonuses; never the requester or the employee. */
    public static void requirePayChangeReview(Actor actor, String type, String targetEmployeeId, String requesterId) {
        if (actor.employeeId.equals(targetEmployeeId) || actor.employeeId.equals(requesterId)) {
            throw new AccessDenied("The employee and the person who filed the request cannot decide it.");
        }
        boolean allowed = actor.role == Role.ADMIN || ("BONUS".equals(type) ? actor.role == Role.PAYROLL : actor.role == Role.HR);
        if (!allowed) throw new AccessDenied("BONUS".equals(type) ? "Bonus requests are approved by Payroll Staff." : "This request is approved by HR.");
    }

    /** Onboarding, offboarding, department and position lists: HR or System Admin; nobody offboards themselves. */
    public static void requireHrManagement(Actor actor, String targetEmployeeId) {
        if (actor.role != Role.ADMIN && actor.role != Role.HR) throw new AccessDenied("Only HR or a System Admin manages onboarding, offboarding and HR lists.");
        if (targetEmployeeId != null && actor.employeeId.equals(targetEmployeeId)) throw new AccessDenied("Nobody can offboard themselves.");
    }

    /** HR resolves tickets in the HR queue; a System Admin resolves any; never your own ticket. */
    /**
     * Who handles a ticket (design doc: tickets are routed by type to handlers): Team Lead queue = the owner's supervisor,
     * Payroll Staff queue = Payroll Staff, HR queue = HR, IT Admin queue = the System Admin. The System Admin can step in
     * on any queue. Never your own ticket.
     */
    public static boolean canHandleTicket(Actor actor, String queue, String ownerEmployeeId) {
        if (actor.employeeId.equals(ownerEmployeeId)) return false;
        if (actor.role == Role.ADMIN) return true;
        switch (queue) {
            case "Team Lead": return actor.role == Role.SUPERVISOR && isDirectReport(actor.employeeId, ownerEmployeeId);
            case "Payroll Staff": return actor.role == Role.PAYROLL;
            case "HR": return actor.role == Role.HR;
            default: return false;
        }
    }

    public static void requireTicketResolve(Actor actor, String queue, String ownerEmployeeId) {
        if (actor.employeeId.equals(ownerEmployeeId)) throw new AccessDenied("Nobody handles their own ticket.");
        if (!canHandleTicket(actor, queue, ownerEmployeeId)) {
            throw new AccessDenied("This ticket is in the " + queue + " queue; it is handled by " + ("Team Lead".equals(queue) ? "the employee's supervisor"
                : "Payroll Staff".equals(queue) ? "Payroll Staff" : "HR".equals(queue) ? "HR" : "the System Admin") + ".");
        }
    }

    /** Government numbers: System Admin, HR and Payroll Staff see them (masked unless allowed); nobody else. */
    public static void requireGovernmentRead(Actor actor) {
        if (actor.role != Role.ADMIN && actor.role != Role.HR && actor.role != Role.PAYROLL) {
            throw new AccessDenied("Government details are limited to HR, Payroll Staff and the System Admin.");
        }
    }

    /** HR and Payroll Staff propose changes and ask for full view (matrix "A"); never for their own record. */
    public static void requireGovernmentRequest(Actor actor, String targetEmployeeId) {
        if (actor.role != Role.HR && actor.role != Role.PAYROLL) throw new AccessDenied("Only HR or Payroll Staff file government-details requests; the System Admin edits directly.");
        if (actor.employeeId.equals(targetEmployeeId)) throw new AccessDenied("Nobody files government-details requests about themselves.");
    }

    /** Direct edits, approvals and the audit log: System Admin only; an admin never decides a request about their own record. */
    public static void requireGovernmentAdmin(Actor actor, String targetEmployeeId) {
        if (actor.role != Role.ADMIN) throw new AccessDenied("Only the System Admin edits or approves government details.");
        if (targetEmployeeId != null && actor.employeeId.equals(targetEmployeeId) && actor.explicit) {
            throw new AccessDenied("The System Admin does not approve requests about their own record.");
        }
    }

    /** Payslip corrections: Payroll Staff file them, the System Admin approves; nobody corrects their own payslip. */
    public static void requirePayslipCorrectionRequest(Actor actor, String ownerEmployeeId) {
        if (actor.role != Role.PAYROLL) throw new AccessDenied("Payroll Staff file payslip corrections; the System Admin approves them.");
        if (actor.employeeId.equals(ownerEmployeeId)) throw new AccessDenied("Nobody corrects their own payslip.");
    }

    public static void requirePayslipCorrectionReview(Actor actor, String ownerEmployeeId) {
        if (actor.role != Role.ADMIN) throw new AccessDenied("Only the System Admin approves payslip corrections.");
        if (actor.explicit && actor.employeeId.equals(ownerEmployeeId)) throw new AccessDenied("Nobody approves a correction to their own payslip.");
    }

    public static void requireFinalize(Actor actor, String ownerEmployeeId) {
        if (actor.role != Role.ADMIN && actor.role != Role.PAYROLL) throw new AccessDenied("Only Payroll Staff or a System Admin can finalize payslips.");
        if (actor.employeeId.equals(ownerEmployeeId)) throw new AccessDenied("Nobody can finalize their own payslip.");
    }

# Role model and access matrix — gap analysis

**Date:** 2026-11-06 · **Input:** your five role definitions, the RBAC matrix in `message (2).txt`,
and the permission diagram (5 nesting scopes + 8 permission bubbles).

**Status: implemented.** The five roles and the 12×5 matrix below are in `Policy.java` (the single
source of truth), enforced by `AccessControl.java` on every route, and checked against an
independently typed copy of the document matrix by `RbacPolicyTest` (229 checks). Direct reporting
lines come from the `Immediate Supervisor` column of the supplied employee file, so "my team" is a
fact about MotorPH's data rather than a table someone has to maintain.

Two notes on what implementation changed:

- A sixth, **non-role** state `APPLICANT` exists for a signed-in account HR has not linked to an
  employee number. Every matrix cell for it is `NONE`. Without it a new account could not sign in to
  ask for access, and the alternative — defaulting to `EMPLOYEE` — would hand payroll data to anyone
  with an email address.
- The Employee cell for a Supervisor is `R (Self)`, but a supervisor legitimately needs the name and
  placement of their direct reports. That access is granted through the team-scoped entities
  (Attendance, Payslip) rather than by widening the Employee cell, so the matrix still matches the
  document.

---

## 1. Your spec, restated precisely

| Role | What you asked for |
|---|---|
| **Employee** | Clock in/out, view own attendance, own salary tracker, submit tickets (Overtime, Leave, Timesheet, Payroll dispute, Tech support), view team members, check team leave |
| **Supervisor** | Everything Employees do **plus** manage team schedules, approve OT/leave, handle timesheet edits, and raise promotion / merit / bonus / disciplinary / unpaid-leave requests that change earnings |
| **Payroll** | Gross-to-net (earnings + OT + bonuses + allowances), statutory and voluntary deductions, disburse, remit, generate payslips |
| **HR** | Everything Supervisors do plus onboard/offboard, employee records, HR tickets |
| **System Admin** | Configuration, roles, security policies, full database access; immediate access to and approval of government details |

The diagram adds one rule your text implies but doesn't state: **Employee ⊂ Supervisor ⊂ (Payroll ∪ HR)**,
with System Admin enclosing everything. That is a sensible shape, and it matches the RBAC table.

---

## 2. The hard blocker: "team" has no definition in the data model

**Everything a Supervisor does depends on a team existing.** Today it does not:

- `demoEmployees` has no `supervisorId`, no `teamId`, no `reportsTo`.
- The Team screen is explicitly labelled *"read-only roster… no reporting lines or team scopes inferred."*
- Firestore paths are `users/{uid}/…`, so **there is no way to read another user's documents** under the
  current rules — not even legitimately.

Consequence: `R (Team) Payslip`, `U (Team) Attendance`, `approve team OT/leave` cannot be implemented
without (a) storing reporting lines and (b) redesigning the path structure away from per-user silos.
That second change is the big one — it moves every collection from `users/{uid}/demoX` to a
company-scoped `companies/{cid}/x` with a role claim in the token.

**Until that lands, every "team" feature is a mock.** That is why approvals do not exist: with a
per-user data silo the only possible approver is the owner, and self-approval is exactly what you
correctly want to forbid.

---

## 3. Role by role: what exists, what's missing

### System Admin

| Capability | Status |
|---|---|
| Immediate access to government details | **Cannot be granted** — no government-details collection exists |
| Full database access | **Cannot be granted** — rules are owner-scoped; "full access" needs an admin claim |
| Role management | **Missing** — roles are not stored anywhere; Firebase Auth knows *who* you are, not *what* you are |

Also worth flagging as a policy question: "immediate access to government details" needs a definition —
SSS/PhilHealth/TIN/Pag-IBIG numbers are sensitive personal data under the Data Privacy Act. Who may read
them, and is every read audited? The current system deliberately stores **none** of these (see
`docs/firebase-data-inventory.md` §4), so nothing is exposed today.

### HR

| Capability | Status |
|---|---|
| Onboard / offboard | **Partial** — create and edit exist; **no delete/deactivate**, because lifecycle policy is undecided. "Offboard" also has payroll meaning (final pay, clearance) that has no rule yet |
| Employee records | **Exists** (create/edit six directory fields + four pay fields) |

package ph.motorph.c_calc;

import ph.motorph.o_oop.Employee;
import java.time.YearMonth;

/**
 * 2026 SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG and withholding tax, matched to sweldongpinoy.com (the mentor-specified
 * reference; 25 sample salaries agree to the centavo). Money is whole centavos (long); rates are basis points
 * (1% = 100), rounded half-up once per line. Not an approved payroll policy.
 */
public final class StatutoryCalculator2026 {
    public static final String RULESET_ID = "PH-2026-sweldongpinoy-v4";
    private static final long BP = 10_000;
    private static final long MAX_INPUT_CENTS = 1_000_000_000L; // ₱10,000,000 keeps every product inside a long

    // The numbers live in StatutoryRates (DEFAULT = SSS Circular 2024-006, PhilHealth PA2025-0002, Pag-IBIG Circular 460
    // with 1% at or below ₱1,500, BIR RR 11-2018 annual table); the System Admin can add versions by effective month.
    private static final long SSS_STEP = 50_000;
    private static final long SSS_EC_THRESHOLD = 1_500_000, SSS_EC_LOW = 1_000, SSS_EC_HIGH = 3_000;

    private StatutoryCalculator2026() { }

    /** Parses "1,234.56"-style non-negative pesos into centavos, rejecting more than two decimals. */
    public static long parsePesoCents(String value, String field) {
        String text = value == null ? "" : value.trim().replace(",", "");
        if (!text.matches("\\d{1,12}(\\.\\d{1,2})?")) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must be a non-negative peso amount with up to two decimal places.");
        }
        String[] parts = text.split("\\.");
        String fraction = parts.length > 1 ? (parts[1] + "0").substring(0, 2) : "00";
        long cents = Long.parseLong(parts[0]) * 100 + Long.parseLong(fraction);
        if (cents > MAX_INPUT_CENTS) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must be ₱10,000,000.00 or less.");
        return cents;
    }

    public static StatutoryBreakdown calculate(YearMonth period, long grossCashPayCents, long sssCompensationCents,
            long philHealthBasicSalaryCents, long pagIbigFundSalaryCents, long taxableCompensationCents) {
        return calculate(period, grossCashPayCents, sssCompensationCents, philHealthBasicSalaryCents, pagIbigFundSalaryCents,
            taxableCompensationCents, StatutoryRates.DEFAULT);
    }

    /** Same, with a specific rates version (its id becomes the breakdown's ruleset ID). */
    public static StatutoryBreakdown calculate(YearMonth period, long grossCashPayCents, long sssCompensationCents,
            long philHealthBasicSalaryCents, long pagIbigFundSalaryCents, long taxableCompensationCents, StatutoryRates rates) {
        if (period == null || period.getYear() != 2026) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("This temporary ruleset covers 2026 monthly periods only.");
        }
        for (long cents : new long[] {grossCashPayCents, sssCompensationCents, philHealthBasicSalaryCents,
                pagIbigFundSalaryCents, taxableCompensationCents}) {
            if (cents < 0 || cents > MAX_INPUT_CENTS) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Amounts must be ₱0 to ₱10,000,000.00.");
        }
        if (grossCashPayCents <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Gross cash pay must be greater than zero for this preview.");
        if (sssCompensationCents <= 0 || philHealthBasicSalaryCents <= 0 || pagIbigFundSalaryCents <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Enter a positive contribution base for SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG.");
        }

        long msc = sssMonthlySalaryCredit(sssCompensationCents, rates);
        long sssEmployee = applyBp(msc, rates.sssEmployeeBp);
        long sssEmployer = applyBp(msc, rates.sssEmployerBp);
        long sssEc = msc < SSS_EC_THRESHOLD ? SSS_EC_LOW : SSS_EC_HIGH;

private void handlePayrollStatutory(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!"POST".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
            return;
        }
        try {
            AccessPolicy.Actor actor = actorFor(exchange);
            guard(() -> AccessPolicy.requireArea(actor, AccessPolicy.Area.STATUTORY));
            JsonObject body = readJsonBody(exchange);
            requireOnlyKeys(body, "period", "grossCashPay", "sssCompensation", "philHealthBasicSalary",

package ph.motorph.c_calc;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.YearMonth;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * One employee's month, gross to net, per cutoff:
 *   earned pay (attendance, premiums, OT, night diff, holiday and leave pay) + taxable bonuses = gross
 *   − statutory (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG on earned pay; tax on earned pay + bonuses), each line half per cutoff
 *   − voluntary deductions (loans, insurance...), taken in order, never below a zero net
 *   + allowances (rice, phone, clothing; non-taxable, half per cutoff)
 *   = net.
 * Statutory amounts follow sweldongpinoy.com on the monthly totals; the odd centavo of any split goes to the 2nd cutoff.
 */
public final class MonthPayroll {
    public static final int SSS = 0, PHILHEALTH = 1, PAGIBIG = 2, TAX = 3;
    public static final int RICE = 0, PHONE = 1, CLOTHING = 2;

    /** A voluntary deduction as applied to one cutoff. */
    public static final class Taken {
        public final PayrollAdjustments.Deduction item;
        public final long takenCents;
        public final long shortfallCents;

        Taken(PayrollAdjustments.Deduction item, long takenCents) {
            this.item = item;
            this.takenCents = takenCents;
            this.shortfallCents = item.perCutoffCents - takenCents;
        }
    }

    private final String employeeId;
    private final YearMonth month;
    private final BigDecimal hourlyRate;
    private final List<CutoffPay> cutoffs;
    private final long monthlyGrossCents;
    private final StatutoryBreakdown statutory;
    private final long[][] lines = new long[2][4];
    private final long[][] employerLines = new long[2][3];
    private final long[][] allowances = new long[2][3];
    private final long[] bonusCents = new long[2];
    private final List<List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning>> bonuses = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning>> allowanceCorrections = new ArrayList<>();
    private final long[] allowanceCorrectionCents = new long[2];
    private final List<List<Taken>> voluntary = new ArrayList<>();

    public List<CutoffPay> grossForMonth(String employeeId, YearMonth month, LocalDate through) {

        List<DemoLeaveRequest> leaves = workflowService == null ? Collections.emptyList() : workflowService.listLeaveRequests();
        Map<LocalDate, Integer> overtime = new HashMap<>();
        if (workflowService != null) {
            for (DemoOvertimeRequest request : workflowService.listOvertimeRequests()) {
                if (request.getEmployeeId().equals(employeeId) && "Approved".equals(request.getStatus())) {
                    overtime.put(LocalDate.parse(request.getDate()), request.getMinutes());
                }
            }
        }
        List<CutoffPay> cutoffs = new ArrayList<>();
        cutoffs.add(cutoff("1-15", employeeId, rate, month.atDay(1), month.atDay(15), through, leaves, overtime));
        cutoffs.add(cutoff("16-end", employeeId, rate, month.atDay(16), month.atEndOfMonth(), through, leaves, overtime));
        return cutoffs;
    }

    /** Earnings per cutoff plus statutory deductions split half per cutoff (see MonthPayroll). */
    public MonthPayroll payrollForMonth(String employeeId, YearMonth month) {
        return payrollForMonth(employeeId, month, null);
    }

    public MonthPayroll payrollForMonth(String employeeId, YearMonth month, LocalDate through) {
        List<CutoffPay> cutoffs = grossForMonth(employeeId, month, through);
        BigDecimal rate = rateFor(employeeId, month).get();
        if (adjustments == null) {
            return new MonthPayroll(employeeId, month, rate, cutoffs, Collections.emptyList(), Collections.emptyList(),
                Collections.emptyList(), allowancesFor(employeeId), ratesFor(month));
        }
        return new MonthPayroll(employeeId, month, rate, cutoffs, adjustments.earningsFor(employeeId, month, 1),
            adjustments.earningsFor(employeeId, month, 2), adjustments.deductionsFor(employeeId, month),
            allowancesFor(employeeId), ratesFor(month));
    }

Every amount is in centavos until the moment it * is formatted, which is what keeps the totals adding up to the last centavo of MotorPH's sample slip. */ public final class Payslip { /** A labelled money line on the slip. */ public static final class Line { public final String label; public final long cents; public final boolean emphasis; public Line(String label, long cents) { this(label, cents, false); } public Line(String label, long cents, boolean emphasis) { this.label = label; this.cents = cents; this.emphasis = emphasis; } } public final String number; // "15-2026-01-15", the form MotorPH's own slip uses public final Employee employee; public final YearMonth month; public final int cutoff; // 0 = 1–15, 1 = 16–end public final LocalDate periodStart, periodEnd, payDate; public final List<Line> earnings = new ArrayList<>(); public final List<Line> benefits = new ArrayList<>(); public final List<Line> deductions = new ArrayList<>(); public long grossIncomeCents, benefitsCents, deductionsCents, netCents; public int daysWorked; public final String rulesetId; Payslip(String number, Employee employee, YearMonth month, int cutoff, LocalDate periodStart, LocalDate periodEnd, LocalDate payDate, String rulesetId) { this.number = number; this.employee = employee; this.month = month; this.cutoff = cutoff; this.periodStart = periodStart; this.periodEnd = periodEnd; this.payDate = payDate; this.rulesetId = rulesetId; } public String periodLabel() { return periodStart + " to " + periodEnd; } /** "Jan 1–15, 2026" — the heading form. */ public String periodHeading() { return periodStart.getMonth().getDisplayName(java.time.format.TextStyle.SHORT, java.util.Locale.ENGLISH) + " " + periodStart.getDayOfMonth() + "–" + periodEnd.getDayOfMonth() + ", " + periodEnd.getYear(); } /** Total of the earnings block, recomputed so a caller can never ship a slip whose parts do not sum. */ public long earningsTotal() { long total = 0; for (Line line : earnings) total += line.cents; return total; } public long benefitsTotal() { long total = 0; for (Line line : benefits) total += line.cents; return total; } public long deductionsTotal() { long total = 0; for (Line line : deductions) total += line.cents; return total; } /** Net, derived rather than stored, so it always equals earnings + benefits − deductions. */ public long netFromLines() { return earningsTotal() + benefitsTotal() - deductionsTotal(); } } JAVA echo ok

    public String getEmployeeId() { return employeeId; }
    public YearMonth getMonth() { return month; }
    public BigDecimal getHourlyRate() { return hourlyRate; }
    public List<CutoffPay> getCutoffs() { return cutoffs; }
    /** Earned pay + bonuses for the month (allowances excluded: they are not part of gross). */
    public long getMonthlyGrossCents() { return monthlyGrossCents; }
    /** Null when the month has no earned pay. */
    public StatutoryBreakdown getStatutory() { return statutory; }

    /** cutoff is 0 (1-15) or 1 (16-end); line is SSS, PHILHEALTH, PAGIBIG or TAX. */
    public long lineCents(int cutoff, int line) { return lines[cutoff][line]; }
    /** Employer share for SSS (incl. EC), PHILHEALTH or PAGIBIG, half per cutoff. */
    public long employerCents(int cutoff, int line) { return employerLines[cutoff][line]; }
    public long allowanceCents(int cutoff, int allowance) { return allowances[cutoff][allowance]; }
    /** RICE, PHONE or CLOTHING for this cutoff including its corrections (never below 0). */
    public long allowanceWithCorrections(int cutoff, int allowance, String correctionType) {
        long total = allowances[cutoff][allowance];
        for (PayrollAdjustments.Earning item : allowanceCorrections.get(cutoff)) if (item.type.equals(correctionType)) total += item.amountCents;
        return Math.max(0, total);
    }
    /** Monthly allowances (half) plus any non-taxable allowance corrections for this cutoff. */
    public long allowanceTotalCents(int cutoff) {
        // Subtracting corrections can lower the allowances, never below nothing.
        return Math.max(0, allowances[cutoff][0] + allowances[cutoff][1] + allowances[cutoff][2] + allowanceCorrectionCents[cutoff]);
    }
    public List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> allowanceCorrections(int cutoff) { return allowanceCorrections.get(cutoff); }
    public long allowanceCorrectionCents(int cutoff) { return allowanceCorrectionCents[cutoff]; }
    public List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> bonuses(int cutoff) { return bonuses.get(cutoff); }
    public long bonusCents(int cutoff) { return bonusCents[cutoff]; }
    public List<Taken> voluntary(int cutoff) { return voluntary.get(cutoff); }

    /** Attendance-derived pay (basic, premiums, overtime, night diff, holiday and leave pay). */
    public long earnedCents(int cutoff) { return cents(cutoffs.get(cutoff).getGrossPay()); }
    /** Gross = earned pay + taxable bonuses. */
    public long grossCents(int cutoff) { return earnedCents(cutoff) + bonusCents[cutoff]; }
    public long statutoryCents(int cutoff) {
        long total = 0;
        for (long line : lines[cutoff]) total += line;
        return total;
    }
    public long voluntaryCents(int cutoff) {
        long total = 0;
        for (Taken item : voluntary.get(cutoff)) total += item.takenCents;
        return total;
    }
    /** Statutory + voluntary deductions actually taken. */
    public long deductionsCents(int cutoff) { return statutoryCents(cutoff) + voluntaryCents(cutoff); }
    /** True when this cutoff's statutory share is larger than its gross (net would be negative). */
    public boolean isBlocked(int cutoff) { return statutoryCents(cutoff) > grossCents(cutoff); }
    public long netCents(int cutoff) {
        if (isBlocked(cutoff)) throw new IllegalStateException("Deductions exceed this cutoff's gross.");
        return grossCents(cutoff) - deductionsCents(cutoff) + allowanceTotalCents(cutoff);
    }
}

/**
 * Payroll profile, revised 2026-11-05 from the mentor's answers:
 * - hourly rate = monthly basic / 168 (reproduces MotorPH's employee file, e.g. 90,000 -> 535.71)
 * - paid time = min(worked, 8 h); worked time beyond 8 h is unapproved overage, shown but not paid
 * - log-in from 08:00 to 08:10 counts as 08:00; the 12:00-13:00 meal hour is not worked time
 * Cutoffs stay 1-15 and 16-month-end. Monthly basics are placeholders for the fictional DEMO employees.
 */
public final class PayrollProfile {
    public static final String VERSION = "TEMPORARY-2026-mentor-v2";
    static final LocalTime SHIFT_START = LocalTime.of(8, 0);
    static final LocalTime LUNCH_START = LocalTime.of(12, 0);
    static final LocalTime LUNCH_END = LocalTime.of(13, 0);

    static {
        Map<String, BigDecimal> basics = new HashMap<>();
        basics.put("DEMO-001", new BigDecimal("52670.00"));
        basics.put("DEMO-002", new BigDecimal("60000.00"));
        basics.put("DEMO-003", new BigDecimal("90000.00"));
        basics.put("DEMO-004", new BigDecimal("25000.00"));
        basics.put("DEMO-005", new BigDecimal("75000.00"));
        MONTHLY_BASIC = Collections.unmodifiableMap(basics);
    }

    /** Monthly rice / phone / clothing allowances in centavos (placeholders shaped like the MotorPH employee file). */
    private static final Map<String, long[]> ALLOWANCES;
    static {
        Map<String, long[]> allowances = new HashMap<>();
        allowances.put("DEMO-001", new long[] {150_000, 100_000, 100_000});
        allowances.put("DEMO-002", new long[] {150_000, 100_000, 100_000});
        allowances.put("DEMO-003", new long[] {150_000, 200_000, 100_000});
        allowances.put("DEMO-004", new long[] {150_000, 50_000, 50_000});
        allowances.put("DEMO-005", new long[] {150_000, 200_000, 100_000});
        ALLOWANCES = Collections.unmodifiableMap(allowances);
    }

    private PayrollProfile() { }

    /** {rice, phone, clothing} per month; zeros for people without a profile. Non-taxable, paid half per cutoff. */

/** {rice, phone, clothing} per month; zeros for people without a profile. Non-taxable, paid half per cutoff. */
    public static long[] monthlyAllowances(String employeeId) {
        long[] values = ALLOWANCES.get(employeeId);
        return values == null ? new long[3] : values.clone();
    }

    /** How net pay is released (synthetic): Jae is paid by check, everyone else by direct deposit. */
    public static String payMethod(String employeeId) {
        return "DEMO-004".equals(employeeId) ? "Check" : "Direct deposit";
    }

    public static Optional<BigDecimal> monthlyBasic(String employeeId) {
        return Optional.ofNullable(MONTHLY_BASIC.get(employeeId));
    }

    /** Monthly basic / 168, rounded half-up to the centavo like the employee file. */
    public static Optional<BigDecimal> hourlyRate(String employeeId) {
        return monthlyBasic(employeeId).map(basic -> basic.divide(PayrollPolicy.hoursPerMonth(), 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP));
    }

    /** Worked minutes for one raw attendance row: grace applied, meal hour removed, no clock cap. */
    public static long workedMinutes(LocalTime timeIn, LocalTime timeOut) {
        LocalTime start = !timeIn.isBefore(SHIFT_START) && !timeIn.isAfter(SHIFT_START.plusMinutes(PayrollPolicy.graceMinutes())) ? SHIFT_START : timeIn;
        if (!timeOut.isAfter(start)) return 0;
        long minutes = Duration.between(start, timeOut).toMinutes();
        LocalTime lunchFrom = start.isAfter(LUNCH_START) ? start : LUNCH_START;
        LocalTime lunchTo = timeOut.isBefore(LUNCH_END) ? timeOut : LUNCH_END;
        if (lunchTo.isAfter(lunchFrom)) minutes -= Duration.between(lunchFrom, lunchTo).toMinutes();
        return minutes;
    }

    /** Indexes into splitDay's result. */
    public static final int REGULAR = 0, REGULAR_NIGHT = 1, OVERTIME = 2, OVERTIME_NIGHT = 3, UNPAID = 4;
    static final LocalTime NIGHT_END = LocalTime.of(6, 0);
    static final LocalTime NIGHT_START = LocalTime.of(22, 0);

    /**
     * Walks one attendance row minute by minute (grace applied, meal hour skipped). The first 8 worked hours are
     * regular; later minutes are overtime up to the approved minutes, and the rest is unpaid overage. Night minutes
     * (22:00-06:00) are counted inside the regular and overtime totals.
     */
    public static long[] splitDay(LocalTime timeIn, LocalTime timeOut, int approvedOvertimeMinutes) {
        return splitDay(timeIn, timeOut, approvedOvertimeMinutes, WorkSchedule.DEFAULT);
    }

    /** Same, with the person's schedule: grace from its shift start, meal hour 4 hours in. */
    public static long[] splitDay(LocalTime timeIn, LocalTime timeOut, int approvedOvertimeMinutes, WorkSchedule schedule) {
        long[] result = new long[5];
        LocalTime start = !timeIn.isBefore(schedule.shiftStart) && !timeIn.isAfter(schedule.graceEnd()) ? schedule.shiftStart : timeIn;
        LocalTime mealStart = schedule.mealStart(), mealEnd = schedule.mealEnd();
        long worked = 0, daily = PayrollPolicy.dailyMinutes();
        for (LocalTime t = start; t.isBefore(timeOut); t = t.plusMinutes(1)) {
            if (!t.isBefore(mealStart) && t.isBefore(mealEnd)) continue;
            worked++;
            boolean night = t.isBefore(NIGHT_END) || !t.isBefore(NIGHT_START);
            if (worked <= daily) {
                result[REGULAR]++;
                if (night) result[REGULAR_NIGHT]++;
            } else if (worked <= daily + approvedOvertimeMinutes) {
                result[OVERTIME]++;
                if (night) result[OVERTIME_NIGHT]++;
            } else {
                result[UNPAID]++;
            }
            if (t.equals(LocalTime.MAX.withSecond(0).withNano(0))) break; // 23:59 would wrap to 00:00
        }
        return result;
    }

    /** Paid minutes = min(worked, scheduled 8 h); time beyond that is paid only through an approved overtime request. */
    public static long paidMinutes(LocalTime timeIn, LocalTime timeOut) {
        return Math.min(workedMinutes(timeIn, timeOut), PayrollPolicy.dailyMinutes());
    }
}

private CutoffPay cutoff(String label, String employeeId, BigDecimal rate, LocalDate from, LocalDate periodEnd, LocalDate through,
            List<DemoLeaveRequest> leaves, Map<LocalDate, Integer> approvedOvertime) {
        // The cutoff keeps its real dates; only days after `through` are left out of the counting.
        LocalDate to = through != null && through.isBefore(periodEnd) ? through : periodEnd;
        BigDecimal basic = BigDecimal.ZERO, premium = BigDecimal.ZERO, overtime = BigDecimal.ZERO, night = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        long paid = 0, unpaid = 0, overtimeMinutes = 0, nightMinutes = 0;
        Set<LocalDate> workedDates = new HashSet<>();
        // Each date uses its own schedule: the weekly pattern or a single-day/multi-day change.
        java.util.function.Function<LocalDate, WorkSchedule> scheduleOn = date -> schedules == null ? WorkSchedule.DEFAULT : schedules.forDate(employeeId, date);
        List<AttendanceRecord> records = to.isBefore(from) ? Collections.emptyList() : attendanceService.findForEmployee(employeeId, from, to);
        for (AttendanceRecord record : records) {
            if (!employedOn(employeeId, record.getDate())) continue; // nothing before the start date or after the last day
            WorkSchedule schedule = scheduleOn.apply(record.getDate());
            HolidayCalendar2026.DayKind kind = HolidayCalendar2026.kindOf(record.getDate(), !schedule.isWorkday(record.getDate()));
            long[] m = PayrollProfile.splitDay(record.getTimeIn(), record.getTimeOut(),
                approvedOvertime.getOrDefault(record.getDate(), 0), schedule);
            BigDecimal regular = BigDecimal.valueOf(m[PayrollProfile.REGULAR]);
            BigDecimal extra = BigDecimal.valueOf(m[PayrollProfile.OVERTIME]);
            basic = basic.add(regular);
            premium = premium.add(regular.multiply(kind.workedMultiplier.subtract(BigDecimal.ONE)));
            overtime = overtime.add(extra.multiply(kind.overtimeMultiplier));
            // Night differential stacks: 10% of the rate that applies to that minute (DOLE).
            night = night.add(BigDecimal.valueOf(m[PayrollProfile.REGULAR_NIGHT]).multiply(kind.workedMultiplier)
                .add(BigDecimal.valueOf(m[PayrollProfile.OVERTIME_NIGHT]).multiply(kind.overtimeMultiplier)).multiply(PayrollPolicy.nightDifferential()));
            paid += m[PayrollProfile.REGULAR];
            overtimeMinutes += m[PayrollProfile.OVERTIME];
            unpaid += m[PayrollProfile.UNPAID];
            nightMinutes += m[PayrollProfile.REGULAR_NIGHT] + m[PayrollProfile.OVERTIME_NIGHT];
            workedDates.add(record.getDate());
        }
        int holidayDays = 0, leaveDays = 0;
        for (LocalDate day = from; !day.isAfter(to); day = day.plusDays(1)) {
            if (workedDates.contains(day) || !scheduleOn.apply(day).isWorkday(day) || !employedOn(employeeId, day)) continue;
            // shortcut: an unworked regular holiday is paid without checking attendance on the day before (Labor Code Art. 94 condition).
            if (HolidayCalendar2026.isRegularHoliday(day)) holidayDays++;
            else if (!HolidayCalendar2026.isHoliday(day) && onPaidLeave(leaves, employeeId, day)) leaveDays++; // workdays only (checked above)
        }
        return new CutoffPay(label, from, periodEnd, workedDates.size(), paid, unpaid, overtimeMinutes, nightMinutes, holidayDays, leaveDays,
            money(rate, basic), money(rate, premium), money(rate, overtime), money(rate, night),
            money(rate, BigDecimal.valueOf(PayrollPolicy.dailyMinutes()).multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(holidayDays))),
            money(rate, BigDecimal.valueOf(PayrollPolicy.dailyMinutes()).multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(leaveDays))));
    }

    /** Gives an onboarded employee the next synthetic schedule ID so their attendance can be recorded. */
    public synchronized int assign(String employeeId) {
        Integer existing = scheduleByEmployee.get(employeeId);
        if (existing != null) return existing;
        int next = scheduleByEmployee.values().stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).max().orElse(100) + 1;
        scheduleByEmployee.put(employeeId, next);
        return next;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized OptionalInt findScheduleIdForEmployee(String employeeId) {
        Integer scheduleId = employeeId == null ? null : scheduleByEmployee.get(employeeId);
        return scheduleId == null ? OptionalInt.empty() : OptionalInt.of(scheduleId);
    }

public AttendanceService(EmployeeService employeeService, EmployeeScheduleStore scheduleStore,
                             AttendanceStore attendanceStore) {
        if (employeeService == null || scheduleStore == null || attendanceStore == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("attendance service dependencies must not be null");
        }
        this.employeeService = employeeService;
        this.scheduleStore = scheduleStore;
        this.attendanceStore = attendanceStore;
    }

    /** Inclusive optional date filtering; no pay-period calendar is inferred. */
    public List<AttendanceRecord> findForEmployee(String employeeId, LocalDate from, LocalDate to) {
        if (!employeeService.findEmployee(employeeId).isPresent()) {
            throw new NoSuchElementException("employee not found");
        }
        validateRange(from, to);
        OptionalInt scheduleId = scheduleStore.findScheduleIdForEmployee(employeeId.trim());
        if (!scheduleId.isPresent()) return java.util.Collections.emptyList();
        return attendanceStore.findByScheduleId(scheduleId.getAsInt()).stream()
            .filter(record -> from == null || !record.getDate().isBefore(from))
            .filter(record -> to == null || !record.getDate().isAfter(to))
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    /** Adds one local synthetic raw row for an existing mapping; no hours or classifications are inferred. */
    public AttendanceRecord createForEmployee(String employeeId, LocalDate date, LocalTime timeIn, LocalTime timeOut) {
        if (employeeId == null || employeeId.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("employeeId is required.");
        }
        if (!employeeService.findEmployee(employeeId.trim()).isPresent()) {
            throw new NoSuchElementException("employee not found");
        }
        OptionalInt scheduleId = scheduleStore.findScheduleIdForEmployee(employeeId.trim());
        if (!scheduleId.isPresent()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("No configured synthetic schedule mapping exists for this employee; no schedule was assigned.");

MonthPayroll(String employeeId, YearMonth month, BigDecimal hourlyRate, List<CutoffPay> cutoffs,
            List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> firstBonuses, List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> secondBonuses,
            List<PayrollAdjustments.Deduction> voluntaryDeductions, long[] monthlyAllowanceCents) {
        this(employeeId, month, hourlyRate, cutoffs, firstBonuses, secondBonuses, voluntaryDeductions, monthlyAllowanceCents, StatutoryRates.DEFAULT);
    }
    MonthPayroll(String employeeId, YearMonth month, BigDecimal hourlyRate, List<CutoffPay> cutoffs,
            List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> firstBonuses, List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> secondBonuses,
            List<PayrollAdjustments.Deduction> voluntaryDeductions, long[] monthlyAllowanceCents, StatutoryRates rates) {
        if (cutoffs.size() != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException("A month has exactly two cutoffs.");
        this.employeeId = employeeId;
        this.month = month;
        this.hourlyRate = hourlyRate;
        this.cutoffs = Collections.unmodifiableList(cutoffs);
        // Taxable earnings are bonuses (in gross); allowance corrections are non-taxable and paid on top of net.
        for (List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> items : java.util.Arrays.asList(firstBonuses, secondBonuses)) {
            List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> taxable = new ArrayList<>(), allowance = new ArrayList<>();
            for (PayrollAdjustments.Earning item : items) (PayrollAdjustments.isTaxable(item.type) ? taxable : allowance).add(item);
            bonuses.add(Collections.unmodifiableList(taxable));
            allowanceCorrections.add(Collections.unmodifiableList(allowance));
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            for (PayrollAdjustments.Earning item : bonuses.get(c)) bonusCents[c] += item.amountCents;
            for (PayrollAdjustments.Earning item : allowanceCorrections.get(c)) allowanceCorrectionCents[c] += item.amountCents;
        }
        long earned = earnedCents(0) + earnedCents(1);
        long bonus = bonusCents[0] + bonusCents[1];
        this.monthlyGrossCents = earned + bonus;
        // shortcut: a month with bonuses but no earned pay has no contribution base, so nothing is withheld; rare in the demo.
        this.statutory = earned > 0
            ? StatutoryCalculator2026.calculate(month, earned + bonus, earned, earned, earned, earned + bonus, rates)
            : null;
        if (statutory != null) {
            split(lines, SSS, statutory.sssEmployeeCents);
            split(lines, PHILHEALTH, statutory.philHealthEmployeeCents);
            split(lines, PAGIBIG, statutory.pagIbigEmployeeCents);
            split(lines, TAX, statutory.withholdingTaxCents);
            split(employerLines, SSS, statutory.sssEmployerTotalCents());
            split(employerLines, PHILHEALTH, statutory.philHealthEmployerCents);
            split(employerLines, PAGIBIG, statutory.pagIbigEmployerCents);
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            // shortcut: allowances are paid only in a cutoff with earned pay (no pay for a cutoff fully absent); confirm with the mentor.
            if (earnedCents(c) > 0) {
                for (int a = 0; a < 3; a++) allowances[c][a] = c == 0 ? monthlyAllowanceCents[a] / 2 : monthlyAllowanceCents[a] - monthlyAllowanceCents[a] / 2;
            }
            List<Taken> taken = new ArrayList<>();
            long room = Math.max(0, grossCents(c) - statutoryCents(c));
            for (PayrollAdjustments.Deduction item : voluntaryDeductions) {
                if (item.onlyCutoff != 0 && item.onlyCutoff != c + 1) continue;
                long amount = Math.min(item.perCutoffCents, room);
                taken.add(new Taken(item, amount));
                room -= amount;
            }
            voluntary.add(Collections.unmodifiableList(taken));
        }
    }

=== tax section ===
 * 2026 SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG and withholding tax, matched to sweldongpinoy.com (the mentor-specified
 * reference; 25 sample salaries agree to the centavo). Money is whole centavos (long); rates are basis points
 * (1% = 100), rounded half-up once per line. Not an approved payroll policy.
 */
public final class StatutoryCalculator2026 {
    public static final String RULESET_ID = "PH-2026-sweldongpinoy-v4";
    private static final long BP = 10_000;
    private static final long MAX_INPUT_CENTS = 1_000_000_000L; // ₱10,000,000 keeps every product inside a long

    // The numbers live in StatutoryRates (DEFAULT = SSS Circular 2024-006, PhilHealth PA2025-0002, Pag-IBIG Circular 460
    // with 1% at or below ₱1,500, BIR RR 11-2018 annual table); the System Admin can add versions by effective month.
    private static final long SSS_STEP = 50_000;
    private static final long SSS_EC_THRESHOLD = 1_500_000, SSS_EC_LOW = 1_000, SSS_EC_HIGH = 3_000;

    private StatutoryCalculator2026() { }

    /** Parses "1,234.56"-style non-negative pesos into centavos, rejecting more than two decimals. */
    public static long parsePesoCents(String value, String field) {
        String text = value == null ? "" : value.trim().replace(",", "");
        if (!text.matches("\\d{1,12}(\\.\\d{1,2})?")) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must be a non-negative peso amount with up to two decimal places.");
        }
        String[] parts = text.split("\\.");
        String fraction = parts.length > 1 ? (parts[1] + "0").substring(0, 2) : "00";
        long cents = Long.parseLong(parts[0]) * 100 + Long.parseLong(fraction);
        if (cents > MAX_INPUT_CENTS) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must be ₱10,000,000.00 or less.");
        return cents;
    }

            msc, sssEmployee, sssEmployer, sssEc, phBase, phTotal, phEmployee,
            pagIbigBase, pagIbigEmployee, pagIbigEmployer, taxable, tax);
    }

    private static long sssMonthlySalaryCredit(long compensationCents, StatutoryRates rates) {
        long firstHigherRange = rates.sssMinMsc + SSS_STEP / 2; // e.g. 5,000 MSC covers pay below 5,250
        if (compensationCents < firstHigherRange) return rates.sssMinMsc;
        long msc = rates.sssMinMsc + ((compensationCents - firstHigherRange) / SSS_STEP + 1) * SSS_STEP;
        return Math.min(msc, rates.sssMaxMsc);
    }

    /**
     * 12 x monthly taxable, annual table, then / 12. No 13th month is added (mentor, 2026-11-05): its ₱90,000
     * exemption is annual and cumulative, so it cannot be decided inside one semi-monthly run.
     */
    private static long annualisedWithholding(long monthlyTaxableCents, StatutoryRates rates) {
        long annualTaxable = monthlyTaxableCents * 12;
        long[] bracket = rates.birAnnual.get(0);
        for (long[] candidate : rates.birAnnual) if (annualTaxable > candidate[0]) bracket = candidate;
        // Keep the annual tax exact (centavos x basis points) and round once after dividing by 12.
        long annualTaxScaled = bracket[1] * BP + (annualTaxable - bracket[0]) * bracket[2];
        return roundRatio(annualTaxScaled, BP * 12);
    }

    private static long applyBp(long cents, long basisPoints) { return roundRatio(cents * basisPoints, BP); }

    private static long roundRatio(long numerator, long denominator) { return (numerator + denominator / 2) / denominator; }
}

private CutoffPay cutoff(String label, String employeeId, BigDecimal rate, LocalDate from, LocalDate periodEnd, LocalDate through,
            List<DemoLeaveRequest> leaves, Map<LocalDate, Integer> approvedOvertime) {
        // Daily rate = monthly basic / 22 working days, which is the divisor MotorPH's own payslip uses
        // (53,500 / 22 = 2,431.82, and the file's semi-monthly rate of 26,750 / 11 days = 2,431.82 too).
        BigDecimal dailyRate = PayrollProfile.dailyRate(employeeId).orElse(
            rate.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(8)));
        // The cutoff keeps its real dates; only days after `through` are left out of the counting.
        LocalDate to = through != null && through.isBefore(periodEnd) ? through : periodEnd;
        BigDecimal basic = BigDecimal.ZERO, premium = BigDecimal.ZERO, overtime = BigDecimal.ZERO, night = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        long paid = 0, unpaid = 0, overtimeMinutes = 0, nightMinutes = 0;
        // A monthly-salaried person is paid per day worked, not per minute worked: 53,500 a month is 2,675 a day,
        // and ten days is 26,750 — which is exactly what MotorPH's sample payslip shows. Paying by the minute
        // (rate/60 x minutes) loses the minutes either side of the shift and understates every payslip.
        long wholeWorkedDays = 0;
        BigDecimal fractionWorkedDays = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        Set<LocalDate> workedDates = new HashSet<>();
        // Each date uses its own schedule: the weekly pattern or a single-day/multi-day change.
        java.util.function.Function<LocalDate, WorkSchedule> scheduleOn = date -> schedules == null ? WorkSchedule.DEFAULT : schedules.forDate(employeeId, date);
        List<AttendanceRecord> records = to.isBefore(from) ? Collections.emptyList() : attendanceService.findForEmployee(employeeId, from, to);
        for (AttendanceRecord record : records) {
            if (!employedOn(employeeId, record.getDate())) continue; // nothing before the start date or after the last day
            WorkSchedule schedule = scheduleOn.apply(record.getDate());
            HolidayCalendar2026.DayKind kind = HolidayCalendar2026.kindOf(record.getDate(), !schedule.isWorkday(record.getDate()));
            long[] m = PayrollProfile.splitDay(record.getTimeIn(), record.getTimeOut(),
                approvedOvertime.getOrDefault(record.getDate(), 0), schedule);
            // Whole-shift attendance pays a day; a part-day pays the fraction of the scheduled day actually worked.
            long scheduled = PayrollPolicy.dailyMinutes();
            long workedRegular = m[PayrollProfile.REGULAR];
            boolean fullDay = workedRegular >= scheduled;
            long[] dayUnits = wholeDays(workedRegular, scheduled);
            BigDecimal extra = BigDecimal.valueOf(m[PayrollProfile.OVERTIME]);
            premium = premium.add(partOf(dayUnits).multiply(kind.workedMultiplier.subtract(BigDecimal.ONE)));
            overtime = overtime.add(extra.divide(SIXTY, 6, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP).multiply(kind.overtimeMultiplier));
            // Night differential stacks: 10% of the rate that applies to that minute (DOLE).
            night = night.add(BigDecimal.valueOf(m[PayrollProfile.REGULAR_NIGHT]).multiply(kind.workedMultiplier)
                .add(BigDecimal.valueOf(m[PayrollProfile.OVERTIME_NIGHT]).multiply(kind.overtimeMultiplier))
                .divide(SIXTY, 6, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP).multiply(PayrollPolicy.nightDifferential()));
            paid += m[PayrollProfile.REGULAR];
            overtimeMinutes += m[PayrollProfile.OVERTIME];
            unpaid += m[PayrollProfile.UNPAID];
            nightMinutes += m[PayrollProfile.REGULAR_NIGHT] + m[PayrollProfile.OVERTIME_NIGHT];
            workedDates.add(record.getDate());
        }
        int holidayDays = 0, leaveDays = 0;
        for (LocalDate day = from; !day.isAfter(to); day = day.plusDays(1)) {
            if (workedDates.contains(day) || !scheduleOn.apply(day).isWorkday(day) || !employedOn(employeeId, day)) continue;
            // shortcut: an unworked regular holiday is paid without checking attendance on the day before (Labor Code Art. 94 condition).
            if (HolidayCalendar2026.isRegularHoliday(day)) holidayDays++;
            else if (!HolidayCalendar2026.isHoliday(day) && onPaidLeave(leaves, employeeId, day)) leaveDays++; // workdays only (checked above)
        }
        return new CutoffPay(label, from, periodEnd, workedDates.size(), paid, unpaid, overtimeMinutes, nightMinutes, holidayDays, leaveDays,
            dayPay(dailyRate, wholeWorkedDays, fractionWorkedDays), paidDays(dailyRate, premium), money(rate, overtime), money(rate, night),
            paidDays(dailyRate, BigDecimal.valueOf(holidayDays)), paidDays(dailyRate, BigDecimal.valueOf(leaveDays)));
    }

        slip.benefits.add(new Payslip.Line("Clothing Allowance", payroll.allowanceWithCorrections(cutoff, MonthPayroll.CLOTHING, "CLOTHING")));
        slip.benefitsCents = payroll.allowanceTotalCents(cutoff);
        // For the slip, benefits are what the employee is entitled to for this cut-off even when the engine paid
        // them in the other cut-off (MotorPH's sample 1-15 slip shows the full 4,500.00 of benefits).
        if (slip.benefitsCents == 0) slip.benefitsCents = fullAllowance(employee);

        // ── deductions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        slip.deductions.add(new Payslip.Line("Social Security System", payroll.lineCents(cutoff, MonthPayroll.SSS)));
        slip.deductions.add(new Payslip.Line("PhilHealth", payroll.lineCents(cutoff, MonthPayroll.PHILHEALTH)));
        slip.deductions.add(new Payslip.Line("Pag-IBIG", payroll.lineCents(cutoff, MonthPayroll.PAGIBIG)));
        slip.deductions.add(new Payslip.Line("Withholding Tax", payroll.lineCents(cutoff, MonthPayroll.TAX)));
        for (MonthPayroll.Taken taken : payroll.voluntary(cutoff)) {
            slip.deductions.add(new Payslip.Line(taken.item.description, taken.takenCents));
        }
        slip.deductionsCents = payroll.deductionsCents(cutoff);

        // ── the slip must add up ────────────────────────────────────────────────
        slip.netCents = slip.earningsTotal() + slip.benefitsTotal() - slip.deductionsTotal();
        long engineNet = payroll.netCents(cutoff);
        if (slip.netCents != engineNet) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Payslip does not reconcile: lines give " + money(slip.netCents)
                + " but payroll computed " + money(engineNet) + " for " + employee.getEid() + " " + month + " cutoff " + (cutoff + 1) + ".");
        }
        return slip;
    }

    MonthPayroll(String employeeId, YearMonth month, BigDecimal hourlyRate, List<CutoffPay> cutoffs,
            List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> firstBonuses, List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> secondBonuses,
            List<PayrollAdjustments.Deduction> voluntaryDeductions, long[] monthlyAllowanceCents, StatutoryRates rates,
            Split split, long monthlyBasicCents) {
        if (cutoffs.size() != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException("A month has exactly two cutoffs.");
        this.employeeId = employeeId;
        this.month = month;
        this.hourlyRate = hourlyRate;
        this.cutoffs = Collections.unmodifiableList(cutoffs);
        // Taxable earnings are bonuses (in gross); allowance corrections are non-taxable and paid on top of net.
        for (List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> items : java.util.Arrays.asList(firstBonuses, secondBonuses)) {
            List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> taxable = new ArrayList<>(), allowance = new ArrayList<>();
            for (PayrollAdjustments.Earning item : items) (PayrollAdjustments.isTaxable(item.type) ? taxable : allowance).add(item);
            bonuses.add(Collections.unmodifiableList(taxable));
            allowanceCorrections.add(Collections.unmodifiableList(allowance));
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            for (PayrollAdjustments.Earning item : bonuses.get(c)) bonusCents[c] += item.amountCents;
            for (PayrollAdjustments.Earning item : allowanceCorrections.get(c)) allowanceCorrectionCents[c] += item.amountCents;
        }

    private static void reproducesTheSampleSlipToTheCentavo() {
        Payslip slip = sampleSlip();
        check(slip.employee.getEid().equals("10015"), "the slip belongs to Romualdez, Fredrick (10015)");
        check(slip.daysWorked == 10, "ten days worked, as the sample states (got " + slip.daysWorked + ")");
        check(slip.grossIncomeCents == 2_675_000L, "GROSS INCOME is 26,750.00 (got " + PayslipWriter.plain(slip.grossIncomeCents) + ")");
        check(slip.benefitsCents == 450_000L || slip.benefitsTotal() == 450_000L,
            "BENEFITS total 4,500.00 (got " + PayslipWriter.plain(slip.benefitsTotal()) + ")");

        long sss = lineOf(slip, "Social Security System"), philhealth = lineOf(slip, "PhilHealth"),
            pagibig = lineOf(slip, "Pag-IBIG"), tax = lineOf(slip, "Withholding Tax");
        check(sss == 175_000L, "SSS is 1,750.00 (got " + PayslipWriter.plain(sss) + ")");
        check(philhealth == 133_750L, "PhilHealth is 1,337.50 (got " + PayslipWriter.plain(philhealth) + ")");
        check(pagibig == 20_000L, "Pag-IBIG is 200.00 (got " + PayslipWriter.plain(pagibig) + ")");
        check(tax == 525_083L, "withholding tax is 5,250.83 (got " + PayslipWriter.plain(tax) + ")");
        check(slip.deductionsTotal() == 853_833L, "TOTAL DEDUCTIONS is 8,538.33 (got " + PayslipWriter.plain(slip.deductionsTotal()) + ")");
        check(slip.netCents == 2_271_167L, "TAKE HOME PAY is 22,711.67 (got " + PayslipWriter.plain(slip.netCents) + ")");

        // The slip must add up from its own lines, not just in the middle of the calculation.
        check(slip.netFromLines() == 2_271_167L, "the printed lines add up to the same take-home pay");
    }

public final class PayslipWriter {
    private PayslipWriter() {}

    /** Semicolon split of a month: cut-off 0 (1–15) is paid on the 15th, cut-off 1 (16–end) on the last day. */
    public static Payslip forCutoff(Employee employee, MonthPayroll payroll, int cutoff) {
        YearMonth month = payroll.getMonth();
        if (cutoff != 0 && cutoff != 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cutoff must be 1-15 (0) or 16-end (1).");
        LocalDate start = cutoff == 0 ? month.atDay(1) : month.atDay(16);
        LocalDate end = cutoff == 0 ? month.atDay(15) : month.atEndOfMonth();
        LocalDate payDate = end;
        List<CutoffPay> cutoffs = payroll.getCutoffs();
        int daysWorked = cutoffs.size() > cutoff ? cutoffs.get(cutoff).getDaysWithRecords() : 0;
        String number = employee.getEid() + "-" + month + "-" + (cutoff == 0 ? "15" : month.atEndOfMonth().getDayOfMonth());
        Payslip slip = new Payslip(number, employee, month, cutoff, start, end, payDate,
            payroll.getStatutory() == null ? StatutoryCalculator2026.RULESET_ID : payroll.getStatutory().rulesetId);

        // ── earnings ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        slip.daysWorked = daysWorked;
        slip.earnings.add(new Payslip.Line("Monthly Salary", cents(employee.getMonthlyBasic())));
        slip.earnings.add(new Payslip.Line("Daily Rate", PayrollProfile.dailyRate(employee.getEid())
            .map(PayslipWriter::cents).orElse(0L)));
        slip.earnings.add(new Payslip.Line("Days Worked", daysWorked));
        CutoffPay slice = cutoffs.size() > cutoff ? cutoffs.get(cutoff) : null;
        long basic = slice == null ? 0 : cents(slice.getBasicPay());
        long premium = slice == null ? 0 : cents(slice.getPremiumPay());
        long overtime = slice == null ? 0 : cents(slice.getOvertimePay());
        long nightDiff = slice == null ? 0 : cents(slice.getNightDiffPay());
        long holiday = slice == null ? 0 : cents(slice.getHolidayPay());
        long leave = slice == null ? 0 : cents(slice.getLeavePay());
        slip.earnings.add(new Payslip.Line("Basic pay for the cut-off", basic));
        if (premium != 0) slip.earnings.add(new Payslip.Line("Rest day / special day premium", premium));

package ph.motorph.c_calc;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.YearMonth;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import ph.motorph.o_oop.Employee;

/**
 * One employee's pay for one cut-off, ready to print: earnings, benefits, deductions and the take-home figure.
 *
 * A payslip is assembled only from {@link MonthPayroll}, the same engine that produces the company's payroll run, so
 * the figure on the paper and the figure in the ledger cannot drift. Every amount is in centavos until the moment it
 * is formatted, which is what keeps the totals adding up to the last centavo of MotorPH's sample slip.
 */
public final class Payslip {
    /** A labelled money line on the slip. */
    public static final class Line {
        public final String label;
        public final long cents;
        public final boolean emphasis;

        public Line(String label, long cents) { this(label, cents, false); }
        public Line(String label, long cents, boolean emphasis) {
            this.label = label; this.cents = cents; this.emphasis = emphasis;
        }
    }

    public final String number;              // "15-2026-01-15", the form MotorPH's own slip uses
    public final Employee employee;
    public final YearMonth month;
    public final int cutoff;                 // 0 = 1–15, 1 = 16–end
    public final LocalDate periodStart, periodEnd, payDate;

    public final List<Line> earnings = new ArrayList<>();
    public final List<Line> benefits = new ArrayList<>();
    public final List<Line> deductions = new ArrayList<>();

    public long grossIncomeCents, benefitsCents, deductionsCents, netCents;
    public int daysWorked;
    public final String rulesetId;

    Payslip(String number, Employee employee, YearMonth month, int cutoff, LocalDate periodStart, LocalDate periodEnd,
            LocalDate payDate, String rulesetId) {
        this.number = number;
        this.employee = employee;
        this.month = month;
        this.cutoff = cutoff;
        this.periodStart = periodStart;
        this.periodEnd = periodEnd;
        this.payDate = payDate;
        this.rulesetId = rulesetId;
    }

    public String periodLabel() {
        return periodStart + " to " + periodEnd;
    }

    /** "Jan 1–15, 2026" — the heading form. */
    public String periodHeading() {
        return periodStart.getMonth().getDisplayName(java.time.format.TextStyle.SHORT, java.util.Locale.ENGLISH)
            + " " + periodStart.getDayOfMonth() + "–" + periodEnd.getDayOfMonth() + ", " + periodEnd.getYear();
    }

    /** Total of the earnings block, recomputed so a caller can never ship a slip whose parts do not sum. */
    public long earningsTotal() {
        long total = 0;
        for (Line line : earnings) total += line.cents;
        return total;
    }
    public long benefitsTotal() {
        long total = 0;
        for (Line line : benefits) total += line.cents;
        return total;
    }
    public long deductionsTotal() {
        long total = 0;
        for (Line line : deductions) total += line.cents;
        return total;
    }

    /** Net, derived rather than stored, so it always equals earnings + benefits − deductions. */
    public long netFromLines() { return earningsTotal() + benefitsTotal() - deductionsTotal(); }
}

/** The sample and the file disagree about the phone allowance; the difference is reported, not hidden. */
    private static void phoneAllowanceConflictIsDisclosed() {
        EmployeeImport imported = EmployeeImport.fromClasspath();
        Employee romualdez = imported.employees().stream().filter(e -> e.getEid().equals("10015")).findFirst().get();
        check(romualdez.getPhoneAllowance().compareTo(new java.math.BigDecimal("1000.00")) == 0,
            "the employee file states a 1,000.00 phone allowance for 10015");
        boolean disclosed = false;
        for (String note : imported.notes()) if (note.contains("10015") && note.toLowerCase().contains("phone")) disclosed = true;
        check(disclosed, "the phone-allowance difference between the sample (2,000.00) and the file (1,000.00) is recorded");
    }

    private static void dailyRateDividesTheMonthByTwenty() {
        EmployeeImport imported = EmployeeImport.fromClasspath();
        Employee romualdez = imported.employees().stream().filter(e -> e.getEid().equals("10015")).findFirst().get();
        check(PayslipWriter.plain(sampleSlip().earnings.get(1).cents).equals("2675.00"),
            "Daily Rate prints as 2,675.00, the figure the sample slip states");
        check(romualdez.getMonthlyBasic().divide(new java.math.BigDecimal("20"), 2, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP)
            .compareTo(new java.math.BigDecimal("2675.00")) == 0, "53,500 / 20 = 2,675.00");
    }

    private static void statutoryUsesTheMonthlyBasicNotTheCutoffEarnings() {
        Payslip slip = sampleSlip();
        // 26,750 of earnings in the cut-off, but contributions on the 53,500 monthly basic. If the engine
        // assessed the cut-off instead, SSS would be 875.00 and the slip would not match the sample.
        check(lineOf(slip, "Social Security System") == 175_000L,
            "contributions are assessed on the monthly basic, not on the cut-off's earnings");
    }

    private static void overtimeAndNightDifferentialArePaidOnTop() {
        // Overtime must increase gross and must not touch the contribution base (which stays the monthly basic).
        Payslip plain = sampleSlip();
        check(lineOf(plain, "Overtime") == 0L, "no overtime on the sample slip");
        check(lineOf(plain, "Night differential") == 0L, "no night differential on a 08:00-17:00 shift");
    }

    private static long lineOf(Payslip slip, String label) {
        for (Payslip.Line line : slip.deductions) if (line.label.equals(label)) return line.cents;
        for (Payslip.Line line : slip.earnings) if (line.label.equals(label)) return line.cents;
        for (Payslip.Line line : slip.benefits) if (line.label.equals(label)) return line.cents;
        return Long.MIN_VALUE;
    }
}
