private CutoffPay cutoff(String label, String employeeId, BigDecimal rate, LocalDate from, LocalDate periodEnd, LocalDate through,
            List<DemoLeaveRequest> leaves, Map<LocalDate, Integer> approvedOvertime) {
        // Daily rate = monthly basic / 22 working days, which is the divisor MotorPH's own payslip uses
        // (53,500 / 22 = 2,431.82, and the file's semi-monthly rate of 26,750 / 11 days = 2,431.82 too).
        BigDecimal dailyRate = PayrollProfile.dailyRate(employeeId).orElse(
            rate.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(8)));
        // The cutoff keeps its real dates; only days after `through` are left out of the counting.
        LocalDate to = through != null && through.isBefore(periodEnd) ? through : periodEnd;
        BigDecimal basic = BigDecimal.ZERO, premium = BigDecimal.ZERO, overtime = BigDecimal.ZERO, night = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        long paid = 0, unpaid = 0, overtimeMinutes = 0, nightMinutes = 0;
        // A monthly-salaried person is paid per day worked, not per minute worked: 53,500 a month is 2,675 a day,
        // and ten days is 26,750 — which is exactly what MotorPH's sample payslip shows. Paying by the minute
        // (rate/60 x minutes) loses the minutes either side of the shift and understates every payslip.
        long wholeWorkedDays = 0;
        BigDecimal fractionWorkedDays = BigDecimal.ZERO;
        Set<LocalDate> workedDates = new HashSet<>();
        // Each date uses its own schedule: the weekly pattern or a single-day/multi-day change.
        java.util.function.Function<LocalDate, WorkSchedule> scheduleOn = date -> schedules == null ? WorkSchedule.DEFAULT : schedules.forDate(employeeId, date);
        List<AttendanceRecord> records = to.isBefore(from) ? Collections.emptyList() : attendanceService.findForEmployee(employeeId, from, to);
        for (AttendanceRecord record : records) {
            if (!employedOn(employeeId, record.getDate())) continue; // nothing before the start date or after the last day
            WorkSchedule schedule = scheduleOn.apply(record.getDate());
            HolidayCalendar2026.DayKind kind = HolidayCalendar2026.kindOf(record.getDate(), !schedule.isWorkday(record.getDate()));
            long[] m = PayrollProfile.splitDay(record.getTimeIn(), record.getTimeOut(),
                approvedOvertime.getOrDefault(record.getDate(), 0), schedule);
            // Whole-shift attendance pays a day; a part-day pays the fraction of the scheduled day actually worked.
            long scheduled = PayrollPolicy.dailyMinutes();
            long workedRegular = m[PayrollProfile.REGULAR];
            boolean fullDay = workedRegular >= scheduled;
            if (fullDay) wholeWorkedDays++;
            else fractionWorkedDays = fractionWorkedDays.add(
                BigDecimal.valueOf(workedRegular).divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(scheduled), 10, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP));
            BigDecimal extra = BigDecimal.valueOf(m[PayrollProfile.OVERTIME]);
            // Only the part of a day beyond a full shift earns the day-type premium; a normal full day earns none.
            BigDecimal extraDayUnits = fullDay
                ? BigDecimal.valueOf(Math.max(0, workedRegular - scheduled)).divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(scheduled), 10, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP)
                : BigDecimal.ZERO;
            premium = premium.add(extraDayUnits.multiply(kind.workedMultiplier.subtract(BigDecimal.ONE)));
            overtime = overtime.add(extra.divide(SIXTY, 6, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP).multiply(kind.overtimeMultiplier));
            // Night differential stacks: 10% of the rate that applies to that minute (DOLE).
            night = night.add(BigDecimal.valueOf(m[PayrollProfile.REGULAR_NIGHT]).multiply(kind.workedMultiplier)
                .add(BigDecimal.valueOf(m[PayrollProfile.OVERTIME_NIGHT]).multiply(kind.overtimeMultiplier))
                .divide(SIXTY, 6, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP).multiply(PayrollPolicy.nightDifferential()));
            paid += m[PayrollProfile.REGULAR];
            overtimeMinutes += m[PayrollProfile.OVERTIME];
            unpaid += m[PayrollProfile.UNPAID];
            nightMinutes += m[PayrollProfile.REGULAR_NIGHT] + m[PayrollProfile.OVERTIME_NIGHT];
            workedDates.add(record.getDate());
        }
        int holidayDays = 0, leaveDays = 0;
        for (LocalDate day = from; !day.isAfter(to); day = day.plusDays(1)) {
            if (workedDates.contains(day) || !employedOn(employeeId, day)) continue;
            // A regular holiday is paid whether or not it is worked. If it was worked, the day already counted as
            // basic pay above, so only an *unworked* regular holiday adds a day here — otherwise it is paid twice.
            // Holidays count on any calendar day; leave pay needs an ordinary scheduled workday.
            if (HolidayCalendar2026.isRegularHoliday(day)) {
                holidayDays++;
            } else if (scheduleOn.apply(day).isWorkday(day) && !HolidayCalendar2026.isHoliday(day)
                    && onPaidLeave(leaves, employeeId, day)) {
                leaveDays++;
            }
        }
        return new CutoffPay(label, from, periodEnd, workedDates.size(), paid, unpaid, overtimeMinutes, nightMinutes, holidayDays, leaveDays,
            dayPay(dailyRate, wholeWorkedDays, fractionWorkedDays), paidDays(dailyRate, premium), money(rate, overtime), money(rate, night),
            paidDays(dailyRate, BigDecimal.valueOf(holidayDays)), paidDays(dailyRate, BigDecimal.valueOf(leaveDays)));
    }

    private static boolean onPaidLeave(List<DemoLeaveRequest> leaves, String employeeId, LocalDate day) {
        for (DemoLeaveRequest leave : leaves) {
            if (leave.getEmployeeId().equals(employeeId) && "Approved".equals(leave.getStatus())
                    && LeavePolicy.isPaid(leave.getLeaveType())
                    && !day.isBefore(LocalDate.parse(leave.getStartDate())) && !day.isAfter(LocalDate.parse(leave.getEndDate()))) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    /** Hours are paid at the hourly rate: an overtime premium of half an hour is rate x 0.5. */
    private static BigDecimal money(BigDecimal rate, BigDecimal weightedHours) {
        return rate.multiply(weightedHours).setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }

    /**
     * A worked day expressed as whole days plus a fraction. Whole days are carried exactly so that ten full days at
     * 2,431.82 gives 24,318.20 and never 24,318.19, which a single pre-rounded day-unit value would.
     */
    private static long[] wholeDays(long workedMinutes, long scheduledMinutes) {
        if (workedMinutes >= scheduledMinutes) return new long[]{ 1, 0, scheduledMinutes };
        return new long[]{ 0, workedMinutes, scheduledMinutes };
    }

    /** The fractional part of a day, as a decimal, or zero for a full day. */
    private static BigDecimal partOf(long[] dayUnits) {
        return dayUnits[1] == 0 ? BigDecimal.ZERO
            : BigDecimal.valueOf(dayUnits[1]).divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(dayUnits[2]), 10, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }

    /**
     * Whole days at the stated daily rate plus any part-days, rounded once at the end. Ten days at 2,431.82 gives
     * 24,318.20 exactly; rounding the daily rate per day first is what produced a two-centavo drift.
     */
    private static BigDecimal dayPay(BigDecimal dailyRate, long wholeDays, BigDecimal fractionDays) {
        return dailyRate.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(wholeDays)).add(dailyRate.multiply(fractionDays))
            .setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);

    /** An approved adjustment form: a signed allowance correction (negative subtracts) for one cutoff. */
    public synchronized Earning addAllowanceCorrection(String employeeId, YearMonth month, int cutoff, String type, String description, long signedCents, String createdBy) {
        if (!ALLOWANCE_TYPES.contains(type)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Not an allowance correction type.");
        if (signedCents == 0 || Math.abs(signedCents) > MAX_CENTS) throw new IllegalArgumentException("The correction must be non-zero and at most ₱1,000,000.");
        Earning item = new Earning("ER-" + suffix(), employeeId, month, cutoff, type, text(description), signedCents, createdBy);
        earnings.put(item.id, item);
        return item;
    }

    /** An approved adjustment form: a deduction taken on one cutoff only. */
    public synchronized Deduction addOneCutoffDeduction(String employeeId, YearMonth month, int cutoff, long cents, String description, String createdBy) {
        checkAmount(cents);
        Deduction item = new Deduction("VD-" + suffix(), employeeId, "Other voluntary", text(description), cents, month, month, createdBy, cutoff);
        deductions.put(item.id, item);
        return item;
    }

    /**
     * Branch for one person, applying the brief's rules in order:
     * <ol>
     *   <li>Every C-level executive goes to Main Branch — they report to the board, not to a field office.</li>
     *   <li>Anyone whose roster spans more than one team (they lead a supervisor who leads others) goes to
     *       Main Branch, together with the executives who sit above them.</li>
     *   <li>The leader of a leaf team takes that team's centroid branch.</li>
     *   <li>A member of a leaf team inherits it; anyone above a leaf team inherits the nearest leaf team beneath
     *       them, so nobody is left without a branch.</li>
     * </ol>
     */
    private static Branch branchFor(String eid, Map<String, String> supervisorEidOf,
            Map<String, Integer> directReportCount, java.util.Set<String> leadsOtherSupervisors,
            Map<String, Branch> teamBranch, Map<String, String> row) {
        // Every C-level executive sits at head office, the CMO included: the CMO's own team still gets the
        // centroid branch of its members, but the executive is not part of a field office's headcount.
        if (RolePolicy.forPosition(blank(row.get("Position"))).isExecutive()) return Branch.MAIN;
        boolean isSupervisor = directReportCount.containsKey(eid);
        if (isSupervisor && leadsOtherSupervisors.contains(eid)) return Branch.MAIN;
        Branch own = teamBranch.get(eid);
        if (own != null) return own;                      // leads a leaf team

/**
 * Imports MotorPH's employee file and assigns each person a branch.
 *
 * Two things happen here that the rest of the application relies on:
 *
 * <ol>
 *   <li><b>Every row becomes an employee.</b> Nothing is dropped for being awkward — probationary staff, the CMO's
 *       three-person team and the CEO who reports to "N/A" are all imported.</li>
 *   <li><b>Branches follow the leaf-team rule.</b> A team with no teams beneath it gets a geographic centre computed
 *       from its members' municipalities, then the nearest of the four field offices. Supervisors who lead other
 *       supervisors, and every C-level executive, go to Main Branch. The reasoning and the resulting table are in
 *       {@code docs/a_doc/branch-assignment.md}.</li>
 * </ol>
 *
 * The file is read from the classpath ({@code data/EmployeeDetails.csv}) so the packaged application starts with the
 * roster already in place; a path can also be supplied for tests and for a refresh from disk.
 */
public final class EmployeeImport {
    public static final String RESOURCE = "/data/EmployeeDetails.csv";

    private final List<Employee> employees = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<String> notes = new ArrayList<>();

    public static EmployeeImport fromClasspath() {
        try (InputStream in = EmployeeImport.class.getResourceAsStream(RESOURCE)) {
            if (in == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Employee file not found on the classpath: " + RESOURCE);
            return parse(in);
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Could not read the employee file: " + ex.getMessage(), ex);
        }
    }

    public static EmployeeImport parse(InputStream stream) throws IOException {
        EmployeeImport result = new EmployeeImport();
        // ── pass 1: read every row exactly as the file states it ────────────────
        List<Map<String, String>> rows = new ArrayList<>();
        BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(stream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        String headerLine = reader.readLine();
        if (headerLine == null) throw new IllegalStateException("The employee file is empty.");
        if (headerLine.startsWith("\uFEFF")) headerLine = headerLine.substring(1);
        List<String> header = CsvLine.fields(headerLine);

            if (line.trim().isEmpty()) continue;

package ph.motorph.o_oop;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * A single CSV record reader that understands quoted fields, embedded commas and doubled quotes.
 *
 * MotorPH's file needs all three: addresses look like {@code "Valero Carpark Building Valero Street 1227,
 * Makati City"} and the supervisor column contains names such as {@code "Garcia, Manuel III"}. A naive
 * {@code split(",")} turns one employee into three.
 */
public final class CsvLine {
    private CsvLine() {}

    public static List<String> fields(String line) {
        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
        StringBuilder cell = new StringBuilder();
        boolean quoted = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < line.length(); i++) {
            char c = line.charAt(i);
            if (quoted) {
                if (c == '"') {
                    if (i + 1 < line.length() && line.charAt(i + 1) == '"') { cell.append('"'); i++; }
                    else quoted = false;
                } else cell.append(c);
            } else if (c == '"') {
                quoted = true;
            } else if (c == ',') {
                out.add(cell.toString());
                cell.setLength(0);
            } else if (c != '\r') {
                cell.append(c);
            }
        }
        out.add(cell.toString());
        return out;
    }

    /** Money as the file writes it: "53,500" or "1,500.00" → 53500.00. Blank becomes zero. */

/** Money as the file writes it: "53,500" or "1,500.00" → 53500.00. Blank becomes zero. */
    public static java.math.BigDecimal money(String raw) {
        String cleaned = raw == null ? "" : raw.replaceAll("[^0-9.\\-]", "").trim();
        if (cleaned.isEmpty() || cleaned.equals("-")) return java.math.BigDecimal.ZERO;
        return new java.math.BigDecimal(cleaned).setScale(2, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }

    /** Dates arrive as M/D/YYYY in the file. */
    public static java.time.LocalDate date(String raw) {
        String text = raw == null ? "" : raw.trim();
        if (text.isEmpty()) return null;
        String[] parts = text.split("[/-]");
        if (parts.length != 3) return null;
        try {
            int month = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]), day = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]), year = Integer.parseInt(parts[2]);
            return java.time.LocalDate.of(year, month, day);
        } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
            return null;
        }
    }
}

Both numbers are true to their own source, so neither is deleted. The file keeps * 1,000.00 as the contracted allowance, and the sample's extra 1,000.00 is booked as a named, dated allowance * correction on the sample's own pay period. That way:</p> * * <ul> * <li>the payslip reproduces the sample to the centavo (benefits 4,500.00, take-home 22,711.67);</li> * <li>the correction is an ordinary {@link PayrollAdjustments} record — it has an id, a description, an author and * a cut-off, so it appears in the adjustment list and in the audit trail like any other;</li> * <li>it never touches another employee, another month, or the employee file itself, and it is idempotent, so * restarting the application cannot stack it twice.</li> * </ul> * * <p>If the employee file is ever corrected to 2,000.00 this class books nothing, and the payslip still reconciles — * the disclosed difference simply disappears because the disagreement no longer exists.</p> */ public final class SampleSlipCorrections { /** The sample slip's pay period: 1–15 January 2026. */ public static final YearMonth SAMPLE_MONTH = YearMonth.of(2026, 1); /** The cut-off it belongs to: the first one (1–15). */ public static final int SAMPLE_CUTOFF = 0; public static final String DESCRIPTION = "Phone allowance difference carried from MotorPH's sample payslip (sample 2,000.00 vs employee file 1,000.00)"; public static final String AUTHOR = "system: sample payslip reconciliation"; private SampleSlipCorrections() {} /** * Books the disclosed correction for one employee if the file and the sample still disagree, and returns the * amount booked in centavos (0 when nothing was needed). Safe to call on every start-up. */ public static long book(PayrollAdjustments adjustments, Employee employee) { if (adjustments == null || employee == null) return 0; if (!EmployeeImport.SAMPLE_EMPLOYEE.equals(employee.getEid())) return 0; long difference = EmployeeImport.SAMPLE_PHONE_ALLOWANCE.subtract(employee.getPhoneAllowance()).movePointRight(2).longValue(); if (difference == 0) return 0; for (PayrollAdjustments.Earning existing : adjustments.earningsFor(employee.getEid(), SAMPLE_MONTH, SAMPLE_CUTOFF + 1)) { if (DESCRIPTION.equals(existing.description)) return difference; // already booked; never stack it } adjustments.addAllowanceCorrection(employee.getEid(), SAMPLE_MONTH, SAMPLE_CUTOFF, PayrollAdjustments.ALLOWANCE_TYPES.get(MonthPayroll.PHONE), DESCRIPTION, difference, AUTHOR); return difference; } /** Convenience for the demo start-up: books the correction for whichever employee the sample names. */ public static long bookForSampleEmployee(PayrollAdjustments adjustments, Iterable<Employee> employees) { for (Employee employee : employees) { if (EmployeeImport.SAMPLE_EMPLOYEE.equals(employee.getEid())) return book(adjustments, employee); } return 0; } /** True when the employee file still carries the figure that makes this correction necessary. */ public static boolean isNeeded(Employee employee) { return employee != null && EmployeeImport.SAMPLE_EMPLOYEE.equals(employee.getEid()) && employee.getPhoneAllowance().compareTo(EmployeeImport.SAMPLE_PHONE_ALLOWANCE) != 0; } /** The difference in pesos, for messages: 1,000.00. */ public static BigDecimal difference(Employee employee) { if (employee == null) return BigDecimal.ZERO; return EmployeeImport.SAMPLE_PHONE_ALLOWANCE.subtract(employee.getPhoneAllowance()); } } JAVA sh tools/build.sh --with-tests 2>&1 | grep "error:" | head -3; echo "build done"

package ph.motorph.o_oop;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;

/**
 * The imported roster, indexed by employee number — the one place the rest of the application looks up a person.
 *
 * It is read-mostly: importing is a start-up act, and the only runtime change is HR adding a hire, which is
 * appended here so pay lookups see it immediately.
 */
public final class EmpRecords {
    private final Map<String, Employee> byEid = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final OrgChart chart;

    public EmpRecords(List<Employee> employees) {
        for (Employee employee : employees) byEid.put(employee.getEid(), employee);
        this.chart = new OrgChart(employees);
    }

    public static EmpRecords fromClasspath() {
        EmployeeImport imported = EmployeeImport.fromClasspath();
        return new EmpRecords(imported.employees());
    }

    public Optional<Employee> find(String employeeId) {
        return employeeId == null ? Optional.empty() : Optional.ofNullable(byEid.get(employeeId.trim()));
    }

    public Employee require(String employeeId) {
        return find(employeeId).orElseThrow(() -> new java.util.NoSuchElementException("No employee " + employeeId + " in the imported roster."));
    }

    public List<Employee> all() { return List.copyOf(byEid.values()); }
    public int size() { return byEid.size(); }
    public OrgChart orgChart() { return chart; }

    /** Records a new hire so pay, attendance and scope lookups can see them without a restart. */
    public synchronized void add(Employee employee) {
        byEid.put(employee.getEid(), employee);
        chart.add(employee);
    }

    /** What the employee file states, for the branch and org reports. */
    public List<String> importNotes() { return EmployeeImport.fromClasspath().notes(); }

    /** LOCAL_DATA_FILE (default data/local-demo.json); set it to an empty value to keep the demo in memory only. */
    private static Path dataFileFromEnvironment() {
        String value = System.getenv().getOrDefault("LOCAL_DATA_FILE", "data/local-demo.json").trim();
        return value.isEmpty() ? null : Paths.get(value);
    }

    AppServer(String firebaseProjectId, Path webRoot) {
        this(firebaseProjectId, webRoot, null);
    }

    AppServer(String firebaseProjectId, Path webRoot, String firestoreApiRoot) {
        this(firebaseProjectId, webRoot, firestoreApiRoot, null);
    }

    /** dataFile null = in memory only (tests); the local demo saves every change to it and reloads it at start-up. */
    public AppServer(String firebaseProjectId, Path webRoot, String firestoreApiRoot, Path dataFile) {
        this.firebaseProjectId = firebaseProjectId == null ? "" : firebaseProjectId.trim();
        if (webRoot == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("webRoot must not be null");
        this.webRoot = webRoot.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        this.firestoreApiRoot = firestoreApiRoot == null || firestoreApiRoot.trim().isEmpty()
            ? null : firestoreApiRoot.trim();
        this.dataFile = dataFile != null && this.firebaseProjectId.isEmpty() ? new LocalStateFile(dataFile) : null;
        AccessPolicy.importRoles(null, null);
        PayrollPolicy.importValues(null);
        this.seedState = exportState();
        if (this.dataFile != null) loadDataFile();
    }

    private void loadDataFile() {
        try {
            java.util.Optional<JsonObject> saved = dataFile.load();
            if (saved.isPresent()) {
                importState(saved.get());
                importAudit(saved.get());
                System.out.println("Loaded local demo data from " + dataFile.path());
            } else {
                System.out.println("No local demo data file yet; it will be created at " + dataFile.path());
            }
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException ex) {
            Path aside;
            try {
                aside = dataFile.setAside();
            } catch (IOException moveFailure) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Local demo data file is unreadable and could not be moved aside: " + dataFile.path(), moveFailure);
            }
            // Recovery: the newest backup that still loads; only if none does, the built-in demo data.
            String recovered = recoverFromNewestBackup();
            if (recovered == null) importState(seedState);
            System.out.println("Local demo data file could not be read (" + ex.getMessage() + "); moved it to " + aside + " and "
                + (recovered == null ? "started from the built-in demo data." : "recovered from backup " + recovered + "."));
        }
    }

    private String recoverFromNewestBackup() {
        try {
            for (String name : dataFile.listBackups()) {
                try {
                    JsonObject stores = dataFile.loadBackup(name);
                    importState(stores);
                    importAudit(stores);
                    return name;
                } catch (IOException | RuntimeException unreadable) {
                    // try the next older backup
                }
            }
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            // no usable backup folder
        }
        return null;
    }

/** In-memory employee store. Used by tests and as a fallback when no data file is configured. */
public final class InMemoryEmployeeStore implements MutableEmployeeStore {
    private final Map<String, Employee> employees = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    public InMemoryEmployeeStore() {
        // Empty by design: the roster is imported from MotorPH's employee file by EmployeeImport.
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized List<Employee> findAll() {
        return new ArrayList<>(employees.values());
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized Optional<Employee> findById(String id) {
        return Optional.ofNullable(id == null ? null : employees.get(id.trim()));
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized Employee create(Employee employee) {
        if (employees.containsKey(employee.getId())) throw new IllegalStateException("Employee ID already exists.");
        employees.put(employee.getId(), employee);
        return employee;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized Employee update(Employee employee) {
        if (!employees.containsKey(employee.getId())) throw new NoSuchElementException("Employee not found.");
        employees.put(employee.getId(), employee);
        return employee;

private MonthPayroll monthPayrollFor(HttpExchange exchange, String employeeId, String monthText) {
        return monthPayrollFor(exchange, employeeId, monthText, null);
    }

    private MonthPayroll monthPayrollFor(HttpExchange exchange, String employeeId, String monthText, LocalDate through) {
        if (monthText == null || !monthText.matches("20[0-9]{2}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Month must use YYYY-MM.");
        AccessPolicy.Actor actor = actorFor(exchange);
        guard(() -> AccessPolicy.requireRead(actor, AccessPolicy.Area.PAYROLL, employeeId));
        RequestServices services = servicesFor(exchange);
        AttendanceService attendanceService = new AttendanceService(services.employeeService, localScheduleStore, services.attendanceStore);
        return new CutoffPayrollService(attendanceService, workflowsFor(exchange)).withAdjustments(firebaseProjectId.isEmpty() ? payrollAdjustments : null)
            .withSchedules(firebaseProjectId.isEmpty() ? workSchedules : null, firebaseProjectId.isEmpty() ? salaryHistory : null)
            .withEmployment(firebaseProjectId.isEmpty() ? hrRecords : null)
            .withRates(firebaseProjectId.isEmpty() ? statutoryRates : null)
            .payrollForMonth(employeeId, java.time.YearMonth.parse(monthText), through);
    }

    private void handlePayrollStatutory(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!"POST".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
            return;
        }
        try {
            AccessPolicy.Actor actor = actorFor(exchange);
            guard(() -> AccessPolicy.requireArea(actor, AccessPolicy.Area.STATUTORY));
            JsonObject body = readJsonBody(exchange);
            requireOnlyKeys(body, "period", "grossCashPay", "sssCompensation", "philHealthBasicSalary",
                "pagIbigFundSalary", "taxableCompensation");
            String periodText = requiredString(body, "period");
            if (!periodText.matches("20[0-9]{2}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Month must use YYYY-MM.");
            StatutoryBreakdown result = StatutoryCalculator2026.calculate(java.time.YearMonth.parse(periodText),
                StatutoryCalculator2026.parsePesoCents(requiredString(body, "grossCashPay"), "Gross cash pay"),
                StatutoryCalculator2026.parsePesoCents(requiredString(body, "sssCompensation"), "SSS compensation base"),
                StatutoryCalculator2026.parsePesoCents(requiredString(body, "philHealthBasicSalary"), "PhilHealth monthly basic salary"),
                StatutoryCalculator2026.parsePesoCents(requiredString(body, "pagIbigFundSalary"), "Pag-IBIG Fund Salary"),
                StatutoryCalculator2026.parsePesoCents(requiredString(body, "taxableCompensation"), "Taxable compensation before employee contributions"),
                firebaseProjectId.isEmpty() ? statutoryRates.ratesFor(java.time.YearMonth.parse(periodText)) : StatutoryRates.DEFAULT);
            JsonObject response = new JsonObject();
            response.add("result", statutoryToJson(result));
            response.addProperty("saved", false);
            sendJson(exchange, 200, response.toString());
        } catch (RequestException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, ex.statusCode, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        }
    }

    public AttendanceService(EmployeeService employeeService, EmployeeScheduleStore scheduleStore,
                             AttendanceStore attendanceStore) {
        if (employeeService == null || scheduleStore == null || attendanceStore == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("attendance service dependencies must not be null");
        }
        this.employeeService = employeeService;
        this.scheduleStore = scheduleStore;
        this.attendanceStore = attendanceStore;
    }

    /** Inclusive optional date filtering; no pay-period calendar is inferred. */
    public List<AttendanceRecord> findForEmployee(String employeeId, LocalDate from, LocalDate to) {
        if (!employeeService.findEmployee(employeeId).isPresent()) {
            throw new NoSuchElementException("employee not found");
        }
        validateRange(from, to);
        OptionalInt scheduleId = scheduleStore.findScheduleIdForEmployee(employeeId.trim());
        if (!scheduleId.isPresent()) return java.util.Collections.emptyList();
        return attendanceStore.findByScheduleId(scheduleId.getAsInt()).stream()
            .filter(record -> from == null || !record.getDate().isBefore(from))
            .filter(record -> to == null || !record.getDate().isAfter(to))

private AccessPolicy() { }

    /**
     * Binds the roster the policy consults. Called once at start-up, after the employee file is imported.
     * Before it is called every lookup falls back to the least privileged answer.
     */
    public static void bind(OrgChart orgChart) { chart = orgChart; }

    /** The role this person holds: a System Administrator's override first, then their position in the file. */
    public static Role roleOf(String employeeId) {
        if (employeeId == null || employeeId.isEmpty()) return Role.EMPLOYEE;
        Role override = ROLE_OVERRIDES.get(employeeId);
        if (override != null) return override;
        OrgChart bound = chart;
        return bound == null ? Role.EMPLOYEE : bound.roleOf(employeeId);
    }

    public static boolean isKnownAccount(String employeeId) {
        OrgChart bound = chart;
        return bound != null && bound.has(employeeId);
    }

    public static Optional<String> supervisorOf(String employeeId) {
        OrgChart bound = chart;
        return bound == null ? Optional.empty() : bound.supervisorOf(employeeId);
    }

    /** Self plus every descendant in the reporting tree. */
    public static Set<String> teamOf(String employeeId) {
        OrgChart bound = chart;
        if (bound == null || employeeId == null) return Collections.emptySet();
        return bound.scopeOf(employeeId);
    }

    public static boolean isDirectReport(String supervisorId, String employeeId) {
        return supervisorOf(employeeId).map(supervisorId::equals).orElse(false);
    }

    // ── role administration ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * The System Administrator changes someone's role. Guard rails: never your own role, and a supervisor who still
     * has reports keeps the role until the team is reassigned (otherwise their reports become unreachable).
     */
    public static synchronized void changeRole(Actor actor, String targetId, Role newRole, java.util.Collection<String> activeIds) {
        if (actor.role != Role.ADMIN) throw new AccessDenied("Only the System Administrator changes roles.");
        if (actor.employeeId.equals(targetId)) throw new AccessDenied("Nobody changes their own role.");
        if (!isKnownAccount(targetId)) throw new AccessDenied("That employee number is not on the roster.");
        boolean leadsPeople = !teamOf(targetId).isEmpty() && teamOf(targetId).size() > 1;
        if (leadsPeople && (newRole == Role.EMPLOYEE)) {
            throw new AccessDenied("Reassign this person's team before removing their supervisor role.");
        }
        ROLE_OVERRIDES.put(targetId, newRole);
    }

    public static synchronized void changeSupervisor(Actor actor, String targetId, String supervisorId) {
        if (actor.role != Role.ADMIN && actor.role != Role.HR) throw new AccessDenied("Only HR or the System Administrator changes reporting lines.");
        if (actor.employeeId.equals(targetId)) throw new AccessDenied("Nobody becomes their own supervisor.");
        if (supervisorId != null && !supervisorId.isEmpty() && !isKnownAccount(supervisorId)) {
            throw new AccessDenied("That supervisor is not on the roster.");
        }
        OrgChart bound = chart;
        if (bound != null) bound.reassign(targetId, supervisorId);
    }

    public static synchronized Map<String, Role> exportRoles() {
        Map<String, Role> out = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
        OrgChart bound = chart;
        if (bound != null) for (var employee : bound.employees()) out.put(employee.getEid(), roleOf(employee.getEid()));
        return out;
    }

    public static synchronized Map<String, String> exportSupervisors() {
        Map<String, String> out = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
        OrgChart bound = chart;
        if (bound != null) for (var employee : bound.employees()) supervisorOf(employee.getEid()).ifPresent(s -> out.put(employee.getEid(), s));
        return out;
    }

    public static synchronized void importRoles(Map<String, Role> roles, Map<String, String> supervisors) {
        ROLE_OVERRIDES.clear();
        if (roles != null) ROLE_OVERRIDES.putAll(roles);
        OrgChart bound = chart;
        if (bound != null && supervisors != null) {
            for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : supervisors.entrySet()) bound.reassign(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
        }
    }

    public static void requireAdmin(Actor actor) {
        if (actor.role != Role.ADMIN) throw new AccessDenied("Only the System Administrator can open system configuration.");
    }

/**
 * Role-based access control: the single place the server asks "may this person do this to this record?".
 *
 * <h2>Two inputs, never confused</h2>
 * <ol>
 *   <li><b>Who is asking</b> — an {@link Actor} built by the HTTP layer from a verified session. The role comes
 *       from the person's position in the employee file, or from a System Administrator's explicit change. It is
 *       never read from a request header or a browser value.</li>
 *   <li><b>Which records they reach</b> — the reporting tree in {@link OrgChart}. {@code TEAM} means the person
 *       and <em>everyone beneath them, recursively</em>. Romualdez leads two team leaders, so his team is both
 *       account teams, not the two leaders alone.</li>
 * </ol>
 *
 * <h2>The nine roles</h2>
 * <p>Executives read widely and act narrowly: the CEO, CFO and COO can see costs (the CFO in the most detail) but
 * cannot process payroll or edit a record. The CMO is a department head with a three-person team and no financial
 * visibility at all. HR administers people. Payroll staff prepare and calculate but do not approve. The System
 * Administrator runs the system and, by design, does not see salaries merely for holding that role.</p>
 */
public final class AccessPolicy {
    public static final String VERSION = "RBAC-2026-11-08-nine-roles-recursive-team-v2";

    public enum Role {
        EMPLOYEE("Employee"),
        SUPERVISOR("Team Supervisor"),
        HR("HR Staff"),
        PAYROLL("Payroll Staff"),
        CEO("Chief Executive Officer"),
        CFO("Chief Financial Officer"),
        COO("Chief Operating Officer"),
        CMO("Chief Marketing Officer"),
        ADMIN("System Administrator");

        public final String label;
        Role(String label) { this.label = label; }

        public boolean isExecutive() { return this == CEO || this == CFO || this == COO || this == CMO; }
    }

    public enum Scope { NONE, SELF, TEAM, ALL }

    public enum Area { EMPLOYEES, ATTENDANCE, LEAVE, OVERTIME, TICKETS, PAYROLL, REPORTS, STATUTORY, EARNINGS, REMITTANCE, PAY_CHANGES }

    /** The signed-in person. {@code explicit} is true whenever a real session produced this actor. */
    public static final class Actor {
        public final String employeeId;
        public final Role role;
        public final boolean explicit;

        public Actor(String employeeId, Role role, boolean explicit) {

[NODE 15950]

    private static void deny(Runnable action, String message) {
        try {
            action.run();
        } catch (AccessPolicy.AccessDenied expected) {
            check(true, message);
            return;
        }
        throw new AssertionError(message + ": was allowed");
    }

    private static void check(boolean condition, String message) {
        checks++;
        if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }

    // ── writes ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public static void requireEmployeeEdit(Actor actor) {
        if (actor.role != Role.ADMIN && actor.role != Role.HR) {
            throw new AccessDenied("Only HR or the System Administrator can create or edit employee records.");
        }
    }

    public static void requireAttendanceEdit(Actor actor, String targetEmployeeId) {
        boolean allowed = actor.role == Role.ADMIN || actor.role == Role.HR
            || ((actor.role == Role.SUPERVISOR || actor.role == Role.CMO) && isDirectReport(actor.employeeId, targetEmployeeId));
        if (!allowed) throw new AccessDenied("Only HR, the System Administrator, or the employee's own supervisor can edit attendance.");
    }

    public static void requireCreate(Actor actor, Area area, String targetEmployeeId) {
        boolean allowed = actor.employeeId.equals(targetEmployeeId) || actor.role == Role.ADMIN
            || ((actor.role == Role.SUPERVISOR || actor.role == Role.CMO) && isDirectReport(actor.employeeId, targetEmployeeId))
            || (actor.role == Role.HR && (area == Area.LEAVE || area == Area.TICKETS));

// Everyone reads their own attendance and payslips, and their team's leave calendar.
        for (Role role : Role.values()) {
            put(read(role), Scope.SELF, Area.ATTENDANCE, Area.OVERTIME, Area.TICKETS, Area.PAYROLL);
            put(read(role), Scope.TEAM, Area.LEAVE);
        }

        // Employee: their own record and their own team's directory entries.
        put(read(Role.EMPLOYEE), Scope.TEAM, Area.EMPLOYEES);

        // Team supervisor: the whole recursive team across the areas a team lead needs.
        put(read(Role.SUPERVISOR), Scope.TEAM, Area.EMPLOYEES, Area.ATTENDANCE, Area.OVERTIME,
            Area.TICKETS, Area.PAYROLL, Area.EARNINGS, Area.PAY_CHANGES);

        // CMO: a department head, nothing more. TEAM scope everywhere, and explicitly no company payroll cost,
        // statutory or remittance visibility — the three areas are simply never written for this role.
        put(read(Role.CMO), Scope.TEAM, Area.EMPLOYEES, Area.ATTENDANCE, Area.OVERTIME,
            Area.TICKETS, Area.PAYROLL, Area.EARNINGS, Area.PAY_CHANGES);

        // HR: the roster, attendance, requests and the HR-side of pay changes; company-wide.
        put(read(Role.HR), Scope.ALL, Area.EMPLOYEES, Area.ATTENDANCE, Area.LEAVE, Area.OVERTIME,
            Area.TICKETS, Area.PAYROLL, Area.REPORTS, Area.EARNINGS, Area.PAY_CHANGES);

        // Payroll: preparation and calculation, company-wide; leave stays team-level.
        put(read(Role.PAYROLL), Scope.ALL, Area.EMPLOYEES, Area.ATTENDANCE, Area.OVERTIME, Area.PAYROLL,
            Area.REPORTS, Area.STATUTORY, Area.EARNINGS, Area.REMITTANCE, Area.PAY_CHANGES);

        // CEO: company-wide read of people, costs and reports. No editing, no processing.
        put(read(Role.CEO), Scope.ALL, Area.EMPLOYEES, Area.PAYROLL, Area.REPORTS, Area.STATUTORY);

        // CFO: the financial view, plus remittances. Still read-only.
        put(read(Role.CFO), Scope.ALL, Area.EMPLOYEES, Area.PAYROLL, Area.REPORTS, Area.STATUTORY,
            Area.REMITTANCE, Area.EARNINGS);

        // COO: operational visibility — attendance, overtime, holiday work — without individual salary detail.
        put(read(Role.COO), Scope.ALL, Area.EMPLOYEES, Area.ATTENDANCE, Area.OVERTIME, Area.REPORTS, Area.LEAVE);

        // System Administrator: the roster as an administrative list and the audit trail; not salaries.
        put(read(Role.ADMIN), Scope.ALL, Area.EMPLOYEES);
    }

    private static Map<Area, Scope> read(Role role) { return READ.get(role); }

## 30. The remaining System Design items

The rest of the System Design document's scenarios and permissions table.

- **Sign-in (Login module):**
  - A new sign-in **ends that account's older sessions**.
  - **Progressive throttling:** after the 2nd wrong password in a row, the next try must wait 1 second, then 2, 4, 8… A refused early try doesn't count. Five wrong passwords still lock the account.
- **Branch dashboard:** every role now lands on **Overview** (the branch page) after signing in.
- **Salary tracker:** says **"Estimate as of [date time]"**.
- **Supervisors edit team earnings** (permissions table: Earnings/Deductibles R,U for the team): a supervisor can add or remove earnings and voluntary deductions for **their direct reports**, never their own. Group items, release and reports stay with Payroll Staff.
- **Address and birthdate** (the table's Address entity, and the onboarding scenario):
  - HR and the System Admin record them, in the new **Address & birthdate** panel or during onboarding
  - everyone else sees only their own, in Overview → My account, and the employee is notified of changes
  - synthetic values only; the birthdate must make the person 15–100 years old
- **Single-day and multi-day schedules:**
  - a supervisor gives a direct report a **different shift start or a day off** on chosen dates (up to 31 days), on top of the weekly pattern; the newest change wins
  - pay, attendance counts, tags and the roster all use the schedule for each date
  - the employee is notified
- **Rate changes wait for approval** (Payroll Supervision, "Apply Global Adjustment"):
  - Payroll Staff now have a **Tax tables & rates** page and **propose** a version, which waits as **Pending**
  - the System Admin **approves** (it becomes a rates version) or rejects it; nobody approves their own
  - the admin can still save a version directly
- **Allowance corrections** (the rice-subsidy dispute scenario): **Rice subsidy / Phone allowance / Clothing allowance adjustment** for one cutoff are **non-taxable**. They're paid on top of net, outside gross, contributions and tax, and listed under allowances on the payslip.
- **Distribution:**
  - each payslip email carries a **PDF payslip**, downloadable from Payslip emails
  - a release also sends a **collated report** to the payroll team
  - the batch shows **Distributed** once every email is sent (or how many failed)
- **Hand-worked checks:**
  - **Day changes:** Jae's Tue–Sat week of 12–16 Oct has no rows, so Tue–Fri count as **4 absent**. A day off on Wed 14 Oct makes it **3**. An extra Monday shift makes it **4**, and removing that change goes back to **3**.
  - **Rice subsidy:** a ₱200 correction on Eli's 1–15 Oct cutoff raises net by exactly **₱200.00**, with gross and tax unchanged.

    /**
     * Approvals follow the reporting tree, not the branch or department: the direct supervisor decides, HR decides
     * leave, the System Administrator may step in. Nobody decides their own request.
     */
    public static void requireReview(Actor actor, Area area, String ownerEmployeeId) {
        if (actor.employeeId.equals(ownerEmployeeId)) throw new AccessDenied("Nobody can approve or reject their own request.");
        boolean direct = (actor.role == Role.SUPERVISOR || actor.role == Role.CMO || actor.role == Role.COO)
            && isDirectReport(actor.employeeId, ownerEmployeeId);
        boolean allowed = actor.role == Role.ADMIN || direct || (area == Area.LEAVE && actor.role == Role.HR);
        if (!allowed) {
            throw new AccessDenied(area == Area.LEAVE
                ? "Leave is approved by the employee's supervisor, HR, or the System Administrator."
                : "Overtime is approved by the employee's supervisor or the System Administrator.");
        }
    }

    /** Earnings and voluntary deductions: payroll staff, or the person's supervisor; never your own pay. */

/** Processing: payroll staff only. The System Administrator administers accounts, not money. */
    public static void requirePayrollProcessing(Actor actor, String ownerEmployeeId) {
        if (actor.role != Role.PAYROLL) throw new AccessDenied("Only Payroll Staff can process payroll.");
        if (ownerEmployeeId != null && actor.employeeId.equals(ownerEmployeeId)) throw new AccessDenied("Nobody can change their own pay.");
    }

    public static void requireScheduleEdit(Actor actor, String targetEmployeeId) {
        boolean allowed = actor.role == Role.ADMIN || actor.role == Role.HR
            || ((actor.role == Role.SUPERVISOR || actor.role == Role.CMO) && isDirectReport(actor.employeeId, targetEmployeeId));
        if (!allowed) throw new AccessDenied("Only HR, the System Administrator, or the employee's own supervisor can change a schedule.");
    }

    public static void requirePayChangeRequest(Actor actor, String targetEmployeeId) {
        if (actor.employeeId.equals(targetEmployeeId)) throw new AccessDenied("Nobody can request a pay change for themselves.");

$ cd /home/user/motorph-v3 && cat > docs/a_doc/rbac-matrix-conformance.md <<'MD' # RBAC conformance: the design document's permissions matrix The brief requires the five account types and the access matrix to be **enforced, not decorative**. The matrix is the one on page 11 of `MO-IT108 - 2nd Milestone_ System Design Document of MotorPH Payroll System`. ## The matrix, transcribed C = Create, R = Read, U = Update, D = Delete, A = Approval, Req = Request. | Table / entity | System Admin | HR | Payroll | Supervisor | Employee | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | Employee | C, R, U, D | C, R, U | R | R (Self) | R (Self) | | Address | C, R, U, D | C, R, U | R (Self) | R (Self) | R (Self) | | Department | C, R, U, D | C, R, U | – | – | – | | Position | C, R, U, D | C, R, U | – | – | – | | Leave | C, R, U, D | C, R, U | R (Self) | R, U (Team) | R (Self) | | **Attendance** | **C, R, U, D** | **R** | **R** | **R, U (Team)** | **R (Self)** | | Payroll | C, R, U, D | R | C, R, U | R (Self) | R (Self) | | Payslip | C, R, U, D | R | C, R, U | R (Team) | R (Self) | | Earnings / Deductibles | C, R, U, D | R | C, R, U | R, U (Team) | – | | Government Deductibles | C, R, U, D | R | R | – | – | | Government Details | C, R, U, D | A | A | – | – | | Tax Table / Rates | C, R, U, D | – | – | – | – | ## Where the code had drifted, and the correction Working through this table turned up three places where `AccessPolicy` was more generous than the document. All three were corrected in the code, not worked around in the test: 1. **Attendance was writable by HR.** The matrix gives HR `R` on Attendance only — the supervisor holds `R, U (Team)` and the System Administrator holds `C, R, U, D`. `requireAttendanceEdit` now admits only those two. A timesheet correction is a team-lead act; HR reads the attendance but does not rewrite it. 2. **Schedules were editable by HR.** Schedules are not a row in the matrix, so the role descriptions decide it: page 21 gives the Supervisor "edit single/multi/weekly schedules", while page 22 gives HR onboarding, offboarding, ticket handling and employee records. `requireScheduleEdit` follows the supervisor. 3. **Team scope is recursive.** The matrix's "(Team)" is resolved through `OrgChart`, so a supervisor reaches every descendant, not just direct reports. Reads use the recursive scope; *writes* to attendance, schedules and approvals stay on the direct line, because the matrix's `U` is the supervisor's own team and a manager should not silently rewrite a team leader's decisions one level down. ## What the matrix implies for the CMO The CMO is not a C-level financial viewer in this system. The document's five account types are System Admin, HR, Payroll, Supervisor and Employee; the CMO is a **department head with a three-person team**, so it is modelled at supervisor level with `TEAM` scope: it reaches employee, attendance, overtime, ticket, payslip and earnings data for its own chain (10032, 10033, 10034) and nothing company-wide. It holds no `REPORTS`, `STATUTORY` or `REMITTANCE` visibility. This is exactly what the brief asks for, and `AccessPolicyTest` asserts it. MD echo "written"; wc -l docs/a_doc/rbac-matrix-conformance.md

    private static EmpRecords records() {
        EmpRecords current = records;
        if (current != null) return current;
        // Lazy fallback so a unit test that touches a single helper does not have to wire the whole application.
        synchronized (PayrollProfile.class) {
            if (records == null) records = EmpRecords.fromClasspath();
            return records;
        }
    }

    private PayrollProfile() { }

    /** {rice, phone, clothing} per month in centavos, from the employee file. Non-taxable, paid half per cutoff. */
    public static long[] monthlyAllowances(String employeeId) {
        Optional<Employee> employee = records().find(employeeId);
        if (!employee.isPresent()) return new long[3];
        return new long[] {
            cents(employee.get().getRiceSubsidy()),
            cents(employee.get().getPhoneAllowance()),
            cents(employee.get().getClothingAllowance())
        };
    }

    private static long cents(BigDecimal amount) {
        return amount == null ? 0 : amount.setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP).movePointRight(2).longValueExact();
    }

    /** How net pay is released. Direct deposit for everyone; the employee file carries no payment method. */
    public static String payMethod(String employeeId) {
        return "Direct deposit";
    }

    /** The monthly basic the employee file states, or empty when the file has no row for this person. */
    public static Optional<BigDecimal> monthlyBasic(String employeeId) {
        return records().find(employeeId).map(Employee::getMonthlyBasic);
    }

    /**
     * Daily rate = monthly basic / 20, which is the divisor MotorPH's own sample payslip states: it prints
     * "Monthly Salary 53,500.00 / Daily Rate 2,675.00", and 53,500 / 20 = 2,675 exactly. Twenty is the working-day
     * divisor MotorPH's payroll office uses (the semi-monthly rate of 26,750 is ten days of 2,675, not eleven).
     */
    public static Optional<BigDecimal> dailyRate(String employeeId) {
        return monthlyBasic(employeeId).map(basic -> basic.divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(20), 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP));
    }

    /** Monthly basic / 168, rounded half-up to the centavo like the employee file. */
    public static Optional<BigDecimal> hourlyRate(String employeeId) {
        return monthlyBasic(employeeId).map(basic -> basic.divide(PayrollPolicy.hoursPerMonth(), 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP));
    }

    /** Worked minutes for one raw attendance row: grace applied, meal hour removed, no clock cap. */
    public static long workedMinutes(LocalTime timeIn, LocalTime timeOut) {
        LocalTime start = !timeIn.isBefore(SHIFT_START) && !timeIn.isAfter(SHIFT_START.plusMinutes(PayrollPolicy.graceMinutes())) ? SHIFT_START : timeIn;
        if (!timeOut.isAfter(start)) return 0;
        long minutes = Duration.between(start, timeOut).toMinutes();
        LocalTime lunchFrom = start.isAfter(LUNCH_START) ? start : LUNCH_START;
        LocalTime lunchTo = timeOut.isBefore(LUNCH_END) ? timeOut : LUNCH_END;
        if (lunchTo.isAfter(lunchFrom)) minutes -= Duration.between(lunchFrom, lunchTo).toMinutes();
        return minutes;
    }

    /** Indexes into splitDay's result. */
    public static final int REGULAR = 0, REGULAR_NIGHT = 1, OVERTIME = 2, OVERTIME_NIGHT = 3, UNPAID = 4;

private static void splitsMonthIntoCutoffsAndPricesHours() {
        CutoffPayrollService service = service();
        List<CutoffPay> mara = service.grossForMonth("DEMO-001", YearMonth.of(2026, 10));
        check(mara.size() == 2, "a month has two cutoffs");
        check("2026-10-01".equals(mara.get(0).getFrom().toString()) && "2026-10-15".equals(mara.get(0).getTo().toString()),
            "first cutoff is 1-15");
        check("2026-10-16".equals(mara.get(1).getFrom().toString()) && "2026-10-31".equals(mara.get(1).getTo().toString()),
            "second cutoff runs to the actual month end");
        check(mara.get(0).getDaysWithRecords() == 3 && mara.get(0).getPaidMinutes() == 1440
            && mara.get(0).getUnpaidOverageMinutes() == 2, "DEMO-001 first cutoff: 3 rows, 1440 paid minutes, 2 unpaid overage");
        check("7524.24".equals(mara.get(0).getGrossPay().toPlainString()), "24 h x 313.51 = 7524.24");
        check(mara.get(1).getDaysWithRecords() == 0 && "0.00".equals(mara.get(1).getGrossPay().toPlainString()),
            "second cutoff with no rows earns 0.00");
        List<CutoffPay> eli = service.grossForMonth("DEMO-002", YearMonth.of(2026, 10));
        check(eli.get(0).getPaidMinutes() == 960 && eli.get(0).getUnpaidOverageMinutes() == 5
            && "5714.24".equals(eli.get(0).getBasicPay().toPlainString()), "DEMO-002: 16 h x 357.14 = 5714.24 basic, 5 min overage");
        // 2026-10-03 is a Saturday (rest day): 8 h x 30% premium = 2.4 h x 357.14 = 857.136 -> 857.14
        check("857.14".equals(eli.get(0).getPremiumPay().toPlainString()) && "6571.38".equals(eli.get(0).getGrossPay().toPlainString()),
            "DEMO-002 Saturday row earns the 30% rest-day premium");
        check("2026-02-28".equals(service.grossForMonth("DEMO-001", YearMonth.of(2026, 2)).get(1).getTo().toString()),
            "February second cutoff ends on the 28th");
    }

        check(none.getStatutory() == null && none.deductionsCents(0) == 0 && none.netCents(1) == 0, "no attendance means no deductions");
    }

    private static void splitsDayIntoRegularOvertimeAndNight() {
        long[] approved = PayrollProfile.splitDay(LocalTime.parse("08:00"), LocalTime.parse("20:00"), 60);
        check(approved[PayrollProfile.REGULAR] == 480 && approved[PayrollProfile.OVERTIME] == 60 && approved[PayrollProfile.UNPAID] == 120,
            "08:00-20:00 with 60 approved: 8 h regular, 1 h overtime, 2 h unpaid overage");
        long[] night = PayrollProfile.splitDay(LocalTime.parse("14:00"), LocalTime.parse("23:30"), 90);
        check(night[PayrollProfile.REGULAR] == 480 && night[PayrollProfile.REGULAR_NIGHT] == 0
            && night[PayrollProfile.OVERTIME] == 90 && night[PayrollProfile.OVERTIME_NIGHT] == 90, "14:00-23:30: overtime 22:00-23:30 is all night time");
        long[] early = PayrollProfile.splitDay(LocalTime.parse("05:00"), LocalTime.parse("09:00"), 0);
        check(early[PayrollProfile.REGULAR] == 240 && early[PayrollProfile.REGULAR_NIGHT] == 60, "05:00-06:00 is night time");
        long[] none = PayrollProfile.splitDay(LocalTime.parse("07:00"), LocalTime.parse("17:00"), 0);
        check(none[PayrollProfile.UNPAID] == 60 && none[PayrollProfile.OVERTIME] == 0, "without approval the extra hour stays unpaid");
        long[] late = PayrollProfile.splitDay(LocalTime.parse("22:00"), LocalTime.parse("23:59"), 0);
        check(late[PayrollProfile.REGULAR] == 119 && late[PayrollProfile.REGULAR_NIGHT] == 119, "a row ending at 23:59 does not wrap");
    }

        throw new AssertionError(message + ": nothing was thrown");

private void handlePayrollPayslip(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!"GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
            return;
        }
        try {
            String query = exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery();
            JsonObject response = new JsonObject();
            response.add("payslip", buildPayslip(exchange, queryParameter(query, "employeeId"), queryParameter(query, "month"),
                queryParameter(query, "cutoff")));
            sendJson(exchange, 200, response.toString());
        } catch (RequestException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, ex.statusCode, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (IllegalStateException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 409, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (NoSuchElementException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 404, "{\"error\":\"Employee not found\"}");
        } catch (FirestoreException ex) {
            sendApiError(exchange, ex);
        }
    }

    /** Builds the payslip for one cutoff from live data. Throws IllegalArgument (400), IllegalState (409) or NoSuchElement (404). */
    private JsonObject buildPayslip(HttpExchange exchange, String employeeIdText, String monthText, String cutoffText) {
        if (!"1".equals(cutoffText) && !"2".equals(cutoffText)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cutoff must be 1 (1-15) or 2 (16-end).");
        int index = Integer.parseInt(cutoffText) - 1;
        String employeeId = employeeIdText == null ? "" : employeeIdText.trim();
        MonthPayroll payroll = monthPayrollFor(exchange, employeeId, monthText);
        CutoffPay cutoff = payroll.getCutoffs().get(index);
        if (payroll.grossCents(index) == 0) throw new IllegalStateException("No paid attendance in this cutoff, so there is no payslip.");
        if (payroll.isBlocked(index)) throw new IllegalStateException("Deductions exceed this cutoff's gross; no payslip is produced rather than a negative net.");
        Employee employee = servicesFor(exchange).employeeService.findEmployee(employeeId).orElseThrow(NoSuchElementException::new);

        JsonObject person = new JsonObject();
        person.addProperty("id", employee.getId());
        person.addProperty("name", employee.getName());
        person.addProperty("department", employee.getDepartment());
        person.addProperty("role", employee.getRole());
        person.addProperty("location", employee.getLocation());
        JsonObject period = new JsonObject();
        period.addProperty("label", cutoff.getLabel());
        period.addProperty("from", cutoff.getFrom().toString());
        period.addProperty("to", cutoff.getTo().toString());
        JsonObject deductions = new JsonObject();
        deductions.addProperty("sssCents", payroll.lineCents(index, MonthPayroll.SSS));
        deductions.addProperty("philHealthCents", payroll.lineCents(index, MonthPayroll.PHILHEALTH));
        deductions.addProperty("pagIbigCents", payroll.lineCents(index, MonthPayroll.PAGIBIG));
        deductions.addProperty("withholdingTaxCents", payroll.lineCents(index, MonthPayroll.TAX));
        deductions.addProperty("statutoryCents", payroll.statutoryCents(index));
        JsonArray voluntary = new JsonArray();
        for (MonthPayroll.Taken taken : payroll.voluntary(index)) {
            JsonObject line = new JsonObject();
            line.addProperty("id", taken.item.id);
            line.addProperty("type", taken.item.type);
            line.addProperty("description", taken.item.description);
            line.addProperty("amountCents", taken.takenCents);
            line.addProperty("shortfallCents", taken.shortfallCents);
            voluntary.add(line);
        }
        deductions.add("voluntary", voluntary);
        deductions.addProperty("voluntaryCents", payroll.voluntaryCents(index));
        deductions.addProperty("totalCents", payroll.deductionsCents(index));
        JsonArray bonuses = new JsonArray();
        for (PayrollAdjustments.Earning earning : payroll.bonuses(index)) {
            JsonObject line = new JsonObject();
            line.addProperty("id", earning.id);

    private static void sendError(HttpExchange exchange, int status, String message) throws IOException {
        sendJson(exchange, status, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(message) + "\"}");

    private static final String[] DAY_CODES = {"MON", "TUE", "WED", "THU", "FRI", "SAT", "SUN"};

    private static JsonObject scheduleToJson(WorkSchedule schedule) {
        JsonObject json = new JsonObject();
        json.addProperty("employeeId", schedule.employeeId);
        json.addProperty("shiftStart", schedule.shiftStart.toString());
        json.addProperty("shiftEnd", schedule.shiftEnd().toString());
        json.addProperty("mealStart", schedule.mealStart().toString());
        JsonArray days = new JsonArray();
        for (java.time.DayOfWeek day : schedule.workdays) days.add(DAY_CODES[day.getValue() - 1]);
        json.add("workdays", days);
        json.addProperty("updatedBy", schedule.updatedBy);
        json.addProperty("updatedAt", schedule.updatedAt);
        return json;
    }

    /** GET team schedules; PUT /api/schedules/{employeeId} {shiftStart, workdays[]} by the supervisor or admin. Local demo. */
    private void handleSchedules(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {

            sendError(exchange, 403, "Team schedules are local-demo only.");
            return;
        }
        String path = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();
        try {
            AccessPolicy.Actor actor = actorFor(exchange);
            if ("GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod()) && "/api/schedules".equals(path)) {
                JsonArray items = new JsonArray();
                for (Employee employee : localEmployeeService.listEmployees()) {
                    if (!AccessPolicy.canRead(actor, AccessPolicy.Area.EMPLOYEES, employee.getId())) continue;
                    JsonObject item = scheduleToJson(workSchedules.get(employee.getId()));
                    item.add("dayChanges", new com.google.gson.Gson().toJsonTree(workSchedules.dayChangesFor(employee.getId())));
                    items.add(item);
                }
                sendJson(exchange, 200, "{\"schedules\":" + items + "}");

    /** Local demo account chooser: every directory person with their role and supervisor. */
    private void handleDemoAccounts(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!"GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
            return;
        }
        List<Employee> people;
        try {
            // Firebase mode: the people in the caller's own sandbox (requires the Firebase sign-in).
            people = servicesFor(exchange).employeeService.listEmployees();
        } catch (FirestoreException ex) {
            sendApiError(exchange, ex);
            return;
        }
        JsonArray items = new JsonArray();
        for (Employee employee : people) {
            if (firebaseProjectId.isEmpty() && hrRecords.isSeparated(employee.getId(), clockService.now().toLocalDate())) continue;
            AccessPolicy.Role role = AccessPolicy.roleOf(employee.getId());
            JsonObject item = new JsonObject();
            item.addProperty("employeeId", employee.getId());
            item.addProperty("name", employee.getName());
            item.addProperty("position", employee.getRole());
            item.addProperty("branch", employee.getLocation());
            item.addProperty("role", role.name());
            item.addProperty("roleLabel", role.label);
            item.addProperty("supervisorId", AccessPolicy.supervisorOf(employee.getId()).orElse(""));
            JsonArray team = new JsonArray();
            for (String member : AccessPolicy.teamOf(employee.getId())) team.add(member);
            item.add("team", team);
            items.add(item);
        }
        JsonObject response = new JsonObject();
        response.add("accounts", items);
        response.addProperty("policyVersion", AccessPolicy.VERSION);
        sendJson(exchange, 200, response.toString());
    }

    private WorkflowService workflowsFor(HttpExchange exchange) {
        if (firebaseProjectId.isEmpty()) return new WorkflowService(localEmployeeService, localWorkflowStore);
        FirestoreRestClient client = firestoreClientFor(exchange);
        EmployeeService employees = new EmployeeService(new FirestoreEmployeeStore(client));
        return new WorkflowService(employees, new FirestoreWorkflowStore(client));
    }

    private static JsonObject readJsonBody(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        return readJsonBody(exchange, 8192);
    }

public AppServer(String firebaseProjectId, Path webRoot, String firestoreApiRoot, Path dataFile) {
        this.firebaseProjectId = firebaseProjectId == null ? "" : firebaseProjectId.trim();
        if (webRoot == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("webRoot must not be null");
        this.webRoot = webRoot.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        this.firestoreApiRoot = firestoreApiRoot == null || firestoreApiRoot.trim().isEmpty()
            ? null : firestoreApiRoot.trim();
        this.dataFile = dataFile != null && this.firebaseProjectId.isEmpty() ? new LocalStateFile(dataFile) : null;
        AccessPolicy.importRoles(null, null);
        PayrollPolicy.importValues(null);
        this.seedState = exportState();
        if (this.dataFile != null) loadDataFile();
    }

    private void loadDataFile() {
        try {
            java.util.Optional<JsonObject> saved = dataFile.load();
            if (saved.isPresent()) {
                importState(saved.get());
                importAudit(saved.get());
                System.out.println("Loaded local demo data from " + dataFile.path());
            } else {
                System.out.println("No local demo data file yet; it will be created at " + dataFile.path());
            }
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException ex) {
            Path aside;
            try {
                aside = dataFile.setAside();
            } catch (IOException moveFailure) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("Local demo data file is unreadable and could not be moved aside: " + dataFile.path(), moveFailure);
            }

package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.util.Optional;
import ph.motorph.o_oop.Employee;
import ph.motorph.o_oop.OrgChart;

/**
 * Sign-in, sign-out, password change and the "who is this request" question, in one place.
 *
 * The HTTP layer owns exactly one authentication decision: {@link #currentEmployee}. Everything else — reading
 * permissions, scoping a roster, deciding whether a payslip may be opened — is asked of
 * {@link AccessMatrix} with the employee this service returns. A request that cannot name a live session gets no
 * employee, and therefore no permission.
 */
public final class AuthService {
    public static final String COOKIE = "motorph_session";

    private final CredentialStore credentials;
    private final SessionStore sessions;
    private final OrgChart chart;

    public AuthService(CredentialStore credentials, SessionStore sessions, OrgChart chart) {
        this.credentials = credentials;
        this.sessions = sessions;
        this.chart = chart;
    }

    public SessionStore sessions() { return sessions; }
    public CredentialStore credentials() { return credentials; }

    /** Outcome of a sign-in: a token for the cookie, or a reason the browser may be told. */
    public static final class SignIn {
        public final String token, employeeId, role;
        public final boolean mustChangePassword;
        public final String error;

        private SignIn(String token, String employeeId, String role, boolean mustChangePassword, String error) {
            this.token = token; this.employeeId = employeeId; this.role = role;
            this.mustChangePassword = mustChangePassword; this.error = error;
        }
        static SignIn failed(String error) { return new SignIn("", "", "", false, error); }
        public boolean ok() { return error.isEmpty(); }
    }

    /**
     * Employee ID + password → session.
     *
     * The failure message is the same for an unknown number and a wrong password: "The employee number or password
     * is incorrect." Anything else lets somebody probe the roster one number at a time.
     */
    public SignIn signIn(String employeeId, String password) {
        String id = employeeId == null ? "" : employeeId.trim();
        if (!id.matches("[0-9]{5}")) return SignIn.failed("Employee numbers are five digits, for example 10015.");
        CredentialStore.Result result = credentials.signIn(id, password);
        if (!result.ok) {
            return SignIn.failed("locked".equals(result.reason)
                ? "Too many incorrect attempts. Try again in a few minutes."
                : "The employee number or password is incorrect.");
        }
        Employee employee = chart.employee(id).orElse(null);
        if (employee == null) return SignIn.failed("The employee number or password is incorrect.");
        String token = sessions.issue(id);
        return new SignIn(token, id, chart.roleOf(id).label, result.account.mustChangePassword(), "");
    }

    /** The employee behind a session token, or empty. Resolving also counts as activity. */
    public Optional<Employee> currentEmployee(String token) {
        return sessions.resolve(token).flatMap(record -> chart.employee(record.employeeId));
    }

    public Optional<SessionRecord> currentSession(String token) { return sessions.resolve(token); }

    public void signOut(String token) { sessions.revoke(token); }

    /**
     * Changes the password and ends every other session for that account.
     *
     * The browser that made the change is given a fresh token (session rotation after a credential change, so a
     * token observed before the change is worthless afterwards). Every other session is revoked.
     */

    /**
     * The signed-in demo account, from the X-Demo-User header the browser sends after choosing an account.
     * Firebase mode: the signed-in Firebase user acts as one fake person from their own private sandbox (same rules).
     * shortcut: a call without the header (scripts, older tests) is unrestricted with explicit=false; replace with
     * a real login before anything leaves the demo. In Firebase mode the data is the caller's own sandbox either way.
     */
    private AccessPolicy.Actor actorFor(HttpExchange exchange) {
        String id = exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("X-Demo-User");
        if (id == null || id.trim().isEmpty()) return new AccessPolicy.Actor("", AccessPolicy.Role.ADMIN, false);
        String trimmed = id.trim();
        if (!firebaseProjectId.isEmpty()) {
            if (!servicesFor(exchange).employeeService.findEmployee(trimmed).isPresent()) throw new RequestException(401, "That person is not in your sandbox.");
            return new AccessPolicy.Actor(trimmed, AccessPolicy.roleOf(trimmed), true);
        }
        if (!localEmployeeService.findEmployee(trimmed).isPresent()) throw new RequestException(401, "Unknown demo account.");
        if (hrRecords.isSeparated(trimmed, clockService.now().toLocalDate())) throw new RequestException(401, "This account was closed after the employee's last day.");
        if (!twoFactor.sessionOwner(exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("X-Demo-Session")).filter(trimmed::equals).isPresent()) {
            throw new RequestException(401, "Sign in again: enter the 2FA code for this account first.");
        }
        return new AccessPolicy.Actor(trimmed, AccessPolicy.roleOf(trimmed), true);
    }

    /**
     * Simulated 2FA for the local demo accounts (see TwoFactor): POST /api/auth/2fa/start {employeeId} "texts" a code,
     * POST /api/auth/2fa/verify {challengeId, code} returns the session token, GET /api/auth/session checks it,
     * POST /api/auth/signout ends it. Firebase mode signs in with Firebase instead.
     */
    private void handleAuth(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!firebaseProjectId.isEmpty()) {
            sendError(exchange, 404, "Firebase mode signs in with Firebase; demo 2FA is local only.");
            return;
        }
        String path = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();
        String method = exchange.getRequestMethod();
        try {
            if ("GET".equals(method) && "/api/auth/session".equals(path)) {
                String owner = twoFactor.sessionOwner(exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("X-Demo-Session"))
                    .orElseThrow(() -> new RequestException(401, "Not signed in."));
                sendJson(exchange, 200, "{\"employeeId\":\"" + escapeJson(owner) + "\"}");
                return;
            }
            if (!"POST".equals(method)) {
                sendError(exchange, 405, "Method not allowed");
                return;
            }
            JsonObject body = readJsonBody(exchange);
            if ("/api/auth/2fa/start".equals(path)) {
                requireOnlyKeys(body, "employeeId", "password");
                String id = requiredString(body, "employeeId").trim();
                exchange.setAttribute("auditTarget", id);
                if (!localEmployeeService.findEmployee(id).isPresent()) throw new RequestException(404, "Unknown demo account.");
                if (hrRecords.isSeparated(id, clockService.now().toLocalDate())) throw new RequestException(401, "This account was closed after the employee's last day.");
                try {
                    accountSecurity.checkPassword(id, optionalString(body, "password"), clockService.now());
                } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
                    throw new RequestException(401, ex.getMessage());
                } catch (AccountSecurity.TooSoon ex) {
                    throw new RequestException(429, ex.getMessage());
                } catch (IllegalStateException ex) {
                    throw new RequestException(423, ex.getMessage());
                }
                TwoFactor.Started started = twoFactor.start(id, accountSecurity.settings().codeMinutes);
                JsonObject response = new JsonObject();
                response.addProperty("challengeId", started.challengeId);
                response.addProperty("sentTo", "the phone number ending in " + id.substring(Math.max(0, id.length() - 2)));
                response.addProperty("expiresAt", started.expires.toLocalTime().toString());
                // Simulated SMS: there is no phone, so the demo shows the code. Never do this with real accounts.
                response.addProperty("demoCode", started.code);
                sendJson(exchange, 200, response.toString());
                return;
            }
            if ("/api/auth/2fa/verify".equals(path)) {
                requireOnlyKeys(body, "challengeId", "code");
                String session;
                try {
                    session = twoFactor.verify(requiredString(body, "challengeId"), requiredString(body, "code"), accountSecurity.settings().sessionHours);
                } catch (IllegalArgumentException | IllegalStateException ex) {
                    throw new RequestException(401, ex.getMessage());
                }
                // Design doc: "on success, old sessions for that ID are terminated".
                twoFactor.signOutEverywhere(twoFactor.sessionOwner(session).orElse(""), session);
                JsonObject response = new JsonObject();
                response.addProperty("session", session);
                response.addProperty("employeeId", twoFactor.sessionOwner(session).orElse(""));
                exchange.setAttribute("auditTarget", twoFactor.sessionOwner(session).orElse(""));
                response.addProperty("defaultPassword", accountSecurity.usesDefaultPassword(twoFactor.sessionOwner(session).orElse("")));
                sendJson(exchange, 200, response.toString());
                return;
            }
            if ("/api/auth/password".equals(path)) {
                requireOnlyKeys(body, "current", "next");
                String session = exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("X-Demo-Session");
                String owner = twoFactor.sessionOwner(session).orElseThrow(() -> new RequestException(401, "Sign in first."));
                try {
                    accountSecurity.changePassword(owner, optionalString(body, "current"), optionalString(body, "next"), clockService.now());
                } catch (IllegalStateException ex) {
                    throw new RequestException(423, ex.getMessage());
                }
                twoFactor.signOutEverywhere(owner, session);
                sendJson(exchange, 200, "{\"changed\":true}");
                return;
            }
            if ("/api/auth/signout".equals(path)) {
                requireOnlyKeys(body);
                twoFactor.signOut(exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("X-Demo-Session"));
                sendJson(exchange, 200, "{\"signedOut\":true}");
                return;
