[NODE 18451]
Chief Finance Officer (CFO)

[NODE 18452]
The CFO has the highest level of financial visibility among the executives, as payroll is usually the company’s largest expense.
• Access Level: Read-Only (Full Visibility) or Approval-level access.
• What they see:
• Total company labor costs, tax liabilities, and government remittance totals (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG).
• Salary bands, executive compensation details, and bonus pools.
• Budget variance reports (comparing actual payroll spend against the company budget).
• System Action: They rarely click "process," but they are often the final digital approver required to release the funds from the corporate bank account.

[NODE 18453]
👔 Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

[NODE 18454]
The CEO needs high-level oversight of company growth, headcount costs, and executive retention.
• Access Level: Read-Only (Full Visibility).
• What they see:
• Complete organizational salary data, including executive and board compensation.
• High-level workforce analytics (e.g., revenue per employee, total headcount spend by department).
• System Action: Viewing dashboard analytics and running long-term labor cost projections.

[NODE 18455]
⚙️ Chief Operating Officer (COO)

[NODE 18456]
The COO focuses on operational efficiency, productivity, and department-level staffing costs.
• Access Level: Read-Only (Operational/Departmental Visibility).
• What they see:
• Overtime (OT) trends, holiday pay, and absenteeism costs across operations and plants.
• Departmental labor budgets to see which teams are over-utilizing resources.
• Contractor and vendor billing vs. regular employee payroll costs.
• System Action: Monitoring labor efficiency metrics and approving department-specific structural changes.

[NODE 18457]
📣 Chief Marketing Officer (CMO)

[NODE 18458]
The CMO operates like a standard Department Head in the system, with access strictly limited to their own team.
• Access Level: Restricted Department Head / Manager Access.
• What they see:
• Only the compensation, bonuses, and timesheets of the Marketing Department employees.
• They have zero visibility into the salaries of Finance, Operations, IT, or other C-level peers.

[NODE 18634]
private void handleAttendanceCreate(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!firebaseProjectId.isEmpty()) {
            sendJson(exchange, 403, "{\"error\":\"Raw attendance entry is disabled in Firebase mode; this demo writer is local-memory only.\"}");
            return;
        }
        try {
            JsonObject body = readJsonBody(exchange);
            requireOnlyKeys(body, "employeeId", "date", "timeIn", "timeOut");
            LocalDate date = LocalDate.parse(requiredString(body, "date").trim());
            LocalTime timeIn = parseAttendanceTime(requiredString(body, "timeIn"));
            LocalTime timeOut = parseAttendanceTime(requiredString(body, "timeOut"));
            AccessPolicy.Actor actor = actorFor(exchange);
            String target = requiredString(body, "employeeId").trim();
            guard(() -> AccessPolicy.requireAttendanceEdit(actor, target));
            RequestServices services = servicesFor(exchange);
            AttendanceService attendanceService = new AttendanceService(services.employeeService,
                localScheduleStore, services.attendanceStore);
            AttendanceRecord created = attendanceService.createForEmployee(
                requiredString(body, "employeeId"), date, timeIn, timeOut);
            sendJson(exchange, 201, "{\"item\":" + attendanceRecordToJson(created)
                + ",\"storage\":\"local\",\"hoursCalculated\":false}");
        } catch (DateTimeParseException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"Date must use YYYY-MM-DD and times must use HH:mm\"}");
        } catch (RequestException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, ex.statusCode, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (NoSuchElementException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 404, "{\"error\":\"Employee not found\"}");
        } catch (IllegalStateException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 409, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        }
    }

[NODE 18811]
export function buildWorkspaceExport({ mode = 'local-imported', employees = [], leaveRequests = [], tickets = [], attendanceByEmployee = {} } = {}, exportedAt = new Date()) {
  if (!Array.isArray(employees) || !Array.isArray(leaveRequests) || !Array.isArray(tickets)) {
    throw new TypeError('Workspace export collections must be arrays.');
  }
  if (!attendanceByEmployee || typeof attendanceByEmployee !== 'object' || Array.isArray(attendanceByEmployee)) {
    throw new TypeError('Attendance export data must be grouped by employee ID.');
  }
  if (!(exportedAt instanceof Date) || Number.isNaN(exportedAt.getTime())) {
    throw new TypeError('A valid export timestamp is required.');
  }
  const records = [];
  for (const [employeeId, items] of Object.entries(attendanceByEmployee)) {
    if (!Array.isArray(items)) throw new TypeError(`Attendance rows for ${employeeId} must be an array.`);
    items.forEach(item => {
      if (!item || typeof item !== 'object' || Array.isArray(item)) {
        throw new TypeError(`Attendance row for ${employeeId} must be an object.`);
      }
      records.push({ ...item, employeeId });
    });
  }
  return {
    formatVersion: 1,
    exportedAt: exportedAt.toISOString(),
    storageMode: String(mode),
    importedOnly: true,
    hoursCalculated: false,
    payrollIncluded: false,
    employees: employees.slice(),
    attendance: records,
    leaveRequests: leaveRequests.slice(),
    tickets: tickets.slice()
  };
}

=== PasswordHasher ===
package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Base64;
import javax.crypto.SecretKeyFactory;
import javax.crypto.spec.PBEKeySpec;
import org.bouncycastle.crypto.generators.Argon2BytesGenerator;
import org.bouncycastle.crypto.params.Argon2Parameters;

public final class PasswordHasher {
    private static final int VERSION = 19;              
    private static final int MEMORY_KIB = 64 * 1024;    
    private static final int ITERATIONS = 3;
    private static final int PARALLELISM = 1;
    private static final int HASH_BYTES = 32;
    private static final int SALT_BYTES = 16;
    private static final SecureRandom RANDOM = new SecureRandom();

    private final byte[] pepperBytes;

    public PasswordHasher(String pepper) {
        if (pepper == null || pepper.trim().length() < 32) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(PasswordPolicy.PEPPER_VARIABLE + " must be set to at least 32 characters; "
                + "refusing to start with a weak or missing pepper.");
        }
        this.pepperBytes = pepper.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    
    public String hash(String password) {
        byte[] salt = new byte[SALT_BYTES];
        RANDOM.nextBytes(salt);
        byte[] digest = derive(password, salt, MEMORY_KIB, ITERATIONS, PARALLELISM);
        Base64.Encoder b64 = Base64.getEncoder().withoutPadding();
        return "argon2id$v=" + VERSION
            + "$m=" + MEMORY_KIB + ",t=" + ITERATIONS + ",p=" + PARALLELISM
            + "$" + b64.encodeToString(salt)
            + "$" + b64.encodeToString(digest);
    }

    
    public boolean verify(String password, String stored) {
        if (password == null || stored == null) return false;
        String[] parts = stored.split("\\$");
        if (parts.length != 5 || !"argon2id".equals(parts[0])) return false;
        try {
            int memory = 65536, iterations = 3, parallelism = 1;
            for (String setting : parts[2].split(",")) {
                String[] pair = setting.split("=");
                if (pair.length != 2) continue;
                switch (pair[0]) {
                    case "m": memory = Integer.parseInt(pair[1]); break;
                    case "t": iterations = Integer.parseInt(pair[1]); break;
                    case "p": parallelism = Integer.parseInt(pair[1]); break;
                    default: break;
                }
            }
            Base64.Decoder b64 = Base64.getDecoder();
            byte[] salt = b64.decode(parts[3]);
            byte[] expected = b64.decode(parts[4]);
            byte[] actual = derive(password, salt, memory, iterations, parallelism);
            return MessageDigest.isEqual(expected, actual);
        } catch (RuntimeException malformed) {
            return false;
        }
    }

public boolean needsRehash(String stored) {
        return stored == null || !stored.startsWith("argon2id$v=" + VERSION + "$m=" + MEMORY_KIB + ",t=" + ITERATIONS + ",p=" + PARALLELISM + "$");
    }

    private byte[] derive(String password, byte[] salt, int memoryKib, int iterations, int parallelism) {
        
        
        byte[] passwordBytes = password.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        byte[] combinedSalt = new byte[salt.length + pepperBytes.length];
        System.arraycopy(salt, 0, combinedSalt, 0, salt.length);
        System.arraycopy(pepperBytes, 0, combinedSalt, salt.length, pepperBytes.length);
        Argon2Parameters params = new Argon2Parameters.Builder(Argon2Parameters.ARGON2_id)
            .withVersion(VERSION)
            .withMemoryAsKB(memoryKib)
            .withIterations(iterations)
            .withParallelism(parallelism)
            .withSalt(combinedSalt)
            .build();
        Argon2BytesGenerator generator = new Argon2BytesGenerator();
        generator.init(params);
        byte[] out = new byte[HASH_BYTES];
        generator.generateBytes(passwordBytes, out);
        Arrays.fill(passwordBytes, (byte) 0);
        return out;
    }

}

package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.util.Base64;

public final class SessionCookie {
    
    public static final String CSRF_COOKIE = "motorph_csrf";
    public static final String CSRF_HEADER = "X-CSRF-Token";
    private static final int CSRF_BYTES = 32;

    private static final SecureRandom RANDOM = new SecureRandom();

    private SessionCookie() {}

    
    public static String newCsrfToken() {
        byte[] bytes = new byte[CSRF_BYTES];
        RANDOM.nextBytes(bytes);
        return Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(bytes);
    }

    
    public static String sessionCookie(String token, int maxAgeSeconds, boolean secure) {
        return AuthService.COOKIE + "=" + token
            + "; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=" + maxAgeSeconds + (secure ? "; Secure" : "");
    }

    
    public static String csrfCookie(String csrfToken, int maxAgeSeconds, boolean secure) {
        return CSRF_COOKIE + "=" + csrfToken
            + "; Path=/; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=" + maxAgeSeconds + (secure ? "; Secure" : "");
    }

    
    public static String[] clearCookies(boolean secure) {
        return new String[] {
            AuthService.COOKIE + "=; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=0" + (secure ? "; Secure" : ""),
            CSRF_COOKIE + "=; Path=/; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=0" + (secure ? "; Secure" : "")
        };
    }

    
    public static String read(String cookieHeader, String name) {
        if (cookieHeader == null || cookieHeader.isEmpty()) return null;
        for (String pair : cookieHeader.split(";")) {
            int equals = pair.indexOf('=');
            if (equals < 0) continue;
            if (pair.substring(0, equals).trim().equals(name)) return pair.substring(equals + 1).trim();
        }
        return null;
    }

    
    public static boolean csrfMatches(String cookieToken, String headerToken) {
        if (cookieToken == null || headerToken == null) return false;
        return MessageDigest.isEqual(cookieToken.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8), headerToken.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }
}

package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.time.Instant;

public final class SessionRecord {
    public final String tokenHash;
    public final String employeeId;
    public final Instant created;
    public final Instant expiresAt;
    
    public final int idleMinutes;

    private Instant lastActive;
    private boolean revoked;

    public SessionRecord(String tokenHash, String employeeId, Instant created, Instant expiresAt, int idleMinutes) {
        this.tokenHash = tokenHash;
        this.employeeId = employeeId;
        this.created = created;
        this.expiresAt = expiresAt;
        this.idleMinutes = idleMinutes;
        this.lastActive = created;
    }

    public Instant lastActive() { return lastActive; }
    public boolean revoked() { return revoked; }

    
    
    public String expiredReason(Instant now) {
        if (revoked) return "revoked";
        if (!now.isBefore(expiresAt)) return "absolute";
        if (!now.isBefore(lastActive.plusSeconds(idleMinutes * 60L))) return "idle";
        return null;
    }

    
    boolean touch(Instant now) {
        if (now.isBefore(lastActive.plusSeconds(60))) return false;
        lastActive = now;
        return true;
    }

    void revoke() { revoked = true; }
}

package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;

public final class SessionStore {
    public static final int IDLE_MINUTES = 15;
    public static final int ABSOLUTE_HOURS = 8;

    private static final SecureRandom RANDOM = new SecureRandom();

    private final Map<String, SessionRecord> byTokenHash = java.util.Collections.synchronizedMap(new LinkedHashMap<>());
    private final Clock clock;
    private final int idleMinutes, absoluteHours;

    public SessionStore() { this(Clock.systemDefaultZone(), IDLE_MINUTES, ABSOLUTE_HOURS); }
    public SessionStore(Clock clock) { this(clock, IDLE_MINUTES, ABSOLUTE_HOURS); }
    public SessionStore(Clock clock, int idleMinutes, int absoluteHours) {
        this.clock = clock;
        this.idleMinutes = idleMinutes;
        this.absoluteHours = absoluteHours;
    }

    public int idleMinutes() { return idleMinutes; }
    public int absoluteHours() { return absoluteHours; }

    
    public String issue(String employeeId) {
        byte[] raw = new byte[32];
        RANDOM.nextBytes(raw);
        String token = Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(raw);
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        byTokenHash.put(hash(token), new SessionRecord(hash(token), employeeId, now,
            now.plus(Duration.ofHours(absoluteHours)), idleMinutes));
        prune(now);
        return token;
    }

    
    public Optional<SessionRecord> resolve(String token) {
        if (token == null || token.isEmpty()) return Optional.empty();
        SessionRecord record = byTokenHash.get(hash(token));
        if (record == null) return Optional.empty();
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        String expired = record.expiredReason(now);
        if (expired != null) {
            byTokenHash.remove(record.tokenHash);
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        record.touch(now);
        return Optional.of(record);
    }

    public void revoke(String token) {
        if (token == null) return;
        byTokenHash.remove(hash(token));
    }

    
    public int revokeAllFor(String employeeId) {
        int removed = 0;
        List<String> keys = new ArrayList<>(byTokenHash.keySet());
        for (String key : keys) {
            SessionRecord record = byTokenHash.get(key);
            if (record != null && record.employeeId.equals(employeeId)) {
                byTokenHash.remove(key);
                removed++;
            }
        }
        return removed;
    }

    
    public long idleSecondsLeft(String token) {
        SessionRecord record = byTokenHash.get(hash(token));
        if (record == null) return 0;
        long seconds = Duration.between(clock.instant(), record.lastActive().plusSeconds(idleMinutes * 60L)).getSeconds();
        return Math.max(0, seconds);

private void prune(Instant now) {
        byTokenHash.values().removeIf(record -> record.expiredReason(now) != null);
    }

    
    static String hash(String token) {
        try {
            byte[] digest = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(token.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            StringBuilder hex = new StringBuilder(digest.length * 2);
            for (byte b : digest) hex.append(String.format("%02x", b));
            return hex.toString();
        } catch (java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException ex) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("SHA-256 is required", ex);
        }
    }

package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.util.Optional;
import ph.motorph.o_oop.Employee;
import ph.motorph.o_oop.OrgChart;

public final class AuthService {
    public static final String COOKIE = "motorph_session";

    private final CredentialStore credentials;
    private final SessionStore sessions;
    private final OrgChart chart;

    public AuthService(CredentialStore credentials, SessionStore sessions, OrgChart chart) {
        this.credentials = credentials;
        this.sessions = sessions;
        this.chart = chart;
    }

    public SessionStore sessions() { return sessions; }
    public CredentialStore credentials() { return credentials; }

    
    public static final class SignIn {
        public final String token, employeeId, role;
        public final boolean mustChangePassword;
        public final String error;

        private SignIn(String token, String employeeId, String role, boolean mustChangePassword, String error) {
            this.token = token; this.employeeId = employeeId; this.role = role;
            this.mustChangePassword = mustChangePassword; this.error = error;
        }
        static SignIn failed(String error) { return new SignIn("", "", "", false, error); }
        public boolean ok() { return error.isEmpty(); }
    }

    
    public SignIn signIn(String employeeId, String password) {
        String id = employeeId == null ? "" : employeeId.trim();
        if (!id.matches("[0-9]{5}")) return SignIn.failed("Employee numbers are five digits, for example 10015.");
        CredentialStore.Result result = credentials.signIn(id, password);
        if (!result.ok) {
            return SignIn.failed("locked".equals(result.reason)
                ? "Too many incorrect attempts. Try again in a few minutes."
                : "The employee number or password is incorrect.");
        }
        Employee employee = chart.employee(id).orElse(null);
        if (employee == null) return SignIn.failed("The employee number or password is incorrect.");
        String token = sessions.issue(id);
        return new SignIn(token, id, chart.roleOf(id).label, result.account.mustChangePassword(), "");
    }

    
    public Optional<Employee> currentEmployee(String token) {
        return sessions.resolve(token).flatMap(record -> chart.employee(record.employeeId));
    }

    public Optional<SessionRecord> currentSession(String token) { return sessions.resolve(token); }

    public void signOut(String token) { sessions.revoke(token); }

    
    public String changePassword(String token, String currentPassword, String newPassword) {
        Optional<SessionRecord> record = sessions.resolve(token);
        if (!record.isPresent()) return null;
        String employeeId = record.get().employeeId;
        if (!credentials.changePassword(employeeId, currentPassword, newPassword)) return null;
        sessions.revokeAllFor(employeeId);
        return sessions.issue(employeeId);
    }

    
    public boolean resetPassword(String employeeId) {
        boolean reset = credentials.resetToInitial(employeeId);
        if (reset) sessions.revokeAllFor(employeeId);
        return reset;
    }

    public int activeSessions() { return sessions.size(); }
}

    public Result signIn(String employeeId, String password) {
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        Account account = employeeId == null ? null : accounts.get(employeeId.trim());
        if (account == null) return new Result(false, null, "unknown");
        if (account.locked(now)) return new Result(false, account, "locked");
        if (!hasher.verify(password, account.passwordHash())) {
            account.recordFailure(MAX_ATTEMPTS, now, LOCK_FOR);
            return new Result(false, account, "password");
        }
        account.recordSuccess(now);
        
        if (hasher.needsRehash(account.passwordHash())) account.replaceHash(hasher.hash(password));
        return new Result(true, account, "");
    }

package ph.motorph.web;

import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.function.Supplier;

/**
 * Requirement 1 / security: simulated two-factor sign-in for the local demo accounts. After the right password the
 * server "texts" a 6-digit code (the demo shows it on screen, because there is no phone); the right code within the
 * admin's code time gives a session token for the admin's session length, and every request as that account must carry it.
 * shortcut: codes are shown instead of sent, and sessions live in memory (a server restart signs everyone out);
 * a real system sends the code by SMS or an authenticator app.
 */
public final class TwoFactor {
    static final int MAX_TRIES = 3;
    private static final SecureRandom RANDOM = new SecureRandom();

    private static final class Challenge {
        final String employeeId, code;
        final LocalDateTime expires;
        int triesLeft = MAX_TRIES;

        Challenge(String employeeId, String code, LocalDateTime expires) {
            this.employeeId = employeeId;
            this.code = code;
            this.expires = expires;
        }
    }

    public static final class Started {
        public final String challengeId, code;
        public final LocalDateTime expires;

        Started(String challengeId, String code, LocalDateTime expires) {
            this.challengeId = challengeId;
            this.code = code;
            this.expires = expires;
        }
    }

    private final Supplier<LocalDateTime> now;
    private final Map<String, Challenge> challenges = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, String> sessions = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, LocalDateTime> sessionExpires = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public TwoFactor(Supplier<LocalDateTime> now) {
        this.now = now;
    }

    public Started start(String employeeId, int codeMinutes) {
        String code = String.format("%06d", RANDOM.nextInt(1_000_000));
        LocalDateTime expires = now.get().plusMinutes(codeMinutes);
        String id = token(12);
        challenges.put(id, new Challenge(employeeId, code, expires));
        return new Started(id, code, expires);
    }

    /** The session token, or an exception saying why not (wrong code with tries left, too many tries, expired). */
    public String verify(String challengeId, String code, int sessionHours) {
        Challenge challenge = challenges.get(challengeId == null ? "" : challengeId);
        if (challenge == null) throw new IllegalStateException("That code request is over; choose the account again for a new code.");
        if (now.get().isAfter(challenge.expires)) {
            challenges.remove(challengeId);
            throw new IllegalStateException("That code expired; choose the account again for a new code.");
        }
        synchronized (challenge) {
            if (!challenge.code.equals(code == null ? "" : code.trim())) {
                challenge.triesLeft--;
                if (challenge.triesLeft <= 0) {
                    challenges.remove(challengeId);
                    throw new IllegalStateException("Wrong code 3 times; choose the account again for a new code.");
                }
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Wrong code; " + challenge.triesLeft + " tr" + (challenge.triesLeft == 1 ? "y" : "ies") + " left.");
            }
        }
        challenges.remove(challengeId);
        String session = token(16);
        sessions.put(session, challenge.employeeId);
        sessionExpires.put(session, now.get().plusHours(sessionHours));
        return session;
    }

    /** The account a session belongs to, while it has not expired (the admin's session length). */
    public Optional<String> sessionOwner(String session) {
        if (session == null || !sessions.containsKey(session.trim())) return Optional.empty();
        String key = session.trim();
        if (now.get().isAfter(sessionExpires.getOrDefault(key, LocalDateTime.MIN))) {
            signOut(key);
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        return Optional.of(sessions.get(key));
    }

    public void signOut(String session) {
        if (session == null) return;
        sessions.remove(session.trim());
        sessionExpires.remove(session.trim());
    }

    /** Ends every session of one account except {@code keep} (after a password change or an admin reset). */
    public void signOutEverywhere(String employeeId, String keep) {
        sessions.entrySet().removeIf(entry -> {
            boolean mine = entry.getValue().equals(employeeId) && !entry.getKey().equals(keep);
            if (mine) sessionExpires.remove(entry.getKey());
            return mine;
        });
    }

    private static String token(int bytes) {
        byte[] value = new byte[bytes];
        RANDOM.nextBytes(value);
        StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder();
        for (byte b : value) text.append(String.format("%02x", b));
        return text.toString();
    }
}

                response.addProperty("csrfToken", csrf);
                sendJson(exchange, 200, response.toString());
                return;
            }
            sendError(exchange, 404, "Auth endpoint not found");
        } catch (RequestException ex) {
            sendError(exchange, ex.statusCode, ex.getMessage());
        } catch (AccountSecurity.TooSoon ex) {
            sendError(exchange, 429, ex.getMessage());
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            sendError(exchange, 400, ex.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private static void signInNeedsTheRightPairAndSaysNothingUsefulOtherwise() {
        AuthService auth = service(new MutableClock("2026-11-09T08:00:00Z"));
        AuthService.SignIn ok = auth.signIn("10015", PasswordPolicy.INITIAL_PASSWORD);
        check(ok.ok() && ok.employeeId.equals("10015"), "the right pair signs in");
        AuthService.SignIn unknown = auth.signIn("99999", PasswordPolicy.INITIAL_PASSWORD);
        AuthService.SignIn wrong = auth.signIn("10015", "not-the-password");
        check(!unknown.ok() && !wrong.ok(), "an unknown number and a wrong password both fail");
        check(unknown.error.equals(wrong.error), "they fail with the same message, so the roster cannot be probed");
        check(!unknown.error.toLowerCase().contains("unknown") && !unknown.error.toLowerCase().contains("no such"),
            "the message does not admit which half was wrong");
        AuthService.SignIn badFormat = auth.signIn("abc", "x");
        check(!badFormat.ok(), "a non-numeric employee number is refused before any hashing");
    }

    private static void signOutAndPasswordChangeRevokeServerSide() {
        MutableClock clock = new MutableClock("2026-11-09T08:00:00Z");
        AuthService auth = service(clock);
        String token = signedIn(auth, "10015");
        check(auth.currentEmployee(token).isPresent(), "the session names the employee");
        auth.signOut(token);
        check(!auth.currentEmployee(token).isPresent(), "signing out ends the session on the server, not just in the browser");
        check(!auth.currentSession(token).isPresent(), "the stored record is gone too");

        String first = signedIn(auth, "10015");
        String second = signedIn(auth, "10015");
        check(auth.currentEmployee(first).isPresent() && auth.currentEmployee(second).isPresent(), "two devices can be signed in");
        auth.changePassword(second, PasswordPolicy.INITIAL_PASSWORD, "a-new-password-2026");
        check(!auth.currentEmployee(first).isPresent(), "changing the password ends every other session");
        check(!auth.currentEmployee(second).isPresent(), "including the one that made the change — it is rotated, not kept");
    }

    private static void passwordChangeRotatesTheSession() {
        MutableClock clock = new MutableClock("2026-11-09T08:00:00Z");
        AuthService auth = service(clock);
        String before = signedIn(auth, "10015");
        String after = auth.changePassword(before, PasswordPolicy.INITIAL_PASSWORD, "another-password-2026");
        check(after != null && !after.equals(before), "the browser is given a different token (session fixation defence)");
        check(auth.currentEmployee(after).isPresent(), "the new token works");
        check(!auth.currentEmployee(before).isPresent(), "the old token does not");

    private static final class MutableClock extends Clock {
        private Instant now;
        MutableClock(String iso) { this.now = Instant.parse(iso); }
        void advance(Duration by) { now = now.plus(by); }
        @Override public ZoneId getZone() { return ZoneOffset.UTC; }
        @Override public Clock withZone(ZoneId zone) { return this; }
        @Override public Instant instant() { return now; }
    }

document.getElementById('change-password-form').addEventListener('submit', async event => {
  event.preventDefault();
  const form = event.currentTarget;
  const status = document.getElementById('change-password-status');
  try {
    await postAuth('/api/auth/password', { current: document.getElementById('password-current').value, next: document.getElementById('password-next').value });
    state.defaultPassword = false;
    document.getElementById('account-password-label').textContent = '';
    form.reset();
    status.textContent = 'Password changed. Other sign-ins of this account were signed out.';
  } catch (error) {
    status.textContent = error.message;
  }
});

function enterAs(account) {
  state.account = account;
  sessionStorage.setItem(ACCOUNT_KEY, account.employeeId);
  applyRoleLayout(document, account);
  showWorkspace(state.user);
  document.getElementById('operator-label').textContent = `${account.name} · ${account.roleLabel}`;
  document.getElementById('operator-avatar').textContent = account.name.split(' ').map(part => part[0]).join('').slice(0, 2);
  document.getElementById('switch-account-button').hidden = false;
  myDay.refresh();
  if (!firebaseConfigured) outbox.refresh();
  if (!firebaseConfigured) refreshBranchAndAccount(account);
  if (!firebaseConfigured) notificationsUi.refresh();
  if (['PAYROLL', 'HR', 'ADMIN', 'SUPERVISOR'].includes(account.role)) payrollProcessing.refresh();
  switchView(defaultView(account));
}

const TAB_KEY = 'motorph-tab-';
const ALL_KEY = 'motorph-all-sections';

export function parseTabs(spec) {
  return String(spec || '').split('|').map(part => part.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(part => {
    const [key, ...label] = part.split(':');
    return { key: key.trim(), label: label.join(':').trim() || key.trim() };
  });
}

export function firstSentence(text) {
  const clean = String(text || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  const match = clean.match(/^(.+?[.!?])(\s|$)/);
  return match ? match[1] : clean;
}

export function badgeCount(elements) {
  let count = 0;
  elements.forEach(element => {
    count += element.querySelectorAll('button[aria-label^="Approve "]').length;
    count += [...element.querySelectorAll('td')].filter(cell => cell.textContent.startsWith('Failed:')).length;
  });
  return count;
}

function friendlyAuthError(error) {
  const code = error && error.code || '';
  if (code === 'auth/operation-not-allowed') return 'Email/Password sign-in is disabled. Enable it in Firebase Console → Authentication → Sign-in method.';
  if (code === 'auth/unauthorized-domain') return 'This preview domain is not authorized. Add its host under Firebase Console → Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains, or test on localhost.';
  if (code === 'auth/invalid-api-key' || code === 'auth/api-key-not-valid.-please-pass-a-valid-api-key.') return 'The Firebase Web API key in .env.local is missing or invalid.';
  if (code === 'auth/email-already-in-use') return 'That email already has a Firebase account. Use Sign in instead.';
  if (code === 'auth/weak-password') return 'Use a password with at least six characters.';
  if (code === 'auth/invalid-email') return 'Enter a valid email address.';

## 12. UI: preserve the existing product identity

Keep Claude's existing GUI, overall colour scheme, and MotorPH logo. The linked examples below are visual/interaction references, not permission to copy their branding or replace the MotorPH identity. Adapt their colours to the existing MotorPH palette and their dimensions to the actual layout.

### 12.1 Landing page

Use this CodePen as the landing-page layout and interaction reference:

https://codepen.io/shshaw/pen/aZXzzE

- Replace the current **Explore** and **Discover** actions with **Login** and **Contact Help**.
- **Login** opens the Employee ID/password login page.
- **Contact Help** opens the IT contact/help page for account access and login problems.
- Replace the example images with imagery suitable for MotorPH and the employee/payroll application.
- Change the highlight/accent colour to match the existing MotorPH colour scheme.
- Keep the page responsive and make both actions functional.

### 12.2 Icons and animation resources

Use the following as component/resource references:

- Icons: https://github.com/kubai087/kubai-icons
- Animations: https://sarthology.github.io/Animatopy/
- CSS effects/animations: https://ustymukhman.github.io/Dynamic.css/public/

Use icons consistently in navigation, sidebar previews, header controls, and relevant actions. Do not use arbitrary Unicode characters as substitutes for the provided icon set. Check licensing and package compatibility before adding assets. Avoid loading every animation library or effect if only a few components need it.

### 12.3 Sidebar navigation buttons

Use the following CodePen as the appearance and interaction reference for sidebar buttons:

https://codepen.io/ (the supplied 3D-button HTML/CSS/JS sample is reproduced in Appendix A)

Adapt the 3D card treatment to MotorPH colours. Use the supplied Start, Favorite, Confirm, and Settings sample only as a styling reference; use the application's actual navigation labels and actions. Scope all selectors to the sidebar component. Do not apply the sample's global `body`, `svg`, or button rules to the entire application.

### 12.4 Collapsible and previewable sidebar

The sidebar must support these states:

- **Expanded:** MotorPH logo, icons, and normal text labels are visible.
- **Collapsed/idle:** retain the MotorPH logo and show compact icon-only navigation.
- **Hover/focus preview:** temporarily reveal the full navigation labels and normal button appearance while the pointer or keyboard focus is within the sidebar. Restore the collapsed state on pointer exit or focus leaving the component.
- **Collapsed header treatment:** when the sidebar is collapsed and not being previewed, use the compact header-style treatment from https://codepen.io/ainalem/pen/pXrVmQ, adapted to the Kubai icons and MotorPH styling.

Keep the behaviour usable on touch devices, where hover is unavailable. Provide a dedicated expand/collapse control, accessible names/tooltips for icon-only controls, keyboard operation, visible focus, and reduced-motion behaviour. The MotorPH logo must remain visible in the collapsed state.

### 12.5 Payslip presentation

Use this as the payslip layout/generation reference:

https://codepen.io/vajkri/pen/PrBQxg

Keep the existing MotorPH logo in the payslip, retain all existing employee/pay-period/payroll details, and preserve the **Print Payslip** button. Adapt the reference to the current payslip data model; do not replace real employee-specific information with placeholder fields. Ensure printed output is legible, correctly paginated, and excludes navigation, unrelated controls, and decorative background effects.

### 12.6 Logout button

Use the supplied tactile/press-button sample in Appendix B as the visual reference for the logout control. Adapt the finish and colours to MotorPH. Scope the styles to the logout component; do not copy the sample's global `body` and `button` rules. The control must still perform the actual server-side logout and session invalidation.

### 12.7 Overview — “Your Pages” section

Use the isometric button reference below for the **Your Pages** section on the Overview tab:

https://codepen.io/ (the supplied HTML/CSS sample is reproduced in Appendix C)

Replace the example labels with the actual destinations available to the logged-in user. Each tile must navigate to its intended page. Retain responsive sizing, keyboard access, readable labels, and a usable reduced-motion alternative. Do not use the reference's full-screen positioning or global background styles inside the Overview tab.

### 12.8 My Pay switch control

Use this as the visual reference for switching between the MotorPH calculation and Sweldong Pinoy comparison:

https://codepen.io/ksenia-k/pen/poYZpyQ

The switch must be accessible by keyboard and screen reader, clearly indicate the selected calculation, and preserve the same employee/pay-period context when toggled.

### 12.9 Small header component

Use a very small, still-legible version of this reference in the application header:

https://codepen.io/ericadu/pen/GRZJjjE

It must remain subordinate to the MotorPH logo and primary navigation, must not crowd the header, and must not obscure controls at narrow widths.

### 12.10 Layered colour effect

Use this reference:

https://codepen.io/supah/pen/mMMdxG

Retain the reference's end colour, but change its start colour to a colour from the MotorPH palette. Make the topmost layer transparent and progressively lower the opacity of the nearby layers so the effect blends into the page background rather than appearing as an opaque slab. Keep text and controls legible above it.

### 12.11 Background effect

Use a restrained, less noticeable adaptation of:

https://codepen.io/mubangadv/pen/oNaBGLW

It should function as a subtle background detail, not compete with page content, consume excessive GPU/CPU resources, or reduce contrast. Provide a static/reduced-motion fallback and avoid unnecessary animation on low-powered devices.

### JavaScript

```javascript
document.querySelectorAll(".btn-3d").forEach((btn) => {
  btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const svg = btn.querySelector("svg");
    if (!svg) return;
    svg.classList.add("pulse");
    window.setTimeout(() => svg.classList.remove("pulse"), 500);
  });
});
```

## 16. Production-readiness requirements: the 12 missing items

Treat the following as required implementation work, not a post-launch wish list. Inspect the existing routes and deployment setup first, then implement each item in the conventions of the current stack. Do not create decorative placeholders that merely satisfy a checklist.

### 16.1 Custom 404 page

- Implement a branded not-found page that matches the MotorPH visual identity.
- Include a clear explanation and working navigation back to the landing page or the user's permitted dashboard.
- Unknown routes must return the correct HTTP 404 status where server routing permits; do not render a 404 design with HTTP 200 (soft 404).
- Do not disclose whether a protected route or resource exists to unauthorised users. Apply the application's normal authentication and authorisation rules.

### 16.2 Above-the-fold call to action

- The landing page must present its primary CTA within the initial viewport on common desktop and mobile dimensions, without requiring scrolling.
- The primary action is **Login**; **Contact Help** remains the secondary action.
- The CTA must be visually prominent, have a clear action label, and navigate to the real login/help routes.
- Keep the MotorPH identity and the existing landing-page reference requirements in Section 12.1. Do not let decorative effects push the CTA below the fold or obscure it.

### 16.3 Unique meta title per page

- Give every route a unique, accurate HTML document title. Do not reuse one generic title across every route.
- Use a consistent title format, such as `Page Name | MotorPH`, while keeping titles concise and descriptive.
- Do not expose private employee, payroll, or account details in document titles.

### 16.4 Unique meta description per page

- Give every public page an accurate meta description that describes the actual page and does not promise features that are absent.
- Do not reuse one generic description across every route. Keep descriptions concise and useful in search/social previews.
- Set canonical URLs only when a stable public canonical URL exists. Do not invent a production domain.
- For authenticated employee, HR, payroll, and administrative pages, use appropriate `noindex` directives. Do not expose private employee, payroll, or account content to search engines.

### 16.5 Open Graph and social sharing image

- Create a branded Open Graph image for public-facing pages, with the correct dimensions and legible composition at social-preview size.
- Configure `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:type`, `og:url`, and `og:image`, plus suitable Twitter/X card metadata.

export function bellLabel(unread) {
  return unread ? `Notifications (${unread} unread)` : 'Notifications';
}

export function notificationLines(items) {
  return items.map(item => ({ id: item.id, unread: !item.read, text: `${item.at.replace('T', ' ')} · ${item.kind}: ${item.text}` }));
}

export function initNotifications(apiJson, getAccount) {
  const bell = document.getElementById('notification-bell');
  const panel = document.getElementById('notification-panel');
  if (!bell || !panel) return { refresh() {} };
  const list = document.getElementById('notification-list');

  async function refresh() {
    if (!getAccount()) return;
    bell.hidden = false;
    try {
      const { items, unread } = await apiJson('/api/notifications');
      bell.textContent = unread ? `🔔 ${unread}` : '🔔';
      bell.setAttribute('aria-label', bellLabel(unread));
      list.replaceChildren();
      const lines = notificationLines(items);
      if (!lines.length) {
        const empty = document.createElement('li');
        empty.textContent = 'No notifications yet.';
        list.append(empty);
      }
      lines.forEach(line => {
        const item = document.createElement('li');
        item.textContent = line.text;
        if (line.unread) item.classList.add('unread');
        list.append(item);
      });
    } catch {
      bell.hidden = true;
    }
  }

  bell.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    panel.hidden = !panel.hidden;
    bell.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!panel.hidden));
    if (panel.hidden) return;
    await refresh();
    
    await apiJson('/api/notifications/read', {}).catch(() => {});
    bell.textContent = '🔔';
    bell.setAttribute('aria-label', bellLabel(0));
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
    if (event.key === 'Escape' && !panel.hidden) {
      panel.hidden = true;
      bell.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');

[NODE 20062]
One deliberate departure. The sample rotates the entire plane scaleX(.866) rotateZ(30deg) skewX(150deg). With two-word labels ("My Pay") that reads fine. With this application's eight
destinations and a description sentence each, the rotated plane makes the text unreadable — measured,
not guessed: the tiles overlapped and the counter-rotated content collapsed. So the plane stays square
and only the tiles extrude. The CSS comment says so, so it does not get "fixed" back.

## 4. Naming and code-style preferences

Follow these conventions where they fit the language and existing code. Do not sacrifice valid syntax, standard tooling, or readability to force a notation into a place where it does not belong.

### Variable and member naming

- When several variables share the same data type and their names are short, group declarations on one line, separated by commas. Split them when the line becomes difficult to scan, wraps excessively, or contains more than roughly four variables.
- For files with only a few variables and functions, prefer lowercase member notation such as `ab_name`. The prefix letters identify the source package/folder group and variable group: for example, `a` can identify `a_doc`, and `p` can identify a PhilHealth-related group.
- For a small number of names containing more than two words, use camelCase after the member prefix.
- For larger files with many declarations, combine the member notation with Hungarian-style type prefixes, for example `ab_dtName`, where `dt` identifies the data type and `Name` is the variable name.
- Apply the notation consistently within a file. Do not rename every existing identifier solely to impose a new style if doing so would create needless churn.

### File naming

- Prefer PascalCase for file names.
- Abbreviations are selective rather than mechanically shortened. `Emp`, `Hday`, `Gov`, `Sched`, `Svc`, `Mem`, `Req`, and `Deet` are acceptable where clear. Avoid unclear abbreviations such as `Atten`, `Pht`, `WF`, `WoFo`, `Cdr`, and `PS` for payslip. Do not abbreviate Firestore as `FS`, or mutable as `Mut`.
- Prefer an understandable full word over an abbreviation when uncertain. Do not invent a new abbreviation merely to shorten a filename.
- Keep names consistent within a feature area.

package ph.motorph.l_log;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

public final class AuditLog {
    static final int KEEP = 1000;
    static final int ARCHIVE_BATCH = 500;

    public static final class Entry {
        public final String at, actor, method, path, target;
        public final int status;

        Entry(String at, String actor, String method, String path, String target, int status) {
            this.at = at;
            this.actor = actor;
            this.method = method;
            this.path = path;
            this.target = target;
            this.status = status;
        }
    }

    
    public interface Archiver {
        String archive(List<Entry> oldest);
    }

    private final List<Entry> entries = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<String> archives = new ArrayList<>();

[NODE 20307]
$ cd /home/user/motorph-v3 && sed -n '32,60p' src/main/java/ph/motorph/l_log/AuditLog.java

[NODE 20308]
public synchronized void record(String at, String actor, String method, String path, String target, int status, Archiver archiver) {
        entries.add(new Entry(at, actor, method, path, target == null ? "" : target, status));
        if (entries.size() > KEEP) {
            List<Entry> oldest = new ArrayList<>(entries.subList(0, ARCHIVE_BATCH));
            String name = archiver == null ? null : archiver.archive(oldest);
            
            entries.subList(0, ARCHIVE_BATCH).clear();
            if (name != null) archives.add(name);
        }
    }

    
    public synchronized List<Entry> search(String actor, String pathContains, boolean failuresOnly, int limit) {
        List<Entry> found = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = entries.size() - 1; i >= 0 && found.size() < limit; i--) {
            Entry entry = entries.get(i);
            if (!actor.isEmpty() && !entry.actor.equals(actor) && !entry.target.equals(actor)) continue;
            if (!pathContains.isEmpty() && !entry.path.contains(pathContains)) continue;
            if (failuresOnly && entry.status < 400) continue;
            found.add(entry);
        }
        return found;
    }

    public synchronized int size() { return entries.size(); }

    public synchronized List<String> archives() { return Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(archives)); }
}

import java.util.ArrayList;

public final class AuditLogTest {
    private static int checks;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        AuditLog log = new AuditLog();
        List<List<AuditLog.Entry>> archived = new ArrayList<>();
        AuditLog.Archiver archiver = oldest -> {
            archived.add(oldest);
            return "audit-test-" + archived.size() + ".json";
        };
        for (int i = 1; i <= AuditLog.KEEP; i++) log.record("2026-11-06T09:00", i % 2 == 0 ? "10012" : "10013", "POST", "/api/x/" + i, "", i % 10 == 0 ? 403 : 200, archiver);
        check(log.size() == 1000 && archived.isEmpty(), "up to 1,000 entries are kept");
        log.record("2026-11-06T09:01", "10013", "POST", "/api/x/1001", "", 200, archiver);
        check(archived.size() == 1 && archived.get(0).size() == 500 && archived.get(0).get(0).path.equals("/api/x/1"), "entry 1,001 archives the oldest 500");
        check(log.size() == 501 && log.archives().equals(java.util.Collections.singletonList("audit-test-1.json")), "501 stay, and the archive is listed");
        check(log.search("", "", false, 1).get(0).path.equals("/api/x/1001"), "newest first");

        AuditLog memoryOnly = new AuditLog();

        check(memoryOnly.size() == 501 && memoryOnly.archives().isEmpty(), "without a data file the oldest are dropped");
        System.out.println("PASS: " + checks + " audit-log checks");
    }

    private static void check(boolean condition, String message) {
        checks++;
        if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }

    public static String cityOf(String address) {
        if (address == null) return null;
        String text = address.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        String best = null;
        for (String place : PLACES.keySet()) {
            if (text.contains(place) && (best == null || place.length() > best.length())) best = place;
        }
        return best;
    }

    public static double[] coordinates(String place) {
        return place == null ? null : PLACES.get(place.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT));
    }

    
    public static double kilometres(double[] a, double[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null) return Double.MAX_VALUE;
        double dLat = Math.toRadians(b[0] - a[0]), dLon = Math.toRadians(b[1] - a[1]);
        double lat1 = Math.toRadians(a[0]), lat2 = Math.toRadians(b[0]);
        double h = Math.sin(dLat / 2) * Math.sin(dLat / 2)
                 + Math.cos(lat1) * Math.cos(lat2) * Math.sin(dLon / 2) * Math.sin(dLon / 2);
        return 6371.0 * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(h), Math.sqrt(1 - h));
    }

package ph.motorph.c_calc;

import ph.motorph.o_oop.AttendanceRecord;

public final class ClockService {
    static final int QR_MINUTES = 10;
    private static final String QR_LETTERS = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789";
    private static final java.security.SecureRandom RANDOM = new java.security.SecureRandom();
    private final Clock clock;
    private final Map<String, LocalDateTime> openShifts = new HashMap<>();
    
    private final Map<String, String> onsiteCheckIns = new HashMap<>(); 
    private final Map<String, String> qrCodes = new HashMap<>();        
    private final Map<String, LocalDateTime> qrExpires = new HashMap<>();

    public ClockService(Clock clock) {
        if (clock == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("clock must not be null");
        this.clock = clock;
    }

    public LocalDateTime now() { return LocalDateTime.now(clock).truncatedTo(ChronoUnit.MINUTES); }

    
    public synchronized Map<String, LocalDateTime> exportOpenShifts() { return new HashMap<>(openShifts); }

    public synchronized void importOpenShifts(Map<String, LocalDateTime> shifts) {
        openShifts.clear();
        if (shifts != null) openShifts.putAll(shifts);
        qrCodes.clear();
        qrExpires.clear();
    }

    public synchronized Map<String, String> exportOnsiteCheckIns() { return new HashMap<>(onsiteCheckIns); }

    public synchronized void importOnsiteCheckIns(Map<String, String> checkIns) {
        onsiteCheckIns.clear();
        if (checkIns != null) onsiteCheckIns.putAll(checkIns);

    public synchronized Optional<LocalTime> onsiteAt(String employeeId, LocalDate date) {
        String time = onsiteCheckIns.get(employeeId + "|" + date);
        return time == null ? Optional.empty() : Optional.of(LocalTime.parse(time));
    }

    
    public synchronized Optional<String> currentQr(String employeeId) {
        if (!qrCodes.containsKey(employeeId) || now().isAfter(qrExpires.get(employeeId))) return Optional.empty();
        return Optional.of(qrCodes.get(employeeId));
    }

    public synchronized Optional<LocalDateTime> qrExpiry(String employeeId) { return Optional.ofNullable(qrExpires.get(employeeId)); }

    
    public synchronized String issueQr(String employeeId) {
        LocalDateTime start = openShifts.get(employeeId);
        if (start == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Clock in first.");
        if (onsiteAt(employeeId, start.toLocalDate()).isPresent()) throw new IllegalStateException("You are already checked in onsite.");
        StringBuilder code = new StringBuilder("MPH-");
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) code.append(QR_LETTERS.charAt(RANDOM.nextInt(QR_LETTERS.length())));
        qrCodes.put(employeeId, code.toString());
        qrExpires.put(employeeId, now().plusMinutes(QR_MINUTES));
        return code.toString();
    }

    
    public synchronized LocalTime scanOnsite(String employeeId, String code) {
        LocalDateTime start = openShifts.get(employeeId);
        if (start == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Clock in first.");
        if (onsiteAt(employeeId, start.toLocalDate()).isPresent()) throw new IllegalStateException("You are already checked in onsite.");
        if (!currentQr(employeeId).isPresent()) throw new IllegalStateException("That QR code expired; show a new one.");
        if (!qrCodes.get(employeeId).equals(code == null ? "" : code.trim().toUpperCase())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("That QR code is not for this shift.");
        LocalTime scanned = now().toLocalTime();
        onsiteCheckIns.put(employeeId + "|" + start.toLocalDate(), scanned.toString());
        qrCodes.remove(employeeId);
        qrExpires.remove(employeeId);
        return scanned;
    }

    public synchronized Optional<LocalDateTime> openShift(String employeeId) {
        return Optional.ofNullable(openShifts.get(employeeId));
    }

    public synchronized LocalDateTime clockIn(AttendanceService attendance, String employeeId) {
        if (openShifts.containsKey(employeeId)) throw new IllegalStateException("You are already clocked in.");
        LocalDateTime now = now();
        
        if (!attendance.findForEmployee(employeeId, now.toLocalDate(), now.toLocalDate()).isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Attendance is already recorded for today.");
        }
        openShifts.put(employeeId, now);
        issueQr(employeeId);
        return now;
    }

    public synchronized AttendanceRecord clockOut(AttendanceService attendance, String employeeId) {
        LocalDateTime start = openShifts.get(employeeId);
        if (start == null) throw new IllegalStateException("You are not clocked in.");
        LocalDateTime now = now();
        LocalDate date = start.toLocalDate();
        
        LocalTime out = now.toLocalDate().equals(date) ? now.toLocalTime() : LocalTime.of(23, 59);
        AttendanceRecord record = attendance.createForEmployee(employeeId, date, start.toLocalTime(), out);
        openShifts.remove(employeeId);
        qrCodes.remove(employeeId);
        qrExpires.remove(employeeId);
        return record;
    }
}

package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.util.Locale;

public final class PasswordPolicy {
    
    public static final String INITIAL_PASSWORD = "MotorPH-demo-2026";

    
    public static final String PEPPER_VARIABLE = "MOTORPH_PASSWORD_PEPPER";

    public static final int MIN_LENGTH = 12;

    private PasswordPolicy() {}

    
    public static java.util.List<String> problems(String password) {
        java.util.List<String> problems = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        String value = password == null ? "" : password;
        if (value.length() < MIN_LENGTH) problems.add("Use at least " + MIN_LENGTH + " characters.");
        if (value.equalsIgnoreCase(INITIAL_PASSWORD)) problems.add("Choose a password other than the initial one.");
        boolean hasLetter = false, hasDigit = false, hasSymbol = false;
        for (char c : value.toCharArray()) {
            if (Character.isLetter(c)) hasLetter = true;
            else if (Character.isDigit(c)) hasDigit = true;
            else if (!Character.isWhitespace(c)) hasSymbol = true;
        }
        if (!hasLetter) problems.add("Include at least one letter.");
        if (!hasDigit) problems.add("Include at least one digit.");
        if (!hasSymbol) problems.add("Include at least one symbol.");
        if (value.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("motorph")) problems.add("Do not use the company name in the password.");
        return problems;
    }

    public static void requireAcceptable(String password) {
        java.util.List<String> problems = problems(password);
        if (!problems.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException(String.join(" ", problems));
    }
}

package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

public final class Account {
    public final String employeeId;
    private String passwordHash;
    private boolean mustChangePassword;
    private int failedAttempts;
    private String lockedUntil;        
    private String lastSignIn;         

    public Account(String employeeId, String passwordHash, boolean mustChangePassword) {
        this.employeeId = employeeId;
        this.passwordHash = passwordHash;
        this.mustChangePassword = mustChangePassword;
        this.lockedUntil = "";
        this.lastSignIn = "";
    }

    public String passwordHash() { return passwordHash; }
    public boolean mustChangePassword() { return mustChangePassword; }
    public int failedAttempts() { return failedAttempts; }
    public String lockedUntil() { return lockedUntil; }
    public String lastSignIn() { return lastSignIn; }

    void replaceHash(String newHash) { this.passwordHash = newHash; this.mustChangePassword = false; }

    void recordFailure(int maxAttempts, java.time.Instant now, java.time.Duration lockFor) {
        failedAttempts++;
        if (failedAttempts >= maxAttempts) {
            lockedUntil = now.plus(lockFor).toString();
            failedAttempts = 0;
        }
    }

    void recordSuccess(java.time.Instant now) {
        failedAttempts = 0;
        lockedUntil = "";
        lastSignIn = now.toString();
    }

    boolean locked(java.time.Instant now) {
        if (lockedUntil == null || lockedUntil.isEmpty()) return false;
        return now.isBefore(java.time.Instant.parse(lockedUntil));
    }
}

function validateColumns(columns) {
  if (!Array.isArray(columns) || columns.length === 0) throw new TypeError('CSV must include at least one column.');
  columns.forEach((column, index) => {
    if (!column || typeof column.key !== 'string' || !column.key.trim()
      || typeof column.label !== 'string' || !column.label.trim()) {
      throw new TypeError(`CSV column ${index + 1} must include a key and label.`);
    }
  });
}

  const from = dateRange ? String(dateRange.from || '') : '';

  if (from && to && from > to) return [];

=== web/f_flares/WorkflowSort.js (16 lines) ===
const SORTABLE_FIELDS = new Set([
  'id', 'employeeName', 'status', 'submittedAt', 'leaveType', 'startDate', 'endDate', 'ticketType', 'queue'
]);

export function sortWorkflowItems(items, { field = 'submittedAt', direction = 'desc' } = {}) {
  if (!Array.isArray(items)) return [];
  const key = SORTABLE_FIELDS.has(field) ? field : 'submittedAt';
  const multiplier = direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
  return [...items].sort((left, right) => {
    const primary = String(left?.[key] ?? '').localeCompare(String(right?.[key] ?? ''), undefined,
      { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' });
    if (primary) return primary * multiplier;
    return String(left?.id ?? '').localeCompare(String(right?.id ?? ''), undefined,
      { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' });
  });
}

function csvCell(value) {

export function buildCsv(columns, rows) {
  validateColumns(columns);
  if (!Array.isArray(rows)) throw new TypeError('CSV rows must be an array.');
  rows.forEach((row, index) => {
    if (!row || typeof row !== 'object' || Array.isArray(row)) {
      throw new TypeError(`CSV row ${index + 1} must be an object.`);
    }
  });
  const header = columns.map(column => csvCell(column.label)).join(',');
  const body = rows.map(row => columns.map(column => csvCell(row[column.key])).join(','));
  return [header, ...body].join('\r\n');

package ph.motorph.o_oop;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.util.Objects;

public final class AttendanceRecord {
    private final int attendanceId;
    private final int scheduleId;
    private final LocalDate date;
    private final LocalTime timeIn;
    private final LocalTime timeOut;
    private final String dayType;

    public AttendanceRecord(int attendanceId, int scheduleId, LocalDate date,
                            LocalTime timeIn, LocalTime timeOut, String dayType) {
        if (attendanceId <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("attendanceId must be positive");
        if (scheduleId <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("scheduleId must be positive");
        this.date = Objects.requireNonNull(date, "date must not be null");
        this.timeIn = Objects.requireNonNull(timeIn, "timeIn must not be null");
        this.timeOut = Objects.requireNonNull(timeOut, "timeOut must not be null");
        if (timeIn.isAfter(timeOut)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("timeIn must be less than or equal to timeOut per the supplied data dictionary");
        }
        if (dayType == null || dayType.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dayType must not be blank");
        this.attendanceId = attendanceId;
        this.scheduleId = scheduleId;
        this.dayType = dayType.trim();
    }

    public int getAttendanceId() { return attendanceId; }
    public int getScheduleId() { return scheduleId; }
    public LocalDate getDate() { return date; }
    public LocalTime getTimeIn() { return timeIn; }
    public LocalTime getTimeOut() { return timeOut; }
    public String getDayType() { return dayType; }
}

package ph.motorph.o_oop;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.Objects;

public final class Employee {
    
    private final String eid,         
                         firstName,
                         lastName,
                         employeeStatus,   
                         position,
                         department;
    private final LocalDate birthday;

    
    private final String phone, street, city, region, postalCode,
                         sssNumber, philhealthNumber, tinNumber, pagibigNumber;

    
    private final BigDecimal monthlyBasic, riceSubsidy, phoneAllowance, clothingAllowance,
                             semiMonthlyRate, hourlyRate;

    
    private final String supervisorEid;   
    private final String branchName;

    private Employee(Builder b) {
        this.eid = require(b.eid, "employee number");
        this.firstName = require(b.firstName, "first name");
        this.lastName = require(b.lastName, "last name");
        this.birthday = b.birthday == null ? LocalDate.of(1970, 1, 1) : b.birthday;
        this.employeeStatus = require(b.employeeStatus, "employment status");
        this.position = require(b.position, "position");
        this.department = require(b.department, "department");
        this.phone = blankToEmpty(b.phone);
        this.street = blankToEmpty(b.street);
        this.city = blankToEmpty(b.city);
        this.region = blankToEmpty(b.region);
        this.postalCode = blankToEmpty(b.postalCode);
        this.sssNumber = blankToEmpty(b.sssNumber);
        this.philhealthNumber = blankToEmpty(b.philhealthNumber);
        this.tinNumber = blankToEmpty(b.tinNumber);
        this.pagibigNumber = blankToEmpty(b.pagibigNumber);
        this.monthlyBasic = money(b.monthlyBasic, "monthly basic rate");
        this.riceSubsidy = money(b.riceSubsidy, "rice subsidy");
        this.phoneAllowance = money(b.phoneAllowance, "phone allowance");
        this.clothingAllowance = money(b.clothingAllowance, "clothing allowance");
        this.semiMonthlyRate = money(b.semiMonthlyRate, "semi-monthly rate");
        this.hourlyRate = money(b.hourlyRate, "hourly rate");
        this.supervisorEid = blankToEmpty(b.supervisorEid);
        this.branchName = require(b.branchName, "branch");
    }

    private static String require(String value, String field) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(value, field + " must not be null");
        String text = value.trim();
        if (text.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must not be blank");
        return text;
    }
    private static String blankToEmpty(String value) { return value == null ? "" : value.trim(); }
    private static BigDecimal money(BigDecimal value, String field) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(value, field + " must not be null");
        if (value.signum() < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must not be negative");
        return value;
    }

    
    public String getEid() { return eid; }
    public String getFirstName() { return firstName; }
    public String getLastName() { return lastName; }
    
    public String getFullName() { return lastName + ", " + firstName; }
    
    public String getDisplayName() { return firstName + " " + lastName; }
    public LocalDate getBirthday() { return birthday; }
    public String getEmployeeStatus() { return employeeStatus; }
    public String getPosition() { return position; }
    public String getDepartment() { return department; }
    public String getPhone() { return phone; }
    public String getStreet() { return street; }
    public String getCity() { return city; }
    public String getRegion() { return region; }
    public String getPostalCode() { return postalCode; }
    public String getSssNumber() { return sssNumber; }
    public String getPhilhealthNumber() { return philhealthNumber; }
    public String getTinNumber() { return tinNumber; }
    public String getPagibigNumber() { return pagibigNumber; }
    public BigDecimal getMonthlyBasic() { return monthlyBasic; }
    public BigDecimal getRiceSubsidy() { return riceSubsidy; }
    public BigDecimal getPhoneAllowance() { return phoneAllowance; }
    public BigDecimal getClothingAllowance() { return clothingAllowance; }
    public BigDecimal getSemiMonthlyRate() { return semiMonthlyRate; }
    public BigDecimal getHourlyRate() { return hourlyRate; }
    public String getSupervisorEid() { return supervisorEid; }
    public boolean hasSupervisor() { return !supervisorEid.isEmpty(); }
    public String getBranchName() { return branchName; }

    
    public BigDecimal getTotalAllowances() { return riceSubsidy.add(phoneAllowance).add(clothingAllowance); }

    
    
    

    
    public String getId() { return eid; }
    
    public String getName() { return getDisplayName(); }
    public String getRole() { return position; }
    
    public String getLocation() { return branchName; }
    
    public String getStatus() { return employeeStatus; }

    
    public static Employee hired(String id, String name, String department, String role, String location, String status) {
        String[] parts = name.trim().isEmpty() ? new String[]{""} : name.trim().split(" +");
        String lastName = parts.length > 1 ? parts[parts.length - 1] : "";
        String firstName = parts.length > 1 ? name.substring(0, name.lastIndexOf(lastName)).trim() : name;
        return new Builder().eid(id).firstName(firstName == null || firstName.isEmpty() ? name : firstName)
            .lastName(lastName.isEmpty() ? "-" : lastName).employeeStatus(status).position(role)
            .department(department).branchName(location)
            .monthlyBasic(BigDecimal.ZERO).riceSubsidy(BigDecimal.ZERO).phoneAllowance(BigDecimal.ZERO)
            .clothingAllowance(BigDecimal.ZERO).semiMonthlyRate(BigDecimal.ZERO).hourlyRate(BigDecimal.ZERO)
            .build();
    }

    @Override public String toString() { return eid + " " + getFullName(); }

    
    public static final class Builder {
        private String eid, firstName, lastName, employeeStatus, position, department;
        private LocalDate birthday;
        private String phone, street, city, region, postalCode;
        private String sssNumber, philhealthNumber, tinNumber, pagibigNumber;
        private BigDecimal monthlyBasic, riceSubsidy, phoneAllowance, clothingAllowance, semiMonthlyRate, hourlyRate;
        private String supervisorEid, branchName;

        public Builder eid(String v) { eid = v; return this; }
        public Builder firstName(String v) { firstName = v; return this; }
        public Builder lastName(String v) { lastName = v; return this; }
        public Builder birthday(LocalDate v) { birthday = v; return this; }
        public Builder employeeStatus(String v) { employeeStatus = v; return this; }
        public Builder position(String v) { position = v; return this; }
        public Builder department(String v) { department = v; return this; }
        public Builder phone(String v) { phone = v; return this; }
        public Builder street(String v) { street = v; return this; }
        public Builder city(String v) { city = v; return this; }
        public Builder region(String v) { region = v; return this; }
        public Builder postalCode(String v) { postalCode = v; return this; }
        public Builder sssNumber(String v) { sssNumber = v; return this; }
        public Builder philhealthNumber(String v) { philhealthNumber = v; return this; }
        public Builder tinNumber(String v) { tinNumber = v; return this; }
        public Builder pagibigNumber(String v) { pagibigNumber = v; return this; }
        public Builder monthlyBasic(BigDecimal v) { monthlyBasic = v; return this; }
        public Builder riceSubsidy(BigDecimal v) { riceSubsidy = v; return this; }
        public Builder phoneAllowance(BigDecimal v) { phoneAllowance = v; return this; }
        public Builder clothingAllowance(BigDecimal v) { clothingAllowance = v; return this; }
        public Builder semiMonthlyRate(BigDecimal v) { semiMonthlyRate = v; return this; }
        public Builder hourlyRate(BigDecimal v) { hourlyRate = v; return this; }
        public Builder supervisorEid(String v) { supervisorEid = v; return this; }
        public Builder branchName(String v) { branchName = v; return this; }
        public Employee build() { return new Employee(this); }
    }

    public Builder toBuilder() {
        return new Builder().eid(eid).firstName(firstName).lastName(lastName).birthday(birthday)
            .employeeStatus(employeeStatus).position(position).department(department)
            .phone(phone).street(street).city(city).region(region).postalCode(postalCode)
            .sssNumber(sssNumber).philhealthNumber(philhealthNumber).tinNumber(tinNumber).pagibigNumber(pagibigNumber)
            .monthlyBasic(monthlyBasic).riceSubsidy(riceSubsidy).phoneAllowance(phoneAllowance)
            .clothingAllowance(clothingAllowance).semiMonthlyRate(semiMonthlyRate).hourlyRate(hourlyRate)
            .supervisorEid(supervisorEid).branchName(branchName);
    }
}

        EnumSet.range(DayOfWeek.MONDAY, DayOfWeek.FRIDAY), "", "");

    public final String employeeId, updatedBy, updatedAt;
    public final LocalTime shiftStart;
    public final Set<DayOfWeek> workdays;

    WorkSchedule(String employeeId, LocalTime shiftStart, Set<DayOfWeek> workdays, String updatedBy, String updatedAt) {
        this.employeeId = employeeId;
        this.shiftStart = shiftStart;
        this.workdays = Collections.unmodifiableSet(EnumSet.copyOf(workdays));
        this.updatedBy = updatedBy;
        this.updatedAt = updatedAt;
    }

    public LocalTime graceEnd() { return shiftStart.plusMinutes(PayrollPolicy.graceMinutes()); }
    public LocalTime mealStart() { return shiftStart.plusHours(4); }
    public LocalTime mealEnd() { return shiftStart.plusHours(5); }
    
    public LocalTime shiftEnd() { return shiftStart.plusMinutes(PayrollPolicy.dailyMinutes() + 60); }
    public boolean isWorkday(LocalDate date) { return workdays.contains(date.getDayOfWeek()); }

        public final String id, employeeId, from, to, shiftStart, reason, setBy, setAt;

            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;

    private void saveDataFile() {
        if (dataFile == null) return;
        try {
            dataFile.save(exportState());
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException ex) {
            System.err.println("Could not save local demo data to " + dataFile.path() + ": " + ex);
        }
    }

    
    private void context(String path, com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpHandler handler) {

                return;

                    sendError(exchange, refused.statusCode, refused.getMessage());

package ph.motorph.o_oop;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.util.Objects;

public final class AttendanceRecord {
    private final int attendanceId;
    private final int scheduleId;
    private final LocalDate date;
    private final LocalTime timeIn;
    private final LocalTime timeOut;
    private final String dayType;

    public AttendanceRecord(int attendanceId, int scheduleId, LocalDate date,
                            LocalTime timeIn, LocalTime timeOut, String dayType) {
        if (attendanceId <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("attendanceId must be positive");
        if (scheduleId <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("scheduleId must be positive");
        this.date = Objects.requireNonNull(date, "date must not be null");
        this.timeIn = Objects.requireNonNull(timeIn, "timeIn must not be null");
        this.timeOut = Objects.requireNonNull(timeOut, "timeOut must not be null");
        if (timeIn.isAfter(timeOut)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("timeIn must be less than or equal to timeOut per the supplied data dictionary");
        }
        if (dayType == null || dayType.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("dayType must not be blank");
        this.attendanceId = attendanceId;
        this.scheduleId = scheduleId;
        this.dayType = dayType.trim();
    }

    public int getAttendanceId() { return attendanceId; }
    public int getScheduleId() { return scheduleId; }
    public LocalDate getDate() { return date; }
    public LocalTime getTimeIn() { return timeIn; }
    public LocalTime getTimeOut() { return timeOut; }
    public String getDayType() { return dayType; }
}

## Deliberately not done

- **`AccessPolicy`** — 9 role constants and `actor.employeeId` are read by `AppServer` and the client
  mirror. Converting it means touching the whole authorisation surface at once, which is exactly the
  churn §4 warns about. Left for last, or never.
- **`AppServer` (4,244 lines)** — the single largest file. Same reasoning, plus it is the routing table:
  a rename that misses one string literal is a 404 nobody notices until a browser is open.
- **`credential.employeeId`, `session.employeeId`** and the other DTO fields — 227 references between
  them. These are the API's own vocabulary and appear in JSON keys; renaming them changes the wire
  format.

[NODE 21141]
$ cd /home/user/motorph-v3 && python3 - <<'PY' import pathlib p = pathlib.Path('docs/a_doc/member-notation.md'); t = p.read_text() anchor = "## Deliberately not done" new_section = """## The serialisation trap `data/local-demo.json` is written by Gson straight off field names. Renaming a field in a persisted class does not rename the JSON key: the old key lands on nothing, the field loads null (or 0), and the next `saveDataFile()` writes the blanked row back. It fails silently and only on a restart. That is what `Employee` and `AttendanceRecord` did -- the second one cost 7,421 attendance rows their `date`, `timeIn`, `timeOut` and `dayType` before the auto-backup was restored. Rule now: **a §4 rename on a persisted class carries `@SerializedName` with the old key.** The Java name is free to follow §4; the wire format never moves. Applied to `Employee` (24 fields) and `AttendanceRecord` (6 fields). Classes already on the wire and therefore pinned: `Employee`, `AttendanceRecord`, `WorkSchedule` + `DayChange`, `GovernmentDetails`, `SalaryHistory`, `PayrollAdjustments` lines, `SavedPayslipStore`, `PersonalDetails`, `AccountSecurity`, `Notifications`, and the other stores listed in `AppServer.loadDataFile`. `AuditLog` is safe by accident -- its fields were already `lg_*`. Verify a persisted rename by restarting the server and reading a row back, not by running the tests. The suite loads the CSV, never the file. """ assert anchor in t t = t.replace(anchor, new_section + anchor, 1) p.write_text(t); print("docs updated") PY cp docs/a_doc/member-notation.md md/markdown/member-notation.md && echo mirrored
