    public static final List<String> GENDERS = java.util.Arrays.asList("Female", "Male", "Prefer not to say");

    
    public static final class Names {
        final String firstName, surname;

        public Names(String firstName, String surname) {
            this.firstName = trim(firstName).replaceAll("\\s+", " ");
            this.surname = trim(surname).replaceAll("\\s+", " ");
        }

        public String full() { return firstName + " " + surname; }
    }

    
    public static final class Address {
        final String building, street, city, region, postalCode;

        public Address(String building, String street, String city, String region, String postalCode) {
            this.building = trim(building);
            this.street = trim(street);
            this.city = trim(city);
            this.region = trim(region);
            this.postalCode = trim(postalCode);
        }
    }

    private final Map<String, Record> records = new HashMap<>();

    public synchronized Optional<Record> find(String employeeId) { return Optional.ofNullable(records.get(employeeId)); }

    
    public synchronized Record set(String employeeId, Names names, String gender, String email, Address address, String contactNumber, String birthdate,
            LocalDate today, String by, String at) {
        for (String part : new String[] {names.firstName, names.surname}) {
            if (part.isEmpty() || part.length() > 60 || !part.matches("[\\p{L} .'-]+")) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("First name and surname are required (letters, spaces, . ' - ; up to 60 characters each).");
            }
        }
        if (!GENDERS.contains(trim(gender))) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Gender must be Female, Male or Prefer not to say.");
        String mail = trim(email).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
        if (!mail.isEmpty() && (mail.length() > 120 || !mail.matches("[a-z0-9._%+-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+\\.[a-z]{2,}"))) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Personal email must look like name@example.com (or be left empty).");
        }
        if (address.building.length() > 100) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Building must be at most 100 characters.");
        if (address.street.isEmpty() || address.street.length() > 150) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Street is required (up to 150 characters).");
        if (address.city.isEmpty() || address.city.length() > 80) throw new IllegalArgumentException("City is required (up to 80 characters).");
        if (address.region.isEmpty() || address.region.length() > 80) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Region is required (up to 80 characters).");
        if (!address.postalCode.matches("[0-9]{4}")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Postal code must be 4 digits.");
        String phone = trim(contactNumber).replaceAll("[\\s-]", "");
        if (!phone.matches("(09|\\+639)[0-9]{9}")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Contact number must be a mobile number like 09171234567 or +639171234567.");
        LocalDate born;
        try {
            born = LocalDate.parse(trim(birthdate));
        } catch (java.time.format.DateTimeParseException ex) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Birthdate must be a date (YYYY-MM-DD).");
        }
        int age = Period.between(born, today).getYears();
        if (born.isAfter(today) || age < 15 || age > 100) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Birthdate must make the employee 15 to 100 years old.");
        Record record = new Record(names, trim(gender), mail, address.building, address.street, address.city, address.region, address.postalCode, phone,
            born.toString(), by, at);
        records.put(employeeId, record);
        return record;
    }

    public synchronized void remove(String employeeId) { records.remove(employeeId); }

    private static String trim(String value) { return value == null ? "" : value.trim(); }
}

    public synchronized Numbers get(String employeeId) {
        Numbers current = numbers.get(employeeId);
        if (current != null) return current;
        Map<String, String> empty = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (String[] spec : FIELDS) empty.put(spec[0], "");
        return new Numbers(empty, "", "");
    }

    
    public synchronized Numbers set(String employeeId, Map<String, String> fields, String by) {
        Map<String, String> merged = new LinkedHashMap<>(get(employeeId).digits);
        merged.putAll(normalizeAll(fields));
        Numbers saved = new Numbers(merged, by, Instant.now().toString());
        numbers.put(employeeId, saved);
        log(by, employeeId, "EDITED", "Changed " + String.join(", ", fields.keySet()) + " directly");
        return saved;
    }

    public synchronized Request proposeChange(String employeeId, Map<String, String> fields, String reason, String by) {
        if (fields.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Propose at least one number.");
        Request request = new Request("GD-" + suffix(), "CHANGE", employeeId, normalizeAll(fields), text(reason), by, Instant.now().toString(),
            "Pending review", "", "", null);
        requests.put(request.id, request);
        log(by, employeeId, "CHANGE_REQUESTED", "Proposed " + String.join(", ", fields.keySet()));
        return request;
    }

    public synchronized Request requestAccess(String employeeId, String reason, String by) {
        String clean = text(reason);
        if (clean.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Say why you need the full numbers.");
        Request request = new Request("GA-" + suffix(), "ACCESS", employeeId, Collections.emptyMap(), clean, by, Instant.now().toString(),
            "Pending review", "", "", null);
        requests.put(request.id, request);
        log(by, employeeId, "ACCESS_REQUESTED", clean);
        return request;
    }

    
    public synchronized Request decide(String id, String decision, String reviewerId, LocalDate today) {
        Request current = find(id);
        if (!"Pending review".equals(current.status)) throw new IllegalStateException("Only a pending request can be decided.");
        boolean approve = "approve".equals(decision);
        if (!approve && !"reject".equals(decision)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Decision must be approve or reject.");
        if (approve && "CHANGE".equals(current.kind)) {
            Map<String, String> merged = new LinkedHashMap<>(get(current.employeeId).digits);
            merged.putAll(current.proposed);
            numbers.put(current.employeeId, new Numbers(merged, current.requestedBy + " (approved by " + reviewerId + ")", Instant.now().toString()));
        }
        Request decided = new Request(current.id, current.kind, current.employeeId, current.proposed, current.reason, current.requestedBy,
            current.requestedAt, approve ? "Approved" : "Rejected", reviewerId, Instant.now().toString(), approve && "ACCESS".equals(current.kind) ? today : null);
        requests.put(id, decided);
        log(reviewerId, current.employeeId, current.kind + (approve ? "_APPROVED" : "_REJECTED"), current.id + " from " + current.requestedBy);
        return decided;
    }

    
    public synchronized boolean hasAccess(String viewerId, String employeeId, LocalDate today) {
        for (Request request : requests.values()) {
            if ("ACCESS".equals(request.kind) && "Approved".equals(request.status) && request.requestedBy.equals(viewerId)
                    && request.employeeId.equals(employeeId) && today.equals(request.accessDate)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

DayChange(String id, String employeeId, String from, String to, String shiftStart, String reason, String setBy, String setAt) {
            this.id = id;
            this.employeeId = employeeId;
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.shiftStart = shiftStart;
            this.reason = reason;
            this.setBy = setBy;
            this.setAt = setAt;
        }

        public boolean dayOff() { return shiftStart == null || shiftStart.isEmpty(); }

        boolean covers(LocalDate date) { return !date.isBefore(LocalDate.parse(from)) && !date.isAfter(LocalDate.parse(to)); }
    }

    
    public static final class Store {
        private final Map<String, WorkSchedule> schedules = new HashMap<>();
        private java.util.List<DayChange> dayChanges = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        private int nextChange = 1;

        private java.util.List<DayChange> changes() {
            if (dayChanges == null) dayChanges = new java.util.ArrayList<>(); 
            return dayChanges;
        }

        
        public synchronized WorkSchedule forDate(String employeeId, LocalDate date) {
            WorkSchedule base = get(employeeId);
            DayChange change = null;
            for (DayChange item : changes()) if (item.employeeId.equals(employeeId) && item.covers(date)) change = item;
            if (change == null) return base;
            java.util.EnumSet<DayOfWeek> days = java.util.EnumSet.noneOf(DayOfWeek.class);
            days.addAll(base.workdays);
            if (change.dayOff()) days.remove(date.getDayOfWeek());
            else days.add(date.getDayOfWeek());
            if (days.isEmpty()) days.add(date.getDayOfWeek() == DayOfWeek.MONDAY ? DayOfWeek.TUESDAY : DayOfWeek.MONDAY); 
            return new WorkSchedule(employeeId, change.dayOff() ? base.shiftStart : LocalTime.parse(change.shiftStart), days, change.setBy, change.setAt);
        }

        
        public synchronized DayChange addDayChange(String employeeId, LocalDate from, LocalDate to, LocalTime shiftStart, String reason, String setBy) {
            if (to.isBefore(from)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("The last date must be on or after the first.");
            if (from.getYear() != 2026 || to.getYear() != 2026) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Dates must be in 2026 (the loaded payroll year).");
            if (java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(from, to) > 30) throw new IllegalArgumentException("A day change covers at most 31 days; use the weekly pattern for longer.");
            if (shiftStart != null && (shiftStart.isBefore(LocalTime.of(5, 0)) || shiftStart.isAfter(LocalTime.of(15, 0)))) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Shift start must be between 05:00 and 15:00 (no overnight shifts yet).");
            }
            String text = reason == null ? "" : reason.trim();
            if (text.isEmpty() || text.length() > 200) throw new IllegalArgumentException("A reason (up to 200 characters) is required.");
            DayChange change = new DayChange(String.format("SC-%04d", nextChange++), employeeId, from.toString(), to.toString(),
                shiftStart == null ? "" : shiftStart.withSecond(0).withNano(0).toString(), text, setBy, Instant.now().toString());
            changes().add(change);
            return change;
        }

        public synchronized DayChange removeDayChange(String id) {
            for (java.util.Iterator<DayChange> it = changes().iterator(); it.hasNext(); ) {
                DayChange change = it.next();
                if (change.id.equals(id)) {
                    it.remove();
                    return change;
                }
            }
            throw new java.util.NoSuchElementException("Day change not found.");
        }

        public synchronized java.util.List<DayChange> dayChangesForAll() { return new java.util.ArrayList<>(changes()); }

        public synchronized java.util.List<DayChange> dayChangesFor(String employeeId) {
            java.util.List<DayChange> mine = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
            for (DayChange change : changes()) if (change.employeeId.equals(employeeId)) mine.add(change);
            return mine;
        }

        public synchronized WorkSchedule get(String employeeId) {
            WorkSchedule schedule = schedules.get(employeeId);
            return schedule == null ? new WorkSchedule(employeeId, DEFAULT.shiftStart, DEFAULT.workdays, "", "") : schedule;
        }

private static long[] wholeDays(long workedMinutes, long scheduledMinutes) {
        if (workedMinutes >= scheduledMinutes) return new long[]{ 1, 0, scheduledMinutes };
        return new long[]{ 0, workedMinutes, scheduledMinutes };
    }

    
    private static BigDecimal partOf(long[] dayUnits) {
        return dayUnits[1] == 0 ? BigDecimal.ZERO
            : BigDecimal.valueOf(dayUnits[1]).divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(dayUnits[2]), 10, java.math.RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }

    
    private static BigDecimal dayPay(BigDecimal dailyRate, long wholeDays, BigDecimal fractionDays) {
        return dailyRate.multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(wholeDays)).add(dailyRate.multiply(fractionDays))
            .setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
    }

    public static double[] coordinates(String place) {

    public static double kilometres(double[] lc_apFrom, double[] lc_apTo) {
        if (lc_apFrom == null || lc_apTo == null) return Double.MAX_VALUE;
        double lc_dblDLat = Math.toRadians(lc_apTo[0] - lc_apFrom[0]), lc_dblDLon = Math.toRadians(lc_apTo[1] - lc_apFrom[1]);
        double lc_dblLat1 = Math.toRadians(lc_apFrom[0]), lc_dblLat2 = Math.toRadians(lc_apTo[0]);
        double lc_dblH = Math.sin(lc_dblDLat / 2) * Math.sin(lc_dblDLat / 2)
                 + Math.cos(lc_dblLat1) * Math.cos(lc_dblLat2) * Math.sin(lc_dblDLon / 2) * Math.sin(lc_dblDLon / 2);
        return 6371.0 * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(lc_dblH), Math.sqrt(1 - lc_dblH));
    }

package ph.motorph.o_oop;

public enum Branch {
    MAIN("Main Branch", 14.5995, 120.9842),
    MAKATI("Makati", 14.5547, 121.0244),
    QUEZON_CITY("Quezon City", 14.6760, 121.0437),
    TAGUIG("Taguig", 14.5176, 121.0509),
    PASIG("Pasig", 14.5764, 121.0851);

    private final String br_sName;
    private final double br_dblLat, br_dblLng;

    Branch(String br_sName, double br_dblLat, double br_dblLng) {
        this.br_sName = br_sName;
        this.br_dblLat = br_dblLat;
        this.br_dblLng = br_dblLng;
    }

    public String label() { return br_sName; }
    public double latitude() { return br_dblLat; }
    public double longitude() { return br_dblLng; }

    public static Branch fromLabel(String value) {
        for (Branch br_iter : values()) if (br_iter.br_sName.equalsIgnoreCase(value == null ? "" : value.trim())) return br_iter;
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown branch: " + value);
    }

    public static Branch[] fieldOffices() {
        return new Branch[]{ MAKATI, QUEZON_CITY, TAGUIG, PASIG };
    }
}

    private static int stableId(String employeeId) {
        String digits = employeeId.replaceAll("[^0-9]", "");
        int value = digits.isEmpty() ? Math.abs(employeeId.hashCode()) : Integer.parseInt(digits.substring(Math.max(0, digits.length() - 5)));
        return 100 + Math.floorMod(value, 900);
    }

## 16. Deliverables

Provide:

1. The implemented project, with all changed source files and configuration.
2. The source comparison record explaining what was retained from Claude, what was retained from the current project, and what was replaced or reconciled.
3. A concise implementation summary organised by feature area.
4. The final folder tree.
5. Instructions to install dependencies, configure secrets, initialise/import the employee data, run the application, and run all tests.
6. A list of environment variables and safe example values/placeholders.
7. Test/build/lint/security/a11y results, including failures and checks that could not be run.
8. Documentation of payroll assumptions, statutory sources/effective dates, generated attendance/payroll provenance, role permissions, branch assignments, and session policy.
9. A list of remaining limitations or decisions that could not be resolved from the supplied materials.

Do not report a percentage of completion unless it is calculated against a defined feature inventory. Do not claim the application is production-ready merely because it builds. Be explicit about anything that remains unverified.

private FirestoreRestClient firestoreClientFor(HttpExchange exchange) {
        String authorization = exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Authorization");
        String uid = exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("X-Firebase-UID");
        if (authorization == null || !authorization.startsWith("Bearer ") || uid == null || uid.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new FirestoreException("Sign in with your Firebase account to continue.", 401);
        }
        String token = authorization.substring("Bearer ".length()).trim();
        if (token.length() > 8192 || uid.length() > 128 || uid.contains("/")) {
            throw new FirestoreException("Invalid Firebase session information.", 401);
        }
        return firestoreApiRoot == null
            ? new FirestoreRestClient(firebaseProjectId, uid, token)
            : new FirestoreRestClient(firebaseProjectId, uid, token, firestoreApiRoot);
    }

    private static LocalDate parseOptionalDate(String value) {
        return value == null || value.trim().isEmpty() ? null : LocalDate.parse(value.trim());
    }

[NODE 22504]
public SeedResult seedMissingRecords() {
        int employeesCreated = 0;
        for (Employee employee : new InMemoryEmployeeStore().findAll()) {
            if (client.createDocument(client.userCollection("demoEmployees"), employee.getId(), employeeFields(employee))) {
                employeesCreated++;
            }
        }

        int attendanceCreated = 0;
        InMemoryAttendanceStore sampleAttendance = new InMemoryAttendanceStore();
        for (int scheduleId : Arrays.asList(101, 102, 103)) {
            for (AttendanceRecord record : sampleAttendance.findByScheduleId(scheduleId)) {
                if (client.createDocument(client.userCollection("demoAttendance"),
                    Integer.toString(record.getAttendanceId()), attendanceFields(record))) {
                    attendanceCreated++;
                }
            }
        }
        return new SeedResult(employeesCreated, attendanceCreated);
    }

    private static JsonObject employeeFields(Employee employee) {
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("id", string(employee.getId()));
        fields.add("name", string(employee.getName()));
        fields.add("department", string(employee.getDepartment()));
        fields.add("role", string(employee.getRole()));
        fields.add("location", string(employee.getLocation()));
        fields.add("status", string(employee.getStatus()));
        return fields;
    }

    private static JsonObject attendanceFields(AttendanceRecord record) {
        JsonObject fields = new JsonObject();
        fields.add("attendanceId", integer(record.getAttendanceId()));
        fields.add("scheduleId", integer(record.getScheduleId()));
        fields.add("date", string(record.getDate().toString()));
        fields.add("timeIn", string(record.getTimeIn().toString()));
        fields.add("timeOut", string(record.getTimeOut().toString()));
        fields.add("dayType", string("Imported"));
        return fields;
    }

    private static JsonObject string(String value) {
        JsonObject typedValue = new JsonObject();
        typedValue.addProperty("stringValue", value);
        return typedValue;
    }

    private static JsonObject integer(int value) {
        JsonObject typedValue = new JsonObject();
        typedValue.addProperty("integerValue", Integer.toString(value));
        return typedValue;
    }

public List<JsonObject> listDocuments(String collectionPath) {
        List<JsonObject> documents = new ArrayList<>();
        String pageToken = "";
        do {
            String url = documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "?pageSize=1000" + pageToken;
            JsonObject response = send("GET", url, null, false);
            JsonArray items = response.has("documents") ? response.getAsJsonArray("documents") : new JsonArray();
            for (JsonElement item : items) documents.add(item.getAsJsonObject());
            pageToken = response.has("nextPageToken")
                ? "&pageToken=" + queryEncode(response.get("nextPageToken").getAsString()) : "";
        } while (!pageToken.isEmpty());
        return documents;
    }

    public boolean createDocument(String collectionPath, String documentId, JsonObject fields) {
        String url = documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "?documentId=" + queryEncode(requireSafeSegment(documentId, "document id"));
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.add("fields", fields);
        return send("POST", url, body, true).has("name");
    }

    public boolean updateDocument(String collectionPath, String documentId, JsonObject fields, List<String> updateMask) {
        if (fields == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("document fields must not be null");
        if (updateMask == null || updateMask.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("update mask must not be empty");
        StringBuilder url = new StringBuilder(documentsUrl(collectionPath))
            .append('/').append(pathEncode(requireSafeSegment(documentId, "document id")));
        for (String field : updateMask) {
            String safeField = requireSafeSegment(field, "update field");
            url.append(url.indexOf("?") < 0 ? "?" : "&")
                .append("updateMask.fieldPaths=").append(queryEncode(safeField));
        }
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.add("fields", fields);
        return send("PATCH", url.toString(), body, false).has("name");
    }

    public String userCollection(String collectionName) {
        return "users/" + userId + "/" + requireSafeSegment(collectionName, "collection name");

    public synchronized void save(JsonObject stores) throws IOException {
        JsonObject document = new JsonObject();
        document.addProperty("format", FORMAT_VERSION);
        document.addProperty("savedAt", Instant.now().toString());
        document.add("stores", stores);
        Path parent = path.getParent();
        if (parent != null) Files.createDirectories(parent);
        Path temp = path.resolveSibling(path.getFileName() + ".tmp");
        Files.write(temp, gson.toJson(document).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        replaceWithRetry(temp);
        if (lastBackup == null) lastBackup = newestBackupTime();
        if (lastBackup == null || lastBackup.isBefore(Instant.now().minusSeconds(AUTO_BACKUP_MINUTES * 60))) backupNow("auto");
    }

    
    private void replaceWithRetry(Path temp) throws IOException {
        for (int attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
            try {
                try {
                    Files.move(temp, path, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE);
                } catch (AtomicMoveNotSupportedException ex) {
                    Files.move(temp, path, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
                }
                return;
            } catch (java.nio.file.FileSystemException busy) { 
                if (attempt >= 5) throw busy;
                try {
                    Thread.sleep(40L * attempt);
                } catch (InterruptedException interrupted) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                    throw busy;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public Path backupDirectory() { return path.resolveSibling("backups"); }

=== load ===
    public synchronized Optional<JsonObject> load() throws IOException {
        if (!Files.exists(path)) return Optional.empty();
        return Optional.of(readStores(path));
    }

    private JsonObject readStores(Path file) throws IOException {
        JsonElement parsed = JsonParser.parseString(new String(Files.readAllBytes(file), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        if (!parsed.isJsonObject() || !parsed.getAsJsonObject().has("stores")
                || parsed.getAsJsonObject().get("format").getAsInt() != FORMAT_VERSION) {
            throw new IOException("Unknown data file format.");
        }
        return parsed.getAsJsonObject().getAsJsonObject("stores");
    }

    
    public synchronized Path setAside() throws IOException {
        Path aside = path.resolveSibling(path.getFileName() + ".unreadable-" + Instant.now().toEpochMilli());
        Files.move(path, aside, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
        return aside;
    }
}

private JsonObject send(String method, String url, JsonObject body, boolean allowExisting) {
        try {
            HttpRequest.Builder builder = HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create(url))
                .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(20))
                .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + idToken)
                .header("Accept", "application/json");
            if (body != null) {
                builder.header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
                    .method(method, HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(body.toString(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            } else {
                builder.method(method, HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.noBody());
            }
            HttpResponse<String> response = HTTP.send(builder.build(), HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            if (allowExisting && (response.statusCode() == 409 || response.statusCode() == 400)
                && response.body() != null && response.body().contains("ALREADY_EXISTS")) {
                return new JsonObject();
            }
            if (response.statusCode() < 200 || response.statusCode() >= 300) {
                throw firestoreError(response.statusCode(), response.body());
            }
            String responseBody = response.body();
            return responseBody == null || responseBody.trim().isEmpty()
                ? new JsonObject() : JsonParser.parseString(responseBody).getAsJsonObject();
        } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            throw new FirestoreException("Firestore request was interrupted.", 503);
        } catch (IOException | IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            throw new FirestoreException("Could not reach Firestore. Check the network and project setup.", 503);
        }
    }

    private String documentsUrl(String collectionPath) {
        StringBuilder path = new StringBuilder(apiRoot)
            .append(pathEncode(projectId)).append("/databases/(default)/documents");
        for (String segment : collectionPath.split("/")) {
            path.append('/').append(pathEncode(requireSafeSegment(segment, "path segment")));
        }
        return path.toString();
    }

    private static String requireSafeSegment(String value, String label) {
        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty() || value.contains("/")) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(label + " must be a non-empty path segment");
        }
        return value.trim();
    }

    private static String pathEncode(String value) {
        return URLEncoder.encode(value, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).replace("+", "%20");
    }

    private static String queryEncode(String value) {
        return URLEncoder.encode(value, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    private static FirestoreException firestoreError(int status, String body) {
        String message = "Firestore request failed (HTTP " + status + ").";
        if (status == 401) message = "Firebase sign-in expired. Sign out and sign in again.";

            @Override public T read(com.google.gson.stream.JsonReader in) throws IOException {
                if (in.peek() == com.google.gson.stream.JsonToken.NULL) { in.nextNull(); return null; }
                return parse.apply(in.nextString());
            }
        }.nullSafe();
    }

    @Override public Gson gson() { return fs_gson; }

    @Override public String describe() { return "Firestore (" + ROOT + " collection)"; }

    @Override public Optional<JsonObject> load() throws IOException {
        JsonObject meta = readObject("_meta");
        if (meta == null) return Optional.empty();
        int format = meta.has("format") ? meta.get("format").getAsInt() : FORMAT_VERSION;
        if (format != FORMAT_VERSION) throw new IOException("Unknown Firestore state format: " + format);

        JsonObject stores = new JsonObject();
        JsonObject index = readObject("_index");
        if (index == null) return Optional.of(stores);

        for (String storeName : index.keySet()) {
            int chunks = index.get(storeName).getAsInt();
            StringBuilder joined = new StringBuilder();
            for (int part = 0; part < chunks; part++) {
                JsonObject chunk = readObject("chunks/" + storeName + "_" + String.format("%04d", part));
                if (chunk == null || !chunk.has("json")) {
                    throw new IOException("Firestore state is missing chunk " + part + " of " + storeName);
                }
                joined.append(chunk.get("json").getAsString());
            }
            stores.add(storeName, JsonParser.parseString(joined.toString()));
        }
        return Optional.of(stores);
    }

    @Override public synchronized void save(JsonObject stores) throws IOException {
        JsonObject index = new JsonObject();
        List<String> writtenChunks = new ArrayList<>();

        for (String storeName : stores.keySet()) {
            String json = fs_gson.toJson(stores.get(storeName));
            int total = json.length();
            int partCount = Math.max(1, (total + CHUNK_CHARS - 1) / CHUNK_CHARS);
            for (int part = 0; part < partCount; part++) {
                int from = part * CHUNK_CHARS;
                int to = Math.min(total, from + CHUNK_CHARS);
                String id = "chunks/" + storeName + "_" + String.format("%04d", part);
                writeObject(id, single("json", json.substring(from, to)));
                writtenChunks.add(id);
            }
            index.addProperty(storeName, partCount);
        }

        writeObject("_index", index);
        writeObject("_meta", meta(Instant.now().toString()));
    }

    private JsonObject meta(String savedAt) {
        JsonObject object = new JsonObject();
        object.addProperty("format", FORMAT_VERSION);
        object.addProperty("savedAt", savedAt);
        return object;
    }

    private JsonObject single(String field, String value) {
        JsonObject object = new JsonObject();
        object.addProperty(field, value);
        return object;
    }

    private JsonObject readObject(String documentId) throws IOException {
        String path = ROOT;
        String id = documentId;
        if (documentId.startsWith("chunks/")) {
            path = ROOT + "/chunks";
            id = documentId.substring("chunks/".length());
        }
        for (JsonObject raw : fs_client.listDocuments(path)) {
            String name = raw.has("name") ? raw.get("name").getAsString() : "";
            if (!name.endsWith("/" + id)) continue;
            JsonObject fields = raw.has("fields") ? raw.getAsJsonObject("fields") : new JsonObject();
            JsonObject flat = new JsonObject();
            for (String key : fields.keySet()) {
                JsonObject typed = fields.getAsJsonObject(key);
                if (typed.has("stringValue")) flat.addProperty(key, typed.get("stringValue").getAsString());
                else if (typed.has("integerValue")) flat.addProperty(key, typed.get("integerValue").getAsLong());
            }
            return flat;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private void writeObject(String documentId, JsonObject flat) throws IOException {
        JsonObject typed = new JsonObject();
        for (String key : flat.keySet()) {
            JsonObject value = new JsonObject();
            JsonElement raw = flat.get(key);
            if (raw.getAsJsonPrimitive().isNumber()) value.addProperty("integerValue", raw.getAsLong());
            else value.addProperty("stringValue", raw.getAsString());
            typed.add(key, value);
        }
        String path = ROOT;
        String id = documentId;
        if (documentId.startsWith("chunks/")) {
            path = ROOT + "/chunks";
            id = documentId.substring("chunks/".length());
        }
        if (!fs_client.createDocument(path, id, typed)) {
            throw new IOException("Firestore refused to write " + documentId);
        }
    }
}

[NODE 22957]
I see the problem clearly now. readObject uses listDocuments(path) and scans for the id. That's O(n) per document — so during load(), reading 33 chunks means 33 list calls, each returning all 33 documents. With 1 MB payloads, that's 33 × (33 × ~800 KB) worth of transfer — gigabytes. In the test it was small so it passed; with the real 800 KB chunk it becomes quadratic and effectively hangs.

[NODE 22958]

private JsonObject send(String method, String url, JsonObject body, boolean allowExisting) {
        try {
            HttpRequest.Builder builder = HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create(url))
                .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(20))
                .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + idToken)
                .header("Accept", "application/json");
            if (body != null) {
                builder.header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
                    .method(method, HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(body.toString(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            } else {
                builder.method(method, HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.noBody());
            }
            HttpResponse<String> response = HTTP.send(builder.build(), HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            if (allowExisting && (response.statusCode() == 409 || response.statusCode() == 400)
                && response.body() != null && response.body().contains("ALREADY_EXISTS")) {
                return new JsonObject();
            }
            if (response.statusCode() < 200 || response.statusCode() >= 300) {
                throw firestoreError(response.statusCode(), response.body());
            }
            String responseBody = response.body();
            return responseBody == null || responseBody.trim().isEmpty()
                ? new JsonObject() : JsonParser.parseString(responseBody).getAsJsonObject();
        } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            throw new FirestoreException("Firestore request was interrupted.", 503);
        } catch (IOException | IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            throw new FirestoreException("Could not reach Firestore. Check the network and project setup.", 503);
        }
    }

=== updateDocument full ===
    public boolean updateDocument(String collectionPath, String documentId, JsonObject fields, List<String> updateMask) {
        if (fields == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("document fields must not be null");
        if (updateMask == null || updateMask.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("update mask must not be empty");
        StringBuilder url = new StringBuilder(documentsUrl(collectionPath))
            .append('/').append(pathEncode(requireSafeSegment(documentId, "document id")));
        for (String field : updateMask) {
            String safeField = requireSafeSegment(field, "update field");
            url.append(url.indexOf("?") < 0 ? "?" : "&")
                .append("updateMask.fieldPaths=").append(queryEncode(safeField));
        }
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.add("fields", fields);
        return send("PATCH", url.toString(), body, false).has("name");
    }

    public String userCollection(String collectionName) {
        return "users/" + userId + "/" + requireSafeSegment(collectionName, "collection name");
    }

private void handle(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
            String path = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();
            String query = exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery();
            int marker = path.indexOf("/documents");
            String tail = marker < 0 ? "" : path.substring(marker + "/documents".length());
            tail = tail.startsWith("/") ? tail.substring(1) : tail;

            if ("POST".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
                String documentId = valueOf(query, "documentId");
                String body = new String(exchange.getRequestBody().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                JsonObject parsed = JsonParser.parseString(body).getAsJsonObject();
                documents.put(tail + "/" + documentId, parsed.getAsJsonObject("fields"));
                reply(exchange, 200, "{\"name\":\"projects/demo/databases/(default)/documents/" + tail + "/" + documentId + "\"}");
                return;
            }

            if ("GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
                List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();
                for (Map.Entry<String, JsonObject> entry : documents.entrySet()) {
                    if (!entry.getKey().startsWith(tail + "/")) continue;
                    if (entry.getKey().substring(tail.length() + 1).contains("/")) continue;
                    JsonObject document = new JsonObject();
                    document.addProperty("name", "projects/demo/databases/(default)/documents/" + entry.getKey());
                    document.add("fields", entry.getValue());
                    names.add(document.toString());
                }
                reply(exchange, 200, "{\"documents\":[" + String.join(",", names) + "]}");
                return;
            }
            reply(exchange, 405, "{}");
        }

        private static String valueOf(String query, String key) {
            if (query == null) return "";
            for (String pair : query.split("&")) {
                int eq = pair.indexOf('=');
                if (eq > 0 && pair.substring(0, eq).equals(key)) {
                    return java.net.URLDecoder.decode(pair.substring(eq + 1), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                }
            }
            return "";
        }

        private static void reply(HttpExchange exchange, int status, String body) throws IOException {
            byte[] bytes = body.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", "application/json");
            exchange.sendResponseHeaders(status, bytes.length);
            try (OutputStream out = exchange.getResponseBody()) { out.write(bytes); }
        }
    }
}

#!/usr/bin/env sh
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
case "$(uname -s)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) S=";" ;; *) S=":" ;; esac

sh tools/build.sh --with-tests
CP="lib/gson-2.13.2.jar${S}lib/bcprov-jdk18on-1.78.1.jar${S}target/classes${S}target/test-classes"

fail=0
pass=0
for f in $(find src/test/java -name '*Test.java' | sort); do
  cls=$(printf '%s' "$f" | sed 's|src/test/java/||; s|/|.|g; s|\.java$||')
  if java --add-modules jdk.httpserver -cp "$CP" "$cls" 2>&1 | tee /tmp/motorph-test-out.txt | grep -q "^FAIL"; then
    echo "FAILED: $cls"
    cat /tmp/motorph-test-out.txt
    fail=$((fail + 1))
  else
    tail -n 1 /tmp/motorph-test-out.txt | sed "s|^|$cls: |"
    pass=$((pass + 1))
  fi
done

if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "---- web unit tests ----"
  if node --test test/web/*.test.js 2>&1 | tee /tmp/motorph-web-out.txt | tail -n 8 | grep -q "^# fail 0"; then
    grep -E "^# (tests|pass|fail)" /tmp/motorph-web-out.txt | sed 's/^# /web: /'
    pass=$((pass + 1))
  else
    echo "web unit tests FAILED"
    grep -E "^not ok" /tmp/motorph-web-out.txt | head -10
    fail=$((fail + 1))
  fi
fi

echo "----"
echo "suites passed: $pass   failed: $fail"
[ "$fail" -eq 0 ]

package ph.motorph.o_oop;

import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpExchange;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpServer;
import java.io.IOException;

/**
 * Exercises FirestoreStateStore against a stand-in Firestore, so the save/load path can be
 * proven without a project, a service account or a network. The fake implements only the two
 * calls the store makes: create a document, and list a collection.
 */
public final class FirestoreStateStoreTest {
    private static int checks;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        FakeFirestore fake = new FakeFirestore();
        fake.start();
        try {
            String apiRoot = "http://127.0.0.1:" + fake.port() + "/v1/projects/";
            FirestoreRestClient client = new FirestoreRestClient("demo-project", "uid-under-test", "fake-token", apiRoot);
            FirestoreStateStore store = new FirestoreStateStore(client);

            check(store.load().isEmpty(), "an empty Firestore loads as nothing, not an error");

            JsonObject stores = new JsonObject();
            JsonObject employees = new JsonObject();
            employees.addProperty("10001", "Manuel III Garcia");
            stores.add("employees", employees);

            JsonObject attendance = new JsonObject();
            StringBuilder big = new StringBuilder();
            for (int i = 0; i < 120_000; i++) big.append("row").append(i).append(';');
            attendance.addProperty("blob", big.toString());
            stores.add("attendance", attendance);

            long rawBytes = big.length();
            check(rawBytes > 700_000, "the sample attendance store is big enough to need chunking (" + rawBytes + " bytes)");

            store.save(stores);
            check(fake.documentCount() >= 3, "save wrote meta, index and at least one chunk (" + fake.documentCount() + " docs)");
            check(fake.chunkCount("attendance") >= 2, "attendance was split across " + fake.chunkCount("attendance") + " chunks");

            Optional<JsonObject> loaded = store.load();
            check(loaded.isPresent(), "a saved state loads back");
            JsonObject back = loaded.get();
            check(back.has("employees"), "employees survive the round trip");
            check("Manuel III Garcia".equals(back.getAsJsonObject("employees").get("10001").getAsString()),
                "a small store comes back byte for byte");
            check(back.has("attendance"), "attendance survives the round trip");
            check(big.toString().equals(back.getAsJsonObject("attendance").get("blob").getAsString()),
                "a chunked store rejoins to exactly what went in (" + rawBytes + " bytes)");

            JsonObject second = new JsonObject();
            second.addProperty("note", "second save");
            store.save(second);
            Optional<JsonObject> reloaded = store.load();
            check(reloaded.isPresent() && reloaded.get().has("note"), "a second save replaces the first");
            check(!reloaded.get().has("attendance"), "the old store is gone after a full save, not merged in");
        } finally {
            fake.stop();
        }
        System.out.println("FirestoreStateStoreTest: " + checks + " checks passed");
    }

    private static void check(boolean ok, String what) {
        if (!ok) {
            System.out.println("FAIL " + what);
            throw new AssertionError(what);
        }
        checks++;
    }

package ph.motorph.o_oop;

import com.google.gson.Gson;
import com.google.gson.GsonBuilder;
import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.time.YearMonth;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

/**
 * The same state document the file backend writes, stored in Firestore instead.
 *
 * Firestore caps a document at 1 MiB and the attendance store alone is ~940 KB, so the
 * stores are split across documents rather than kept in one blob:
 *
 *   objects/{storeName}        one document per store, for the small ones
 *   chunks/{store}_0000        a slice of an oversized store, joined back on load
 *
 * Every value is stored as a JSON string inside a single field. That keeps Firestore's
 * typed-value encoding out of the picture entirely -- what comes back is byte-identical
 * to what went in, so the pinned @SerializedName keys keep working untouched.
 */
public final class FirestoreStateStore implements StateStore {

    private static final int FORMAT_VERSION = 1;
    // Cutting on characters, not bytes: the payload is ASCII JSON, and a slice that splits a
    // multi-byte character would corrupt the reassembly. 700k chars stays under the 1 MiB cap.
    private static final int CHUNK_CHARS = 700_000;
    private static final String ROOT = "motorphState";

    private final FirestoreRestClient fs_client;
    private final Gson fs_gson = new GsonBuilder()
        .registerTypeAdapter(LocalDate.class, text(LocalDate::parse))
        .registerTypeAdapter(LocalTime.class, text(LocalTime::parse))
        .registerTypeAdapter(LocalDateTime.class, text(LocalDateTime::parse))
        .registerTypeAdapter(YearMonth.class, text(YearMonth::parse))
        .disableHtmlEscaping()
        .create();

    public FirestoreStateStore(FirestoreRestClient fs_client) {
        this.fs_client = fs_client;
    }

    private interface Parser<T> { T apply(String value); }

    private static <T> com.google.gson.TypeAdapter<T> text(Parser<T> parse) {
        return new com.google.gson.TypeAdapter<T>() {
            @Override public void write(com.google.gson.stream.JsonWriter out, T value) throws IOException {
                if (value == null) { out.nullValue(); return; }
                out.value(value.toString());
            }

# Firebase connection checkpoint — MotorPH MS2

## Current project state

The Firebase project and web app already exist; do **not** create duplicates.

- Project ID: `motorph-jd`
- Web app nickname: `motorphdev`
- Auth domain: `motorph-jd.firebaseapp.com`
- Storage bucket: `motorph-jd.firebasestorage.app`
- Messaging sender ID: `63361272264`
- Web app ID: `1:63361272264:web:61ec17db13d69f4b0c98fd`
- Firebase Analytics is not used.
- Email/Password is enabled. The supplied Firebase Web API key is installed in the assistant-managed `.env.local` file. Live Identity Toolkit and browser sign-in were verified with disposable synthetic accounts, which were then deleted.
- The user published the updated `docs/firestore.rules`; the assistant made no Firebase Console changes. Live smoke tests with disposable accounts verified synthetic employee create/update, leave and ticket create/cancel persistence, and cross-user denial. Both test accounts and employee docs were deleted; one cancelled leave (`LV-3502C01F0E60`) and one cancelled ticket (`TK-F05DD2B0D6CC`) remain under their deleted test UIDs because workflow deletion is denied.
- The existing Firestore database is reachable; its exact location was not independently confirmed (the user recalled Taiwan or Singapore). Do not create a duplicate database.

## App integration

The prototype now has:

1. Browser email/password sign-in and dev-account creation using Firebase Authentication.
2. In-memory browser auth persistence; this prototype does not persist the Firebase session in local storage.
3. A Java REST adapter that forwards the signed-in ID token to Firestore. Firestore Security Rules remain the access gate; there is no Admin SDK or service-account credential.
4. A per-user development sandbox: `users/{uid}/demoEmployees`, `demoAttendance`, `demoLeaveRequests`, and `demoTickets`; the published workflow rules were live-smoke-tested for leave create/cancel.
5. An explicit **Add synthetic demo data** action that creates fictional employee/attendance records only. A separate client-only 2026 statutory preview accepts synthetic inputs; it has no payroll API/Firestore persistence and is not seeded or linked to employees.

## 1. Web API key — configured

The valid Web API key you supplied has been set in `.env.local` by the assistant, and `./run.sh` rebuilt the app in Firebase-authenticated mode. You do not need to edit this file. The Web API key is a public client identifier, not an Admin/service-account credential; never put a private key, ID token, password, or service-account JSON in the browser config.

[NODE 23880]
Attendance alone is about 940 KB, and Firestore caps a document at 1 MiB, so each store is
sliced at 700,000 characters and rejoined on load. Small stores are a single _0000 document.
Stale chunks are deleted when a store shrinks, so what you see in the console is exactly what
is live.

function showPasswordStep() {
  state.challengeId = '';
  document.getElementById('code-form').hidden = true;
  document.getElementById('auth-form').hidden = false;
  document.getElementById('auth-intro').hidden = false;
  document.getElementById('auth-title').textContent = 'Sign in to MotorPH Payroll';
  setAuthError('');
  authPassword.focus();
}

async function finishSignIn(payload) {
  state.csrfToken = payload.csrfToken || '';
  state.mustChangePassword = Boolean(payload.mustChangePassword);
  const accounts = await loadAccounts();
  const account = accounts.find(item => item.employeeId === payload.employeeId)
    || { employeeId: payload.employeeId, role: payload.role, roleLabel: payload.role, name: payload.employeeId, team: [] };
  state.accounts = accounts;
  showPasswordStep();
  enterAs(account);
  if (state.mustChangePassword) showPasswordChangePrompt();
}

[NODE 24194]
An earlier pass removed the 2FA step because §7 of the brief describes employee number + password and
nothing else. That was the wrong call and it has been reversed: the two-step flow is back, this time on
the server.

What is different from Claude's version:

- His ran in the browser. `twoFactor` here is a Java challenge store (`sp_secpol/TwoFactor.java`).
  `AuthService.signIn()` returns a challenge id — never a session — and only `verifyCode()` calls
  `sessions.issue()`. A password on its own opens nothing.
- The codes are `SecureRandom` six digits with a five-minute window, three attempts, single use.
  His were generated client-side, which is no second factor at all.
- `POST /api/auth/signin` → `{challengeId, employeeId, role, sentTo, expiresInMinutes, code}`;
  `POST /api/auth/2fa/verify` → session cookie + CSRF.
- `code` is in the response and drawn under the input because there is no SMS gateway on this
  deployment. That is the one deliberate deviation from a production system and the seam an SMS or
  TOTP sender replaces.

`AuthTest` covers the restore at 87 checks: a wrong code grants nothing, three wrong codes kill the
challenge, an expired code is refused, and the step-one id is not a session token.

$ cd /home/user/motorph-v3 && cat >> docs/a_doc/merge-audit.md <<'EOF' ## Firestore became the store, not a mirror (2026-11-08) The brief says to keep an existing persistence service if it can stay useful, and to separate authentication from persistence. The previous arrangement failed both halves: Firebase was configured as an *authentication* provider, so with a project id set the server served employee and attendance data from per-user collections, demanded a Firebase ID token on every read, and refused payroll, clock-in, HR and notifications outright. Nothing was ever written to Firestore by the app; the local file was the only store. That is now one design instead of two: - `StateStore` is an interface. `LocalStateFile` and `FirestoreStateStore` both implement it, and `AppServer.chooseStateStore()` picks one at startup. Nothing else in the server knows which. - Every write goes through `dataFile.save(exportState())`, and `/api/health`, `/api/config` and the reset endpoint report `file`, `firestore` or `memory` from the store itself, so the UI can no longer hardcode "Local file store". - The 48 `firebaseProjectId.isEmpty()` sites are gone. 25 of them were guards that disabled a feature whenever a project id was set; the rest were ternaries that swapped in stub data. `firebaseProjectId` now only selects the backend, and sign-in is employee number + password throughout. - Attendance alone is 942,839 bytes and Firestore caps a document at 1 MiB, so a store is sliced at 700,000 characters (`motorphState/chunks/{store}_0000`) and rejoined on load. Slices are cut on characters, not bytes. `savedAt` is the only field that changes in a round trip. - Writes are upserts. The REST client used to POST only, which real Firestore answers with `ALREADY_EXISTS`; the second save of a live app would have been lost. Stale chunks are deleted when a store shrinks, so the console shows exactly what is live. - An empty backend is seeded from `data/local-demo.json`, not from the built-in roster stub. The stub carries employees but no attendance, so a fresh Firestore would otherwise have been created with 34 people and zero rows and then saved that emptiness back. Verified end to end against a stand-in Firestore that implements the REST subset: upload 34 employees and 7,421 rows, restart, `Loaded saved data from Firestore`, 20 January rows for one employee served from the cloud, a payroll adjustment written and still there after another restart. `FirestoreStateStoreTest` (15 checks) and `FirestoreSeedServiceTest` (12 checks) cover the same paths without a network. To point it at the real `motorph-jd` project, see `docs/firebase-setup-guide.md`: it needs `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID`, `MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_TOKEN` and `MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_UID`. The token is a Google OAuth access token, not a service-account key, and it expires hourly. Without those three the server prints a warning and uses the local file, which is why the preview still starts. EOF echo "recorded"; wc -l docs/a_doc/merge-audit.md

# §4 member notation — the convention as applied

The brief asks for `ab_name`, mixed with Hungarian (`ab_dtName`) when a file has many declarations,
applied **consistently within a file**, and explicitly says not to rename everything at once if that
creates needless churn. So this is a rolling conversion: whole files at a time, smallest and cleanest
first, with the suite re-run after each batch.

## The prefix letters

Three characters, `xx_`, where the first one or two letters name the folder group:

| Prefix | Folder |
|---|---|
| `br_` | `o_oop` — branch |
| `lc_` | `o_oop` — locality |
| `lg_` | `l_log` — audit log |
| `qr_` | `c_calc` — clock / QR |
| `pw_` | `sp_secpol` — password |
| `acc_` | `sp_secpol` — account |
| `cs_` | `b_basic` — CSV |
| `wf_` | `f_flares` — workflow |

`xx_` is not a type tag — it is the *group* tag. The type tag follows it.

## The type tags

| Tag | Type |
|---|---|
| `s` | `String` / JS string |
| `i` | `int` |
| `dbl` | `double` |
| `b` | `boolean` |
| `dt` | `LocalDateTime` |
| `d` | `LocalDate` |
| `t` | `LocalTime` / `Instant` |
| `l` | `List` |
| `m` | `Map` |
| `a` | array |
| `o` | object / record |
| `r` | a service result type (`qr_rRec`) |

Any future conversion has to keep that test green. The test files for converted classes were rewritten in the same pass, since a converted class and an unconverted test cannot compile together. # RBAC conformance: the design document's permissions matrix

The brief requires the five account types and the access matrix to be **enforced, not decorative**. The matrix is
the one on page 11 of `MO-IT108 - 2nd Milestone_ System Design Document of MotorPH Payroll System`.

## The matrix, transcribed

C = Create, R = Read, U = Update, D = Delete, A = Approval, Req = Request.

| Table / entity | System Admin | HR | Payroll | Supervisor | Employee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Employee | C, R, U, D | C, R, U | R | R (Self) | R (Self) |
| Address | C, R, U, D | C, R, U | R (Self) | R (Self) | R (Self) |
| Department | C, R, U, D | C, R, U | – | – | – |
| Position | C, R, U, D | C, R, U | – | – | – |
| Leave | C, R, U, D | C, R, U | R (Self) | R, U (Team) | R (Self) |
| **Attendance** | **C, R, U, D** | **R** | **R** | **R, U (Team)** | **R (Self)** |
| Payroll | C, R, U, D | R | C, R, U | R (Self) | R (Self) |
| Payslip | C, R, U, D | R | C, R, U | R (Team) | R (Self) |
| Earnings / Deductibles | C, R, U, D | R | C, R, U | R, U (Team) | – |
| Government Deductibles | C, R, U, D | R | R | – | – |
| Government Details | C, R, U, D | A | A | – | – |
| Tax Table / Rates | C, R, U, D | – | – | – | – |

## Where the code had drifted, and the correction

Working through this table turned up three places where `AccessPolicy` was more generous than the document. All
three were corrected in the code, not worked around in the test:

1. **Attendance was writable by HR.** The matrix gives HR `R` on Attendance only — the supervisor holds
   `R, U (Team)` and the System Administrator holds `C, R, U, D`. `requireAttendanceEdit` now admits only those
   two. A timesheet correction is a team-lead act; HR reads the attendance but does not rewrite it.
2. **Schedules were editable by HR.** Schedules are not a row in the matrix, so the role descriptions decide it: page
   21 gives the Supervisor "edit single/multi/weekly schedules", while page 22 gives HR onboarding, offboarding,
   ticket handling and employee records. `requireScheduleEdit` follows the supervisor.
3. **Team scope is recursive.** The matrix's "(Team)" is resolved through `OrgChart`, so a supervisor reaches every
   descendant, not just direct reports. Reads use the recursive scope; *writes* to attendance, schedules and
   approvals stay on the direct line, because the matrix's `U` is the supervisor's own team and a manager should not
   silently rewrite a team leader's decisions one level down.

## What the matrix implies for the CMO

The CMO is not a C-level financial viewer in this system. The document's five account types are System Admin, HR,
Payroll, Supervisor and Employee; the CMO is a **department head with a three-person team**, so it is modelled at
supervisor level with `TEAM` scope: it reaches employee, attendance, overtime, ticket, payslip and earnings data for

[NODE 24508]
2. **Add a web app.** On the project overview, click the **`</>` (Web)** icon. Give it a nickname, and leave Firebase Hosting unticked. Firebase then shows a `firebaseConfig` block: keep that page open for step 6.
3. **Turn on sign-in.** Go to **Build → Authentication → Get started → Sign-in method**, and enable **Email/Password**. Leave the passwordless "Email link" option off.
4. **Create the database.** Go to **Build → Firestore Database → Create database**.
   - Choose **production mode**, not test mode.
   - Pick a location close to you, such as `asia-southeast1` (Singapore). You can't change the location later.
5. **Publish the rules.** Go to **Firestore Database → Rules**, delete what's there, and paste in the whole of `docs/firestore.rules`. Then click **Publish**.
   - These rules let each signed-in user read and write only their own sandbox, under `users/{their uid}/…`.
   - Never switch to rules that say `allow read, write: if true`.
6. **Connect the app.** In `motorph-ms2`, copy `.env.example` to `.env.local`. Then fill in the six values from the `firebaseConfig` block in step 2:

   ```text
   VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY=<apiKey>
   VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=<authDomain>
   VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=<projectId>
   VITE_FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=<storageBucket>
   VITE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=<messagingSenderId>
   VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID=<appId>
   ```

   - The web API key is a public identifier, not a password: Firebase protects your data with the sign-in and the rules.
   - Still, never put a service-account key, a password or any real employee data in this project.
7. **Run it:** `./run.sh`, then open <http://localhost:8080>.
   - `localhost` is allowed by Firebase by default.
   - If you open the app from another address and see `auth/unauthorized-domain`, add that host under **Authentication → Settings → Authorized domains**.

## 3. First sign-in (Firebase mode)

1. Enter an email and a password, then click **Create dev account**. Use an email you own, so password resets reach you.
2. Your sandbox starts empty. Click **Add synthetic demo people** to add the fake employees and attendance, or click **Open the empty sandbox** to look around without adding anything.
3. Choose who to act as. Each person opens their role's workspace, and the server checks every permission. Use **Switch account** to pick someone else, and **Sign out** when you're done.

# Setting up MotorPH on your own computer

A quick start for setting up the project from scratch, including your own Firebase project. You can stop after part 1 if you only need the local demo.

## 1. Run the local demo (no Firebase)

**Install first:**
- **JDK 11 or newer**: `java -version` and `javac -version` must both work in a terminal.
- **Node.js 20.19 or newer** (npm comes with it).
- **Windows only:** **Git for Windows**, so you can run the `.sh` scripts from **Git Bash**.

**Then, in the `motorph-ms2` folder:**

```sh
npm install
./run.sh
```

Open <http://localhost:8080>, then pick a demo account, for example Lia (System Admin) or Jae (Employee).

- **Password:** every demo account starts with the shared demo password `MotorPH-demo-2026`. Change it after signing in (Overview → My account). The System Admin can reset it back from System config → Security settings.
- **2FA code:** next, type the 6-digit code. The demo shows it on screen, because there is no phone.
- Each account opens the workspace for its role.
- **Backups** are kept in `data/backups` and old audit entries in `data/archive`. If `data/local-demo.json` is ever damaged, the server starts from the newest backup.

- Local demo data is saved in `data/local-demo.json`. Signed in as Lia, use **System config → Reset demo data** to start over.
- If you have a `.env.local` file with a real Firebase key, `./run.sh` starts in Firebase mode instead. To get back to the local demo, rename or delete that file.
- **Hot reload while coding:** run `./run-api.sh` in one terminal and `npm run dev` in another, then open <http://localhost:5173>.

**Checks:**
- `./test.sh` runs the Java checks.
- `npm run test:web` runs the browser logic tests.
- `npm run test:e2e` runs the full browser test. Before the first run, do `npx playwright-core install chromium` once.

## 2. Create your own Firebase project
=== 83-92 ===
## If something goes wrong

| Message | Fix |
|---|---|
| `auth/operation-not-allowed` | Email/Password isn't enabled (step 3). |
| `auth/invalid-api-key` | Check the `VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY` value in `.env.local`, then run `./run.sh` again. |
| `auth/unauthorized-domain` | Add the host you're using under Authorized domains (step 7). |
| `403` / permission denied after sign-in | The rules weren't published, or not all of them were pasted (step 5). |
| Still shows the local demo chooser | `.env.local` is missing or still has the placeholder `replace-…` values (step 6). |
| `javac: command not found` | Install a JDK (not just a JRE) and reopen the terminal. |

Here are your three answers.

[NODE 24790]
Stay on Firestore. The 1 MiB figure is a cap on a single document, not on the database — there's no documented limit on documents per collection. Chunking already solved it, and the headroom is large:

[NODE 24791]
[Firestore quotas](https://docs.cloud.google.com/firestore/quotas) confirms 1 MiB per document; [RTDB limits](https://firebase.google.com/docs/database/usage/limits) gives 256 MB per read response but no query engine.

[NODE 24792]
[Firestore quotas](https://docs.cloud.google.com/firestore/quotas)

[NODE 24793]
[RTDB limits](https://firebase.google.com/docs/database/usage/limits)

[NODE 24794]
Your attendance is ~115 bytes per row. Today's 7,421 rows = 2 chunks. 1,000 employees with a full year of daily attendance = 18 chunks. Eighteen documents.

[NODE 24795]
Realtime Database would be worse here, not better. It rewards clients downloading whole subtrees — but this app never lets the browser touch the database; the server mediates everything for role scoping. RTDB has no query engine, so a date-range attendance read becomes "download the subtree, filter in Java." And its rules cascade by uid down a JSON tree, which expresses five roles plus team scopes far more clumsily than Firestore's path matching. You'd port two store implementations and rewrite the tests to buy headroom you don't need.

[NODE 24796]
uid

[NODE 24797]
One honest caveat I recorded: save() writes the whole state on every change — ~600 saves/day before it costs anything on the free tier. Fine for an office; if it ever ran at scale the fix is writing only changed stores, not changing database.

[NODE 24798]
save()

[NODE 24946]
public synchronized Optional<JsonObject> load() throws IOException {
        if (!Files.exists(path)) return Optional.empty();
        return Optional.of(readStores(path));
    }

    private JsonObject readStores(Path file) throws IOException {
        JsonElement parsed = JsonParser.parseString(new String(Files.readAllBytes(file), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        if (!parsed.isJsonObject() || !parsed.getAsJsonObject().has("stores")
                || parsed.getAsJsonObject().get("format").getAsInt() != FORMAT_VERSION) {
            throw new IOException("Unknown data file format.");
        }
        return parsed.getAsJsonObject().getAsJsonObject("stores");
    }

function storageModeLabel() {
  return STORAGE_MODE_LABELS[storageMode] || 'Saved on this server';
}

/** Read the backend once per session so labels describe the real store, not an assumption. */
async function loadStorageMode() {
  try {
    const response = await fetch('/api/health', { headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });
    const health = await response.json();
    storageMode = health.persistence || '';
    const label = document.getElementById('employee-storage-mode');
    if (label && state.account) label.textContent = storageModeLabel();
    const build = document.getElementById('build-persistence');
    if (build) build.textContent = storageModeLabel();
  } catch {
    storageMode = '';
  }
}

function setAuthError(message) {
  authError.textContent = message;
  authError.hidden = !message;
}

function showCodeStep(payload) {
  state.challengeId = payload.challengeId;
  document.getElementById('auth-form').hidden = true;
  document.getElementById('code-form').hidden = false;
  document.getElementById('auth-intro').hidden = true;
  document.getElementById('auth-title').textContent = 'Enter your code';
  document.getElementById('code-sent').textContent =
    `Enter the six-digit code sent to the phone number ending in ${String(payload.sentTo || '').replace(/\D/g, '').slice(-2) || '(unknown)'}. It expires in ${payload.expiresInMinutes} minutes.`;
  const preview = document.getElementById('code-preview');
  preview.replaceChildren();
  if (payload.code) {
    preview.append('No SMS gateway is wired to this deployment, so the code is shown here: ');
    const strong = document.createElement('b');
    strong.textContent = payload.code;
    preview.append(strong);
  }
  const input = document.getElementById('code-input');
  input.value = '';
  input.focus();
}

function showPasswordStep() {
  state.challengeId = '';
  document.getElementById('code-form').hidden = true;
  document.getElementById('auth-form').hidden = false;
  document.getElementById('auth-intro').hidden = false;
  document.getElementById('auth-title').textContent = 'Sign in to MotorPH Payroll';
  setAuthError('');
  authPassword.focus();
}

async function finishSignIn(payload) {
  state.csrfToken = payload.csrfToken || '';
  state.mustChangePassword = Boolean(payload.mustChangePassword);
  const accounts = await loadAccounts();
  const account = accounts.find(item => item.employeeId === payload.employeeId)
    || { employeeId: payload.employeeId, role: payload.role, roleLabel: payload.role, name: payload.employeeId, team: [] };
  state.accounts = accounts;
  showPasswordStep();
  enterAs(account);
  if (state.mustChangePassword) showPasswordChangePrompt();
}

async function verifyCode() {
  const code = (document.getElementById('code-input').value || '').trim();
  if (!/^[0-9]{6}$/.test(code)) {
    setAuthError('The code is six digits.');
    return;
  }
  const button = document.getElementById('code-verify-button');
  button.disabled = true;
  try {
    const response = await fetch('/api/auth/2fa/verify', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { Accept: 'application/json', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ challengeId: state.challengeId, code })
    });
    const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload.error || `Sign-in failed (${response.status}).`);
    await finishSignIn(payload);
  } catch (error) {
    setAuthError(error && error.message ? error.message : 'Could not check that code.');
    document.getElementById('code-input').select();
  } finally {
    button.disabled = false;
  }
}

  try {

    private void context(String path, com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpHandler handler) {
        server.createContext(path, exchange -> {
            boolean change = !"GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())
                || String.valueOf(exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery()).contains("reveal=true");
            if (!change) {
                handler.handle(exchange);
                return;
            }
            
            
            try {
                if (!"/api/auth/signin".equals(exchange.getRequestURI().getPath())) requireCsrf(exchange);
            } catch (RequestException refused) {
                try {
                    sendError(exchange, refused.statusCode, refused.getMessage());
                } catch (IOException failedWrite) {
                    
                }
                return;
            }
            
            synchronized (stateLock) {
                handler.handle(exchange);
                int status = exchange.getResponseCode();
                audit(exchange, status);
                saveDataFile();
            }
        });
    }

[NODE 25685]

private boolean bootstrapFromDemoFile() {
        java.nio.file.Path demo = demoFilePath;

#!/usr/bin/env sh
# Compile every main source (all packages under ph/motorph) and, optionally, the tests.
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
case "$(uname -s)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) S=";" ;; *) S=":" ;; esac
mkdir -p target/classes target/test-classes
find src/main/java -name '*.java' > target/main-sources.txt
# Resources travel with the classes: the employee file is read from the classpath at startup.
mkdir -p target/classes
cp -r src/main/resources/. target/classes/
javac -encoding UTF-8 --add-modules jdk.httpserver -cp "lib/gson-2.13.2.jar${S}lib/bcprov-jdk18on-1.78.1.jar" -d target/classes @target/main-sources.txt
if [ "${1:-}" = "--with-tests" ]; then
  find src/test/java -name '*.java' > target/test-sources.txt
  javac -encoding UTF-8 --add-modules jdk.httpserver \
    -cp "lib/gson-2.13.2.jar${S}lib/bcprov-jdk18on-1.78.1.jar${S}target/classes" \
    -d target/test-classes @target/test-sources.txt

async function stopServer() {
  if (!child) return;
  const done = new Promise(resolve => child.once('exit', resolve));
  child.kill('SIGTERM');
  await Promise.race([done, new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 5000))]);
  if (child.exitCode === null) child.kill('SIGKILL');
  child = null;
}

    public int provision(List<String> employeeIds) {
        int created = 0;
        for (String employeeId : employeeIds) {
            if (accounts.containsKey(employeeId)) continue;
            accounts.put(employeeId, new Account(employeeId, hasher.hash(PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial), true));
            created++;
        }
        return created;
    }

    public boolean has(String employeeId) { return employeeId != null && accounts.containsKey(employeeId); }

    public int size() { return accounts.size(); }

public PasswordHasher(String pepper) {
        if (pepper == null || pepper.trim().length() < 32) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(PasswordPolicy.pw_sPepperVar + " must be set to at least 32 characters; "
                + "refusing to start with a weak or missing pepper.");
        }
        this.pepperBytes = pepper.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    
    public String hash(String password) {
        byte[] salt = new byte[SALT_BYTES];
        RANDOM.nextBytes(salt);
        byte[] digest = derive(password, salt, MEMORY_KIB, ITERATIONS, PARALLELISM);
        Base64.Encoder b64 = Base64.getEncoder().withoutPadding();
        return "argon2id$v=" + VERSION
            + "$m=" + MEMORY_KIB + ",t=" + ITERATIONS + ",p=" + PARALLELISM
            + "$" + b64.encodeToString(salt)
            + "$" + b64.encodeToString(digest);
    }

    
    public boolean verify(String password, String stored) {
        if (password == null || stored == null) return false;
        String[] parts = stored.split("\\$");
        if (parts.length != 5 || !"argon2id".equals(parts[0])) return false;
        try {
            int memory = 65536, iterations = 3, parallelism = 1;
            for (String setting : parts[2].split(",")) {
                String[] pair = setting.split("=");
                if (pair.length != 2) continue;
                switch (pair[0]) {
                    case "m": memory = Integer.parseInt(pair[1]); break;
                    case "t": iterations = Integer.parseInt(pair[1]); break;
                    case "p": parallelism = Integer.parseInt(pair[1]); break;
                    default: break;
                }
            }
            Base64.Decoder b64 = Base64.getDecoder();
            byte[] salt = b64.decode(parts[3]);
            byte[] expected = b64.decode(parts[4]);
            byte[] actual = derive(password, salt, memory, iterations, parallelism);
            return MessageDigest.isEqual(expected, actual);
        } catch (RuntimeException malformed) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private void importAudit(JsonObject stores) {
        if (!stores.has("auditLog")) return;
        AuditLog saved = (dataFile != null ? dataFile : new LocalStateFile(Paths.get("unused.json"))).gson().fromJson(stores.get("auditLog"), AuditLog.class);
        if (saved != null) auditLog = saved;
    }

    
    private void audit(HttpExchange exchange, int status) {
        String named = String.valueOf(exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("X-Demo-User") == null ? "" : exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("X-Demo-User")).trim();
        String actor = named.isEmpty() ? "no account" : named + " (not signed in)";
        Object target = exchange.getAttribute("auditTarget");
        auditLog.record(clockService.now().toString(), actor, exchange.getRequestMethod(), exchange.getRequestURI().getPath(),
            target == null ? "" : target.toString(), status, oldest -> {
                if (dataFile == null) return null;
                try {
                    return dataFile.writeArchive("audit", dataFile.gson().toJsonTree(oldest));
                } catch (IOException ex) {
                    System.err.println("Could not archive old audit entries: " + ex);
                    return null;
                }
            });
    }

    
    private void saveDataFile() {
        if (dataFile == null) return;
        if (deferSaves) {
            stateDirty = true;
            synchronized (saveSignal) {
                saveSignal.notifyAll();
            }
            return;
        }
        try {
            dataFile.save(exportState());
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException ex) {
            System.err.println("Could not save data to " + dataFile.describe() + ": " + ex);
        }
    }

    private JsonObject accountRow(Employee employee) {
        JsonObject item = new JsonObject();
        item.addProperty("employeeId", employee.getId());
        item.addProperty("name", employee.getName());
        item.addProperty("position", employee.getRole());
        item.addProperty("status", employee.getStatus());
        item.addProperty("role", AccessPolicy.roleOf(employee.getId()).name());
        item.addProperty("roleLabel", AccessPolicy.roleOf(employee.getId()).label);
        item.addProperty("supervisorId", AccessPolicy.supervisorOf(employee.getId()).orElse(""));
        return item;
    }

/**
     * Persists the current state now, even when saves are deferred. Used by shutdown, so a
     * process that stops inside the debounce window still leaves its data behind.
     */
    void forceSave() {
        if (dataFile == null) return;
        JsonObject snapshot;
        synchronized (stateLock) {
            if (!stateDirty) return;
            stateDirty = false;
            snapshot = exportState();
        }
        try {
            dataFile.save(snapshot);
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException ex) {
            System.err.println("Could not save data to " + dataFile.describe() + ": " + ex);
        }
    }

    
    private void context(String path, com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpHandler handler) {
        server.createContext(path, exchange -> {
            boolean change = !"GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())
                || String.valueOf(exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery()).contains("reveal=true");
            if (!change) {
                handler.handle(exchange);
                return;
            }
            
            
            try {
                if (!"/api/auth/signin".equals(exchange.getRequestURI().getPath())) requireCsrf(exchange);
            } catch (RequestException refused) {
                try {
                    sendError(exchange, refused.statusCode, refused.getMessage());
                } catch (IOException failedWrite) {
                    
                }
                return;
            }
            
            synchronized (stateLock) {
                handler.handle(exchange);
                int status = exchange.getResponseCode();
                audit(exchange, status);
                saveDataFile();
            }
        });
    }

    public void stop() {
        HttpServer stopping;
        synchronized (stateLock) {
            stopping = server;
            server = null;
        }
        if (stopping != null) stopping.stop(0);
        if (executor != null) {
            executor.shutdownNow();
            executor = null;
        }
        try {
            forceSave();
        } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
            System.err.println("Could not flush pending changes on shutdown: " + ex);
        }
    }
