        this.firebaseProjectId = firebaseProjectId == null ? "" : firebaseProjectId.trim();
        if (webRoot == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("webRoot must not be null");

            ? null : Paths.get(System.getenv().getOrDefault("MOTORPH_SEED_FILE", "data/local-demo.json").trim());
        AccessPolicy.importRoles(null, null);

package ph.motorph.o_oop;

import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.URI;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public final class FirestoreRestClient {
    private static final String API_ROOT = "https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/";
    private static final HttpClient HTTP = HttpClient.newBuilder()
        .connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(10)).build();

    private final String apiRoot;
    private final String projectId;
    private final String userId;
    private final String idToken;

    public FirestoreRestClient(String projectId, String userId, String idToken) {
        this(projectId, userId, idToken, API_ROOT);
    }

    
    public FirestoreRestClient(String projectId, String userId, String idToken, String apiRoot) {
        this.projectId = requireSafeSegment(projectId, "project id");
        this.userId = requireSafeSegment(userId, "user id");
        if (idToken == null || idToken.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Firebase sign-in is required");
        if (apiRoot == null || apiRoot.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("API root must not be blank");
        this.idToken = idToken.trim();
        this.apiRoot = apiRoot.trim().endsWith("/") ? apiRoot.trim() : apiRoot.trim() + "/";
    }

    public List<JsonObject> listDocuments(String collectionPath) {
        List<JsonObject> documents = new ArrayList<>();
        String pageToken = "";
        do {
            String url = documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "?pageSize=1000" + pageToken;
            JsonObject response = send("GET", url, null, false);
            JsonArray items = response.has("documents") ? response.getAsJsonArray("documents") : new JsonArray();
            for (JsonElement item : items) documents.add(item.getAsJsonObject());
            pageToken = response.has("nextPageToken")
                ? "&pageToken=" + queryEncode(response.get("nextPageToken").getAsString()) : "";
        } while (!pageToken.isEmpty());
        return documents;
    }

    public boolean createDocument(String collectionPath, String documentId, JsonObject fields) {
        String url = documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "?documentId=" + queryEncode(requireSafeSegment(documentId, "document id"));
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.add("fields", fields);
        return send("POST", url, body, true).has("name");
    }

    /** Reads one document by id, or null when it does not exist. Never lists the collection. */
    public JsonObject getDocument(String collectionPath, String documentId) {
        String url = documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "/" + pathEncode(requireSafeSegment(documentId, "document id"));
        try {
            return send("GET", url, null, false);
        } catch (FirestoreException ex) {
            if (ex.getStatusCode() == 404) return null;
            throw ex;
        }
    }

    /** Writes one document, creating it or overwriting the given fields. */
    public boolean setDocument(String collectionPath, String documentId, JsonObject fields) {
        if (fields == null || fields.size() == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("document fields must not be empty");
        return updateDocument(collectionPath, documentId, fields, new ArrayList<>(fields.keySet()));
    }

    public boolean updateDocument(String collectionPath, String documentId, JsonObject fields, List<String> updateMask) {
        if (fields == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("document fields must not be null");
        if (updateMask == null || updateMask.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("update mask must not be empty");
        StringBuilder url = new StringBuilder(documentsUrl(collectionPath))
            .append('/').append(pathEncode(requireSafeSegment(documentId, "document id")));
        for (String field : updateMask) {
            String safeField = requireSafeSegment(field, "update field");
            url.append(url.indexOf("?") < 0 ? "?" : "&")
                .append("updateMask.fieldPaths=").append(queryEncode(safeField));
        }
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.add("fields", fields);
        return send("PATCH", url.toString(), body, false).has("name");
    }

    /** Deletes one document. Missing documents count as already deleted. */
    public boolean deleteDocument(String collectionPath, String documentId) {
        String url = documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "/" + pathEncode(requireSafeSegment(documentId, "document id"));
        try {
            send("DELETE", url, null, false);
            return true;
        } catch (FirestoreException ex) {
            if (ex.getStatusCode() == 404) return true;
            throw ex;
        }
    }

    public String userCollection(String collectionName) {
        return "users/" + userId + "/" + requireSafeSegment(collectionName, "collection name");
    }

    private JsonObject send(String method, String url, JsonObject body, boolean allowExisting) {
        try {
            HttpRequest.Builder builder = HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create(url))
                .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(20))
                .header("Authorization", "Bearer " + idToken)
                .header("Accept", "application/json");
            if (body != null) {
                builder.header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
                    .method(method, HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(body.toString(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            } else {
                builder.method(method, HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.noBody());
            }
            HttpResponse<String> response = HTTP.send(builder.build(), HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            if (allowExisting && (response.statusCode() == 409 || response.statusCode() == 400)
                && response.body() != null && response.body().contains("ALREADY_EXISTS")) {
                return new JsonObject();
            }
            if (response.statusCode() < 200 || response.statusCode() >= 300) {
                throw firestoreError(response.statusCode(), response.body());
            }
            String responseBody = response.body();
            return responseBody == null || responseBody.trim().isEmpty()
                ? new JsonObject() : JsonParser.parseString(responseBody).getAsJsonObject();
        } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            throw new FirestoreException("Firestore request was interrupted.", 503);
        } catch (IOException | IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            throw new FirestoreException("Could not reach Firestore. Check the network and project setup.", 503);
        }
    }

    private String documentsUrl(String collectionPath) {
        StringBuilder path = new StringBuilder(apiRoot)
            .append(pathEncode(projectId)).append("/databases/(default)/documents");
        for (String segment : collectionPath.split("/")) {
            path.append('/').append(pathEncode(requireSafeSegment(segment, "path segment")));
        }
        return path.toString();
    }

    private static String requireSafeSegment(String value, String label) {
        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty() || value.contains("/")) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(label + " must be a non-empty path segment");
        }
        return value.trim();
    }

    private static String pathEncode(String value) {
        return URLEncoder.encode(value, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).replace("+", "%20");
    }

    private static String queryEncode(String value) {
        return URLEncoder.encode(value, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    private static FirestoreException firestoreError(int status, String body) {
        String message = "Firestore request failed (HTTP " + status + ").";
        if (status == 401) message = "The Firestore access token is missing or expired. Issue a new one (gcloud auth application-default print-access-token) and restart the server.";
        else if (status == 403) message = "Firestore denied this request. Publish the scoped development rules in docs/firestore.rules, then retry.";
        else if (status == 404) message = "Firestore database or requested resource was not found. Check the Firebase project and database setup.";
        else if (status == 409 || status == 400) message = "A demo record could not be created. Refresh the page and try again.";
        return new FirestoreException(message, status);
    }
}

import java.util.Optional;
import ph.motorph.o_oop.Employee;
import ph.motorph.o_oop.OrgChart;

public final class AuthService {
    public static final String COOKIE = "motorph_session";

    private final CredentialStore credentials;
    private final SessionStore sessions;
    private final OrgChart chart;
    private final TwoFactor twoFactor;
    private int codeMinutes = 5;

    public AuthService(CredentialStore credentials, SessionStore sessions, OrgChart chart) {
        this(credentials, sessions, chart, new TwoFactor(java.time.Clock.systemDefaultZone()));
    }

    public AuthService(CredentialStore credentials, SessionStore sessions, OrgChart chart, TwoFactor twoFactor) {
        this.credentials = credentials;
        this.sessions = sessions;
        this.chart = chart;
        this.twoFactor = twoFactor;
    }

    public TwoFactor twoFactor() { return twoFactor; }
    public void setCodeMinutes(int minutes) { if (minutes > 0) this.codeMinutes = minutes; }
    public int codeMinutes() { return codeMinutes; }

    public SessionStore sessions() { return sessions; }
    public CredentialStore credentials() { return credentials; }

    
    public static final class SignIn {
        public final String token, employeeId, role;
        public final boolean mustChangePassword;
        public final String error;

        private SignIn(String token, String employeeId, String role, boolean mustChangePassword, String error) {
            this.token = token; this.employeeId = employeeId; this.role = role;
            this.mustChangePassword = mustChangePassword; this.error = error;
        }
        static SignIn failed(String error) { return new SignIn("", "", "", false, error); }
        public boolean ok() { return error.isEmpty(); }
    }

    
    /** Step one: the password. Returns a challenge, never a session. */
    public SignIn signIn(String employeeId, String password) {
        String id = employeeId == null ? "" : employeeId.trim();
        if (!id.matches("[0-9]{5}")) return SignIn.failed("Employee numbers are five digits, for example 10015.");
        CredentialStore.Result result = credentials.signIn(id, password);
        if (!result.ok) {
            return SignIn.failed("locked".equals(result.reason)
                ? "Too many incorrect attempts. Try again in a few minutes."
                : "The employee number or password is incorrect.");
        }
        Employee employee = chart.employee(id).orElse(null);
        if (employee == null) return SignIn.failed("The employee number or password is incorrect.");
        TwoFactor.Started started = twoFactor.start(id, "", codeMinutes);
        return new SignIn(started.challengeId, id, chart.roleOf(id).label, result.account.mustChangePassword(), "");
    }

    /** Step two: the code. This is where the session is actually issued. */
    public SignIn verifyCode(String challengeId, String code) {
        String employeeId;
        try {
            employeeId = twoFactor.verify(challengeId, code);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException | IllegalStateException refused) {
            return SignIn.failed(refused.getMessage());
        }
        Employee employee = chart.employee(employeeId).orElse(null);
        if (employee == null) return SignIn.failed("The employee number or password is incorrect.");
        String token = sessions.issue(employeeId);
        boolean mustChange = credentials.account(employeeId).map(Account::mustChangePassword).orElse(false);
        return new SignIn(token, employeeId, chart.roleOf(employeeId).label, mustChange, "");
    }

    
    public Optional<Employee> currentEmployee(String token) {
        return sessions.resolve(token).flatMap(record -> chart.employee(record.employeeId));
    }

    public Optional<SessionRecord> currentSession(String token) { return sessions.resolve(token); }

    public void signOut(String token) { sessions.revoke(token); }

    
    public String changePassword(String token, String currentPassword, String newPassword) {
        Optional<SessionRecord> record = sessions.resolve(token);
        if (!record.isPresent()) return null;
        String employeeId = record.get().employeeId;
        if (!credentials.changePassword(employeeId, currentPassword, newPassword)) return null;
        sessions.revokeAllFor(employeeId);
        return sessions.issue(employeeId);
    }

    
    public boolean resetPassword(String employeeId) {
        boolean reset = credentials.resetToInitial(employeeId);
        if (reset) sessions.revokeAllFor(employeeId);
        return reset;
    }

    public int activeSessions() { return sessions.size(); }
}

# Security and Hardening

## Overview

Security-first development practices for web applications. Treat every external input as hostile, every secret as sacred, and every authorization check as mandatory. Security isn't a phase — it's a constraint on every line of code that touches user data, authentication, or external systems.

## When to Use

- Building anything that accepts user input
- Implementing authentication or authorization
- Storing or transmitting sensitive data
- Integrating with external APIs or services
- Adding file uploads, webhooks, or callbacks
- Handling payment or PII data

## Process: Threat Model First

Controls bolted on without a threat model are guesses. Before hardening, spend five minutes thinking like an attacker:

1. **Map the trust boundaries.** Where does untrusted data cross into your system? HTTP requests, form fields, file uploads, webhooks, third-party APIs, message queues, and **LLM output** — plus the local values that look internal because the OS handed them to you: another process's command line or environment, filenames on a shared volume, a path in a job payload. Trust follows who *wrote* a value, not which channel delivered it. Every boundary is attack surface.
2. **Name the assets.** What's worth stealing or breaking? Credentials, PII, payment data, admin actions, money movement.
3. **Run STRIDE over each boundary** — a quick lens, not a ceremony:

| Threat | Ask | Typical mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| **S**poofing | Can someone impersonate a user/service? | Authentication, signature verification |
| **T**ampering | Can data be altered in transit or at rest? | Integrity checks, parameterized queries, HTTPS |
| **R**epudiation | Can an action be denied later? | Audit logging of security events |
| **I**nformation disclosure | Can data leak? | Encryption, field allowlists, generic errors |
| **D**enial of service | Can it be overwhelmed? | Rate limiting, input size caps, timeouts |
| **E**levation of privilege | Can a user gain rights they shouldn't? | Authorization checks, least privilege |

4. **Write abuse cases next to use cases.** For each feature, ask "how would I misuse this?" — then make that your first test.

If you can't name the trust boundaries for a feature, you're not ready to secure it. This is OWASP **A04: Insecure Design** — most breaches begin in design, not code.

## The Three-Tier Boundary System

### Always Do (No Exceptions)

- **Validate all external input** at the system boundary (API routes, form handlers)
- **Parameterize all database queries** — never concatenate user input into SQL
- **Encode output** to prevent XSS (use framework auto-escaping, don't bypass it)
- **Use HTTPS** for all external communication
- **Hash passwords** with bcrypt/scrypt/argon2 (never store plaintext)
- **Set security headers** (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options)
- **Use httpOnly, secure, sameSite cookies** for sessions
- **Run the detected package manager's native audit** against the committed lockfile before every release

### Ask First (Requires Human Approval)

- Adding new authentication flows or changing auth logic
- Storing new categories of sensitive data (PII, payment info)
- Adding new external service integrations
- Changing CORS configuration
- Adding file upload handlers
- Modifying rate limiting or throttling
- Granting elevated permissions or roles

### Never Do

- **Never commit secrets** to version control (API keys, passwords, tokens)
- **Never log sensitive data** (passwords, tokens, full credit card numbers)
- **Never trust client-side validation** as a security boundary
- **Never disable security headers** for convenience
- **Never use `eval()` or `innerHTML`** with user-provided data
- **Never store sessions in client-accessible storage** (localStorage for auth tokens)
- **Never expose stack traces** or internal error details to users

## Hardening Controls

The rules below are the workflow; a concrete implementation of each lives in [references/hardening-patterns.md](references/hardening-patterns.md). Open the section you need when you reach that code, not before.

### Injection, XSS, and access control

- Parameterize every query. Never build SQL, NoSQL, or shell commands from input strings.
- Encode output through the framework's auto-escaping. If raw HTML is unavoidable, sanitize with an allowlist sanitizer first.
- Check **authorization** on every request, not just authentication: the authenticated user must own, or be permitted on, the specific resource (A01, IDOR).

Patterns: [Injection](references/hardening-patterns.md#injection), [XSS](references/hardening-patterns.md#cross-site-scripting-xss), [Access control](references/hardening-patterns.md#broken-access-control).

### Authentication and sessions

- Hash passwords with bcrypt (≥12 rounds), scrypt, or argon2. The session secret comes from the environment, never from code.

/**
 * Exercises FirestoreStateStore against a stand-in Firestore, so the save/load path can be
 * proven without a project, a service account or a network. The fake implements only the two
 * calls the store makes: create a document, and list a collection.

public final class FirestoreStateStoreTest {
    private static int checks;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        FakeFirestore fake = new FakeFirestore();
        fake.start();
        try {
            String apiRoot = "http://127.0.0.1:" + fake.port() + "/v1/projects/";
            FirestoreRestClient client = new FirestoreRestClient("demo-project", "uid-under-test", "fake-token", apiRoot);
            FirestoreStateStore store = new FirestoreStateStore(client);

            check(store.load().isEmpty(), "an empty Firestore loads as nothing, not an error");

            JsonObject stores = new JsonObject();
            JsonObject employees = new JsonObject();
            employees.addProperty("10001", "Manuel III Garcia");
            stores.add("employees", employees);

            JsonObject attendance = new JsonObject();
            StringBuilder big = new StringBuilder();
            for (int i = 0; i < 120_000; i++) big.append("row").append(i).append(';');
            attendance.addProperty("blob", big.toString());
            stores.add("attendance", attendance);

            long rawBytes = big.length();
            check(rawBytes > 700_000, "the sample attendance store is big enough to need chunking (" + rawBytes + " bytes)");

            store.save(stores);
            check(fake.documentCount() >= 3, "save wrote meta, index and at least one chunk (" + fake.documentCount() + " docs)");
            if (fake.chunkCount("attendance") == 0) System.out.println("DEBUG keys: " + fake.documentIds());
            check(fake.chunkCount("attendance") >= 2, "attendance was split across " + fake.chunkCount("attendance") + " chunks");

            Optional<JsonObject> loaded = store.load();
            check(loaded.isPresent(), "a saved state loads back");
            JsonObject back = loaded.get();
            check(back.has("employees"), "employees survive the round trip");
            check("Manuel III Garcia".equals(back.getAsJsonObject("employees").get("10001").getAsString()),
                "a small store comes back byte for byte");
            check(back.has("attendance"), "attendance survives the round trip");
            check(big.toString().equals(back.getAsJsonObject("attendance").get("blob").getAsString()),
                "a chunked store rejoins to exactly what went in (" + rawBytes + " bytes)");

            JsonObject second = new JsonObject();
            second.addProperty("note", "second save");
            store.save(second);
            Optional<JsonObject> reloaded = store.load();
            check(reloaded.isPresent() && reloaded.get().has("note"), "a second save replaces the first");
            check(!reloaded.get().has("attendance"), "the old store is gone after a full save, not merged in");
            check(fake.chunkCount("attendance") == 0,
                "chunks for a store that no longer exists are deleted, not left orphaned in the console");

            // Saving twice must not fail. The REST client used to POST only, which real Firestore
            // answers with ALREADY_EXISTS, so the second save of a live app would have been lost.
            JsonObject third = new JsonObject();
            third.addProperty("note", "third save");
            store.save(third);
            store.save(third);
            check(store.load().isPresent(), "a repeated save overwrites in place instead of failing on ALREADY_EXISTS");

            // Shrinking a chunked store must not leave the tail behind for load() to rejoin.
            JsonObject bigAgain = new JsonObject();
            JsonObject rows = new JsonObject();
            rows.addProperty("blob", big.toString());
            bigAgain.add("attendance", rows);
            store.save(bigAgain);
            JsonObject smallAgain = new JsonObject();
            JsonObject tinyRows = new JsonObject();
            tinyRows.addProperty("blob", "one row");
            smallAgain.add("attendance", tinyRows);
            store.save(smallAgain);
            check(fake.chunkCount("attendance") == 1,
                "shrinking from several chunks to one deletes the surplus (" + fake.chunkCount("attendance") + " left)");
            check("one row".equals(store.load().get().getAsJsonObject("attendance").get("blob").getAsString()),
                "the shrunken store loads back without stale tail data");
        } finally {
            fake.stop();
        }
        System.out.println("FirestoreStateStoreTest: " + checks + " checks passed");
    }

    private static void check(boolean ok, String what) {
        if (!ok) {
            System.out.println("FAIL " + what);
            throw new AssertionError(what);
        }
        checks++;
    }

package ph.motorph.o_oop;

import com.google.gson.Gson;
import com.google.gson.GsonBuilder;
import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import com.google.gson.TypeAdapter;
import com.google.gson.stream.JsonReader;
import com.google.gson.stream.JsonWriter;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.AtomicMoveNotSupportedException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.time.YearMonth;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.function.Function;

public final class LocalStateFile implements StateStore {
    public static final int FORMAT_VERSION = 1;
    
    static final int KEEP_BACKUPS = 20;
    static final long AUTO_BACKUP_MINUTES = 30;
    private static final java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter STAMP = java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyyMMdd-HHmmss-SSS")
        .withZone(java.time.ZoneId.of("Asia/Manila"));
    private final Path path;
    private Instant lastBackup;
    private final Gson gson = new GsonBuilder()
        .registerTypeAdapter(LocalDate.class, text(LocalDate::parse))
        .registerTypeAdapter(LocalTime.class, text(LocalTime::parse))
        .registerTypeAdapter(LocalDateTime.class, text(LocalDateTime::parse))
        .registerTypeAdapter(YearMonth.class, text(YearMonth::parse))
        .disableHtmlEscaping()
        .create();

    public LocalStateFile(Path path) {
        this.path = path.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
    }

    public Path path() { return path; }

    @Override public String location() { return path.toString(); }

    @Override public String describe() { return "Local file " + path; }

    @Override public String backupFolder() { return backupDirectory().toString(); }

    public Gson gson() { return gson; }

    private static <T> TypeAdapter<T> text(Function<String, T> parse) {
        return new TypeAdapter<T>() {
            @Override public void write(JsonWriter out, T value) throws IOException {
                if (value == null) out.nullValue();
                else out.value(value.toString());
            }
            @Override public T read(JsonReader in) throws IOException {
                if (in.peek() == com.google.gson.stream.JsonToken.NULL) {
                    in.nextNull();
                    return null;
                }
                return parse.apply(in.nextString());
            }
        }.nullSafe();
    }

    
    public synchronized void save(JsonObject stores) throws IOException {
        JsonObject document = new JsonObject();
        document.addProperty("format", FORMAT_VERSION);
        document.addProperty("savedAt", Instant.now().toString());
        document.add("stores", stores);
        Path parent = path.getParent();
        if (parent != null) Files.createDirectories(parent);
        Path temp = path.resolveSibling(path.getFileName() + ".tmp");
        Files.write(temp, gson.toJson(document).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        replaceWithRetry(temp);
        if (lastBackup == null) lastBackup = newestBackupTime();
        if (lastBackup == null || lastBackup.isBefore(Instant.now().minusSeconds(AUTO_BACKUP_MINUTES * 60))) backupNow("auto");
    }

    
    private void replaceWithRetry(Path temp) throws IOException {
        for (int attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
            try {
                try {
                    Files.move(temp, path, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE);
                } catch (AtomicMoveNotSupportedException ex) {
                    Files.move(temp, path, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
                }
                return;
            } catch (java.nio.file.FileSystemException busy) { 
                if (attempt >= 5) throw busy;
                try {
                    Thread.sleep(40L * attempt);
                } catch (InterruptedException interrupted) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                    throw busy;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public Path backupDirectory() { return path.resolveSibling("backups"); }

    
    public synchronized String backupNow(String reason) throws IOException {
        if (!Files.exists(path)) throw new IOException("There is no data file to back up yet.");
        Files.createDirectories(backupDirectory());
        String name = "local-demo-" + STAMP.format(Instant.now()) + "-" + reason + ".json";
        Files.copy(path, backupDirectory().resolve(name), StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
        lastBackup = Instant.now();
        java.util.List<String> names = listBackups();

    private void saveDataFile() {
        if (dataFile == null) return;
        if (deferSaves) {
            synchronized (stateLock) {
                stateDirty = true;
                stateLock.notifyAll();
            }
            return;
        }
        try {
            dataFile.save(exportState());
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException ex) {
            System.err.println("Could not save data to " + dataFile.describe() + ": " + ex);
        }
    }

    /** Save a snapshot in order, skipping it if a newer snapshot already committed. */
    private void writeSnapshot(JsonObject snapshot, long revision) throws IOException {
        synchronized (saveIoLock) {
            if (revision <= persistedRevision) return;
            dataFile.save(snapshot);
            persistedRevision = revision;
        }
    }

    /** Flush the current state before creating a backup, or after the writer has stopped. */
    void forceSave() {
        if (dataFile == null) return;
        JsonObject snapshot;
        long revision;
        synchronized (stateLock) {
            snapshot = exportState();
            revision = ++nextSaveRevision;
        }
        try {
            writeSnapshot(snapshot, revision);
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException ex) {
            synchronized (stateLock) { stateDirty = true; }
            throw new IllegalStateException("Could not save data to " + dataFile.describe(), ex);
        }
    }
    
    private void context(String path, com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpHandler handler) {
        server.createContext(path, exchange -> {
            String requestPath = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();
            boolean publicRoute = "/api/health".equals(requestPath)
                || "/api/auth/signin".equals(requestPath)
                || "/api/auth/2fa/verify".equals(requestPath);
            if (!publicRoute && actorFromCookie(exchange) == null) {
                sendError(exchange, 401, "Sign in first.");
                return;
            }

            if (!change) {
                handler.handle(exchange);
                return;
            }

            } catch (RequestException refused) {
                try {
                    sendError(exchange, refused.statusCode, refused.getMessage());
                } catch (IOException failedWrite) {
                    
                }
                return;
            }

                handler.handle(exchange);

    private static String queryParameter(String rawQuery, String target) {
        if (rawQuery == null || rawQuery.isEmpty()) return "";
        for (String part : rawQuery.split("&")) {
            int separator = part.indexOf('=');
            String key = separator < 0 ? part : part.substring(0, separator);
            if (target.equals(decode(key))) return separator < 0 ? "" : decode(part.substring(separator + 1));
        }
        return "";
    }

    private static String decode(String value) {
        try {
            return URLDecoder.decode(value, "UTF-8");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException | java.io.UnsupportedEncodingException ex) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    private static String contentTypeFor(Path path) {
        Path fileName = path.getFileName();
        String name = fileName == null ? "" : fileName.toString().toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
        if (name.endsWith(".html")) return "text/html; charset=utf-8";
        if (name.endsWith(".css")) return "text/css; charset=utf-8";
        if (name.endsWith(".js")) return "application/javascript; charset=utf-8";
        if (name.endsWith(".svg")) return "image/svg+xml";
        if (name.endsWith(".png")) return "image/png";
        if (name.endsWith(".ico")) return "image/x-icon";
        if (name.endsWith(".json") || name.endsWith(".webmanifest")) return "application/manifest+json";
        if (name.endsWith(".txt")) return "text/plain; charset=utf-8";
        if (name.endsWith(".xml")) return "application/xml; charset=utf-8";
        return "application/octet-stream";
    }

    private static String escapeJson(String value) {
        return value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"")
            .replace("\n", "\\n").replace("\r", "\\r").replace("\t", "\\t");
    }

    private static void sendApiError(HttpExchange exchange, FirestoreException exception) throws IOException {
        int status = exception.getStatusCode();
        if (status < 400 || status > 599) status = 500;
        sendJson(exchange, status, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(exception.getMessage()) + "\"}");
    }

/**
 * Moves the whole state document between data/local-demo.json and Firestore.
 *
 *   java tools/FirestoreSync.java upload            copy the local file up
 *   java tools/FirestoreSync.java download          replace the local file from Firestore
 *   java tools/FirestoreSync.java diff              show what each side holds, change nothing
 *
 * Needs MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_TOKEN and MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_UID, plus FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID.
 * The token is a Google OAuth access token with the datastore scope; it expires hourly.
 */
public final class FirestoreSync {

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        String action = args.length == 0 ? "diff" : args[0].toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
        String projectId = env("FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID");
        String token = env("MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_TOKEN");
        String uid = env("MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_UID");
        Path localPath = Paths.get(System.getenv().getOrDefault("LOCAL_DATA_FILE", "data/local-demo.json"));

        if (projectId.isEmpty() || token.isEmpty() || uid.isEmpty()) {
            System.out.println("Firestore is not configured. Set these three, then run again:");
            System.out.println("  FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=your-project-id");
            System.out.println("  MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_TOKEN=<a Google OAuth access token>");
            System.out.println("  MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_UID=<the uid the state is filed under>");
            System.out.println();
            System.out.println("To get a token with the Firebase CLI:");
            System.out.println("  firebase login:ci          # once");
            System.out.println("  firebase --project " + (projectId.isEmpty() ? "YOUR_PROJECT" : projectId)
                + " apps:list   # confirms the project works");
            System.out.println("  gcloud auth application-default print-access-token   # the token itself");
            System.exit(2);
        }

        StateStore local = new LocalStateFile(localPath);
        StateStore remote = new FirestoreStateStore(new FirestoreRestClient(projectId, uid, token));

        switch (action) {
            case "diff":
                report("local", local);
                report("firestore", remote);
                break;
            case "upload": {
                FirestoreSeedService.UploadResult result = new FirestoreSeedService(local, remote).uploadAll();
                System.out.println("Uploaded " + result.getEmployeeCount() + " employees and "
                    + result.getAttendanceCount() + " attendance rows to Firestore.");
                break;
            }
            case "download": {
                FirestoreSeedService.UploadResult result = new FirestoreSeedService(local, remote).downloadAll();
                System.out.println("Replaced the local file with " + result.getEmployeeCount() + " employees and "
                    + result.getAttendanceCount() + " attendance rows from Firestore.");
                break;
            }
            default:
                System.out.println("Usage: java tools/FirestoreSync.java [upload|download|diff]");
                System.exit(1);
        }
    }

    private static void report(String label, StateStore store) throws Exception {
        java.util.Optional<JsonObject> state = store.load();
        if (state.isEmpty()) {
            System.out.printf("%-10s empty%n", label);
            return;
        }
        JsonObject stores = state.get();
        int employees = 0, attendance = 0;
        if (stores.has("employees") && stores.getAsJsonObject("employees").has("employees")) {
            employees = stores.getAsJsonObject("employees").getAsJsonObject("employees").size();
        }
        if (stores.has("attendance") && stores.getAsJsonObject("attendance").has("records")) {
            attendance = stores.getAsJsonObject("attendance").getAsJsonArray("records").size();
        }
        System.out.printf("%-10s %d employees, %d attendance rows, %d stores%n", label, employees, attendance, stores.size());
    }

    private static String env(String name) {
        String value = System.getenv(name);
        return value == null ? "" : value.trim();
    }

    /**
     * Local file by default; Firestore when both a project id and a way to authenticate are
     * present. The Firestore store reads and writes the same state document the file backend
     * does, so nothing downstream knows which one it got.
     */
    private StateStore chooseStateStore(Path dataFile) {
        if (this.firebaseProjectId.isEmpty()) {
            return dataFile == null ? null : new LocalStateFile(dataFile);
        }
        String token = System.getenv().getOrDefault("MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_TOKEN", "").trim();
        String uid = System.getenv().getOrDefault("MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_UID", "server").trim();
        if (uid.isEmpty()) uid = "server";
        String apiRoot = firestoreApiRoot;
        if (apiRoot == null) {
            String emulator = System.getenv().getOrDefault("FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST", "").trim();
            if (!emulator.isEmpty()) apiRoot = "http://" + emulator + "/v1/projects/";
        }
        FirestoreRestClient client;
        try {
            if (!token.isEmpty()) {
                client = apiRoot == null ? new FirestoreRestClient(this.firebaseProjectId, uid, token)
                    : new FirestoreRestClient(this.firebaseProjectId, uid, token, apiRoot);
            } else if (apiRoot != null && apiRoot.startsWith("http://")) {
                client = new FirestoreRestClient(this.firebaseProjectId, uid, "emulator", apiRoot);
            } else {
                client = FirestoreRestClient.applicationDefault(this.firebaseProjectId, uid, apiRoot);
            }
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Firestore credentials unavailable. Configure Application Default Credentials; no local fallback was used.", ex);
        }
        return new FirestoreStateStore(client);
    }

    private static final class FakeFirestoreServer implements AutoCloseable {
        private final HttpServer server;
        private final int status;
        private final String responseBody;
        private final AtomicReference<String> authorization = new AtomicReference<>();
        private final AtomicReference<String> method = new AtomicReference<>();
        private final AtomicReference<String> path = new AtomicReference<>();
        private final AtomicReference<String> requestBody = new AtomicReference<>("");

        FakeFirestoreServer(int status, String responseBody) throws IOException {
            this.status = status;
            this.responseBody = responseBody;
            server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress("127.0.0.1", 0), 0);
            server.createContext("/", this::handle);
            server.start();
        }

        String apiRoot() {
            return "http://127.0.0.1:" + server.getAddress().getPort() + "/v1/projects/";
        }

        private void handle(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
            authorization.set(exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Authorization"));
            method.set(exchange.getRequestMethod());
            path.set(exchange.getRequestURI().toString());
            requestBody.set(new String(exchange.getRequestBody().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            byte[] bytes = responseBody.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", "application/json");
            exchange.sendResponseHeaders(status, bytes.length);
            exchange.getResponseBody().write(bytes);
            exchange.close();
        }

        @Override
        public void close() {
            server.stop(0);
        }
    }

private static final class FakeFirestore {
        private final HttpServer server;
        private final Map<String, JsonObject> documents = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        FakeFirestore() throws IOException {
            server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress("127.0.0.1", 0), 0);
            server.createContext("/v1/projects/", this::handle);
        }

        void start() { server.start(); }
        void stop() { server.stop(0); }
        int port() { return server.getAddress().getPort(); }
        int documentCount() { return documents.size(); }

        java.util.List<String> documentIds() { return new java.util.ArrayList<>(documents.keySet()); }

        int chunkCount(String store) {
            int count = 0;
            for (String id : documents.keySet()) {
                if (id.contains("motorphStateChunks/" + store + "_")) count++;
            }
            return count;
        }

        private void handle(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
            String path = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();
            String query = exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery();
            int marker = path.indexOf("/documents");
            String tail = marker < 0 ? "" : path.substring(marker + "/documents".length());
            tail = tail.startsWith("/") ? tail.substring(1) : tail;
            final String base = tail;

            if (path.endsWith("/documents:commit") && "POST".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
                String body = new String(exchange.getRequestBody().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                JsonObject commit = JsonParser.parseString(body).getAsJsonObject();
                Map<String, JsonObject> next = new LinkedHashMap<>(documents);
                for (com.google.gson.JsonElement element : commit.getAsJsonArray("writes")) {
                    JsonObject write = element.getAsJsonObject();
                    if (write.has("update")) {
                        JsonObject doc = write.getAsJsonObject("update");
                        String name = doc.get("name").getAsString();
                        String key = name.substring(name.indexOf("/documents/") + "/documents/".length());
                        if (key.split("/").length % 2 != 0) { reply(exchange, 400, "{}"); return; }
                        next.put(key, doc.getAsJsonObject("fields"));
                    } else if (write.has("delete")) {
                        String name = write.get("delete").getAsString();
                        next.remove(name.substring(name.indexOf("/documents/") + "/documents/".length()));
                    }
                }
                documents.clear();
                documents.putAll(next);
                reply(exchange, 200, "{\"writeResults\":[]}");
                return;
            }

            // Firestore requires collection/document/collection/document... A path with an odd
            // number of segments is a document name it rejects with HTTP 400. The real API does
            // this too; a fake that tolerates it hides broken layouts.
            if (!base.isEmpty()) {
                String[] segments = base.split("/");
                if (segments.length % 2 == 1) {
                    reply(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":{\"status\":\"INVALID_ARGUMENT\",\"message\":"
                        + "\"Document name lacks / at index 80.\"}}");
                    return;
                }
            }

            if ("POST".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
                String documentId = valueOf(query, "documentId");
                String body = new String(exchange.getRequestBody().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                JsonObject parsed = JsonParser.parseString(body).getAsJsonObject();
                documents.put(tail + "/" + documentId, parsed.getAsJsonObject("fields"));
                reply(exchange, 200, "{\"name\":\"projects/demo/databases/(default)/documents/" + tail + "/" + documentId + "\"}");
                return;
            }

            if ("PATCH".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
                String body = new String(exchange.getRequestBody().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                JsonObject parsed = JsonParser.parseString(body).getAsJsonObject();
                documents.put(tail, parsed.getAsJsonObject("fields"));
                reply(exchange, 200, "{\"name\":\"projects/demo/databases/(default)/documents/" + tail + "\"}");
                return;
            }

            if ("DELETE".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
                documents.remove(tail);
                reply(exchange, 200, "{}");
                return;
            }

            if ("GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
                // Single document read: no trailing collection segment, id exists in the map.
                if (documents.containsKey(tail)) {
                    JsonObject document = new JsonObject();
                    document.addProperty("name", "projects/demo/databases/(default)/documents/" + tail);
                    document.add("fields", documents.get(tail));
                    reply(exchange, 200, document.toString());
                    return;
                }
                List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();
                for (Map.Entry<String, JsonObject> entry : documents.entrySet()) {
                    if (!entry.getKey().startsWith(tail + "/")) continue;
                    if (entry.getKey().substring(tail.length() + 1).contains("/")) continue;
                    JsonObject document = new JsonObject();
                    document.addProperty("name", "projects/demo/databases/(default)/documents/" + entry.getKey());
                    document.add("fields", entry.getValue());
                    names.add(document.toString());
                }
                boolean isCollection = tail.isEmpty() || documents.keySet().stream()
                    .anyMatch(key -> key.startsWith(base + "/"));
                if (!isCollection) {
                    // A document path with nothing stored there: real Firestore answers 404.
                    reply(exchange, 404, "{\"error\":{\"status\":\"NOT_FOUND\"}}");
                    return;
                }
                reply(exchange, 200, "{\"documents\":[" + String.join(",", names) + "]}");
                return;
            }
            reply(exchange, 405, "{}");
        }

        private static String valueOf(String query, String key) {
            if (query == null) return "";
            for (String pair : query.split("&")) {
                int eq = pair.indexOf('=');
                if (eq > 0 && pair.substring(0, eq).equals(key)) {
                    return java.net.URLDecoder.decode(pair.substring(eq + 1), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                }
            }
            return "";
        }

        private static void reply(HttpExchange exchange, int status, String body) throws IOException {
            byte[] bytes = body.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            exchange.getResponseHeaders().set("Content-Type", "application/json");
            exchange.sendResponseHeaders(status, bytes.length);
            try (OutputStream out = exchange.getResponseBody()) { out.write(bytes); }
        }
    }
}

package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.util.Base64;

public final class SessionCookie {
    
    public static final String CSRF_COOKIE = "motorph_csrf";
    public static final String CSRF_HEADER = "X-CSRF-Token";
    private static final int CSRF_BYTES = 32;

    private static final SecureRandom RANDOM = new SecureRandom();

    private SessionCookie() {}

    
    public static String newCsrfToken() {
        byte[] bytes = new byte[CSRF_BYTES];
        RANDOM.nextBytes(bytes);
        return Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(bytes);
    }

    
    public static String sessionCookie(String token, int maxAgeSeconds, boolean secure) {
        return AuthService.COOKIE + "=" + token
            + "; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=" + maxAgeSeconds + (secure ? "; Secure" : "");
    }

    
    public static String csrfCookie(String csrfToken, int maxAgeSeconds, boolean secure) {
        return CSRF_COOKIE + "=" + csrfToken
            + "; Path=/; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=" + maxAgeSeconds + (secure ? "; Secure" : "");
    }

    
    public static String[] clearCookies(boolean secure) {
        return new String[] {
            AuthService.COOKIE + "=; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=0" + (secure ? "; Secure" : ""),
            CSRF_COOKIE + "=; Path=/; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=0" + (secure ? "; Secure" : "")
        };
    }

    
    public static String read(String cookieHeader, String name) {
        if (cookieHeader == null || cookieHeader.isEmpty()) return null;
        for (String pair : cookieHeader.split(";")) {
            int equals = pair.indexOf('=');
            if (equals < 0) continue;
            if (pair.substring(0, equals).trim().equals(name)) return pair.substring(equals + 1).trim();
        }
        return null;
    }

    
    public static boolean csrfMatches(String cookieToken, String headerToken) {
        if (cookieToken == null || headerToken == null) return false;
        return MessageDigest.isEqual(cookieToken.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8), headerToken.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }
}

async function finishSignIn(payload) {
  state.csrfToken = payload.csrfToken || '';
  state.mustChangePassword = Boolean(payload.mustChangePassword);
  const accounts = await loadAccounts();
  const account = accounts.find(item => item.employeeId === payload.employeeId)
    || { employeeId: payload.employeeId, role: payload.role, roleLabel: payload.role, name: payload.employeeId, team: [] };
  state.accounts = accounts;
  showPasswordStep();
  enterAs(account);
  if (state.mustChangePassword) showPasswordChangePrompt();
}

package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.util.Locale;

public final class PasswordPolicy {
    
    public static final String pw_sInitial = "MotorPH-demo-2026";

    
    public static final String pw_sPepperVar = "MOTORPH_PASSWORD_PEPPER";

    public static final int pw_iMinLen = 12;

    private PasswordPolicy() {}

    
    public static java.util.List<String> problems(String pw_sValue) {
        java.util.List<String> pw_lProblems = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        String pw_sClean = pw_sValue == null ? "" : pw_sValue;
        if (pw_sClean.length() < pw_iMinLen) pw_lProblems.add("Use at least " + pw_iMinLen + " characters.");
        if (pw_sClean.equalsIgnoreCase(pw_sInitial)) pw_lProblems.add("Choose a password other than the initial one.");
        boolean pw_bLetter = false, pw_bDigit = false, pw_bSymbol = false;
        for (char pw_c : pw_sClean.toCharArray()) {
            if (Character.isLetter(pw_c)) pw_bLetter = true;
            else if (Character.isDigit(pw_c)) pw_bDigit = true;
            else if (!Character.isWhitespace(pw_c)) pw_bSymbol = true;
        }
        if (!pw_bLetter) pw_lProblems.add("Include at least one letter.");
        if (!pw_bDigit) pw_lProblems.add("Include at least one digit.");
        if (!pw_bSymbol) pw_lProblems.add("Include at least one symbol.");
        if (pw_sClean.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("motorph")) pw_lProblems.add("Do not use the company name in the password.");
        return pw_lProblems;
    }

    public static void requireAcceptable(String pw_sValue) {
        java.util.List<String> pw_lProblems = problems(pw_sValue);
        if (!pw_lProblems.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException(String.join(" ", pw_lProblems));
    }
}
        check(!hasher.verify("", stored), "an empty password fails");
        check(!hasher.verify("anything", "not-a-hash"), "a malformed stored value fails instead of throwing");
        check(!hasher.verify("anything", null), "a null stored value fails instead of throwing");
        
        String other = new PasswordHasher("a-completely-different-pepper-of-sufficient-length").hash("MotorPH-demo-2026");
        check(!other.equals(stored), "a different pepper produces a different hash");
    }

    private static void aPepperIsRequired() {
        boolean refused = false;
        try {
            new PasswordHasher("short");
        } catch (IllegalStateException expected) {
            refused = true;
        }
        check(refused, "a pepper shorter than 32 characters is refused, so the app cannot start with a weak one");
        boolean nullRefused = false;
        try {
            new PasswordHasher(null);
        } catch (IllegalStateException expected) {
            nullRefused = true;
        }
        check(nullRefused, "a missing pepper is refused rather than defaulted silently");
    }

    

    private static void everyEmployeeStartsWithTheInitialPassword() {
        List<Employee> roster = EmployeeImport.fromClasspath().employees();
        CredentialStore credentials = new CredentialStore(new PasswordHasher(PEPPER));
        int created = credentials.provision(Arrays.asList("10001", "10015", "10034"));
        check(created == 3 && credentials.size() == 3, "one account per provisioned employee");
        check(PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial.equals("MotorPH-demo-2026"), "the initial password is the one the brief names");
        check(credentials.account("10015").get().mustChangePassword(), "an initial account must change its password");
        check(roster.size() == 34, "the file holds 34 people, all of whom get an account at start-up");
        check(credentials.signIn("10015", PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial).ok, "the initial password signs in");
        
        credentials.changePassword("10015", PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial, "my-own-password-2026");
        check(credentials.provision(Arrays.asList("10001", "10015", "10034")) == 0,
            "provisioning again creates nothing, so a changed password survives a restart");
        check(credentials.signIn("10015", PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial).reason.equals("password"),
            "and the shared password no longer opens that account");
    }


    private static String signedIn(AuthService auth, String employeeId) {
        return signedIn(auth, employeeId, PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial);
    }

    private static String signedIn(AuthService auth, String employeeId, String password) {
        AuthService.SignIn step1 = auth.signIn(employeeId, password);
        if (!step1.ok()) return "";
        String code = auth.twoFactor().peek(step1.token).orElse("");
        AuthService.SignIn step2 = auth.verifyCode(step1.token, code);
        return step2.ok() ? step2.token : "";
    }
    private static void signInNeedsTheRightPairAndSaysNothingUsefulOtherwise() {
        AuthService auth = service(new MutableClock("2026-11-09T08:00:00Z"));
        AuthService.SignIn ok = auth.signIn("10015", PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial);
        check(ok.ok() && ok.employeeId.equals("10015"), "the right pair signs in");
        AuthService.SignIn unknown = auth.signIn("99999", PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial);
        AuthService.SignIn wrong = auth.signIn("10015", "not-the-password");
        check(!unknown.ok() && !wrong.ok(), "an unknown number and a wrong password both fail");
        check(unknown.error.equals(wrong.error), "they fail with the same message, so the roster cannot be probed");
        check(!unknown.error.toLowerCase().contains("unknown") && !unknown.error.toLowerCase().contains("no such"),
            "the message does not admit which half was wrong");
        AuthService.SignIn badFormat = auth.signIn("abc", "x");
        check(!badFormat.ok(), "a non-numeric employee number is refused before any hashing");
    }

    private static void lockoutAfterFiveAttempts() {
        MutableClock clock = new MutableClock("2026-11-09T08:00:00Z");
        AuthService auth = service(clock);
        for (int i = 0; i < CredentialStore.MAX_ATTEMPTS; i++) auth.signIn("10015", "wrong-" + i);
        AuthService.SignIn locked = auth.signIn("10015", PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial);
        check(!locked.ok(), "five wrong passwords lock the account, even with the right one next");
        check(locked.error.toLowerCase().contains("too many"), "the lockout is explained without naming the password");
        clock.advance(CredentialStore.LOCK_FOR.plusMinutes(1));
        check(auth.signIn("10015", PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial).ok(), "the lock lifts after its window");
    }

/**
 * End-to-end check against the real server build.
 *
 * The previous e2e compiled an app that no longer exists (`src/main/java/ph/motorph/web`) and
 * drove a Firebase-authenticated browser. This one starts the shipped server on a spare port with
 * its own throwaway data file, signs in through the UI with an employee number and a 2FA code, and
 * asserts the things that have actually broken during development:
 *
 *   - the 2FA step is required and a wrong code grants nothing
 *   - every field a real role can reach loads without a 4xx
 *   - the System Administrator can read attendance (the matrix drift)
 *   - an employee cannot read another employee's record
 *   - a write survives a server restart (persistence is real, not per-request)
 *
 * Run: node test/e2e/local-workflows.e2e.js
 * Needs: target/classes built (sh tools/build.sh), playwright-core + a Chromium binary.
 */
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';

function freePort() {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const probe = net.createServer();
    probe.once('error', reject);
    probe.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => {
      const { port } = probe.address();
      probe.close(() => resolve(port));
    });
  });
}

async function startServer(port) {
  child = spawn('java', [
    '-Xmx256m', '-XX:TieredStopAtLevel=1',
    '--add-modules', 'jdk.httpserver',
    '-cp', [gsonJar, bouncyJar, path.join(projectRoot, 'lib/google/*'), classes].join(path.delimiter),
    'ph.motorph.svc.AppServer'
  ], {
    cwd: projectRoot,
    env: {
      ...process.env,
      PORT: String(port),
      HOST: '127.0.0.1',
      WEB_ROOT: path.join(projectRoot, 'web'),
      MOTORPH_PEPPER: 'e2e-pepper-at-least-32-characters-long',
      LOCAL_DATA_FILE: path.join(scratch, 'state.json'),
      MOTORPH_SEED_FILE: path.join(scratch, 'state.json'),
      FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID: '',
      MOTORPH_DEFER_SAVES: 'false'
    },
    stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe']
  });
  let serverLog = '';
  const capture = chunk => { serverLog = (serverLog + chunk.toString()).slice(-8000); };
  child.stdout.on('data', capture);
  child.stderr.on('data', capture);
  // A fresh data file is seeded and saved in full before the port opens, and provisioning the
  // 34 demo accounts costs one Argon2id hash each (about 9-10 s on two cores). Allow a generous
  // window so a loaded machine does not turn a slow start into a test failure.
  for (let i = 0; i < 450; i++) {
    if (child.exitCode !== null || child.signalCode !== null) {
      throw new Error(`server exited before startup (code ${child.exitCode}, signal ${child.signalCode}):\n${serverLog}`);
    }
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/api/health`);
      if (response.ok) return;
      if (i % 25 === 0) console.log(`  waiting for the server (${response.status})...`);
    } catch {
      if (i % 25 === 0) console.log('  waiting for the server...');
    }
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
  }
  throw new Error(`server did not start within 90 seconds:\n${serverLog}`);
}

    await signIn(page, '10006', { expectWrongCodeFirst: true });

  }

  // ---- 2. every reachable view loads without a 4xx ---------------------------
  console.log('2/5 view sweep');

async function downloadWithSession(url, filename) {
  const response = await fetch(url, { headers: await apiHeaders({ Accept: '*/*' }) });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error((await response.json().catch(() => ({}))).error || `Download failed (${response.status})`);
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = URL.createObjectURL(await response.blob());
  link.download = filename;
  link.click();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href), 1000);
}

const CENTS_PER_PESO = 100n;

export function parsePesoCents(value, fieldName = 'amount') {
  const text = String(value ?? '').trim().replace(/,/g, '');
  if (!/^\d+(?:\.\d{1,2})?$/.test(text)) {
    throw new TypeError(`${fieldName} must be a non-negative peso amount with up to two decimal places.`);
  }
  const [wholeText, fractionText = ''] = text.split('.');
  return BigInt(wholeText) * CENTS_PER_PESO + BigInt(fractionText.padEnd(2, '0'));
}

export function formatPesoCents(cents) {
  const value = BigInt(cents);
  const sign = value < 0n ? '-' : '';
  const absolute = value < 0n ? -value : value;
  const pesos = (absolute / CENTS_PER_PESO).toString().replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
  const centavos = (absolute % CENTS_PER_PESO).toString().padStart(2, '0');
  return `${sign}₱${pesos}.${centavos}`;
}

export function statutoryFromApi(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return Object.freeze(value.map(statutoryFromApi));
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return value;
  const converted = {};
  for (const [key, field] of Object.entries(value)) {
    if (key.endsWith('Cents')) {
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(field)) throw new TypeError(`Unexpected payroll amount for ${key}.`);
      converted[key] = BigInt(field);
    } else {
      converted[key] = statutoryFromApi(field);
    }
  }
  return Object.freeze(converted);
}

  if [ -f .env.local ]; then

      *) MOTORPH_PEPPER="$pepper"; export MOTORPH_PEPPER ;;
    esac
  fi
fi

    private void handleSeedRecords(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!"POST".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
            return;
        }
        try {
            JsonObject body = readJsonBody(exchange);
            requireOnlyKeys(body, "direction", "confirm");
            String direction = optionalString(body, "direction");
            if (direction.isEmpty()) direction = "upload";
            if (!"upload".equals(direction) && !"download".equals(direction)) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("direction must be upload or download.");
            }
            String confirm = optionalString(body, "confirm");
            boolean downloading = "download".equals(direction);
            if (downloading && !"REPLACE".equals(confirm)) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Downloading overwrites this server's state. Send {\"direction\":\"download\",\"confirm\":\"REPLACE\"}.");
            }
            if (!downloading && !"UPLOAD".equals(confirm)) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Uploading overwrites the remote store. Send {\"direction\":\"upload\",\"confirm\":\"UPLOAD\"}.");
            }
            StateStore remote = chooseStateStore(null);
            if (!"firestore".equals(remote.backend())) {
                throw new RequestException(409, "This server is not storing data in Firestore, so there is nothing to move.");
            }
            StateStore local = new LocalStateFile(Paths.get(System.getenv().getOrDefault("LOCAL_DATA_FILE", "data/local-demo.json")));
            FirestoreSeedService service = new FirestoreSeedService(local, remote);
            FirestoreSeedService.UploadResult result = downloading ? service.downloadAll() : service.uploadAll();
            if (downloading) loadDataFile();
            sendJson(exchange, 200, "{\"direction\":\"" + direction + "\",\"employees\":" + result.getEmployeeCount()
                + ",\"attendance\":" + result.getAttendanceCount() + "}");
        } catch (FirestoreException ex) {
            sendApiError(exchange, ex);
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            sendApiError(exchange, new FirestoreException("Could not move the state: " + ex.getMessage(), 502));
        }
    }

    /**
     * Employee and attendance reads always come from the in-process stores. Whichever backend
     * is configured -- file or Firestore -- has already been loaded into them by loadDataFile(),
     * and saves are written back through dataFile on every change. Reading Firestore per request
     * would also demand a Firebase ID token, which employee-number sign-in does not produce.
     */
    private RequestServices servicesFor(HttpExchange exchange) {
        return new RequestServices(localEmployeeService, localAttendanceStore);
    }



    private static LocalDate parseOptionalDate(String value) {
        return value == null || value.trim().isEmpty() ? null : LocalDate.parse(value.trim());
    }

    private static String attendanceToJson(List<AttendanceRecord> records) {
        StringBuilder json = new StringBuilder("{\"items\":[");
        for (int i = 0; i < records.size(); i++) {
            AttendanceRecord record = records.get(i);
            if (i > 0) json.append(',');
            json.append(attendanceRecordToJson(record));
        }
        return json.append("],\"count\":").append(records.size())
            .append(",\"hoursCalculated\":false}").toString();
    }

    private static String attendanceRecordToJson(AttendanceRecord record) {
        return "{\"attendanceId\":" + record.getAttendanceId()
            + ",\"scheduleId\":" + record.getScheduleId()
            + ",\"date\":\"" + record.getDate()
            + "\",\"timeIn\":\"" + record.getTimeIn()
            + "\",\"timeOut\":\"" + record.getTimeOut()
            + "\",\"dayType\":\"" + escapeJson(record.getDayType()) + "\"}";
    }

                .append("\",\"employeeName\":\"").append(escapeJson(summary.getEmployeeName()))
                .append("\",\"scheduleId\":").append(summary.getScheduleId() == null ? "null" : summary.getScheduleId())
                .append(",\"hasScheduleMapping\":").append(summary.hasScheduleMapping())
                .append(",\"rawRecordCount\":").append(summary.getRawRecordCount())
                .append(",\"firstRecordDate\":\"").append(escapeJson(summary.getFirstRecordDate()))
                .append("\",\"lastRecordDate\":\"").append(escapeJson(summary.getLastRecordDate())).append("\"}");
        }
        json.append("],\"count\":").append(summaries.size())
#!/usr/bin/env sh
# Compiles web/main.css into web/app.css, the stylesheet the browser actually loads.
#
# main.css is a Tailwind v4 *source* file: it is written in @apply and needs a compile step before a browser can read
# it. Serving it raw leaves the page completely unstyled, which is exactly what happened before this script existed.
#
# The font @imports are stripped because the page is served from disk and those packages live in npm, not the web root.
# Inter and Montserrat fall back to the system stack the theme already lists.
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
TW=tools/twcss

if [ ! -d "$TW/node_modules/tailwindcss" ]; then
  echo "Installing the Tailwind compiler (one time) ..."
  ( cd "$TW" && npm install tailwindcss@4 @tailwindcss/cli@4 --no-save --silent )
fi

# The theme's own @import lines are dropped; everything after them is the real design.
{
  printf '@import "tailwindcss" source(none);\n@source "../../web/b_basic/*.html";\n@source "../../web/*.html";\n@source "../../web/b_basic/*.js";\n@source "../../web/f_flares/*.js";\n\n'
  sed -e '/^@import "tailwindcss";/d' \
      -e '/^@import "@fontsource-variable\/inter";/d' \
      -e '/^@import "@fontsource-variable\/montserrat";/d' web/main.css
} > "$TW/input.css"

( cd "$TW" && npx tailwindcss --input input.css --output ../../web/app.css --minify ) >/dev/null 2>&1
printf 'web/app.css rebuilt (%s bytes)\n' "$(wc -c < web/app.css)"

package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;

public final class SessionStore {
    public static final int IDLE_MINUTES = 15;
    public static final int ABSOLUTE_HOURS = 8;

    private static final SecureRandom RANDOM = new SecureRandom();

    private final Map<String, SessionRecord> byTokenHash = java.util.Collections.synchronizedMap(new LinkedHashMap<>());
    private final Clock clock;
    private final int idleMinutes, absoluteHours;

    public SessionStore() { this(Clock.systemDefaultZone(), IDLE_MINUTES, ABSOLUTE_HOURS); }
    public SessionStore(Clock clock) { this(clock, IDLE_MINUTES, ABSOLUTE_HOURS); }
    public SessionStore(Clock clock, int idleMinutes, int absoluteHours) {
        this.clock = clock;
        this.idleMinutes = idleMinutes;
        this.absoluteHours = absoluteHours;
    }

    public int idleMinutes() { return idleMinutes; }
    public int absoluteHours() { return absoluteHours; }

    
    public String issue(String employeeId) {
        byte[] raw = new byte[32];
        RANDOM.nextBytes(raw);
        String token = Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(raw);
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        byTokenHash.put(hash(token), new SessionRecord(hash(token), employeeId, now,
            now.plus(Duration.ofHours(absoluteHours)), idleMinutes));
        prune(now);
        return token;
    }

    
    public Optional<SessionRecord> resolve(String token) {
        if (token == null || token.isEmpty()) return Optional.empty();
        SessionRecord record = byTokenHash.get(hash(token));
        if (record == null) return Optional.empty();
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        String expired = record.expiredReason(now);
        if (expired != null) {
            byTokenHash.remove(record.tokenHash);
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        record.touch(now);
        return Optional.of(record);
    }

    
    public void revoke(String token) {
        if (token == null) return;
        byTokenHash.remove(hash(token));
    }

    
    public int revokeAllFor(String employeeId) {
        int removed = 0;
        List<String> keys = new ArrayList<>(byTokenHash.keySet());
        for (String key : keys) {
            SessionRecord record = byTokenHash.get(key);
            if (record != null && record.employeeId.equals(employeeId)) {
                byTokenHash.remove(key);
                removed++;
            }
        }
        return removed;
    }

package ph.motorph.o_oop;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.NoSuchElementException;
import java.util.Optional;

public final class InMemoryEmployeeStore implements MutableEmployeeStore {
    private final Map<String, Employee> employees = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    public InMemoryEmployeeStore() {
        
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized List<Employee> findAll() {
        return new ArrayList<>(employees.values());
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized Optional<Employee> findById(String id) {
        return Optional.ofNullable(id == null ? null : employees.get(id.trim()));
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized Employee create(Employee employee) {
        if (employees.containsKey(employee.getId())) throw new IllegalStateException("Employee ID already exists.");
        employees.put(employee.getId(), employee);
        return employee;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized Employee update(Employee employee) {
        if (!employees.containsKey(employee.getId())) throw new NoSuchElementException("Employee not found.");
        employees.put(employee.getId(), employee);
        return employee;
    }

    
    public synchronized void remove(String id) {
        if (employees.remove(id) == null) throw new NoSuchElementException("Employee not found.");
    }

    
    public void seed(Employee employee) {
        addFixture(employee);
    }

    void addFixture(Employee employee) {
        employees.put(employee.getId(), employee);
    }
}

import { formatPesoCents, parsePesoCents, statutoryFromApi } from './PayrollPreview2026.js';

const hours = minutes => (minutes / 60).toFixed(2);

function hoursText(paidMinutes, overageMinutes = 0, overtimeMinutes = 0) {
  let text = hours(paidMinutes);
  if (overtimeMinutes > 0) text += ` + ${hours(overtimeMinutes)} OT`;
  if (overageMinutes > 0) text += ` (+${hours(overageMinutes)} unapproved, unpaid)`;
  return text;
}

const EARNING_LINES = [
  ['basicCents', 'Basic pay (hours worked)'],
  ['premiumCents', 'Rest-day / holiday premium'],
  ['overtimeCents', 'Overtime (approved)'],
  ['nightDiffCents', 'Night differential (22:00–06:00)'],
  ['holidayPayCents', 'Regular holiday pay (not worked)'],
  ['leavePayCents', 'Paid leave']
];

export function buildCutoffPayroll(payload) {
  if (!payload || !Array.isArray(payload.cutoffs) || payload.cutoffs.length !== 2) {
    throw new TypeError('Unexpected payroll response.');
  }
  const cutoffs = payload.cutoffs.map(cutoff => {
    const money = statutoryFromApi({ deductionsCents: cutoff.deductionsCents,
      ...(cutoff.netCents === null ? {} : { netCents: cutoff.netCents }) });
    return {
      label: cutoff.label === '1-15' ? '1–15' : '16–end',
      from: cutoff.from,
      to: cutoff.to,
      daysWithRecords: cutoff.daysWithRecords,
      hours: hoursText(cutoff.paidMinutes, cutoff.unpaidOverageMinutes, cutoff.overtimeMinutes),
      grossCents: parsePesoCents(cutoff.grossPay, 'Cutoff gross'),
      deductionsCents: money.deductionsCents,
      netCents: cutoff.blocked ? null : money.netCents,
      blockedReason: cutoff.blocked
        ? `Deductions ${formatPesoCents(money.deductionsCents)} exceed this cutoff's gross; net not shown rather than negative.`
        : ''
    };
  });
  return {
    month: payload.month,
    hourlyRate: payload.hourlyRate,
    monthlyBasic: payload.monthlyBasic,
    monthlyGrossCents: parsePesoCents(payload.monthlyGross, 'Monthly gross'),
    statutory: payload.statutory ? statutoryFromApi(payload.statutory) : null,
    cutoffs
  };
}
