package ph.motorph.c_calc;

import java.time.YearMonth;

public final class StatutoryCalculator2026 {
    public static final String RULESET_ID = "PH-2026-sweldongpinoy-v4";
    private static final long BP = 10_000;
    private static final long MAX_INPUT_CENTS = 1_000_000_000L; 

    
    
    private static final long SSS_STEP = 50_000;
    private static final long SSS_EC_THRESHOLD = 1_500_000, SSS_EC_LOW = 1_000, SSS_EC_HIGH = 3_000;

    private StatutoryCalculator2026() { }

    
    public static long parsePesoCents(String value, String field) {
        String text = value == null ? "" : value.trim().replace(",", "");
        if (!text.matches("\\d{1,12}(\\.\\d{1,2})?")) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must be a non-negative peso amount with up to two decimal places.");
        }
        String[] parts = text.split("\\.");
        String fraction = parts.length > 1 ? (parts[1] + "0").substring(0, 2) : "00";
        long cents = Long.parseLong(parts[0]) * 100 + Long.parseLong(fraction);
        if (cents > MAX_INPUT_CENTS) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must be ₱10,000,000.00 or less.");
        return cents;
    }

    public static StatutoryBreakdown calculate(YearMonth period, long grossCashPayCents, long sssCompensationCents,
            long philHealthBasicSalaryCents, long pagIbigFundSalaryCents, long taxableCompensationCents) {
        return calculate(period, grossCashPayCents, sssCompensationCents, philHealthBasicSalaryCents, pagIbigFundSalaryCents,
            taxableCompensationCents, StatutoryRates.DEFAULT);
    }

    
    public static StatutoryBreakdown calculate(YearMonth period, long grossCashPayCents, long sssCompensationCents,
            long philHealthBasicSalaryCents, long pagIbigFundSalaryCents, long taxableCompensationCents, StatutoryRates rates) {
        if (period == null || period.getYear() != 2026) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("This temporary ruleset covers 2026 monthly periods only.");
        }
        for (long cents : new long[] {grossCashPayCents, sssCompensationCents, philHealthBasicSalaryCents,
                pagIbigFundSalaryCents, taxableCompensationCents}) {
            if (cents < 0 || cents > MAX_INPUT_CENTS) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Amounts must be ₱0 to ₱10,000,000.00.");
        }
        if (grossCashPayCents <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Gross cash pay must be greater than zero for this preview.");
        if (sssCompensationCents <= 0 || philHealthBasicSalaryCents <= 0 || pagIbigFundSalaryCents <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Enter a positive contribution base for SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG.");
        }

        long msc = sssMonthlySalaryCredit(sssCompensationCents, rates);
        long sssEmployee = applyBp(msc, rates.sssEmployeeBp);
        long sssEmployer = applyBp(msc, rates.sssEmployerBp);
        long sssEc = msc < SSS_EC_THRESHOLD ? SSS_EC_LOW : SSS_EC_HIGH;

        long phBase = Math.min(Math.max(philHealthBasicSalaryCents, rates.philHealthFloor), rates.philHealthCeiling);
        long phTotal = applyBp(phBase, rates.philHealthPremiumBp);
        
        long phEmployee = applyBp(phBase, rates.philHealthPremiumBp / 2);

        long pagIbigBase = Math.min(pagIbigFundSalaryCents, rates.pagIbigCap);
        long pagIbigEmployee = applyBp(pagIbigBase, pagIbigFundSalaryCents <= rates.pagIbigLowBand ? rates.pagIbigLowBp : rates.pagIbigHighBp);
        long pagIbigEmployer = applyBp(pagIbigBase, rates.pagIbigEmployerBp);

        long employeeStatutory = sssEmployee + phEmployee + pagIbigEmployee;
        long taxable = Math.max(0, taxableCompensationCents - employeeStatutory);
        long tax = annualisedWithholding(taxable, rates);
        if (employeeStatutory + tax > grossCashPayCents) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Employee deductions exceed gross cash pay; preview blocked rather than showing negative net pay.");
        }
        return new StatutoryBreakdown(rates.id, period, grossCashPayCents, sssCompensationCents,
            philHealthBasicSalaryCents, pagIbigFundSalaryCents, taxableCompensationCents,
            msc, sssEmployee, sssEmployer, sssEc, phBase, phTotal, phEmployee,
            pagIbigBase, pagIbigEmployee, pagIbigEmployer, taxable, tax);
    }

    private static long sssMonthlySalaryCredit(long compensationCents, StatutoryRates rates) {
        long firstHigherRange = rates.sssMinMsc + SSS_STEP / 2; 
        if (compensationCents < firstHigherRange) return rates.sssMinMsc;
        long msc = rates.sssMinMsc + ((compensationCents - firstHigherRange) / SSS_STEP + 1) * SSS_STEP;
        return Math.min(msc, rates.sssMaxMsc);
    }

    
    private static long annualisedWithholding(long monthlyTaxableCents, StatutoryRates rates) {
        long annualTaxable = monthlyTaxableCents * 12;
        long[] bracket = rates.birAnnual.get(0);
        for (long[] candidate : rates.birAnnual) if (annualTaxable > candidate[0]) bracket = candidate;
        
        long annualTaxScaled = bracket[1] * BP + (annualTaxable - bracket[0]) * bracket[2];
        return roundRatio(annualTaxScaled, BP * 12);
    }

    private static long applyBp(long cents, long basisPoints) { return roundRatio(cents * basisPoints, BP); }

    private static long roundRatio(long numerator, long denominator) { return (numerator + denominator / 2) / denominator; }
}

## 2. Put the data in Firestore (optional)

This does **not** change how you sign in. The server keeps owning authentication; Firestore
becomes its data store, so the console shows the same records the app is using.

1. **Create the project and database**, if you haven't already: **Build → Firestore Database →
   Create database**, in a region near you (for example `asia-southeast1`). You cannot change
   the region later.
2. **Get an access token.** The server authenticates as itself, not as an end user, so it needs an
   OAuth token with the `datastore` scope — not a browser API key, and not a service-account file
   committed to the repo:

   ```sh
   gcloud auth application-default login
   export MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_TOKEN="$(gcloud auth application-default print-access-token)"
   ```

   The token expires after about an hour. Firestore operations then fail with 401; queued saves
   may still have received successful HTTP responses. Check server logs, print a new token, and
   restart the server. See the persistence and crash-safety warning in `docs/firebase-setup-guide.md`.
3. **Start the server pointing at the project:**

   ```sh
   export FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=your-project-id
   export MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_UID=server          # any stable string; just a path segment
   ./run.sh
   ```

   The banner confirms it: `State store: Firestore (motorphState collection)`.
4. **The first run seeds itself.** An empty Firestore is filled from `data/local-demo.json`, so
   you get all 34 employees and 7,421 attendance rows without a separate import step. The log
   says `Seeded the empty store from data/local-demo.json`.
5. **Look at it.** In the console, open Firestore and find the `motorphState` collection:
   `_meta` and `_index`, plus a separate `motorphStateChunks` collection holding the payload.
   Open `attendance_0000` in that second collection and its `json` field starts with
   `{"records":[`. Attendance is about 940 KB and Firestore caps a document at
   1 MiB, which is why it is split across chunks and rejoined on load.

**Moving data by hand** (both directions refuse to run without a confirmation token):

```sh
java -cp "target/classes:lib/gson-2.13.2.jar" tools/FirestoreSync.java diff
java -cp "target/classes:lib/gson-2.13.2.jar" tools/FirestoreSync.java upload
java -cp "target/classes:lib/gson-2.13.2.jar" tools/FirestoreSync.java download
```
# Connecting MotorPH to Firebase (`motorph-jd`)

This guide replaces the older Firebase-Auth-and-per-user-sandbox setup. Nothing here is
required to run the app: with no configuration it stores data in `data/local-demo.json`.
Set the three variables below and it stores everything in Firestore instead.

## What changed, in one paragraph

Sign-in is employee number + password, handled by the Java server, with 2FA on top. Firebase
no longer authenticates anyone and the browser never talks to Firestore. The server owns the
whole dataset — 34 employees and 7,421 attendance rows plus every other store — and writes it
to Firestore on each change. Firestore is now the database, not a per-user scratch space.

## How the data is laid out

Everything lives under one collection, `motorphState`:

| Document | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `motorphState/_meta` | `format` and `savedAt` for the whole state |
| `motorphState/_index` | how many chunk documents each store occupies |
| `motorphStateChunks/{store}_0000` | a slice of one store, as a JSON string |

Chunks live in their **own top-level collection**, not at `motorphState/chunks/{id}`. Firestore
document paths must alternate collection and document, so that path has three segments after
`documents/` and the API rejects it with *"Document name lacks / at index N"*. This was found
against the live project, not the stand-in, and `FirestoreStateStoreTest`'s fake now enforces the
same even-segment rule so the layout cannot regress.

Attendance alone is about 940 KB, and Firestore caps a document at 1 MiB, so each store is
sliced at 700,000 characters and rejoined on load. Small stores are a single `_0000` document.
Stale chunks are deleted when a store shrinks, so what you see in the console is exactly what
is live.

Every value is a JSON string, so what comes back is byte-identical to what went in. The
`@SerializedName` pins on the Java classes therefore keep working without a migration.

## 1. Point the server at the project

You need a Google OAuth access token with the `datastore` scope, plus the project id:

```sh
export FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=motorph-jd
export MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_TOKEN="$(gcloud auth application-default print-access-token)"
export MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_UID=<the uid to file the state under>
./run.sh
```

`MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_UID` is only a path segment; any stable string works, and the data is *not*
namespaced per user the way the old sandbox was.

The token expires after about an hour. When it does, Firestore operations fail with a 401;
background save failures are logged, but application requests can still appear successful. Print a
new token and restart the server. There is no service-account key checked into this repository, by design.

The startup banner tells you which backend is live:

```
State store: Firestore (motorphState collection)
Mode: employee-number sign-in; data held in firestore
```

If the token or uid is missing, the server prints a warning and falls back to the local file so
it still starts.

## 2. First run seeds itself

A brand-new, empty Firestore would otherwise come up with the built-in roster stub and no
attendance at all — and the first save would write that emptiness back. So when the store is
empty and `data/local-demo.json` exists, the server imports that file in full and saves it up:

```
Seeded the empty store from data/local-demo.json.
```

After that, changes are queued for a background Firestore save, and a restart shows
`Loaded saved data from Firestore (motorphState collection)`. The server logs save errors and
retries while it is running; it waits for an in-progress save and attempts a final flush on an
orderly shutdown. A successful HTTP response **does not guarantee the change has been saved**:
a crash, forced termination, expired token, or prolonged connection failure can lose pending
changes. The multi-document save is not an atomic transaction and interruption can leave an
inconsistent snapshot. This is a demo, not a durable production persistence design. Check server
logs and use backups. Local-file saves remain synchronous by default. Set
`MOTORPH_DEFER_SAVES=false` to opt out of background saves (requests may be slow), or `true` to
opt in for a local file. Do not run multiple server instances against the same store: their full
state writes can overwrite one another.

## 3. Moving data between the file and Firestore

Two ways, both deliberate and both refusing to run without a confirmation token.

```sh
# copy the local file up, replacing what is in Firestore
java -cp "target/classes:lib/gson-2.13.2.jar" tools/FirestoreSync.java upload

# replace the local file with what is in Firestore
java -cp "target/classes:lib/gson-2.13.2.jar" tools/FirestoreSync.java download

# show what each side holds, change nothing
java -cp "target/classes:lib/gson-2.13.2.jar" tools/FirestoreSync.java diff
```

The same move is available over HTTP, authenticated as an admin:

```
POST /api/firestore/seed   {"direction":"upload","confirm":"UPLOAD"}
POST /api/firestore/seed   {"direction":"download","confirm":"REPLACE"}
```

`upload` reports what it wrote, for example `{"direction":"upload","employees":34,"attendance":7421}`.

## 4. Checking it worked

Open the Firebase console, choose Firestore, and look at the `motorphState` collection. You
should see `_meta`, `_index` and a `chunks` subcollection. Open
`chunks/attendance_0000` and the `json` field starts with `{"records":[`.

In the app, the Saved data panel under Configuration reads its label from the server and shows
**SAVED TO FIRESTORE** once the backend is live.

## 5. Running against a stand-in instead

`FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8099` points the server at the Firestore emulator — or any
service that speaks the same subset of the REST API — without a Google project. This is how the
round trip is tested end to end without credentials.

## Security rules

The server authenticates with a bearer token, not an end-user identity, so the rules must allow
that principal to read and write `motorphState`. Do **not** open the collection to the public:
the payload contains every employee's salary and attendance record.

## What is deliberately gone

- Browser Firebase SDK: removed. The `firebase` npm dependency and the
  `firebase-auth-lifecycle` e2e test were deleted along with it.
- Per-user `users/{uid}/demo*` collections: no longer written. Anything left there by the old
  prototype is inert and can be deleted from the console.
- Firebase Authentication as a login requirement: removed. `firebaseProjectId` no longer gates
  payroll, clock-in, HR or any other feature; it only selects the Firestore backend.

The Google authentication library finds Application Default Credentials (ADC) and refreshes the server's short-lived access token as needed. You normally do not need to issue or paste tokens manually. A local user login may occasionally need to be renewed by its owner. MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_TOKEN is an optional fixed-token override for diagnostics; it takes precedence over ADC and does not refresh, so leave it unset for normal operation.

# Nothing here is required to run the app: with no configuration it stores data in
# data/local-demo.json and serves the built-in roster. Copy the parts you need.

# The browser never talks to Firebase. Sign-in is employee number + password, handled by the

# ---- Firestore as the data store ------------------------------------------
# Set all three to keep the dataset in Firestore instead of the local file.
# See docs/firebase-setup-guide.md for the full walkthrough.

# Point the server at a Firestore emulator (or any service speaking the same REST subset).

import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import ph.motorph.o_oop.FirestoreRestClient;
import ph.motorph.o_oop.FirestoreStateStore;
import ph.motorph.o_oop.LocalStateFile;
import ph.motorph.o_oop.StateStore;
import ph.motorph.t_tkt.FirestoreSeedService;

/**
 * Moves the whole state document between data/local-demo.json and Firestore.
 *
 *   java tools/FirestoreSync.java upload            copy the local file up
 *   java tools/FirestoreSync.java download          replace the local file from Firestore
 *   java tools/FirestoreSync.java diff              show what each side holds, change nothing
 *
 * Needs MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_TOKEN and MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_UID, plus FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID.
 * The token is a Google OAuth access token with the datastore scope; it expires hourly.
 */
public final class FirestoreSync {

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        String action = args.length == 0 ? "diff" : args[0].toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
        String projectId = env("FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID");
        String token = env("MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_TOKEN");
        String uid = env("MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_UID");
        Path localPath = Paths.get(System.getenv().getOrDefault("LOCAL_DATA_FILE", "data/local-demo.json"));

        if (projectId.isEmpty()) {
            System.err.println("Set FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID and configure Application Default Credentials first.");
            System.exit(2);
        }
        if (uid.isEmpty()) uid = "server";
        StateStore local = new LocalStateFile(localPath);
        FirestoreRestClient client = token.isEmpty()
            ? FirestoreRestClient.applicationDefault(projectId, uid, null)
            : new FirestoreRestClient(projectId, uid, token);
        StateStore remote = new FirestoreStateStore(client);

        switch (action) {
            case "diff":
                report("local", local);
                report("firestore", remote);
                break;
            case "upload": {
                FirestoreSeedService.UploadResult result = new FirestoreSeedService(local, remote).uploadAll();
                System.out.println("Uploaded " + result.getEmployeeCount() + " employees and "
                    + result.getAttendanceCount() + " attendance rows to Firestore.");
                break;
            }
            case "download": {
                FirestoreSeedService.UploadResult result = new FirestoreSeedService(local, remote).downloadAll();
                System.out.println("Replaced the local file with " + result.getEmployeeCount() + " employees and "
                    + result.getAttendanceCount() + " attendance rows from Firestore.");
                break;
            }
            default:
                System.out.println("Usage: java tools/FirestoreSync.java [upload|download|diff]");
                System.exit(1);
        }

    private void provisionSignIn() {
        String pepper = System.getenv("MOTORPH_PEPPER");
        boolean fromEnvironment = pepper != null && pepper.trim().length() >= 32;
        if (!fromEnvironment) {
            if (dataFile instanceof FirestoreStateStore)
                throw new IllegalStateException("MOTORPH_PEPPER must contain at least 32 characters when using Firestore.");
            pepper = "motorph-development-pepper-not-for-production-use";
            System.out.println("WARNING: MOTORPH_PEPPER is not set, so the development pepper is in use."
                + " Set a 32+ character secret before running this against real data.");
        }
        this.credentialStore = new CredentialStore(new ph.motorph.sp_secpol.PasswordHasher(pepper));
        importCredentials(savedCredentials);
        java.util.List<String> ids = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        for (Employee employee : localEmployeeStore.findAll()) ids.add(employee.getId());
        int created = credentialStore.provision(ids);
        java.util.List<Employee> roster = localEmployeeStore.findAll();
        this.authService = new AuthService(credentialStore, sessionStore,
            roster.isEmpty() ? new ph.motorph.o_oop.OrgChart(java.util.Collections.emptyList())
                             : new ph.motorph.o_oop.OrgChart(roster));
        if (created > 0) System.out.println("Sign-in ready for " + created + " accounts (employee number + password).");
    }

    
    private void importCredentials(com.google.gson.JsonElement saved) {
        if (saved == null || saved.isJsonNull() || credentialStore == null) return;
        java.lang.reflect.Type type = new com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken<java.util.Map<String, ph.motorph.sp_secpol.Account>>() { }.getType();
        credentialStore.importAccounts((dataFile != null ? dataFile : new LocalStateFile(Paths.get("unused.json"))).gson().fromJson(saved, type));
    }

package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;

public final class SessionStore {
    public static final int IDLE_MINUTES = 15;
    public static final int ABSOLUTE_HOURS = 8;

    private static final SecureRandom RANDOM = new SecureRandom();

    private final Map<String, SessionRecord> byTokenHash = java.util.Collections.synchronizedMap(new LinkedHashMap<>());
    private final Clock clock;
    private final int idleMinutes, absoluteHours;

    public SessionStore() { this(Clock.systemDefaultZone(), IDLE_MINUTES, ABSOLUTE_HOURS); }
    public SessionStore(Clock clock) { this(clock, IDLE_MINUTES, ABSOLUTE_HOURS); }
    public SessionStore(Clock clock, int idleMinutes, int absoluteHours) {
        this.clock = clock;
        this.idleMinutes = idleMinutes;
        this.absoluteHours = absoluteHours;
    }

    public int idleMinutes() { return idleMinutes; }
    public int absoluteHours() { return absoluteHours; }

    
    public String issue(String employeeId) {
        byte[] raw = new byte[32];
        RANDOM.nextBytes(raw);
        String token = Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(raw);
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        byTokenHash.put(hash(token), new SessionRecord(hash(token), employeeId, now,
            now.plus(Duration.ofHours(absoluteHours)), idleMinutes));
        prune(now);
        return token;
    }

    
    public Optional<SessionRecord> resolve(String token) {
        if (token == null || token.isEmpty()) return Optional.empty();
        SessionRecord record = byTokenHash.get(hash(token));
        if (record == null) return Optional.empty();
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        String expired = record.expiredReason(now);
        if (expired != null) {
            byTokenHash.remove(record.tokenHash);
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        record.touch(now);
        return Optional.of(record);
    }

    
    public void revoke(String token) {
        if (token == null) return;
        byTokenHash.remove(hash(token));
    }

    
    public int revokeAllFor(String employeeId) {
        int removed = 0;
        List<String> keys = new ArrayList<>(byTokenHash.keySet());
        for (String key : keys) {
            SessionRecord record = byTokenHash.get(key);
            if (record != null && record.employeeId.equals(employeeId)) {
                byTokenHash.remove(key);
                removed++;
            }
        }
        return removed;
    }

    
    public long idleSecondsLeft(String token) {
        SessionRecord record = byTokenHash.get(hash(token));
        if (record == null) return 0;
        long seconds = Duration.between(clock.instant(), record.lastActive().plusSeconds(idleMinutes * 60L)).getSeconds();
        return Math.max(0, seconds);
    }

    
    public int sweep() {
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        int before = byTokenHash.size();
        prune(now);
        return before - byTokenHash.size();
    }

    public int size() { return byTokenHash.size(); }

    private void prune(Instant now) {
        byTokenHash.values().removeIf(record -> record.expiredReason(now) != null);
    }

    
    static String hash(String token) {
        try {
            byte[] digest = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(token.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            StringBuilder hex = new StringBuilder(digest.length * 2);
            for (byte b : digest) hex.append(String.format("%02x", b));
            return hex.toString();
        } catch (java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException ex) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("SHA-256 is required", ex);
        }
    }
}

    public AuthService(CredentialStore credentials, SessionStore sessions, OrgChart chart) {
        this(credentials, sessions, chart, new TwoFactor(java.time.Clock.systemDefaultZone()));
    }

    public AuthService(CredentialStore credentials, SessionStore sessions, OrgChart chart, TwoFactor twoFactor) {
        this.credentials = credentials;
        this.sessions = sessions;
        this.chart = chart;
        this.twoFactor = twoFactor;
    }

    public TwoFactor twoFactor() { return twoFactor; }
    public void setCodeMinutes(int minutes) { if (minutes > 0) this.codeMinutes = minutes; }
    public int codeMinutes() { return codeMinutes; }

    public SessionStore sessions() { return sessions; }
    public CredentialStore credentials() { return credentials; }

    
    public static final class SignIn {
        public final String token, employeeId, role;
        public final boolean mustChangePassword;
        public final String error;

        private SignIn(String token, String employeeId, String role, boolean mustChangePassword, String error) {
            this.token = token; this.employeeId = employeeId; this.role = role;
            this.mustChangePassword = mustChangePassword; this.error = error;
        }
        static SignIn failed(String error) { return new SignIn("", "", "", false, error); }
        public boolean ok() { return error.isEmpty(); }
    }

    
    /** Step one: the password. Returns a challenge, never a session. */
    public SignIn signIn(String employeeId, String password) {
        String id = employeeId == null ? "" : employeeId.trim();
        if (!id.matches("[0-9]{5}")) return SignIn.failed("Employee numbers are five digits, for example 10015.");
        CredentialStore.Result result = credentials.signIn(id, password);
        if (!result.ok) {
            return SignIn.failed("locked".equals(result.reason)
                ? "Too many incorrect attempts. Try again in a few minutes."
                : "The employee number or password is incorrect.");
        }
        Employee employee = chart.employee(id).orElse(null);
        if (employee == null) return SignIn.failed("The employee number or password is incorrect.");
        TwoFactor.Started started = twoFactor.start(id, "", codeMinutes);
        return new SignIn(started.challengeId, id, chart.roleOf(id).label, result.account.mustChangePassword(), "");
    }

    /** Step two: the code. This is where the session is actually issued. */
    public SignIn verifyCode(String challengeId, String code) {
        String employeeId;
        try {
            employeeId = twoFactor.verify(challengeId, code);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException | IllegalStateException refused) {
            return SignIn.failed(refused.getMessage());
        }
        Employee employee = chart.employee(employeeId).orElse(null);
        if (employee == null) return SignIn.failed("The employee number or password is incorrect.");
        String token = sessions.issue(employeeId);
        boolean mustChange = credentials.account(employeeId).map(Account::mustChangePassword).orElse(false);
        return new SignIn(token, employeeId, chart.roleOf(employeeId).label, mustChange, "");
    }

    
    public Optional<Employee> currentEmployee(String token) {
        return sessions.resolve(token).flatMap(record -> chart.employee(record.employeeId));
    }

    public Optional<SessionRecord> currentSession(String token) { return sessions.resolve(token); }

    public void signOut(String token) { sessions.revoke(token); }

    
    public String changePassword(String token, String currentPassword, String newPassword) {
        Optional<SessionRecord> record = sessions.resolve(token);
        if (!record.isPresent()) return null;
        String employeeId = record.get().employeeId;
        if (!credentials.changePassword(employeeId, currentPassword, newPassword)) return null;
        sessions.revokeAllFor(employeeId);
        return sessions.issue(employeeId);
    }

    
    public boolean resetPassword(String employeeId) {
        boolean reset = credentials.resetToInitial(employeeId);
        if (reset) sessions.revokeAllFor(employeeId);
        return reset;
    }

    public int activeSessions() { return sessions.size(); }

/**
 * End-to-end check against the real server build.
 *
 * The previous e2e compiled an app that no longer exists (`src/main/java/ph/motorph/web`) and
 * drove a Firebase-authenticated browser. This one starts the shipped server on a spare port with
 * its own throwaway data file, signs in through the UI with an employee number and a 2FA code, and
 * asserts the things that have actually broken during development:
 *
 *   - the 2FA step is required and a wrong code grants nothing
 *   - every field a real role can reach loads without a 4xx
 *   - the System Administrator can read attendance (the matrix drift)
 *   - an employee cannot read another employee's record
 *   - a write survives a server restart (persistence is real, not per-request)
 *
 * Run: node test/e2e/local-workflows.e2e.js
 * Needs: target/classes built (sh tools/build.sh), playwright-core + a Chromium binary.
 */

function freePort() {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const probe = net.createServer();
    probe.once('error', reject);
    probe.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => {
      const { port } = probe.address();
      probe.close(() => resolve(port));
    });
  });
}

async function startServer(port) {
  child = spawn('java', [
    '-Xmx256m', '-XX:TieredStopAtLevel=1',
    '--add-modules', 'jdk.httpserver',
    '-cp', [gsonJar, bouncyJar, path.join(projectRoot, 'lib/google/*'), classes].join(path.delimiter),
    'ph.motorph.svc.AppServer'
  ], {
    cwd: projectRoot,
    env: {
      ...process.env,
      PORT: String(port),
      HOST: '127.0.0.1',
      WEB_ROOT: process.env.MOTORPH_E2E_WEB_ROOT || path.join(projectRoot, 'web'),
      MOTORPH_PEPPER: 'e2e-pepper-at-least-32-characters-long',
      LOCAL_DATA_FILE: path.join(scratch, 'state.json'),
      MOTORPH_SEED_FILE: path.join(scratch, 'state.json'),
      FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID: process.env.MOTORPH_E2E_FIRESTORE_PROJECT || '',
      MOTORPH_DEFER_SAVES: 'false'
    },
    stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe']
  });
  let serverLog = '';
  const capture = chunk => { serverLog = (serverLog + chunk.toString()).slice(-8000); };
  child.stdout.on('data', capture);
  child.stderr.on('data', capture);
  // A fresh data file is seeded and saved in full before the port opens, and provisioning the
  // 34 demo accounts costs one Argon2id hash each (about 9-10 s on two cores). Allow a generous
  // window so a loaded machine does not turn a slow start into a test failure.
  for (let i = 0; i < 450; i++) {
    if (child.exitCode !== null || child.signalCode !== null) {
      throw new Error(`server exited before startup (code ${child.exitCode}, signal ${child.signalCode}):\n${serverLog}`);
    }
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/api/health`);
      if (response.ok) return;
      if (i % 25 === 0) console.log(`  waiting for the server (${response.status})...`);
    } catch {
      if (i % 25 === 0) console.log('  waiting for the server...');
    }
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
  }
  throw new Error(`server did not start within 90 seconds:\n${serverLog}`);
}

async function stopServer() {
  if (!child) return;
  const done = new Promise(resolve => child.once('exit', resolve));
  child.kill('SIGTERM');
  await Promise.race([done, new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 5000))]);
  if (child.exitCode === null) child.kill('SIGKILL');
  child = null;
}

/** Sign in through the UI and return the page, already on the workspace. */
async function signIn(page, employeeId, { expectWrongCodeFirst = false } = {}) {
  await page.goto(`http://127.0.0.1:${page.__port}/signin`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
  await page.waitForTimeout(800);
  await page.fill('#auth-employee', employeeId);
  const currentPassword = changedPasswords.get(employeeId) || password;
  await page.fill('#auth-password', currentPassword);
  await page.click('#sign-in-button');
  await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.getElementById('code-form').hidden, null, { timeout: timeoutMs });

  if (expectWrongCodeFirst) {
    await page.fill('#code-input', '000000');
    await page.click('#code-verify-button');
    await page.waitForFunction(
      () => !document.getElementById('auth-error').hidden,
      null,
      { timeout: timeoutMs }
    ).catch(() => {});
    const error = (await page.textContent('#auth-error')) || '';
    assert.match(error, /wrong code|tries/i, `a wrong 2FA code is refused (got: ${error})`);
    assert.equal(await page.isVisible('.nav-item'), false, 'a wrong code still shows no workspace');
  }

  const preview = await page.textContent('#code-preview');
  const code = (preview.match(/\d{6}/) || [])[0];
  assert.ok(code, 'the demo deployment shows the code under the input');
  await page.fill('#code-input', code);
  await page.click('#code-verify-button');
  await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.getElementById('first-password-form').hidden
    || !document.getElementById('app-shell').hidden, null, { timeout: timeoutMs });
  if (await page.isVisible('#first-password-form')) {
    const blocked = await page.evaluate(async () => (await fetch('/api/employees')).status);
    assert.equal(blocked, 403, 'first-login users cannot access data before changing their password');
    const nextPassword = `CaseSensitive!2026-${employeeId}`;
    await page.fill('#first-password-current', currentPassword);
    await page.fill('#first-password-next', nextPassword);
    await page.click('#first-password-form button[type=submit]');
    changedPasswords.set(employeeId, nextPassword);
  }
  await page.waitForSelector('.nav-item:visible', { timeout: timeoutMs })
    .catch(() => {});
  await page.waitForTimeout(1800);
  assert.ok(await page.isVisible('.nav-item'), `employee ${employeeId} reaches the workspace`);
}

    public static synchronized void changeSupervisor(Actor actor, String targetId, String supervisorId) {
        if (actor.role != Role.ADMIN && actor.role != Role.HR) throw new AccessDenied("Only HR or the System Administrator changes reporting lines.");
        if (actor.employeeId.equals(targetId)) throw new AccessDenied("Nobody becomes their own supervisor.");
        if (supervisorId != null && !supervisorId.isEmpty() && !isKnownAccount(supervisorId)) {
            throw new AccessDenied("That supervisor is not on the roster.");
        }
        OrgChart bound = chart;
        if (bound != null) bound.reassign(targetId, supervisorId);
    }

    public static synchronized Map<String, Role> exportRoles() {
        Map<String, Role> out = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
        OrgChart bound = chart;
        if (bound != null) for (var employee : bound.employees()) out.put(employee.getEid(), roleOf(employee.getEid()));
        return out;
    }

    public static synchronized Map<String, String> exportSupervisors() {
        Map<String, String> out = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
        OrgChart bound = chart;
        if (bound != null) for (var employee : bound.employees()) supervisorOf(employee.getEid()).ifPresent(s -> out.put(employee.getEid(), s));
        return out;
    }

    public static synchronized void importRoles(Map<String, Role> roles, Map<String, String> supervisors) {
        ROLE_OVERRIDES.clear();
        if (roles != null) ROLE_OVERRIDES.putAll(roles);
        OrgChart bound = chart;
        if (bound != null && supervisors != null) {
            for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : supervisors.entrySet()) bound.reassign(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
        }
    }

    public static void requireAdmin(Actor actor) {
        if (actor.role != Role.ADMIN) throw new AccessDenied("Only the System Administrator can open system configuration.");
    }

    public static void assignSupervisor(String employeeId, String supervisorId) {
        OrgChart bound = chart;
        if (bound != null) bound.reassign(employeeId, supervisorId);
    }

# Setting up MotorPH on your own computer

Part 1 gets you running in a minute with no cloud account. Part 2 is optional: it keeps the same
dataset in Firestore instead of a local file, so you can inspect it in the Firebase console.

## 1. Run it (no Firebase needed)

**Install first:**
- **JDK 11 or newer**: `java -version` and `javac -version` must both work in a terminal.
- **Node.js 20.19 or newer** (npm comes with it).
- **Windows only:** **Git for Windows**, so you can run the `.sh` scripts from **Git Bash**.

**Then, in the `motorph-ms2` folder:**

```sh
npm install
./run.sh
```

Open <http://localhost:8080>. Sign in with an employee number, not an email:

| Employee no. | Who | Password |
|---|---|---|
| `10005` | System Administrator | `MotorPH-demo-2026` |
| `10006` | HR Staff | `MotorPH-demo-2026` |
| `10011` | Payroll Staff | `MotorPH-demo-2026` |
| `10015` | Supervisor | `MotorPH-demo-2026` |
| `10018` | Employee | `MotorPH-demo-2026` |

- **2FA:** after the password, type the six-digit code. The demo prints it under the input,
  because there is no SMS gateway wired up. It expires in five minutes and dies after three
  wrong tries.
- **Change the password** after signing in (Overview → My account). The System Admin can reset
  one from System config → Security settings.
- **Where the data lives:** `data/local-demo.json` — 34 employees and 7,421 attendance rows.
  Backups go to `data/backups`, old audit entries to `data/archive`. If the file is ever
  damaged the server starts from the newest backup.
- **Start over:** signed in as `10005`, use **System config → Reset demo data**.
- **Hot reload while coding:** `./run-api.sh` in one terminal, `npm run dev` in another, then
  open <http://localhost:5173>.

**Checks:**

    public void importAccounts(Map<String, Account> saved) {
        if (saved == null) return;
        for (Map.Entry<String, Account> entry : saved.entrySet()) {
            Account account = entry.getValue();
            if (entry.getKey() == null || account == null || !entry.getKey().equals(account.acc_sEid)
                || account.passwordHash() == null || !account.passwordHash().startsWith("argon2id$")) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid stored account");
            }
        }
        accounts.clear();
        accounts.putAll(saved);
    }

## If something goes wrong

| Message | Fix |
|---|---|
| `Wrong code; N tries left` | The 2FA code expired or was mistyped. It lasts five minutes; start the sign-in again for a fresh one. |
| `Unknown demo account` | Employee numbers are five digits. `10015`, not `15` or `EMP-10015`. |
| `Firestore is not configured` | One of `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID`, `MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_TOKEN`, `MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_UID` is missing; the server falls back to the local file and says so at startup. |
| `Firebase sign-in expired` (401) | The OAuth token aged out. Print a new one and restart the server. |
| `Firestore denied this request` (403) | The rules don't allow the server's principal to read/write `motorphState`. See `docs/firebase-setup-guide.md`. |
| Shows "Local file store" but you set the env vars | Check the startup banner — it names the store it actually opened. |
| `javac: command not found` | Install a JDK (not just a JRE) and reopen the terminal. |
| The browser e2e times out on a machine with little RAM | Chromium plus a default-heap JVM can deadlock. The suite already starts its server with `-Xmx256m`; close other JVMs first. |

    private JsonObject accountRow(Employee employee) {
        JsonObject item = new JsonObject();
        item.addProperty("employeeId", employee.getId());
        item.addProperty("name", employee.getName());
        item.addProperty("position", employee.getRole());
        item.addProperty("status", employee.getStatus());
        item.addProperty("role", AccessPolicy.roleOf(employee.getId()).name());
        item.addProperty("roleLabel", AccessPolicy.roleOf(employee.getId()).label);
        item.addProperty("supervisorId", AccessPolicy.supervisorOf(employee.getId()).orElse(""));
        return item;
    }

## 11. My Pay: MotorPH calculation and Sweldong Pinoy comparison

Add a switch in the **My Pay** tab, available to all employees, between:

- the application's MotorPH payroll calculation; and
- a Sweldong Pinoy-based calculation/reference.

Before implementing the second option, inspect the current Sweldong Pinoy calculator and establish what inputs, assumptions, rates, and outputs it uses. Use a public, legitimate source; do not depend on an undocumented private endpoint or brittle page scraping. Where practical, implement the comparison as a separate calculation module using documented rules rather than embedding an external website in the application.

Both views must use the same employee and pay-period inputs. Clearly identify which calculation is being displayed, explain any differing assumptions, and show discrepancies without silently changing the actual payroll record. The switch is for employee comparison and understanding; it must not alter a processed payslip or the official payroll calculation. Add tests for representative employees and calculation edge cases.

Rounding is to the nearest centavo, half-up. This does not determine eligibility, payroll-period allocation, annualisation, or tax treatment of unprovided benefits.</p>


const CENTS_PER_PESO = 100n;

export function parsePesoCents(value, fieldName = 'amount') {
  const text = String(value ?? '').trim().replace(/,/g, '');
  if (!/^\d+(?:\.\d{1,2})?$/.test(text)) {
    throw new TypeError(`${fieldName} must be a non-negative peso amount with up to two decimal places.`);
  }
  const [wholeText, fractionText = ''] = text.split('.');
  return BigInt(wholeText) * CENTS_PER_PESO + BigInt(fractionText.padEnd(2, '0'));
}

export function formatPesoCents(cents) {
  const value = BigInt(cents);
  const sign = value < 0n ? '-' : '';
  const absolute = value < 0n ? -value : value;
  const pesos = (absolute / CENTS_PER_PESO).toString().replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
  const centavos = (absolute % CENTS_PER_PESO).toString().padStart(2, '0');
  return `${sign}₱${pesos}.${centavos}`;
}

export function statutoryFromApi(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return Object.freeze(value.map(statutoryFromApi));
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return value;
  const converted = {};
  for (const [key, field] of Object.entries(value)) {
    if (key.endsWith('Cents')) {
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(field)) throw new TypeError(`Unexpected payroll amount for ${key}.`);
      converted[key] = BigInt(field);
    } else {
      converted[key] = statutoryFromApi(field);
    }
  }
  return Object.freeze(converted);
}

    private void handlePayrollStatutory(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!"POST".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
            return;
        }
        try {
            AccessPolicy.Actor actor = actorFor(exchange);
            guard(() -> AccessPolicy.requireArea(actor, AccessPolicy.Area.STATUTORY));
            JsonObject body = readJsonBody(exchange);
            requireOnlyKeys(body, "period", "grossCashPay", "sssCompensation", "philHealthBasicSalary",
                "pagIbigFundSalary", "taxableCompensation");
            String periodText = requiredString(body, "period");
            if (!periodText.matches("20[0-9]{2}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Month must use YYYY-MM.");
            StatutoryBreakdown result = StatutoryCalculator2026.calculate(java.time.YearMonth.parse(periodText),
                StatutoryCalculator2026.parsePesoCents(requiredString(body, "grossCashPay"), "Gross cash pay"),
                StatutoryCalculator2026.parsePesoCents(requiredString(body, "sssCompensation"), "SSS compensation base"),
                StatutoryCalculator2026.parsePesoCents(requiredString(body, "philHealthBasicSalary"), "PhilHealth monthly basic salary"),
                StatutoryCalculator2026.parsePesoCents(requiredString(body, "pagIbigFundSalary"), "Pag-IBIG Fund Salary"),
                StatutoryCalculator2026.parsePesoCents(requiredString(body, "taxableCompensation"), "Taxable compensation before employee contributions"),
                statutoryRates.ratesFor(java.time.YearMonth.parse(periodText)));
            JsonObject response = new JsonObject();
            response.add("result", statutoryToJson(result));
            response.addProperty("saved", false);
            sendJson(exchange, 200, response.toString());
        } catch (RequestException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, ex.statusCode, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        }
    }

package ph.motorph.c_calc;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.YearMonth;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

public final class MonthPayroll {
    public static final int SSS = 0, PHILHEALTH = 1, PAGIBIG = 2, TAX = 3;
    public static final int RICE = 0, PHONE = 1, CLOTHING = 2;

    
    public static final class Taken {
        public final PayrollAdjustments.Deduction item;
        public final long takenCents;
        public final long shortfallCents;

        Taken(PayrollAdjustments.Deduction item, long takenCents) {
            this.item = item;
            this.takenCents = takenCents;
            this.shortfallCents = item.perCutoffCents - takenCents;
        }
    }

    
    public enum Split { HALF, FULL_FIRST }

    private final Split split;
    private final String employeeId;
    private final YearMonth month;
    private final BigDecimal hourlyRate;
    private final List<CutoffPay> cutoffs;
    private final long monthlyGrossCents;
    private final StatutoryBreakdown statutory;
    private final long[][] lines = new long[2][4];
    private final long[][] employerLines = new long[2][3];
    private final long[][] allowances = new long[2][3];
    private final long[] bonusCents = new long[2];
    private final List<List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning>> bonuses = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning>> allowanceCorrections = new ArrayList<>();
    private final long[] allowanceCorrectionCents = new long[2];
    private final List<List<Taken>> voluntary = new ArrayList<>();

    MonthPayroll(String employeeId, YearMonth month, BigDecimal hourlyRate, List<CutoffPay> cutoffs) {
        this(employeeId, month, hourlyRate, cutoffs, Collections.emptyList(), Collections.emptyList(), Collections.emptyList(), new long[3]);
    }

    MonthPayroll(String employeeId, YearMonth month, BigDecimal hourlyRate, List<CutoffPay> cutoffs,
            List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> firstBonuses, List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> secondBonuses,
            List<PayrollAdjustments.Deduction> voluntaryDeductions, long[] monthlyAllowanceCents) {
        this(employeeId, month, hourlyRate, cutoffs, firstBonuses, secondBonuses, voluntaryDeductions, monthlyAllowanceCents, StatutoryRates.DEFAULT);
    }

    MonthPayroll(String employeeId, YearMonth month, BigDecimal hourlyRate, List<CutoffPay> cutoffs,
            List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> firstBonuses, List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> secondBonuses,
            List<PayrollAdjustments.Deduction> voluntaryDeductions, long[] monthlyAllowanceCents, StatutoryRates rates) {
        this(employeeId, month, hourlyRate, cutoffs, firstBonuses, secondBonuses, voluntaryDeductions, monthlyAllowanceCents, rates, Split.HALF, 0L);
    }

    MonthPayroll(String employeeId, YearMonth month, BigDecimal hourlyRate, List<CutoffPay> cutoffs,
            List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> firstBonuses, List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> secondBonuses,
            List<PayrollAdjustments.Deduction> voluntaryDeductions, long[] monthlyAllowanceCents, StatutoryRates rates,
            Split split, long monthlyBasicCents) {
        if (cutoffs.size() != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException("A month has exactly two cutoffs.");
        this.split = split == null ? Split.HALF : split;
        this.employeeId = employeeId;
        this.month = month;
        this.hourlyRate = hourlyRate;
        this.cutoffs = Collections.unmodifiableList(cutoffs);
        
        for (List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> items : java.util.Arrays.asList(firstBonuses, secondBonuses)) {
            List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> taxable = new ArrayList<>(), allowance = new ArrayList<>();
            for (PayrollAdjustments.Earning item : items) (PayrollAdjustments.isTaxable(item.type) ? taxable : allowance).add(item);
            bonuses.add(Collections.unmodifiableList(taxable));
            allowanceCorrections.add(Collections.unmodifiableList(allowance));
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            for (PayrollAdjustments.Earning item : bonuses.get(c)) bonusCents[c] += item.amountCents;
            for (PayrollAdjustments.Earning item : allowanceCorrections.get(c)) allowanceCorrectionCents[c] += item.amountCents;
        }
        long earned = earnedCents(0) + earnedCents(1);
        long bonus = bonusCents[0] + bonusCents[1];
        this.monthlyGrossCents = earned + bonus;
        
        
        
        
        
        long base = monthlyBasicCents > 0 ? monthlyBasicCents : earned;
        this.statutory = base > 0
            ? StatutoryCalculator2026.calculate(month, Math.max(base + bonus, 1), base, base, base, base + bonus, rates)
            : null;
        if (statutory != null) {
            if (split == Split.FULL_FIRST) {
                lines[0][SSS] = statutory.sssEmployeeCents;
                lines[0][PHILHEALTH] = statutory.philHealthEmployeeCents;
                lines[0][PAGIBIG] = statutory.pagIbigEmployeeCents;
                lines[0][TAX] = statutory.withholdingTaxCents;
                employerLines[0][SSS] = statutory.sssEmployerTotalCents();
                employerLines[0][PHILHEALTH] = statutory.philHealthEmployerCents;
                employerLines[0][PAGIBIG] = statutory.pagIbigEmployerCents;
            } else {
                split(lines, SSS, statutory.sssEmployeeCents);
                split(lines, PHILHEALTH, statutory.philHealthEmployeeCents);
                split(lines, PAGIBIG, statutory.pagIbigEmployeeCents);
                split(lines, TAX, statutory.withholdingTaxCents);
                split(employerLines, SSS, statutory.sssEmployerTotalCents());
                split(employerLines, PHILHEALTH, statutory.philHealthEmployerCents);
                split(employerLines, PAGIBIG, statutory.pagIbigEmployerCents);
            }
        }
        for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
            if (split == Split.FULL_FIRST) {
                
                
                for (int a = 0; a < 3; a++) allowances[c][a] = c == 0 ? monthlyAllowanceCents[a] : 0;
            } else {
                
                for (int a = 0; a < 3; a++) allowances[c][a] = c == 0 ? monthlyAllowanceCents[a] / 2 : monthlyAllowanceCents[a] - monthlyAllowanceCents[a] / 2;
            }
            List<Taken> taken = new ArrayList<>();
            long room = Math.max(0, grossCents(c) - statutoryCents(c));
            for (PayrollAdjustments.Deduction item : voluntaryDeductions) {
                if (item.onlyCutoff != 0 && item.onlyCutoff != c + 1) continue;
                long amount = Math.min(item.perCutoffCents, room);
                taken.add(new Taken(item, amount));
                room -= amount;
            }
            voluntary.add(Collections.unmodifiableList(taken));
        }
    }

    private static void split(long[][] target, int line, long monthlyCents) {
        target[0][line] = monthlyCents / 2;
        target[1][line] = monthlyCents - target[0][line];
    }

    private static long cents(BigDecimal pesos) { return pesos.movePointRight(2).longValueExact(); }

    public String getEmployeeId() { return employeeId; }
    public YearMonth getMonth() { return month; }
    public BigDecimal getHourlyRate() { return hourlyRate; }
    public List<CutoffPay> getCutoffs() { return cutoffs; }
    
    public long getMonthlyGrossCents() { return monthlyGrossCents; }
    
    public StatutoryBreakdown getStatutory() { return statutory; }

    
    public long lineCents(int cutoff, int line) { return lines[cutoff][line]; }
    
    public long employerCents(int cutoff, int line) { return employerLines[cutoff][line]; }
    public long allowanceCents(int cutoff, int allowance) { return allowances[cutoff][allowance]; }
    
    public static String allowanceAdjustmentType(int allowance) {
        return PayrollAdjustments.ALLOWANCE_TYPES.get(allowance);
    }

    
    public long allowanceWithCorrections(int cutoff, int allowance) {
        long total = allowances[cutoff][allowance];
        String type = allowanceAdjustmentType(allowance);
        for (PayrollAdjustments.Earning item : allowanceCorrections.get(cutoff)) if (item.type.equals(type)) total += item.amountCents;
        return Math.max(0, total);
    }

    
    public List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> allowanceCorrectionsFor(int cutoff) {
        return new ArrayList<>(allowanceCorrections.get(cutoff));
    }
    
    public long allowanceTotalCents(int cutoff) {
        
        return Math.max(0, allowances[cutoff][0] + allowances[cutoff][1] + allowances[cutoff][2] + allowanceCorrectionCents[cutoff]);
    }
    public List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> allowanceCorrections(int cutoff) { return allowanceCorrections.get(cutoff); }
    public long allowanceCorrectionCents(int cutoff) { return allowanceCorrectionCents[cutoff]; }
    public List<PayrollAdjustments.Earning> bonuses(int cutoff) { return bonuses.get(cutoff); }
    public long bonusCents(int cutoff) { return bonusCents[cutoff]; }

const hours = minutes => (minutes / 60).toFixed(2);

function hoursText(paidMinutes, overageMinutes = 0, overtimeMinutes = 0) {
  let text = hours(paidMinutes);
  if (overtimeMinutes > 0) text += ` + ${hours(overtimeMinutes)} OT`;
  if (overageMinutes > 0) text += ` (+${hours(overageMinutes)} unapproved, unpaid)`;
  return text;
}

export function remittanceRows(slip) {
  if (!slip || typeof slip !== 'object') throw new TypeError('A payslip object is required.');
  const sum = (a, b) => (Number(a || 0) + Number(b || 0)).toFixed(2);
  return [
    ['Social Security System', sum(slip.sssEmployee, slip.sssEmployer)],
    ["Employees' Compensation", sum(slip.sssEc, 0)],
    ['PhilHealth', sum(slip.philHealthEmployee, slip.philHealthEmployer)],
    ['Pag-IBIG', sum(slip.pagibigEmployee, slip.pagibigEmployer)],
    ['BIR withholding', sum(slip.withholdingTax, 0)]
  ];
}

export function initCutoffPayroll(apiJson, { canFinalize = () => true } = {}) {
  const getJson = url => apiJson(url);
  finalizeAllowed = canFinalize;
  const form = document.getElementById('payroll-cutoff-form');
  if (!form) return { refreshHistory() {} };
  const status = document.getElementById('payroll-cutoff-status');
  const rows = document.getElementById('payroll-cutoff-rows');
  const payslipSection = document.getElementById('payroll-payslip');
  const historyRows = document.getElementById('payroll-history-rows');
  const historyStatus = document.getElementById('payroll-history-status');
  document.getElementById('payslip-print').addEventListener('click', () => window.print());

  async function refreshHistory() {
    try {
      const view = savedPayslipRows((await getJson('/api/payroll/payslips')).payslips);
      historyRows.replaceChildren();
      view.forEach(item => {
        const row = document.createElement('tr');
        item.cells.forEach(text => {
          const cell = document.createElement('td');
          cell.textContent = text;
          row.append(cell);
        });
        const action = document.createElement('td');
        const open = document.createElement('button');
        open.type = 'button';
        open.className = 'button button-quiet';
        open.textContent = 'Open';
        open.dataset.savedId = item.id;
        open.setAttribute('aria-label', `Open saved payslip ${item.id}`);
        action.append(open);
        row.append(action);
        historyRows.append(row);
      });
      historyStatus.textContent = view.length
        ? `${view.length} finalized payslip${view.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} (local memory; cleared when the server restarts).`
        : 'No finalized payslips yet. Open a payslip and choose Finalize payslip.';
    } catch (error) {
      historyStatus.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not load payroll history.';
    }
  }

  document.getElementById('payslip-finalize').addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const button = event.currentTarget;
    button.disabled = true;
    try {
      const { employeeId, month, cutoff } = button.dataset;
      const payload = await apiJson('/api/payroll/payslips', { employeeId, month, cutoff });
      renderPayslip(payload.payslip);
      historyStatus.textContent = `Finalized ${payload.payslip.payslipId}.`;
      await refreshHistory();
    } catch (error) {
      historyStatus.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not finalize the payslip.';
    } finally {
      button.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  historyRows.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const button = event.target.closest('button[data-saved-id]');
    if (!button) return;
    try {
      renderPayslip((await getJson(`/api/payroll/payslips/${encodeURIComponent(button.dataset.savedId)}`)).payslip);
    } catch (error) {
      historyStatus.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not open the saved payslip.';
    }
  });

  rows.addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const button = event.target.closest('button[data-cutoff]');
    if (!button) return;
    button.disabled = true;
    try {
      const { employeeId, month, cutoff } = button.dataset;
      const payload = await getJson(`/api/payroll/payslip?employeeId=${encodeURIComponent(employeeId)}&month=${encodeURIComponent(month)}&cutoff=${cutoff}`);
      renderPayslip(payload.payslip);
    } catch (error) {
      status.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not load the payslip.';
      status.classList.add('payroll-preview-error');
    } finally {
      button.disabled = false;
    }
  });
  form.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    status.classList.remove('payroll-preview-error');
    rows.replaceChildren();
    payslipSection.hidden = true;
    const employeeId = document.getElementById('payroll-cutoff-employee').value;
    const month = document.getElementById('payroll-cutoff-month').value;
    try {
      if (!employeeId) throw new Error('Choose an employee.');
      const payload = await getJson(`/api/payroll/cutoffs?employeeId=${encodeURIComponent(employeeId)}&month=${encodeURIComponent(month)}`);
      const result = buildCutoffPayroll(payload);
      result.cutoffs.forEach((cutoff, index) => {
        const row = document.createElement('tr');
        [`${cutoff.label} (${cutoff.from} – ${cutoff.to})`, String(cutoff.daysWithRecords), cutoff.hours,
          formatPesoCents(cutoff.grossCents), formatPesoCents(cutoff.deductionsCents),
          cutoff.netCents === null ? cutoff.blockedReason : formatPesoCents(cutoff.netCents)]
          .forEach(text => {
            const cell = document.createElement('td');
            cell.textContent = text;
            row.append(cell);
          });
        const action = document.createElement('td');
        if (cutoff.netCents !== null && cutoff.grossCents > 0n) {
          const button = document.createElement('button');
          button.type = 'button';
          button.className = 'button button-quiet';
          button.textContent = 'Payslip';
          button.dataset.employeeId = employeeId;
          button.dataset.month = result.month;
          button.dataset.cutoff = String(index + 1);
          button.setAttribute('aria-label', `View payslip for ${employeeId}, ${cutoff.label} ${result.month}`);
          action.append(button);
        } else {
          action.textContent = '—';
        }
        row.append(action);
        rows.append(row);
      });
      const deductions = result.statutory
        ? `Month's deductions (half per cutoff): SSS ${formatPesoCents(result.statutory.sss.employeeCents)}, PhilHealth ${formatPesoCents(result.statutory.philHealth.employeeCents)}, Pag-IBIG ${formatPesoCents(result.statutory.pagIbig.employeeCents)}, tax ${formatPesoCents(result.statutory.withholdingTaxCents)}.`
        : 'No paid attendance this month, so no deductions.';
      status.textContent = `${employeeId} · ${result.month} · rate ₱${result.hourlyRate}/hour (placeholder monthly basic ₱${result.monthlyBasic} ÷ 168) · monthly gross ${formatPesoCents(result.monthlyGrossCents)}. ${deductions} Not saved. Choose Payslip on a cutoff to view or print it.`;
    } catch (error) {
      status.textContent = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not calculate cutoff payroll.';
      status.classList.add('payroll-preview-error');
    }
  });
  return { refreshHistory };
}
package ph.motorph.c_calc;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.YearMonth;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

public final class StatutoryRates {
    public final String id, note, createdBy, createdAt;
    public final YearMonth effectiveMonth;
    public final long sssEmployeeBp, sssEmployerBp, sssMinMsc, sssMaxMsc;
    public final long philHealthPremiumBp, philHealthFloor, philHealthCeiling;
    public final long pagIbigLowBand, pagIbigLowBp, pagIbigHighBp, pagIbigEmployerBp, pagIbigCap;
    
    public final List<long[]> birAnnual;

    public static final StatutoryRates DEFAULT = new StatutoryRates(StatutoryCalculator2026.RULESET_ID, YearMonth.of(2026, 1),
        "Built-in 2026 rates (matches sweldongpinoy.com; Pag-IBIG 1% at exactly ₱1,500 per Circular 460)", "", "",
        500, 1_000, 500_000, 3_500_000, 500, 1_000_000, 10_000_000, 150_000, 100, 200, 200, 1_000_000,
        java.util.Arrays.asList(new long[] {0, 0, 0}, new long[] {25_000_000, 0, 1_500}, new long[] {40_000_000, 2_250_000, 2_000},
            new long[] {80_000_000, 10_250_000, 2_500}, new long[] {200_000_000, 40_250_000, 3_000}, new long[] {800_000_000, 220_250_000, 3_500}));

    StatutoryRates(String id, YearMonth effectiveMonth, String note, String createdBy, String createdAt,
            long sssEmployeeBp, long sssEmployerBp, long sssMinMsc, long sssMaxMsc,
            long philHealthPremiumBp, long philHealthFloor, long philHealthCeiling,
            long pagIbigLowBand, long pagIbigLowBp, long pagIbigHighBp, long pagIbigEmployerBp, long pagIbigCap, List<long[]> birAnnual) {
        this.id = id; this.effectiveMonth = effectiveMonth; this.note = note; this.createdBy = createdBy; this.createdAt = createdAt;
        this.sssEmployeeBp = sssEmployeeBp; this.sssEmployerBp = sssEmployerBp; this.sssMinMsc = sssMinMsc; this.sssMaxMsc = sssMaxMsc;
        this.philHealthPremiumBp = philHealthPremiumBp; this.philHealthFloor = philHealthFloor; this.philHealthCeiling = philHealthCeiling;
        this.pagIbigLowBand = pagIbigLowBand; this.pagIbigLowBp = pagIbigLowBp; this.pagIbigHighBp = pagIbigHighBp;
        this.pagIbigEmployerBp = pagIbigEmployerBp; this.pagIbigCap = pagIbigCap;
        List<long[]> rows = new ArrayList<>();
        for (long[] row : birAnnual) rows.add(row.clone());
        this.birAnnual = Collections.unmodifiableList(rows);
        validate();
    }

    private void validate() {
        for (long bp : new long[] {sssEmployeeBp, sssEmployerBp, philHealthPremiumBp, pagIbigLowBp, pagIbigHighBp, pagIbigEmployerBp}) {
            if (bp < 0 || bp > 5_000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Contribution rates must be 0% to 50%.");
        }
        if (philHealthPremiumBp % 2 != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("The PhilHealth premium must split evenly (e.g. 5.00%).");
        if (sssMinMsc <= 0 || sssMaxMsc < sssMinMsc || (sssMaxMsc - sssMinMsc) % 50_000 != 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("SSS MSC range must be positive, with the maximum at least the minimum, in ₱500 steps.");
        }
        if (philHealthFloor <= 0 || philHealthCeiling < philHealthFloor) throw new IllegalArgumentException("PhilHealth floor and ceiling must be positive, ceiling at least floor.");
        if (pagIbigLowBand < 0 || pagIbigCap <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Pag-IBIG band and cap must be positive.");
        if (birAnnual.isEmpty() || birAnnual.size() > 12 || birAnnual.get(0)[0] != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("The tax table needs 1-12 rows, the first starting at ₱0.");
        for (int i = 0; i < birAnnual.size(); i++) {
            long[] row = birAnnual.get(i);
            if (row.length != 3 || row[1] < 0 || row[2] < 0 || row[2] > 10_000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Each tax row needs over ≥ 0, base tax ≥ 0 and a rate of 0% to 100%.");
            if (i > 0 && row[0] <= birAnnual.get(i - 1)[0]) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Tax table rows must go up in income.");
        }
    }

    
    public static StatutoryRates version(String id, YearMonth effectiveMonth, String note, String createdBy,
            long sssEmployeeBp, long sssEmployerBp, long sssMinMsc, long sssMaxMsc,
            long philHealthPremiumBp, long philHealthFloor, long philHealthCeiling,
            long pagIbigLowBand, long pagIbigLowBp, long pagIbigHighBp, long pagIbigEmployerBp, long pagIbigCap, List<long[]> birAnnual) {
        if (effectiveMonth == null || effectiveMonth.getYear() != 2026) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Effective month must be in 2026.");
        return new StatutoryRates(id, effectiveMonth, note == null ? "" : note.trim(), createdBy, Instant.now().toString(),
            sssEmployeeBp, sssEmployerBp, sssMinMsc, sssMaxMsc, philHealthPremiumBp, philHealthFloor, philHealthCeiling,
            pagIbigLowBand, pagIbigLowBp, pagIbigHighBp, pagIbigEmployerBp, pagIbigCap, birAnnual);
    }

    
    public static final class Registry {
        private final List<StatutoryRates> versions = new ArrayList<>();

        public synchronized StatutoryRates ratesFor(YearMonth month) {
            StatutoryRates chosen = DEFAULT;
            for (StatutoryRates version : versions) {
                if (!version.effectiveMonth.isAfter(month) && !version.effectiveMonth.isBefore(chosen.effectiveMonth)) chosen = version;
            }
            return chosen;
        }

        public synchronized String nextId() { return "PH-2026-admin-v" + (versions.size() + 1); }

        public synchronized StatutoryRates add(StatutoryRates version) {
            for (StatutoryRates existing : versions) {
                if (existing.effectiveMonth.equals(version.effectiveMonth)) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException("A rates version already starts in " + version.effectiveMonth + "; choose another month.");
                }
            }
            versions.add(version);
            return version;
        }

        
        public synchronized List<StatutoryRates> all() {
            List<StatutoryRates> result = new ArrayList<>();
            result.add(DEFAULT);
            result.addAll(versions);
            return result;
        }
    }
}
    public long bonusCents(int cutoff) { return bonusCents[cutoff]; }
    public List<Taken> voluntary(int cutoff) { return voluntary.get(cutoff); }

    
    public long earnedCents(int cutoff) { return cents(cutoffs.get(cutoff).getGrossPay()); }
    
    public long grossCents(int cutoff) { return earnedCents(cutoff) + bonusCents[cutoff]; }
    public long statutoryCents(int cutoff) {
        long total = 0;
        for (long line : lines[cutoff]) total += line;
        return total;
    }
    public long voluntaryCents(int cutoff) {
        long total = 0;
        for (Taken item : voluntary.get(cutoff)) total += item.takenCents;
        return total;
    }
    
    public long deductionsCents(int cutoff) { return statutoryCents(cutoff) + voluntaryCents(cutoff); }
    
    public boolean isBlocked(int cutoff) { return statutoryCents(cutoff) > grossCents(cutoff); }
    public long netCents(int cutoff) {
        if (isBlocked(cutoff)) throw new IllegalStateException("Deductions exceed this cutoff's gross.");
        return grossCents(cutoff) - deductionsCents(cutoff) + allowanceTotalCents(cutoff);
    }

package ph.motorph.c_calc;

import java.time.YearMonth;

public final class StatutoryBreakdown {
    public final String rulesetId;
    public final YearMonth period;
    public final long grossCashPayCents;
    public final long sssCompensationCents;
    public final long philHealthBasicSalaryCents;
    public final long pagIbigFundSalaryCents;
    public final long taxableCompensationCents;
    public final long sssMscCents;
    public final long sssEmployeeCents;
    public final long sssEmployerRegularCents;
    public final long sssEcCents;
    public final long philHealthPremiumBaseCents;
    public final long philHealthTotalPremiumCents;
    public final long philHealthEmployeeCents;
    public final long philHealthEmployerCents;
    public final long pagIbigBaseCents;
    public final long pagIbigEmployeeCents;
    public final long pagIbigEmployerCents;
    public final long taxableAfterEmployeeContributionsCents;
    public final long withholdingTaxCents;

    StatutoryBreakdown(String rulesetId, YearMonth period, long grossCashPayCents, long sssCompensationCents,
            long philHealthBasicSalaryCents, long pagIbigFundSalaryCents, long taxableCompensationCents,
            long sssMscCents, long sssEmployeeCents, long sssEmployerRegularCents, long sssEcCents,
            long philHealthPremiumBaseCents, long philHealthTotalPremiumCents, long philHealthEmployeeCents,
            long pagIbigBaseCents, long pagIbigEmployeeCents, long pagIbigEmployerCents,
            long taxableAfterEmployeeContributionsCents, long withholdingTaxCents) {
        this.rulesetId = rulesetId;
        this.period = period;
        this.grossCashPayCents = grossCashPayCents;
        this.sssCompensationCents = sssCompensationCents;
        this.philHealthBasicSalaryCents = philHealthBasicSalaryCents;
        this.pagIbigFundSalaryCents = pagIbigFundSalaryCents;
        this.taxableCompensationCents = taxableCompensationCents;
        this.sssMscCents = sssMscCents;
        this.sssEmployeeCents = sssEmployeeCents;
        this.sssEmployerRegularCents = sssEmployerRegularCents;
        this.sssEcCents = sssEcCents;
        this.philHealthPremiumBaseCents = philHealthPremiumBaseCents;
        this.philHealthTotalPremiumCents = philHealthTotalPremiumCents;
        this.philHealthEmployeeCents = philHealthEmployeeCents;
        this.philHealthEmployerCents = philHealthTotalPremiumCents - philHealthEmployeeCents;
        this.pagIbigBaseCents = pagIbigBaseCents;
        this.pagIbigEmployeeCents = pagIbigEmployeeCents;
        this.pagIbigEmployerCents = pagIbigEmployerCents;
        this.taxableAfterEmployeeContributionsCents = taxableAfterEmployeeContributionsCents;
        this.withholdingTaxCents = withholdingTaxCents;
    }

    public long sssEmployerTotalCents() { return sssEmployerRegularCents + sssEcCents; }
    public long totalEmployeeStatutoryCents() { return sssEmployeeCents + philHealthEmployeeCents + pagIbigEmployeeCents; }
    public long totalEmployeeDeductionsCents() { return totalEmployeeStatutoryCents() + withholdingTaxCents; }
    public long totalEmployerContributionsCents() { return sssEmployerTotalCents() + philHealthEmployerCents + pagIbigEmployerCents; }
    public long netPayCents() { return grossCashPayCents - totalEmployeeDeductionsCents(); }
    public long employerCashCostCents() { return grossCashPayCents + totalEmployerContributionsCents(); }
}

import { buildCutoffPayroll, payslipRows, savedPayslipRows } from '../../web/f_flares/PayrollCutoff.js';
import { overtimeRows } from '../../web/f_flares/Overtime.js';

// Shaped like GET /api/payroll/cutoffs for DEMO-001, October 2026 (Java computes every amount).
const payload = {
  employeeId: 'DEMO-001',
  month: '2026-10',
  hourlyRate: '150.00',
  monthlyGross: '3597.50',
  cutoffs: [
    { label: '1-15', from: '2026-10-01', to: '2026-10-15', daysWithRecords: 3, paidMinutes: 1439, unpaidOverageMinutes: 0, grossPay: '3597.50',
      deductionsCents: 28597, netCents: 331153, blocked: false },
    { label: '16-end', from: '2026-10-16', to: '2026-10-31', daysWithRecords: 0, paidMinutes: 0, grossPay: '0.00',
      deductionsCents: 28598, netCents: null, blocked: true }
  ],
  statutory: { totalEmployeeDeductionsCents: 57195, sss: { employeeCents: 25000 } }
};

test('shows Java cutoff amounts without recalculating them', () => {
  const result = buildCutoffPayroll(payload);
  const [first] = result.cutoffs;
  assert.equal(first.label, '1–15');
  assert.equal(first.hours, '23.98');
  assert.equal(first.grossCents, 359750n);
  assert.equal(first.deductionsCents, 28597n);
  assert.equal(first.netCents, 331153n);
  assert.equal(result.monthlyGrossCents, 359750n);
  assert.equal(result.statutory.totalEmployeeDeductionsCents, 57195n);
});

test('unapproved overage is shown next to paid hours, not added to them', () => {
  const withOverage = { ...payload, cutoffs: [{ ...payload.cutoffs[0], paidMinutes: 1440, unpaidOverageMinutes: 90 }, payload.cutoffs[1]] };
  assert.equal(buildCutoffPayroll(withOverage).cutoffs[0].hours, '24.00 (+1.50 unapproved, unpaid)');
});

test('a blocked cutoff shows a reason instead of a negative net', () => {
  const second = buildCutoffPayroll(payload).cutoffs[1];
  assert.equal(second.netCents, null);
  assert.match(second.blockedReason, /₱285\.98 exceed/);
});

test('a month with no paid attendance has no statutory breakdown', () => {
  const result = buildCutoffPayroll({ ...payload, monthlyGross: '0.00', statutory: null });
  assert.equal(result.statutory, null);
});

test('rejects a malformed response', () => {
  assert.throws(() => buildCutoffPayroll({ cutoffs: [] }), /Unexpected payroll response/);
