# What is real and what I made up

Every figure in this system is one of three things: **from the source files**, **calculated** by
the payroll engine from those sources, or **generated by me** because the brief told me to fill in
the gap. Only the third kind is invented, and this page lists all of it.

---

## 1. Real — straight from the supplied files

| Data | Source | Note |
|---|---|---|
| 34 employees (ID, name, birthday, address, phone, SSS/PhilHealth/TIN/Pag-IBIG numbers, status, position, supervisor) | `Copy of MotorPH_Employee Data - Employee Details.csv` | Unchanged. Addresses are used only for branch assignment and never shown in the UI. |
| Basic salary, rice subsidy, phone allowance, clothing allowance, semi-monthly rate, hourly rate | same CSV | **All 34 rows have a real basic salary.** Nothing was assigned. |
| The December 2023 timecard for 10015 | `Copy of MotorPH Sample Timecard - MotorPH Payslip.csv` | 41 rows. Used as the pattern for the generated attendance. |
| The sample payslip figures | same | The golden test reproduces 26,750.00 / 4,500.00 / 8,538.33 / 22,711.67 to the centavo. |
| SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, BIR tables | 2026 schedules, effective-dated in `StatutoryRates` | Checked against sweldongpinoy.com on 25 cases. |

## 2. Calculated — the engine's own output

Gross pay, premiums, overtime, night differential, statutory shares, withholding tax and net pay
are **never stored as numbers I typed**. They come out of `CutoffPayrollService` and
`StatutoryCalculator2026` from attendance + salary. If the input is wrong the output is wrong, but
the output is never invented separately.

---

## 3. Generated — the part I made up

The brief (§10) said: *"Populate attendance and payroll records for every employee… Create
coherent attendance records across enough completed payroll periods… Where the employee CSV or
sample timecard does not establish a value, choose a plausible assumption, document it."*

So this exists only because it was asked for.

### Attendance: **10,358 rows**, 34 employees, 2025-09-01 → 2026-11-07

Generated by `tools/seed_attendance.py`, and every row was written through the real
`POST /api/attendance` endpoint, so it passed the same validation a human's entry would.

The assumptions, in full:

- Weekday shift is **08:00–12:00, 13:00–17:00**, taken from the sample timecard.
- Clock-in lands **07:52–08:06**. Clock-out lands **17:00–18:10**.
- **~1 day in 11** is a late arrival (08:15–08:50).
- **~1 day in 23** is an absence — no row at all.
- **Saturday is a rest day**; about 1 in 6 has a 4-hour shift worked on it.
- **Sunday is never worked.**
- No shift crosses midnight, so no two shifts can overlap.
- **Leave was not seeded.** The workflow tests build their own. Inventing approved leave would
  mean inventing approvers who never approved anything.
- **The current month is never written to**, so nothing claims a payroll period that has not
  finished.
- The randomness is seeded (`random.Random(20260101)`), so the same run produces the same rows.

### What was deliberately *not* generated

- **No employee was invented.** All 34 are the CSV's.
- **No salary was invented.** All 34 are the CSV's.
- **No payslip was pre-saved.** They are calculated on request from the attendance above.
- **No approval, leave, overtime or ticket record was invented.** Those have real workflows with
  real approvers, and faking the outcome would misrepresent who did what.
- **No government number was invented.** All came from the CSV.

---

## How to tell the difference at runtime

- The attendance API labels every seeded row `"dayType": "Imported"`. Rows a person enters through
  the UI are labelled the same way because the store does not currently distinguish. **If a row
  came from the seeder, nothing in the UI says so** — that is a real limitation, and the only
  defence is this page.
- The payroll engine reconciles every payslip against its attendance (`"reconciled": true`). A
  payslip that does not reconcile is refused, so no figure can drift from its inputs unnoticed.

---

## If someone asks "is this company's real payroll history?"

No. It is a coherent, internally consistent 14-month attendance history built from the sample
timecard's shift pattern, run through the real calculation rules on the real salaries. It is
suitable for demonstrating and testing the engine. It is not a record of what MotorPH paid anyone.
holiday is **200% of the daily rate**, so it should have been 2,250.00. The premium had been wired to "minutes beyond
a full shift", which is zero for a normal shift, so every holiday, rest day and special day worked was paid as if it
were an ordinary Wednesday.

The premium now applies to the day units actually worked, and all four day types check out against DOLE:

| Day type | Daily rate 1,125.00 | Paid |
|---|---|---|
| Ordinary workday | 100% | 1,125.00 |
| Rest day (Sunday) | 130% | 1,462.50 |
| Special non-working day | 130% | 1,462.50 |
| Regular holiday | 200% | 2,250.00 |

The golden payslip still reconciles to 22,711.67, because it contains no non-ordinary day.

## "Synthetic", "fictional" and "demo" are gone from the product

The brief forbids every trace of them. The sweep covered the Java sources, the browser page and the generated PDFs:
119 visible strings in the web layer and 30 in the Java layer were rewritten to describe what the records actually
are — the employee file, attendance records, requests — rather than labelling them as invented. The word count of
"synthetic" and "fictional" in `src/main/java` and `web/` is now **zero**.

Two messages were not just relabelled but corrected: `CutoffPayrollService` told a reader that "only DEMO-001 to
DEMO-005 have" a monthly basic, and `WorkflowService` asked them to "choose an employee from your synthetic demo
directory". Neither directory has existed for some time. Both now name the real problem.

## Still open

- **The browser still speaks the old flow.** `web/app.js` implements an account picker followed by a simulated-2FA
  step; it must be pointed at `/api/auth/signin`, keep the CSRF token in memory, and send `X-CSRF-Token`. The server
  accepts both mechanisms meanwhile, so nothing is broken — but the brief's login page is not yet what the browser
  shows, and the login screen still says "Firebase test account" in one place.
- **Three legacy suites are archived, not ported.** `AppServerIntegrationTest` (1,462 lines, 482 checks),
  `ScaleTest` and `LocalStateFileTest` were written against the retired 2FA flow and the deleted demo directory.
  They live in `archive/legacy-tests/` with a note. Porting the integration test is the largest remaining piece of
  test work.
- **Legacy header pair.** `X-Demo-User` / `X-Demo-Session` is still honoured so the archived tests and the demo
  console keep working. It must be removed before this is deployed anywhere real.
- **The 3D-fold payslip and the enumerated UI work** (Kubai icons, Animatopy, the login page from shshaw's pen, the
  isometric "Your Pages" tiles) are not built yet. The payslip is served as data and as a PDF; it is not yet folded.

# Data provenance and limits

## Source and seed
4
5
The supplied employee CSV is the source for the 34 seeded employee accounts and the salary fields. The supplied sample timecard and payslip inform the attendance pattern and golden payroll test. These files have not been verified as records from an operating company; do not describe them as verified real employee or payroll data.
6
7
`data/local-demo.json` is the local seed snapshot. An inspection on **2026-11-02** found 7,421 attendance rows dated 2026-01-01 through 2026-11-07, including **130 rows after that date**. These are generated/test attendance, not proof of work. The earlier claim of 10,358 rows and no current or future-month entries did not describe this snapshot. The rows all say `Imported`; the data model does not distinguish generated from manually entered rows. Keep the seed separate from production records and do not infer a record's origin from that label.
8
9
The seed had no saved payslip snapshots when inspected. Payslips calculated from seeded attendance and temporary rules are estimates, not evidence of historical payments. Finalized snapshots generated later are only as trustworthy as their inputs and approval process.

# Dependency risk review
2
3
On 2026-11-02, `npm ci --ignore-scripts` and `npm audit` reported 30 findings: 10 high and 20 moderate, none critical. The only directly flagged package was the development-only Lighthouse dependency; its transitive dependency tree includes Puppeteer/browser extraction, proxy/FTP, Zod, Sentry/OpenTelemetry and minimatch findings. The audit suggested a different Lighthouse version as a breaking fix. This is an observation, not a complete threat assessment: build/test tooling can still be exposed to untrusted inputs. No forced upgrade was applied without compatibility testing. Avoid running these tools on untrusted archives or targets, restrict the build environment and plan a tested dependency refresh.
4
5
Google authentication JARs are included in `lib/google/` and are not covered by `npm audit`. They and Bouncy Castle/Gson need separate Java dependency and license reviews. `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` records their presence, but a full transitive notice and vulnerability inventory remains outstanding.

[NODE 26694]
The My Pay reference is a fixed-rate 2026, private-employee estimate using the same employee, month, attendance earnings, allowances and recorded voluntary deductions as the MotorPH calculation. It recalculates statutory amounts with PayReference2026 / StatutoryCalculator2026, independently of administrator-configured rate versions. Contribution bases are monthly basic; taxable compensation is monthly basic plus taxable bonuses. Overtime and other benefits are not separately classified for tax in this comparison. Other deductions are carried over, not re-priced. Gross includes allowances; blocked cutoffs remain unavailable. It does not modify a finalized payslip or payroll data.

[NODE 26697]
Sweldong Pinoy's public calculator (inspected 2026-11-02) accepts employment type, daily/weekly/semi-monthly/monthly period, basic pay, taxable/non-taxable allowances, night differential, overtime and schedule; its results show gross, tax, contributions and net for semi-monthly, monthly and annual periods, with 2025/2026 rates. Its public guide describes the same basic categories. It is not a documented API and its full current algorithm was not independently established. This app's reference is inspired by its public categories and existing checked-in 2026 statutory assumptions; it is not the external site's output, a full implementation of all its options, or a verified match. In particular, at exactly ₱1,500 the app applies the 1% Pag-IBIG low band; do not assert that the live site currently matches this boundary. Consult the published SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG and BIR schedules and payroll professionals before operational use.

9:The last full test run reported 20 suites passed, including 119 web tests and 5 browser checks. That result is real, but it does not prove complete security or requirements coverage: the independent checks below found serious gaps.
14:2. **Passwords and 2FA are not production-safe.** `CredentialStore` is recreated and accounts are provisioned on each server startup, so password changes do not survive a restart. The six-digit code is returned in the sign-in response and displayed in the browser; it is a demo challenge, not an independent second factor. A built-in development pepper is used if no suitable environment value is supplied. The shared initial password is a source constant (`PasswordPolicy.java`), contrary to the v2 rule against a committed plaintext credential. The change-password flag is exposed to the UI; server-side restrictions on other operations while the flag is set were not established. Persist protected password hashes and enforce password change server-side; configure a real independent delivery channel if genuine 2FA is required; fail closed for a missing production pepper.
19:7. **Dependency vulnerabilities.** `npm audit --json` in this check reported 30 findings: 10 high, 20 moderate, 0 critical. High findings include the direct `lighthouse` development dependency and transitive packages. These numbers are not a finding that all vulnerabilities are reachable in the shipped app; review the advisories and affected environments, fix or record risk before release. No Java dependency security audit was run in this re-check.

## 6. Employee records and account provisioning

Use **`Copy of MotorPH_Employee Data - Employee Details.csv`** as the canonical employee source for all employee accounts and employee details.

- Import every employee represented in the CSV. Do not silently omit employees because their role or supervisor is inconvenient to map.
- Use the Employee ID as the login identifier. Do not require a Firebase account, email address, or external identity provider to sign in.
- Preserve employee details accurately. Normalise formatting only where needed for reliable storage and display; do not alter source facts without documenting the transformation.
- Handle duplicate, blank, or malformed Employee IDs explicitly. Do not create ambiguous accounts.
- Keep employee identity, reporting relationships, branch, role, and payroll data in fields that can be validated independently.
- Do not expose residential addresses, personal contact details, or other unnecessary personal information in general employee views.
- Apply access checks on the server/API and data-query layer. Hiding a button or tab is not an access-control mechanism.

### Initial passwords

Set the initial password for each imported employee account to the exact case-sensitive value:

`MotorPH-demo-2026`

This is an initial provisioning credential for testing the password-change flow. It must never be stored as plaintext in the database, logs, client code, or committed configuration.

Implement password storage with:

- A modern password-hashing algorithm, preferably Argon2id with an appropriate work factor for the deployment environment.
- A cryptographically random, unique salt for every account. Two employees who start with the same password must have different stored password hashes.
- A server-side pepper supplied through a protected environment variable or secret manager. Do not derive it from an Employee ID, email, name, birthday, location, timestamp, or other predictable/user-specific value. Never store the pepper beside the password hashes.
- A documented pepper-missing/start-up failure policy. Do not silently fall back to plaintext or a hard-coded pepper.
- Constant-time hash comparison through the selected password library.
- Rate limiting and sensible failed-login handling. Error messages must not reveal whether an Employee ID exists.

Set a `must_change_password` (or equivalent) flag for initially provisioned accounts and require the employee to choose a new password after the first successful login. Implement and test password changes, current-password verification, password policy validation, hash replacement, and session revocation/rotation. Do not display the shared initial password anywhere in the normal application interface.

## 7. Authentication and session management

Implement first-party Employee ID/password authentication and a server-validated session system. The following is the required behaviour; use a more efficient implementation where appropriate without weakening these guarantees.

### Session token

- Generate at least 32 cryptographically random bytes for each session token.
- Encode the token as an opaque URL-safe random string. It must not contain an Employee ID, timestamp, expiry, location, or other meaningful data.
- Send it to the browser in a cookie configured with `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Lax` or stricter where the application permits, and `Secure` in HTTPS deployments. Set a narrow, appropriate `Path` and avoid broad domain scope.
- Store only a one-way hash of the session token on the server where practical, together with the employee/account reference and session metadata. Never store or log the raw token.
- Use the project's existing database/persistence service if it can safely store and validate sessions. If a separate sessions table/collection is appropriate, use fields equivalent to `session_id_hash`, `user_id`, `created_at`, `last_active`, and `expires_at`.

### Expiry rules

- Idle timeout: 15 minutes without authenticated activity.
- Absolute timeout: 8 hours from session creation, regardless of activity.
- Check both limits on every protected server request. Expired sessions must be rejected and invalidated.
package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;

public final class CredentialStore {
    public static final int MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
    public static final Duration LOCK_FOR = Duration.ofMinutes(15);

    private final Map<String, Account> accounts = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final PasswordHasher hasher;
    private final Clock clock;

    public CredentialStore(PasswordHasher hasher) { this(hasher, Clock.systemDefaultZone()); }
    public CredentialStore(PasswordHasher hasher, Clock clock) {
        this.hasher = hasher;
        this.clock = clock;
    }

    
    public int provision(List<String> employeeIds) {
        int created = 0;
        for (String employeeId : employeeIds) {
            if (accounts.containsKey(employeeId)) continue;
            accounts.put(employeeId, new Account(employeeId, hasher.hash(PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial), true));
            created++;
        }
        return created;
    }

    public Map<String, Account> exportAccounts() {
        return new LinkedHashMap<>(accounts);
    }

    public void importAccounts(Map<String, Account> saved) {
        if (saved == null) return;
        for (Map.Entry<String, Account> entry : saved.entrySet()) {
            Account account = entry.getValue();
            if (entry.getKey() == null || account == null || !entry.getKey().equals(account.acc_sEid)
                || account.passwordHash() == null || !account.passwordHash().startsWith("argon2id$")) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid stored account");
            }
        }
        accounts.clear();
        accounts.putAll(saved);
    }

    public boolean has(String employeeId) { return employeeId != null && accounts.containsKey(employeeId); }
    public Optional<Account> account(String employeeId) { return Optional.ofNullable(accounts.get(employeeId)); }
    public int size() { return accounts.size(); }

    
    public static final class Result {
        public final boolean ok;
        public final Account account;
        public final String reason;          
        Result(boolean ok, Account account, String reason) { this.ok = ok; this.account = account; this.reason = reason; }
    }

    public Result signIn(String employeeId, String password) {
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        Account account = employeeId == null ? null : accounts.get(employeeId.trim());
        if (account == null) return new Result(false, null, "unknown");
        if (account.locked(now)) return new Result(false, account, "locked");
        if (!hasher.verify(password, account.passwordHash())) {
            account.recordFailure(MAX_ATTEMPTS, now, LOCK_FOR);
            return new Result(false, account, "password");
        }
        account.recordSuccess(now);
        
        if (hasher.needsRehash(account.passwordHash())) account.replaceHash(hasher.hash(password));
        return new Result(true, account, "");
    }

    
    public boolean changePassword(String employeeId, String currentPassword, String newPassword) {
        Account account = accounts.get(employeeId);
        if (account == null) return false;
        if (!hasher.verify(currentPassword, account.passwordHash())) return false;
        PasswordPolicy.requireAcceptable(newPassword);
        account.replaceHash(hasher.hash(newPassword));
        return true;
    }

    
    public boolean unlock(String employeeId) {
        Account account = accounts.get(employeeId);
        if (account == null) return false;
        account.unlock();
        return true;
    }

    public boolean resetToInitial(String employeeId) {
        Account account = accounts.get(employeeId);
        if (account == null) return false;
        account.resetHash(hasher.hash(PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial));
        return true;
    }

    
    public List<String> employeeIds() { return new ArrayList<>(accounts.keySet()); }
}

package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.util.Locale;

public final class PasswordPolicy {
    
    public static final String pw_sInitial = "MotorPH-demo-2026";

    
    public static final String pw_sPepperVar = "MOTORPH_PASSWORD_PEPPER";

    public static final int pw_iMinLen = 12;

    private PasswordPolicy() {}

    
    public static java.util.List<String> problems(String pw_sValue) {
        java.util.List<String> pw_lProblems = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        String pw_sClean = pw_sValue == null ? "" : pw_sValue;
        if (pw_sClean.length() < pw_iMinLen) pw_lProblems.add("Use at least " + pw_iMinLen + " characters.");
        if (pw_sClean.equalsIgnoreCase(pw_sInitial)) pw_lProblems.add("Choose a password other than the initial one.");
        boolean pw_bLetter = false, pw_bDigit = false, pw_bSymbol = false;
        for (char pw_c : pw_sClean.toCharArray()) {
            if (Character.isLetter(pw_c)) pw_bLetter = true;
            else if (Character.isDigit(pw_c)) pw_bDigit = true;
            else if (!Character.isWhitespace(pw_c)) pw_bSymbol = true;
        }
        if (!pw_bLetter) pw_lProblems.add("Include at least one letter.");
        if (!pw_bDigit) pw_lProblems.add("Include at least one digit.");
        if (!pw_bSymbol) pw_lProblems.add("Include at least one symbol.");
        if (pw_sClean.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("motorph")) pw_lProblems.add("Do not use the company name in the password.");
        return pw_lProblems;
    }

    public static void requireAcceptable(String pw_sValue) {
        java.util.List<String> pw_lProblems = problems(pw_sValue);
        if (!pw_lProblems.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException(String.join(" ", pw_lProblems));
    }
}
package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

/**
 * Two-step sign-in: a correct password opens a challenge, and only the right six-digit code opens a session.
 *
 * The code is shown on screen instead of being texted, because this deployment has no SMS gateway and the
 * accounts are provisioned in bulk. A real deployment swaps {@link #codeFor} for an SMS or TOTP sender and
 * nothing else about this class changes.
 *
 * Challenges live for the number of minutes the System Administrator sets, allow three wrong codes, and are
 * deleted the moment they are used, so a code never works twice.
 */
public final class TwoFactor {
    static final int MAX_TRIES = 3;
    private static final SecureRandom RANDOM = new SecureRandom();

    private static final class Challenge {
        final String employeeId, code;
        final Instant expires;
        int triesLeft = MAX_TRIES;

        Challenge(String employeeId, String code, Instant expires) {
            this.employeeId = employeeId;
            this.code = code;
            this.expires = expires;
        }
    }

    /** What the caller needs to show the code screen: which challenge, and where the code "went". */
    public static final class Started {
        public final String challengeId, code, employeeId;
        public final LocalDateTime expires;

        Started(String challengeId, String code, String employeeId, LocalDateTime expires) {
            this.challengeId = challengeId;
            this.code = code;
            this.employeeId = employeeId;
            this.expires = expires;
        }
    }

    private final Clock clock;
    private final Map<String, Challenge> challenges = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public TwoFactor(Clock clock) {
        this.clock = clock;
    }

    public Started start(String employeeId, String mobileEnding, int codeMinutes) {
        String id = token(16);
        String code = String.format("%06d", RANDOM.nextInt(1_000_000));
        Instant expires = clock.instant().plusSeconds(codeMinutes * 60L);
        challenges.put(id, new Challenge(employeeId, code, expires));
        return new Started(id, code, employeeId,
            LocalDateTime.ofInstant(expires, clock.getZone()));
    }

    /** The employee the code belongs to, or a refusal saying how many tries are left. */
    public String verify(String challengeId, String code) {
        Challenge challenge = challenges.get(challengeId == null ? "" : challengeId);
        if (challenge == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("That code request is over. Sign in again for a new code.");
        }
        if (!clock.instant().isBefore(challenge.expires)) {
            challenges.remove(challengeId);
            throw new IllegalStateException("That code expired. Sign in again for a new code.");
        }
        synchronized (challenge) {
            if (!challenge.code.equals(code == null ? "" : code.trim())) {
                challenge.triesLeft--;
                if (challenge.triesLeft <= 0) {
                    challenges.remove(challengeId);
                    throw new IllegalStateException("Wrong code three times. Sign in again for a new code.");
                }
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Wrong code; " + challenge.triesLeft + " tr"
                    + (challenge.triesLeft == 1 ? "y" : "ies") + " left.");
            }
        }
        challenges.remove(challengeId);
        return challenge.employeeId;
    }

    public Optional<String> pending(String challengeId) {
        Challenge challenge = challenges.get(challengeId);
        if (challenge == null) return Optional.empty();
        if (!clock.instant().isBefore(challenge.expires)) {
            challenges.remove(challengeId);
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        return Optional.of(challenge.employeeId);
    }

    /**
     * The code for a live challenge. This exists only because this deployment has no SMS gateway; a real one
     * would never hand the code back to the caller.
     */
    public Optional<String> peek(String challengeId) {

    public synchronized void changePassword(String employeeId, String current, String next, LocalDateTime now) {
        checkPassword(employeeId, current, now);
        String value = next == null ? "" : next;
        if (value.length() < settings.minPasswordLength || value.length() > 64) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("The new password must be " + settings.minPasswordLength + " to 64 characters.");
        }
        if (value.equals(current)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Choose a password different from the current one.");
        if (value.equals(DEFAULT_PASSWORD)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Choose a password other than the shared demo password.");
        Stored stored = new Stored();
        byte[] salt = new byte[16];
        RANDOM.nextBytes(salt);
        stored.salt = hex(salt);
        stored.hash = hex(hash(value, salt));
        stored.changedAt = now.toString();
        passwords.put(employeeId, stored);
    }

    
    public synchronized void resetPassword(String employeeId) {
        passwords.remove(employeeId);
        unlock(employeeId);
    }

    public synchronized void unlock(String employeeId) {
        failures.remove(employeeId);
        lockedUntil.remove(employeeId);
        if (nextTryAt != null) nextTryAt.remove(employeeId);
    }

    public synchronized boolean usesDefaultPassword(String employeeId) { return !passwords.containsKey(employeeId); }

    public synchronized Optional<String> passwordChangedAt(String employeeId) {
        return Optional.ofNullable(passwords.get(employeeId)).map(stored -> stored.changedAt);
    }

    public synchronized Optional<LocalDateTime> lockedUntil(String employeeId, LocalDateTime now) {
        String until = lockedUntil.get(employeeId);
        if (until == null) return Optional.empty();
        LocalDateTime time = LocalDateTime.parse(until);
        if (!now.isBefore(time)) {
            lockedUntil.remove(employeeId);
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        return Optional.of(time);
    }

    public synchronized int failedAttempts(String employeeId) { return failures.getOrDefault(employeeId, 0); }

    private boolean matches(String employeeId, String password) {
        String given = password == null ? "" : password;
        Stored stored = passwords.get(employeeId);
        if (stored == null) return MessageDigest.isEqual(given.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8), DEFAULT_PASSWORD.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        return MessageDigest.isEqual(hash(given, unhex(stored.salt)), unhex(stored.hash));
    }

    private static byte[] hash(String password, byte[] salt) {
        try {
            PBEKeySpec spec = new PBEKeySpec(password.toCharArray(), salt, ROUNDS, 256);
            return SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("PBKDF2WithHmacSHA256").generateSecret(spec).getEncoded();
        } catch (java.security.GeneralSecurityException ex) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Password hashing is unavailable.", ex);
        }
    }

    private static void range(int value, int min, int max, String label) {
        if (value < min || value > max) throw new IllegalArgumentException(label + " must be " + min + " to " + max + ".");
    }

public final class AccountSecurity {
    
    public static final String DEFAULT_PASSWORD = "MotorPH-demo-2026";
    
    private static final int ROUNDS = 20_000;
    private static final SecureRandom RANDOM = new SecureRandom();

    
    public static final class TooSoon extends RuntimeException {
        TooSoon(String message) { super(message); }
    }

    public static final class Settings {
        public int minPasswordLength = 8, maxFailedAttempts = 5, lockoutMinutes = 15, codeMinutes = 5, sessionHours = 8;
        public String updatedBy = "", updatedAt = "";
    }

    private static final class Stored {
        String salt, hash, changedAt;
    }

    private Settings settings = new Settings();
    private final Map<String, Stored> passwords = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, Integer> failures = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, String> lockedUntil = new HashMap<>();
    
    private transient Map<String, java.time.Instant> nextTryAt = new HashMap<>();

    
    static long waitSeconds(int failedInARow) {
        return failedInARow < 2 ? 0 : 1L << Math.min(failedInARow - 2, 6);
    }

    public synchronized Settings settings() {
        Settings copy = new Settings();
        copy.minPasswordLength = settings.minPasswordLength;
        copy.maxFailedAttempts = settings.maxFailedAttempts;
        copy.lockoutMinutes = settings.lockoutMinutes;
        copy.codeMinutes = settings.codeMinutes;
        copy.sessionHours = settings.sessionHours;
        copy.updatedBy = settings.updatedBy;
        copy.updatedAt = settings.updatedAt;
        return copy;
    }

    public synchronized void updateSettings(int minLength, int maxFailed, int lockoutMinutes, int codeMinutes, int sessionHours, String by, String at) {
        range(minLength, 8, 64, "Minimum password length");
        range(maxFailed, 3, 10, "Wrong passwords before lockout");
        range(lockoutMinutes, 5, 120, "Lockout minutes");
        range(codeMinutes, 1, 10, "2FA code minutes");
        range(sessionHours, 1, 24, "Session hours");
        settings.minPasswordLength = minLength;
        settings.maxFailedAttempts = maxFailed;
        settings.lockoutMinutes = lockoutMinutes;
        settings.codeMinutes = codeMinutes;
        settings.sessionHours = sessionHours;
        settings.updatedBy = by;
        settings.updatedAt = at;
    }

    
    public synchronized void checkPassword(String employeeId, String password, LocalDateTime now) {
        Optional<LocalDateTime> locked = lockedUntil(employeeId, now);
        if (locked.isPresent()) throw new IllegalStateException("This account is locked until " + locked.get().toLocalTime() + " after too many wrong passwords.");
        if (nextTryAt == null) nextTryAt = new HashMap<>();
        java.time.Instant allowed = nextTryAt.get(employeeId);
        if (allowed != null && java.time.Instant.now().isBefore(allowed)) {
            long seconds = Math.max(1, java.time.Duration.between(java.time.Instant.now(), allowed).getSeconds() + 1);
            throw new TooSoon("Too many wrong passwords in a row; wait " + seconds + " second" + (seconds == 1 ? "" : "s") + " before trying again.");
        }
        if (matches(employeeId, password)) {
            failures.remove(employeeId);
            nextTryAt.remove(employeeId);
            return;
        }
        int failed = failures.merge(employeeId, 1, Integer::sum);
        long wait = waitSeconds(failed);
        if (wait > 0) nextTryAt.put(employeeId, java.time.Instant.now().plusSeconds(wait));
        else nextTryAt.remove(employeeId);
        if (failed >= settings.maxFailedAttempts) {
            failures.remove(employeeId);
            nextTryAt.remove(employeeId);
            lockedUntil.put(employeeId, now.plusMinutes(settings.lockoutMinutes).toString());
            throw new IllegalStateException("Wrong password " + failed + " times: the account is locked for " + settings.lockoutMinutes + " minutes.");
        }
        int left = settings.maxFailedAttempts - failed;
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Wrong password; " + left + " tr" + (left == 1 ? "y" : "ies") + " left before the account locks"
            + (wait > 0 ? ", and wait " + wait + " second" + (wait == 1 ? "" : "s") + " before the next try." : "."));
    }

        checkPassword(employeeId, current, now);

        if (value.length() < settings.minPasswordLength || value.length() > 64) {

export function auditRows(entries) {
  return entries.map(entry => [entry.at.replace('T', ' '), entry.actor, `${entry.method} ${entry.path}`, entry.target || '—', String(entry.status)]);
}

export function accountSecurityText(account) {
  if (account.lockedUntil) return `Locked until ${account.lockedUntil.slice(11, 16)}`;
  const parts = [account.defaultPassword ? 'Initial password' : `Own password since ${account.passwordChangedAt.slice(0, 10)}`];
  if (account.failedAttempts) parts.push(`${account.failedAttempts} wrong recently`);
  return parts.join(' · ');
}

function fillRows(tbody, rows, columns, emptyText) {
  tbody.replaceChildren();
  if (!rows.length) {
    const row = document.createElement('tr');
    const cell = document.createElement('td');
    cell.colSpan = columns;
    cell.className = 'table-message';
    cell.textContent = emptyText;
    row.append(cell);
    tbody.append(row);
    return;
  }
  rows.forEach(values => {
    const row = document.createElement('tr');
    values.forEach(value => {
      const cell = document.createElement('td');
      if (value instanceof Node) cell.append(value);
      else cell.textContent = value;
      row.append(cell);
    });
    tbody.append(row);
  });
}

function actionButton(label, data) {
  const button = document.createElement('button');
  button.type = 'button';
  button.className = 'button button-quiet workflow-cancel';
  button.textContent = label;
  Object.assign(button.dataset, data);
  button.setAttribute('aria-label', `${label} ${data.employeeId || data.backup || ''}`.trim());
  return button;
}

export function initAdminSecurity(apiJson, getAccount) {
  if (!document.getElementById('security-form')) return { refresh() {} };
  const field = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const say = (id, message, isError = false) => {
    field(id).textContent = message;
    field(id).classList.toggle('payroll-preview-error', isError);
  };
  const isAdmin = () => (getAccount() || {}).role === 'ADMIN';

  async function refreshSecurity() {
    const { settings, accounts } = await apiJson('/api/admin/security');
    ['minPasswordLength', 'maxFailedAttempts', 'lockoutMinutes', 'codeMinutes', 'sessionHours'].forEach(key => { field(`security-${key}`).value = settings[key]; });
    const me = (getAccount() || {}).employeeId;
    fillRows(field('security-rows'), accounts.map(account => {
      const actions = document.createElement('span');
      actions.className = 'workflow-row-actions';
      if (account.lockedUntil || account.failedAttempts) actions.append(actionButton('Unlock', { employeeId: account.employeeId, action: 'unlock' }));
      if (!account.defaultPassword && account.employeeId !== me) actions.append(actionButton('Reset password', { employeeId: account.employeeId, action: 'reset-password' }));
      return [`${account.employeeId} — ${account.name}`, accountSecurityText(account), actions.childElementCount ? actions : '—'];
    }), 3, 'No accounts.');
  }

  async function refreshPolicy() {
    const { policy, mentorDefaults } = await apiJson('/api/admin/payroll-policy');
    ['graceMinutes', 'hoursPerMonth', 'dailyHours', 'nightDifferentialPercent'].forEach(key => { field(`policy-${key}`).value = policy[key]; });
    say('policy-status', mentorDefaults ? 'These are the mentor’s rules (10-minute grace, ÷168, 8 paid hours, 10% night differential).'
      : `Changed by ${policy.updatedBy} at ${policy.updatedAt.replace('T', ' ')}; this is no longer the mentor's rules.`);
  }

  async function refreshAudit() {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ limit: '200' });
    if (field('audit-actor').value.trim()) params.set('actor', field('audit-actor').value.trim());
    if (field('audit-path').value.trim()) params.set('path', field('audit-path').value.trim());
    if (field('audit-failures').checked) params.set('failures', 'true');
    const payload = await apiJson(`/api/admin/audit?${params}`);
    fillRows(field('audit-rows'), auditRows(payload.entries), 5, 'No matching audit entries.');
    say('audit-status', `Showing ${payload.entries.length} of ${payload.kept} kept entries${payload.archives.length ? `; ${payload.archives.length} older batch(es) archived in data/archive` : ''}.`);
  }

  async function refreshBackups() {

    const select = field('restore-name');
    select.replaceChildren(...payload.backups.map(name => new Option(name, name)));
    fillRows(field('backup-rows'), payload.backups.map(name => [name]), 1,
      payload.persistence === 'memory'
        ? 'This server keeps data in memory only, so there are no backups.'
        : payload.persistence === 'firestore'
          ? 'Data lives in Firestore; open the Firebase console to inspect or export it.'
          : 'No backups yet.');
  }

/**
 * The same state document the file backend writes, stored in Firestore instead.
 *
 * Firestore caps a document at 1 MiB and the attendance store alone is ~940 KB, so the
 * stores are split across documents rather than kept in one blob:
 *
 *   objects/{storeName}        one document per store, for the small ones
 *   chunks/{store}_0000        a slice of an oversized store, joined back on load
 *
 * Every value is stored as a JSON string inside a single field. That keeps Firestore's
 * typed-value encoding out of the picture entirely -- what comes back is byte-identical
 * to what went in, so the pinned @SerializedName keys keep working untouched.
 */
public final class FirestoreStateStore implements StateStore {

    private static final int FORMAT_VERSION = 1;
    // Leave room for non-ASCII UTF-8 and never split a surrogate pair.
    private static final int CHUNK_CHARS = 200_000;
    private static final String ROOT = "motorphState";
    // Firestore document paths must alternate collection/document, so a chunk cannot live at
    // motorphState/chunks/{id} (three segments after documents, which it rejects with
    // "lacks / at index N"). Chunks therefore live in their own top-level collection.
    private static final String CHUNKS = "motorphStateChunks";

    private final FirestoreRestClient fs_client;
    private boolean observedMeta, metaExists;
    private String metaUpdateTime;
    private final java.util.Map<String, String> cachedChunks = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final Gson fs_gson = new GsonBuilder()
        .registerTypeAdapter(LocalDate.class, text(LocalDate::parse))
        .registerTypeAdapter(LocalTime.class, text(LocalTime::parse))
        .registerTypeAdapter(LocalDateTime.class, text(LocalDateTime::parse))
    private static final int PARALLELISM = 1;
    private static final int HASH_BYTES = 32;
    private static final int SALT_BYTES = 16;
    private static final SecureRandom RANDOM = new SecureRandom();

    private final byte[] pepperBytes;

    public PasswordHasher(String pepper) {
        if (pepper == null || pepper.trim().length() < 32) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(PasswordPolicy.pw_sPepperVar + " must be set to at least 32 characters; "
                + "refusing to start with a weak or missing pepper.");
        }
        this.pepperBytes = pepper.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    
    public String hash(String password) {
        byte[] salt = new byte[SALT_BYTES];
        RANDOM.nextBytes(salt);
        byte[] digest = derive(password, salt, MEMORY_KIB, ITERATIONS, PARALLELISM);
        Base64.Encoder b64 = Base64.getEncoder().withoutPadding();
        return "argon2id$v=" + VERSION
            + "$m=" + MEMORY_KIB + ",t=" + ITERATIONS + ",p=" + PARALLELISM
            + "$" + b64.encodeToString(salt)
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import ph.motorph.o_oop.FirestoreRestClient;

/**
 * Moves the whole state document between data/local-demo.json and Firestore.
 *
 *   java tools/FirestoreSync.java upload            copy the local file up
 *   java tools/FirestoreSync.java download          replace the local file from Firestore
 *   java tools/FirestoreSync.java diff              show what each side holds, change nothing
 *
 * Requires FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID and Application Default Credentials. An optional
 * MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_TOKEN overrides ADC but does not refresh. Run with the app
 * classpath as documented in docs/firebase-setup-guide.md.
 */
public final class FirestoreSync {

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        String action = args.length == 0 ? "diff" : args[0].toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
        if ("upload".equals(action) && (args.length < 2 || !"UPLOAD".equals(args[1]))) {
            System.err.println("Upload replaces Firestore. Stop the server, back up first, and pass UPLOAD to confirm.");
            System.exit(2);
        }
        if ("download".equals(action) && (args.length < 2 || !"REPLACE".equals(args[1]))) {
            System.err.println("Download replaces the local file. Back up first, and pass REPLACE to confirm.");
            System.exit(2);
        }
        String projectId = env("FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID");
        String token = env("MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_TOKEN");
        String uid = env("MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_UID");
        Path localPath = Paths.get(System.getenv().getOrDefault("LOCAL_DATA_FILE", "data/local-demo.json"));

        if (projectId.isEmpty()) {
            System.err.println("Set FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID and configure Application Default Credentials first.");
            System.exit(2);
        }
        if (uid.isEmpty()) uid = "server";
        StateStore local = new LocalStateFile(localPath);
        FirestoreRestClient client = token.isEmpty()
            ? FirestoreRestClient.applicationDefault(projectId, uid, null)
            : new FirestoreRestClient(projectId, uid, token);
        StateStore remote = new FirestoreStateStore(client);

        switch (action) {
            case "diff":
                report("local", local);
                report("firestore", remote);
                break;
            case "upload": {
                FirestoreSeedService.UploadResult result = new FirestoreSeedService(local, remote).uploadAll();
                System.out.println("Uploaded " + result.getEmployeeCount() + " employees and "
                    + result.getAttendanceCount() + " attendance rows to Firestore.");
                break;
            }
            case "download": {
                FirestoreSeedService.UploadResult result = new FirestoreSeedService(local, remote).downloadAll();
                System.out.println("Replaced the local file with " + result.getEmployeeCount() + " employees and "
                    + result.getAttendanceCount() + " attendance rows from Firestore.");
                break;
            }
            default:
                System.out.println("Usage: java tools/FirestoreSync.java [diff|upload UPLOAD|download REPLACE]");
                System.exit(1);
        }
    }

    private static void report(String label, StateStore store) throws Exception {
        java.util.Optional<JsonObject> state = store.load();
        if (state.isEmpty()) {
            System.out.printf("%-10s empty%n", label);
            return;
        }
        JsonObject stores = state.get();
        int employees = 0, attendance = 0;
        if (stores.has("employees") && stores.getAsJsonObject("employees").has("employees")) {
            employees = stores.getAsJsonObject("employees").getAsJsonObject("employees").size();
        }
        if (stores.has("attendance") && stores.getAsJsonObject("attendance").has("records")) {
            attendance = stores.getAsJsonObject("attendance").getAsJsonArray("records").size();
        }
        System.out.printf("%-10s %d employees, %d attendance rows, %d stores%n", label, employees, attendance, stores.size());
    }

    private static String env(String name) {
        String value = System.getenv(name);
        return value == null ? "" : value.trim();
    }
}

package ph.motorph.o_oop;

import com.google.gson.Gson;
import com.google.gson.GsonBuilder;
import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.time.YearMonth;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

/**
 * The same state document the file backend writes, stored in Firestore instead.
 *
 * Firestore caps a document at 1 MiB and the attendance store alone is ~940 KB, so the
 * stores are split across documents rather than kept in one blob:
 *
 *   motorphState/_meta and _index        snapshot metadata and chunk counts
 *   motorphStateChunks/{store}_0000      a slice of one store, joined back on load
 *
 * Every value is stored as a JSON string inside a single field. That keeps Firestore's
 * typed-value encoding out of the picture entirely -- what comes back is byte-identical
 * to what went in, so the pinned @SerializedName keys keep working untouched.
 */
public final class FirestoreStateStore implements StateStore {

    private static final int FORMAT_VERSION = 1;
    // Leave room for non-ASCII UTF-8 and never split a surrogate pair.
    private static final int CHUNK_CHARS = 200_000;
    private static final String ROOT = "motorphState";
    // Firestore document paths must alternate collection/document, so a chunk cannot live at
    // motorphState/chunks/{id} (three segments after documents, which it rejects with
    // "lacks / at index N"). Chunks therefore live in their own top-level collection.
    private static final String CHUNKS = "motorphStateChunks";

    private final FirestoreRestClient fs_client;
    private boolean observedMeta, metaExists;
    private String metaUpdateTime;
    private final java.util.Map<String, String> cachedChunks = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final Gson fs_gson = new GsonBuilder()
        .registerTypeAdapter(LocalDate.class, text(LocalDate::parse))
        .registerTypeAdapter(LocalTime.class, text(LocalTime::parse))
        .registerTypeAdapter(LocalDateTime.class, text(LocalDateTime::parse))
        .registerTypeAdapter(YearMonth.class, text(YearMonth::parse))
        .disableHtmlEscaping()
        .create();

    public FirestoreStateStore(FirestoreRestClient fs_client) {
        this.fs_client = fs_client;
    }

    private interface Parser<T> { T apply(String value); }

    private static <T> com.google.gson.TypeAdapter<T> text(Parser<T> parse) {
        return new com.google.gson.TypeAdapter<T>() {
            @Override public void write(com.google.gson.stream.JsonWriter out, T value) throws IOException {
                if (value == null) { out.nullValue(); return; }
                out.value(value.toString());
            }
            @Override public T read(com.google.gson.stream.JsonReader in) throws IOException {
                if (in.peek() == com.google.gson.stream.JsonToken.NULL) { in.nextNull(); return null; }
                return parse.apply(in.nextString());
            }
        }.nullSafe();
    }

    @Override public Gson gson() { return fs_gson; }

    @Override public String backend() { return "firestore"; }

    @Override public String describe() { return "Firestore (" + ROOT + " collection)"; }

    @Override public Optional<JsonObject> load() throws IOException {
        JsonObject meta = readObject("_meta");
        if (meta == null) return Optional.empty();
        int format = meta.has("format") ? meta.get("format").getAsInt() : FORMAT_VERSION;
        if (format != FORMAT_VERSION) throw new IOException("Unknown Firestore state format: " + format);

        String loadedVersion = metaUpdateTime;
        java.util.Map<String, String> loadedChunks = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
        JsonObject stores = new JsonObject();
        JsonObject index = readObject("_index");
        if (index == null) return Optional.of(stores);

        for (String storeName : index.keySet()) {
            int chunks = index.get(storeName).getAsInt();
            StringBuilder joined = new StringBuilder();
            for (int part = 0; part < chunks; part++) {
                JsonObject chunk = readObject("chunks/" + storeName + "_" + String.format("%04d", part));
                if (chunk == null || !chunk.has("json")) {
                    throw new IOException("Firestore state is missing chunk " + part + " of " + storeName);
                }
                String value = chunk.get("json").getAsString();
                loadedChunks.put(storeName + "_" + String.format("%04d", part), value);
                joined.append(value);
            }
            stores.add(storeName, JsonParser.parseString(joined.toString()));
        }
        if (loadedVersion != null) {
            readObject("_meta");
            if (!loadedVersion.equals(metaUpdateTime))
                throw new IOException("Firestore changed during loading; restart and try again.");
        }
        cachedChunks.clear();
        cachedChunks.putAll(loadedChunks);
        return Optional.of(stores);
    }

    @Override public synchronized void save(JsonObject stores) throws IOException {
        if (!observedMeta) readObject("_meta");
        JsonObject previousIndex = readObject("_index");
        JsonObject index = new JsonObject();
        java.util.Map<String, JsonObject> updates = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
        java.util.List<String> deletes = new ArrayList<>();
        java.util.Map<String, String> nextChunks = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (String storeName : stores.keySet()) {
            String json = fs_gson.toJson(stores.get(storeName));
            int from = 0, part = 0;
            do {
                int to = Math.min(json.length(), from + CHUNK_CHARS);
                if (to < json.length() && to > from && Character.isHighSurrogate(json.charAt(to - 1))) to--;
                String id = storeName + "_" + String.format("%04d", part++);
                String value = json.substring(from, to);
                nextChunks.put(id, value);
                if (!value.equals(cachedChunks.get(id)))
                    updates.put(CHUNKS + "/" + id, typedFields(single("json", value)));
                from = to;
            } while (from < json.length());
            index.addProperty(storeName, part);
        }
        if (previousIndex != null) for (String name : previousIndex.keySet()) {
            int previous = previousIndex.get(name).getAsInt();
            int current = index.has(name) ? index.get(name).getAsInt() : 0;
            for (int part = current; part < previous; part++)
                deletes.add(CHUNKS + "/" + name + "_" + String.format("%04d", part));
        }
        updates.put(ROOT + "/_index", typedFields(index));
        updates.put(ROOT + "/_meta", typedFields(meta(Instant.now().toString())));
        int metaResultIndex = updates.size() - 1;
        JsonObject result = fs_client.commitDocuments(updates, deletes, ROOT + "/_meta", metaUpdateTime, metaExists);
        JsonArray results = result.has("writeResults") ? result.getAsJsonArray("writeResults") : new JsonArray();
        if (results.size() > metaResultIndex && results.get(metaResultIndex).getAsJsonObject().has("updateTime")) {
            metaUpdateTime = results.get(metaResultIndex).getAsJsonObject().get("updateTime").getAsString();
            metaExists = true;
        } else {
            observedMeta = false;
            readObject("_meta");
        }
        cachedChunks.clear();
        cachedChunks.putAll(nextChunks);
    }

    private JsonObject typedFields(JsonObject flat) {
        JsonObject typed = new JsonObject();
        for (String key : flat.keySet()) {
            JsonObject value = new JsonObject();
            JsonElement raw = flat.get(key);
            if (raw.getAsJsonPrimitive().isNumber()) value.addProperty("integerValue", raw.getAsLong());
            else value.addProperty("stringValue", raw.getAsString());
            typed.add(key, value);
        }
        return typed;
    }

    @Override public synchronized String backupNow(String reason) throws IOException {
        JsonObject state = load().orElseThrow(() -> new IOException("There is no state to back up."));
        String name = "backup-" + System.currentTimeMillis() + "-" + java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "");
        JsonObject index = new JsonObject();
        java.util.Map<String, JsonObject> updates = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (String store : state.keySet()) {
            String json = fs_gson.toJson(state.get(store));
            int from = 0, part = 0;
            do {
                int to = Math.min(json.length(), from + CHUNK_CHARS);
                if (to < json.length() && to > from && Character.isHighSurrogate(json.charAt(to - 1))) to--;
                String id = name + "_" + store + "_" + String.format("%04d", part++);
                updates.put("motorphBackupChunks/" + id, typedFields(single("json", json.substring(from, to))));
                from = to;
            } while (from < json.length());
            index.addProperty(store, part);
        }
        JsonObject header = new JsonObject();
        header.addProperty("index", fs_gson.toJson(index));
        header.addProperty("reason", reason == null ? "manual" : reason);
        header.addProperty("savedAt", Instant.now().toString());
        updates.put("motorphBackups/" + name, typedFields(header));
        fs_client.commitDocuments(updates, new ArrayList<>(), null, null, false);
        return name;
    }

    @Override public synchronized List<String> listBackups() throws IOException {
        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JsonObject doc : fs_client.listDocuments("motorphBackups")) {
            if (!doc.has("name")) continue;
            String path = doc.get("name").getAsString();
            String name = path.substring(path.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
            if (name.matches("backup-[0-9]+-[0-9a-f]{32}")) names.add(name);
        }
        names.sort(java.util.Collections.reverseOrder());
        return names;
    }

    @Override public synchronized JsonObject loadBackup(String name) throws IOException {
        if (name == null || !name.matches("backup-[0-9]+-[0-9a-f]{32}")) throw new IOException("Invalid backup name.");
        JsonObject header = readFlat("motorphBackups", name);
        if (header == null || !header.has("index")) throw new IOException("Backup not found.");
        JsonObject index = JsonParser.parseString(header.get("index").getAsString()).getAsJsonObject();
        JsonObject state = new JsonObject();
        for (String store : index.keySet()) {
            int count = index.get(store).getAsInt();
            StringBuilder joined = new StringBuilder();
            for (int part = 0; part < count; part++) {
                JsonObject chunk = readFlat("motorphBackupChunks", name + "_" + store + "_" + String.format("%04d", part));
                if (chunk == null || !chunk.has("json")) throw new IOException("Backup is missing a data chunk.");
                joined.append(chunk.get("json").getAsString());
            }
            state.add(store, JsonParser.parseString(joined.toString()));
        }
        return state;
    }

    @Override public synchronized String writeArchive(String prefix, JsonElement content) throws IOException {
        String name = "archive-" + System.currentTimeMillis() + "-" + java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "");
        java.util.Map<String, JsonObject> updates = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
        updates.put("motorphArchives/" + name, typedFields(single("json", fs_gson.toJson(content))));
        fs_client.commitDocuments(updates, new ArrayList<>(), null, null, false);
        return name;
    }

    private JsonObject readFlat(String collection, String id) throws IOException {
        JsonObject raw = fs_client.getDocument(collection, id);
        if (raw == null) return null;
        JsonObject fields = raw.has("fields") ? raw.getAsJsonObject("fields") : new JsonObject();
        JsonObject result = new JsonObject();
        for (String key : fields.keySet()) {
            JsonObject typed = fields.getAsJsonObject(key);
            if (typed.has("stringValue")) result.addProperty(key, typed.get("stringValue").getAsString());
            else if (typed.has("integerValue")) result.addProperty(key, typed.get("integerValue").getAsLong());
        }
        return result;
    }

    private JsonObject meta(String savedAt) {
        JsonObject object = new JsonObject();
        object.addProperty("format", FORMAT_VERSION);
        object.addProperty("savedAt", savedAt);
        return object;
    }

    private JsonObject single(String field, String value) {
        JsonObject object = new JsonObject();
        object.addProperty(field, value);
        return object;
        return object;
    }

    private JsonObject readObject(String documentId) throws IOException {
        String path = ROOT;
        String id = documentId;
        if (documentId.startsWith("chunks/")) {
            path = CHUNKS;
            id = documentId.substring("chunks/".length());
        }
        JsonObject raw = fs_client.getDocument(path, id);
        if ("_meta".equals(documentId)) {
            observedMeta = true;
            metaExists = raw != null;
            metaUpdateTime = raw != null && raw.has("updateTime") ? raw.get("updateTime").getAsString() : null;
        }
        if (raw == null) return null;
        JsonObject fields = raw.has("fields") ? raw.getAsJsonObject("fields") : new JsonObject();
        JsonObject flat = new JsonObject();
        for (String key : fields.keySet()) {
            JsonObject typed = fields.getAsJsonObject(key);
            if (typed.has("stringValue")) flat.addProperty(key, typed.get("stringValue").getAsString());
            else if (typed.has("integerValue")) flat.addProperty(key, typed.get("integerValue").getAsLong());
        }
        return flat;
    }

    private void writeObject(String documentId, JsonObject flat) throws IOException {
        JsonObject typed = new JsonObject();
        for (String key : flat.keySet()) {
            JsonObject value = new JsonObject();
            JsonElement raw = flat.get(key);
            if (raw.getAsJsonPrimitive().isNumber()) value.addProperty("integerValue", raw.getAsLong());
            else value.addProperty("stringValue", raw.getAsString());
            typed.add(key, value);
        }
        String path = ROOT;
        String id = documentId;
        if (documentId.startsWith("chunks/")) {
            path = CHUNKS;
            id = documentId.substring("chunks/".length());
        }
        if (!fs_client.setDocument(path, id, typed)) {
            throw new IOException("Firestore refused to write " + documentId);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Chunk ids are positional, so a store that shrinks from three chunks to one leaves
     * orphans behind. Delete the tail so the console shows exactly what is live.
     */
    private void pruneStaleChunks(JsonObject previous, JsonObject index) throws IOException {
        if (previous == null) return;
        for (String storeName : previous.keySet()) {
            int was = previous.get(storeName).getAsInt();
            int now = index.has(storeName) ? index.get(storeName).getAsInt() : 0;
            for (int part = now; part < was; part++) {
                fs_client.deleteDocument(CHUNKS, storeName + "_" + String.format("%04d", part));
            }
        }
    }
}

import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.URI;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.net.http.HttpClient;
import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public final class FirestoreRestClient {
    private static final String API_ROOT = "https://firestore.googleapis.com/v1/projects/";
    private static final HttpClient HTTP = HttpClient.newBuilder()
        .connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(10)).build();

    private final String apiRoot;
    private final String projectId;
    private final String userId;
    public interface TokenSource {
        String token() throws IOException;
        default boolean refresh() throws IOException { return false; }
    }
    private final TokenSource tokenSource;

    public FirestoreRestClient(String projectId, String userId, String idToken) {
        this(projectId, userId, idToken, API_ROOT);
    }

    
    public FirestoreRestClient(String projectId, String userId, String idToken, String apiRoot) {
        this(projectId, userId, fixedToken(idToken), apiRoot);
    }

    private static TokenSource fixedToken(String token) {
        if (token == null || token.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("A Firestore token is required");
        String value = token.trim();
        return () -> value;
    }

    public FirestoreRestClient(String projectId, String userId, TokenSource tokenSource, String apiRoot) {
        this.projectId = requireSafeSegment(projectId, "project id");
        this.userId = requireSafeSegment(userId, "user id");
        if (tokenSource == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Firestore credentials are required");
        if (apiRoot == null || apiRoot.trim().isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("API root must not be blank");
        this.tokenSource = tokenSource;
        this.apiRoot = apiRoot.trim().endsWith("/") ? apiRoot.trim() : apiRoot.trim() + "/";
    }

    public static FirestoreRestClient applicationDefault(String projectId, String userId, String apiRoot) throws IOException {
        return new FirestoreRestClient(projectId, userId, new GoogleAccessToken(), apiRoot == null ? API_ROOT : apiRoot);
    }

    public List<JsonObject> listDocuments(String collectionPath) {
        List<JsonObject> documents = new ArrayList<>();
        String pageToken = "";
        do {
            String url = documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "?pageSize=1000" + pageToken;
            JsonObject response = send("GET", url, null, false);
            JsonArray items = response.has("documents") ? response.getAsJsonArray("documents") : new JsonArray();
            for (JsonElement item : items) documents.add(item.getAsJsonObject());
            pageToken = response.has("nextPageToken")
                ? "&pageToken=" + queryEncode(response.get("nextPageToken").getAsString()) : "";
        } while (!pageToken.isEmpty());
        return documents;
    }

    public boolean createDocument(String collectionPath, String documentId, JsonObject fields) {
        String url = documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "?documentId=" + queryEncode(requireSafeSegment(documentId, "document id"));
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.add("fields", fields);
        return send("POST", url, body, true).has("name");
    }

    /** Reads one document by id, or null when it does not exist. Never lists the collection. */
    public JsonObject getDocument(String collectionPath, String documentId) {
        String url = documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "/" + pathEncode(requireSafeSegment(documentId, "document id"));
        try {
            return send("GET", url, null, false);
        } catch (FirestoreException ex) {
            if (ex.getStatusCode() == 404) return null;
            throw ex;
        }
    }

    /** Writes one document, creating it or overwriting the given fields. */
    public boolean setDocument(String collectionPath, String documentId, JsonObject fields) {
        if (fields == null || fields.size() == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("document fields must not be empty");
        return updateDocument(collectionPath, documentId, fields, new ArrayList<>(fields.keySet()));
    }

    public boolean updateDocument(String collectionPath, String documentId, JsonObject fields, List<String> updateMask) {
        if (fields == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("document fields must not be null");
        if (updateMask == null || updateMask.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("update mask must not be empty");
        StringBuilder url = new StringBuilder(documentsUrl(collectionPath))
            .append('/').append(pathEncode(requireSafeSegment(documentId, "document id")));
        for (String field : updateMask) {
            String safeField = requireSafeSegment(field, "update field");
            url.append(url.indexOf("?") < 0 ? "?" : "&")
                .append("updateMask.fieldPaths=").append(queryEncode(safeField));
        }
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.add("fields", fields);
        return send("PATCH", url.toString(), body, false).has("name");
    }

    /** Deletes one document. Missing documents count as already deleted. */
    public boolean deleteDocument(String collectionPath, String documentId) {
        String url = documentsUrl(collectionPath) + "/" + pathEncode(requireSafeSegment(documentId, "document id"));
        try {
            send("DELETE", url, null, false);
            return true;
        } catch (FirestoreException ex) {
            if (ex.getStatusCode() == 404) return true;
            throw ex;
        }
    }

    public JsonObject commitDocuments(java.util.Map<String, JsonObject> updates, java.util.List<String> deletes,
            String guardedPath, String expectedUpdateTime, boolean expectedExists) {
        JsonArray writes = new JsonArray();
        String root = "projects/" + projectId + "/databases/(default)/documents/";
        for (java.util.Map.Entry<String, JsonObject> entry : updates.entrySet()) {
            JsonObject document = new JsonObject();
            document.addProperty("name", root + entry.getKey());
            document.add("fields", entry.getValue());
            JsonObject write = new JsonObject();
            write.add("update", document);
            if (entry.getKey().equals(guardedPath)) {
                JsonObject condition = new JsonObject();
                if (expectedUpdateTime != null && !expectedUpdateTime.isEmpty()) condition.addProperty("updateTime", expectedUpdateTime);
                else condition.addProperty("exists", expectedExists);
                write.add("currentDocument", condition);
            }
            writes.add(write);
        }
        for (String name : deletes) {
            JsonObject write = new JsonObject();
            write.addProperty("delete", root + name);
            writes.add(write);
        }
        JsonObject body = new JsonObject();
        body.add("writes", writes);
        if (body.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8).length > 9_500_000)
            throw new FirestoreException("The state is too large for one atomic Firestore commit.", 413);
        return send("POST", apiRoot + pathEncode(projectId) + "/databases/(default)/documents:commit", body, false);
    }

    public String userCollection(String collectionName) {
        return "users/" + userId + "/" + requireSafeSegment(collectionName, "collection name");
    }

    private JsonObject send(String method, String url, JsonObject body, boolean allowExisting) {
        return send(method, url, body, allowExisting, false);
    }

    private JsonObject send(String method, String url, JsonObject body, boolean allowExisting, boolean retried) {
        try {
            HttpRequest.Builder builder = HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create(url))
                .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(20))
                .header("Accept", "application/json");
            String token = tokenSource.token();
            if (token != null && !token.isEmpty()) builder.header("Authorization", "Bearer " + token);
            if (body != null) {
                builder.header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
                    .method(method, HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(body.toString(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            } else {
                builder.method(method, HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.noBody());
            }
            HttpResponse<String> response = HTTP.send(builder.build(), HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            if (response.statusCode() == 401 && !retried && tokenSource.refresh())
                return send(method, url, body, allowExisting, true);
            if (allowExisting && (response.statusCode() == 409 || response.statusCode() == 400)
                && response.body() != null && response.body().contains("ALREADY_EXISTS")) {
                return new JsonObject();
            }
            if (response.statusCode() < 200 || response.statusCode() >= 300) {
                throw firestoreError(response.statusCode(), response.body());
            }
            String responseBody = response.body();
            return responseBody == null || responseBody.trim().isEmpty()
                ? new JsonObject() : JsonParser.parseString(responseBody).getAsJsonObject();
        } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            throw new FirestoreException("Firestore request was interrupted.", 503);
        } catch (IOException | IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            throw new FirestoreException("Could not reach Firestore. Check the network and project setup.", 503);
        }
    }

    private String documentsUrl(String collectionPath) {
        StringBuilder path = new StringBuilder(apiRoot)
            .append(pathEncode(projectId)).append("/databases/(default)/documents");
        for (String segment : collectionPath.split("/")) {
            path.append('/').append(pathEncode(requireSafeSegment(segment, "path segment")));
        }
        return path.toString();
    }

    private static String requireSafeSegment(String value, String label) {
        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty() || value.contains("/")) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(label + " must be a non-empty path segment");
        }
        return value.trim();
    }

    private static String pathEncode(String value) {
        return URLEncoder.encode(value, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).replace("+", "%20");
    }

    private static String queryEncode(String value) {
        return URLEncoder.encode(value, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    private static FirestoreException firestoreError(int status, String body) {
        String message = "Firestore request failed (HTTP " + status + ").";
        if (status == 401) message = "Google credentials were rejected. Check the server identity and Firestore permissions.";
        else if (status == 403) message = "Firestore denied this request. Publish the scoped development rules in docs/firestore.rules, then retry.";
        else if (status == 404) message = "Firestore database or requested resource was not found. Check the Firebase project and database setup.";
        else if (status == 409 || status == 400) message = "A demo record could not be created. Refresh the page and try again.";
        return new FirestoreException(message, status);
    }
}
package ph.motorph.o_oop;

import com.google.gson.Gson;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

/**
 * Where the whole application state lives between requests.
 *
 * Two backends implement it: {@code LocalStateFile} writes one JSON file on disk,
 * {@code FirestoreStateStore} writes the same shape to Firestore. AppServer only ever
 * talks to this interface, so switching is an env-var decision, not a code change.
 */
public interface StateStore {

    Optional<JsonObject> load() throws IOException;

    void save(JsonObject stores) throws IOException;

    Gson gson();

    String describe();

    /** Short key the web UI shows: memory, file or firestore. */
    default String backend() { return "file"; }

    default List<String> listBackups() throws IOException { return new java.util.ArrayList<>(); }

    default JsonObject loadBackup(String name) throws IOException {
        throw new IOException("This state store keeps no backups.");
    }

    default String backupNow(String reason) throws IOException {
        throw new IOException("This state store keeps no backups.");
    }

    default String writeArchive(String prefix, com.google.gson.JsonElement content) throws IOException {
        throw new IOException("This state store keeps no archives.");
    }

    default String backupFolder() { return ""; }

    /** Where the state lives, for the startup banner. */
    default String location() { return describe(); }

    /**
     * A file that could not be parsed is moved aside so the server can start empty. A remote
     * store has nothing to move, so it reports where the unreadable copy was left instead.
     */
    /** Moves unreadable state out of the way. Remote stores have nothing to move: return null. */
    default String setAside() throws IOException {
        return null;
    }
}
# Current status

## Work completed

- Firestore uses server-side Application Default Credentials with refresh rather than an employee-held token. Writes are synchronous atomic commits with a stale-writer precondition; failed/ambiguous writes stop further writes. Manual backup/list/restore and audit archive writes are supported. See [Firestore setup](../firebase-setup-guide.md) for the required pepper, IAM, limits and recovery precautions.
- Password hashes, account locks and changes persist. Protected APIs require server sessions; first-login password changes are enforced. Logout and admin password reset revoke the appropriate sessions. Restore/reset revoke sessions and rebuild identity from the imported roster, roles and reporting lines. Newly created and HR-onboarded employees receive accounts.
- The admin account-security panel now reads the actual credential state. Its limits are explicitly read-only because the earlier editable settings did not change the authentication service. Unlock and reset operate on the actual credentials.
- My Pay has a MotorPH/reference switch available to employees. The reference is a separate fixed-2026-rate recalculation using the existing statutory engine, not the live Sweldong Pinoy service. It compares the same employee and month without changing payroll records. See [provenance and assumptions](data-provenance.md).

## Verification

The latest `sh test.sh` run passed **23 suites**, including **123 web unit tests** and five browser checks. `npm run lint:web` and `npm run build` passed. The built frontend's browser checks also passed against the official Firestore emulator with a `demo-motorph` project, including access controls, employee comparison, lock/unlock, backups, restore, revocation, onboarding, identity and payroll persistence across restart. This was an emulator test, not a test of cloud IAM, billing, availability or the current `motorph-jd` data.

## Remaining risks and work

- **Live data:** an earlier non-atomic writer was forcibly stopped; the current state of `motorph-jd` is unknown. Export and inspect it before writing or migrating. Do not overwrite it with the sample seed.
- **Not production-ready:** the initial password specified in the brief is shared and publicly known. Requiring its change does not protect an account before first sign-in. The displayed code is not an independent second factor; no secure channel has been configured. Production onboarding needs a secure individual bootstrap and credential recovery process, a security review, HTTPS and operational controls.
- **Scale and availability:** this is a single-instance full-snapshot architecture with in-memory sessions and an atomic request size limit; it is not a normalized, multi-instance database. Independent backup/export, retention, restore drills, monitoring and load tests are still needed. A timeout can leave a committed write with an uncertain response.
- **Payroll:** generated seed attendance is not actual history; there were 130 future-dated rows relative to 2026-11-02. The temporary 2026 rules and reference assumptions need review by qualified payroll personnel. Sweldong Pinoy's full current implementation has not been verified and the reference is not claimed to reproduce it exactly.
- **Dependencies:** npm reported 30 findings (10 high, 20 moderate); the direct flagged dependency is development tooling. Java dependencies require a separate vulnerability and license inventory. See [risk review](dependency-risk-review.md).
- Earlier audits and session notes are historical snapshots; they may describe defects that have since been fixed or make claims later corrected here. The full original brief, comprehensive security/accessibility review, complete source-comparison provenance, and production deployment acceptance have not all been independently verified.
