      say('security-status', error.message, true);
    }
  });

  field('security-rows').addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const button = event.target.closest('button[data-employee-id]');
    if (!button) return;
    try {
      await apiJson(`/api/admin/security/${encodeURIComponent(button.dataset.employeeId)}/${button.dataset.action}`, {});
      say('security-status', button.dataset.action === 'unlock' ? `${button.dataset.employeeId} unlocked.`
        : `${button.dataset.employeeId} is back on the initial password and signed out everywhere.`);
      await Promise.all([refreshSecurity(), refreshAudit()]);
    } catch (error) {
      say('security-status', error.message, true);
    }
  });

  field('policy-form').addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    try {
      const body = {};
      ['graceMinutes', 'hoursPerMonth', 'dailyHours', 'nightDifferentialPercent'].forEach(key => { body[key] = field(`policy-${key}`).value; });
      await apiJson('/api/admin/payroll-policy', body);
      await Promise.all([refreshPolicy(), refreshAudit()]);
    } catch (error) {
      say('policy-status', error.message, true);
    }
  });

  field('policy-defaults').addEventListener('click', () => {
    [['graceMinutes', 10], ['hoursPerMonth', 168], ['dailyHours', 8], ['nightDifferentialPercent', 10]].forEach(([key, value]) => { field(`policy-${key}`).value = value; });

async function payrollJson(url, body, method = 'POST') {
  const options = body === undefined
    ? { headers: await apiHeaders() }
    : { method, headers: await apiHeaders({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }), body: JSON.stringify(body) };
  const response = await fetch(url, options);
  const payload = await response.json();
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload.error || `Request failed (${response.status})`);
  if (payload.csrfToken) state.csrfToken = payload.csrfToken;
  return payload;
}

async function downloadWithSession(url, filename) {
  const response = await fetch(url, { headers: await apiHeaders({ Accept: '*/*' }) });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error((await response.json().catch(() => ({}))).error || `Download failed (${response.status})`);
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = URL.createObjectURL(await response.blob());
  link.download = filename;
  link.click();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href), 1000);
}

package ph.motorph.svc;

import com.sun.net.httpserver.Headers;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpContext;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpExchange;
import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpPrincipal;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.net.URI;

final class BufferedExchange extends HttpExchange {
    private final HttpExchange original;
    private final ByteArrayOutputStream body = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
    private int status = -1;
    private long length;

    BufferedExchange(HttpExchange original) { this.original = original; }
    @Override public Headers getRequestHeaders() { return original.getRequestHeaders(); }
    @Override public Headers getResponseHeaders() { return original.getResponseHeaders(); }
    @Override public URI getRequestURI() { return original.getRequestURI(); }
    @Override public String getRequestMethod() { return original.getRequestMethod(); }
    @Override public HttpContext getHttpContext() { return original.getHttpContext(); }
    @Override public void close() { }
    @Override public InputStream getRequestBody() { return original.getRequestBody(); }
    @Override public OutputStream getResponseBody() { return body; }
    @Override public void sendResponseHeaders(int code, long responseLength) { status = code; length = responseLength; }
    @Override public InetSocketAddress getRemoteAddress() { return original.getRemoteAddress(); }
    @Override public int getResponseCode() { return status; }
    @Override public InetSocketAddress getLocalAddress() { return original.getLocalAddress(); }
    @Override public String getProtocol() { return original.getProtocol(); }
    @Override public Object getAttribute(String name) { return original.getAttribute(name); }
    @Override public void setAttribute(String name, Object value) { original.setAttribute(name, value); }
    @Override public void setStreams(InputStream in, OutputStream out) { throw new UnsupportedOperationException(); }
    @Override public HttpPrincipal getPrincipal() { return original.getPrincipal(); }

    void finish() throws IOException {
        if (status < 0) throw new IOException("Handler did not send a response");
        original.sendResponseHeaders(status, length < 0 ? -1 : body.size());
        if (length >= 0) try (OutputStream out = original.getResponseBody()) { body.writeTo(out); }
        else original.close();
    }
}

function populateAttendanceEmployees() {
  [[attendanceEmployee, 'attendance-view'], [document.getElementById('attendance-entry-employee'), 'attendance-edit']].forEach(([select, purpose]) => {
    if (!select) return;

      const option = document.createElement('option');
      option.value = employee.id;

      select.append(option);
    });
    if (state.allEmployees.some(employee => employee.id === current)) select.value = current;
  });
}

export const ROLE_OPTIONS = [['EMPLOYEE', 'Employee'], ['SUPERVISOR', 'Supervisor'], ['PAYROLL', 'Payroll Staff'], ['HR', 'HR'], ['ADMIN', 'System Admin']];

export function rateSummary(version) {
  return `SSS ${version.sss.employeePercent}% / ${version.sss.employerPercent}% (MSC ₱${version.sss.minMsc}–₱${version.sss.maxMsc}) · `
    + `PhilHealth ${version.philHealth.premiumPercent}% (₱${version.philHealth.floor}–₱${version.philHealth.ceiling}) · `
    + `Pag-IBIG ${version.pagIbig.lowPercent}% ≤ ₱${version.pagIbig.lowBand}, else ${version.pagIbig.highPercent}% (cap ₱${version.pagIbig.cap}) · `
    + `${version.bir.length} tax brackets, top ${version.bir[version.bir.length - 1].ratePercent}%`;
}

export function birRows(rows) {
  return rows.filter(row => row.over !== '' || row.baseTax !== '' || row.ratePercent !== '');
}

const RATE_FIELDS = [
  ['sss', 'employeePercent'], ['sss', 'employerPercent'], ['sss', 'minMsc'], ['sss', 'maxMsc'],
  ['philHealth', 'premiumPercent'], ['philHealth', 'floor'], ['philHealth', 'ceiling'],
  ['pagIbig', 'lowBand'], ['pagIbig', 'lowPercent'], ['pagIbig', 'highPercent'], ['pagIbig', 'employerPercent'], ['pagIbig', 'cap']
];

function fill(select, values) {
  const current = select.value;
  select.replaceChildren();
  values.forEach(([value, label]) => {
    const option = document.createElement('option');
    option.value = value;
    option.textContent = label;
    select.append(option);
  });
  if (values.some(([value]) => value === current)) select.value = current;
}

function table(tbody, rows) {
  tbody.replaceChildren();
  rows.forEach(values => {
    const row = document.createElement('tr');
    values.forEach(value => {
      const cell = document.createElement('td');
      if (value instanceof Node) cell.append(value);
      else cell.textContent = value;
      row.append(cell);
    });
    tbody.append(row);
  });
}

function say(target, message, isError = false) {
  target.textContent = message;
  target.classList.toggle('payroll-preview-error', isError);
}

export function initAdminConfig(apiJson, getAccount) {
  if (!document.getElementById('config-view')) return { refresh() {} };
  const value = id => document.getElementById(id).value.trim();
  let accounts = [];

  async function refreshRoles() {
    const payload = await apiJson('/api/admin/roles');
    accounts = payload.accounts;
    const me = getAccount();
    fill(document.getElementById('role-employee'), accounts.filter(item => !me || item.employeeId !== me.employeeId)
      .map(item => [item.employeeId, `${item.employeeId} — ${item.name}`]));
    fill(document.getElementById('role-supervisor'), [['', 'No supervisor'], ...accounts.filter(item => item.role === 'SUPERVISOR')
      .map(item => [item.employeeId, `${item.employeeId} — ${item.name}`])]);
    syncRoleForm();
    table(document.getElementById('role-rows'), accounts.map(item => [`${item.employeeId} — ${item.name}`, item.position, item.roleLabel,
      item.supervisorId || '—', item.status]));
    table(document.getElementById('role-log-rows'), payload.changes.map(change => [change.at, change.by, change.employeeId, change.before, change.after]));
  }

  function syncRoleForm() {
    const chosen = accounts.find(item => item.employeeId === document.getElementById('role-employee').value);
    if (!chosen) return;
    document.getElementById('role-role').value = chosen.role;
    document.getElementById('role-supervisor').value = chosen.supervisorId;
  }

  async function refreshRates() {
    const payload = await apiJson('/api/rate-proposals');
    const me = getAccount();
    document.getElementById('rates-submit').textContent = me && me.role === 'PAYROLL' ? 'Propose for approval' : 'Save as new version';
    table(document.getElementById('proposal-rows'), payload.proposals.map(item => {
      let result = item.status === 'Pending review' ? 'Pending review' : `${item.status}: ${item.outcome}`;
      if (me && me.role === 'ADMIN' && item.status === 'Pending review' && item.proposedBy !== me.employeeId) {
        result = document.createElement('span');
        result.className = 'workflow-row-actions';
        ['approve', 'reject'].forEach(decision => {
          const button = document.createElement('button');
          button.type = 'button';
          button.className = 'button button-quiet workflow-cancel';
          button.textContent = decision === 'approve' ? 'Approve' : 'Reject';
          button.dataset.proposalId = item.id;
          button.dataset.decision = decision;
          button.setAttribute('aria-label', `${button.textContent} ${item.id}`);
          result.append(button);
        });
      }
      return [item.id, item.effectiveMonth, item.note || '—', item.proposedBy, result];
    }));
    table(document.getElementById('rates-rows'), payload.versions.map(version => [version.id + (version.id === payload.inForce ? ' (in force now)' : ''),
      version.effectiveMonth, rateSummary(version), version.note, version.createdBy || 'Built in']));
    
    const current = payload.versions.find(version => version.id === payload.inForce) || payload.versions[0];
    RATE_FIELDS.forEach(([group, key]) => { document.getElementById(`rate-${group}-${key}`).value = current[group][key]; });
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const row = current.bir[i] || { over: '', baseTax: '', ratePercent: '' };
      document.getElementById(`bir-${i}-over`).value = row.over;
      document.getElementById(`bir-${i}-baseTax`).value = row.baseTax;
      document.getElementById(`bir-${i}-ratePercent`).value = row.ratePercent;
    }
  }

  async function refresh() {
    const account = getAccount();
    if (!account || !['ADMIN', 'PAYROLL'].includes(account.role)) return;
    try {
      await Promise.all([account.role === 'ADMIN' ? refreshRoles() : null, refreshRates()]);
    } catch (error) {
      say(document.getElementById('role-status'), error.message, true);
    }
  }

  document.getElementById('role-employee').addEventListener('change', syncRoleForm);
  document.getElementById('role-form').addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const status = document.getElementById('role-status');
    try {
      const { change } = await apiJson(`/api/admin/roles/${encodeURIComponent(value('role-employee'))}`,
        { role: value('role-role'), supervisorId: value('role-supervisor') });
      say(status, `${change.employeeId}: ${change.before} → ${change.after}. It applies at their next sign-in.`);
      await refreshRoles();
    } catch (error) {
      say(status, error.message, true);
    }
  });

  document.getElementById('rates-form').addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const status = document.getElementById('rates-status');

Unlike the site, no 13th month is added (mentor: its ₱90,000 exemption is annual, so it cannot be decided per cutoff). <a href="https://bir-cdn.bir.gov.ph/local/pdf/Annex%20E%20RR%2011-2018.pdf">BIR Annex E</a></p>

const CENTS_PER_PESO = 100n;

export function parsePesoCents(value, fieldName = 'amount') {
  const text = String(value ?? '').trim().replace(/,/g, '');
  if (!/^\d+(?:\.\d{1,2})?$/.test(text)) {
    throw new TypeError(`${fieldName} must be a non-negative peso amount with up to two decimal places.`);
  }
  const [wholeText, fractionText = ''] = text.split('.');
  return BigInt(wholeText) * CENTS_PER_PESO + BigInt(fractionText.padEnd(2, '0'));
}

export function formatPesoCents(cents) {
  const value = BigInt(cents);
  const sign = value < 0n ? '-' : '';
  const absolute = value < 0n ? -value : value;
  const pesos = (absolute / CENTS_PER_PESO).toString().replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
  const centavos = (absolute % CENTS_PER_PESO).toString().padStart(2, '0');
  return `${sign}₱${pesos}.${centavos}`;
}

export function statutoryFromApi(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return Object.freeze(value.map(statutoryFromApi));
  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return value;
  const converted = {};
  for (const [key, field] of Object.entries(value)) {
    if (key.endsWith('Cents')) {
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(field)) throw new TypeError(`Unexpected payroll amount for ${key}.`);
      converted[key] = BigInt(field);
    } else {
      converted[key] = statutoryFromApi(field);
    }
  }
  return Object.freeze(converted);
}

    private static void parsesPesosAndRejectsBadInput() {

    private static String pesos(long cents) { return String.format("%d.%02d", cents / 100, cents % 100); }

    }

            long pagIbigLowBand, long pagIbigLowBp, long pagIbigHighBp, long pagIbigEmployerBp, long pagIbigCap, List<long[]> birAnnual) {
        this.id = id; this.effectiveMonth = effectiveMonth; this.note = note; this.createdBy = createdBy; this.createdAt = createdAt;
        this.sssEmployeeBp = sssEmployeeBp; this.sssEmployerBp = sssEmployerBp; this.sssMinMsc = sssMinMsc; this.sssMaxMsc = sssMaxMsc;
        this.philHealthPremiumBp = philHealthPremiumBp; this.philHealthFloor = philHealthFloor; this.philHealthCeiling = philHealthCeiling;
        this.pagIbigLowBand = pagIbigLowBand; this.pagIbigLowBp = pagIbigLowBp; this.pagIbigHighBp = pagIbigHighBp;
        this.pagIbigEmployerBp = pagIbigEmployerBp; this.pagIbigCap = pagIbigCap;
        List<long[]> rows = new ArrayList<>();
        for (long[] row : birAnnual) rows.add(row.clone());
        this.birAnnual = Collections.unmodifiableList(rows);
        validate();
    }

    private void validate() {
        for (long bp : new long[] {sssEmployeeBp, sssEmployerBp, philHealthPremiumBp, pagIbigLowBp, pagIbigHighBp, pagIbigEmployerBp}) {
            if (bp < 0 || bp > 5_000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Contribution rates must be 0% to 50%.");
        }
        if (philHealthPremiumBp % 2 != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("The PhilHealth premium must split evenly (e.g. 5.00%).");
        if (sssMinMsc <= 0 || sssMaxMsc < sssMinMsc || (sssMaxMsc - sssMinMsc) % 50_000 != 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("SSS MSC range must be positive, with the maximum at least the minimum, in ₱500 steps.");
        }
        if (philHealthFloor <= 0 || philHealthCeiling < philHealthFloor) throw new IllegalArgumentException("PhilHealth floor and ceiling must be positive, ceiling at least floor.");
        if (pagIbigLowBand < 0 || pagIbigCap <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Pag-IBIG band and cap must be positive.");
        if (birAnnual.isEmpty() || birAnnual.size() > 12 || birAnnual.get(0)[0] != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("The tax table needs 1-12 rows, the first starting at ₱0.");
        for (int i = 0; i < birAnnual.size(); i++) {
            long[] row = birAnnual.get(i);
            if (row.length != 3 || row[1] < 0 || row[2] < 0 || row[2] > 10_000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Each tax row needs over ≥ 0, base tax ≥ 0 and a rate of 0% to 100%.");
            if (i > 0 && row[0] <= birAnnual.get(i - 1)[0]) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Tax table rows must go up in income.");
        }
    }

    
    public static StatutoryRates version(String id, YearMonth effectiveMonth, String note, String createdBy,
            long sssEmployeeBp, long sssEmployerBp, long sssMinMsc, long sssMaxMsc,
            long philHealthPremiumBp, long philHealthFloor, long philHealthCeiling,
            long pagIbigLowBand, long pagIbigLowBp, long pagIbigHighBp, long pagIbigEmployerBp, long pagIbigCap, List<long[]> birAnnual) {
        if (effectiveMonth == null || effectiveMonth.getYear() != 2026) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Effective month must be in 2026.");
        return new StatutoryRates(id, effectiveMonth, note == null ? "" : note.trim(), createdBy, Instant.now().toString(),
            sssEmployeeBp, sssEmployerBp, sssMinMsc, sssMaxMsc, philHealthPremiumBp, philHealthFloor, philHealthCeiling,
            pagIbigLowBand, pagIbigLowBp, pagIbigHighBp, pagIbigEmployerBp, pagIbigCap, birAnnual);
    }

    
    public static final class Registry {
        private final List<StatutoryRates> versions = new ArrayList<>();

        public synchronized StatutoryRates ratesFor(YearMonth month) {
            StatutoryRates chosen = DEFAULT;
            for (StatutoryRates version : versions) {
                if (!version.effectiveMonth.isAfter(month) && !version.effectiveMonth.isBefore(chosen.effectiveMonth)) chosen = version;
            }
            return chosen;
        }

        public synchronized String nextId() { return "PH-2026-admin-v" + (versions.size() + 1); }

        public synchronized StatutoryRates add(StatutoryRates version) {
            for (StatutoryRates existing : versions) {
                if (existing.effectiveMonth.equals(version.effectiveMonth)) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException("A rates version already starts in " + version.effectiveMonth + "; choose another month.");
                }
            }
            versions.add(version);
            return version;
        }

        
        public synchronized List<StatutoryRates> all() {
            List<StatutoryRates> result = new ArrayList<>();
            result.add(DEFAULT);
            result.addAll(versions);
            return result;
        }
    }
}

const TAB_KEY = 'motorph-tab-';
const ALL_KEY = 'motorph-all-sections';

export function parseTabs(spec) {
  return String(spec || '').split('|').map(part => part.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(part => {
    const [key, ...label] = part.split(':');
    return { key: key.trim(), label: label.join(':').trim() || key.trim() };
  });
}

export function firstSentence(text) {
  const clean = String(text || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  const match = clean.match(/^(.+?[.!?])(\s|$)/);
  return match ? match[1] : clean;
}

export function badgeCount(elements) {
  let count = 0;
  elements.forEach(element => {
    count += element.querySelectorAll('button[aria-label^="Approve "]').length;
    count += [...element.querySelectorAll('td')].filter(cell => cell.textContent.startsWith('Failed:')).length;
  });
  return count;
}

const available = element => !element.hidden && !element.classList.contains('role-hidden');

function shortenIntros(page) {
  page.querySelectorAll('p.payroll-preview-intro, p.processing-note:not([id]):not([role]), .notice > p').forEach(paragraph => {
    if (paragraph.dataset.shortened || paragraph.textContent.trim().length < 140) return;
    paragraph.dataset.shortened = 'true';
    const short = document.createElement('p');
    short.className = `${paragraph.className} intro-short`;
    short.textContent = firstSentence(paragraph.textContent);
    const more = document.createElement('details');
    more.className = 'intro-more';
    const summary = document.createElement('summary');
    summary.textContent = 'How this works';
    paragraph.replaceWith(short);
    more.append(summary, paragraph);
    short.after(more);
  });
}

export function initPageTabs(root = document) {
  const pages = [...root.querySelectorAll('.page-view[data-tabs]')];
  const state = new Map();

  function showAll() { return window.localStorage.getItem(ALL_KEY) === 'true'; }

  function apply(page) {
    const entry = state.get(page);
    const tabbed = [...page.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]')];
    const keysOf = element => element.dataset.tab.split(/\s+/);
    const usable = entry.tabs.filter(tab => tabbed.some(element => keysOf(element).includes(tab.key) && available(element)
      && (!element.parentElement.closest('[data-tab-group]') || available(element.parentElement.closest('[data-tab-group]')))));
    let active = entry.active;
    if (!usable.some(tab => tab.key === active)) active = usable.length ? usable[0].key : '';
    entry.active = active;
    const all = showAll();
    entry.observer.disconnect();
    tabbed.forEach(element => element.classList.toggle('tab-off', !all && !keysOf(element).includes(active)));
    page.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-group]').forEach(group => {
      const anyOn = [...group.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]')].some(element => !element.classList.contains('tab-off') && available(element));
      group.classList.toggle('tab-off', !all && !anyOn);
    });
    entry.bar.hidden = usable.length < 2 && !all;
    entry.buttons.forEach((button, key) => {
      const tab = entry.tabs.find(item => item.key === key);
      button.hidden = !usable.includes(tab);
      const selected = !all && key === active;
      button.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(selected));
      button.tabIndex = selected || (all && key === usable[0]?.key) ? 0 : -1;
      const count = badgeCount(tabbed.filter(element => keysOf(element).includes(key) && available(element)));
      const badge = button.querySelector('.tab-badge');
      badge.textContent = count ? String(count) : '';
      badge.hidden = !count;
      button.setAttribute('aria-label', count ? `${tab.label} (${count} waiting)` : tab.label);
    });
    entry.allToggle.textContent = all ? 'Show one section at a time' : 'Show all sections';
    entry.allToggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(all));
    entry.observer.observe(page, { subtree: true, childList: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['hidden', 'class'] });
  }

  function select(page, key, focus = false) {
    const entry = state.get(page);
    entry.active = key;
    window.sessionStorage.setItem(TAB_KEY + page.id, key);
    if (showAll()) window.localStorage.setItem(ALL_KEY, 'false');
    pages.forEach(apply);
    if (focus) entry.buttons.get(key).focus();
  }

  pages.forEach(page => {
    shortenIntros(page);
    const tabs = parseTabs(page.dataset.tabs);
    const bar = document.createElement('div');
    bar.className = 'page-tabs';
    const list = document.createElement('div');
    list.className = 'page-tab-list';
    list.setAttribute('role', 'tablist');
    list.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Sections on this page');
    const buttons = new Map();
    tabs.forEach(tab => {
      const button = document.createElement('button');
      button.type = 'button';
      button.className = 'page-tab';
      button.setAttribute('role', 'tab');
      button.dataset.tabKey = tab.key;
      const label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = tab.label;
      const badge = document.createElement('span');
      badge.className = 'tab-badge';
      badge.hidden = true;
      button.append(label, badge);
      button.addEventListener('click', () => select(page, tab.key));
      button.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
        if (!['ArrowRight', 'ArrowLeft', 'Home', 'End'].includes(event.key)) return;
        event.preventDefault();

#!/usr/bin/env sh

fail=0
pass=0
for f in $(find src/test/java -name '*Test.java' | sort); do
  cls=$(printf '%s' "$f" | sed 's|src/test/java/||; s|/|.|g; s|\.java$||')
  if java --add-modules jdk.httpserver -cp "$CP" "$cls" > /tmp/motorph-test-out.txt 2>&1 && ! grep -q "^FAIL" /tmp/motorph-test-out.txt; then
    tail -n 1 /tmp/motorph-test-out.txt | sed "s|^|$cls: |"
    pass=$((pass + 1))
  else
    echo "FAILED: $cls"
    cat /tmp/motorph-test-out.txt
    fail=$((fail + 1))
  fi
done

if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "---- web unit tests ----"
  if node --test test/web/*.test.js 2>&1 | tee /tmp/motorph-web-out.txt | tail -n 8 | grep -q "^# fail 0"; then
    grep -E "^# (tests|pass|fail)" /tmp/motorph-web-out.txt | sed 's/^# /web: /'
    pass=$((pass + 1))
  else
    echo "web unit tests FAILED"
    grep -E "^not ok" /tmp/motorph-web-out.txt | head -10
    fail=$((fail + 1))
  fi
fi

# The browser suite needs playwright-core and a Chromium binary; skip it cleanly when absent
# instead of failing a machine that has neither.
if [ "${MOTORPH_SKIP_E2E:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  echo "e2e: skipped (MOTORPH_SKIP_E2E=1)"
elif [ -d node_modules/playwright-core ] && [ -x "${CHROMIUM_PATH:-/home/user/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux64/chrome}" ]; then

else

    private void context(String path, com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpHandler handler) {
        server.createContext(path, exchange -> {
            String requestPath = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();
            boolean publicRoute = "/api/health".equals(requestPath)
                || "/api/auth/signin".equals(requestPath)
                || "/api/auth/2fa/verify".equals(requestPath);
            AccessPolicy.Actor signedIn = publicRoute ? null : actorFromCookie(exchange);
            if (!publicRoute && signedIn == null) {
                sendError(exchange, 401, "Sign in first.");
                return;
            }
            boolean accountRoute = "/api/auth/session".equals(requestPath)
                || "/api/auth/password".equals(requestPath) || "/api/auth/signout".equals(requestPath);
            if (signedIn != null && !accountRoute && credentialStore.account(signedIn.employeeId)
                    .map(account -> account.mustChangePassword()).orElse(true)) {
                sendError(exchange, 403, "Change your initial password before using the workspace.");
                return;
            }
            boolean change = !"GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())
                || String.valueOf(exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery()).contains("reveal=true");
            if (!change) {
                handler.handle(exchange);
                return;
            }
            
            
            try {
                if (!"/api/auth/signin".equals(exchange.getRequestURI().getPath())) requireCsrf(exchange);
            } catch (RequestException refused) {
                try {
                    sendError(exchange, refused.statusCode, refused.getMessage());
                } catch (IOException failedWrite) {
                    
                }
                return;
            }
            
            synchronized (stateLock) {
                if (persistenceBroken) {
                    sendError(exchange, 503, "Saving is unavailable. Contact the administrator before retrying.");
                    return;
                }
                BufferedExchange buffered = new BufferedExchange(exchange);
                com.google.gson.Gson rosterGson = (dataFile != null ? dataFile : new LocalStateFile(Paths.get("unused.json"))).gson();
                String rosterBefore = rosterGson.toJson(localEmployeeStore);
                JsonObject before = dataFile == null || deferSaves ? null : exportState();
                handler.handle(buffered);
                if (!rosterBefore.equals(rosterGson.toJson(localEmployeeStore))) {
                    provisionNewEmployees();
                    bindPolicyToRoster();
                }
                int status = buffered.getResponseCode();
                audit(buffered, status);
                if (deferSaves) {
                    saveDataFile();
                } else if (dataFile != null) {
                    try {
                        forceSave();
                    } catch (RuntimeException failure) {
                        persistenceBroken = true;
                        try { importState(before); importAudit(before); }
                        catch (RuntimeException rollback) { System.err.println("Could not restore in-memory state after save failure: " + rollback); }
                        System.err.println("Persistence failed; writes are disabled until restart: " + failure.getMessage());
                        exchange.getResponseHeaders().clear();
                        sendError(exchange, 503, "Saving failed. The result is uncertain; contact the administrator before retrying.");
                        return;
                    }
                }
                buffered.finish();
            }
        });
    }
    private void handleAdmin(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        String path = exchange.getRequestURI().getPath();
        String method = exchange.getRequestMethod();
        try {
            AccessPolicy.Actor actor = actorFor(exchange);
            guard(() -> AccessPolicy.requireAdmin(actor));
            if ("GET".equals(method) && "/api/admin/roles".equals(path)) {
                JsonArray items = new JsonArray();
                for (Employee employee : localEmployeeService.listEmployees()) items.add(accountRow(employee));
                JsonArray log = new JsonArray();
                synchronized (roleChanges) { roleChanges.forEach(log::add); }
                sendJson(exchange, 200, "{\"accounts\":" + items + ",\"changes\":" + log + "}");
                return;
            }
            if ("GET".equals(method) && "/api/admin/rates".equals(path)) {
                JsonArray versions = new JsonArray();
                for (StatutoryRates version : statutoryRates.all()) versions.add(ratesToJson(version));
                String month = queryParameter(exchange.getRequestURI().getRawQuery(), "month");
                JsonObject response = new JsonObject();
                response.add("versions", versions);
                response.addProperty("inForce", statutoryRates.ratesFor(month == null || month.isEmpty()
                    ? java.time.YearMonth.from(clockService.now()) : parseMonth(month)).id);
                sendJson(exchange, 200, response.toString());
                return;
            }
            if ("GET".equals(method) && "/api/admin/audit".equals(path)) {

                String limitText = queryParameter(query, "limit");

                response.add("entries", new com.google.gson.Gson().toJsonTree(auditLog.search(nullToEmpty(queryParameter(query, "actor")).trim(),

                    throw new RequestException(403, ex.getMessage());
                }
                JsonObject change = new JsonObject();
                change.addProperty("at", java.time.Instant.now().toString());
                change.addProperty("by", actor.employeeId);

package ph.motorph.o_oop;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

public final class InMemoryAttendanceStore implements MutableAttendanceStore {
    private final List<AttendanceRecord> records;

    
    public InMemoryAttendanceStore() {
        records = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    
    public static InMemoryAttendanceStore withSampleRows() {
        return new InMemoryAttendanceStore(true);
    }

    private InMemoryAttendanceStore(boolean seed) {
        List<AttendanceRecord> values = new ArrayList<>();
        values.add(record(5001, 101, "2026-10-01", "08:01", "17:00"));
        values.add(record(5002, 101, "2026-10-02", "07:58", "16:59"));
        values.add(record(5003, 101, "2026-10-15", "08:03", "17:01"));
        values.add(record(5101, 102, "2026-10-01", "08:00", "17:02"));
        values.add(record(5102, 102, "2026-10-03", "08:04", "17:03"));
        values.add(record(5201, 103, "2026-10-02", "08:10", "16:55"));
        values.add(record(5301, 104, "2026-10-05", "08:00", "17:00"));
        values.add(record(5302, 104, "2026-10-06", "08:06", "17:00"));
        records = values;
        enforceUniqueScheduleDate(records);
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized List<AttendanceRecord> findAll() {
        return new ArrayList<>(records);
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized List<AttendanceRecord> findByScheduleId(int scheduleId) {
        return records.stream()
            .filter(record -> record.getScheduleId() == scheduleId)
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized AttendanceRecord create(int scheduleId, LocalDate date, LocalTime timeIn,
                                                 LocalTime timeOut, String dayType) {
        for (AttendanceRecord existing : records) {
            if (existing.getScheduleId() == scheduleId && existing.getDate().equals(date)) {
                throw new IllegalStateException("An attendance record already exists for this schedule and date.");
            }
        }
        int nextId = records.stream().mapToInt(AttendanceRecord::getAttendanceId).max().orElse(0) + 1;
        if (nextId <= 0) throw new IllegalStateException("No attendance IDs remain.");
        AttendanceRecord record = new AttendanceRecord(nextId, scheduleId, date, timeIn, timeOut, dayType);
        records.add(record);
        return record;
    }

    @Override
    public synchronized AttendanceRecord correctTimes(int attendanceId, LocalTime timeIn, LocalTime timeOut) {
        for (int i = 0; i < records.size(); i++) {
            AttendanceRecord existing = records.get(i);
            if (existing.getAttendanceId() != attendanceId) continue;
            AttendanceRecord corrected = new AttendanceRecord(attendanceId, existing.getScheduleId(), existing.getDate(), timeIn, timeOut, existing.getDayType());
            records.set(i, corrected);
            return corrected;
        }
        throw new java.util.NoSuchElementException("Attendance row was not found.");
    }

    private static AttendanceRecord record(int attendanceId, int scheduleId, String date, String in, String out) {
        return new AttendanceRecord(attendanceId, scheduleId, LocalDate.parse(date),
            LocalTime.parse(in), LocalTime.parse(out), "Imported");
    }

    private static void enforceUniqueScheduleDate(List<AttendanceRecord> records) {
        Set<String> keys = new HashSet<>();
        for (AttendanceRecord record : records) {
            String key = record.getScheduleId() + ":" + record.getDate();
            if (!keys.add(key)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("duplicate attendance for schedule/date: " + key);
        }
    }
}
package ph.motorph.o_oop;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;

public final class SavedPayslipStore {
    private final Map<String, String> snapshots = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private Map<String, String> voided = new LinkedHashMap<>();

    
    private Map<String, String> voided() {
        if (voided == null) voided = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        return voided;
    }

    public synchronized void save(String payslipId, String snapshotJson) {
        if (snapshots.containsKey(payslipId)) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Payslip " + payslipId + " is already finalized; saved payslips cannot be changed.");
        }
        snapshots.put(payslipId, snapshotJson);
    }

    
    public synchronized Optional<String> find(String payslipId) {
        String active = snapshots.get(payslipId);
        return Optional.ofNullable(active != null ? active : voided().get(payslipId));
    }

    public synchronized boolean isActive(String payslipId) { return snapshots.containsKey(payslipId); }

    
    public synchronized int voidCount(String payslipId) {
        int count = 0;
        for (String id : voided().keySet()) if (id.startsWith(payslipId + "-void")) count++;
        return count;
    }

    
    public synchronized String voidSnapshot(String payslipId, String voidedSnapshotJson) {
        if (!snapshots.containsKey(payslipId)) throw new IllegalStateException("Only an active finalized payslip can be voided.");
        String archiveId = payslipId + "-void" + (voidCount(payslipId) + 1);
        snapshots.remove(payslipId);
        voided().put(archiveId, voidedSnapshotJson);
        return archiveId;
    }

    
    public synchronized List<String> list() {
        List<String> result = new ArrayList<>(snapshots.values());
        java.util.Collections.reverse(result);
        return result;
    }

    
    public synchronized List<String> listVoided() {
        List<String> result = new ArrayList<>(voided().values());
        java.util.Collections.reverse(result);
        return result;
    }
}

            <summary>Open source notes and assumptions</summary>
            <div class="payroll-source-content">
              <p><strong>SSS:</strong> 2025 schedule remains the latest published contribution table found for the 2026 preview; employee 5% and employer 10% apply to MSC up to ₱35,000, with EC ₱10/₱30 paid by employer. <a href="https://www.sss.gov.ph/pay-contribution/">SSS contribution schedule</a></p>
              <p><strong>PhilHealth:</strong> 5% of monthly basic salary with ₱10,000 floor/₱100,000 ceiling, split equally. Commission, overtime and allowances are excluded from the MBS base. <a href="https://www.philhealth.gov.ph/advisories/2025/PA2025-0002.pdf">PA2025-0002</a></p>
              <p><strong>Pag-IBIG:</strong> MFS ceiling ₱10,000; employee 1% below ₱1,500 and 2% from ₱1,500 (as sweldongpinoy.com; the circular says 1% at ₱1,500 and below); employer 2%. <a href="https://www.pagibigfund.gov.ph/documents/Circular%20No.%20460%20-%20Guidelines%20on%20the%20Pag-IBIG%20Fund's%20Implementation%20of%20Increase%20in%20the%20MFS%20Effective%20February%202024.pdf">Circular No. 460</a></p>
              <p><strong>Reference:</strong> the current preview is a MotorPH implementation based on the cited statutory material. A set of historical comparison figures exists in tests, but raw site requests/responses and independently verified parity evidence are not retained. Do not treat them as proof that this implementation matches <a href="https://www.sweldongpinoy.com/">Sweldong Pinoy</a>. <strong>BIR:</strong> annualised like that site: 12 × monthly taxable pay, run through the RR 11-2018 annual table (2023 onward), then ÷ 12. Unlike the site, no 13th month is added (mentor: its ₱90,000 exemption is annual, so it cannot be decided per cutoff). <a href="https://bir-cdn.bir.gov.ph/local/pdf/Annex%20E%20RR%2011-2018.pdf">BIR Annex E</a></p>
              <p>All bases are typed separately by the user, and centavo rounding is a provisional half-up rule. No employee status, eligibility, semi-monthly deduction split, non-cash benefits, 13th-month annualisation, or tax adjustment is inferred.</p>
            </div>
          </details>

# Sweldong Pinoy: captured form probe and safe use
2
3
A user-provided Network capture shows a browser request to `POST https://www.sweldongpinoy.com/` using `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. The form submits these 11 keys: `employment_type`, `pay_period`, `payroll_period_daily_days`, `basic_pay`, `taxable_allowance`, `nontaxable_allowance`, `night_differential_hours`, `night_differential_rate`, `overtime_hours`, `overtime_rate`, and `work_schedule`. The captured response contains `status`, `result`, and `altresult`. A `JSESSIONID` cookie was present in the browser capture.
4
5
A session cookie does not, by itself, require a browser. `tools/sweldong_pinoy_probe.py` uses Python's standard-library HTTP client and cookie jar: it GETs the homepage, retains any session cookie, then POSTs the form in the same session. It does not open a browser, use the copied session cookie, or print cookie values. Its default amounts are the user's captured **test figures**. It validates response fields and arithmetic before reporting success.

[NODE 26885]
The website does not publish a supported API contract or service guarantee. Its endpoint, session requirements, fields and response may change; the service may rate-limit or disallow automated use. The app's existing My Pay reference remains an internal fixed-rate estimate; it is not fetched from Sweldong Pinoy. The probe is an operator-run calibration diagnostic, not a production payroll fallback and not an automatic replacement for MotorPH results. No actual employee ID or name is sent by this script, but the amounts themselves are confidential compensation data. Use test amounts unless sending live payroll amounts has been explicitly approved, and contact the provider before relying on automated integration.

[NODE 26894]
The verification write updates the Firestore snapshot metadata and uses its compare-and-set update-time precondition. It does not modify payroll or employee business data. A normal audit-log entry for the check is saved. On a mismatch or an ambiguous read/write result, the app refuses to overwrite the saved state and pauses subsequent writes; inspect/export the database and restart from the chosen verified source. Do not repeat the check blindly after a timeout.

[NODE 26895]
A passing Firestore check proves that, at that time and for that server identity, the running app can read its saved state, match it to loaded state, commit an unchanged snapshot via the app's actual Firestore state-store code, and read it back. The E2E suite runs this check both with a local file and with the official Firestore emulator.

[NODE 26896]
It does not prove that the live motorph-jd project is the intended production project, that its records are correct, that the service-account IAM is least-privileged, that another instance is not running, that a backup can be restored, or that production load/availability targets are met. Repeat against the actual deployment identity and project after each deployment. The app remains single-instance; the state snapshot design is not a normalized multi-instance database.

[NODE 26906]
202:- `GET /api/admin/roles` lists every person's `role`, `roleLabel`, `supervisorId` and `status`, plus `changes` (newest first: `at`, `by`, `employeeId`, `before`, `after`). `POST /api/admin/roles/{id}` `{role?, supervisorId?}` (`""` clears the supervisor). Guard rails: never your own role (`403`); at least one System Admin stays (`409`); a supervisor with direct reports keeps the role until the team is reassigned (`409`); the supervisor must hold the Supervisor role and reporting lines can't loop (`400`). A change applies at the person's next request/sign-in.
203:- `GET /api/admin/rates[?month=]` lists rates `versions` (the built-in `PH-2026-sweldongpinoy-v4` first) and `inForce` for the month (default: this month). `POST /api/admin/rates` `{effectiveMonth (2026), note, sss {employeePercent, employerPercent, minMsc, maxMsc}, philHealth {premiumPercent, floor, ceiling}, pagIbig {lowBand, lowPercent, highPercent, employerPercent, cap}, bir [{over, baseTax, ratePercent}…]}` adds `PH-2026-admin-vN`. Percents up to two decimals; pesos as text. Validation: rates 0–50% (tax 0–100%), even PhilHealth split, SSS MSC range in ₱500 steps, tax rows ascending from ₱0; one version per effective month (`409`). Payroll and the statutory preview use the latest version on or before each month, and `rulesetId` names it.
230:- **Security settings (System Admin):** `GET /api/admin/security` returns `settings` (`minPasswordLength` 8-64, `maxFailedAttempts` 3-10, `lockoutMinutes` 5-120, `codeMinutes` 1-10, `sessionHours` 1-24) and each account's password status. `POST /api/admin/security` saves the settings; `POST /api/admin/security/{id}/unlock` and `/{id}/reset-password` (not your own; also signs that account out).
231:- **Payroll policy (System Admin):** `GET/POST /api/admin/payroll-policy` `{graceMinutes 0-30, hoursPerMonth 160-208, dailyHours 4-10, nightDifferentialPercent 10-30}`; `mentorDefaults` says whether it is 10 / 168 / 8 / 10. Applies to unfinalized pay; each payslip records `payrollPolicy`.
232:- **Audit log (System Admin):** `GET /api/admin/audit?actor=&path=&failures=true&limit=` returns `entries` (`at`, `actor`, `method`, `path`, `target`, `status`; newest first, never request bodies), `kept` and `archives`. Every change request and sign-in attempt is recorded; past 1,000 entries the oldest 500 go to `data/archive/audit-*.json`.
233:- **Backups (System Admin):** `GET /api/admin/backups`; `POST /api/admin/backups` `{}` backs up now; `POST /api/admin/backups/restore` `{name, confirm: "RESTORE"}` restores (after a `before-restore` safety backup). Automatic backups at most every 30 minutes of changes; the newest 20 are kept; a damaged data file is replaced by the newest readable backup at start.
249:- **Rate changes for approval:** `POST /api/rate-proposals` (Payroll Staff; same body as `/api/admin/rates`) files `RP-0001` as `Pending review`; `POST /api/rate-proposals/{id}/approve|reject` (System Admin, not the proposer) turns it into a rates version or rejects it. `GET /api/rate-proposals` lists proposals, `versions` and `inForce` (Payroll Staff and System Admin).
272:- `POST /api/admin/reset` `{"confirm":"RESET"}` (System Admin) restores the built-in demo data (five accounts, sample attendance, default roles and rates) and saves it.
11-
12-The UID header is not trusted for authorization: Firestore Rules compare it to the UID in the verified ID token. Do not log or persist ID tokens.

The change history keeps a "Record deleted" entry.

268-## Local data file
269-
270-- The local demo keeps its state in `data/local-demo.json` (override with `LOCAL_DATA_FILE`; empty = memory only). It is loaded at start-up and written after every successful change (non-GET request, or a logged full view of government numbers), through a temporary file that replaces the old one. Changes are applied one at a time while saving; stopping the server waits for a save in progress. An unreadable file is moved to `local-demo.json.unreadable-<time>` and the demo starts from the built-in data. Firebase mode never uses the file.

docs/a_doc/sweldong-reference-probe.md:1:# Sweldong Pinoy: captured form probe and safe use
docs/a_doc/sweldong-reference-probe.md:3:A user-provided Network capture shows a browser request to `POST https://www.sweldongpinoy.com/` using `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. The form submits these 11 keys: `employment_type`, `pay_period`, `payroll_period_daily_days`, `basic_pay`, `taxable_allowance`, `nontaxable_allowance`, `night_differential_hours`, `night_differential_rate`, `overtime_hours`, `overtime_rate`, and `work_schedule`. The captured response contains `status`, `result`, and `altresult`. A `JSESSIONID` cookie was present in the browser capture.
docs/a_doc/sweldong-reference-probe.md:27:The website does not publish a supported API contract or service guarantee. Its endpoint, session requirements, fields and response may change; the service may rate-limit or disallow automated use. The app's existing My Pay reference remains an internal fixed-rate estimate; it is not fetched from Sweldong Pinoy. The probe is an operator-run calibration diagnostic, not a production payroll fallback and not an automatic replacement for MotorPH results. No actual employee ID or name is sent by this script, but the amounts themselves are confidential compensation data. Use test amounts unless sending live payroll amounts has been explicitly approved, and contact the provider before relying on automated integration.
docs/a_doc/data-provenance.md:17:Sweldong Pinoy's [public calculator](https://www.sweldongpinoy.com/) (inspected 2026-11-02) accepts employment type, daily/weekly/semi-monthly/monthly period, basic pay, taxable/non-taxable allowances, night differential, overtime and schedule; its results show gross, tax, contributions and net for semi-monthly, monthly and annual periods, with 2025/2026 rates. Its [public guide](https://blog.sweldongpinoy.com/2023/03/sweldong-pinoy-guide-to-understanding.html) describes the same basic categories. It is not a documented API and its full current algorithm was not independently established. This app's reference is inspired by its public categories and existing checked-in 2026 statutory assumptions; it is **not** the external site's output, a full implementation of all its options, or a verified match. In particular, at exactly ₱1,500 the app applies the 1% Pag-IBIG low band; do not assert that the live site currently matches this boundary. Consult the published SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG and BIR schedules and payroll professionals before operational use.

export function storageSummary(payload) {
  if (!payload || typeof payload.backend !== 'string' || !Number.isInteger(payload.storeCount)) {
    throw new TypeError('Unexpected storage status response.');
  }
  const location = payload.backend === 'firestore' ? 'Firestore' : payload.backend === 'file' ? 'local file' : 'memory only';
  const saved = payload.durable ? 'durable store configured' : 'not durable';
  const readiness = payload.writeReady ? 'writes enabled' : 'writes paused';
  return `${location} · ${saved} · ${readiness} · ${payload.storeCount} state stores · ${payload.employeeRecords} employees · ${payload.attendanceRecords} attendance rows · ${payload.activePayslips} active payslips`;
}

export function verificationSummary(result) {
  if (!result || result.readBeforeWrite !== true || result.stateMatchedBeforeWrite !== true
      || result.writeCommitted !== true || result.readBackMatched !== true) {
    throw new TypeError('Storage round-trip did not return all verification checks.');
  }
  const at = result.verifiedAt || 'time unavailable';
  return `PASS · ${result.backend} read matched the running state, an unchanged snapshot was committed, and read-back matched at ${at}. No employee or payroll values were changed.`;
}

export function initAdminStorage(apiJson, getAccount) {
  const status = document.getElementById('storage-status');
  if (!status) return { refresh() {} };
  const button = document.getElementById('storage-verify');
  const verification = document.getElementById('storage-verification');
  const say = (element, message, isError = false) => {
    element.textContent = message;
    element.classList.toggle('payroll-preview-error', isError);
  };

  async function refresh() {
    if ((getAccount() || {}).role !== 'ADMIN') return;
    try {
      const payload = await apiJson('/api/admin/storage');
      say(status, storageSummary(payload), !payload.writeReady);
      button.disabled = !payload.durable || !payload.writeReady;
      if (payload.lastVerification) say(verification, verificationSummary(payload.lastVerification));
      else say(verification, 'No successful round-trip verification has been recorded in this server process.');
    } catch (error) {
      button.disabled = true;
      say(status, error.message, true);
    }
  }

  button.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    button.disabled = true;
    say(verification, 'Checking the configured store. The unchanged state will be written and read back.');
    try {
      const result = await apiJson('/api/admin/storage/verify', { confirm: 'VERIFY' });
      say(verification, verificationSummary(result));
      await refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      say(verification, error.message, true);
      await refresh();
    }
  });

  return { refresh };

        final CountDownLatch release = new CountDownLatch(1);
        final AtomicInteger writes = new AtomicInteger();
        volatile String last = "";
        public Gson gson() { return gson; }
        public String describe() { return "controlled test store"; }
        public Optional<JsonObject> load() { return Optional.empty(); }
        public void save(JsonObject stores) throws IOException {
            int number = writes.incrementAndGet();
            if (number == 1) {
                entered.countDown();
                try {
                    if (!release.await(15, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) throw new IOException("timed out waiting for test");
                } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); throw new IOException(e); }
            }
            last = stores.toString();
        }
    }

    }

        if (!ok) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }

        try {

            synchronized (lock) { audit.record("two", "test", "POST", "/second", "", 200, null); mark.invoke(app); }
            check(store.writes.get() == 1, "second save unexpectedly ran concurrently");
            store.release.countDown();
            long deadline = System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(15);
            while (!store.last.contains("/second") && System.nanoTime() < deadline) Thread.sleep(25);
            check(store.last.contains("/second"), "change during in-flight save was not persisted");
            synchronized (lock) { audit.record("three", "test", "POST", "/shutdown", "", 200, null); mark.invoke(app); }
            app.stop();
            check(store.last.contains("/shutdown"), "shutdown did not flush latest state");
        } finally { store.release.countDown(); app.stop(); }

private void writeSnapshot(JsonObject snapshot, long revision) throws IOException {
        synchronized (saveIoLock) {
            if (revision <= persistedRevision) return;
            dataFile.save(snapshot);
            persistedRevision = revision;
        }
    }

        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException ex) {
            synchronized (stateLock) { stateDirty = true; }
            throw new IllegalStateException("Could not save data to " + dataFile.describe(), ex);
        }
    }

    private JsonObject storageStatus(JsonObject stores) {
        JsonObject status = new JsonObject();
        status.addProperty("backend", persistenceKind());
        status.addProperty("durable", dataFile != null);
        status.addProperty("writeReady", !persistenceBroken);
        status.addProperty("storeCount", stores.size());
        status.addProperty("employeeRecords", nestedObjectSize(stores, "employees", "employees"));
        status.addProperty("attendanceRecords", nestedArraySize(stores, "attendance", "records"));
        status.addProperty("activePayslips", nestedObjectSize(stores, "savedPayslips", "snapshots"));
        status.addProperty("voidedPayslips", nestedObjectSize(stores, "savedPayslips", "voided"));
        status.addProperty("checkedAt", clockService.now().toString());
        status.addProperty("verificationScope", "in-process counts only; use Verify read/write/read to prove the configured store");
        return status;
    }

    private static int nestedObjectSize(JsonObject stores, String storeName, String field) {
        if (stores == null || !stores.has(storeName) || !stores.get(storeName).isJsonObject()) return 0;
        JsonObject store = stores.getAsJsonObject(storeName);
        if (!store.has(field) || !store.get(field).isJsonObject()) return 0;
        return store.getAsJsonObject(field).size();
    }

    private static int nestedArraySize(JsonObject stores, String storeName, String field) {
        if (stores == null || !stores.has(storeName) || !stores.get(storeName).isJsonObject()) return 0;
        JsonObject store = stores.getAsJsonObject(storeName);
        if (!store.has(field) || !store.get(field).isJsonArray()) return 0;
        return store.getAsJsonArray(field).size();
    }

    private void storageVerificationFailure(HttpExchange exchange, int status, String message) throws IOException {
        persistenceBroken = true;
        exchange.setAttribute("storageVerificationAbort", Boolean.TRUE);
        sendError(exchange, status, message);
    }

    private void verifyStorageRoundTrip(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (dataFile == null) {
            storageVerificationFailure(exchange, 409, "This server is memory-only; no durable store can be verified.");
            return;
        }
        JsonObject expected = exportState();
        try {
            Optional<JsonObject> before = dataFile.load();
            if (!before.isPresent()) {
                storageVerificationFailure(exchange, 409, "The configured store has no saved snapshot. Writes are paused; inspect and restart before continuing.");
                return;
            }
            if (!before.get().equals(expected)) {
                storageVerificationFailure(exchange, 409, "The saved snapshot differs from this server's loaded state. No overwrite was attempted; writes are paused. Inspect the database and restart from the verified source.");
                return;
            }
            dataFile.save(expected);
            Optional<JsonObject> after = dataFile.load();
            if (!after.isPresent() || !after.get().equals(expected)) {
                storageVerificationFailure(exchange, 503, "The write/read-back did not match. Writes are paused; inspect the database before retrying.");
                return;
            }
            JsonObject result = storageStatus(after.get());
            result.addProperty("readBeforeWrite", true);
            result.addProperty("stateMatchedBeforeWrite", true);
            result.addProperty("writeCommitted", true);
            result.addProperty("readBackMatched", true);
            result.addProperty("verifiedAt", clockService.now().toString());
            result.addProperty("verificationScope", "unchanged active snapshot committed and read back through the configured store; payroll records were not changed");
            exchange.setAttribute("storageVerificationResult", result.deepCopy());
            sendJson(exchange, 200, result.toString());
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException failure) {
            storageVerificationFailure(exchange, 503,
                "The storage round-trip could not be confirmed. Writes are paused; inspect the database before retrying.");
        }
    }

    /** A single worker snapshots under stateLock and performs I/O without holding it. */
    private void startBackgroundWriter() {
        if (!deferSaves || dataFile == null) return;
        writerStopping = false;
        stateWriter = new Thread(() -> {
            while (true) {
                JsonObject snapshot;
                long revision;
                synchronized (stateLock) {
                    while (!stateDirty && !writerStopping) {
                        try { stateLock.wait(); }
                        catch (InterruptedException ex) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); return; }
                    }
                    if (writerStopping) return;
                    try {
                        snapshot = exportState();
                        revision = ++nextSaveRevision;
                        stateDirty = false;
                    } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
                        System.err.println("Could not snapshot state for saving: " + ex);
                        try { stateLock.wait(1000L); }
                        catch (InterruptedException interrupted) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); return; }
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                try {
                    writeSnapshot(snapshot, revision);
                } catch (IOException | RuntimeException ex) {
                    System.err.println("Could not save data to " + dataFile.describe() + ": " + ex);
                    synchronized (stateLock) {
                        stateDirty = true;
                        try { stateLock.wait(1000L); }
                        catch (InterruptedException interrupted) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); return; }
                    }
                }
            }
        }, "motorph-state-writer");
        stateWriter.setDaemon(true);
        stateWriter.start();
    }

    public void stop() {
        HttpServer stopping;
        synchronized (stateLock) {
            stopping = server;
            server = null;
        }
        if (stopping != null) stopping.stop(0);
        if (executor != null) {
            executor.shutdownNow();
            executor = null;
        }
        synchronized (stateLock) {
            writerStopping = true;
            stateLock.notifyAll();
        }
        if (stateWriter != null) {
            try { stateWriter.join(); }
            catch (InterruptedException ex) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                System.err.println("Interrupted while waiting for the state writer; pending changes may be lost.");
                return;
            }
            stateWriter = null;
        }
        try {
            if (deferSaves) forceSave();
        } catch (RuntimeException ex) {
            System.err.println("Could not flush pending changes on shutdown: " + ex);
        }
    }

/**
 * End-to-end check against the real server build.
 *
 * The previous e2e compiled an app that no longer exists (`src/main/java/ph/motorph/web`) and
 * drove a Firebase-authenticated browser. This one starts the shipped server on a spare port with
 * its own throwaway data file, signs in through the UI with an employee number and a 2FA code, and
 * asserts the things that have actually broken during development:
 *
 *   - the 2FA step is required and a wrong code grants nothing
 *   - every field a real role can reach loads without a 4xx
 *   - the System Administrator can read attendance (the matrix drift)
 *   - an employee cannot read another employee's record
 *   - a write survives a server restart (persistence is real, not per-request)
 *
 * Run: node test/e2e/local-workflows.e2e.js
 * Needs: target/classes built (sh tools/build.sh), playwright-core + a Chromium binary.
 */
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { copyFileSync, existsSync, mkdtempSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';

const projectRoot = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const classes = path.join(projectRoot, 'target/classes');

const bouncyJar = path.join(projectRoot, 'lib/bcprov-jdk18on-1.78.1.jar');

  || '/home/user/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux64/chrome';

function freePort() {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const probe = net.createServer();
    probe.once('error', reject);
    probe.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => {
      const { port } = probe.address();
      probe.close(() => resolve(port));
    });
  });
}

async function startServer(port) {
  child = spawn('java', [
    '-Xmx256m', '-XX:TieredStopAtLevel=1',
    '--add-modules', 'jdk.httpserver',
    '-cp', [gsonJar, bouncyJar, path.join(projectRoot, 'lib/google/*'), classes].join(path.delimiter),
    'ph.motorph.svc.AppServer'
  ], {
    cwd: projectRoot,
    env: {
      ...process.env,
      PORT: String(port),
      HOST: '127.0.0.1',
      WEB_ROOT: process.env.MOTORPH_E2E_WEB_ROOT || path.join(projectRoot, 'web'),
      MOTORPH_PEPPER: 'e2e-pepper-at-least-32-characters-long',
      LOCAL_DATA_FILE: path.join(scratch, 'state.json'),
      MOTORPH_SEED_FILE: path.join(scratch, 'state.json'),
      FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID: process.env.MOTORPH_E2E_FIRESTORE_PROJECT || '',
      MOTORPH_DEFER_SAVES: 'false'
    },
    stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe']
  });
  let serverLog = '';
  const capture = chunk => { serverLog = (serverLog + chunk.toString()).slice(-8000); };
  child.stdout.on('data', capture);
  child.stderr.on('data', capture);
  // A fresh data file is seeded and saved in full before the port opens, and provisioning the
  // 34 demo accounts costs one Argon2id hash each (about 9-10 s on two cores). Allow a generous
  // window so a loaded machine does not turn a slow start into a test failure.
  for (let i = 0; i < 450; i++) {
    if (child.exitCode !== null || child.signalCode !== null) {
      throw new Error(`server exited before startup (code ${child.exitCode}, signal ${child.signalCode}):\n${serverLog}`);
    }
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/api/health`);
      if (response.ok) return;
      if (i % 25 === 0) console.log(`  waiting for the server (${response.status})...`);
    } catch {
      if (i % 25 === 0) console.log('  waiting for the server...');
    }
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
  }
  throw new Error(`server did not start within 90 seconds:\n${serverLog}`);
}

async function stopServer() {
  if (!child) return;
  const done = new Promise(resolve => child.once('exit', resolve));
  child.kill('SIGTERM');
  await Promise.race([done, new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 5000))]);
  if (child.exitCode === null) child.kill('SIGKILL');
  child = null;
}

/** Sign in through the UI and return the page, already on the workspace. */
async function signIn(page, employeeId, { expectWrongCodeFirst = false } = {}) {
  await page.goto(`http://127.0.0.1:${page.__port}/signin`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
  await page.waitForTimeout(800);
  await page.fill('#auth-employee', employeeId);
  const currentPassword = changedPasswords.get(employeeId) || password;
  await page.fill('#auth-password', currentPassword);
  await page.click('#sign-in-button');
  await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.getElementById('code-form').hidden, null, { timeout: timeoutMs })
    .catch(async error => { throw new Error(`sign-in ${employeeId} failed: ${await page.textContent('#auth-error')} (${error.message})`); });

  if (expectWrongCodeFirst) {
    await page.fill('#code-input', '000000');
    await page.click('#code-verify-button');
    await page.waitForFunction(
      () => !document.getElementById('auth-error').hidden,
      null,
      { timeout: timeoutMs }
    ).catch(() => {});
    const error = (await page.textContent('#auth-error')) || '';
    assert.match(error, /wrong code|tries/i, `a wrong 2FA code is refused (got: ${error})`);
    assert.equal(await page.isVisible('.nav-item'), false, 'a wrong code still shows no workspace');
  }

  const preview = await page.textContent('#code-preview');
  const code = (preview.match(/\d{6}/) || [])[0];
  assert.ok(code, 'the demo deployment shows the code under the input');
  await page.fill('#code-input', code);
  await page.click('#code-verify-button');
  await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.getElementById('first-password-form').hidden
    || !document.getElementById('app-shell').hidden, null, { timeout: timeoutMs })
    .catch(async error => { throw new Error(`verification ${employeeId} failed: ${await page.textContent('#auth-error')} (${error.message})`); });
  if (await page.isVisible('#first-password-form')) {
    const blocked = await page.evaluate(async () => (await fetch('/api/employees')).status);
    assert.equal(blocked, 403, 'first-login users cannot access data before changing their password');
    const nextPassword = `CaseSensitive!2026-${employeeId}`;
    await page.fill('#first-password-current', currentPassword);
    await page.fill('#first-password-next', nextPassword);
    await page.click('#first-password-form button[type=submit]');
    changedPasswords.set(employeeId, nextPassword);
  }
  await page.waitForSelector('.nav-item:visible', { timeout: timeoutMs })
    .catch(() => {});
  await page.waitForTimeout(1800);
  assert.ok(await page.isVisible('.nav-item'), `employee ${employeeId} reaches the workspace`);
}

private void provisionSignIn() {
        String pepper = System.getenv("MOTORPH_PEPPER");
        boolean fromEnvironment = pepper != null && pepper.trim().length() >= 32;
        if (!fromEnvironment) {
            if (dataFile instanceof FirestoreStateStore)
                throw new IllegalStateException("MOTORPH_PEPPER must contain at least 32 characters when using Firestore.");
            pepper = "motorph-development-pepper-not-for-production-use";
            System.out.println("WARNING: MOTORPH_PEPPER is not set, so the development pepper is in use."
                + " Set a 32+ character secret before running this against real data.");
        }
        this.credentialStore = new CredentialStore(new ph.motorph.sp_secpol.PasswordHasher(pepper));
        importCredentials(savedCredentials);
        java.util.List<String> ids = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        for (Employee employee : localEmployeeStore.findAll()) ids.add(employee.getId());
        int created = credentialStore.provision(ids);
        java.util.List<Employee> roster = localEmployeeStore.findAll();
        this.authService = new AuthService(credentialStore, sessionStore,
            roster.isEmpty() ? new ph.motorph.o_oop.OrgChart(java.util.Collections.emptyList())
                             : new ph.motorph.o_oop.OrgChart(roster));
        if (created > 0) System.out.println("Sign-in ready for " + created + " accounts (employee number + password).");
    }

    
    private void importCredentials(com.google.gson.JsonElement saved) {
        if (saved == null || saved.isJsonNull() || credentialStore == null) return;
        java.lang.reflect.Type type = new com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken<java.util.Map<String, ph.motorph.sp_secpol.Account>>() { }.getType();
        credentialStore.importAccounts((dataFile != null ? dataFile : new LocalStateFile(Paths.get("unused.json"))).gson().fromJson(saved, type));
    }

    private void loadEmployeeFile() {
        ph.motorph.o_oop.EmployeeImport imported = ph.motorph.o_oop.EmployeeImport.fromClasspath();
        for (Employee employee : imported.employees()) {
            if (!localEmployeeStore.findById(employee.getId()).isPresent()) localEmployeeStore.seed(employee);
        }
        EmployeeService employees = new EmployeeService(localEmployeeStore);
        for (Employee employee : imported.employees()) {
            
            if (!localScheduleStore.findScheduleIdForEmployee(employee.getId()).isPresent()) {
                localScheduleStore.assign(employee.getId());
            }
        }
        localEmployeeService = employees;
        this.importNotes = imported.notes();
    }

    
    private void bindPolicyToRoster() {
        java.util.List<Employee> people = localEmployeeStore.findAll();
        if (people.isEmpty()) return;
        Map<String, AccessPolicy.Role> roles = AccessPolicy.exportRoles();
        Map<String, String> supervisors = AccessPolicy.exportSupervisors();
        ph.motorph.o_oop.OrgChart chart = new ph.motorph.o_oop.OrgChart(people);
        AccessPolicy.bind(chart);
        AccessPolicy.importRoles(roles, supervisors);
        if (credentialStore != null) authService = new AuthService(credentialStore, sessionStore, chart);
    }

    private void provisionNewEmployees() {
        if (credentialStore == null) return;
        java.util.List<String> ids = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        for (Employee employee : localEmployeeStore.findAll()) ids.add(employee.getId());
        credentialStore.provision(ids);
    }
