/**
 * The same state document the file backend writes, stored in Firestore instead.
 *
 * Firestore caps a document at 1 MiB and the attendance store alone is ~940 KB, so the
 * stores are split across documents rather than kept in one blob:
 *
 *   motorphState/_meta and _index        snapshot metadata and chunk counts
 *   motorphStateChunks/{store}_0000      a slice of one store, joined back on load
 *
 * Every value is stored as a JSON string inside a single field. That keeps Firestore's
 * typed-value encoding out of the picture entirely -- what comes back is byte-identical
 * to what went in, so the pinned @SerializedName keys keep working untouched.
 */
public final class FirestoreStateStore implements StateStore {

    private static final int FORMAT_VERSION = 1;
    // Leave room for non-ASCII UTF-8 and never split a surrogate pair.
    private static final int CHUNK_CHARS = 200_000;
    private static final String ROOT = "motorphState";
    // Firestore document paths must alternate collection/document, so a chunk cannot live at
    // motorphState/chunks/{id} (three segments after documents, which it rejects with
    // "lacks / at index N"). Chunks therefore live in their own top-level collection.
    private static final String CHUNKS = "motorphStateChunks";

    private final FirestoreRestClient fs_client;
    private boolean observedMeta, metaExists;
    private String metaUpdateTime;
    private final java.util.Map<String, String> cachedChunks = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final Gson fs_gson = new GsonBuilder()
        .registerTypeAdapter(LocalDate.class, text(LocalDate::parse))
        .registerTypeAdapter(LocalTime.class, text(LocalTime::parse))
        .registerTypeAdapter(LocalDateTime.class, text(LocalDateTime::parse))
        .registerTypeAdapter(YearMonth.class, text(YearMonth::parse))
        .disableHtmlEscaping()
        .create();

    public FirestoreStateStore(FirestoreRestClient fs_client) {
        this.fs_client = fs_client;
    }

    private interface Parser<T> { T apply(String value); }

    private static <T> com.google.gson.TypeAdapter<T> text(Parser<T> parse) {
        return new com.google.gson.TypeAdapter<T>() {
            @Override public void write(com.google.gson.stream.JsonWriter out, T value) throws IOException {
                if (value == null) { out.nullValue(); return; }
                out.value(value.toString());
            }
            @Override public T read(com.google.gson.stream.JsonReader in) throws IOException {
                if (in.peek() == com.google.gson.stream.JsonToken.NULL) { in.nextNull(); return null; }
                return parse.apply(in.nextString());
            }
        }.nullSafe();
    }

    @Override public Gson gson() { return fs_gson; }

    @Override public String backend() { return "firestore"; }

    @Override public String describe() { return "Firestore (" + ROOT + " collection)"; }

    @Override public Optional<JsonObject> load() throws IOException {
        JsonObject meta = readObject("_meta");
        if (meta == null) return Optional.empty();
        int format = meta.has("format") ? meta.get("format").getAsInt() : FORMAT_VERSION;
        if (format != FORMAT_VERSION) throw new IOException("Unknown Firestore state format: " + format);

        String loadedVersion = metaUpdateTime;
        java.util.Map<String, String> loadedChunks = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
        JsonObject stores = new JsonObject();
        JsonObject index = readObject("_index");
        if (index == null) return Optional.of(stores);

        for (String storeName : index.keySet()) {
            int chunks = index.get(storeName).getAsInt();
            StringBuilder joined = new StringBuilder();
            for (int part = 0; part < chunks; part++) {
                JsonObject chunk = readObject("chunks/" + storeName + "_" + String.format("%04d", part));
                if (chunk == null || !chunk.has("json")) {
                    throw new IOException("Firestore state is missing chunk " + part + " of " + storeName);
                }
                String value = chunk.get("json").getAsString();
                loadedChunks.put(storeName + "_" + String.format("%04d", part), value);
                joined.append(value);
            }
            stores.add(storeName, JsonParser.parseString(joined.toString()));
        }
        if (loadedVersion != null) {
            readObject("_meta");
            if (!loadedVersion.equals(metaUpdateTime))
                throw new IOException("Firestore changed during loading; restart and try again.");
        }
        cachedChunks.clear();
        cachedChunks.putAll(loadedChunks);
        return Optional.of(stores);
    }

    @Override public synchronized void save(JsonObject stores) throws IOException {
        if (!observedMeta) readObject("_meta");
        JsonObject previousIndex = readObject("_index");
        JsonObject index = new JsonObject();
        java.util.Map<String, JsonObject> updates = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
        java.util.List<String> deletes = new ArrayList<>();
        java.util.Map<String, String> nextChunks = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (String storeName : stores.keySet()) {
            String json = fs_gson.toJson(stores.get(storeName));
            int from = 0, part = 0;
            do {
                int to = Math.min(json.length(), from + CHUNK_CHARS);
                if (to < json.length() && to > from && Character.isHighSurrogate(json.charAt(to - 1))) to--;
                String id = storeName + "_" + String.format("%04d", part++);
                String value = json.substring(from, to);
                nextChunks.put(id, value);
                if (!value.equals(cachedChunks.get(id)))
                    updates.put(CHUNKS + "/" + id, typedFields(single("json", value)));
                from = to;
            } while (from < json.length());
            index.addProperty(storeName, part);
        }
        if (previousIndex != null) for (String name : previousIndex.keySet()) {
            int previous = previousIndex.get(name).getAsInt();
            int current = index.has(name) ? index.get(name).getAsInt() : 0;
            for (int part = current; part < previous; part++)
                deletes.add(CHUNKS + "/" + name + "_" + String.format("%04d", part));
        }
        updates.put(ROOT + "/_index", typedFields(index));
        updates.put(ROOT + "/_meta", typedFields(meta(Instant.now().toString())));
        int metaResultIndex = updates.size() - 1;
        JsonObject result = fs_client.commitDocuments(updates, deletes, ROOT + "/_meta", metaUpdateTime, metaExists);
        JsonArray results = result.has("writeResults") ? result.getAsJsonArray("writeResults") : new JsonArray();
        if (results.size() > metaResultIndex && results.get(metaResultIndex).getAsJsonObject().has("updateTime")) {
            metaUpdateTime = results.get(metaResultIndex).getAsJsonObject().get("updateTime").getAsString();
            metaExists = true;
        } else {
            observedMeta = false;
            readObject("_meta");
        }
        cachedChunks.clear();
        cachedChunks.putAll(nextChunks);
    }

    private JsonObject typedFields(JsonObject flat) {
        JsonObject typed = new JsonObject();
        for (String key : flat.keySet()) {
            JsonObject value = new JsonObject();
            JsonElement raw = flat.get(key);
            if (raw.getAsJsonPrimitive().isNumber()) value.addProperty("integerValue", raw.getAsLong());
            else value.addProperty("stringValue", raw.getAsString());
            typed.add(key, value);
        }
        return typed;
    }

    @Override public synchronized String backupNow(String reason) throws IOException {
        JsonObject state = load().orElseThrow(() -> new IOException("There is no state to back up."));
        String name = "backup-" + System.currentTimeMillis() + "-" + java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "");
        JsonObject index = new JsonObject();
        java.util.Map<String, JsonObject> updates = new java.util.LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (String store : state.keySet()) {
            String json = fs_gson.toJson(state.get(store));
            int from = 0, part = 0;
            do {
                int to = Math.min(json.length(), from + CHUNK_CHARS);
                if (to < json.length() && to > from && Character.isHighSurrogate(json.charAt(to - 1))) to--;
                String id = name + "_" + store + "_" + String.format("%04d", part++);
                updates.put("motorphBackupChunks/" + id, typedFields(single("json", json.substring(from, to))));
                from = to;
            } while (from < json.length());
            index.addProperty(store, part);
        }
        JsonObject header = new JsonObject();
        header.addProperty("index", fs_gson.toJson(index));
        header.addProperty("reason", reason == null ? "manual" : reason);
        header.addProperty("savedAt", Instant.now().toString());
        updates.put("motorphBackups/" + name, typedFields(header));
        fs_client.commitDocuments(updates, new ArrayList<>(), null, null, false);
        return name;
    }

    @Override public synchronized List<String> listBackups() throws IOException {
        List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();
        for (JsonObject doc : fs_client.listDocuments("motorphBackups")) {
            if (!doc.has("name")) continue;

    private JsonObject meta(String savedAt) {
        JsonObject object = new JsonObject();
        object.addProperty("format", FORMAT_VERSION);
        object.addProperty("savedAt", savedAt);
        return object;
    }

    private JsonObject single(String field, String value) {
        JsonObject object = new JsonObject();
        object.addProperty(field, value);
        return object;
    }

    private JsonObject readObject(String documentId) throws IOException {
        String path = ROOT;
        String id = documentId;
        if (documentId.startsWith("chunks/")) {
            path = CHUNKS;
            id = documentId.substring("chunks/".length());
        }
        JsonObject raw = fs_client.getDocument(path, id);
        if ("_meta".equals(documentId)) {
            observedMeta = true;
            metaExists = raw != null;
            metaUpdateTime = raw != null && raw.has("updateTime") ? raw.get("updateTime").getAsString() : null;
        }
        if (raw == null) return null;
        JsonObject fields = raw.has("fields") ? raw.getAsJsonObject("fields") : new JsonObject();
        JsonObject flat = new JsonObject();
        for (String key : fields.keySet()) {
            JsonObject typed = fields.getAsJsonObject(key);
            if (typed.has("stringValue")) flat.addProperty(key, typed.get("stringValue").getAsString());
            else if (typed.has("integerValue")) flat.addProperty(key, typed.get("integerValue").getAsLong());
        }
        return flat;
    }

package ph.motorph.o_oop;

import com.google.gson.Gson;
import com.google.gson.GsonBuilder;
import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import com.google.gson.TypeAdapter;
import com.google.gson.stream.JsonReader;
import com.google.gson.stream.JsonWriter;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.AtomicMoveNotSupportedException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.LocalTime;
import java.time.YearMonth;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.function.Function;

public final class LocalStateFile implements StateStore {
    public static final int FORMAT_VERSION = 1;
    
    static final int KEEP_BACKUPS = 20;
    static final long AUTO_BACKUP_MINUTES = 30;
    private static final java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter STAMP = java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyyMMdd-HHmmss-SSS")
        .withZone(java.time.ZoneId.of("Asia/Manila"));
    private final Path path;
    private Instant lastBackup;
    private final Gson gson = new GsonBuilder()
        .registerTypeAdapter(LocalDate.class, text(LocalDate::parse))
        .registerTypeAdapter(LocalTime.class, text(LocalTime::parse))
        .registerTypeAdapter(LocalDateTime.class, text(LocalDateTime::parse))
        .registerTypeAdapter(YearMonth.class, text(YearMonth::parse))
        .disableHtmlEscaping()
        .create();

    public LocalStateFile(Path path) {
        this.path = path.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
    }

    public Path path() { return path; }

    @Override public String location() { return path.toString(); }

    @Override public String describe() { return "Local file " + path; }

    @Override public String backupFolder() { return backupDirectory().toString(); }

    public Gson gson() { return gson; }

    private static <T> TypeAdapter<T> text(Function<String, T> parse) {
        return new TypeAdapter<T>() {
            @Override public void write(JsonWriter out, T value) throws IOException {
                if (value == null) out.nullValue();
                else out.value(value.toString());
            }
            @Override public T read(JsonReader in) throws IOException {
                if (in.peek() == com.google.gson.stream.JsonToken.NULL) {
                    in.nextNull();
                    return null;
                }
                return parse.apply(in.nextString());
            }
        }.nullSafe();
    }

    
    public synchronized void save(JsonObject stores) throws IOException {
        JsonObject document = new JsonObject();
        document.addProperty("format", FORMAT_VERSION);
        document.addProperty("savedAt", Instant.now().toString());
        document.add("stores", stores);
        Path parent = path.getParent();
        if (parent != null) Files.createDirectories(parent);
        Path temp = path.resolveSibling(path.getFileName() + ".tmp");
        Files.write(temp, gson.toJson(document).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        replaceWithRetry(temp);
        if (lastBackup == null) lastBackup = newestBackupTime();
        if (lastBackup == null || lastBackup.isBefore(Instant.now().minusSeconds(AUTO_BACKUP_MINUTES * 60))) backupNow("auto");
    }

    
    private void replaceWithRetry(Path temp) throws IOException {
        for (int attempt = 1; ; attempt++) {
            try {
                try {
                    Files.move(temp, path, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE);
                } catch (AtomicMoveNotSupportedException ex) {
                    Files.move(temp, path, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
                }
                return;
            } catch (java.nio.file.FileSystemException busy) { 
                if (attempt >= 5) throw busy;
                try {
                    Thread.sleep(40L * attempt);
                } catch (InterruptedException interrupted) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                    throw busy;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public Path backupDirectory() { return path.resolveSibling("backups"); }

    
    public synchronized String backupNow(String reason) throws IOException {
        if (!Files.exists(path)) throw new IOException("There is no data file to back up yet.");
        Files.createDirectories(backupDirectory());
        String name = "local-demo-" + STAMP.format(Instant.now()) + "-" + reason + ".json";
        Files.copy(path, backupDirectory().resolve(name), StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
        lastBackup = Instant.now();
        java.util.List<String> names = listBackups();
        for (String old : names.subList(Math.min(KEEP_BACKUPS, names.size()), names.size())) Files.deleteIfExists(backupDirectory().resolve(old));
        return name;
    }

    
    public synchronized java.util.List<String> listBackups() throws IOException {
        if (!Files.isDirectory(backupDirectory())) return new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        try (java.util.stream.Stream<Path> files = Files.list(backupDirectory())) {
            return files.map(LocalStateFile::fileNameOf).filter(LocalStateFile::isBackupName)
                .sorted(java.util.Comparator.reverseOrder()).collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.toList());
        }
    }

    private static String fileNameOf(Path file) {
        Path name = file.getFileName();
        return name == null ? "" : name.toString();
    }

    static boolean isBackupName(String name) { return name != null && name.matches("local-demo-\\d{8}-\\d{6}-\\d{3}-[a-z-]{1,20}\\.json"); }

    
    public synchronized JsonObject loadBackup(String name) throws IOException {
        if (!isBackupName(name) || !Files.exists(backupDirectory().resolve(name))) throw new java.util.NoSuchElementException("Backup not found.");
        return readStores(backupDirectory().resolve(name));
    }

    private Instant newestBackupTime() {
        try {
            java.util.List<String> names = listBackups();
            return names.isEmpty() ? null : Files.getLastModifiedTime(backupDirectory().resolve(names.get(0))).toInstant();
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    
    public synchronized String writeArchive(String prefix, JsonElement content) throws IOException {
        Path folder = path.resolveSibling("archive");
        Files.createDirectories(folder);
        String name = prefix + "-" + STAMP.format(Instant.now()) + ".json";
        Files.write(folder.resolve(name), gson.toJson(content).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        return name;
    }

    
    public synchronized Optional<JsonObject> load() throws IOException {
        if (!Files.exists(path)) return Optional.empty();
        return Optional.of(readStores(path));
    }

    private JsonObject readStores(Path file) throws IOException {
        JsonElement parsed = JsonParser.parseString(new String(Files.readAllBytes(file), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        if (!parsed.isJsonObject() || !parsed.getAsJsonObject().has("stores")
                || parsed.getAsJsonObject().get("format").getAsInt() != FORMAT_VERSION) {
            throw new IOException("Unknown data file format.");
        }
        return parsed.getAsJsonObject().getAsJsonObject("stores");
    }

    
    @Override public synchronized String setAside() throws IOException {
        Path aside = path.resolveSibling(path.getFileName() + ".unreadable-" + Instant.now().toEpochMilli());
        Files.move(path, aside, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
        return aside.toString();
    }
}

package ph.motorph.l_log;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

public final class AuditLog {
    static final int lg_iKeep = 1000;
    static final int lg_iBatch = 500;

    public static final class Entry {
        public final String lg_sAt, lg_sActor, lg_sMethod, lg_sPath, lg_sTarget;
        public final int lg_iStatus;

        Entry(String lg_sAt, String lg_sActor, String lg_sMethod, String lg_sPath, String lg_sTarget, int lg_iStatus) {
            this.lg_sAt = lg_sAt;
            this.lg_sActor = lg_sActor;
            this.lg_sMethod = lg_sMethod;
            this.lg_sPath = lg_sPath;
            this.lg_sTarget = lg_sTarget;
            this.lg_iStatus = lg_iStatus;
        }
    }

    public interface Archiver {
        String archive(List<Entry> oldest);
    }

    private final List<Entry> lg_lEntries = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<String> lg_lArchives = new ArrayList<>();

    public synchronized void record(String at, String actor, String method, String path, String target, int status, Archiver archiver) {
        lg_lEntries.add(new Entry(at, actor, method, path, target == null ? "" : target, status));
        if (lg_lEntries.size() > lg_iKeep) {
            List<Entry> lg_lOldest = new ArrayList<>(lg_lEntries.subList(0, lg_iBatch));
            String lg_sName = archiver == null ? null : archiver.archive(lg_lOldest);
            lg_lEntries.subList(0, lg_iBatch).clear();
            if (lg_sName != null) lg_lArchives.add(lg_sName);
        }
    }

    public synchronized List<Entry> search(String actor, String pathContains, boolean failuresOnly, int limit) {
        List<Entry> lg_lFound = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int lg_iIdx = lg_lEntries.size() - 1; lg_iIdx >= 0 && lg_lFound.size() < limit; lg_iIdx--) {
            Entry lg_eRow = lg_lEntries.get(lg_iIdx);
            if (!actor.isEmpty() && !lg_eRow.lg_sActor.equals(actor) && !lg_eRow.lg_sTarget.equals(actor)) continue;
            if (!pathContains.isEmpty() && !lg_eRow.lg_sPath.contains(pathContains)) continue;
            if (failuresOnly && lg_eRow.lg_iStatus < 400) continue;
            lg_lFound.add(lg_eRow);
        }
        return lg_lFound;
    }

    public synchronized int size() { return lg_lEntries.size(); }

    public synchronized List<String> archives() { return Collections.unmodifiableList(new ArrayList<>(lg_lArchives)); }
}

import com.sun.net.httpserver.Headers;

import com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpExchange;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
import java.net.URI;

final class BufferedExchange extends HttpExchange {
    private final HttpExchange original;
    private final ByteArrayOutputStream body = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
    private int status = -1;
    private long length;

    BufferedExchange(HttpExchange original) { this.original = original; }
    @Override public Headers getRequestHeaders() { return original.getRequestHeaders(); }
    @Override public Headers getResponseHeaders() { return original.getResponseHeaders(); }
    @Override public URI getRequestURI() { return original.getRequestURI(); }
    @Override public String getRequestMethod() { return original.getRequestMethod(); }
    @Override public HttpContext getHttpContext() { return original.getHttpContext(); }
    @Override public void close() { }
    @Override public InputStream getRequestBody() { return original.getRequestBody(); }
    @Override public OutputStream getResponseBody() { return body; }
    @Override public void sendResponseHeaders(int code, long responseLength) { status = code; length = responseLength; }
    @Override public InetSocketAddress getRemoteAddress() { return original.getRemoteAddress(); }
    @Override public int getResponseCode() { return status; }
    @Override public InetSocketAddress getLocalAddress() { return original.getLocalAddress(); }
    @Override public String getProtocol() { return original.getProtocol(); }
    @Override public Object getAttribute(String name) { return original.getAttribute(name); }
    @Override public void setAttribute(String name, Object value) { original.setAttribute(name, value); }
    @Override public void setStreams(InputStream in, OutputStream out) { throw new UnsupportedOperationException(); }
    @Override public HttpPrincipal getPrincipal() { return original.getPrincipal(); }

    void finish() throws IOException {
        if (status < 0) throw new IOException("Handler did not send a response");
        original.sendResponseHeaders(status, length < 0 ? -1 : body.size());
        if (length >= 0) try (OutputStream out = original.getResponseBody()) { body.writeTo(out); }
        else original.close();
    }
}

package ph.motorph.c_calc;

import java.time.YearMonth;

public final class PayReference2026 {
    private PayReference2026() { }

    public static StatutoryBreakdown calculate(YearMonth month, long monthlyBasicCents, long taxableBonusCents) {
        if (monthlyBasicCents <= 0 || taxableBonusCents < 0)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("The reference needs a positive monthly basic and non-negative bonus.");
        long taxable = Math.addExact(monthlyBasicCents, taxableBonusCents);
        return StatutoryCalculator2026.calculate(month, taxable, monthlyBasicCents, monthlyBasicCents,
            monthlyBasicCents, taxable, StatutoryRates.DEFAULT);
    }
}
package ph.motorph.c_calc;

import java.time.YearMonth;

public final class StatutoryCalculator2026 {
    public static final String RULESET_ID = "PH-2026-MOTORPH-ESTIMATE-v5";
    private static final long BP = 10_000;
    private static final long MAX_INPUT_CENTS = 1_000_000_000L; 

    
    
    private static final long SSS_STEP = 50_000;
    private static final long SSS_EC_THRESHOLD = 1_500_000, SSS_EC_LOW = 1_000, SSS_EC_HIGH = 3_000;

    private StatutoryCalculator2026() { }

    
    public static long parsePesoCents(String value, String field) {
        String text = value == null ? "" : value.trim().replace(",", "");
        if (!text.matches("\\d{1,12}(\\.\\d{1,2})?")) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must be a non-negative peso amount with up to two decimal places.");
        }
        String[] parts = text.split("\\.");
        String fraction = parts.length > 1 ? (parts[1] + "0").substring(0, 2) : "00";
        long cents = Long.parseLong(parts[0]) * 100 + Long.parseLong(fraction);
        if (cents > MAX_INPUT_CENTS) throw new IllegalArgumentException(field + " must be ₱10,000,000.00 or less.");
        return cents;
    }

    public static StatutoryBreakdown calculate(YearMonth period, long grossCashPayCents, long sssCompensationCents,
            long philHealthBasicSalaryCents, long pagIbigFundSalaryCents, long taxableCompensationCents) {
        return calculate(period, grossCashPayCents, sssCompensationCents, philHealthBasicSalaryCents, pagIbigFundSalaryCents,
            taxableCompensationCents, StatutoryRates.DEFAULT);
    }

    
    public static StatutoryBreakdown calculate(YearMonth period, long grossCashPayCents, long sssCompensationCents,
            long philHealthBasicSalaryCents, long pagIbigFundSalaryCents, long taxableCompensationCents, StatutoryRates rates) {
        if (period == null || period.getYear() != 2026) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("This temporary ruleset covers 2026 monthly periods only.");
        }
        for (long cents : new long[] {grossCashPayCents, sssCompensationCents, philHealthBasicSalaryCents,
                pagIbigFundSalaryCents, taxableCompensationCents}) {
            if (cents < 0 || cents > MAX_INPUT_CENTS) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Amounts must be ₱0 to ₱10,000,000.00.");
        }
        if (grossCashPayCents <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Gross cash pay must be greater than zero for this preview.");
        if (sssCompensationCents <= 0 || philHealthBasicSalaryCents <= 0 || pagIbigFundSalaryCents <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Enter a positive contribution base for SSS, PhilHealth, and Pag-IBIG.");
        }

        long msc = sssMonthlySalaryCredit(sssCompensationCents, rates);
        long sssEmployee = applyBp(msc, rates.sssEmployeeBp);
        long sssEmployer = applyBp(msc, rates.sssEmployerBp);
        long sssEc = msc < SSS_EC_THRESHOLD ? SSS_EC_LOW : SSS_EC_HIGH;

        long phBase = Math.min(Math.max(philHealthBasicSalaryCents, rates.philHealthFloor), rates.philHealthCeiling);
        long phTotal = applyBp(phBase, rates.philHealthPremiumBp);
        
        long phEmployee = applyBp(phBase, rates.philHealthPremiumBp / 2);

        long pagIbigBase = Math.min(pagIbigFundSalaryCents, rates.pagIbigCap);
        long pagIbigEmployee = applyBp(pagIbigBase, pagIbigFundSalaryCents <= rates.pagIbigLowBand ? rates.pagIbigLowBp : rates.pagIbigHighBp);
        long pagIbigEmployer = applyBp(pagIbigBase, rates.pagIbigEmployerBp);

        long employeeStatutory = sssEmployee + phEmployee + pagIbigEmployee;
        long taxable = Math.max(0, taxableCompensationCents - employeeStatutory);
        long tax = annualisedWithholding(taxable, rates);
        if (employeeStatutory + tax > grossCashPayCents) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Employee deductions exceed gross cash pay; preview blocked rather than showing negative net pay.");
        }
        return new StatutoryBreakdown(rates.id, period, grossCashPayCents, sssCompensationCents,
            philHealthBasicSalaryCents, pagIbigFundSalaryCents, taxableCompensationCents,
            msc, sssEmployee, sssEmployer, sssEc, phBase, phTotal, phEmployee,
            pagIbigBase, pagIbigEmployee, pagIbigEmployer, taxable, tax);
    }

    private static long sssMonthlySalaryCredit(long compensationCents, StatutoryRates rates) {
        long firstHigherRange = rates.sssMinMsc + SSS_STEP / 2; 
        if (compensationCents < firstHigherRange) return rates.sssMinMsc;
        long msc = rates.sssMinMsc + ((compensationCents - firstHigherRange) / SSS_STEP + 1) * SSS_STEP;
        return Math.min(msc, rates.sssMaxMsc);
    }

    
    private static long annualisedWithholding(long monthlyTaxableCents, StatutoryRates rates) {
        long annualTaxable = monthlyTaxableCents * 12;
        long[] bracket = rates.birAnnual.get(0);
        for (long[] candidate : rates.birAnnual) if (annualTaxable > candidate[0]) bracket = candidate;
        
        long annualTaxScaled = bracket[1] * BP + (annualTaxable - bracket[0]) * bracket[2];
        return roundRatio(annualTaxScaled, BP * 12);
    }

    private static long applyBp(long cents, long basisPoints) { return roundRatio(cents * basisPoints, BP); }

    private static long roundRatio(long numerator, long denominator) { return (numerator + denominator / 2) / denominator; }
}
package ph.motorph.c_calc;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.YearMonth;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;

public final class StatutoryRates {
    public final String id, note, createdBy, createdAt;
    public final YearMonth effectiveMonth;
    public final long sssEmployeeBp, sssEmployerBp, sssMinMsc, sssMaxMsc;
    public final long philHealthPremiumBp, philHealthFloor, philHealthCeiling;
    public final long pagIbigLowBand, pagIbigLowBp, pagIbigHighBp, pagIbigEmployerBp, pagIbigCap;
    
    public final List<long[]> birAnnual;

    public static final StatutoryRates DEFAULT = new StatutoryRates(StatutoryCalculator2026.RULESET_ID, YearMonth.of(2026, 1),
        "Built-in MotorPH 2026 estimate; see docs/a_doc/data-provenance.md for inputs and limits", "", "",
        500, 1_000, 500_000, 3_500_000, 500, 1_000_000, 10_000_000, 150_000, 100, 200, 200, 1_000_000,
        java.util.Arrays.asList(new long[] {0, 0, 0}, new long[] {25_000_000, 0, 1_500}, new long[] {40_000_000, 2_250_000, 2_000},
            new long[] {80_000_000, 10_250_000, 2_500}, new long[] {200_000_000, 40_250_000, 3_000}, new long[] {800_000_000, 220_250_000, 3_500}));

    StatutoryRates(String id, YearMonth effectiveMonth, String note, String createdBy, String createdAt,
            long sssEmployeeBp, long sssEmployerBp, long sssMinMsc, long sssMaxMsc,
            long philHealthPremiumBp, long philHealthFloor, long philHealthCeiling,
            long pagIbigLowBand, long pagIbigLowBp, long pagIbigHighBp, long pagIbigEmployerBp, long pagIbigCap, List<long[]> birAnnual) {
        this.id = id; this.effectiveMonth = effectiveMonth; this.note = note; this.createdBy = createdBy; this.createdAt = createdAt;
        this.sssEmployeeBp = sssEmployeeBp; this.sssEmployerBp = sssEmployerBp; this.sssMinMsc = sssMinMsc; this.sssMaxMsc = sssMaxMsc;
        this.philHealthPremiumBp = philHealthPremiumBp; this.philHealthFloor = philHealthFloor; this.philHealthCeiling = philHealthCeiling;
        this.pagIbigLowBand = pagIbigLowBand; this.pagIbigLowBp = pagIbigLowBp; this.pagIbigHighBp = pagIbigHighBp;
        this.pagIbigEmployerBp = pagIbigEmployerBp; this.pagIbigCap = pagIbigCap;
        List<long[]> rows = new ArrayList<>();
        for (long[] row : birAnnual) rows.add(row.clone());
        this.birAnnual = Collections.unmodifiableList(rows);
        validate();
    }

    private void validate() {
        for (long bp : new long[] {sssEmployeeBp, sssEmployerBp, philHealthPremiumBp, pagIbigLowBp, pagIbigHighBp, pagIbigEmployerBp}) {
            if (bp < 0 || bp > 5_000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Contribution rates must be 0% to 50%.");
        }
        if (philHealthPremiumBp % 2 != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("The PhilHealth premium must split evenly (e.g. 5.00%).");
        if (sssMinMsc <= 0 || sssMaxMsc < sssMinMsc || (sssMaxMsc - sssMinMsc) % 50_000 != 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("SSS MSC range must be positive, with the maximum at least the minimum, in ₱500 steps.");
        }
        if (philHealthFloor <= 0 || philHealthCeiling < philHealthFloor) throw new IllegalArgumentException("PhilHealth floor and ceiling must be positive, ceiling at least floor.");
        if (pagIbigLowBand < 0 || pagIbigCap <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Pag-IBIG band and cap must be positive.");
        if (birAnnual.isEmpty() || birAnnual.size() > 12 || birAnnual.get(0)[0] != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("The tax table needs 1-12 rows, the first starting at ₱0.");
        for (int i = 0; i < birAnnual.size(); i++) {
            long[] row = birAnnual.get(i);
            if (row.length != 3 || row[1] < 0 || row[2] < 0 || row[2] > 10_000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Each tax row needs over ≥ 0, base tax ≥ 0 and a rate of 0% to 100%.");
            if (i > 0 && row[0] <= birAnnual.get(i - 1)[0]) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Tax table rows must go up in income.");
        }
    }

    
    public static StatutoryRates version(String id, YearMonth effectiveMonth, String note, String createdBy,
            long sssEmployeeBp, long sssEmployerBp, long sssMinMsc, long sssMaxMsc,
            long philHealthPremiumBp, long philHealthFloor, long philHealthCeiling,
            long pagIbigLowBand, long pagIbigLowBp, long pagIbigHighBp, long pagIbigEmployerBp, long pagIbigCap, List<long[]> birAnnual) {
        if (effectiveMonth == null || effectiveMonth.getYear() != 2026) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Effective month must be in 2026.");
        return new StatutoryRates(id, effectiveMonth, note == null ? "" : note.trim(), createdBy, Instant.now().toString(),
            sssEmployeeBp, sssEmployerBp, sssMinMsc, sssMaxMsc, philHealthPremiumBp, philHealthFloor, philHealthCeiling,
            pagIbigLowBand, pagIbigLowBp, pagIbigHighBp, pagIbigEmployerBp, pagIbigCap, birAnnual);
    }

    
    public static final class Registry {
        private final List<StatutoryRates> versions = new ArrayList<>();

        public synchronized StatutoryRates ratesFor(YearMonth month) {
            StatutoryRates chosen = DEFAULT;
            for (StatutoryRates version : versions) {
                if (!version.effectiveMonth.isAfter(month) && !version.effectiveMonth.isBefore(chosen.effectiveMonth)) chosen = version;
            }
            return chosen;
        }

        public synchronized String nextId() { return "PH-2026-admin-v" + (versions.size() + 1); }

        public synchronized StatutoryRates add(StatutoryRates version) {
            for (StatutoryRates existing : versions) {
                if (existing.effectiveMonth.equals(version.effectiveMonth)) {
                    throw new IllegalStateException("A rates version already starts in " + version.effectiveMonth + "; choose another month.");
                }
            }
            versions.add(version);
            return version;
        }

        
        public synchronized List<StatutoryRates> all() {
            List<StatutoryRates> result = new ArrayList<>();
            result.add(DEFAULT);
            result.addAll(versions);
            return result;
        }
    }
}

    private static void addEarnings(JsonObject target, CutoffPay cutoff) {
        target.addProperty("overtimeMinutes", cutoff.getOvertimeMinutes());
        target.addProperty("nightDiffMinutes", cutoff.getNightDiffMinutes());
        target.addProperty("holidayDays", cutoff.getHolidayDays());
        target.addProperty("leaveDays", cutoff.getLeaveDays());
        JsonObject earnings = new JsonObject();
        earnings.addProperty("basicCents", cents(cutoff.getBasicPay()));
        earnings.addProperty("premiumCents", cents(cutoff.getPremiumPay()));
        earnings.addProperty("overtimeCents", cents(cutoff.getOvertimePay()));
        earnings.addProperty("nightDiffCents", cents(cutoff.getNightDiffPay()));
        earnings.addProperty("holidayPayCents", cents(cutoff.getHolidayPay()));
        earnings.addProperty("leavePayCents", cents(cutoff.getLeavePay()));
        target.add("earnings", earnings);
    }

    private static long cents(java.math.BigDecimal pesos) { return pesos.movePointRight(2).longValueExact(); }

    private MonthPayroll monthPayrollFor(HttpExchange exchange, String employeeId, String monthText) {
        return monthPayrollFor(exchange, employeeId, monthText, null);
    }

    private MonthPayroll monthPayrollFor(HttpExchange exchange, String employeeId, String monthText, LocalDate through) {
        if (monthText == null || !monthText.matches("20[0-9]{2}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Month must use YYYY-MM.");
        AccessPolicy.Actor actor = actorFor(exchange);
        guard(() -> AccessPolicy.requireRead(actor, AccessPolicy.Area.PAYROLL, employeeId));
        RequestServices services = servicesFor(exchange);
        AttendanceService attendanceService = new AttendanceService(services.employeeService, localScheduleStore, services.attendanceStore);
        return new CutoffPayrollService(attendanceService, workflowsFor(exchange)).withAdjustments(payrollAdjustments)
            .withSchedules(workSchedules, salaryHistory)
            .withEmployment(hrRecords)
            .withRates(statutoryRates)
            .payrollForMonth(employeeId, java.time.YearMonth.parse(monthText), through);
    }

    private void handlePayrollStatutory(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!"POST".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
            return;
        }
        try {
            AccessPolicy.Actor actor = actorFor(exchange);
            guard(() -> AccessPolicy.requireArea(actor, AccessPolicy.Area.STATUTORY));
            JsonObject body = readJsonBody(exchange);
            requireOnlyKeys(body, "period", "grossCashPay", "sssCompensation", "philHealthBasicSalary",
                "pagIbigFundSalary", "taxableCompensation");
            String periodText = requiredString(body, "period");
            if (!periodText.matches("20[0-9]{2}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Month must use YYYY-MM.");
            StatutoryBreakdown result = StatutoryCalculator2026.calculate(java.time.YearMonth.parse(periodText),
                StatutoryCalculator2026.parsePesoCents(requiredString(body, "grossCashPay"), "Gross cash pay"),
                StatutoryCalculator2026.parsePesoCents(requiredString(body, "sssCompensation"), "SSS compensation base"),
                StatutoryCalculator2026.parsePesoCents(requiredString(body, "philHealthBasicSalary"), "PhilHealth monthly basic salary"),
                StatutoryCalculator2026.parsePesoCents(requiredString(body, "pagIbigFundSalary"), "Pag-IBIG Fund Salary"),
                StatutoryCalculator2026.parsePesoCents(requiredString(body, "taxableCompensation"), "Taxable compensation before employee contributions"),
                statutoryRates.ratesFor(java.time.YearMonth.parse(periodText)));
            JsonObject response = new JsonObject();
            response.add("result", statutoryToJson(result));
            response.addProperty("saved", false);
            sendJson(exchange, 200, response.toString());
        } catch (RequestException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, ex.statusCode, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            sendJson(exchange, 400, "{\"error\":\"" + escapeJson(ex.getMessage()) + "\"}");
        }
    }

    
    private static JsonObject statutoryToJson(StatutoryBreakdown r) {
        JsonObject sss = new JsonObject();

        JsonObject item = new JsonObject();

        item.addProperty("period", r.period.toString());
        item.addProperty("grossCashPayCents", r.grossCashPayCents);

        item.addProperty("totalEmployerContributionsCents", r.totalEmployerContributionsCents());
        item.addProperty("employerCashCostCents", r.employerCashCostCents());
        return item;
    }

package ph.motorph.c_calc;

import java.time.YearMonth;

public final class StatutoryBreakdown {
    public final String rulesetId;
    public final YearMonth period;
    public final long grossCashPayCents;
    public final long sssCompensationCents;
    public final long philHealthBasicSalaryCents;
    public final long pagIbigFundSalaryCents;
    public final long taxableCompensationCents;
    public final long sssMscCents;
    public final long sssEmployeeCents;
    public final long sssEmployerRegularCents;
    public final long sssEcCents;
    public final long philHealthPremiumBaseCents;
    public final long philHealthTotalPremiumCents;
    public final long philHealthEmployeeCents;
    public final long philHealthEmployerCents;
    public final long pagIbigBaseCents;
    public final long pagIbigEmployeeCents;
    public final long pagIbigEmployerCents;
    public final long taxableAfterEmployeeContributionsCents;
    public final long withholdingTaxCents;

    StatutoryBreakdown(String rulesetId, YearMonth period, long grossCashPayCents, long sssCompensationCents,
            long philHealthBasicSalaryCents, long pagIbigFundSalaryCents, long taxableCompensationCents,
            long sssMscCents, long sssEmployeeCents, long sssEmployerRegularCents, long sssEcCents,
            long philHealthPremiumBaseCents, long philHealthTotalPremiumCents, long philHealthEmployeeCents,
            long pagIbigBaseCents, long pagIbigEmployeeCents, long pagIbigEmployerCents,
            long taxableAfterEmployeeContributionsCents, long withholdingTaxCents) {
        this.rulesetId = rulesetId;
        this.period = period;

package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.util.Base64;

public final class SessionCookie {
    
    public static final String CSRF_COOKIE = "motorph_csrf";
    public static final String CSRF_HEADER = "X-CSRF-Token";
    private static final int CSRF_BYTES = 32;

    private static final SecureRandom RANDOM = new SecureRandom();

    private SessionCookie() {}

    
    public static String newCsrfToken() {
        byte[] bytes = new byte[CSRF_BYTES];
        RANDOM.nextBytes(bytes);
        return Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(bytes);
    }

    
    public static String sessionCookie(String token, int maxAgeSeconds, boolean secure) {
        return AuthService.COOKIE + "=" + token
            + "; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=" + maxAgeSeconds + (secure ? "; Secure" : "");
    }

    
    public static String csrfCookie(String csrfToken, int maxAgeSeconds, boolean secure) {
        return CSRF_COOKIE + "=" + csrfToken
            + "; Path=/; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=" + maxAgeSeconds + (secure ? "; Secure" : "");
    }

    
    public static String[] clearCookies(boolean secure) {
        return new String[] {
            AuthService.COOKIE + "=; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=0" + (secure ? "; Secure" : ""),
            CSRF_COOKIE + "=; Path=/; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=0" + (secure ? "; Secure" : "")
        };
    }

    
    public static String read(String cookieHeader, String name) {
        if (cookieHeader == null || cookieHeader.isEmpty()) return null;
        for (String pair : cookieHeader.split(";")) {
            int equals = pair.indexOf('=');
            if (equals < 0) continue;
            if (pair.substring(0, equals).trim().equals(name)) return pair.substring(equals + 1).trim();
        }
        return null;
    }

    
    public static boolean csrfMatches(String cookieToken, String headerToken) {
        if (cookieToken == null || headerToken == null) return false;
        return MessageDigest.isEqual(cookieToken.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8), headerToken.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }
}

public static final class SignIn {
        public final String token, employeeId, role;
        public final boolean mustChangePassword;
        public final String error;

        private SignIn(String token, String employeeId, String role, boolean mustChangePassword, String error) {
            this.token = token; this.employeeId = employeeId; this.role = role;
            this.mustChangePassword = mustChangePassword; this.error = error;
        }
        static SignIn failed(String error) { return new SignIn("", "", "", false, error); }
        public boolean ok() { return error.isEmpty(); }
    }

    
    /** Step one: the password. Returns a challenge, never a session. */
    public SignIn signIn(String employeeId, String password) {
        String id = employeeId == null ? "" : employeeId.trim();
        if (!id.matches("[0-9]{5}")) return SignIn.failed("Employee numbers are five digits, for example 10015.");
        CredentialStore.Result result = credentials.signIn(id, password);
        if (!result.ok) {
            return SignIn.failed("locked".equals(result.reason)
                ? "Too many incorrect attempts. Try again in a few minutes."
                : "The employee number or password is incorrect.");
        }
        Employee employee = chart.employee(id).orElse(null);
        if (employee == null) return SignIn.failed("The employee number or password is incorrect.");
        TwoFactor.Started started = twoFactor.start(id, "", codeMinutes);
        return new SignIn(started.challengeId, id, AccessPolicy.roleOf(id).label, result.account.mustChangePassword(), "");
    }

    /** Step two: the code. This is where the session is actually issued. */
    public SignIn verifyCode(String challengeId, String code) {
        String employeeId;
        try {
            employeeId = twoFactor.verify(challengeId, code);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException | IllegalStateException refused) {
            return SignIn.failed(refused.getMessage());
        }
        Employee employee = chart.employee(employeeId).orElse(null);
        if (employee == null) return SignIn.failed("The employee number or password is incorrect.");
        String token = sessions.issue(employeeId);
        boolean mustChange = credentials.account(employeeId).map(Account::mustChangePassword).orElse(false);
        return new SignIn(token, employeeId, AccessPolicy.roleOf(employeeId).label, mustChange, "");
    }

    
    public Optional<Employee> currentEmployee(String token) {
        return sessions.resolve(token).flatMap(record -> chart.employee(record.employeeId));
    }

    public Optional<SessionRecord> currentSession(String token) { return sessions.resolve(token); }

    public void signOut(String token) { sessions.revoke(token); }

    
    public String changePassword(String token, String currentPassword, String newPassword) {
        Optional<SessionRecord> record = sessions.resolve(token);
        if (!record.isPresent()) return null;
        String employeeId = record.get().employeeId;
        if (!credentials.changePassword(employeeId, currentPassword, newPassword)) return null;
        sessions.revokeAllFor(employeeId);
        return sessions.issue(employeeId);
    }

    
    public boolean resetPassword(String employeeId) {
package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;

public final class SessionStore {
    public static final int IDLE_MINUTES = 15;
    public static final int ABSOLUTE_HOURS = 8;

    private static final SecureRandom RANDOM = new SecureRandom();

    private final Map<String, SessionRecord> byTokenHash = java.util.Collections.synchronizedMap(new LinkedHashMap<>());
    private final Clock clock;
    private final int idleMinutes, absoluteHours;

    public SessionStore() { this(Clock.systemDefaultZone(), IDLE_MINUTES, ABSOLUTE_HOURS); }
    public SessionStore(Clock clock) { this(clock, IDLE_MINUTES, ABSOLUTE_HOURS); }
    public SessionStore(Clock clock, int idleMinutes, int absoluteHours) {
        this.clock = clock;
        this.idleMinutes = idleMinutes;
        this.absoluteHours = absoluteHours;
    }

    public int idleMinutes() { return idleMinutes; }
    public int absoluteHours() { return absoluteHours; }

    
    public String issue(String employeeId) {
        byte[] raw = new byte[32];
        RANDOM.nextBytes(raw);
        String token = Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(raw);
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        byTokenHash.put(hash(token), new SessionRecord(hash(token), employeeId, now,
            now.plus(Duration.ofHours(absoluteHours)), idleMinutes));
        prune(now);
        return token;
    }

    
    public Optional<SessionRecord> resolve(String token) {
        if (token == null || token.isEmpty()) return Optional.empty();
        SessionRecord record = byTokenHash.get(hash(token));
        if (record == null) return Optional.empty();
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        String expired = record.expiredReason(now);
        if (expired != null) {
            byTokenHash.remove(record.tokenHash);
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        record.touch(now);
        return Optional.of(record);
    }

    
    public void revoke(String token) {
        if (token == null) return;
        byTokenHash.remove(hash(token));
    }

    
    public int revokeAllFor(String employeeId) {
        int removed = 0;
        List<String> keys = new ArrayList<>(byTokenHash.keySet());
        for (String key : keys) {
            SessionRecord record = byTokenHash.get(key);
            if (record != null && record.employeeId.equals(employeeId)) {
                byTokenHash.remove(key);
                removed++;
            }
        }
        return removed;
    }

    
    public long idleSecondsLeft(String token) {
        SessionRecord record = byTokenHash.get(hash(token));
        if (record == null) return 0;
        long seconds = Duration.between(clock.instant(), record.lastActive().plusSeconds(idleMinutes * 60L)).getSeconds();
        return Math.max(0, seconds);
    }

    
    public int sweep() {
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        int before = byTokenHash.size();
        prune(now);
        return before - byTokenHash.size();
    }

    public void revokeAll() { byTokenHash.clear(); }

    public int size() { return byTokenHash.size(); }

    private void prune(Instant now) {
        byTokenHash.values().removeIf(record -> record.expiredReason(now) != null);
    }

    
    static String hash(String token) {
        try {
            byte[] digest = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(token.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            StringBuilder hex = new StringBuilder(digest.length * 2);
            for (byte b : digest) hex.append(String.format("%02x", b));
            return hex.toString();
        } catch (java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException ex) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("SHA-256 is required", ex);
        }
    }
}

    private AccessPolicy.Actor actorFromCookie(HttpExchange exchange) {
        if (authService == null) return null;
        String token = SessionCookie.read(exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Cookie"), AuthService.COOKIE);
        if (token == null || token.isEmpty()) return null;
        return authService.currentEmployee(token)
            .map(employee -> new AccessPolicy.Actor(employee.getId(), AccessPolicy.roleOf(employee.getId()), true))
            .orElse(null);
    }

    private RemoteResponse request(Input input) throws IOException {
        CookieManager cookies = new CookieManager(null, CookiePolicy.ACCEPT_ALL);
        HttpClient client = HttpClient.newBuilder().cookieHandler(cookies).followRedirects(HttpClient.Redirect.NEVER)
            .connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(4)).build();
        HttpRequest homepage = HttpRequest.newBuilder(endpoint).timeout(timeout)
            .header("User-Agent", "MotorPH-Reference-Comparison/1.0")
            .header("Accept", "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8")
            .GET().build();
        HttpResponse<InputStream> page = send(client, homepage, "homepage GET");
        try (InputStream body = page.body()) {
            readLimited(body);
        }
        if (page.statusCode() < 200 || page.statusCode() >= 300 || !sameOrigin(endpoint, page.uri()))
            throw new IOException("Sweldong homepage session request failed or redirected; no payroll input was sent.");

        String form = requestPayload(input).entrySet().stream()
            .map(entry -> encode(entry.getKey()) + "=" + encode(entry.getValue().getAsString()))
            .collect(Collectors.joining("&"));
        HttpRequest post = HttpRequest.newBuilder(endpoint).timeout(timeout)
            .header("User-Agent", "MotorPH-Reference-Comparison/1.0")
            .header("Accept", "application/json")
            .header("Origin", origin(endpoint))
            .header("Referer", endpoint.toString())
            .header("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8")
            .POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(form, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)).build();
        HttpResponse<InputStream> response = send(client, post, "calculator POST");
        byte[] bytes;
        try (InputStream body = response.body()) {
            bytes = readLimited(body);
        }
        if (response.statusCode() < 200 || response.statusCode() >= 300 || !sameOrigin(endpoint, response.uri()))
            throw new IOException("Sweldong calculator request failed or redirected; no result was accepted.");
        String contentType = response.headers().firstValue("Content-Type").orElse("");
        if (!contentType.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("json"))
            throw new IOException("Sweldong did not return JSON; no result was accepted.");
        String raw = new String(bytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        JsonObject json;
        try {
            JsonElement parsed = JsonParser.parseString(raw);
            if (!parsed.isJsonObject()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("not an object");
            json = parsed.getAsJsonObject();
        } catch (RuntimeException invalid) {
            throw new IOException("Sweldong returned malformed JSON; no result was accepted.");
        }
        if (!json.has("status") || !"OK".equals(json.get("status").getAsString()))
            throw new IOException("Sweldong did not return status OK; no result was accepted.");
        ValidatedResult primary = validateResult(json.get("result"), "result");
        ValidatedResult alternate = json.has("altresult") && json.get("altresult").isJsonObject()
            ? validateResult(json.get("altresult"), "altresult") : null;
        boolean same = alternate != null && primary.cents.equals(alternate.cents);
        boolean inputMatched = primary.cents.get("basic_pay") == input.basicPayCents
            && primary.cents.get("taxable_allowance") == input.taxableAllowanceCents
            && primary.cents.get("nontaxable_allowance") == input.nontaxableAllowanceCents
            && primary.cents.get("night_differential") == 0
            && primary.cents.get("overtime_pay") == 0;
        Set<String> names = new LinkedHashSet<>();
        for (HttpCookie cookie : cookies.getCookieStore().getCookies()) names.add(cookie.getName());
        return new RemoteResponse(response.statusCode(), contentType, names, raw, json, primary.raw, alternate == null ? null : alternate.raw,
            same, inputMatched, primary.cents);
    }

    private static HttpResponse<InputStream> send(HttpClient client, HttpRequest request, String operation) throws IOException {
        try { return client.send(request, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofInputStream()); }
        catch (InterruptedException ex) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            throw new IOException("Sweldong " + operation + " was interrupted; no result was accepted.");
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            throw new IOException("Sweldong " + operation + " failed; no result was accepted.", ex);
        }
    }

    private static byte[] readLimited(InputStream body) throws IOException {
        ByteArrayOutputStream bytes = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
        int total = 0;
        for (int count; (count = body.read(buffer)) != -1;) {
            total += count;
            if (total > MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES) throw new IOException("Sweldong response exceeded the safety limit; no result was accepted.");
            bytes.write(buffer, 0, count);
        }
        return bytes.toByteArray();
    }

    private static JsonObject requestPayload(Input input) {
        JsonObject payload = new JsonObject();
        payload.addProperty("employment_type", "Private Employee");
        payload.addProperty("pay_period", "Monthly");
        payload.addProperty("payroll_period_daily_days", Integer.toString(input.dailyDays));
        payload.addProperty("basic_pay", peso(input.basicPayCents));
        payload.addProperty("taxable_allowance", peso(input.taxableAllowanceCents));
        payload.addProperty("nontaxable_allowance", peso(input.nontaxableAllowanceCents));

const TAB_KEY = 'motorph-tab-';
const ALL_KEY = 'motorph-all-sections';

export function parseTabs(spec) {
  return String(spec || '').split('|').map(part => part.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(part => {
    const [key, ...label] = part.split(':');
    return { key: key.trim(), label: label.join(':').trim() || key.trim() };
  });
}

export function firstSentence(text) {
  const clean = String(text || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  const match = clean.match(/^(.+?[.!?])(\s|$)/);
  return match ? match[1] : clean;
}

export function badgeCount(elements) {
  let count = 0;
  elements.forEach(element => {
    count += element.querySelectorAll('button[aria-label^="Approve "]').length;
    count += [...element.querySelectorAll('td')].filter(cell => cell.textContent.startsWith('Failed:')).length;
  });
  return count;
}

const available = element => !element.hidden && !element.classList.contains('role-hidden');

function shortenIntros(page) {
  page.querySelectorAll('p.payroll-preview-intro, p.processing-note:not([id]):not([role]), .notice > p').forEach(paragraph => {
    if (paragraph.dataset.shortened || paragraph.textContent.trim().length < 140) return;
    paragraph.dataset.shortened = 'true';
    const short = document.createElement('p');
    short.className = `${paragraph.className} intro-short`;
    short.textContent = firstSentence(paragraph.textContent);
    const more = document.createElement('details');
    more.className = 'intro-more';
    const summary = document.createElement('summary');
    summary.textContent = 'How this works';
    paragraph.replaceWith(short);
    more.append(summary, paragraph);
    short.after(more);
  });
}

export function initPageTabs(root = document) {
  const pages = [...root.querySelectorAll('.page-view[data-tabs]')];
  const state = new Map();

  function showAll() { return window.localStorage.getItem(ALL_KEY) === 'true'; }

  function apply(page) {
    const entry = state.get(page);
    const tabbed = [...page.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]')];
    const keysOf = element => element.dataset.tab.split(/\s+/);
    const usable = entry.tabs.filter(tab => tabbed.some(element => keysOf(element).includes(tab.key) && available(element)
      && (!element.parentElement.closest('[data-tab-group]') || available(element.parentElement.closest('[data-tab-group]')))));
    let active = entry.active;
    if (!usable.some(tab => tab.key === active)) active = usable.length ? usable[0].key : '';
    entry.active = active;
    const all = showAll();
    entry.observer.disconnect();
    tabbed.forEach(element => element.classList.toggle('tab-off', !all && !keysOf(element).includes(active)));
    page.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-group]').forEach(group => {
      const anyOn = [...group.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]')].some(element => !element.classList.contains('tab-off') && available(element));
      group.classList.toggle('tab-off', !all && !anyOn);
    });
    entry.bar.hidden = usable.length < 2 && !all;
    entry.buttons.forEach((button, key) => {
      const tab = entry.tabs.find(item => item.key === key);
      button.hidden = !usable.includes(tab);
      const selected = !all && key === active;
      button.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(selected));
      button.tabIndex = selected || (all && key === usable[0]?.key) ? 0 : -1;
      const count = badgeCount(tabbed.filter(element => keysOf(element).includes(key) && available(element)));
      const badge = button.querySelector('.tab-badge');
      badge.textContent = count ? String(count) : '';
      badge.hidden = !count;
      button.setAttribute('aria-label', count ? `${tab.label} (${count} waiting)` : tab.label);
    });
    entry.allToggle.textContent = all ? 'Show one section at a time' : 'Show all sections';
    entry.allToggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(all));
    entry.observer.observe(page, { subtree: true, childList: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['hidden', 'class'] });
  }

  function select(page, key, focus = false) {
    const entry = state.get(page);
    entry.active = key;
    window.sessionStorage.setItem(TAB_KEY + page.id, key);
    if (showAll()) window.localStorage.setItem(ALL_KEY, 'false');
    pages.forEach(apply);
    if (focus) entry.buttons.get(key).focus();
  }

  pages.forEach(page => {
    shortenIntros(page);
    const tabs = parseTabs(page.dataset.tabs);
    const bar = document.createElement('div');
    bar.className = 'page-tabs';
    const list = document.createElement('div');
    list.className = 'page-tab-list';
    list.setAttribute('role', 'tablist');
    list.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Sections on this page');
    const buttons = new Map();
    tabs.forEach(tab => {
      const button = document.createElement('button');
      button.type = 'button';
      button.className = 'page-tab';
      button.setAttribute('role', 'tab');
      button.dataset.tabKey = tab.key;
      const label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = tab.label;
      const badge = document.createElement('span');
      badge.className = 'tab-badge';
      badge.hidden = true;
      button.append(label, badge);
      button.addEventListener('click', () => select(page, tab.key));
      button.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
        if (!['ArrowRight', 'ArrowLeft', 'Home', 'End'].includes(event.key)) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        const visible = [...buttons.values()].filter(item => !item.hidden);
        const index = visible.indexOf(button);
        const next = event.key === 'Home' ? visible[0] : event.key === 'End' ? visible[visible.length - 1]
          : visible[(index + (event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1) + visible.length) % visible.length];
        select(page, next.dataset.tabKey, true);
      });
      buttons.set(tab.key, button);
      list.append(button);
    });
    const allToggle = document.createElement('button');
    allToggle.type = 'button';
    allToggle.className = 'page-tabs-all';
    allToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
      window.localStorage.setItem(ALL_KEY, String(!showAll()));
      pages.forEach(apply);
    });
    bar.append(list, allToggle);
    const anchor = page.querySelector(':scope > .notice') || page.querySelector(':scope > .page-heading');
    if (anchor) anchor.after(bar);
    else page.prepend(bar);
    let pending = false;
    const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
      if (pending) return;
      pending = true;
      window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        pending = false;
        apply(page);
      });
    });
    state.set(page, { tabs, bar, buttons, allToggle, observer, active: window.sessionStorage.getItem(TAB_KEY + page.id) || tabs[0]?.key || '' });
  });
  pages.forEach(apply);

  return {
    refresh: () => pages.forEach(apply),
    
    reveal(element) {
      const page = element.closest('.page-view[data-tabs]');
      const holder = element.closest('[data-tab]');
      if (page && holder) select(page, holder.dataset.tab.split(/\s+/)[0]);
    }
  };
}
import { formatPesoCents, parsePesoCents, statutoryFromApi } from './PayrollPreview2026.js';

const hours = minutes => (minutes / 60).toFixed(2);

function hoursText(paidMinutes, overageMinutes = 0, overtimeMinutes = 0) {
  let text = hours(paidMinutes);
  if (overtimeMinutes > 0) text += ` + ${hours(overtimeMinutes)} OT`;
  if (overageMinutes > 0) text += ` (+${hours(overageMinutes)} unapproved, unpaid)`;
  return text;
}

const EARNING_LINES = [
  ['basicCents', 'Basic pay (hours worked)'],
  ['premiumCents', 'Rest-day / holiday premium'],
  ['overtimeCents', 'Overtime (approved)'],
  ['nightDiffCents', 'Night differential (22:00–06:00)'],
  ['holidayPayCents', 'Regular holiday pay (not worked)'],
  ['leavePayCents', 'Paid leave']
];

export function buildCutoffPayroll(payload) {
  if (!payload || !Array.isArray(payload.cutoffs) || payload.cutoffs.length !== 2) {
    throw new TypeError('Unexpected payroll response.');
  }
  const cutoffs = payload.cutoffs.map(cutoff => {
    const money = statutoryFromApi({ deductionsCents: cutoff.deductionsCents,
      ...(cutoff.netCents === null ? {} : { netCents: cutoff.netCents }) });
    return {
      label: cutoff.label === '1-15' ? '1–15' : '16–end',
      from: cutoff.from,
      to: cutoff.to,
      daysWithRecords: cutoff.daysWithRecords,
      hours: hoursText(cutoff.paidMinutes, cutoff.unpaidOverageMinutes, cutoff.overtimeMinutes),
      grossCents: parsePesoCents(cutoff.grossPay, 'Cutoff gross')
        + BigInt(cutoff.bonusCents || 0) + BigInt(cutoff.allowanceCents || 0),
      deductionsCents: money.deductionsCents,
      netCents: cutoff.blocked ? null : money.netCents,
      blockedReason: cutoff.blocked
        ? `Deductions ${formatPesoCents(money.deductionsCents)} exceed this cutoff's gross; net not shown rather than negative.`
        : ''
    };
  });
  return {
    month: payload.month,
    hourlyRate: payload.hourlyRate,
    monthlyBasic: payload.monthlyBasic,
    monthlyGrossCents: parsePesoCents(payload.monthlyGross, 'Monthly gross'),
    statutory: payload.statutory ? statutoryFromApi(payload.statutory) : null,
    cutoffs
  };
}

804-              <p><strong>Pag-IBIG:</strong> MFS ceiling ₱10,000; employee 1% at or below ₱1,500 and 2% above ₱1,500; employer 2%. <a href="https://www.pagibigfund.gov.ph/documents/Circular%20No.%20460%20-%20Guidelines%20on%20the%20Pag-IBIG%20Fund's%20Implementation%20of%20Increase%20in%20the%20MFS%20Effective%20February%202024.pdf">Circular No. 460</a></p>
805-              <p><strong>Reference:</strong> the current preview is a MotorPH implementation based on the cited statutory material. A set of historical comparison figures exists in tests, but raw site requests/responses and independently verified parity evidence are not retained. Do not treat them as proof that this implementation matches <a href="https://www.sweldongpinoy.com/">Sweldong Pinoy</a>. <strong>BIR:</strong> this preview annualises 12 × monthly taxable pay through the RR 11-2018 annual table (2023 onward), then divides by 12. It does not add 13th-month or other annual adjustments. <a href="https://bir-cdn.bir.gov.ph/local/pdf/Annex%20E%20RR%2011-2018.pdf">BIR Annex E</a></p>
806-              <p>All bases are typed separately by the user, and centavo rounding is a provisional half-up rule. No employee status, eligibility, semi-monthly deduction split, non-cash benefits, 13th-month annualisation, or tax adjustment is inferred.</p>

    private void handleBranches(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!"GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            
            if ("POST".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())
                    && "/api/admin/sweldong/compare".equals(exchange.getRequestURI().getPath())) {
                synchronized (stateLock) {
                    if (persistenceBroken) {
                        sendError(exchange, 503, "Saving is unavailable. Contact the administrator before retrying.");
                        return;
                    }
                }
                // The third-party request is intentionally outside stateLock so a slow or
                // unavailable reference site cannot block attendance/payroll application writes.
                BufferedExchange referenceResponse = new BufferedExchange(exchange);
                try {
                    handler.handle(referenceResponse);
                } catch (IOException failedRequest) {
                    sendError(referenceResponse, 502, "Sweldong reference request failed; no result was accepted.");
                }
                synchronized (stateLock) {
                    JsonObject beforeAudit = dataFile == null ? null : exportState();
                    if (persistenceBroken) {
                        referenceResponse.resetResponse();
                        sendError(referenceResponse, 503, "Application storage failed during the reference check; no result was returned.");
                    }
                    int status = referenceResponse.getResponseCode();
                    audit(referenceResponse, status);
                    if (dataFile != null && !persistenceBroken) {
                        try {
                            forceSave();
                        } catch (RuntimeException failure) {
                            persistenceBroken = true;
                            if (beforeAudit != null) importAudit(beforeAudit);
                            referenceResponse.resetResponse();
                            sendError(referenceResponse, 503, "The comparison audit could not be saved; application writes are paused.");
                        }
                    }
                }
                referenceResponse.finish();
                return;
            }

            synchronized (stateLock) {
                if (persistenceBroken) {
                    sendError(exchange, 503, "Saving is unavailable. Contact the administrator before retrying.");
                    return;
                }
                BufferedExchange buffered = new BufferedExchange(exchange);
                com.google.gson.Gson rosterGson = (dataFile != null ? dataFile : new LocalStateFile(Paths.get("unused.json"))).gson();
                String rosterBefore = rosterGson.toJson(localEmployeeStore);
                JsonObject before = dataFile == null || deferSaves ? null : exportState();
                handler.handle(buffered);
                if (Boolean.TRUE.equals(buffered.getAttribute("storageVerificationAbort"))) {
                    buffered.finish();
                    return;
                }
                if (!rosterBefore.equals(rosterGson.toJson(localEmployeeStore))) {
                    provisionNewEmployees();
                    bindPolicyToRoster();
                }
                int status = buffered.getResponseCode();
                audit(buffered, status);
                if (deferSaves) {
                    saveDataFile();
                } else if (dataFile != null) {
                    try {
                        forceSave();
                    } catch (RuntimeException failure) {
                        persistenceBroken = true;
                        try { importState(before); importAudit(before); }
                        catch (RuntimeException rollback) { System.err.println("Could not restore in-memory state after save failure: " + rollback); }
                        System.err.println("Persistence failed; writes are disabled until restart: " + failure.getMessage());
                        exchange.getResponseHeaders().clear();
                        sendError(exchange, 503, "Saving failed. The result is uncertain; contact the administrator before retrying.");

## System configuration (System Admin only, `403` otherwise)
2
+
3
+
- `GET /api/admin/storage` reports configured backend (`file`, `memory`, `firestore`), durability/write readiness, in-process store and aggregate counts, and this process's last successful verification. Counts alone are not a remote read check.
4
+
- `POST /api/admin/storage/verify` `{confirm: "VERIFY"}` performs a serialized configured-store read/compare, unchanged-snapshot write, and read-back. A missing/mismatched snapshot or ambiguous read/write result pauses writes; pre-write mismatch is not overwritten. Failure audit is visible only in the current process if the store cannot safely be written. See [storage verification](a_doc/storage-verification.md).
5
+
- `POST /api/admin/sweldong/compare` `{confirm: "SEND_TO_SWELDONG", period, employmentType, payPeriod, dailyDays, basicPay, taxableAllowance, nontaxableAllowance, nightDifferentialHours, nightDifferentialRate, overtimeHours, overtimeRate, workSchedule}` sends one explicitly approved, supported manual input to the observed homepage form. Current scope is 2026 Private Employee / Monthly / 20-day / 5-day schedule and zero ND/OT only. It returns a validated raw/normalized comparison report; it never saves payroll. This undocumented external call requires admin session and CSRF, runs outside the state lock, and stores only a normal audit event (not inputs/results).
