#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Browser-free diagnostic for the captured Sweldong Pinoy form POST.

This is an operator-run probe, not a supported API client or a MotorPH payroll fallback.
It sends the amounts passed on the command line to Sweldong Pinoy. Use test figures unless
external transmission of actual payroll inputs is approved.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import http.cookiejar
import json
import re
import sys
import urllib.error
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation, ROUND_HALF_UP
from typing import Any
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

SITE_URL = "https://www.sweldongpinoy.com/"
USER_AGENT = "MotorPH-Reference-Probe/1.0"
MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES = 256_000
EMPLOYMENT_TYPES = (
    "Private Employee", "Government Employee", "Self-Employed Individual",
    "Minimum Wage Employee", "Domestic Worker", "RHQ/ROHQ Employee",
)
PAY_PERIODS = ("Daily", "Weekly", "Semi-Monthly", "Monthly")
REQUIRED_RESULT = (
    "basic_pay", "taxable_allowance", "nontaxable_allowance", "night_differential",
    "overtime_pay", "gross_pay", "sss_gsis_contribution", "philhealth_contribution",
    "pagibig_contribution", "withholding_tax", "total_deductions", "net_pay",
)


class ProbeError(Exception):
    """An endpoint, transport, or response-validation failure."""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ProbeReply:
    status_code: int
    content_type: str
    cookie_names: tuple[str, ...]
    result: dict[str, Any]
    altresult: dict[str, Any] | None


def money_text(value: str, name: str) -> str:
    text = str(value or "").strip().replace(",", "")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{1,10}(?:\.\d{1,2})?", text):
        raise ProbeError(f"{name} must be a non-negative peso amount with up to two decimals.")
    amount = Decimal(text)
    return f"{amount:,.2f}"


def quantity_text(value: str, name: str, maximum: Decimal = Decimal("1000000")) -> str:
    text = str(value or "").strip()
    if text == "":
        return ""
    if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{1,8}(?:\.\d{1,2})?", text):
        raise ProbeError(f"{name} must be a non-negative number with up to two decimals.")
    amount = Decimal(text)
    if amount > maximum:
        raise ProbeError(f"{name} is outside the supported probe range.")
    return f"{amount:.2f}"


def make_payload(args: argparse.Namespace) -> dict[str, str]:
    if args.employment_type not in EMPLOYMENT_TYPES:
        raise ProbeError("Unsupported employment type.")
    if args.pay_period not in PAY_PERIODS:
        raise ProbeError("Unsupported payroll period.")
        raise ProbeError(f"Response field {name} is not a valid monetary value.") from exc
    if not amount.is_finite() or amount < 0 or amount > Decimal("10000000000"):
        raise ProbeError(f"Response field {name} is outside the supported monetary range.")
    return int(amount * 100)


def validate_result(value: Any, label: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ProbeError(f"Response {label} is missing or is not an object.")
    for field in REQUIRED_RESULT:
        if field not in value:
            raise ProbeError(f"Response {label} is missing {field}.")
        cents(value[field], field)
    amount = {field: cents(value[field], field) for field in REQUIRED_RESULT}
    gross_parts = sum(amount[name] for name in (
        "basic_pay", "taxable_allowance", "nontaxable_allowance", "night_differential", "overtime_pay"))
    contributions = sum(amount[name] for name in (
        "sss_gsis_contribution", "philhealth_contribution", "pagibig_contribution", "withholding_tax"))
    if abs(amount["gross_pay"] - gross_parts) > 1:
        raise ProbeError(f"Response {label} does not balance gross pay against its returned components.")
    if abs(amount["total_deductions"] - contributions) > 1:
        raise ProbeError(f"Response {label} does not balance total deductions against its returned components.")
    if abs(amount["net_pay"] - (amount["gross_pay"] - amount["total_deductions"])) > 1:
        raise ProbeError(f"Response {label} does not balance net pay against gross and deductions.")
    return value


def read_limited(response: Any) -> bytes:
    body = response.read(MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES + 1)
    if len(body) > MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES:
        raise ProbeError("Calculator response exceeded the 256 KB safety limit.")
    return body


def origin(url: str) -> str:
    parsed = urlsplit(url)
    return f"{parsed.scheme}://{parsed.netloc}"


def request_calculation(url: str, payload: dict[str, str], timeout: float = 20.0,
                        opener: urllib.request.OpenerDirector | None = None) -> ProbeReply:
    endpoint = validate_endpoint(url)
    cookie_jar = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
    client = opener or urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(cookie_jar))
    if opener is not None:
        cookie_processor = getattr(opener, "_motorph_cookie_jar", None)
        if cookie_processor is not None:
            cookie_jar = cookie_processor

    get_request = urllib.request.Request(endpoint, headers={
        "User-Agent": USER_AGENT,
        "Accept": "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8",
    })
    try:
        with client.open(get_request, timeout=timeout) as page:
            if not 200 <= page.status < 300:
                raise ProbeError(f"Homepage GET failed with HTTP {page.status}.")
            if origin(page.geturl()) != origin(endpoint):
                raise ProbeError("Homepage redirected to a different origin; refusing to send the payload.")
            read_limited(page)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        raise ProbeError(f"Homepage GET failed with HTTP {exc.code}.") from exc
    except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError) as exc:
        raise ProbeError(f"Homepage GET failed: {exc.reason if isinstance(exc, urllib.error.URLError) else exc}") from exc

    body = urllib.parse.urlencode(payload).encode("ascii")
    post_request = urllib.request.Request(endpoint, data=body, method="POST", headers={
        "User-Agent": USER_AGENT,
        "Accept": "application/json",
        "Origin": origin(endpoint),
        "Referer": endpoint,
        "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8",
    })
    try:
        with client.open(post_request, timeout=timeout) as response:
            status_code = response.status
            content_type = response.headers.get("Content-Type", "")
            final_url = response.geturl()
            response_body = read_limited(response)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        body_preview = exc.read(1500).decode("utf-8", "replace")
        raise ProbeError(f"Calculator POST failed with HTTP {exc.code}; body preview: {body_preview}") from exc
    except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError) as exc:
        raise ProbeError(f"Calculator POST failed: {exc.reason if isinstance(exc, urllib.error.URLError) else exc}") from exc

    if origin(final_url) != origin(endpoint):
        raise ProbeError("Calculator POST redirected to a different origin; response rejected.")
    if not 200 <= status_code < 300:
        raise ProbeError(f"Calculator POST failed with HTTP {status_code}.")
    try:
        decoded = json.loads(response_body.decode("utf-8"))
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        preview = response_body[:1500].decode("utf-8", "replace")
        raise ProbeError(f"Calculator did not return JSON. Body preview: {preview}") from exc
    if not isinstance(decoded, dict) or decoded.get("status") != "OK":
        raise ProbeError("Calculator response did not contain status OK.")

    result = validate_result(decoded.get("result"), "result")
    alt = decoded.get("altresult")
    if alt is not None:
        alt = validate_result(alt, "altresult")
    cookie_names = tuple(sorted({cookie.name for cookie in cookie_jar}))
    return ProbeReply(status_code, content_type, cookie_names, result, alt)


def parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    result = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Submit a synthetic payroll input to the captured Sweldong Pinoy form without a browser.")
    result.add_argument("--url", default=SITE_URL, help=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    result.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=20.0)
    result.add_argument("--employment-type", choices=EMPLOYMENT_TYPES, default="Private Employee")
    result.add_argument("--pay-period", choices=PAY_PERIODS, default="Monthly")
    result.add_argument("--daily-days", type=int, default=20)
    result.add_argument("--basic-pay", default="10000.00")
    result.add_argument("--taxable-allowance", default="1000.00")
    result.add_argument("--nontaxable-allowance", default="0.00")
    result.add_argument("--night-hours", default="")
    result.add_argument("--night-rate", default="")
    result.add_argument("--overtime-hours", default="")
    result.add_argument("--overtime-rate", default="")
    result.add_argument("--work-schedule", type=int, choices=(5, 6, 7), default=5)
    return result


def printable(reply: ProbeReply) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "httpStatus": reply.status_code,
        "contentType": reply.content_type,
        "sessionCookieNames": list(reply.cookie_names),
        "result": reply.result,
        "altresult": reply.altresult,
    }


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        payload = make_payload(args)
        if args.timeout <= 0 or args.timeout > 60:
            raise ProbeError("Timeout must be greater than 0 and no more than 60 seconds.")
        print("Browser-free Sweldong Pinoy reference probe; use approved test figures only.")
        print("A GET establishes a cookie session; the form POST follows in the same HTTP session.")
        reply = request_calculation(args.url, payload, args.timeout)
        print(json.dumps(printable(reply), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
        print("PASS: a browserless form request returned a balanced result. This is not proof of a supported public API or payroll correctness.")
        return 0
    except ProbeError as exc:
        print(f"NOT VERIFIED: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    51	def money_text(value: str, name: str) -> str:
    52	    text = str(value or "").strip().replace(",", "")
    53	    if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{1,10}(?:\.\d{1,2})?", text):
    54	        raise ProbeError(f"{name} must be a non-negative peso amount with up to two decimals.")
    55	    amount = Decimal(text)
    56	    return f"{amount:,.2f}"
    57	
    58	
    59	def quantity_text(value: str, name: str, maximum: Decimal = Decimal("1000000")) -> str:
    60	    text = str(value or "").strip()
    61	    if text == "":
    62	        return ""
    63	    if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{1,8}(?:\.\d{1,2})?", text):
    64	        raise ProbeError(f"{name} must be a non-negative number with up to two decimals.")
    65	    amount = Decimal(text)
    66	    if amount > maximum:
    67	        raise ProbeError(f"{name} is outside the supported probe range.")
    68	    return f"{amount:.2f}"

   103	def validate_endpoint(url: str) -> str:
   104	    parsed = urlsplit(url)
   105	    if parsed.username or parsed.password or parsed.query or parsed.fragment:
   106	        raise ProbeError("Endpoint URL must not contain credentials, query parameters, or a fragment.")
   107	    if parsed.path not in ("", "/"):
   108	        raise ProbeError("The captured calculator posts to the homepage path only.")
   109	    if parsed.scheme == "https" and parsed.hostname == "www.sweldongpinoy.com":
   110	        return url if url.endswith("/") else url + "/"
   111	    if parsed.scheme == "http" and parsed.hostname in ("127.0.0.1", "localhost") and parsed.port:
   112	        return url if url.endswith("/") else url + "/"
   113	    raise ProbeError("Use the official HTTPS homepage; HTTP overrides are allowed only for localhost tests.")
   114	
   115	
   116	def cents(value: Any, name: str) -> int:
   117	    try:
   118	        amount = Decimal(str(value).replace(",", "")).quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
   119	    except (InvalidOperation, AttributeError, ValueError) as exc:
   120	        raise ProbeError(f"Response field {name} is not a valid monetary value.") from exc
   121	    if not amount.is_finite() or amount < 0 or amount > Decimal("10000000000"):
   122	        raise ProbeError(f"Response field {name} is outside the supported monetary range.")
   123	    return int(amount * 100)
   124	
   125	
   126	def validate_result(value: Any, label: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
   127	    if not isinstance(value, dict):
   128	        raise ProbeError(f"Response {label} is missing or is not an object.")
   129	    for field in REQUIRED_RESULT:
   130	        if field not in value:
   131	            raise ProbeError(f"Response {label} is missing {field}.")
   132	        cents(value[field], field)
   133	    amount = {field: cents(value[field], field) for field in REQUIRED_RESULT}
   134	    gross_parts = sum(amount[name] for name in (
   135	        "basic_pay", "taxable_allowance", "nontaxable_allowance", "night_differential", "overtime_pay"))
   136	    contributions = sum(amount[name] for name in (
   137	        "sss_gsis_contribution", "philhealth_contribution", "pagibig_contribution", "withholding_tax"))
   138	    if abs(amount["gross_pay"] - gross_parts) > 1:
   139	        raise ProbeError(f"Response {label} does not balance gross pay against its returned components.")
   140	    if abs(amount["total_deductions"] - contributions) > 1:
   141	        raise ProbeError(f"Response {label} does not balance total deductions against its returned components.")
   142	    if abs(amount["net_pay"] - (amount["gross_pay"] - amount["total_deductions"])) > 1:
   143	        raise ProbeError(f"Response {label} does not balance net pay against gross and deductions.")
   144	    return value
   145	
   146	
   147	def read_limited(response: Any) -> bytes:
   148	    body = response.read(MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES + 1)
   149	    if len(body) > MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES:
   150	        raise ProbeError("Calculator response exceeded the 256 KB safety limit.")
   151	    return body
   152

   154	def origin(url: str) -> str:
   155	    parsed = urlsplit(url)
   156	    return f"{parsed.scheme}://{parsed.netloc}"

   159	def request_calculation(url: str, payload: dict[str, str], timeout: float = 20.0,
   160	                        opener: urllib.request.OpenerDirector | None = None) -> ProbeReply:
   161	    endpoint = validate_endpoint(url)
   162	    cookie_jar = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
   163	    client = opener or urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(cookie_jar))
   164	    if opener is not None:
   165	        cookie_processor = getattr(opener, "_motorph_cookie_jar", None)
   166	        if cookie_processor is not None:
   167	            cookie_jar = cookie_processor
   168	
   169	    get_request = urllib.request.Request(endpoint, headers={
   170	        "User-Agent": USER_AGENT,
   171	        "Accept": "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8",
   172	    })
   173	    try:
   174	        with client.open(get_request, timeout=timeout) as page:
   175	            if not 200 <= page.status < 300:
   176	                raise ProbeError(f"Homepage GET failed with HTTP {page.status}.")
   177	            if origin(page.geturl()) != origin(endpoint):
   178	                raise ProbeError("Homepage redirected to a different origin; refusing to send the payload.")
   179	            read_limited(page)
   180	    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
   181	        raise ProbeError(f"Homepage GET failed with HTTP {exc.code}.") from exc
   182	    except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError) as exc:
   183	        raise ProbeError(f"Homepage GET failed: {exc.reason if isinstance(exc, urllib.error.URLError) else exc}") from exc
   184	
   185	    body = urllib.parse.urlencode(payload).encode("ascii")
   186	    post_request = urllib.request.Request(endpoint, data=body, method="POST", headers={
   187	        "User-Agent": USER_AGENT,
   188	        "Accept": "application/json",
   189	        "Origin": origin(endpoint),
   190	        "Referer": endpoint,
   191	        "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8",
   192	    })
   193	    try:
   194	        with client.open(post_request, timeout=timeout) as response:
   195	            status_code = response.status
   196	            content_type = response.headers.get("Content-Type", "")
   197	            final_url = response.geturl()
   198	            response_body = read_limited(response)
   199	    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
   200	        body_preview = exc.read(1500).decode("utf-8", "replace")
   201	        raise ProbeError(f"Calculator POST failed with HTTP {exc.code}; body preview: {body_preview}") from exc
   202	    except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, OSError) as exc:
   203	        raise ProbeError(f"Calculator POST failed: {exc.reason if isinstance(exc, urllib.error.URLError) else exc}") from exc
   204	
   205	    if origin(final_url) != origin(endpoint):
   206	        raise ProbeError("Calculator POST redirected to a different origin; response rejected.")
   207	    if not 200 <= status_code < 300:
   208	        raise ProbeError(f"Calculator POST failed with HTTP {status_code}.")
   209	    try:
   210	        decoded = json.loads(response_body.decode("utf-8"))
   211	    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
   212	        preview = response_body[:1500].decode("utf-8", "replace")
   213	        raise ProbeError(f"Calculator did not return JSON. Body preview: {preview}") from exc
   214	    if not isinstance(decoded, dict) or decoded.get("status") != "OK":
   215	        raise ProbeError("Calculator response did not contain status OK.")
   216	
   217	    result = validate_result(decoded.get("result"), "result")
   218	    alt = decoded.get("altresult")
   219	    if alt is not None:
   220	        alt = validate_result(alt, "altresult")
   221	    cookie_names = tuple(sorted({cookie.name for cookie in cookie_jar}))
   222	    return ProbeReply(status_code, content_type, cookie_names, result, alt)
   223

case "$(uname -s)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) S=";" ;; *) S=":" ;; esac

sh tools/build.sh --with-tests
CP="lib/gson-2.13.2.jar${S}lib/bcprov-jdk18on-1.78.1.jar${S}lib/google/*${S}target/classes${S}target/test-classes"

fail=0
pass=0
for f in $(find src/test/java -name '*Test.java' | sort); do
  cls=$(printf '%s' "$f" | sed 's|src/test/java/||; s|/|.|g; s|\.java$||')
  if java --add-modules jdk.httpserver -cp "$CP" "$cls" > /tmp/motorph-test-out.txt 2>&1 && ! grep -q "^FAIL" /tmp/motorph-test-out.txt; then
    tail -n 1 /tmp/motorph-test-out.txt | sed "s|^|$cls: |"
    pass=$((pass + 1))
  else
    echo "FAILED: $cls"
    cat /tmp/motorph-test-out.txt
    fail=$((fail + 1))
  fi
done

if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "---- Python tool tests ----"
  if python3 -m unittest discover -s test/python -p 'test_*.py' > /tmp/motorph-python-out.txt 2>&1; then
    tail -n 2 /tmp/motorph-python-out.txt | sed 's/^/python: /'
    pass=$((pass + 1))
  else
    echo "Python tool tests FAILED"
    cat /tmp/motorph-python-out.txt
    fail=$((fail + 1))
  fi
fi

if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "---- web unit tests ----"
  if node --test test/web/*.test.js 2>&1 | tee /tmp/motorph-web-out.txt | tail -n 8 | grep -q "^# fail 0"; then
    grep -E "^# (tests|pass|fail)" /tmp/motorph-web-out.txt | sed 's/^# /web: /'
    pass=$((pass + 1))
  else
    echo "web unit tests FAILED"
    grep -E "^not ok" /tmp/motorph-web-out.txt | head -10
    fail=$((fail + 1))
  fi
fi

# The browser suite needs playwright-core and a Chromium binary; skip it cleanly when absent
# instead of failing a machine that has neither.
if [ "${MOTORPH_SKIP_E2E:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  echo "e2e: skipped (MOTORPH_SKIP_E2E=1)"
elif [ -d node_modules/playwright-core ] && [ -x "${CHROMIUM_PATH:-/home/user/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux64/chrome}" ]; then

    fail=$((fail + 1))
  fi

/**
 * End-to-end check against the real server build.
 *
 * The previous e2e compiled an app that no longer exists (`src/main/java/ph/motorph/web`) and
 * drove a Firebase-authenticated browser. This one starts the shipped server on a spare port with
 * its own throwaway data file, signs in through the UI with an employee number and a 2FA code, and
 * asserts the things that have actually broken during development:
 *
 *   - the 2FA step is required and a wrong code grants nothing
 *   - every field a real role can reach loads without a 4xx
 *   - the System Administrator can read attendance (the matrix drift)
 *   - an employee cannot read another employee's record
 *   - a write survives a server restart (persistence is real, not per-request)
 *
 * Run: node test/e2e/local-workflows.e2e.js
 * Needs: target/classes built (sh tools/build.sh), playwright-core + a Chromium binary.
 */
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { copyFileSync, existsSync, mkdtempSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';
import net from 'node:net';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { chromium } from 'playwright-core';

const projectRoot = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '../..');
const classes = path.join(projectRoot, 'target/classes');
const gsonJar = path.join(projectRoot, 'lib/gson-2.13.2.jar');
const bouncyJar = path.join(projectRoot, 'lib/bcprov-jdk18on-1.78.1.jar');
const chromiumPath = process.env.CHROMIUM_PATH
  || '/home/user/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux64/chrome';
const password = 'MotorPH-demo-2026';
const changedPasswords = new Map();
const timeoutMs = 30_000;

let scratch;
let browser;
let child = null;
let failure = null;
let newEmployeeId;
let onboardedId;
let backupName;

function freePort() {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const probe = net.createServer();
    probe.once('error', reject);
    probe.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => {
      const { port } = probe.address();
      probe.close(() => resolve(port));
    });
  });
}

async function startServer(port) {
  child = spawn('java', [
    '-Xmx256m', '-XX:TieredStopAtLevel=1',
    '--add-modules', 'jdk.httpserver',
    '-cp', [gsonJar, bouncyJar, path.join(projectRoot, 'lib/google/*'), classes].join(path.delimiter),
    'ph.motorph.svc.AppServer'
  ], {
    cwd: projectRoot,
    env: {
      ...process.env,
      PORT: String(port),
      HOST: '127.0.0.1',
      WEB_ROOT: process.env.MOTORPH_E2E_WEB_ROOT || path.join(projectRoot, 'web'),
      MOTORPH_PEPPER: 'e2e-pepper-at-least-32-characters-long',
      LOCAL_DATA_FILE: path.join(scratch, 'state.json'),
      MOTORPH_SEED_FILE: path.join(scratch, 'state.json'),
      FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID: process.env.MOTORPH_E2E_FIRESTORE_PROJECT || '',
      MOTORPH_DEFER_SAVES: 'false'
    },
    stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe']
  });
  let serverLog = '';
  const capture = chunk => { serverLog = (serverLog + chunk.toString()).slice(-8000); };
  child.stdout.on('data', capture);
  child.stderr.on('data', capture);
  // A fresh data file is seeded and saved in full before the port opens, and provisioning the
  // 34 demo accounts costs one Argon2id hash each (about 9-10 s on two cores). Allow a generous
  // window so a loaded machine does not turn a slow start into a test failure.
  for (let i = 0; i < 450; i++) {
    if (child.exitCode !== null || child.signalCode !== null) {
      throw new Error(`server exited before startup (code ${child.exitCode}, signal ${child.signalCode}):\n${serverLog}`);
    }
    try {
      const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/api/health`);
      if (response.ok) return;
      if (i % 25 === 0) console.log(`  waiting for the server (${response.status})...`);
    } catch {
      if (i % 25 === 0) console.log('  waiting for the server...');
    }
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200));
  }
  throw new Error(`server did not start within 90 seconds:\n${serverLog}`);
}

async function stopServer() {
  if (!child) return;
  const done = new Promise(resolve => child.once('exit', resolve));
  child.kill('SIGTERM');
  await Promise.race([done, new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 5000))]);
  if (child.exitCode === null) child.kill('SIGKILL');
  child = null;
}

/** Sign in through the UI and return the page, already on the workspace. */
async function signIn(page, employeeId, { expectWrongCodeFirst = false } = {}) {
  await page.goto(`http://127.0.0.1:${page.__port}/signin`, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });
  await page.waitForTimeout(800);
  await page.fill('#auth-employee', employeeId);
  const currentPassword = changedPasswords.get(employeeId) || password;
  await page.fill('#auth-password', currentPassword);
  await page.click('#sign-in-button');
  await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.getElementById('code-form').hidden, null, { timeout: timeoutMs })
    .catch(async error => { throw new Error(`sign-in ${employeeId} failed: ${await page.textContent('#auth-error')} (${error.message})`); });

  if (expectWrongCodeFirst) {
    await page.fill('#code-input', '000000');
    await page.click('#code-verify-button');
    await page.waitForFunction(
      () => !document.getElementById('auth-error').hidden,
      null,
      { timeout: timeoutMs }
    ).catch(() => {});
    const error = (await page.textContent('#auth-error')) || '';
    assert.match(error, /wrong code|tries/i, `a wrong 2FA code is refused (got: ${error})`);
    assert.equal(await page.isVisible('.nav-item'), false, 'a wrong code still shows no workspace');
  }

  const preview = await page.textContent('#code-preview');
  const code = (preview.match(/\d{6}/) || [])[0];
  assert.ok(code, 'the demo deployment shows the code under the input');
  await page.fill('#code-input', code);
  await page.click('#code-verify-button');
  await page.waitForFunction(() => !document.getElementById('first-password-form').hidden
    || !document.getElementById('app-shell').hidden, null, { timeout: timeoutMs })
    .catch(async error => { throw new Error(`verification ${employeeId} failed: ${await page.textContent('#auth-error')} (${error.message})`); });
  if (await page.isVisible('#first-password-form')) {
    const blocked = await page.evaluate(async () => (await fetch('/api/employees')).status);
    assert.equal(blocked, 403, 'first-login users cannot access data before changing their password');
    const nextPassword = `CaseSensitive!2026-${employeeId}`;
    await page.fill('#first-password-current', currentPassword);
    await page.fill('#first-password-next', nextPassword);
    await page.click('#first-password-form button[type=submit]');
    changedPasswords.set(employeeId, nextPassword);
  }
  await page.waitForSelector('.nav-item:visible', { timeout: timeoutMs })
    .catch(() => {});
  await page.waitForTimeout(1800);
  assert.ok(await page.isVisible('.nav-item'), `employee ${employeeId} reaches the workspace`);
}

async function main() {
  if (!existsSync(classes)) throw new Error('target/classes missing; run sh tools/build.sh first');
  scratch = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), 'motorph-e2e-'));
  // Start from the real dataset so counts in this test mean something.
  copyFileSync(path.join(projectRoot, 'data/local-demo.json'), path.join(scratch, 'state.json'));

  const port = await freePort();
  await startServer(port);

  for (const endpoint of ['/api/admin/roles', '/api/employees', '/api/attendance?employeeId=10015&from=2026-01-01&to=2026-01-31']) {
    const anonymous = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}${endpoint}`);
    assert.equal(anonymous.status, 401, `${endpoint} rejects anonymous access`);
    const forged = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}${endpoint}`, { headers: { 'X-Demo-User': '10005' } });
    assert.equal(forged.status, 401, `${endpoint} rejects a forged identity header`);
  }
  console.log('PASS: protected APIs reject anonymous and forged-header requests');

  browser = await chromium.launch({
    executablePath: chromiumPath,
    args: ['--no-sandbox', '--disable-dev-shm-usage']
  });

  // ---- 1. 2FA is a real gate -------------------------------------------------
  console.log('1/5 two-factor gate');
  {
    const page = await browser.newPage();
    page.__port = port;
    await signIn(page, '10006', { expectWrongCodeFirst: true });
    console.log('PASS: sign-in needs the second factor; a wrong code opens nothing');
    await page.close();
  }

  // ---- 2. every reachable view loads without a 4xx ---------------------------
  console.log('2/5 view sweep');
  {
    const page = await browser.newPage();
    page.__port = port;
    const bad = [];
    const pageErrors = [];
    page.on('pageerror', e => pageErrors.push(e.message));
    await signIn(page, '10005');   // System Admin reaches the most views
    const storage = await page.evaluate(async () => {
      const stateResponse = await fetch('/api/admin/storage');
      const state = await stateResponse.json();
      const csrf = decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.match(/motorph_csrf=([^;]+)/) || [])[1] || '');
      const checkResponse = await fetch('/api/admin/storage/verify', { method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': csrf }, body: JSON.stringify({ confirm: 'VERIFY' }) });
      const check = await checkResponse.json();
      const after = await (await fetch('/api/admin/storage')).json();
      return { stateStatus: stateResponse.status, state, checkStatus: checkResponse.status, check, after };
    });
    const expectedBackend = process.env.MOTORPH_E2E_FIRESTORE_PROJECT ? 'firestore' : 'file';
    assert.equal(storage.stateStatus, 200, 'admin reads storage diagnostics');
    assert.equal(storage.state.backend, expectedBackend, 'diagnostics report the configured backend');
    assert.equal(storage.state.employeeRecords, 34, 'loaded employee count is reported');
    assert.equal(storage.state.attendanceRecords, 7421, 'loaded attendance count is reported');
    assert.equal(storage.checkStatus, 200, `storage read/write/read succeeds: ${JSON.stringify(storage.check)}`);
    assert.equal(storage.check.stateMatchedBeforeWrite, true, 'live saved snapshot matches running memory before the probe');
    assert.equal(storage.check.writeCommitted, true, 'the configured store committed the unchanged snapshot');
    assert.equal(storage.check.readBackMatched, true, 'the store returns the same snapshot after commit');
    assert.equal(storage.after.lastVerification.readBackMatched, true, 'successful check is recorded for this server process');
    page.on('response', r => {
      if (r.status() >= 400 && !r.url().includes('/api/auth/session')) {
        bad.push(`${r.status()} ${r.request().method()} ${r.url().replace(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}`, '')}`);
      }
    });
    const views = ['overview', 'employees', 'attendance', 'requests', 'team', 'hr', 'reports', 'payroll', 'config'];
    for (const view of views) {
      const item = await page.$(`.nav-item[data-view="${view}"]`);
      if (!item || !(await item.isVisible())) continue;
      await item.click();
      await page.waitForTimeout(1100);
      const text = await page.evaluate(() => {
        const shown = [...document.querySelectorAll('.page-view, section.view')].filter(v => v.offsetParent !== null);
        return (shown[0] || document.body).innerText.trim();
      });
      assert.ok(text.length > 200, `the ${view} view renders content`);
    }
    assert.deepEqual(bad, [], 'no view issues a request the server refuses');
    assert.deepEqual(pageErrors, [], 'no uncaught page errors while walking the app');
    console.log('PASS: all nine admin views render with no refused requests');
    await page.close();
  }

  // ---- 3. the System Administrator can read attendance ----------------------
  console.log('3/5 admin attendance access');
  {
    const page = await browser.newPage();
    page.__port = port;
    await signIn(page, '10005');
    const rows = await page.evaluate(async () => {
      const response = await fetch('/api/attendance?employeeId=10001', { headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });
      return { status: response.status, body: await response.json().catch(() => ({})) };

    assert.equal(rows.status, 200, 'the admin reads any attendance record (design matrix C,R,U,D)');
    assert.ok(Array.isArray(rows.body.items) && rows.body.items.length > 0, 'the admin attendance read returns rows');
    const security = await page.evaluate(async () => {
      const state = await (await fetch('/api/admin/security')).json();
      const csrf = decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.match(/motorph_csrf=([^;]+)/) || [])[1] || '');
      const refused = await fetch('/api/admin/security', { method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-CSRF-Token': csrf }, body: JSON.stringify({
          minPasswordLength: 8, maxFailedAttempts: 3, lockoutMinutes: 5, codeMinutes: 1, sessionHours: 24 }) });
      return { state, status: refused.status };
    });
    assert.equal(security.state.settings.minPasswordLength, 12, 'security panel reports the real password limit');

const ROWS = [
  ['grossPay', 'Gross pay'],
  ['sss', 'SSS / GSIS employee share'],
  ['philHealth', 'PhilHealth employee share'],
  ['pagIbig', 'Pag-IBIG employee share'],
  ['withholdingTax', 'Withholding tax'],
  ['totalDeductions', 'Total deductions'],
  ['netPay', 'Net pay']
];

export function formatReferenceCents(value) {
  let cents;
  try { cents = BigInt(value); } catch { throw new TypeError('Comparison amounts must be integer centavos.'); }
  const negative = cents < 0n;
  if (negative) cents = -cents;
  const pesos = (cents / 100n).toString().replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',');
  const fraction = String(cents % 100n).padStart(2, '0');
  return `${negative ? '−' : ''}₱${pesos}.${fraction}`;
}

export function comparisonRows(report) {
  if (!report || report.validated !== true || !report.sweldong?.validated
      || !Array.isArray(report.deltas)) throw new TypeError('Comparison report is missing validated results.');
  if (report.comparisonStatus !== 'LOCAL_UNAVAILABLE' && !report.motorph) {
    throw new TypeError('Comparison report is missing the MotorPH result.');
  }
  const indexed = new Map(report.deltas.map(item => [item.component, item]));
  return ROWS.map(([key, label]) => {
    const item = indexed.get(key);
    if (!item) {
      if (report.comparisonStatus === 'LOCAL_UNAVAILABLE') return { key, label, motorph: null, sweldong: null, delta: null, matches: false };
      throw new TypeError(`Comparison report is missing ${key}.`);
    }
    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(item.motorphCents) || !Number.isSafeInteger(item.sweldongCents)
        || !Number.isSafeInteger(item.deltaCents) || item.deltaCents !== item.sweldongCents - item.motorphCents) {
      throw new TypeError(`Comparison report has an invalid ${key} delta.`);
    }
    return { key, label, motorph: item.motorphCents, sweldong: item.sweldongCents,
      delta: item.deltaCents, matches: item.matches === true };
  });
}

export function comparisonHeading(report) {
  if (!report || !report.sweldong || !report.motorph && report.comparisonStatus !== 'LOCAL_UNAVAILABLE') {
    throw new TypeError('Comparison report has no source metadata.');
  }
  if (report.comparisonStatus === 'MATCH') return 'MATCH — all listed employee-side amounts are equal.';
  if (report.comparisonStatus === 'MISMATCH') return 'MISMATCH — review every delta; neither calculation is automatically preferred.';
  return 'MotorPH estimate unavailable — validated Sweldong result is available only as an explicit reference fallback.';
}

const field = id => document.getElementById(id);

function renderRows(tableBody, report) {
  const rows = comparisonRows(report);
  tableBody.replaceChildren();
  rows.forEach(row => {
    const tr = document.createElement('tr');
    [row.label, row.motorph === null ? 'Unavailable' : formatReferenceCents(row.motorph),
      row.sweldong === null ? 'Unavailable' : formatReferenceCents(row.sweldong),
      row.delta === null ? '—' : formatReferenceCents(row.delta),
      row.delta === null ? 'Not compared' : row.matches ? 'MATCH' : 'DIFFERS']
      .forEach(value => {
        const td = document.createElement('td');
        td.textContent = value;
        tr.append(td);
      });
    tableBody.append(tr);
  });
}

export function initSweldongComparison(apiJson, getAccount) {
  const form = field('sweldong-comparison-form');
  if (!form) return { refresh() {} };
  const consent = field('sweldong-consent');
  const submit = field('sweldong-submit');
  const status = field('sweldong-status');
  const resultPanel = field('sweldong-results');
  const decisionStatus = field('sweldong-selection-status');
  let report = null;
  let decision = null;

  const say = (element, text, error = false) => {
    element.textContent = text;
    element.classList.toggle('payroll-preview-error', error);
  };
  const render = () => {
    if (!report) return;
    const result = report.sweldong;
    const local = report.motorph;
    say(field('sweldong-result-heading'), comparisonHeading(report), report.comparisonStatus === 'MISMATCH');
    field('sweldong-comparison-id').textContent = `Comparison ${report.comparisonId || 'unavailable'} · ${report.checkedAt || ''}`;
    field('sweldong-motorph-source').textContent = local
      ? `${local.source} · ${local.rulesetId} · rates ${local.ratesVersion}`
      : `MotorPH unavailable · ${report.motorphUnavailableReason || 'reason not returned'}`;
    field('sweldong-provider-source').textContent = `${result.source} · ${result.providerVersion} · HTTP ${result.httpStatus}`;
    field('sweldong-audit-scope').textContent = report.auditScope || 'The report is not stored by the server; export it to retain the normalized input and response.';
    renderRows(field('sweldong-comparison-rows'), report);
    field('sweldong-raw-response').textContent = result.rawResponseText;
    field('sweldong-select-reference').disabled = !report.fallback?.eligible;
    field('sweldong-results').hidden = false;
    decisionStatus.textContent = decision?.selectionReason
      || 'MotorPH remains selected by default. No Sweldong value is used unless an admin explicitly selects it after review.';
  };

  const refresh = () => {
    if ((getAccount() || {}).role !== 'ADMIN') {
      submit.disabled = true;
      return;
    }
    submit.disabled = !consent.checked;
  };

  consent.addEventListener('change', refresh);
  form.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if ((getAccount() || {}).role !== 'ADMIN') {
      say(status, 'System Admin access is required.', true);
      return;
    }
    if (!consent.checked) {
      say(status, 'Confirm the external data transfer before continuing.', true);
      return;
    }
    submit.disabled = true;
    say(status, 'Sending the supported manual inputs to Sweldong Pinoy and validating its response.');
    resultPanel.hidden = true;
    decision = null;
    try {
      report = await apiJson('/api/admin/sweldong/compare', {
        confirm: 'SEND_TO_SWELDONG',
        period: field('sweldong-period').value,
        employmentType: 'Private Employee',
        payPeriod: 'Monthly',
        dailyDays: 20,
        basicPay: field('sweldong-basic').value,
        taxableAllowance: field('sweldong-taxable-allowance').value,
        nontaxableAllowance: field('sweldong-nontaxable-allowance').value,
        nightDifferentialHours: '', nightDifferentialRate: '', overtimeHours: '', overtimeRate: '', workSchedule: 5
      });
      say(status, 'Response validated. Review the source versions, assumptions and every component before choosing a reference.');
      render();
    } catch (error) {
      report = null;
      say(status, error.message, true);
    } finally {
      refresh();
    }
  });

  async function selectSource(source) {
    if (!report?.comparisonId) return;
    if (source === 'SWELDONG' && !report.fallback?.eligible) return;
    const buttons = [field('sweldong-keep-motorph'), field('sweldong-select-reference')];
    buttons.forEach(button => { button.disabled = true; });
    say(decisionStatus, 'Recording the explicit comparison-source choice in the admin audit log.');
    try {
      decision = await apiJson('/api/admin/sweldong/decision', {
        comparisonId: report.comparisonId,
        selectedSource: source
      });
      report.selectedSource = decision.selectedSource;
      report.selectionReason = decision.selectionReason;
      report.selectionAt = new Date().toISOString();
      decisionStatus.textContent = `${decision.selectedSource} selected for this reference preview only. ${decision.selectionReason}`;
    } catch (error) {
      say(decisionStatus, error.message, true);
    } finally {
      buttons[0].disabled = false;
      buttons[1].disabled = !report?.fallback?.eligible;
    }
  }

  field('sweldong-keep-motorph').addEventListener('click', () => selectSource('MOTORPH'));
  field('sweldong-select-reference').addEventListener('click', () => selectSource('SWELDONG'));
  field('sweldong-export').addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (!report) return;
    const evidence = { ...report, retainedAs: 'downloaded comparison evidence only; not a saved payroll record',
      selectedSource: decision?.selectedSource || 'MOTORPH',
      selectionReason: decision?.selectionReason || 'MotorPH default retained; no explicit external fallback was selected.' };
    const blob = new Blob([`${JSON.stringify(evidence, null, 2)}\n`], { type: 'application/json' });
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    link.download = `motorph-sweldong-comparison-${report.checkedAt?.replace(/[^0-9TZ-]/g, '-') || 'evidence'}.json`;
    link.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href);
  });

  return { refresh };
}

import json
import sys
import threading
import unittest
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import parse_qs

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))
import sweldong_pinoy_probe as probe


class ProbeHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    invalid_net = False
    post_seen = None

    def log_message(self, _format, *_args):
        pass

    def do_GET(self):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Set-Cookie", "JSESSIONID=test-session; Path=/; HttpOnly")
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(b"<html>test homepage</html>")

    def do_POST(self):
        raw = self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))).decode()
        ProbeHandler.post_seen = {
            "cookie": self.headers.get("Cookie", ""),
            "content_type": self.headers.get("Content-Type", ""),
            "origin": self.headers.get("Origin", ""),
            "fields": parse_qs(raw, keep_blank_values=True),
        }
        result = {
            "basic_pay": "10000.00", "taxable_allowance": "1000.00", "nontaxable_allowance": "0.00",
            "night_differential": "0.00", "overtime_pay": "0.00", "gross_pay": "11000.00",
            "sss_gsis_contribution": "500.00", "philhealth_contribution": "250.00",
            "pagibig_contribution": "200.00", "withholding_tax": "0.00",
            "total_deductions": "950.00", "net_pay": "10050.00",
        }
        if ProbeHandler.invalid_net:
            result["net_pay"] = "10051.00"
        body = json.dumps({"status": "OK", "result": result, "altresult": result}).encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)


class SweldongProbeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        cls.server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), ProbeHandler)
        cls.thread = threading.Thread(target=cls.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
        cls.thread.start()
        cls.url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{cls.server.server_port}/"

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        cls.server.shutdown()
        cls.server.server_close()
        cls.thread.join(timeout=2)

    def setUp(self):
        ProbeHandler.invalid_net = False
        ProbeHandler.post_seen = None

    def test_browserless_cookie_session_posts_exact_form(self):
        args = probe.parser().parse_args([])
        payload = probe.make_payload(args)
        reply = probe.request_calculation(self.url, payload, timeout=3)
        self.assertEqual(reply.status_code, 200)
        self.assertEqual(reply.cookie_names, ("JSESSIONID",))
        self.assertEqual(reply.result["net_pay"], "10050.00")
        sent = ProbeHandler.post_seen
        self.assertIn("JSESSIONID=test-session", sent["cookie"])
        self.assertIn("application/x-www-form-urlencoded", sent["content_type"])
        self.assertEqual(sent["fields"]["pay_period"], ["Monthly"])
        self.assertEqual(sent["fields"]["basic_pay"], ["10,000.00"])
        self.assertEqual(sent["fields"]["night_differential_hours"], [""])
        self.assertEqual(len(sent["fields"]), 11)

    def test_rejects_unbalanced_response(self):
        ProbeHandler.invalid_net = True
        args = probe.parser().parse_args([])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(probe.ProbeError, "does not balance net pay"):
            probe.request_calculation(self.url, probe.make_payload(args), timeout=3)

    def test_only_official_https_or_loopback_test_endpoint_is_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(probe.validate_endpoint(probe.SITE_URL), probe.SITE_URL)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(probe.ProbeError, "localhost tests"):
            probe.validate_endpoint("http://example.com/")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(probe.ProbeError, "credentials"):
            probe.validate_endpoint("https://user:pass@www.sweldongpinoy.com/")

    def test_optional_hour_and_rate_fields_must_be_paired(self):
        args = probe.parser().parse_args(["--night-hours", "4"])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(probe.ProbeError, "both night-differential"):
            probe.make_payload(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

const TAB_KEY = 'motorph-tab-';
const ALL_KEY = 'motorph-all-sections';

export function parseTabs(spec) {
  return String(spec || '').split('|').map(part => part.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(part => {
    const [key, ...label] = part.split(':');
    return { key: key.trim(), label: label.join(':').trim() || key.trim() };
  });
}

export function firstSentence(text) {
  const clean = String(text || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
  const match = clean.match(/^(.+?[.!?])(\s|$)/);
  return match ? match[1] : clean;
}

export function badgeCount(elements) {
  let count = 0;
  elements.forEach(element => {
    count += element.querySelectorAll('button[aria-label^="Approve "]').length;
    count += [...element.querySelectorAll('td')].filter(cell => cell.textContent.startsWith('Failed:')).length;
  });
  return count;
}

const available = element => !element.hidden && !element.classList.contains('role-hidden');

function shortenIntros(page) {
  page.querySelectorAll('p.payroll-preview-intro, p.processing-note:not([id]):not([role]), .notice > p').forEach(paragraph => {
    if (paragraph.dataset.shortened || paragraph.textContent.trim().length < 140) return;
    paragraph.dataset.shortened = 'true';
    const short = document.createElement('p');
    short.className = `${paragraph.className} intro-short`;
    short.textContent = firstSentence(paragraph.textContent);
    const more = document.createElement('details');
    more.className = 'intro-more';
    const summary = document.createElement('summary');
    summary.textContent = 'How this works';
    paragraph.replaceWith(short);
    more.append(summary, paragraph);
    short.after(more);
  });
}

export function initPageTabs(root = document) {
  const pages = [...root.querySelectorAll('.page-view[data-tabs]')];
  const state = new Map();

  function showAll() { return window.localStorage.getItem(ALL_KEY) === 'true'; }

  function apply(page) {
    const entry = state.get(page);
    const tabbed = [...page.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]')];
    const keysOf = element => element.dataset.tab.split(/\s+/);
    const usable = entry.tabs.filter(tab => tabbed.some(element => keysOf(element).includes(tab.key) && available(element)
      && (!element.parentElement.closest('[data-tab-group]') || available(element.parentElement.closest('[data-tab-group]')))));
    let active = entry.active;
    if (!usable.some(tab => tab.key === active)) active = usable.length ? usable[0].key : '';
    entry.active = active;
    const all = showAll();
    entry.observer.disconnect();
    tabbed.forEach(element => element.classList.toggle('tab-off', !all && !keysOf(element).includes(active)));
    page.querySelectorAll('[data-tab-group]').forEach(group => {
      const anyOn = [...group.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]')].some(element => !element.classList.contains('tab-off') && available(element));
      group.classList.toggle('tab-off', !all && !anyOn);
    });
    entry.bar.hidden = usable.length < 2 && !all;
    entry.buttons.forEach((button, key) => {
      const tab = entry.tabs.find(item => item.key === key);
      button.hidden = !usable.includes(tab);
      const selected = !all && key === active;
      button.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(selected));
      button.tabIndex = selected || (all && key === usable[0]?.key) ? 0 : -1;
      const count = badgeCount(tabbed.filter(element => keysOf(element).includes(key) && available(element)));
      const badge = button.querySelector('.tab-badge');
      badge.textContent = count ? String(count) : '';
      badge.hidden = !count;
      button.setAttribute('aria-label', count ? `${tab.label} (${count} waiting)` : tab.label);
    });
    entry.allToggle.textContent = all ? 'Show one section at a time' : 'Show all sections';
    entry.allToggle.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(all));
    entry.observer.observe(page, { subtree: true, childList: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['hidden', 'class'] });
  }

  function select(page, key, focus = false) {
    const entry = state.get(page);
    entry.active = key;
    window.sessionStorage.setItem(TAB_KEY + page.id, key);
    if (showAll()) window.localStorage.setItem(ALL_KEY, 'false');
    pages.forEach(apply);
    if (focus) entry.buttons.get(key).focus();
  }

  pages.forEach(page => {
    shortenIntros(page);
    const tabs = parseTabs(page.dataset.tabs);
    const bar = document.createElement('div');
    bar.className = 'page-tabs';
    const list = document.createElement('div');
    list.className = 'page-tab-list';
    list.setAttribute('role', 'tablist');
    list.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Sections on this page');
    const buttons = new Map();
    tabs.forEach(tab => {
      const button = document.createElement('button');
      button.type = 'button';
      button.className = 'page-tab';
      button.setAttribute('role', 'tab');
      button.dataset.tabKey = tab.key;
      const label = document.createElement('span');
      label.textContent = tab.label;
      const badge = document.createElement('span');
      badge.className = 'tab-badge';
      badge.hidden = true;
      button.append(label, badge);
      button.addEventListener('click', () => select(page, tab.key));
      button.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
        if (!['ArrowRight', 'ArrowLeft', 'Home', 'End'].includes(event.key)) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        const visible = [...buttons.values()].filter(item => !item.hidden);
        const index = visible.indexOf(button);
        const next = event.key === 'Home' ? visible[0] : event.key === 'End' ? visible[visible.length - 1]
          : visible[(index + (event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1) + visible.length) % visible.length];
        select(page, next.dataset.tabKey, true);
      });
      buttons.set(tab.key, button);
      list.append(button);
    });
    const allToggle = document.createElement('button');
    allToggle.type = 'button';
    allToggle.className = 'page-tabs-all';
    allToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
      window.localStorage.setItem(ALL_KEY, String(!showAll()));
      pages.forEach(apply);
    });
    bar.append(list, allToggle);
    const anchor = page.querySelector(':scope > .notice') || page.querySelector(':scope > .page-heading');
    if (anchor) anchor.after(bar);
    else page.prepend(bar);
    let pending = false;
    const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
      if (pending) return;
      pending = true;
      window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        pending = false;
        apply(page);
      });
    });
    state.set(page, { tabs, bar, buttons, allToggle, observer, active: window.sessionStorage.getItem(TAB_KEY + page.id) || tabs[0]?.key || '' });
  });
  pages.forEach(apply);

  return {
    refresh: () => pages.forEach(apply),
    
    reveal(element) {
      const page = element.closest('.page-view[data-tabs]');
      const holder = element.closest('[data-tab]');
      if (page && holder) select(page, holder.dataset.tab.split(/\s+/)[0]);
    }
  };
}

package ph.motorph.c_calc;

import com.google.gson.JsonArray;
import com.google.gson.JsonElement;
import com.google.gson.JsonObject;
import com.google.gson.JsonParser;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;

import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.net.CookieManager;

import java.net.URI;

/**
 * Explicit, browserless adapter for the observed Sweldong Pinoy calculator form.
 *
 * This is a calibration/reference client for one narrow supported case, not a supported provider
 * API and never an automatic payroll source. A fresh cookie jar is used for every request.
 */
public final class SweldongPinoyReference {
    public static final String ENDPOINT = "https://www.sweldongpinoy.com/";
    public static final String PROVIDER_VERSION = "unknown (undocumented homepage form; captured 2026-11-02)";
    public static final String INPUT_SCOPE = "Private Employee / Monthly / 2026 only / no night differential or overtime; captured 20-day and 5-day form defaults";
    private static final int MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES = 256_000;
    private static final List<String> REMOTE_FIELDS = Arrays.asList("basic_pay", "taxable_allowance", "nontaxable_allowance",
        "night_differential", "overtime_pay", "gross_pay", "sss_gsis_contribution", "philhealth_contribution",
        "pagibig_contribution", "withholding_tax", "total_deductions", "net_pay");

    private final URI endpoint;
    private final Duration timeout;

    public SweldongPinoyReference() {
        this.endpoint = URI.create(ENDPOINT);
        this.timeout = Duration.ofSeconds(8);
    }

    /** Test seam: only the official endpoint or loopback test servers are allowed. */
    public SweldongPinoyReference(URI endpoint, Duration timeout) {
        if (endpoint == null || timeout == null || timeout.isZero() || timeout.isNegative()
                || timeout.compareTo(Duration.ofSeconds(20)) > 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Reference endpoint and a timeout up to 20 seconds are required.");
        }
        boolean official = "https".equalsIgnoreCase(endpoint.getScheme())
            && "www.sweldongpinoy.com".equalsIgnoreCase(endpoint.getHost())
            && (endpoint.getPort() == -1 || endpoint.getPort() == 443)
            && (endpoint.getPath().isEmpty() || "/".equals(endpoint.getPath()))
            && endpoint.getRawQuery() == null && endpoint.getRawFragment() == null && endpoint.getUserInfo() == null;
        boolean loopback = "http".equalsIgnoreCase(endpoint.getScheme()) && endpoint.getHost() != null
            && ("127.0.0.1".equals(endpoint.getHost()) || "localhost".equalsIgnoreCase(endpoint.getHost()))
            && endpoint.getPort() > 0 && (endpoint.getPath().isEmpty() || "/".equals(endpoint.getPath()))
            && endpoint.getRawQuery() == null && endpoint.getRawFragment() == null && endpoint.getUserInfo() == null;
        if (!official && !loopback) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Use the official HTTPS homepage or a loopback-only test endpoint.");
        this.endpoint = endpoint;
        this.timeout = timeout;
    }

    public static Input normalize(String period, String employmentType, String payPeriod, int dailyDays,
            String basicPay, String taxableAllowance, String nontaxableAllowance, String nightHours,
            String nightRate, String overtimeHours, String overtimeRate, int workSchedule) {
        if (!"Private Employee".equals(employmentType))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("External comparison supports Private Employee only; government/GSIS is not in scope.");
        if (!"Monthly".equals(payPeriod))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("External comparison supports Monthly only; other period conversion is not verified.");
        YearMonth month;
        try { month = YearMonth.parse(period); }
        catch (RuntimeException ex) { throw new IllegalArgumentException("Period must use YYYY-MM."); }
        if (month.getYear() != 2026) throw new IllegalArgumentException("The local comparison ruleset covers 2026 only.");
        if (dailyDays != 20 || workSchedule != 5)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Only the captured 20-day / 5-day monthly form defaults are calibrated.");
        if (!quantityIsZero(nightHours) || !quantityIsZero(nightRate)
                || !quantityIsZero(overtimeHours) || !quantityIsZero(overtimeRate)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Night differential and overtime are outside the supported comparison scope.");
        }
        long basic = parseNormalizedMoney(basicPay, "Basic pay");
        long taxable = parseNormalizedMoney(taxableAllowance, "Taxable allowance");
        long nontaxable = parseNormalizedMoney(nontaxableAllowance, "Non-taxable allowance");
        if (basic <= 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Basic pay must be greater than zero.");
        Math.addExact(Math.addExact(basic, taxable), nontaxable);
        return new Input(month, basic, taxable, nontaxable, dailyDays, workSchedule);
    }

    private static long parseNormalizedMoney(String value, String name) {
        String text = value == null ? "" : value.trim();
        if (!text.matches("(?:[0-9]+|[0-9]{1,3}(?:,[0-9]{3})+)(?:[.][0-9]{1,2})?"))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + " must be a peso amount with valid thousands separators and up to two decimals.");
        return StatutoryCalculator2026.parsePesoCents(text, name);
    }

    private static boolean quantityIsZero(String value) {
        if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty()) return true;
        try {
            BigDecimal amount = new BigDecimal(value.trim().replace(",", ""));
            return amount.signum() == 0;
        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Premium hours and rates must be zero for this comparison.");
        }
    }

    public JsonObject compare(Input input, StatutoryRates rates) throws IOException {
        if (input == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Comparison input is required.");

    private static byte[] readLimited(InputStream body) throws IOException {
        ByteArrayOutputStream bytes = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
        int total = 0;
        for (int count; (count = body.read(buffer)) != -1;) {
            total += count;
            if (total > MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES) throw new IOException("Sweldong response exceeded the safety limit; no result was accepted.");
            bytes.write(buffer, 0, count);
        }
        return bytes.toByteArray();
    }

# Sweldong Pinoy: captured form probe and safe use

A user-provided Network capture shows a browser request to `POST https://www.sweldongpinoy.com/` using `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. The form submits these 11 keys: `employment_type`, `pay_period`, `payroll_period_daily_days`, `basic_pay`, `taxable_allowance`, `nontaxable_allowance`, `night_differential_hours`, `night_differential_rate`, `overtime_hours`, `overtime_rate`, and `work_schedule`. The captured response contains `status`, `result`, and `altresult`. A `JSESSIONID` cookie was present in the browser capture.

A session cookie does not, by itself, require a browser. `tools/sweldong_pinoy_probe.py` uses Python's standard-library HTTP client and cookie jar: it GETs the homepage, retains any session cookie, then POSTs the form in the same session. It does not open a browser, use the copied session cookie, or print cookie values. Its default amounts are the user's captured **test figures**. It validates response fields and arithmetic before reporting success.

Run with Python 3:

```sh
python3 tools/sweldong_pinoy_probe.py
```

Example inputs can be varied using flags, e.g.:

```sh
python3 tools/sweldong_pinoy_probe.py \
  --employment-type 'Private Employee' --pay-period Monthly \
  --daily-days 20 --basic-pay 10000 --taxable-allowance 1000 \
  --nontaxable-allowance 0 --night-hours 20 --night-rate 30 \
  --overtime-hours 40 --overtime-rate 50 --work-schedule 5
```

The selected `pay_period` is sent as submitted: do not pre-normalize or double the salary in MotorPH and then send it. The user's captures show that the selected period affects the site's returned salary basis; the remote calculation can return a normalized amount different from the posted amount. Compare only after confirming both systems mean the same period and basis. `result` / `altresult` and the endpoint are observed page behavior, not a published stable API contract.

## Production boundary

The website does not publish a supported API contract or service guarantee. Its endpoint, session requirements, fields and response may change; the service may rate-limit or disallow automated use. The employee My Pay reference remains MotorPH's internal fixed-rate estimate; it is not fetched from Sweldong Pinoy. A separate admin-only calibration panel is available under **Payroll workspace → External reference**. It never updates payroll and is not enabled for automatic requests or employee-specific records.

## Integrated admin comparison

The optional panel is limited to 2026, `Private Employee`, `Monthly`, the captured 20-day / 5-day schedule defaults, and no night differential or overtime. It accepts basic pay plus taxable and non-taxable allowances. The form requires explicit consent for each one-time transfer; it sends only those amounts and the fixed form fields, never an employee ID/name or government number. Use synthetic amounts unless external transmission of actual compensation has been approved.

The backend:

1. Validates/normalizes the form values and the local month; unsupported employment types, periods, premiums, or form defaults are rejected before any external request.
2. Calculates the MotorPH comparison with the app's selected 2026 rules/rates version and issues a fresh homepage GET, cookie jar and form POST. It never reuses the cookie from the attached cURL.
3. Validates the external status, output fields, gross/deduction/net arithmetic, and that the returned earning components still match the submitted amounts. It preserves the raw successful JSON, normalized request fields, validated result, optional `altresult`, input scope, checked time, MotorPH ruleset/rates version, and the unknown provider-version caveat.
4. Displays all seven employee-side components and centavo deltas. A mismatch is just a review signal; neither side becomes authoritative automatically.
5. Keeps MotorPH selected by default. An eligible, validated and unambiguous Sweldong result can be selected only by a separate explicit admin action. That selection is a **reference preview only**; `appliesToPayroll` is always false, and it does not create or change a payslip. The source choice/reason is written to the app's admin audit log.
6. Offers a downloadable JSON evidence file containing the normalized inputs and raw/validated comparison. The app audit stores actor, route, time, outcome, and a short comparison ID, not the compensation values/raw result. Keep the downloaded report appropriately protected. In memory-only mode, the audit event is process-local.

The integrated route is `POST /api/admin/sweldong/compare` with the confirmation value `SEND_TO_SWELDONG`; it is admin- and CSRF-protected. A separate `POST /api/admin/sweldong/decision` records `MOTORPH` or an eligible `SWELDONG` reference choice. An external request runs outside the app's state lock so a slow provider does not block normal app transactions. The official provider URL is fixed in production code; test injection permits only loopback endpoints.

The Java adapter/API tests use a local HTTP server with a synthetic `JSESSIONID` and canned responses. They verify the form/cookie flow, validation, mismatches, access control, opt-in, explicit fallback and audit decision. They do **not** establish live-site reachability, permission to automate, provider terms, live formula parity, uptime, or production suitability. Do not use this undocumented endpoint as a final payroll calculation service without the provider's approval, a privacy review and an operational contract.

    private static boolean sameOrigin(URI left, URI right) {
        return left.getScheme().equalsIgnoreCase(right.getScheme())
            && left.getHost().equalsIgnoreCase(right.getHost()) && effectivePort(left) == effectivePort(right);
    }

    private static int effectivePort(URI uri) {
        return uri.getPort() >= 0 ? uri.getPort() : "https".equalsIgnoreCase(uri.getScheme()) ? 443 : 80;
    }

    private static String origin(URI uri) {
        int port = effectivePort(uri);
        boolean standard = ("https".equalsIgnoreCase(uri.getScheme()) && port == 443)
            || ("http".equalsIgnoreCase(uri.getScheme()) && port == 80);
        return uri.getScheme() + "://" + uri.getHost() + (standard ? "" : ":" + port);
    }

    private static ValidatedResult validateResult(JsonElement element, String name) throws IOException {
        if (element == null || !element.isJsonObject()) throw new IOException("Sweldong response " + name + " is missing or malformed.");
        JsonObject raw = element.getAsJsonObject().deepCopy();
        Map<String, Long> values = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        try {
            for (String field : REMOTE_FIELDS) {
                if (!raw.has(field) || raw.get(field).isJsonNull()) throw new IllegalArgumentException();
                values.put(field, cents(raw.get(field)));
            }
        } catch (RuntimeException invalid) {
            throw new IOException("Sweldong response " + name + " is missing valid monetary fields.");
        }
        long grossParts = values.get("basic_pay") + values.get("taxable_allowance") + values.get("nontaxable_allowance")
            + values.get("night_differential") + values.get("overtime_pay");
        long deductions = values.get("sss_gsis_contribution") + values.get("philhealth_contribution")
            + values.get("pagibig_contribution") + values.get("withholding_tax");
        if (Math.abs(values.get("gross_pay") - grossParts) > 1)
            throw new IOException("Sweldong response " + name + " does not balance gross pay against its components.");
        if (Math.abs(values.get("total_deductions") - deductions) > 1)
            throw new IOException("Sweldong response " + name + " does not balance deductions against its components.");
        if (Math.abs(values.get("net_pay") - (values.get("gross_pay") - values.get("total_deductions"))) > 1)
            throw new IOException("Sweldong response " + name + " does not balance net pay.");
        return new ValidatedResult(raw, values);
    }

    private static long cents(JsonElement raw) {
        BigDecimal money = new BigDecimal(raw.getAsString().replace(",", "")).setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);
        if (money.signum() < 0 || money.compareTo(new BigDecimal("10000000000.00")) > 0)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("money outside range");
        return money.movePointRight(2).longValueExact();
    }

    private static JsonObject normalizedRemoteResult(JsonObject raw) {
        JsonObject result = new JsonObject();
        for (String field : REMOTE_FIELDS) result.addProperty(field, peso(cents(raw.get(field))));
        return result;
    }

#!/usr/bin/env sh
# Compile every main source (all packages under ph/motorph) and, optionally, the tests.
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
case "$(uname -s)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) S=";" ;; *) S=":" ;; esac
mkdir -p target/classes target/test-classes
find src/main/java -name '*.java' > target/main-sources.txt
# Resources travel with the classes: the employee file is read from the classpath at startup.
mkdir -p target/classes
cp -r src/main/resources/. target/classes/
javac -encoding UTF-8 --add-modules jdk.httpserver -cp "lib/gson-2.13.2.jar${S}lib/bcprov-jdk18on-1.78.1.jar${S}lib/google/*" -d target/classes @target/main-sources.txt
if [ "${1:-}" = "--with-tests" ]; then
  find src/test/java -name '*.java' > target/test-sources.txt
  javac -encoding UTF-8 --add-modules jdk.httpserver \
    -cp "lib/gson-2.13.2.jar${S}lib/bcprov-jdk18on-1.78.1.jar${S}lib/google/*${S}target/classes" \
    -d target/test-classes @target/test-sources.txt
fi

#!/usr/bin/env sh
# Runs the MotorPH API and web UI.
#
# The classpath carries three things: Gson (JSON), BouncyCastle (Argon2id, which the password hashes need), and the
# compiled classes. The employee file and the sample payslip ship inside target/classes as resources.
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
case "$(uname -s)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) S=";" ;; *) S=":" ;; esac

# Build first: compiling here means a fresh clone runs with one command.
sh tools/build.sh

# The session pepper. Refusing to invent one silently is the point: a pepper the code carries is not a secret.
if [ -z "${MOTORPH_PEPPER:-}" ]; then
  if [ -f .env.local ]; then
    pepper=$(sed -n 's/^MOTORPH_PEPPER=//p' .env.local | head -n 1)
    case "$pepper" in
      ''|replace-*|PASTE_*|__*) ;;
      *) MOTORPH_PEPPER="$pepper"; export MOTORPH_PEPPER ;;
    esac
  fi
fi

exec java --add-modules jdk.httpserver \
  -cp "lib/gson-2.13.2.jar${S}lib/bcprov-jdk18on-1.78.1.jar${S}lib/google/*${S}target/classes" \
  ph.motorph.svc.AppServer

    /**
     * Local file by default; Firestore when both a project id and a way to authenticate are
     * present. The Firestore store reads and writes the same state document the file backend
     * does, so nothing downstream knows which one it got.
     */
    private StateStore chooseStateStore(Path dataFile) {
        if (this.firebaseProjectId.isEmpty()) {
            return dataFile == null ? null : new LocalStateFile(dataFile);
        }
        String token = System.getenv().getOrDefault("MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_TOKEN", "").trim();
        String uid = System.getenv().getOrDefault("MOTORPH_FIRESTORE_UID", "server").trim();
        if (uid.isEmpty()) uid = "server";
        String apiRoot = firestoreApiRoot;
        if (apiRoot == null) {
            String emulator = System.getenv().getOrDefault("FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST", "").trim();
            if (!emulator.isEmpty()) apiRoot = "http://" + emulator + "/v1/projects/";
        }
        FirestoreRestClient client;
        try {
            if (!token.isEmpty()) {
                client = apiRoot == null ? new FirestoreRestClient(this.firebaseProjectId, uid, token)
                    : new FirestoreRestClient(this.firebaseProjectId, uid, token, apiRoot);
            } else if (apiRoot != null && apiRoot.startsWith("http://")) {
                client = new FirestoreRestClient(this.firebaseProjectId, uid, () -> null, apiRoot);
            } else {
                client = FirestoreRestClient.applicationDefault(this.firebaseProjectId, uid, apiRoot);
            }
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Firestore credentials unavailable. Configure Application Default Credentials; no local fallback was used.", ex);
        }
        return new FirestoreStateStore(client);
    }
