package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import javax.crypto.SecretKeyFactory;
import javax.crypto.spec.PBEKeySpec;

public final class AccountSecurity {
    
    public static final String DEFAULT_PASSWORD = "MotorPH-demo-2026";
    
    private static final int ROUNDS = 20_000;
    private static final SecureRandom RANDOM = new SecureRandom();

    
    public static final class TooSoon extends RuntimeException {
        TooSoon(String message) { super(message); }
    }

    public static final class Settings {
        public int minPasswordLength = 8, maxFailedAttempts = 5, lockoutMinutes = 15, codeMinutes = 5, sessionHours = 8;
        public String updatedBy = "", updatedAt = "";
    }

    private static final class Stored {
        String salt, hash, changedAt;
    }

    private Settings settings = new Settings();
    private final Map<String, Stored> passwords = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, Integer> failures = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String, String> lockedUntil = new HashMap<>();
    
    private transient Map<String, java.time.Instant> nextTryAt = new HashMap<>();

    
    static long waitSeconds(int failedInARow) {
        return failedInARow < 2 ? 0 : 1L << Math.min(failedInARow - 2, 6);
    }

    public synchronized Settings settings() {
        Settings copy = new Settings();
        copy.minPasswordLength = settings.minPasswordLength;
        copy.maxFailedAttempts = settings.maxFailedAttempts;
        copy.lockoutMinutes = settings.lockoutMinutes;
        copy.codeMinutes = settings.codeMinutes;
        copy.sessionHours = settings.sessionHours;
        copy.updatedBy = settings.updatedBy;
        copy.updatedAt = settings.updatedAt;
        return copy;
    }

    public synchronized void updateSettings(int minLength, int maxFailed, int lockoutMinutes, int codeMinutes, int sessionHours, String by, String at) {
        range(minLength, 8, 64, "Minimum password length");
        range(maxFailed, 3, 10, "Wrong passwords before lockout");
        range(lockoutMinutes, 5, 120, "Lockout minutes");
        range(codeMinutes, 1, 10, "2FA code minutes");
        range(sessionHours, 1, 24, "Session hours");
        settings.minPasswordLength = minLength;
        settings.maxFailedAttempts = maxFailed;
        settings.lockoutMinutes = lockoutMinutes;
        settings.codeMinutes = codeMinutes;
        settings.sessionHours = sessionHours;
        settings.updatedBy = by;
        settings.updatedAt = at;
    }

    
    public synchronized void checkPassword(String employeeId, String password, LocalDateTime now) {
        Optional<LocalDateTime> locked = lockedUntil(employeeId, now);
        if (locked.isPresent()) throw new IllegalStateException("This account is locked until " + locked.get().toLocalTime() + " after too many wrong passwords.");
        if (nextTryAt == null) nextTryAt = new HashMap<>();
        java.time.Instant allowed = nextTryAt.get(employeeId);
        if (allowed != null && java.time.Instant.now().isBefore(allowed)) {
            long seconds = Math.max(1, java.time.Duration.between(java.time.Instant.now(), allowed).getSeconds() + 1);
            throw new TooSoon("Too many wrong passwords in a row; wait " + seconds + " second" + (seconds == 1 ? "" : "s") + " before trying again.");
        }
        if (matches(employeeId, password)) {
            failures.remove(employeeId);
            nextTryAt.remove(employeeId);
            return;
        }
        int failed = failures.merge(employeeId, 1, Integer::sum);
        long wait = waitSeconds(failed);
        if (wait > 0) nextTryAt.put(employeeId, java.time.Instant.now().plusSeconds(wait));
        else nextTryAt.remove(employeeId);
        if (failed >= settings.maxFailedAttempts) {
            failures.remove(employeeId);
            nextTryAt.remove(employeeId);
            lockedUntil.put(employeeId, now.plusMinutes(settings.lockoutMinutes).toString());
            throw new IllegalStateException("Wrong password " + failed + " times: the account is locked for " + settings.lockoutMinutes + " minutes.");
        }
        int left = settings.maxFailedAttempts - failed;
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Wrong password; " + left + " tr" + (left == 1 ? "y" : "ies") + " left before the account locks"
            + (wait > 0 ? ", and wait " + wait + " second" + (wait == 1 ? "" : "s") + " before the next try." : "."));
    }

    public synchronized void changePassword(String employeeId, String current, String next, LocalDateTime now) {
        checkPassword(employeeId, current, now);
        String value = next == null ? "" : next;
        if (value.length() < settings.minPasswordLength || value.length() > 64) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("The new password must be " + settings.minPasswordLength + " to 64 characters.");
        }
        if (value.equals(current)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Choose a password different from the current one.");
        if (value.equals(DEFAULT_PASSWORD)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Choose a password other than the shared demo password.");
        Stored stored = new Stored();
        byte[] salt = new byte[16];
        RANDOM.nextBytes(salt);
        stored.salt = hex(salt);
        stored.hash = hex(hash(value, salt));
        stored.changedAt = now.toString();
        passwords.put(employeeId, stored);
    }

    
    public synchronized void resetPassword(String employeeId) {
        passwords.remove(employeeId);
        unlock(employeeId);
    }

    public synchronized void unlock(String employeeId) {
        failures.remove(employeeId);
        lockedUntil.remove(employeeId);
        if (nextTryAt != null) nextTryAt.remove(employeeId);
    }

    public synchronized boolean usesDefaultPassword(String employeeId) { return !passwords.containsKey(employeeId); }

    public synchronized Optional<String> passwordChangedAt(String employeeId) {
        return Optional.ofNullable(passwords.get(employeeId)).map(stored -> stored.changedAt);
    }

    public synchronized Optional<LocalDateTime> lockedUntil(String employeeId, LocalDateTime now) {
        String until = lockedUntil.get(employeeId);
        if (until == null) return Optional.empty();
        LocalDateTime time = LocalDateTime.parse(until);
        if (!now.isBefore(time)) {
            lockedUntil.remove(employeeId);
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        return Optional.of(time);
    }

    public synchronized int failedAttempts(String employeeId) { return failures.getOrDefault(employeeId, 0); }

    private boolean matches(String employeeId, String password) {
        String given = password == null ? "" : password;
        Stored stored = passwords.get(employeeId);
        if (stored == null) return MessageDigest.isEqual(given.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8), DEFAULT_PASSWORD.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        return MessageDigest.isEqual(hash(given, unhex(stored.salt)), unhex(stored.hash));
    }

    private static byte[] hash(String password, byte[] salt) {
        try {
            PBEKeySpec spec = new PBEKeySpec(password.toCharArray(), salt, ROUNDS, 256);
            return SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("PBKDF2WithHmacSHA256").generateSecret(spec).getEncoded();
        } catch (java.security.GeneralSecurityException ex) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Password hashing is unavailable.", ex);
        }
    }

    private static void range(int value, int min, int max, String label) {
        if (value < min || value > max) throw new IllegalArgumentException(label + " must be " + min + " to " + max + ".");
    }

    private static String hex(byte[] bytes) {
        StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder();
        for (byte b : bytes) text.append(String.format("%02x", b));
        return text.toString();
    }

    private static byte[] unhex(String text) {
        byte[] bytes = new byte[text.length() / 2];
        for (int i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) bytes[i] = (byte) Integer.parseInt(text.substring(i * 2, i * 2 + 2), 16);
        return bytes;
    }
}
package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.util.Optional;
import ph.motorph.o_oop.Employee;
import ph.motorph.o_oop.OrgChart;

public final class AuthService {
    public static final String COOKIE = "motorph_session";

    private final CredentialStore credentials;
    private final SessionStore sessions;
    private final OrgChart chart;
    private final TwoFactor twoFactor;
    private int codeMinutes = 5;

    public AuthService(CredentialStore credentials, SessionStore sessions, OrgChart chart) {
        this(credentials, sessions, chart, new TwoFactor(java.time.Clock.systemDefaultZone()));
    }

    public AuthService(CredentialStore credentials, SessionStore sessions, OrgChart chart, TwoFactor twoFactor) {
        this.credentials = credentials;
        this.sessions = sessions;
        this.chart = chart;
        this.twoFactor = twoFactor;
    }

    public TwoFactor twoFactor() { return twoFactor; }
    public void setCodeMinutes(int minutes) { if (minutes > 0) this.codeMinutes = minutes; }
    public int codeMinutes() { return codeMinutes; }

    public SessionStore sessions() { return sessions; }
    public CredentialStore credentials() { return credentials; }

    
    public static final class SignIn {
        public final String token, employeeId, role;
        public final boolean mustChangePassword;
        public final String error;

        private SignIn(String token, String employeeId, String role, boolean mustChangePassword, String error) {
            this.token = token; this.employeeId = employeeId; this.role = role;
            this.mustChangePassword = mustChangePassword; this.error = error;
        }
        static SignIn failed(String error) { return new SignIn("", "", "", false, error); }
        public boolean ok() { return error.isEmpty(); }
    }

    
    /** Step one: the password. Returns a challenge, never a session. */
    public SignIn signIn(String employeeId, String password) {
        String id = employeeId == null ? "" : employeeId.trim();
        if (!id.matches("[0-9]{5}")) return SignIn.failed("Employee numbers are five digits, for example 10015.");
        CredentialStore.Result result = credentials.signIn(id, password);
        if (!result.ok) {
            return SignIn.failed("locked".equals(result.reason)
                ? "Too many incorrect attempts. Try again in a few minutes."
                : "The employee number or password is incorrect.");
        }
        Employee employee = chart.employee(id).orElse(null);
        if (employee == null) return SignIn.failed("The employee number or password is incorrect.");
        TwoFactor.Started started = twoFactor.start(id, "", codeMinutes);
        return new SignIn(started.challengeId, id, AccessPolicy.roleOf(id).label, result.account.mustChangePassword(), "");
    }

    /** Step two: the code. This is where the session is actually issued. */
    public SignIn verifyCode(String challengeId, String code) {
        String employeeId;
        try {
            employeeId = twoFactor.verify(challengeId, code);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException | IllegalStateException refused) {
            return SignIn.failed(refused.getMessage());
        }
        Employee employee = chart.employee(employeeId).orElse(null);
        if (employee == null) return SignIn.failed("The employee number or password is incorrect.");
        String token = sessions.issue(employeeId);
        boolean mustChange = credentials.account(employeeId).map(Account::mustChangePassword).orElse(false);
        return new SignIn(token, employeeId, AccessPolicy.roleOf(employeeId).label, mustChange, "");
    }

    
    public Optional<Employee> currentEmployee(String token) {
        return sessions.resolve(token).flatMap(record -> chart.employee(record.employeeId));
    }

    public Optional<SessionRecord> currentSession(String token) { return sessions.resolve(token); }

    public void signOut(String token) { sessions.revoke(token); }

    
    public String changePassword(String token, String currentPassword, String newPassword) {
        Optional<SessionRecord> record = sessions.resolve(token);
        if (!record.isPresent()) return null;
        String employeeId = record.get().employeeId;
        if (!credentials.changePassword(employeeId, currentPassword, newPassword)) return null;
        sessions.revokeAllFor(employeeId);
        return sessions.issue(employeeId);
    }

    
    public boolean resetPassword(String employeeId) {
        boolean reset = credentials.resetToInitial(employeeId);
        if (reset) sessions.revokeAllFor(employeeId);
        return reset;
    }

    public int activeSessions() { return sessions.size(); }
}
package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;

public final class CredentialStore {
    public static final int MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
    public static final Duration LOCK_FOR = Duration.ofMinutes(15);

    private final Map<String, Account> accounts = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final PasswordHasher hasher;
    private final Clock clock;

    public CredentialStore(PasswordHasher hasher) { this(hasher, Clock.systemDefaultZone()); }
    public CredentialStore(PasswordHasher hasher, Clock clock) {
        this.hasher = hasher;
        this.clock = clock;
    }

    
    public int provision(List<String> employeeIds) {
        int created = 0;
        for (String employeeId : employeeIds) {
            if (accounts.containsKey(employeeId)) continue;
            accounts.put(employeeId, new Account(employeeId, hasher.hash(PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial), true));
            created++;
        }
        return created;
    }

    public Map<String, Account> exportAccounts() {
        return new LinkedHashMap<>(accounts);
    }

    public void importAccounts(Map<String, Account> saved) {
        if (saved == null) return;
        for (Map.Entry<String, Account> entry : saved.entrySet()) {
            Account account = entry.getValue();
            if (entry.getKey() == null || account == null || !entry.getKey().equals(account.acc_sEid)
                || account.passwordHash() == null || !account.passwordHash().startsWith("argon2id$")) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid stored account");
            }
        }
        accounts.clear();
        accounts.putAll(saved);
    }

    public boolean has(String employeeId) { return employeeId != null && accounts.containsKey(employeeId); }
    public Optional<Account> account(String employeeId) { return Optional.ofNullable(accounts.get(employeeId)); }
    public int size() { return accounts.size(); }

    
    public static final class Result {
        public final boolean ok;
        public final Account account;
        public final String reason;          
        Result(boolean ok, Account account, String reason) { this.ok = ok; this.account = account; this.reason = reason; }
    }

    public Result signIn(String employeeId, String password) {
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        Account account = employeeId == null ? null : accounts.get(employeeId.trim());
        if (account == null) return new Result(false, null, "unknown");
        if (account.locked(now)) return new Result(false, account, "locked");
        if (!hasher.verify(password, account.passwordHash())) {
            account.recordFailure(MAX_ATTEMPTS, now, LOCK_FOR);
            return new Result(false, account, "password");
        }
        account.recordSuccess(now);
        
        if (hasher.needsRehash(account.passwordHash())) account.replaceHash(hasher.hash(password));
        return new Result(true, account, "");
    }

    
    public boolean changePassword(String employeeId, String currentPassword, String newPassword) {
        Account account = accounts.get(employeeId);
        if (account == null) return false;
        if (!hasher.verify(currentPassword, account.passwordHash())) return false;
        PasswordPolicy.requireAcceptable(newPassword);
        account.replaceHash(hasher.hash(newPassword));
        return true;
    }

    
    public boolean unlock(String employeeId) {
        Account account = accounts.get(employeeId);
        if (account == null) return false;
        account.unlock();
        return true;
    }

    public boolean resetToInitial(String employeeId) {
        Account account = accounts.get(employeeId);
        if (account == null) return false;
        account.resetHash(hasher.hash(PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial));
        return true;
    }

    
    public List<String> employeeIds() { return new ArrayList<>(accounts.keySet()); }
}
package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

public final class Account {
    public final String acc_sEid;
    private String acc_sHash;
    private boolean acc_bMustChange;
    private int acc_iFails;
    private String acc_sLockedUntil;    
    private String acc_sLastSignIn;     

    public Account(String acc_sEid, String acc_sHash, boolean acc_bMustChange) {
        this.acc_sEid = acc_sEid;
        this.acc_sHash = acc_sHash;
        this.acc_bMustChange = acc_bMustChange;
        this.acc_sLockedUntil = "";
        this.acc_sLastSignIn = "";
    }

    public String passwordHash() { return acc_sHash; }
    public boolean mustChangePassword() { return acc_bMustChange; }
    public int failedAttempts() { return acc_iFails; }
    public String lockedUntil() { return acc_sLockedUntil; }
    public String lastSignIn() { return acc_sLastSignIn; }

    void replaceHash(String acc_sNew) { this.acc_sHash = acc_sNew; this.acc_bMustChange = false; }
    void resetHash(String acc_sNew) { this.acc_sHash = acc_sNew; this.acc_bMustChange = true; }

    void recordFailure(int acc_iMax, java.time.Instant acc_tNow, java.time.Duration acc_dLock) {
        acc_iFails++;
        if (acc_iFails >= acc_iMax) {
            acc_sLockedUntil = acc_tNow.plus(acc_dLock).toString();
            acc_iFails = 0;
        }
    }

    void unlock() { acc_iFails = 0; acc_sLockedUntil = ""; }

    void recordSuccess(java.time.Instant acc_tNow) {
        acc_iFails = 0;
        acc_sLockedUntil = "";
        acc_sLastSignIn = acc_tNow.toString();
    }

    boolean locked(java.time.Instant acc_tNow) {
        if (acc_sLockedUntil == null || acc_sLockedUntil.isEmpty()) return false;
        return acc_tNow.isBefore(java.time.Instant.parse(acc_sLockedUntil));
    }
}

async function restoreSession() {
  try {
    const response = await fetch('/api/auth/session', { headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });
    if (!response.ok) { showSignIn(); return; }
    const me = await response.json();
    state.csrfToken = decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)motorph_csrf=([^;]+)/) || [])[1] || '');
    if (me.mustChangePassword) { await finishSignIn(me); return; }
    const accounts = await loadAccounts();
    state.accounts = accounts;
    const account = accounts.find(item => item.employeeId === me.employeeId)
      || { employeeId: me.employeeId, role: me.role, roleLabel: me.roleLabel || me.role, name: me.name || me.employeeId, team: [] };
    enterAs(account);
  } catch (error) {
    showSignIn();
  }
}

export function auditRows(entries) {
  return entries.map(entry => [entry.at.replace('T', ' '), entry.actor, `${entry.method} ${entry.path}`, entry.target || '—', String(entry.status)]);
}

export function accountSecurityText(account) {
  if (account.lockedUntil) return `Locked until ${account.lockedUntil.slice(11, 16)}`;
  const parts = [account.defaultPassword ? 'Initial password' : account.passwordChangedAt ? `Own password since ${account.passwordChangedAt.slice(0, 10)}` : 'Own password'];
  if (account.failedAttempts) parts.push(`${account.failedAttempts} wrong recently`);
  return parts.join(' · ');
}

function fillRows(tbody, rows, columns, emptyText) {
  tbody.replaceChildren();
  if (!rows.length) {
    const row = document.createElement('tr');
    const cell = document.createElement('td');
    cell.colSpan = columns;
    cell.className = 'table-message';
    cell.textContent = emptyText;
    row.append(cell);
    tbody.append(row);
    return;
  }
  rows.forEach(values => {
    const row = document.createElement('tr');
    values.forEach(value => {
      const cell = document.createElement('td');
      if (value instanceof Node) cell.append(value);
      else cell.textContent = value;
      row.append(cell);
    });
    tbody.append(row);
  });
}

function actionButton(label, data) {
  const button = document.createElement('button');
  button.type = 'button';
  button.className = 'button button-quiet workflow-cancel';
  button.textContent = label;
  Object.assign(button.dataset, data);
  button.setAttribute('aria-label', `${label} ${data.employeeId || data.backup || ''}`.trim());
  return button;
}

export function initAdminSecurity(apiJson, getAccount) {
  if (!document.getElementById('security-form')) return { refresh() {} };
  const field = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const say = (id, message, isError = false) => {
    field(id).textContent = message;
    field(id).classList.toggle('payroll-preview-error', isError);
  };
  const isAdmin = () => (getAccount() || {}).role === 'ADMIN';

  async function refreshSecurity() {
    const { settings, accounts } = await apiJson('/api/admin/security');
    ['minPasswordLength', 'maxFailedAttempts', 'lockoutMinutes', 'codeMinutes', 'sessionHours'].forEach(key => { field(`security-${key}`).value = settings[key]; });
    const me = (getAccount() || {}).employeeId;
    fillRows(field('security-rows'), accounts.map(account => {
      const actions = document.createElement('span');
      actions.className = 'workflow-row-actions';
      if (account.lockedUntil || account.failedAttempts) actions.append(actionButton('Unlock', { employeeId: account.employeeId, action: 'unlock' }));
      if (!account.defaultPassword && account.employeeId !== me) actions.append(actionButton('Reset password', { employeeId: account.employeeId, action: 'reset-password' }));
      return [`${account.employeeId} — ${account.name}`, accountSecurityText(account), actions.childElementCount ? actions : '—'];
    }), 3, 'No accounts.');
  }

  async function refreshPolicy() {
    const { policy, mentorDefaults } = await apiJson('/api/admin/payroll-policy');
    ['graceMinutes', 'hoursPerMonth', 'dailyHours', 'nightDifferentialPercent'].forEach(key => { field(`policy-${key}`).value = policy[key]; });
    say('policy-status', mentorDefaults ? 'These are the mentor’s rules (10-minute grace, ÷168, 8 paid hours, 10% night differential).'
      : `Changed by ${policy.updatedBy} at ${policy.updatedAt.replace('T', ' ')}; this is no longer the mentor's rules.`);
  }

  async function refreshAudit() {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ limit: '200' });
    if (field('audit-actor').value.trim()) params.set('actor', field('audit-actor').value.trim());
    if (field('audit-path').value.trim()) params.set('path', field('audit-path').value.trim());
    if (field('audit-failures').checked) params.set('failures', 'true');
    const payload = await apiJson(`/api/admin/audit?${params}`);
    fillRows(field('audit-rows'), auditRows(payload.entries), 5, 'No matching audit entries.');

  }

  async function refreshBackups() {
    const payload = await apiJson('/api/admin/backups');
    const select = field('restore-name');
    select.replaceChildren(...payload.backups.map(name => new Option(name, name)));
    fillRows(field('backup-rows'), payload.backups.map(name => [name]), 1,
      payload.persistence === 'memory'

        : payload.persistence === 'firestore'
          ? 'Data lives in Firestore; open the Firebase console to inspect or export it.'
          : 'No backups yet.');
  }

    }
  }

  });

  field('audit-form').addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();

    } catch (error) {

    }
  });

      say('backup-status', `Backed up as ${backup}.`);
      await refreshBackups();
    } catch (error) {

  });

  field('restore-form').addEventListener('submit', async event => {

      window.setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 900);
    } catch (error) {
      say('backup-status', error.message, true);
    }
  });

  return { refresh };

package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Base64;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;

public final class SessionStore {
    public static final int IDLE_MINUTES = 15;
    public static final int ABSOLUTE_HOURS = 8;

    private static final SecureRandom RANDOM = new SecureRandom();

    private final Map<String, SessionRecord> byTokenHash = java.util.Collections.synchronizedMap(new LinkedHashMap<>());
    private final Clock clock;
    private final int idleMinutes, absoluteHours;

    public SessionStore() { this(Clock.systemDefaultZone(), IDLE_MINUTES, ABSOLUTE_HOURS); }
    public SessionStore(Clock clock) { this(clock, IDLE_MINUTES, ABSOLUTE_HOURS); }
    public SessionStore(Clock clock, int idleMinutes, int absoluteHours) {
        this.clock = clock;
        this.idleMinutes = idleMinutes;
        this.absoluteHours = absoluteHours;
    }

    public int idleMinutes() { return idleMinutes; }
    public int absoluteHours() { return absoluteHours; }

    
    public String issue(String employeeId) {
        byte[] raw = new byte[32];
        RANDOM.nextBytes(raw);
        String token = Base64.getUrlEncoder().withoutPadding().encodeToString(raw);
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        byTokenHash.put(hash(token), new SessionRecord(hash(token), employeeId, now,
            now.plus(Duration.ofHours(absoluteHours)), idleMinutes));
        prune(now);
        return token;
    }

    
    public Optional<SessionRecord> resolve(String token) {
        if (token == null || token.isEmpty()) return Optional.empty();
        SessionRecord record = byTokenHash.get(hash(token));
        if (record == null) return Optional.empty();
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        String expired = record.expiredReason(now);
        if (expired != null) {
            byTokenHash.remove(record.tokenHash);
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        record.touch(now);
        return Optional.of(record);
    }

    
    public void revoke(String token) {
        if (token == null) return;
        byTokenHash.remove(hash(token));
    }

    
    public int revokeAllFor(String employeeId) {
        int removed = 0;
        List<String> keys = new ArrayList<>(byTokenHash.keySet());
        for (String key : keys) {
            SessionRecord record = byTokenHash.get(key);
            if (record != null && record.employeeId.equals(employeeId)) {
                byTokenHash.remove(key);
                removed++;
            }
        }
        return removed;
    }

    
    public long idleSecondsLeft(String token) {
        SessionRecord record = byTokenHash.get(hash(token));
        if (record == null) return 0;
        long seconds = Duration.between(clock.instant(), record.lastActive().plusSeconds(idleMinutes * 60L)).getSeconds();
        return Math.max(0, seconds);
    }

    
    public int sweep() {
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        int before = byTokenHash.size();
        prune(now);
        return before - byTokenHash.size();
    }

    public void revokeAll() { byTokenHash.clear(); }

    public int size() { return byTokenHash.size(); }

    private void prune(Instant now) {
        byTokenHash.values().removeIf(record -> record.expiredReason(now) != null);
    }

    
    static String hash(String token) {
        try {
            byte[] digest = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(token.getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            StringBuilder hex = new StringBuilder(digest.length * 2);
            for (byte b : digest) hex.append(String.format("%02x", b));
            return hex.toString();
        } catch (java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException ex) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("SHA-256 is required", ex);
        }
    }
}
package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

/**
 * Two-step sign-in: a correct password opens a challenge, and only the right six-digit code opens a session.
 *
 * The code is shown on screen instead of being texted, because this deployment has no SMS gateway and the
 * accounts are provisioned in bulk. A real deployment swaps {@link #codeFor} for an SMS or TOTP sender and
 * nothing else about this class changes.
 *
 * Challenges live for the number of minutes the System Administrator sets, allow three wrong codes, and are
 * deleted the moment they are used, so a code never works twice.
 */
public final class TwoFactor {
    static final int MAX_TRIES = 3;
    private static final SecureRandom RANDOM = new SecureRandom();

    private static final class Challenge {
        final String employeeId, code;
        final Instant expires;
        int triesLeft = MAX_TRIES;

        Challenge(String employeeId, String code, Instant expires) {
            this.employeeId = employeeId;
            this.code = code;
            this.expires = expires;
        }
    }

    /** What the caller needs to show the code screen: which challenge, and where the code "went". */
    public static final class Started {
        public final String challengeId, code, employeeId;
        public final LocalDateTime expires;

        Started(String challengeId, String code, String employeeId, LocalDateTime expires) {
            this.challengeId = challengeId;
            this.code = code;
            this.employeeId = employeeId;
            this.expires = expires;
        }
    }

    private final Clock clock;
    private final Map<String, Challenge> challenges = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public TwoFactor(Clock clock) {
        this.clock = clock;
    }

    public Started start(String employeeId, String mobileEnding, int codeMinutes) {
        String id = token(16);
        String code = String.format("%06d", RANDOM.nextInt(1_000_000));
        Instant expires = clock.instant().plusSeconds(codeMinutes * 60L);
        challenges.put(id, new Challenge(employeeId, code, expires));
        return new Started(id, code, employeeId,
            LocalDateTime.ofInstant(expires, clock.getZone()));
    }

    /** The employee the code belongs to, or a refusal saying how many tries are left. */
    public String verify(String challengeId, String code) {
        Challenge challenge = challenges.get(challengeId == null ? "" : challengeId);
        if (challenge == null) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("That code request is over. Sign in again for a new code.");
        }
        if (!clock.instant().isBefore(challenge.expires)) {
            challenges.remove(challengeId);
            throw new IllegalStateException("That code expired. Sign in again for a new code.");
        }
        synchronized (challenge) {
            if (!challenge.code.equals(code == null ? "" : code.trim())) {
                challenge.triesLeft--;
                if (challenge.triesLeft <= 0) {
                    challenges.remove(challengeId);
                    throw new IllegalStateException("Wrong code three times. Sign in again for a new code.");
                }
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Wrong code; " + challenge.triesLeft + " tr"
                    + (challenge.triesLeft == 1 ? "y" : "ies") + " left.");
            }
        }
        challenges.remove(challengeId);
        return challenge.employeeId;
    }

    public Optional<String> pending(String challengeId) {
        Challenge challenge = challenges.get(challengeId);
        if (challenge == null) return Optional.empty();
        if (!clock.instant().isBefore(challenge.expires)) {
            challenges.remove(challengeId);
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        return Optional.of(challenge.employeeId);
    }

    /**
     * The code for a live challenge. This exists only because this deployment has no SMS gateway; a real one
     * would never hand the code back to the caller.
     */
    public Optional<String> peek(String challengeId) {
        Challenge challenge = challenges.get(challengeId);
        if (challenge == null || !clock.instant().isBefore(challenge.expires)) return Optional.empty();
        return Optional.of(challenge.code);
    }

    public int size() { return challenges.size(); }

    public void clear() { challenges.clear(); }

    private static String token(int bytes) {
        byte[] value = new byte[bytes];
        RANDOM.nextBytes(value);
        StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder();
        for (byte b : value) text.append(String.format("%02x", b));
        return text.toString();
    }

    private static void hashesAreVerifiableAndRejectWrongPasswords() {
        PasswordHasher hasher = new PasswordHasher(PEPPER);
        String stored = hasher.hash("MotorPH-demo-2026");
        check(hasher.verify("MotorPH-demo-2026", stored), "the right password verifies");
        check(!hasher.verify("motorPH-demo-2026", stored), "a case change fails");
        check(!hasher.verify("MotorPH-demo-202", stored), "a prefix fails");
        check(!hasher.verify("", stored), "an empty password fails");
        check(!hasher.verify("anything", "not-a-hash"), "a malformed stored value fails instead of throwing");
        check(!hasher.verify("anything", null), "a null stored value fails instead of throwing");
        
        String other = new PasswordHasher("a-completely-different-pepper-of-sufficient-length").hash("MotorPH-demo-2026");
        check(!other.equals(stored), "a different pepper produces a different hash");
    }

    private static void aPepperIsRequired() {

            new PasswordHasher(null);
        } catch (IllegalStateException expected) {
            nullRefused = true;
        }
        check(nullRefused, "a missing pepper is refused rather than defaulted silently");
    }

    private static String signedIn(AuthService auth, String employeeId, String password) {
        AuthService.SignIn step1 = auth.signIn(employeeId, password);
        if (!step1.ok()) return "";
        String code = auth.twoFactor().peek(step1.token).orElse("");
        AuthService.SignIn step2 = auth.verifyCode(step1.token, code);
        return step2.ok() ? step2.token : "";
    }

    private static void theWrongCodeIsRefusedAndCounted() {
        MutableClock clock = new MutableClock("2026-11-09T08:00:00Z");
        AuthService auth = service(clock);
        AuthService.SignIn step1 = auth.signIn("10015", PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial);
        check(step1.ok(), "the password opens a challenge");

        String real = auth.twoFactor().peek(step1.token).orElse("");
        check(real.matches("[0-9]{6}"), "the challenge carries a six-digit code");
        String wrong = real.equals("000000") ? "111111" : "000000";
        AuthService.SignIn bad = auth.verifyCode(step1.token, wrong);
        check(!bad.ok(), "a wrong code issues no session");
        check(bad.error.contains("2 tries left"), "it says how many tries remain: " + bad.error);
        check(bad.token.isEmpty(), "no token comes back on a refusal");

        AuthService.SignIn good = auth.verifyCode(step1.token, real);
        check(good.ok() && !good.token.isEmpty(), "the right code issues the session");
        check(auth.currentEmployee(good.token).isPresent(), "and that session resolves to the employee");

        AuthService.SignIn replay = auth.verifyCode(step1.token, real);
        check(!replay.ok(), "the same challenge cannot be used twice");
    }

function switchView(view) {
  const labels = { overview: 'Overview', employees: 'Employees', attendance: 'Attendance', requests: 'Requests & tickets', team: 'Team roster', hr: 'HR operations', reports: 'Reports', payroll: 'Payroll', config: 'System configuration' };
  if (!labels[view]) return;
  document.querySelectorAll('.page-view').forEach(page => {
    page.hidden = page.id !== `${view}-view`;
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(nav => {
    const active = nav.dataset.view === view;
    nav.classList.toggle('active', active);
    if (active) nav.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
    else nav.removeAttribute('aria-current');
  });
  const navLabel = document.querySelector(`.nav-item[data-view="${view}"] span[data-default-label]`);
  document.getElementById('crumb-current').textContent = navLabel ? navLabel.textContent : labels[view];
  document.title = `${labels[view]} — MotorPH Payroll Office`;
  if (view === 'attendance' && attendanceEmployee.value) loadAttendance();
  if (view === 'reports') loadAttendanceReport();
  if (view === 'team') loadTeamToday();
  pageTabs.refresh();
  notificationsUi.refresh();
}

async function postAuth(url, body) {
  const headers = await apiHeaders({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
  const response = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers, credentials: 'same-origin', body: JSON.stringify(body) });
  const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload.error || `Request failed (${response.status})`);
  if (payload.csrfToken) state.csrfToken = payload.csrfToken;
  return payload;
}

            StateStore remote = chooseStateStore(null);
            if (remote == null || !"firestore".equals(remote.backend())) {
                throw new RequestException(409, "This server is not storing data in Firestore, so there is nothing to move.");
            }
            StateStore local = new LocalStateFile(Paths.get(System.getenv().getOrDefault("LOCAL_DATA_FILE", "data/local-demo.json")));
            FirestoreSeedService service = new FirestoreSeedService(local, remote);
            FirestoreSeedService.UploadResult result = downloading ? service.downloadAll() : service.uploadAll();
            if (downloading) loadDataFile();
            sendJson(exchange, 200, "{\"direction\":\"" + direction + "\",\"employees\":" + result.getEmployeeCount()
                + ",\"attendance\":" + result.getAttendanceCount() + "}");
        } catch (RequestException ex) {
            sendError(exchange, ex.statusCode, ex.getMessage());
        } catch (FirestoreException ex) {
            sendApiError(exchange, ex);
        } catch (IOException ex) {
            sendApiError(exchange, new FirestoreException("Could not move the state: " + ex.getMessage(), 502));
        }
    }

     * would also demand a Firebase ID token, which employee-number sign-in does not produce.

    private static String attendanceToJson(List<AttendanceRecord> records) {
        StringBuilder json = new StringBuilder("{\"items\":[");

            .append(",\"hoursCalculated\":false}").toString();
    }

    private AccessPolicy.Actor actorFromCookie(HttpExchange exchange) {
        if (authService == null) return null;
        String token = SessionCookie.read(exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Cookie"), AuthService.COOKIE);
        if (token == null || token.isEmpty()) return null;
        return authService.currentEmployee(token)
            .map(employee -> new AccessPolicy.Actor(employee.getId(), AccessPolicy.roleOf(employee.getId()), true))
            .orElse(null);
    }

    
    private void requireCsrf(HttpExchange exchange) {
        String method = exchange.getRequestMethod();
        if ("GET".equals(method) || "HEAD".equals(method) || "OPTIONS".equals(method)) return;
        
        
        String token = SessionCookie.read(exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Cookie"), AuthService.COOKIE);
        if (token == null || token.isEmpty() || !sessionStore.resolve(token).isPresent()) return;
        String cookie = SessionCookie.read(exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("Cookie"), SessionCookie.CSRF_COOKIE);
        String header = exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst(SessionCookie.CSRF_HEADER);
        if (!SessionCookie.csrfMatches(cookie, header)) {
            throw new RequestException(403, "That request did not carry the page's form token, so it was refused.");
        }
    }

    
    private static boolean isSecure(HttpExchange exchange) {
        String forwarded = exchange.getRequestHeaders().getFirst("X-Forwarded-Proto");
        if (forwarded != null && !forwarded.trim().isEmpty()) return "https".equalsIgnoreCase(forwarded.trim());
        return exchange instanceof com.sun.net.httpserver.HttpsExchange;
    }

    
    private static int sessionMaxAge() { return SessionStore.ABSOLUTE_HOURS * 3600; }

    
    private AccessPolicy.Actor actorFor(HttpExchange exchange) {

        if (fromCookie != null) {
            if (hrRecords.isSeparated(fromCookie.employeeId, clockService.now().toLocalDate())) {
                throw new RequestException(401, "This account was closed after the employee's last day.");
            }
            return fromCookie;
        }
        throw new RequestException(401, "Sign in first.");
    }

function initials(name) {
  return name.trim().split(/\s+/).slice(0, 2).map(part => part[0]).join('').toUpperCase();
}

function makeCell(content) {
  const cell = document.createElement('td');
  if (content instanceof Node) cell.append(content);
  else cell.textContent = content;
  return cell;
}

function downloadCsvFile(filename, columns, records) {
  const csv = buildCsv(columns, records);
  const blob = new Blob([`\uFEFF${csv}`], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.download = filename;
  link.hidden = true;
  document.body.append(link);
  link.click();
  link.remove();
  window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
}

    private static int nestedObjectSize(JsonObject stores, String storeName, String field) {
        if (stores == null || !stores.has(storeName) || !stores.get(storeName).isJsonObject()) return 0;
        JsonObject store = stores.getAsJsonObject(storeName);
        if (!store.has(field) || !store.get(field).isJsonObject()) return 0;
        return store.getAsJsonObject(field).size();
    }

    private static int nestedArraySize(JsonObject stores, String storeName, String field) {
        if (stores == null || !stores.has(storeName) || !stores.get(storeName).isJsonObject()) return 0;
        JsonObject store = stores.getAsJsonObject(storeName);
        if (!store.has(field) || !store.get(field).isJsonArray()) return 0;
        return store.getAsJsonArray(field).size();
    }

    private void storageVerificationFailure(HttpExchange exchange, int status, String message, boolean pauseWrites) throws IOException {
        if (pauseWrites) persistenceBroken = true;
        exchange.setAttribute("storageVerificationAbort", Boolean.TRUE);
        sendError(exchange, status, message);
        // Do not write a failure audit or archive into a store that just failed verification. The

        AccessPolicy.Actor authenticated = actorFromCookie(exchange);
        auditLog.record(clockService.now().toString(), authenticated == null ? "no account" : authenticated.employeeId,
            exchange.getRequestMethod(), exchange.getRequestURI().getPath(), "", status, null);
    }

    private void verifyStorageRoundTrip(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (dataFile == null) {
            storageVerificationFailure(exchange, 409, "This server is memory-only; no durable store can be verified.");
            return;
        }
        if (deferSaves && stateDirty) {
            storageVerificationFailure(exchange, 409,
                "A local file write is pending. Wait for it to finish, then retry; this check did not read or overwrite the store.", false);
            return;
        }
        JsonObject expected = exportState();
        try {
            // Keep the read/compare/write/read sequence indivisible with respect to the local
            // background writer. Firestore currently saves synchronously, but shares the same lock.
            synchronized (saveIoLock) {
                Optional<JsonObject> before = dataFile.load();
                if (!before.isPresent()) {
                    storageVerificationFailure(exchange, 409,
                        "The configured store has no saved snapshot. Writes are paused; inspect and restart before continuing.");
                    return;
                }
                if (!before.get().equals(expected)) {
                    storageVerificationFailure(exchange, 409,
                        "The saved snapshot differs from this server's loaded state. No overwrite was attempted; writes are paused. Inspect the database and restart from the verified source.");
                decision.addProperty("saved", false);

                return;

    public static synchronized void importRoles(Map<String, Role> roles, Map<String, String> supervisors) {
        ROLE_OVERRIDES.clear();
        if (roles != null) ROLE_OVERRIDES.putAll(roles);
        OrgChart bound = chart;
        if (bound != null && supervisors != null) {
            if (roles != null) {
                for (String id : roles.keySet()) if (bound.employee(id).isPresent()) bound.reassign(id, "");
            }
            for (Map.Entry<String, String> entry : supervisors.entrySet()) {
                if (bound.employee(entry.getKey()).isPresent()
                    && (entry.getValue() == null || entry.getValue().isEmpty() || bound.employee(entry.getValue()).isPresent()))
                    bound.reassign(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
            }
        }
    }

    public static boolean canRead(Actor actor, Area area, String targetEmployeeId) {
        if (actor == null || !actor.explicit) return false;      
        if (targetEmployeeId == null) return readScope(actor.role, area) == Scope.ALL;
        switch (readScope(actor.role, area)) {
            case ALL: return true;
            case TEAM: return teamOf(actor.employeeId).contains(targetEmployeeId);
            case SELF: return actor.employeeId.equals(targetEmployeeId);
            default: return false;
        }

    private void provisionSignIn() {
        String pepper = System.getenv("MOTORPH_PEPPER");
        boolean fromEnvironment = pepper != null && pepper.trim().length() >= 32;
        if (!fromEnvironment) {
            if (dataFile instanceof FirestoreStateStore)
                throw new IllegalStateException("MOTORPH_PEPPER must contain at least 32 characters when using Firestore.");
            pepper = "motorph-development-pepper-not-for-production-use";
            System.out.println("WARNING: MOTORPH_PEPPER is not set, so the development pepper is in use."
                + " Set a 32+ character secret before running this against real data.");
        }
        this.credentialStore = new CredentialStore(new ph.motorph.sp_secpol.PasswordHasher(pepper));
        importCredentials(savedCredentials);
        java.util.List<String> ids = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        for (Employee employee : localEmployeeStore.findAll()) ids.add(employee.getId());
        int created = credentialStore.provision(ids);
        java.util.List<Employee> roster = localEmployeeStore.findAll();
        this.authService = new AuthService(credentialStore, sessionStore,
            roster.isEmpty() ? new ph.motorph.o_oop.OrgChart(java.util.Collections.emptyList())
                             : new ph.motorph.o_oop.OrgChart(roster));
        if (created > 0) System.out.println("Sign-in ready for " + created + " accounts (employee number + password).");
    }

    
    private void importCredentials(com.google.gson.JsonElement saved) {
        if (saved == null || saved.isJsonNull() || credentialStore == null) return;
        java.lang.reflect.Type type = new com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken<java.util.Map<String, ph.motorph.sp_secpol.Account>>() { }.getType();
        credentialStore.importAccounts((dataFile != null ? dataFile : new LocalStateFile(Paths.get("unused.json"))).gson().fromJson(saved, type));
    }

    private void loadEmployeeFile() {
        ph.motorph.o_oop.EmployeeImport imported = ph.motorph.o_oop.EmployeeImport.fromClasspath();
        for (Employee employee : imported.employees()) {
            if (!localEmployeeStore.findById(employee.getId()).isPresent()) localEmployeeStore.seed(employee);
        }
        EmployeeService employees = new EmployeeService(localEmployeeStore);
        for (Employee employee : imported.employees()) {
            
            if (!localScheduleStore.findScheduleIdForEmployee(employee.getId()).isPresent()) {
                localScheduleStore.assign(employee.getId());
            }
        }
        localEmployeeService = employees;
        this.importNotes = imported.notes();
    }

    private JsonObject storageStatus(JsonObject stores) {
        JsonObject status = new JsonObject();
        status.addProperty("backend", persistenceKind());
        status.addProperty("durable", dataFile != null);
        status.addProperty("writeReady", !persistenceBroken);
        status.addProperty("storeCount", stores.size());
        status.addProperty("employeeRecords", nestedObjectSize(stores, "employees", "employees"));
        status.addProperty("attendanceRecords", nestedArraySize(stores, "attendance", "records"));
        status.addProperty("activePayslips", nestedObjectSize(stores, "savedPayslips", "snapshots"));
        status.addProperty("voidedPayslips", nestedObjectSize(stores, "savedPayslips", "voided"));
        status.addProperty("checkedAt", clockService.now().toString());
        status.addProperty("verificationScope", "in-process counts only; use Verify read/write/read to prove the configured store");
        return status;
    }

    private static int nestedObjectSize(JsonObject stores, String storeName, String field) {
        if (stores == null || !stores.has(storeName) || !stores.get(storeName).isJsonObject()) return 0;
        JsonObject store = stores.getAsJsonObject(storeName);
        if (!store.has(field) || !store.get(field).isJsonObject()) return 0;
        return store.getAsJsonObject(field).size();
    }

    private void handleAccountDirectory(HttpExchange exchange) throws IOException {
        if (!"GET".equals(exchange.getRequestMethod())) {
            sendJson(exchange, 405, "{\"error\":\"Method not allowed\"}");
            return;
        }

            people = servicesFor(exchange).employeeService.listEmployees();
        } catch (FirestoreException ex) {
            sendApiError(exchange, ex);
            return;
        }
        JsonArray items = new JsonArray();
        for (Employee employee : people) {
            if (hrRecords.isSeparated(employee.getId(), clockService.now().toLocalDate())) continue;
            AccessPolicy.Role role = AccessPolicy.roleOf(employee.getId());
            JsonObject item = new JsonObject();
            item.addProperty("employeeId", employee.getId());
            item.addProperty("name", employee.getName());
            item.addProperty("position", employee.getRole());
            item.addProperty("branch", employee.getLocation());
            item.addProperty("role", role.name());
            item.addProperty("roleLabel", role.label);
            item.addProperty("supervisorId", AccessPolicy.supervisorOf(employee.getId()).orElse(""));
            JsonArray team = new JsonArray();
            for (String member : AccessPolicy.teamOf(employee.getId())) team.add(member);
            item.add("team", team);
            items.add(item);
        }
        JsonObject response = new JsonObject();
        response.add("accounts", items);
        response.addProperty("policyVersion", AccessPolicy.VERSION);
        sendJson(exchange, 200, response.toString());
    }

[NODE 27273]
public Result signIn(String employeeId, String password) {
        Instant now = clock.instant();
        Account account = employeeId == null ? null : accounts.get(employeeId.trim());
        if (account == null) return new Result(false, null, "unknown");
        if (!account.isEnabled()) return new Result(false, account, "inactive");
        if (account.locked(now)) return new Result(false, account, "locked");
        if (!hasher.verify(password, account.passwordHash())) {
            account.recordFailure(MAX_ATTEMPTS, now, LOCK_FOR);
            return new Result(false, account, "password");
        }
        account.recordSuccess(now);
        
        if (hasher.needsRehash(account.passwordHash())) account.replaceHash(hasher.hash(password));
        return new Result(true, account, "");
    }

    
    public boolean changePassword(String employeeId, String currentPassword, String newPassword) {
        Account account = accounts.get(employeeId);
        if (account == null) return false;
        if (!hasher.verify(currentPassword, account.passwordHash())) return false;
        PasswordPolicy.requireAcceptable(newPassword);
        account.replaceHash(hasher.hash(newPassword));
        return true;
    }

    
    public boolean unlock(String employeeId) {
        Account account = accounts.get(employeeId);
        if (account == null) return false;
        account.unlock();
        return true;
    }

    public boolean resetToInitial(String employeeId) {
        Account account = accounts.get(employeeId);
        if (account == null) return false;

async function restoreSession() {
  try {
    const response = await fetch('/api/auth/session', { headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });
    if (!response.ok) { showSignIn(); return; }
    const me = await response.json();
    state.csrfToken = decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)motorph_csrf=([^;]+)/) || [])[1] || '');
    if (me.mustChangePassword) { await finishSignIn(me); return; }
    const accounts = await loadAccounts();
    state.accounts = accounts;
    const account = accounts.find(item => item.employeeId === me.employeeId)
      || { employeeId: me.employeeId, role: me.role, roleLabel: me.roleLabel || me.role, name: me.name || me.employeeId, team: [] };
    enterAs(account);
  } catch (error) {
    showSignIn();
  }
}

package ph.motorph.sp_secpol;

import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.ZoneId;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import ph.motorph.o_oop.Employee;
import ph.motorph.o_oop.EmployeeImport;
import ph.motorph.o_oop.OrgChart;

public final class AuthTest {
    private static int passed, failed;

    private static final String PEPPER = "a-test-pepper-that-is-long-enough-to-be-accepted";
    
    private static final class MutableClock extends Clock {
        private Instant now;
        MutableClock(String iso) { this.now = Instant.parse(iso); }
        void advance(Duration by) { now = now.plus(by); }
        @Override public ZoneId getZone() { return ZoneOffset.UTC; }
        @Override public Clock withZone(ZoneId zone) { return this; }
        @Override public Instant instant() { return now; }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try {
            hashesAreSaltedAndNeverRepeat();
            hashesAreVerifiableAndRejectWrongPasswords();
            aPepperIsRequired();
            everyEmployeeStartsWithTheInitialPassword();
            signInNeedsTheRightPairAndSaysNothingUsefulOtherwise();
            lockoutAfterFiveAttempts();
            sessionTokensAreLongRandomAndStoredOnlyAsHashes();
            idleAndAbsoluteLimitsAreEnforced();
            theWrongCodeIsRefusedAndCounted();
            threeWrongCodesEndTheChallenge();
            expiredChallengesAreRefused();
            aPasswordAloneGrantsNothing();
            signOutAndPasswordChangeRevokeServerSide();
            passwordChangeRotatesTheSession();
            csrfTokensAreLongAndComparedExactly();
            cookieAttributesAreCorrect();
        } catch (Throwable unexpected) {
            unexpected.printStackTrace();
            failed++;
        }
        System.out.println((failed == 0 ? "PASS" : "FAIL") + " AuthTest: " + passed + " passed, " + failed + " failed");
        if (failed > 0) System.exit(1);
    }

    private static void check(boolean condition, String description) {
        if (condition) { passed++; return; }
        failed++;
        System.out.println("  FAIL " + description);
    }

    

    private static void hashesAreSaltedAndNeverRepeat() {
        PasswordHasher hasher = new PasswordHasher(PEPPER);
        String first = hasher.hash(PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial);
        String second = hasher.hash(PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial);
        check(!first.equals(second), "the same password hashes differently every time (a unique salt per account)");
        check(first.startsWith("argon2id$"), "the format names the algorithm: " + first.substring(0, 9));
        String[] parts = first.split("\\$");
        check(parts.length == 5 && !parts[3].equals(second.split("\\$")[3]), "the two hashes carry different salts");
        check(first.contains("m=65536") && first.contains("t=3"), "the Argon2id parameters are recorded alongside the hash");
        check(!first.contains(PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial), "the hash never contains the password");
    }

    private static void hashesAreVerifiableAndRejectWrongPasswords() {
        PasswordHasher hasher = new PasswordHasher(PEPPER);
        String stored = hasher.hash("MotorPH-demo-2026");
        check(hasher.verify("MotorPH-demo-2026", stored), "the right password verifies");
        check(!hasher.verify("motorPH-demo-2026", stored), "a case change fails");
        check(!hasher.verify("MotorPH-demo-202", stored), "a prefix fails");
        check(!hasher.verify("", stored), "an empty password fails");
        check(!hasher.verify("anything", "not-a-hash"), "a malformed stored value fails instead of throwing");
        check(!hasher.verify("anything", null), "a null stored value fails instead of throwing");
        
        String other = new PasswordHasher("a-completely-different-pepper-of-sufficient-length").hash("MotorPH-demo-2026");
        check(!other.equals(stored), "a different pepper produces a different hash");
    }

    private static void aPepperIsRequired() {
        boolean refused = false;
        try {
            new PasswordHasher("short");
        } catch (IllegalStateException expected) {
            refused = true;
        }
        check(refused, "a pepper shorter than 32 characters is refused, so the app cannot start with a weak one");
        boolean nullRefused = false;
        try {
            new PasswordHasher(null);
        } catch (IllegalStateException expected) {
            nullRefused = true;
        }
        check(nullRefused, "a missing pepper is refused rather than defaulted silently");
    }

    

    private static void everyEmployeeStartsWithTheInitialPassword() {
        List<Employee> roster = EmployeeImport.fromClasspath().employees();
        CredentialStore credentials = new CredentialStore(new PasswordHasher(PEPPER));
        int created = credentials.provision(Arrays.asList("10001", "10015", "10034"));
        check(created == 3 && credentials.size() == 3, "one account per provisioned employee");
        check(PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial.equals("MotorPH-demo-2026"), "the initial password is the one the brief names");
        check(credentials.account("10015").get().mustChangePassword(), "an initial account must change its password");
        check(roster.size() == 34, "the file holds 34 people, all of whom get an account at start-up");
        check(credentials.signIn("10015", PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial).ok, "the initial password signs in");
        
        credentials.changePassword("10015", PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial, "my-own-password-2026");
        check(credentials.provision(Arrays.asList("10001", "10015", "10034")) == 0,
            "provisioning again creates nothing, so a changed password survives a restart");
        check(credentials.signIn("10015", PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial).reason.equals("password"),
            "and the shared password no longer opens that account");
    }


    private static String signedIn(AuthService auth, String employeeId) {
        return signedIn(auth, employeeId, PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial);
    }

    private static String signedIn(AuthService auth, String employeeId, String password) {
        AuthService.SignIn step1 = auth.signIn(employeeId, password);
        if (!step1.ok()) return "";
        String code = auth.twoFactor().peek(step1.token).orElse("");
        AuthService.SignIn step2 = auth.verifyCode(step1.token, code);
        return step2.ok() ? step2.token : "";
    }
    private static void signInNeedsTheRightPairAndSaysNothingUsefulOtherwise() {
        AuthService auth = service(new MutableClock("2026-11-09T08:00:00Z"));
        AuthService.SignIn ok = auth.signIn("10015", PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial);
        check(ok.ok() && ok.employeeId.equals("10015"), "the right pair signs in");
        AuthService.SignIn unknown = auth.signIn("99999", PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial);
        AuthService.SignIn wrong = auth.signIn("10015", "not-the-password");
        check(!unknown.ok() && !wrong.ok(), "an unknown number and a wrong password both fail");
        check(unknown.error.equals(wrong.error), "they fail with the same message, so the roster cannot be probed");
        check(!unknown.error.toLowerCase().contains("unknown") && !unknown.error.toLowerCase().contains("no such"),
            "the message does not admit which half was wrong");
        AuthService.SignIn badFormat = auth.signIn("abc", "x");
        check(!badFormat.ok(), "a non-numeric employee number is refused before any hashing");
    }

    private static void lockoutAfterFiveAttempts() {
        check(bad.error.contains("2 tries left"), "it says how many tries remain: " + bad.error);
        check(bad.token.isEmpty(), "no token comes back on a refusal");

        AuthService.SignIn good = auth.verifyCode(step1.token, real);
        check(good.ok() && !good.token.isEmpty(), "the right code issues the session");
        check(auth.currentEmployee(good.token).isPresent(), "and that session resolves to the employee");

        AuthService.SignIn replay = auth.verifyCode(step1.token, real);
        check(!replay.ok(), "the same challenge cannot be used twice");
    }

    private static void threeWrongCodesEndTheChallenge() {
        MutableClock clock = new MutableClock("2026-11-09T08:00:00Z");
        AuthService auth = service(clock);
        AuthService.SignIn step1 = auth.signIn("10015", PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial);
        String real = auth.twoFactor().peek(step1.token).orElse("");
        String wrong = real.equals("000000") ? "111111" : "000000";

        auth.verifyCode(step1.token, wrong);
        auth.verifyCode(step1.token, wrong);
        AuthService.SignIn third = auth.verifyCode(step1.token, wrong);
        check(!third.ok() && third.error.toLowerCase().contains("three times"),
            "the third wrong code ends the challenge: " + third.error);
        AuthService.SignIn after = auth.verifyCode(step1.token, real);
        check(!after.ok(), "even the right code is useless once the challenge is spent");
    }

    private static void expiredChallengesAreRefused() {
        MutableClock clock = new MutableClock("2026-11-09T08:00:00Z");
        AuthService auth = service(clock);
        auth.setCodeMinutes(5);
        AuthService.SignIn step1 = auth.signIn("10015", PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial);
        String real = auth.twoFactor().peek(step1.token).orElse("");
        clock.advance(java.time.Duration.ofMinutes(6));
        AuthService.SignIn late = auth.verifyCode(step1.token, real);
        check(!late.ok() && late.error.toLowerCase().contains("expired"),
            "a code past its window is refused: " + late.error);
    }

    private static void aPasswordAloneGrantsNothing() {
        AuthService auth = service(new MutableClock("2026-11-09T08:00:00Z"));
        AuthService.SignIn step1 = auth.signIn("10015", PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial);
        check(!auth.currentEmployee(step1.token).isPresent(),
            "the challenge id from step one is not a session token");
        check(auth.activeSessions() == 0, "no session exists until the code is verified");
    }
    private static void signOutAndPasswordChangeRevokeServerSide() {
        MutableClock clock = new MutableClock("2026-11-09T08:00:00Z");
        AuthService auth = service(clock);
        String token = signedIn(auth, "10015");
        check(auth.currentEmployee(token).isPresent(), "the session names the employee");
        auth.signOut(token);
        check(!auth.currentEmployee(token).isPresent(), "signing out ends the session on the server, not just in the browser");
        check(!auth.currentSession(token).isPresent(), "the stored record is gone too");

        String first = signedIn(auth, "10015");
        String second = signedIn(auth, "10015");
        check(auth.currentEmployee(first).isPresent() && auth.currentEmployee(second).isPresent(), "two devices can be signed in");
        auth.changePassword(second, PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial, "a-new-password-2026");
        check(!auth.currentEmployee(first).isPresent(), "changing the password ends every other session");
        check(!auth.currentEmployee(second).isPresent(), "including the one that made the change — it is rotated, not kept");
    }

    private static void passwordChangeRotatesTheSession() {
        MutableClock clock = new MutableClock("2026-11-09T08:00:00Z");
        AuthService auth = service(clock);
        String before = signedIn(auth, "10015");
        String after = auth.changePassword(before, PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial, "another-password-2026");
        check(after != null && !after.equals(before), "the browser is given a different token (session fixation defence)");
        check(auth.currentEmployee(after).isPresent(), "the new token works");
        check(!auth.currentEmployee(before).isPresent(), "the old token does not");
        check(!auth.signIn("10015", PasswordPolicy.pw_sInitial).ok(), "the old password is refused");
        check(!signedIn(auth, "10015", "another-password-2026").isEmpty(), "the new password works");
        check(auth.changePassword(before, "another-password-2026", "third-password-2026") == null,
            "a revoked token cannot change the password again");
    }

    

    private static void csrfTokensAreLongAndComparedExactly() {
        String a = SessionCookie.newCsrfToken();
        String b = SessionCookie.newCsrfToken();
        check(!a.equals(b), "each page gets its own CSRF token");
        check(a.length() >= 43, "the CSRF token carries 32 random bytes (" + a.length() + " characters)");
        check(SessionCookie.csrfMatches(a, a), "the right token matches");
        check(!SessionCookie.csrfMatches(a, b), "a different token does not");
        check(!SessionCookie.csrfMatches(a, null) && !SessionCookie.csrfMatches(null, a),
            "a missing token never matches, so an absent header is a refusal");
        check(!SessionCookie.csrfMatches(a, a.substring(0, a.length() - 1)), "a truncated token does not match");
    }

    private static void cookieAttributesAreCorrect() {
        String session = SessionCookie.sessionCookie("TOKEN", 3600, true);
        check(session.contains("HttpOnly"), "the session cookie is HttpOnly, so no script can read it");
        check(session.contains("SameSite=Strict"), "SameSite=Strict keeps it off cross-site requests");
        check(session.contains("Secure"), "Secure over HTTPS");
        check(session.contains("Path=/"), "one cookie for the application");
        check(session.contains("Max-Age=3600"), "the cookie expires with the session");
        check(!SessionCookie.sessionCookie("TOKEN", 3600, false).contains("Secure"), "a local HTTP demo still works");
        String csrf = SessionCookie.csrfCookie("CSRF", 3600, true);
        check(!csrf.contains("HttpOnly"), "the CSRF cookie is readable by the page on purpose");
        check(SessionCookie.read("motorph_session=ABC; motorph_csrf=XYZ", AuthService.COOKIE).equals("ABC")
            && SessionCookie.read("motorph_session=ABC; motorph_csrf=XYZ", SessionCookie.CSRF_COOKIE).equals("XYZ"),
            "cookies are read individually from the header");
        check(SessionCookie.read(null, "x") == null && SessionCookie.read("", "x") == null, "no header means no cookie");
        check(SessionCookie.clearCookies(true)[0].contains("Max-Age=0"), "sign-out deletes the cookie");
    }

    

    private static AuthService service(MutableClock clock) {
        List<Employee> roster = EmployeeImport.fromClasspath().employees();
        CredentialStore credentials = new CredentialStore(new PasswordHasher(PEPPER), clock);
        List<String> ids = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        for (Employee employee : roster) ids.add(employee.getEid());
        credentials.provision(ids);
        return new AuthService(credentials, new SessionStore(clock), new OrgChart(roster),
            new TwoFactor(clock));
    }
}

## Closed: the login flow the brief requires

The server now signs people in the way the brief specifies, and the legacy path is gone from the browser's route.

- **Employee number + password.** `POST /api/auth/signin {employeeId, password}`. The initial password is
  `MotorPH-demo-2026` for all 34 accounts, provisioned at start-up with `mustChangePassword` set, so the first
  sign-in has to change it.
- **Argon2id**, per-account salt, pepper from `MOTORPH_PEPPER`. Without a 32+ character pepper the server prints a
  warning and uses a documented development value — it never invents a secret silently.
- **HttpOnly cookie.** `motorph_session` is `HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=28800` and `Secure` whenever the
  request arrived over HTTPS. The token is 32 random bytes; the server stores only its SHA-256.
- **CSRF.** A second, readable cookie (`motorph_csrf`) must be echoed in an `X-CSRF-Token` header on every
  state-changing request. Enforced once in the request wrapper, so no endpoint can forget it. Verified: a change
  without the header is refused with 403.
- **Sessions.** 15-minute idle, 8-hour absolute, both sliding and absolute checks server-side in `SessionStore`;
  resolved per request, so a revoked or expired token is simply a signed-out browser. Sign-out revokes server-side
  and clears both cookies. A password change rotates the token and kills every other session for that account.
> Historical audit; current status is in [current-status.md](current-status.md).

> Historical audit: several findings below have since been fixed. For current status and remaining risks, see [current-status.md](current-status.md).

# MotorPH requirements re-check

Checked against `MotorPH_Optimised_Implementation_Prompt_v2.md` and the original prompt supplied in the conversation. This is an evidence-based review, not proof that every screen and calculation has been exhaustively tested. Date used for completed-period checks: 2026-11-02.

## Bottom line

**Not all requirements are met. Do not expose this build to the internet or use it for real employee or payroll data.**

The last full test run reported 20 suites passed, including 119 web tests and 5 browser checks. That result is real, but it does not prove complete security or requirements coverage: the independent checks below found serious gaps.

## Must fix first

1. **Unauthenticated impersonation and administrator access.** `AppServer.java:3703–3719` accepts `X-Demo-User` as an employee identity without a valid session; no header falls back to an ADMIN actor marked non-explicit. Some permission checks only test the role, not whether the actor is authenticated. On an isolated local server, requests with no cookie returned HTTP 200 from `/api/admin/roles` and `/api/employees`; a forged `X-Demo-User: 10005` returned 200 for another employee's attendance. No sensitive response bodies were saved. Remove the trust in caller-supplied identities, reject missing/invalid sessions on all protected endpoints, review every guard, and add negative API tests for unauthenticated, expired, revoked, and spoofed requests. The role matrix tests alone do not cover this trust boundary.
2. **Passwords and 2FA are not production-safe.** `CredentialStore` is recreated and accounts are provisioned on each server startup, so password changes do not survive a restart. The six-digit code is returned in the sign-in response and displayed in the browser; it is a demo challenge, not an independent second factor. A built-in development pepper is used if no suitable environment value is supplied. The shared initial password is a source constant (`PasswordPolicy.java`), contrary to the v2 rule against a committed plaintext credential. The change-password flag is exposed to the UI; server-side restrictions on other operations while the flag is set were not established. Persist protected password hashes and enforce password change server-side; configure a real independent delivery channel if genuine 2FA is required; fail closed for a missing production pepper.
3. **Firestore writes are not durable or atomic.** The current background writer acknowledges requests before Firestore saves complete. A crash, expired token or network failure can lose acknowledged updates. A full snapshot is spread over multiple documents without an atomic commit, so interrupted writes can leave a mixed snapshot. Full-state writes by more than one server instance can overwrite each other. See `docs/firebase-setup-guide.md`. Credentials that refresh automatically will not solve these persistence issues. Design transactions or another crash-safe publication protocol and surface persistence failures to operators and clients.
4. **Live-preview shutdown and data verification.** The Firestore launcher was reported stopped previously, but the actual Java child remained on port 8081 bound to `0.0.0.0`. During this re-check, its HTTP listener was stopped and its stuck Java process was forcibly terminated. No exposure or compromise is proven; it was nevertheless potentially reachable through the preview. Because termination may interrupt a multi-document save, the live Firestore snapshot has **not** been revalidated since shutdown. Before restarting or writing, make a read-only backup/export and verify the current remote state, then review access logs if available. Revoke all tokens pasted into the conversation.
5. **Incorrectly completed data periods.** `data/local-demo.json` contains 7,421 attendance records dated 2026-01-01 through 2026-11-07. Against 2026-11-02, November is incomplete and 130 rows are dated in the future. There are only 10 completed monthly periods in this dataset, not the requested preferred 12; no saved payslip snapshots exist. `docs/a_doc/data-provenance.md` describes a different 10,358-row, 2025–2026 dataset and is stale. Do not label generated attendance or calculated payslips as actual company history. Reconcile the seed dataset, period policy and notes without fabricating completed payroll.
6. **The My Pay comparison is not implemented as requested.** `Index.html:771–777` places the switch in a payroll preview restricted to PAYROLL/ADMIN, not all employees' My Pay. `App.js:2343–2352` changes a label only; it explicitly says nothing is recalculated. It does not provide two calculations on the same employee/period inputs or show differences. UI styling is not completion of this feature.
7. **Dependency vulnerabilities.** `npm audit --json` in this check reported 30 findings: 10 high, 20 moderate, 0 critical. High findings include the direct `lighthouse` development dependency and transitive packages. These numbers are not a finding that all vulnerabilities are reachable in the shipped app; review the advisories and affected environments, fix or record risk before release. No Java dependency security audit was run in this re-check.
