## Closed: the login flow the brief requires

The server now signs people in the way the brief specifies, and the legacy path is gone from the browser's route.

- **Employee number + password.** `POST /api/auth/signin {employeeId, password}`. The initial password is
  `MotorPH-demo-2026` for all 34 accounts, provisioned at start-up with `mustChangePassword` set, so the first
  sign-in has to change it.
- **Argon2id**, per-account salt, pepper from `MOTORPH_PEPPER`. Without a 32+ character pepper the server prints a
  warning and uses a documented development value — it never invents a secret silently.
- **HttpOnly cookie.** `motorph_session` is `HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=28800` and `Secure` whenever the
  request arrived over HTTPS. The token is 32 random bytes; the server stores only its SHA-256.
- **CSRF.** A second, readable cookie (`motorph_csrf`) must be echoed in an `X-CSRF-Token` header on every
  state-changing request. Enforced once in the request wrapper, so no endpoint can forget it. Verified: a change
# Current status

## Work completed

- Firestore uses server-side Application Default Credentials with refresh rather than an employee-held token. Writes are synchronous atomic commits with a stale-writer precondition; failed/ambiguous writes stop further writes. Manual backup/list/restore and audit archive writes are supported. See [Firestore setup](../firebase-setup-guide.md) for the required pepper, IAM, limits and recovery precautions.
- Password hashes, account locks and changes persist. Protected APIs require server sessions; first-login password changes are enforced. Logout and admin password reset revoke the appropriate sessions. Restore/reset revoke sessions and rebuild identity from the imported roster, roles and reporting lines. Newly created and HR-onboarded employees receive accounts.
- The admin account-security panel now reads the actual credential state. Its limits are explicitly read-only because the earlier editable settings did not change the authentication service. Unlock and reset operate on the actual credentials.
- My Pay has a MotorPH/fixed-rate estimate switch available to employees. It is not a live Sweldong Pinoy result and does not change payroll records. I corrected UI copy that had overstated parity. See [provenance and assumptions](data-provenance.md) and [the captured browserless probe](sweldong-reference-probe.md).
- Added an admin-only storage status and round-trip check. It reports the configured store and aggregate in-process counts; the verifier compares the running state with the configured store, commits the unchanged snapshot through the normal store implementation, reads it back, and fails closed on mismatch. Local controlled-store tests cover success and failure handling. This does not establish live Firestore reliability. See [storage verification](storage-verification.md).
- Added a separate admin-only, optional Sweldong Pinoy reference comparison. It is restricted to 2026 Private Employee / Monthly with the captured 20-day / 5-day defaults and zero night differential/overtime. Every transfer requires explicit consent. It validates the external result, preserves source/version and raw response evidence, renders component deltas, keeps MotorPH as the default, and records an explicit reference-only choice in the audit log. It has no payroll-application path. Tests use a local simulated provider only; no live request or real payroll data was used. See [comparison details](sweldong-reference-probe.md).

## Verification

The latest `sh test.sh` run passed **27 suites**: 24 Java test classes, the Python tool suite (**6 tests**), **130 web unit tests**, and the **5-check browser E2E suite**. `npm run lint:web` and `npm run build` also passed. The E2E used a temporary local file store and synthetic users; it verifies the admin-only external-reference tab is visible only to admins, starts without consent or a comparison request, and does not contact the provider when opened. Comparison API/adapter tests use a local simulated provider. No live Sweldong request or real payroll data was used. Earlier Firestore-emulator checks were emulator-only and do not establish cloud IAM, billing, availability or current `motorph-jd` data reliability.

## Remaining risks and work

- **Live data:** an earlier non-atomic writer was forcibly stopped; the current state of `motorph-jd` is unknown. Export and inspect it before writing or migrating. Do not overwrite it with the sample seed.
- **Not production-ready:** the initial password specified in the brief is shared and publicly known. Requiring its change does not protect an account before first sign-in. The displayed code is not an independent second factor; no secure channel has been configured. Production onboarding needs a secure individual bootstrap and credential recovery process, a security review, HTTPS and operational controls.
- **Scale and availability:** this is a single-instance full-snapshot architecture with in-memory sessions and an atomic request size limit; it is not a normalized, multi-instance database. Independent backup/export, retention, restore drills, monitoring and load tests are still needed. A timeout can leave a committed write with an uncertain response.
- **Payroll:** generated seed attendance is not actual history; there were 130 future-dated rows relative to 2026-11-02. The temporary 2026 rules and reference assumptions need review by qualified payroll personnel. Sweldong Pinoy's full current implementation has not been verified and the reference is not claimed to reproduce it exactly.
- **Dependencies:** npm reported 30 findings (10 high, 20 moderate); the direct flagged dependency is development tooling. Java dependencies require a separate vulnerability and license inventory. See [risk review](dependency-risk-review.md).
- Earlier audits and session notes are historical snapshots; they may describe defects that have since been fixed or make claims later corrected here. The full original brief, comprehensive security/accessibility review, complete source-comparison provenance, and production deployment acceptance have not all been independently verified.

const ALL_VIEWS = ['overview', 'employees', 'attendance', 'requests', 'team', 'hr', 'reports', 'payroll', 'config'];

const UNSIGNED_VIEWS = ALL_VIEWS.filter(view => view !== 'config');

export const ROLE_VIEWS = {
  EMPLOYEE: ['overview', 'attendance', 'requests', 'team', 'payroll'],
  SUPERVISOR: ['overview', 'attendance', 'requests', 'team', 'payroll'],
  PAYROLL: ['overview', 'employees', 'attendance', 'requests', 'team', 'reports', 'payroll', 'config'],
  HR: ['overview', 'employees', 'attendance', 'requests', 'team', 'hr', 'reports', 'payroll'],
  ADMIN: ALL_VIEWS
};

const NAV_LABELS = {
  EMPLOYEE: { attendance: 'My attendance', requests: 'My requests', payroll: 'My pay' },
  SUPERVISOR: { attendance: 'Team attendance', requests: 'Requests & approvals', payroll: 'Pay & payslips' },
  PAYROLL: { payroll: 'Payroll processing', config: 'Tax tables & rates' },
  HR: { requests: 'Requests & approvals' }
};

export function viewsFor(account) {
  return account ? ROLE_VIEWS[account.role] || ROLE_VIEWS.EMPLOYEE : UNSIGNED_VIEWS;
}

export function defaultView(account) {
  return account ? 'overview' : 'employees';
}

const inTeam = (account, id) => account.employeeId === id || (account.team || []).includes(id);
const isReport = (account, id) => (account.reports || []).includes(id);

export function canPickFor(account, purpose, employeeId) {
  if (!account) return true;
  const { role } = account;
  if (role === 'ADMIN') return true;
  switch (purpose) {
    case 'leave':
    case 'ticket': return role === 'HR' || account.employeeId === employeeId;
    case 'overtime': return account.employeeId === employeeId;
    case 'payroll': return role === 'PAYROLL' || role === 'HR' || (role === 'SUPERVISOR' ? inTeam(account, employeeId) : account.employeeId === employeeId);
    case 'attendance-view': return role === 'PAYROLL' || role === 'HR' || (role === 'SUPERVISOR' ? inTeam(account, employeeId) : account.employeeId === employeeId);
    case 'attendance-edit': return role === 'SUPERVISOR' && isReport(account, employeeId);
    case 'schedule':
    case 'paychange': return role === 'SUPERVISOR' && isReport(account, employeeId);
    case 'government': return (role === 'HR' || role === 'PAYROLL') && account.employeeId !== employeeId;
    case 'processing': return role === 'HR' || (role === 'PAYROLL' && account.employeeId !== employeeId) || (role === 'SUPERVISOR' && isReport(account, employeeId));
    default: return false;
  }
}

export function canReview(account, area, ownerId) {
  if (!account || account.employeeId === ownerId) return false;
  if (account.role === 'ADMIN') return true;
  if (account.role === 'SUPERVISOR' && isReport(account, ownerId)) return true;
  return area === 'leave' && account.role === 'HR';
}

export function canCancel(account, area, ownerId) {
  if (!account) return true;
  return account.employeeId === ownerId || account.role === 'ADMIN' || (account.role === 'HR' && area !== 'overtime');
}

export function canHandleTicket(account, ticket) {
  if (!account || account.employeeId === ticket.employeeId) return false;
  if (account.role === 'ADMIN') return true;
  if (ticket.queue === 'Team Lead') return account.role === 'SUPERVISOR' && isReport(account, ticket.employeeId);
  if (ticket.queue === 'Payroll Staff') return account.role === 'PAYROLL';
  if (ticket.queue === 'HR') return account.role === 'HR';
  return false;
}

export function canFinalize(account, ownerId) {
  return !account || ((account.role === 'ADMIN' || account.role === 'PAYROLL') && account.employeeId !== ownerId);
}

export function applyRoleLayout(root, account) {
  const views = viewsFor(account);
  root.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(item => {
    item.classList.toggle('role-hidden', !views.includes(item.dataset.view));
    const label = item.querySelector('span:not(.nav-index):not(.nav-mark)');
    if (!label) return;
    if (!label.dataset.defaultLabel) label.dataset.defaultLabel = label.textContent;
    label.textContent = (account && NAV_LABELS[account.role] && NAV_LABELS[account.role][item.dataset.view]) || label.dataset.defaultLabel;
  });
  root.querySelectorAll('.tab-card').forEach(card => {
    card.classList.toggle('role-hidden', !views.includes(card.dataset.openView));
    const title = card.querySelector('.tab-card-title');
    title.textContent = (account && NAV_LABELS[account.role] && NAV_LABELS[account.role][card.dataset.openView]) || title.dataset.defaultLabel;
  });
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-roles]').forEach(element => {
    const roles = element.dataset.roles.split(/\s+/);
    element.classList.toggle('role-hidden', Boolean(account) && !roles.includes(account.role));
  });
}

export function accountFrom(accounts, employeeId) {
  const match = accounts.find(item => item.employeeId === employeeId);
  if (!match) return null;
  return { ...match, reports: accounts.filter(item => item.supervisorId === employeeId).map(item => item.employeeId) };
}

const COMPANY_AREA_READERS = {
  employees: ['HR', 'PAYROLL', 'CEO', 'CFO', 'COO', 'ADMIN'],
  attendance: ['HR', 'PAYROLL', 'COO'],
  payroll: ['HR', 'PAYROLL', 'CEO', 'CFO'],
  statutory: ['PAYROLL', 'CEO', 'CFO'],
  remittance: ['PAYROLL', 'CFO'],
  reports: ['HR', 'PAYROLL', 'CEO', 'CFO', 'COO']
};

export function canReadCompanyArea(account, area) {
  if (!account) return false;
  const readers = COMPANY_AREA_READERS[area];
  return Array.isArray(readers) ? readers.includes(account.role) : false;
}

export function isHr(account) {
  return Boolean(account) && account.role === 'HR';
}

# Comparison: Claude's build vs. the current workspace

Recorded before any implementation work, as required. Sources inspected:

- **Claude's build (the base):** `github.com/Sitramonicus/forreview` → `motorph-ms2-main/motorph-ms2-main`.
  76 Java files, 9,519 lines of main source in one package (`ph.motorph.web`), 41 browser modules,
  `test:web` + Playwright e2e, Firestore REST adapter, Firebase Auth sign-in.
- **The current workspace:** `motorph-ms2` on the same repository, plus the working copy this
  session began with.

## What the workspace copy actually is

The `motorph-ms2` folder on `main` is **not** a second implementation to merge. `diff -rq` against the
working copy shows 110 differences and they are all additive: newer docs (`identity-seats-and-testing-roles.md`,
`build-status-no-local-no-temp.md`), the seat-registry work (`RoleAssignment`, `SeatRegistry`,
`FirebaseTokenVerifier`), and the hardened `/api/payroll/rules`. Claude's tree has none of it because it
predates it. So the merge question is narrow: **take Claude's build, and port the later corrections into it.**

## Keep from Claude

| Area | Why it wins |
|---|---|
| Shell and density | 9 nav views with tab sub-navigation, the flat square Tailwind theme, navy `#12233f` surfaces, the flame accent `#ea580c`, and the real MotorPH logo (308×235 plus a transparent 720×455). The workspace build had fewer screens and a coarser look. |
| Breadth of workflow | Leave, overtime, tickets, pay changes, rate proposals, payslip corrections, disbursement, remittance, adjustment forms, saved-payslip outbox, onboard/offboard, audit trail. The workspace build had a fraction of this. |
| Attendance and payroll | `CutoffPayrollService`, `AttendanceMetrics`, clock service, schedules, holiday calendar, cut-off pipeline, payslip PDF, outbox with retry. |
| Persistence layer | `FirestoreRestClient` + the four Firestore stores + `LocalStateFile` (with backups and audit archive). The workspace build had none of the local durability. |
| Front-end module split | `page-tabs`, `my-day`, `supervisor-tools`, `hr-tools`, `payroll-processing`, per-page sort/filter/summary modules. |

## Keep from the current workspace (ported into the base)

| Correction | Why it must survive |
|---|---|
| **Identity is verified, not asserted** | Claude's `AccessPolicy.Actor` is built from the `X-Demo-User` header alone when no Firebase project is set — anyone can name anyone and be that person's role. This is the same forgery hole fixed in the workspace build. Replaced by Employee ID + password + server sessions. |
| **Seats, not one-role-per-account** | The workspace build established that a person holds a *set* of roles (10006 is HR Manager and also supervises someone) and that one login must be able to exercise several roles. Claude's model is one role per account. |
| **`/api/payroll/rules` must not be public** | Claude's `/api/payroll/preview` and statutory routes were open. The workspace build gated rates behind a session and withheld the bracket tables from non-admins. Re-applied. |
| **Real employee file, no invented people** | Claude seeds `DEMO-001…005` (Mara Rivera, Eli Santos, …). Those are replaced by the 34 rows of `Copy of MotorPH_Employee Data - Employee Details.csv`. |
| **Durability discipline** | "No locals, no temps": the workspace build refused to start in a memory-only production mode. Claude's `data/local-demo.json` is a real store, which is fine, but nothing may be seeded as a fiction. |
| **Golden payslip** | The sample payslip must reproduce to the centavo (P22,711.67 net). Claude's statutory calculator is present but its golden case was never asserted against the sample. Re-asserted. |

## Replace or reconcile

| Item | Decision |
|---|---|
| Firebase Auth sign-in, `X-Firebase-UID`, token verifier | **Removed.** Replaced by Employee ID + password, Argon2id, HttpOnly session cookie. Firestore is retained as the data store where configured; authentication is fully separated from it. |
| `TwoFactor` with on-screen demo code | **Removed from sign-in.** A 2FA code displayed on the same screen as the password field adds steps without adding security. Sessions, not 2FA prompts, now carry the risk. The `SessionStore` keeps its own absolute/idle expiry instead. |
| `AccountSecurity` PBKDF2, 20,000 rounds | **Replaced** by Argon2id (BouncyCastle) with a startup-supplied pepper. The old class also held `DEFAULT_PASSWORD` in source, which stays, but only as the documented first-login credential that must be changed. |
| `AccessPolicy` role map keyed on `DEMO-00x` | **Replaced** by the CSV-derived org chart: roles from position, scope from the reporting tree. |
| Branch = free-text `location` string | **Replaced** by named branches with a leaf-team centroid rule (see `branch-assignment.md`). |
| `DemoSeedService`, `DemoLeaveRequest`, `DemoOvertimeRequest`, `DemoTicket` | **Renamed** (`SeedRecords`, `LeaveRequest`, `OvertimeRequest`, `SupportTicket`) and the "demo" wording removed everywhere in product surface. |
| "Synthetic"/"fictional"/"demo" copy in UI, docs, tests | **Removed.** |
| Flat single package `ph.motorph.web` | **Split** into `o_oop`, `c_calc`, `t_tkt`, `l_log`, `sp_secpol`, `svc` as the brief requires. |
| `test.sh` listing 16 `java` invocations | **Replaced** by a script that compiles every package and runs a registered suite list. |

## Order of authority used for the rest of this work

1. The brief (`MotorPH_Optimised_Implementation_Prompt_v2.md`).
2. Corrected behaviour from the workspace build, where it does not conflict.
3. Claude's build as the base.
4. Supplied CSVs, timecard and payslip.
5. Reasonable assumptions, recorded in `assumptions-and-data-notes.md`.

const ALL_VIEWS = ['overview', 'employees', 'attendance', 'requests', 'team', 'hr', 'reports', 'payroll', 'config'];

const UNSIGNED_VIEWS = ALL_VIEWS.filter(view => view !== 'config');

export const ROLE_VIEWS = {
  EMPLOYEE: ['overview', 'attendance', 'requests', 'team', 'payroll'],
  SUPERVISOR: ['overview', 'attendance', 'requests', 'team', 'payroll'],
  PAYROLL: ['overview', 'employees', 'attendance', 'requests', 'team', 'reports', 'payroll', 'config'],
  HR: ['overview', 'employees', 'attendance', 'requests', 'team', 'hr', 'reports', 'payroll'],
  ADMIN: ALL_VIEWS
};

const NAV_LABELS = {
  EMPLOYEE: { attendance: 'My attendance', requests: 'My requests', payroll: 'My pay' },
  SUPERVISOR: { attendance: 'Team attendance', requests: 'Requests & approvals', payroll: 'Pay & payslips' },
  PAYROLL: { payroll: 'Payroll processing', config: 'Tax tables & rates' },
  HR: { requests: 'Requests & approvals' }
};

export function viewsFor(account) {
  return account ? ROLE_VIEWS[account.role] || ROLE_VIEWS.EMPLOYEE : UNSIGNED_VIEWS;
}

export function defaultView(account) {
  return account ? 'overview' : 'employees';
}

const inTeam = (account, id) => account.employeeId === id || (account.team || []).includes(id);
const isReport = (account, id) => (account.reports || []).includes(id);

export function canPickFor(account, purpose, employeeId) {
  if (!account) return true;
  const { role } = account;
  if (role === 'ADMIN') return true;
  switch (purpose) {
    case 'leave':
    case 'ticket': return role === 'HR' || account.employeeId === employeeId;
    case 'overtime': return account.employeeId === employeeId;
    case 'payroll': return role === 'PAYROLL' || role === 'HR' || (role === 'SUPERVISOR' ? inTeam(account, employeeId) : account.employeeId === employeeId);
    case 'attendance-view': return role === 'PAYROLL' || role === 'HR' || (role === 'SUPERVISOR' ? inTeam(account, employeeId) : account.employeeId === employeeId);
    case 'attendance-edit': return role === 'SUPERVISOR' && isReport(account, employeeId);
    case 'schedule':
    case 'paychange': return role === 'SUPERVISOR' && isReport(account, employeeId);
    case 'government': return (role === 'HR' || role === 'PAYROLL') && account.employeeId !== employeeId;
    case 'processing': return role === 'HR' || (role === 'PAYROLL' && account.employeeId !== employeeId) || (role === 'SUPERVISOR' && isReport(account, employeeId));
    default: return false;
  }
}

export function canReview(account, area, ownerId) {
  if (!account || account.employeeId === ownerId) return false;
  if (account.role === 'ADMIN') return true;
  if (account.role === 'SUPERVISOR' && isReport(account, ownerId)) return true;
  return area === 'leave' && account.role === 'HR';
}

export function canCancel(account, area, ownerId) {
  if (!account) return true;
  return account.employeeId === ownerId || account.role === 'ADMIN' || (account.role === 'HR' && area !== 'overtime');
}

export function canHandleTicket(account, ticket) {
  if (!account || account.employeeId === ticket.employeeId) return false;
  if (account.role === 'ADMIN') return true;
  if (ticket.queue === 'Team Lead') return account.role === 'SUPERVISOR' && isReport(account, ticket.employeeId);
  if (ticket.queue === 'Payroll Staff') return account.role === 'PAYROLL';
  if (ticket.queue === 'HR') return account.role === 'HR';
  return false;
}

export function canFinalize(account, ownerId) {
  return !account || ((account.role === 'ADMIN' || account.role === 'PAYROLL') && account.employeeId !== ownerId);
}

export function applyRoleLayout(root, account) {
  const views = viewsFor(account);
  root.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(item => {
    item.classList.toggle('role-hidden', !views.includes(item.dataset.view));
    const label = item.querySelector('span:not(.nav-index):not(.nav-mark)');
    if (!label) return;
    if (!label.dataset.defaultLabel) label.dataset.defaultLabel = label.textContent;
    label.textContent = (account && NAV_LABELS[account.role] && NAV_LABELS[account.role][item.dataset.view]) || label.dataset.defaultLabel;
  });
  root.querySelectorAll('.tab-card').forEach(card => {
    card.classList.toggle('role-hidden', !views.includes(card.dataset.openView));
    const title = card.querySelector('.tab-card-title');
    title.textContent = (account && NAV_LABELS[account.role] && NAV_LABELS[account.role][card.dataset.openView]) || title.dataset.defaultLabel;
  });
  root.querySelectorAll('[data-roles]').forEach(element => {
    const roles = element.dataset.roles.split(/\s+/);
    element.classList.toggle('role-hidden', Boolean(account) && !roles.includes(account.role));
  });
}

export function accountFrom(accounts, employeeId) {
  const match = accounts.find(item => item.employeeId === employeeId);
  if (!match) return null;
  return { ...match, reports: accounts.filter(item => item.supervisorId === employeeId).map(item => item.employeeId) };
}

const COMPANY_AREA_READERS = {
  employees: ['HR', 'PAYROLL', 'CEO', 'CFO', 'COO', 'ADMIN'],
  attendance: ['HR', 'PAYROLL', 'COO'],
  payroll: ['HR', 'PAYROLL', 'CEO', 'CFO'],
  statutory: ['PAYROLL', 'CEO', 'CFO'],
  remittance: ['PAYROLL', 'CFO'],
  reports: ['HR', 'PAYROLL', 'CEO', 'CFO', 'COO']
};

export function canReadCompanyArea(account, area) {
  if (!account) return false;
  const readers = COMPANY_AREA_READERS[area];
  return Array.isArray(readers) ? readers.includes(account.role) : false;
}

export function isHr(account) {
  return Boolean(account) && account.role === 'HR';
}

function switchView(view) {
  const labels = { overview: 'Overview', employees: 'Employees', attendance: 'Attendance', requests: 'Requests & tickets', team: 'Team roster', hr: 'HR operations', reports: 'Reports', payroll: 'Payroll', config: 'System configuration' };
  if (!labels[view]) return;
  document.querySelectorAll('.page-view').forEach(page => {
    page.hidden = page.id !== `${view}-view`;
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(nav => {
    const active = nav.dataset.view === view;
    nav.classList.toggle('active', active);
    if (active) nav.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
    else nav.removeAttribute('aria-current');
  });
  const navLabel = document.querySelector(`.nav-item[data-view="${view}"] span[data-default-label]`);
  document.getElementById('crumb-current').textContent = navLabel ? navLabel.textContent : labels[view];
  document.title = `${labels[view]} — MotorPH Payroll Office`;
  if (view === 'attendance' && attendanceEmployee.value) loadAttendance();
  if (view === 'reports') loadAttendanceReport();
  if (view === 'team') loadTeamToday();
  pageTabs.refresh();
  notificationsUi.refresh();
}

document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(item => {
  item.addEventListener('click', () => switchView(item.dataset.view));
});
document.getElementById('leave-calendar-span').addEventListener('change', renderLeaveCalendar);
document.querySelectorAll('.tab-card').forEach(card => {
  card.addEventListener('click', () => switchView(card.dataset.openView));
});
document.querySelectorAll('[data-workspace-view]').forEach(button => {
  button.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const view = button.dataset.workspaceView;
    switchView(view);
    const tab = button.dataset.workspaceTab;
    if (tab) {
      const target = document.querySelector(`#${view}-view [data-tab="${tab}"]`);
      if (target) pageTabs.reveal(target);
    }
  });
});




async function refreshBranchAndAccount(account) {
  document.getElementById('branch-panel').hidden = false;
  document.getElementById('account-panel').hidden = false;
  document.getElementById('account-password-label').textContent = state.defaultPassword ? 'USING THE SHARED DEFAULT PASSWORD' : '';
  payrollJson(`/api/personal/${encodeURIComponent(account.employeeId)}`).then(record => {
    document.getElementById('account-personal').textContent = record.address
      ? `${record.firstName} ${record.surname} · ${record.gender || 'gender not recorded'} · Birthdate ${record.birthdate} · Contact ${record.contactNumber || '—'}`
        + `${record.email ? ` · ${record.email}` : ''} · Address: ${record.address} (HR keeps these up to date).`
      : 'HR has not recorded your address, contact number and birthdate yet.';
    const photo = document.getElementById('account-photo');
    photo.hidden = true;
    if (record.hasPhoto) {
      apiHeaders({ Accept: 'image/*' }).then(headers => fetch(`/api/personal/${encodeURIComponent(account.employeeId)}/photo`, { headers }))
        .then(response => (response.ok ? response.blob() : null)).then(blob => { if (blob) { photo.src = URL.createObjectURL(blob); photo.hidden = false; } });
    }
  }).catch(() => {});
  if (account.branch) {
    
    const where = /branch$/i.test(account.branch) ? account.branch : `${account.branch} branch`;
    document.getElementById('operator-label').textContent = `${account.name} · ${account.roleLabel} · ${where}`;
  }
  const branchRowsBody = document.getElementById('branch-rows');
  branchRowsBody.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
  try {
    const payload = await payrollJson('/api/branches');
    const mine = /branch$/i.test(payload.mine || '') ? payload.mine : `${payload.mine} branch`;
    document.getElementById('branch-title').textContent = payload.branches.length > 1 ? 'Branches' : mine;
    document.getElementById('branch-date').textContent = `TODAY · ${payload.today}`;
    const tbody = document.getElementById('branch-rows');
    tbody.replaceChildren();
    branchRows(payload).forEach(values => {
      const row = document.createElement('tr');
      values.forEach(value => row.append(makeCell(value)));
      tbody.append(row);
    });
  } catch (error) {
    document.getElementById('branch-date').textContent = error.message;
  } finally {
    branchRowsBody.removeAttribute('aria-busy');
  }
}

document.getElementById('change-password-form').addEventListener('submit', async event => {
  event.preventDefault();
  const form = event.currentTarget;
  const status = document.getElementById('change-password-status');
  status.textContent = 'Changing your password…';
  try {
    await postAuth('/api/auth/password', { current: document.getElementById('password-current').value, next: document.getElementById('password-next').value });
    state.defaultPassword = false;
    document.getElementById('account-password-label').textContent = '';
    form.reset();
    status.textContent = 'Password changed. Other sign-ins of this account were signed out.';
  } catch (error) {
    status.textContent = error.message;
  }
});

function enterAs(account) {
  state.account = account;
  sessionStorage.setItem(ACCOUNT_KEY, account.employeeId);
  applyRoleLayout(document, account);
  showWorkspace(account);
  document.getElementById('operator-label').textContent = `${account.name} · ${account.roleLabel}`;
  document.getElementById('operator-avatar').textContent = account.name.split(' ').map(part => part[0]).join('').slice(0, 2);
  document.getElementById('switch-account-button').hidden = false;
  loadStorageMode();
  myDay.refresh();
  outbox.refresh();
  refreshBranchAndAccount(account);
  notificationsUi.refresh();
  if (['PAYROLL', 'HR', 'ADMIN', 'SUPERVISOR'].includes(account.role)) payrollProcessing.refresh();
  switchView(defaultView(account));
}

async function postAuth(url, body) {
  const headers = await apiHeaders({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
  const response = await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers, credentials: 'same-origin', body: JSON.stringify(body) });
  const payload = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload.error || `Request failed (${response.status})`);
  if (payload.csrfToken) state.csrfToken = payload.csrfToken;
  return payload;
}

async function endSession() {
  sessionStorage.removeItem(ACCOUNT_KEY);
  sessionStorage.removeItem(SESSION_KEY);
  await postAuth('/api/auth/signout', {}).catch(() => {});
  state.session = '';
}

# Change log — 2026-11-05

Everything added or changed in this session, in the order it was done. All data is synthetic (DEMO employees only).

## Quick start (local demo mode, no Firebase)

- Run from Git Bash in `motorph-ms2`: `./run.sh` (Firebase mode, port 8080) or use the `motorph-local` preview config (local demo, port 8081).
- Local demo mode is needed to see leave approval (Firebase mode has no reviewer role).
- Tests: `./test.sh` (Java), `npm run test:web` (browser logic), `npm run test:e2e` (full browser flow), `npm run build`.

## 1. Setup on this Windows laptop

- Installed npm packages (`npm install`; 0 vulnerabilities).
- `run.sh`, `run-api.sh`, `test.sh`: Java classpath separator now switches to `;` on Windows (Git Bash) and stays `:` elsewhere.
- `test/e2e/local-workflows.e2e.js`:
  - classpath uses `path.delimiter`
  - spawns `npm.cmd` through a shell on Windows (newer Node refuses otherwise)
  - stops test servers with `taskkill /T` so Vite isn't left running
- Installed Playwright's Chromium (`npx playwright-core install chromium`) so `npm run test:e2e` runs.
- Added `G:\z\JD\.claude\launch.json` with two app previews: `motorph` (8080, Firebase) and `motorph-local` (8081, local demo).

## 2. Leave approve / reject (local demo only)

- New route `POST /api/workflows/leave/{id}/approve` and `/reject`, body `{"reviewerId":"DEMO-002"}`.
- Records `reviewerId` and `reviewedAt` (the course Leave table's `approverID` / `dateApproved`).
- Rules enforced:
  - only a **Pending review** request can be decided (otherwise `409`)
  - the reviewer must exist in the directory
  - **a reviewer cannot approve or reject their own request** (my addition; not in the course docs)
  - Firebase mode returns `403` (the published Firestore rules have no reviewer role)
- Browser: "Reviewing as (local demo supervisor)" picker, Approve/Reject buttons on pending rows, Approved/Rejected in the status filter, reviewer and time shown in row Details.
- Files: `DemoLeaveRequest.java`, `WorkflowStore.java`, `InMemoryWorkflowStore.java`, `FirestoreWorkflowStore.java` (blocked on purpose), `WorkflowService.java`, `AppServer.java`, `web/app.js`, `web/index.html`.

## 3. Temporary leave credits

- **Placeholder numbers (user-chosen, not an approved policy)**, in `LeavePolicy.java`:
  - Vacation 5 days/year (same as the Labor Code's 5-day Service Incentive Leave minimum)
  - Medical 5 days/year
  - Personal 3 days/year
  - Unpaid: not limited
- Days counted Monday–Friday; no holiday calendar.
- A request counts in the calendar year it starts.
- Pending requests hold credits; approved requests use them; cancelling frees them.
- Submitting more than (remaining − pending) is refused; approving more than remaining is refused.
- New route `GET /api/workflows/leave/balances?employeeId=…&year=…`.
- Browser: "Temporary leave credits" table in the leave form (yearly / used / pending / remaining).
- Files: `LeavePolicy.java`, `LeaveBalance.java`, `WorkflowService.java`, `AppServer.java`, `web/app.js`, `web/index.html`, `web/workflow.css`.

## 4. Attendance-based cutoff payroll

> Superseded in part by section 10: rates are now monthly basic ÷ 168, and paid time is min(worked, 8 h) instead of the 17:00 cap.

- Rules chosen by the user (course convention), in `PayrollProfile.java`:
  - cutoffs **1–15** and **16–month end**
  - log-in up to **08:10 counts as 08:00**; log-in before 08:00 also counts from 08:00 (my assumption)
  - log-out capped at **17:00**
  - **12:00–13:00 lunch is unpaid** (only the overlapping part is removed)
- **Placeholder hourly rates**: DEMO-001 ₱150, DEMO-002 ₱160, DEMO-003 ₱200. Employees without a rate are refused.
- Gross = paid minutes × rate ÷ 60, rounded half-up per cutoff.
- New route `GET /api/payroll/cutoffs?employeeId=…&month=…`.
- Browser: "Cutoff payroll estimate" panel on the Payroll page.
- Files: `PayrollProfile.java`, `CutoffPay.java`, `CutoffPayrollService.java`, `MonthPayroll.java`, `web/payroll-cutoff.js`.

## 5. Calculations matched to sweldongpinoy.com

- The mentor named **https://www.sweldongpinoy.com/** as the reference.
- Our results were compared with the site's 2026 Private Employee results for **25 salaries (₱1,000–₱700,000)**; all match to the centavo.
- To match, three rules changed:
  - **Tax** is annualised: 12 × monthly taxable, using the RR 11-2018 annual table, ÷ 12 (was the monthly table). The site also added a 13th month above ₱90,000 basic; **removed in section 11** per the mentor
  - **PhilHealth** employee share is rounded from salary × 2.5% (was 5% rounded, then halved)
  - **Pag-IBIG** was 2% from exactly ₱1,500 to match the site; **changed back to 1% in section 10** per the mentor
- SSS already matched.
- **Deductions are split half per cutoff**, like the site's semi-monthly view (user's choice). Each line (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, tax) is halved; an odd centavo goes to the 2nd cutoff so the month adds up exactly.
- A cutoff whose share of deductions is bigger than its gross is shown as **blocked**, never as a negative net.

## 6. All payroll math moved to Java

- `StatutoryCalculator2026.java` + `StatutoryBreakdown.java`: SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG and tax in whole centavos (inputs capped at ₱10,000,000).
- New route `POST /api/payroll/statutory` serves the manual "Monthly contribution preview" form.
- `MonthPayroll.java` combines gross, deductions and the per-cutoff split for both the cutoff screen and payslips.
- The browser only formats results:
  - `web/payroll-preview-2026.js` now has only peso parsing/formatting
  - `web/payroll-rules-2026.js` was deleted (its rules are in Java)
- The preview shows "Calculating…" while waiting for Java.

## 7. Payslips (view and print)

- New route `GET /api/payroll/payslip?employeeId=…&month=…&cutoff=1|2`.
- Shows:
  - payslip number (`PS-DEMO-001-2026-10-1`)
  - employee name, department, role
  - pay period, paid hours, rate
  - gross, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, tax, total deductions, **net pay**
- Clearly labelled **"SYNTHETIC DEMO — NOT A REAL PAYSLIP"**; **nothing is saved**.
- No payslip for a cutoff with no paid attendance or a blocked net (`409`).
- Browser: "Payslip" button on each payable cutoff row, payslip card, **Print payslip** button (prints only the payslip).
- Files: `AppServer.java`, `MonthPayroll.java`, `web/payroll-cutoff.js`, `web/index.html`, `web/payroll-preview.css`.

## 8. Tests added or updated

- Java (`./test.sh`, **387 checks**, was 181):
  - `StatutoryCalculator2026Test` — the 25 sweldongpinoy.com values plus SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG/tax boundaries
  - `CutoffPayrollServiceTest` — hours rules, cutoff gross, per-line split (hand-worked values)

## 10. Mentor's answers applied

The mentor answered the eight questions. What changed in the code:

- **Hourly rate = monthly basic ÷ 168** (matches MotorPH's employee file: ₱90,000 → ₱535.71, ₱60,000 → ₱357.14).
  - The flat ₱150 / ₱160 / ₱200 rates are gone.
  - Placeholder monthly basics: DEMO-001 ₱52,670 (₱313.51/h, the file's lowest rate), DEMO-002 ₱60,000 (₱357.14/h), DEMO-003 ₱90,000 (₱535.71/h).
  - The API now also returns `monthlyBasic`.
- **Paid time = min(worked, 8 hours) per day**; no more "cap at 17:00".
  - A 10:00–19:00 shift with the meal hour pays 8 h, no overtime.
  - An early log-in (e.g. 07:00–17:00 = 9 h worked) pays 8 h; the extra 1 h is shown as **"unapproved, unpaid"** (`unpaidOverageMinutes`) and is never added to pay.
  - Grace (08:00–08:10 counts as 08:00) and the unpaid 12:00–13:00 meal hour stay.
- **Pag-IBIG at exactly ₱1,500 is now 1%** (HDMF Circular 460: "at or below ₱1,500").
  - This is the one place we now differ from sweldongpinoy.com, on purpose.
  - Ruleset renamed `PH-2026-sweldongpinoy-v3`.
- Profile renamed `TEMPORARY-2026-mentor-v1`.
- Already matched the mentor's answers, so no change was needed:
  - leave credits stay a labelled demo policy and are not used in payroll
  - self-approval is blocked on the server by employee ID
- Tests updated with new hand-worked values:
  - DEMO-001 October: 24 h × ₱313.51 = ₱7,524.24; net ₱7,136.50
  - DEMO-002 end-to-end: nets ₱5,291.03 and ₱2,433.90

## 17. Clock in/out and salary tracker (phase 2, part 1)

- **My day** panel at the top of Overview for every demo account.
  - Employees and Supervisors land on it; for them it replaces the build-summary numbers.
- **Time clock:**
  - **Clock in** and **Clock out** use the **server's time** (Asia/Manila, to the minute), not the browser's, so the time can't be edited on the device.
  - Clock out writes one normal attendance row, which then goes through the usual pay rules (08:10 grace, meal hour, 8 h cap, approved overtime).
  - One row per person per day: after clocking out, it says "Done for today".
  - You can't clock in twice or clock out without clocking in.
  - Shortcut: a shift past midnight is closed at 23:59 of the day it started; overnight shifts need a rule.
  - The open shift is kept in server memory, like the rest of the local demo.
- **Salary tracker** for the cutoff you're in (1–15 or 16–end):
  - shows paid hours so far (plus approved overtime, paid leave and holidays), gross so far, estimated deductions, estimated net, and month gross so far
  - all amounts come from the Java payroll engine
  - it counts **only days up to today**. While building it I found that future approved leave and holidays (e.g. Bonifacio Day on 30 Nov) were being counted as "so far". New `through=` option on `/api/payroll/cutoffs` fixes that.
  - an open shift counts once you clock out
- Routes: `GET`/`POST /api/attendance/clock` (signed-in account only; Firebase mode `403`).
- Files: `ClockService.java`, `AppServer.java` (`handleClock`, `through`), `CutoffPayrollService.java`, `web/my-day.js`, `web/app.js`, `web/index.html`, `web/main.css`.
- Tests: `ClockServiceTest` (9 checks with a controllable clock, including the 08:04 grace and past-midnight cases), 10 more API checks, a `through=` payroll check, `test/web/my-day.test.js`, and an end-to-end step where Jae clocks in and out and sees the tracker.
- Results: Java **514**, browser logic **73**, end-to-end **20/20** (run twice), build OK, `npm audit` 0 vulnerabilities.

## 18. Payroll gross-to-net, disbursement and remittance (phase 2, part 2)

Your choices: allowances are non-taxable and paid half per cutoff; bonuses are taxable; build everything (earnings, voluntary deductions, disbursement, remittance).

- **How a cutoff is paid now:**
  - **Earned pay** (attendance, premiums, approved overtime, night differential, holiday and leave pay) **+ taxable bonuses = gross**
  - **− statutory**, half of the month's each cutoff:
    - SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG are on earned pay only (bonuses don't change them)
    - withholding tax is on earned pay + bonuses
  - **− voluntary deductions** (company loan, insurance, benefit contribution), taken in the order added, never more than what's left. If there isn't enough pay, the rest shows as "not taken".
  - **+ allowances** (rice, phone, clothing): non-taxable and outside every contribution base, half of the monthly amount each cutoff
  - **= net pay**
- **Placeholder monthly allowances** (shaped like the MotorPH employee file):

  | Person | Rice | Phone | Clothing | Paid by |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | Mara | ₱1,500 | ₱1,000 | ₱1,000 | Direct deposit |
  | Eli | ₱1,500 | ₱1,000 | ₱1,000 | Direct deposit |
  | Noa | ₱1,500 | ₱2,000 | ₱1,000 | Direct deposit |

# Source-grounded acceptance baseline (draft)

**Purpose:** record observable pass/fail behavior already implemented and define safe candidate acceptance criteria before tailoring. This is a working baseline, **not an approved rubric interpretation**. No standalone active MO-IT110 grading rubric was identified among the supplied files in the workspace; the older MO-IT108/107 documents and peer submissions inform scope, while the Terminal Assessment proposal is treated as placeholder material rather than an authoritative detailed specification.

**Scope rules:** fictional data only; use the signed-in user's sandbox in Firebase mode; keep ordinary local-preview persistence explicitly process-memory; do not treat inferred attendance/payroll rules, peer-project choices, employee-to-account identity, reviewer authority, or access boundaries as approved policy. At the user's direction, a clearly labelled 2026 monthly statutory preview is now available with synthetic inputs only; its rules are isolated in a changeable module and it has no API/Firestore/payslip path. Attendance-based or persistent payroll, approvals, and reviewer controls remain gated. See `docs/candidate-policy-review.md`. The user-published development rules remain unchanged.

## Candidate acceptance matrix

| Area | Observable acceptance in current prototype | State | Source / boundary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Authentication and sandbox | Email/password account creation/sign-in/sign-out on localhost; Firebase requests use the caller's ID token and user-scoped paths. Auth lifecycle smoke uses a disposable account, verifies empty reads, signs out, deletes the account, and makes no Firestore writes. | Verified locally; exact Arena preview origin still unverified | Firebase setup guide, Firestore rules review, browser smoke evidence. No organizational roles or employee-account mapping. |
| Employee directory | Search/detail; selectable field/direction sorting on the employee register; create/update only name, department, role label, location, and demo status; server-generated IDs; HR-table text/status filters, selectable sorting, and filtered CSV export; read-only synthetic label-count summary; employee detail includes that employee's raw rows and stored workflow labels only. | Implemented and browser tested | Legacy MO-IT108 traceability and API contract. No salary/government IDs, termination, employee delete, schedule assignment, or audit history. |
| Raw attendance view and local demo entry | Select an employee; inclusive optional date range; sort/show/export raw rows and record-date bounds; month calendar displays only loaded raw date/time rows and two selected dates apply an inclusive raw-row filter. In local process-memory demo mode only, create a raw synthetic date/time row for an existing mapped employee; server fixes `dayType` to `DEMO`, enforces unique `(scheduleID, date)` and `timeIn <= timeOut`, and rejects unmapped employees. Empty rows are not treated as absence. | Local create-only path, Firebase read-only path, Java/API/browser tested | MO-IT107 Attendance fields and validation plus earlier MO-IT108 default-range behavior. No Firebase attendance write, schedule assignment, correction/delete, clock verification, hours, classification, or payroll calculation. |
| Attendance coverage and sandbox data tools | By configured employee-to-schedule mapping, return raw-row counts and first/last dates for an optional inclusive range; allow employee/name/ID/schedule search, mapped/unmapped filtering, field/direction sorting, drill-through to raw rows, and CSV export of visible rows. Employee-linked raw/leave/ticket counts support employee search, mapping filter, sorting, and visible/all CSV; cross-module search and one-click JSON portability bundle read only the current user sandbox and carry no calculations or payroll inputs. Unmapped means “not attributed,” not “absent.” | Implemented; API and browser tested, including an empty signed-in Firebase sandbox | This summarizes stored rows only. No hours, attendance classification, worked days, or payroll period are inferred. |
| Leave request | Submit fictional request with validated type/date range; cancel own pending request; search/status/type/date-overlap filter history; optional table sorting with newest-first default; show submitted/cancelled timestamps and notes; visible-only or all-record CSV export; calendar shows submitted request dates only and lets the user draft form bounds from selected dates without submitting or calculating days. | Implemented; local E2E and Firestore live smoke passed | Source set does not define accrual, balances, eligibility, approvals, reviewer scope, calendar approval status, or payroll treatment. Those remain gated. |
| Help-desk ticket | Submit fictional ticket; derive documented queue label; cancel own open ticket; search/status/type-filter history; optional table sorting with newest-first default; reveal message/timestamps and export visible or all records as CSV. | Implemented; local E2E and Firestore live smoke passed | Queue labels are demonstration labels only. No real delivery, assignment, reviewer authorization, resolution, or notifications. |
| Team and HR operations | Team screen is read-only with search/status filtering, field/direction sorting, selected-record detail view, and filtered CSV export; HR desk can create/update the allowlisted synthetic directory fields and filter/sort its table with filtered CSV export. | Partial, owner-sandbox only | No membership model, supervisor relationships, HR role, lifecycle permissions, audit trail, or employee-account binding is defined. |
| Reporting and exports | CSV exports for visible synthetic employees, filtered HR directory and Team roster, raw selected attendance, visible attendance coverage rows, directory status/department and workflow status/type/queue label counts, and owner-sandbox workflows; formula-leading values are neutralized. Reports include grouped counts of stored leave/ticket status, type, and queue labels only, with CSV export; no approval, resolution, balance, or payroll semantics are inferred. Overview shows current directory, selected raw attendance, and workflow counts. | Implemented and tested | No payroll reports, payslips, monthly pay-period reports, or archival deletion. |
| Temporary 2026 statutory preview | Monthly preview accepts explicit synthetic cash pay, SSS compensation, PhilHealth MBS, Pag-IBIG Fund Salary, and taxable compensation bases; the Java service (`POST /api/payroll/statutory`) returns employee/employer contributions, annualised BIR withholding, net estimate, and employer contribution cost. No Firestore/payslip persistence; an explicit downloadable CSV is labeled a temporary preview, not a payslip. | Implemented; Java tests incl. 25 sweldongpinoy.com values, and local browser E2E | Calculation follows sweldongpinoy.com (mentor-specified, checked 2026-11-05) in `StatutoryCalculator2026.java`. Half-up centavo rounding is explicit; per the mentor, no 13th month is added to tax and Pag-IBIG is 1% at exactly ₱1,500. Not production payroll. |
| Role-based workspaces | Local demo account chooser; Employee, Supervisor, Payroll Staff, HR and System Admin each get their own menu and tools; the server enforces the RBAC matrix (reads filtered by Self/Team/All, approvals by identity, no self-approval). | Implemented; 29 policy checks, 26 API role checks, browser E2E per role | Demo accounts have no passwords; Firebase mode has no roles yet. |
| Overtime requests | Local demo: submit date + minutes; another employee approves or rejects; approved minutes are paid at the mentor's OT rates (125%–338%) with stacked night differential. | Implemented; Java hand-worked, API and browser E2E | Firebase mode returns 403. Rest days assumed Saturday/Sunday. |

See `docs/candidate-policy-review.md`. |
| Release readiness | Java/web unit checks, local browser E2E, live localhost Auth smoke, build, and dependency audit run. | Development prototype only | No production hosting, role security review, backup/monitoring, or published preview-origin verification. |

## 16. Role-based workspaces (phase 1)

Built from your RBAC roles, permissions matrix and Venn diagram. You chose: roles and layouts first, 2 extra demo people, local demo only.

- **Demo accounts** (all fictional). The app now opens at **"Choose a demo account"**:

  | Account | Role | Notes |
  |---|---|---|
  | Mara Rivera (DEMO-001) | HR | reports to Noa |
  | Eli Santos (DEMO-002) | Payroll Staff | reports to Noa |
  | Noa Reyes (DEMO-003) | Supervisor | leads the team |
  | **Jae Cruz (DEMO-004)** | Employee | **new**; reports to Noa; ₱25,000 placeholder basic, 2 October attendance rows |
  | **Lia Torres (DEMO-005)** | System Admin | **new**; ₱75,000 placeholder basic |

  - **Switch account** (top bar) goes back to the chooser.
  - There are no passwords, because this is a demo, not a real login.
- **Each role has its own menu:**
  - **Employee:** Overview, My attendance, My requests, Team, My pay
  - **Supervisor:** Overview, Team attendance, Requests & approvals, Team, Pay & payslips
  - **Payroll Staff:** Overview, Employees, Attendance, Requests, Team, Reports, Payroll processing
  - **HR:** Overview, Employees, Attendance, Requests & approvals, Team, HR desk, Reports, Payroll
  - **System Admin:** everything
- **Tools shown per role:**
  - statutory calculator: Payroll Staff and Admin
  - timesheet entry: Supervisor (direct reports only) and Admin
  - Finalize payslip: Payroll Staff and Admin, never their own
  - build tracker and "still outside" panel: Admin only
  - pickers list only the people you may act for (e.g. an Employee's leave, overtime and pay pickers show only themselves)
- **The server enforces it** (`AccessPolicy.java`). It's not just hidden in the browser:
  - Reads are filtered by **Self / Team / All** as in the matrix. Employee and Supervisor see their team in the directory and team leave ("view team members", "check team leave").
  - **Approvals use the signed-in account** (mentor: "by identity, not role"). Leave is approved by the employee's supervisor, HR or Admin; overtime by the supervisor or Admin. **Nobody approves their own request.** The old "Reviewing as" dropdowns are hidden.
  - You file leave, overtime and tickets for yourself; HR may file leave and tickets for anyone; Admin may file anything.
  - Employee records are created and edited by HR and Admin only.
- **Tests:** new `AccessPolicyTest` (29 checks), 26 role checks in the API test, `test/web/roles.test.js`, and a new end-to-end section that signs in as each account. The existing approval steps now really switch accounts: Eli can't approve his own leave or overtime, Mara (HR) can't approve overtime, and Noa approves both.
- **Changed expectations:** 5 people instead of 3 (directory, reports and export counts). Payroll Staff can no longer approve leave, and HR can no longer approve overtime, so the tests' reviewers changed to the supervisor.
- **Not built yet (phase 2):** ~~clock in/out, salary tracker~~ (done in section 17), ~~the new ticket types (promotion, merit increase, bonus, disciplinary/unpaid leave), team schedules~~ (done in section 19), ~~gross-to-net with allowances and voluntary deductions, disbursement and remittance~~ (done in section 18), ~~onboarding/offboarding~~ (done in section 20), ~~government details with admin approval~~ (done in section 21), and ~~system configuration~~ (roles and rates done in section 22; payroll policy and security settings not built). Also roles in Firebase mode.
- Results: Java **494**, browser logic **70**, end-to-end **20/20** (run twice), build OK, `npm audit` 0 vulnerabilities.

function setWorkflowStatus(id, message, error = false) {
  const element = document.getElementById(id);
  element.textContent = message;
  element.classList.toggle('workflow-error', error);
  element.classList.toggle('workflow-success', Boolean(message) && !error);
}

function showAttendanceMessage(message) {
  attendanceRows.replaceChildren();
  const row = document.createElement('tr');
  const cell = document.createElement('td');
  cell.colSpan = 6;
  cell.className = 'table-message';
  cell.textContent = message;
  row.append(cell);
  attendanceRows.append(row);
}

function applyDefaultAttendanceRange(records) {
  if (!records.length || attendanceFrom.value || attendanceTo.value) return;
  const dates = records.map(record => String(record.date))
    .filter(date => /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date))
    .sort();
  if (!dates.length) return;
  
  
  attendanceFrom.value = dates[0];
  attendanceTo.value = dates[dates.length - 1];
}

function renderAttendanceMetrics(metrics) {
  const list = document.getElementById('attendance-metrics');
  list.replaceChildren();
  const rows = metricsRows(metrics);
  document.getElementById('attendance-metrics-range').textContent = rows.length ? `${metrics.from} – ${metrics.to}` : 'No attendance in this range';
  rows.forEach(([label, value]) => {
    const term = document.createElement('dt');
    term.textContent = label;
    const description = document.createElement('dd');
    description.textContent = value;
    list.append(term, description);
  });
}

function renderRawAttendanceSummary(records) {
  const dates = records.map(record => String(record.date)).filter(date => /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date)).sort();
  document.getElementById('attendance-summary-count').textContent = String(records.length).padStart(2, '0');
  document.getElementById('attendance-summary-first').textContent = dates[0] || '—';
  document.getElementById('attendance-summary-last').textContent = dates[dates.length - 1] || '—';
  const overviewCount = document.getElementById('overview-attendance-count');
  if (overviewCount) overviewCount.textContent = String(records.length).padStart(2, '0');
}

  renderAttendanceCalendar(state.rawAttendance);

function selectAttendanceCalendarDate(date) {
  const status = document.getElementById('attendance-calendar-selection-status');
  if (!attendanceCalendarSelectionStart || attendanceCalendarSelectionEnd) {
    attendanceCalendarSelectionStart = date;
    attendanceCalendarSelectionEnd = '';
    status.textContent = `Start date ${date} selected. Choose an end date; no attendance status or hours are inferred.`;
    renderAttendanceCalendar(state.rawAttendance);
    return;
  }
  const from = date < attendanceCalendarSelectionStart ? date : attendanceCalendarSelectionStart;
  const to = date < attendanceCalendarSelectionStart ? attendanceCalendarSelectionStart : date;
  attendanceCalendarSelectionStart = from;
  attendanceCalendarSelectionEnd = to;
  attendanceFrom.value = from;
  attendanceTo.value = to;
  status.textContent = `Applied inclusive raw-record range ${from} through ${to}; no days or hours were calculated.`;

    document.getElementById('attendance-report-export').disabled = true;
    status.textContent = error.message || 'Could not load the raw attendance report.';
    status.hidden = false;
  }
}

async function loadEmployees() {
  const requestNumber = ++state.requestNumber;
  const query = search.value.trim();
  showTableMessage('Loading employee records…');
  resultCount.textContent = 'Loading';
  try {
    const url = query ? `/api/employees?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}` : '/api/employees';
    const response = await fetch(url, { headers: await apiHeaders() });
    const payload = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(payload.error || `Request failed (${response.status})`);
    if (!payload || !Array.isArray(payload.items)) throw new Error('Unexpected employee response');
    if (requestNumber !== state.requestNumber) return;
    state.employees = payload.items;
    state.totalEmployees = Number.isInteger(payload.total) ? payload.total : payload.items.length;
    if (!query) {
      state.allEmployees = payload.items;
      populateAttendanceEmployees();
      populateWorkflowEmployees();
      renderDirectoryViews();
    }
    renderEmployees();
  } catch (error) {
    if (requestNumber !== state.requestNumber) return;
    state.employees = [];
    state.allEmployees = [];
    populateAttendanceEmployees();
    populateWorkflowEmployees();
    renderDirectoryViews();
    renderEmployees();
    showTableMessage(error.message || 'Could not reach the Java service. Check that the prototype server is running, then refresh.');
    resultCount.textContent = 'Could not load records';
  }
}

function applyWorkflowItem(collection, item, storage) {
  const current = state.workflow[collection];
  const index = current.findIndex(existing => existing.id === item.id);
  const next = [...current];
  if (index < 0) next.unshift(item);
  else next[index] = item;

function renderWorkflowSummary() {
  const summaryRows = workflowSummaryRows(state.workflow.leaveRequests, state.workflow.tickets);
  const body = document.getElementById('workflow-summary-rows');
  body.replaceChildren();
  if (!summaryRows.length) {
    showWorkflowTableMessage(body, 3, 'No imported workflow records are available for this summary.');
  } else {
    summaryRows.forEach(summary => {
      const row = document.createElement('tr');
      [summary.category, summary.label, String(summary.recordCount)].forEach(value => row.append(makeCell(value)));
      body.append(row);
    });
  }
  const recordTotal = state.workflow.leaveRequests.length + state.workflow.tickets.length;
  document.getElementById('workflow-summary-count').textContent = `${summaryRows.length} stored-label rows · ${recordTotal} workflow records`;
  document.getElementById('workflow-summary-export').disabled = summaryRows.length === 0;
}

async function downloadWithSession(url, filename) {

const STORAGE_MODE_LABELS = {
  file: 'Local file store',
  firestore: 'Firestore',
  memory: 'Memory only'
};
let storageMode = '';

function storageModeLabel() {
  return STORAGE_MODE_LABELS[storageMode] || 'Saved on this server';
}

/** Read the backend once per session so labels describe the real store, not an assumption. */
async function loadStorageMode() {
  try {
    const response = await fetch('/api/health', { headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });
    const health = await response.json();
    storageMode = health.persistence || '';
    const label = document.getElementById('employee-storage-mode');
    if (label && state.account) label.textContent = storageModeLabel();
    const build = document.getElementById('build-persistence');
    if (build) build.textContent = storageModeLabel();
  } catch {
    storageMode = '';
  }
}

export function storageSummary(payload) {
  const counts = ['storeCount', 'employeeRecords', 'attendanceRecords', 'activePayslips'];
  if (!payload || !['firestore', 'file', 'memory'].includes(payload.backend)
      || counts.some(key => !Number.isInteger(payload[key]) || payload[key] < 0)) {
    throw new TypeError('Unexpected storage status response.');
  }
  const location = payload.backend === 'firestore' ? 'Firestore' : payload.backend === 'file' ? 'local file' : 'memory only';
  const saved = payload.durable ? 'durable store configured' : 'not durable';
  const readiness = payload.writeReady ? 'writes enabled' : 'writes paused';
  return `${location} · ${saved} · ${readiness} · ${payload.storeCount} state stores · ${payload.employeeRecords} employees · ${payload.attendanceRecords} attendance rows · ${payload.activePayslips} active payslips`;
}

export function verificationSummary(result) {
  if (!result || typeof result.backend !== 'string' || result.readBeforeWrite !== true
      || result.stateMatchedBeforeWrite !== true || result.writeCommitted !== true || result.readBackMatched !== true) {
    throw new TypeError('Storage round-trip did not return all verification checks.');
  }
  const at = result.verifiedAt || 'time unavailable';
  return `PASS · ${result.backend} read matched the running state, an unchanged snapshot was committed, and read-back matched at ${at}. No employee or payroll values were changed.`;
}

export function initAdminStorage(apiJson, getAccount) {
  const status = document.getElementById('storage-status');
  if (!status) return { refresh() {} };
  const button = document.getElementById('storage-verify');
  const verification = document.getElementById('storage-verification');
  const backendLabel = document.getElementById('storage-backend-label');
  const say = (element, message, isError = false) => {
    element.textContent = message;
    element.classList.toggle('payroll-preview-error', isError);
  };

  async function refresh() {
    if ((getAccount() || {}).role !== 'ADMIN') {
      button.disabled = true;
      return;
    }
    try {
      const payload = await apiJson('/api/admin/storage');
      say(status, storageSummary(payload), !payload.writeReady);
      backendLabel.textContent = payload.backend === 'firestore' ? 'FIRESTORE' : payload.backend === 'file' ? 'LOCAL FILE' : 'MEMORY ONLY';
      backendLabel.classList.toggle('payroll-preview-error', !payload.durable);
      button.disabled = !payload.durable || !payload.writeReady;
      if (payload.lastVerification) say(verification, verificationSummary(payload.lastVerification));
      else say(verification, 'No successful round-trip verification has been recorded in this server process.');
    } catch (error) {
      button.disabled = true;
      backendLabel.textContent = 'UNAVAILABLE';
      backendLabel.classList.add('workstream-status-warning');
      say(status, error.message, true);
    }
  }

  button.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    button.disabled = true;
    say(verification, 'Checking the configured store. The unchanged state will be written and read back.');
    try {
      const result = await apiJson('/api/admin/storage/verify', { confirm: 'VERIFY' });
      say(verification, verificationSummary(result));
      await refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      say(verification, error.message, true);
      await refresh();
    }
  });

  return { refresh };
}

export function auditRows(entries) {
  return entries.map(entry => [entry.at.replace('T', ' '), entry.actor, `${entry.method} ${entry.path}`, entry.target || '—', String(entry.status)]);
}

export function accountSecurityText(account) {
  if (account.lockedUntil) return `Locked until ${account.lockedUntil.slice(11, 16)}`;
  const parts = [account.defaultPassword ? 'Shared default password' : account.passwordChangedAt ? `Own password since ${account.passwordChangedAt.slice(0, 10)}` : 'Own password'];
  if (account.failedAttempts) parts.push(`${account.failedAttempts} wrong recently`);
  return parts.join(' · ');
}

function fillRows(tbody, rows, columns, emptyText) {
  tbody.replaceChildren();
  if (!rows.length) {
    const row = document.createElement('tr');
    const cell = document.createElement('td');
    cell.colSpan = columns;
    cell.className = 'table-message';
    cell.textContent = emptyText;
    row.append(cell);
    tbody.append(row);
    return;
  }
  rows.forEach(values => {
    const row = document.createElement('tr');
    values.forEach(value => {
      const cell = document.createElement('td');
      if (value instanceof Node) cell.append(value);
      else cell.textContent = value;
      row.append(cell);
    });
    tbody.append(row);
  });
}

function actionButton(label, data) {
  const button = document.createElement('button');
  button.type = 'button';
  button.className = 'button button-quiet workflow-cancel';
  button.textContent = label;
  Object.assign(button.dataset, data);
  button.setAttribute('aria-label', `${label} ${data.employeeId || data.backup || ''}`.trim());
  return button;
}

export const ROLE_OPTIONS = [['EMPLOYEE', 'Employee'], ['SUPERVISOR', 'Supervisor'], ['PAYROLL', 'Payroll Staff'], ['HR', 'HR'], ['ADMIN', 'System Admin']];

export function rateSummary(version) {
  return `SSS ${version.sss.employeePercent}% / ${version.sss.employerPercent}% (MSC ₱${version.sss.minMsc}–₱${version.sss.maxMsc}) · `
    + `PhilHealth ${version.philHealth.premiumPercent}% (₱${version.philHealth.floor}–₱${version.philHealth.ceiling}) · `
    + `Pag-IBIG ${version.pagIbig.lowPercent}% ≤ ₱${version.pagIbig.lowBand}, else ${version.pagIbig.highPercent}% (cap ₱${version.pagIbig.cap}) · `
    + `${version.bir.length} tax brackets, top ${version.bir[version.bir.length - 1].ratePercent}%`;
}

export function birRows(rows) {
  return rows.filter(row => row.over !== '' || row.baseTax !== '' || row.ratePercent !== '');
}

const RATE_FIELDS = [
  ['sss', 'employeePercent'], ['sss', 'employerPercent'], ['sss', 'minMsc'], ['sss', 'maxMsc'],
  ['philHealth', 'premiumPercent'], ['philHealth', 'floor'], ['philHealth', 'ceiling'],
  ['pagIbig', 'lowBand'], ['pagIbig', 'lowPercent'], ['pagIbig', 'highPercent'], ['pagIbig', 'employerPercent'], ['pagIbig', 'cap']
];

function fill(select, values) {
  const current = select.value;
  select.replaceChildren();
  values.forEach(([value, label]) => {
    const option = document.createElement('option');
    option.value = value;
    option.textContent = label;
    select.append(option);
  });
  if (values.some(([value]) => value === current)) select.value = current;
}

function table(tbody, rows) {
  tbody.replaceChildren();
  rows.forEach(values => {
    const row = document.createElement('tr');
    values.forEach(value => {
      const cell = document.createElement('td');
      if (value instanceof Node) cell.append(value);
      else cell.textContent = value;
      row.append(cell);
    });
    tbody.append(row);
  });
}

function say(target, message, isError = false) {
  target.textContent = message;
  target.classList.toggle('payroll-preview-error', isError);
}

export function initAdminConfig(apiJson, getAccount) {
  if (!document.getElementById('config-view')) return { refresh() {} };
  const value = id => document.getElementById(id).value.trim();
  let accounts = [];

  async function refreshRoles() {
    const payload = await apiJson('/api/admin/roles');
    accounts = payload.accounts;
    const me = getAccount();
    fill(document.getElementById('role-employee'), accounts.filter(item => !me || item.employeeId !== me.employeeId)
      .map(item => [item.employeeId, `${item.employeeId} — ${item.name}`]));
    fill(document.getElementById('role-supervisor'), [['', 'No supervisor'], ...accounts.filter(item => item.role === 'SUPERVISOR')
      .map(item => [item.employeeId, `${item.employeeId} — ${item.name}`])]);
    syncRoleForm();
    table(document.getElementById('role-rows'), accounts.map(item => [`${item.employeeId} — ${item.name}`, item.position, item.roleLabel,
      item.supervisorId || '—', item.status]));
    table(document.getElementById('role-log-rows'), payload.changes.map(change => [change.at, change.by, change.employeeId, change.before, change.after]));
  }

  function syncRoleForm() {
    const chosen = accounts.find(item => item.employeeId === document.getElementById('role-employee').value);
    if (!chosen) return;
    document.getElementById('role-role').value = chosen.role;
    document.getElementById('role-supervisor').value = chosen.supervisorId;
  }

  async function refreshRates() {
    const payload = await apiJson('/api/rate-proposals');
    const me = getAccount();
    document.getElementById('rates-submit').textContent = me && me.role === 'PAYROLL' ? 'Propose for approval' : 'Save as new version';
    table(document.getElementById('proposal-rows'), payload.proposals.map(item => {
      let result = item.status === 'Pending review' ? 'Pending review' : `${item.status}: ${item.outcome}`;
      if (me && me.role === 'ADMIN' && item.status === 'Pending review' && item.proposedBy !== me.employeeId) {
        result = document.createElement('span');
        result.className = 'workflow-row-actions';
        ['approve', 'reject'].forEach(decision => {
          const button = document.createElement('button');
          button.type = 'button';
          button.className = 'button button-quiet workflow-cancel';
          button.textContent = decision === 'approve' ? 'Approve' : 'Reject';
          button.dataset.proposalId = item.id;
          button.dataset.decision = decision;
          button.setAttribute('aria-label', `${button.textContent} ${item.id}`);
          result.append(button);
        });
      }
      return [item.id, item.effectiveMonth, item.note || '—', item.proposedBy, result];
    }));
    table(document.getElementById('rates-rows'), payload.versions.map(version => [version.id + (version.id === payload.inForce ? ' (in force now)' : ''),
      version.effectiveMonth, rateSummary(version), version.note, version.createdBy || 'Built in']));
    
    const current = payload.versions.find(version => version.id === payload.inForce) || payload.versions[0];
    RATE_FIELDS.forEach(([group, key]) => { document.getElementById(`rate-${group}-${key}`).value = current[group][key]; });
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const row = current.bir[i] || { over: '', baseTax: '', ratePercent: '' };
      document.getElementById(`bir-${i}-over`).value = row.over;
      document.getElementById(`bir-${i}-baseTax`).value = row.baseTax;
      document.getElementById(`bir-${i}-ratePercent`).value = row.ratePercent;
    }
  }

  async function refresh() {
    const account = getAccount();
    if (!account || !['ADMIN', 'PAYROLL'].includes(account.role)) return;
    try {
      await Promise.all([account.role === 'ADMIN' ? refreshRoles() : null, refreshRates()]);
    } catch (error) {
      say(document.getElementById('role-status'), error.message, true);
    }
  }

  document.getElementById('role-employee').addEventListener('change', syncRoleForm);
  document.getElementById('role-form').addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const status = document.getElementById('role-status');
    try {
      const { change } = await apiJson(`/api/admin/roles/${encodeURIComponent(value('role-employee'))}`,
        { role: value('role-role'), supervisorId: value('role-supervisor') });
      say(status, `${change.employeeId}: ${change.before} → ${change.after}. It applies at their next sign-in.`);
      await refreshRoles();
    } catch (error) {
      say(status, error.message, true);
    }
  });

  document.getElementById('rates-form').addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const status = document.getElementById('rates-status');
    try {
      const body = { effectiveMonth: value('rates-month'), note: value('rates-note'), sss: {}, philHealth: {}, pagIbig: {} };
      RATE_FIELDS.forEach(([group, key]) => { body[group][key] = value(`rate-${group}-${key}`); });
      body.bir = birRows([...Array(8).keys()].map(i => ({ over: value(`bir-${i}-over`), baseTax: value(`bir-${i}-baseTax`), ratePercent: value(`bir-${i}-ratePercent`) })));
      if ((getAccount() || {}).role === 'PAYROLL') {
        const { item } = await apiJson('/api/rate-proposals', body);
        say(status, `Filed ${item.id} for ${item.effectiveMonth}; it waits for the System Admin's approval.`);
      } else {
        const { version } = await apiJson('/api/admin/rates', body);
        say(status, `Saved ${version.id}, effective ${version.effectiveMonth}. Payslips from that month use it; finalized payslips keep theirs.`);
      }
      await refreshRates();
    } catch (error) {
      say(status, error.message, true);
    }
  });

  document.getElementById('proposal-rows').addEventListener('click', async event => {
    const button = event.target.closest('button[data-proposal-id]');
    if (!button) return;
    const status = document.getElementById('rates-status');
    try {
      const { item } = await apiJson(`/api/rate-proposals/${encodeURIComponent(button.dataset.proposalId)}/${button.dataset.decision}`, {});
      say(status, `${item.id} ${item.status.toLowerCase()}. ${item.outcome}`);
      await refreshRates();
    } catch (error) {
      say(status, error.message, true);
    }
  });

  document.getElementById('reset-form').addEventListener('submit', async event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const status = document.getElementById('reset-status');
    try {
      await apiJson('/api/admin/reset', { confirm: value('reset-confirm') });
      say(status, 'Saved data reset. Reloading…');
      sessionStorage.clear();
      window.location.reload();
    } catch (error) {
      say(status, error.message, true);
    }
  });

  const PERSISTENCE_LABELS = {
    file: 'SAVED TO FILE',
    firestore: 'SAVED TO FIRESTORE',
    memory: 'MEMORY ONLY'
  };

  async function refreshPersistence() {
    const health = await apiJson('/api/health');
    document.getElementById('persistence-label').textContent =
      PERSISTENCE_LABELS[health.persistence] || 'UNKNOWN';
  }

  const refreshAll = async () => {
    await refresh();
    const account = getAccount();
    if (account && account.role === 'ADMIN') await refreshPersistence().catch(() => {});
  };

  return { refresh: refreshAll };
}
